name: awesome-dsh-plugin
desc: A curated list of plugins for DeepSeek Harness (dsh) · DeepSeek Harness 插件精选列表

resources.name: Anmulzhao/DSH-AGINT
resources.desc: Self-evolving agent framework on DeepSeek Harness (dsh): 40 Cordis plugins and 4 presets covering memory, reflection, gates, metrics and an auditable evolution loop. Not a one-command install. Clone the repo and run install/install.sh --profile=web (needs bash, Node 20+, python3, DSH 0.1.7-rc.1 or newer with an initialized profile), then restart.

resources.name: AnonyJcy/dsh-j-space
resources.desc: J-Space Cognition Suite SV1 native agent preset and standalone Cordis plugin: 13 modules, persistent controller and decoupled workspace.

resources.name: Asiu-x/dsh-harness2
resources.desc: Harness² recursive self-improvement for DSH agents: Propose–Probe–Compose, isolated probes, anonymous selection, and a per-domain experience library.

resources.name: benrong2048-boop/dsh-prompt-polish
resources.desc: Turns a one-line DSH draft into a complete task brief (role / goal / constraints / output format). The engine is a byte-verified port of linshenkx/prompt-optimizer (three modes, 10 templates identical to upstream); history is consent-gated with version chains and structural comparison; every run reports its token usage. Nothing is written back or sent without a click.

resources.name: burning-frappuccino/dsh-turbo
resources.desc: Per-session execution gears for the DSH composer: an OVERDRIVE toggle turns Turbo on for the current session only, the Fast and Max gears swap the agent's planning and verification policy and may lower the request's reasoning effort, and the Host keeps the authoritative mode plus per-turn latency, step count, tool calls and whether a verification command ran.

resources.name: dsh-answer-reviewer
resources.desc: Agentic answer reviewer for DeepSeek Harness: each final assistant turn is re-reviewed by a separate LLM graded 1-100; below-threshold scores steer the agent back with concrete feedback. The score is shown as a chip on the answer's action row (green pass / red needs-work, with retry count and reason on hover). Live gate config from the Reviewer 配置 tab in the conversation view ring above the composer (对话 / 轨迹 / 记忆系统 / Reviewer 配置), from a 127.0.0.1 HTTP server, or from an optional right-sidebar tab via dsh-better-sidebar.

resources.name: CAI-MH/dsh-quality-review
resources.desc: Audit each finished assistant turn with an independent reviewer model and steer the agent to fix failed output, with at most 2 review rounds per turn and SOP-folder standards injected as an extra review dimension.

resources.name: CanaryJing/dsh-big-fat-whale-maid-adaptive
resources.desc: Agent preset with adaptive tool presentation and environment-aware shell routing. Ports modules from yjh051108/dsh-routing-suite and xiaobright/dsh-anchored-standard (the former is listed here), so do not enable it alongside those presets.

resources.name: ccll/dsh-advisor-flow
resources.desc: Executor/advisor workflow ported from pi-advisor-flow: the executor calls ask_advisor for a second opinion at key decisions, after repeated failures and before completion; equivalent repeated tool calls are intercepted before execution for an advisor review with a proceed/revise/blocked verdict, and hard mode force-reviews every turn before it closes. Per-call token and cost ledger with /advisor status readout, privacy tiers for repo context and file contents, six-shape secret redaction, and a web settings card; advisor failures never stall the main loop.

resources.name: Clearailhc/clearai-dsh
resources.desc: An agent preset for evidence-checked research: every step advances only through system-verified observations, L3+ claims go to an independent evaluator, and the session folds into a replayable ledger that grows into a browsable domain ontology. Requires DSH >=0.1.7-alpha.1.

resources.name: DDL095/dsh-moa-native
resources.desc: Native generation-time Mixture-of-Agents: every turn, reference models run the same session context in parallel as pre-run drafts and one aggregator executes with full tooling; config-as-model recipes, F mirror / R trimmed views, subagent gating, derived per-recipe vision (vision refs relay image reads to text-only aggregators).

resources.name: DoreiHime/dsh-help-me-to-ask
resources.desc: On the first real work message of each chat window, asks for the missing goal, deliverable, constraints and acceptance criteria, then turns the answers into a short task sheet and injects it into the chat. Pure greetings are ignored.

resources.name: FelixJiashengFu/dsh-force-collab
resources.desc: Forced collaboration: a composer picker sets 0–6 sub-agents, and while it is on every hands-on task must be split across exactly that many child agents through a collab_fanout tool that has no count parameter, then merged by the main agent.

resources.name: FelixJiashengFu/dsh-muse-code
resources.desc: Meta's Muse Code CLI inside DSH: a composer switch starts muse serve, a right-sidebar panel and five chat tools (muse_open, muse_prompt, muse_read, muse_status, muse_interrupt) share one Muse session, approvals are decided only in the panel, and a local spend guard hard-stops at $10 by default. Windows only; needs the Muse Code CLI installed and signed in. The $10 cap is a local estimate for the muse serve this plugin starts.

resources.name: ff66ccff/dsh-ATN
resources.desc: Adaptive topology multi-agent preset for DeepSeek Harness with peer messaging, task handoff and live network visualization.

resources.name: Funny1Potato/dsh-outsourcing-expert
resources.desc: Agent presets whose leader does no work itself: every non-management tool call is denied at the harness boundary so the task has to go to a subagent, after a one-time lookup of the available subagent models and a per-task model choice; a second preset deliberately picks the model least suited to the task.

resources.name: FuRongJun-1999/dsh-memory
resources.desc: White-box AGI architecture exploration: metacognition (self-cognition loop), continual learning (knowledge flywheel), world model (condition space, spatiotemporal memory graph), self-improvement (bootstrap discipline), zero-LLM white-box pipeline, and auditable trust guardrails.

resources.name: HYClub/deepseek-harness-game-studios
resources.desc: DeepSeek Harness port of Claude Code Game Studios (CCGS v1.1.2, MIT): 76 skills, 49 agents, hook bridge.

resources.name: icyaaaww/dsh-soul
resources.desc: Records recurring task corrections and tool failures locally, then compiles them into changes to eight harness components through explicitly started evolution, paired baseline/candidate checks, trial activation and rollback. Includes a budget and audit ledger; requires Node.js 24+ and a compatible DSH 0.2.1-rc.2 or later 0.2.x host.

resources.name: JiewiW/dsh-cot-anchor
resources.desc: Injects conclusions already established in the previous reasoning block after each tool result, so the model continues from them instead of re-deriving the same conclusions.

resources.name: jiuaiwo/dsh-expert
resources.desc: Expert roster for DeepSeek Harness: 636 experts across 22 divisions with full Chinese names and bios, summoned as subagents from the @ menu or by the model through list_t_experts / summon_t_expert / summon_t_experts, plus custom experts and a skill on/off switch.

resources.name: dsh-proactive
resources.desc: Host-level proactive wake-ups for DeepSeek Harness: the model schedules its own alarms (once, recurring interval, or cron, with optional random jitter), cold sessions are woken on time by session resume, model-initiated follow-ups are gated by quiet hours and a daily delivery budget, silent wake turns end with proactive_reclaim and fold out of model context as tombstones, declared schedule files glob-sync JSON schedules into host alarms idempotently, min_idle_seconds defers wakes until the destination session quiets down, and a web panel (settings section plus per-session tab, SSE live refresh) manages alarms and wake history — the heartbeat engine for AI companions and roleplay characters with their own daily routines and world evolution.

resources.name: john-walks-slow/dsh-simulated-life
resources.desc: Simulated life context for DeepSeek Harness: every turn injects the past 24h of simulated life events from the workspace .life/ directory (sliding-window filter, session-level deduplication with delta updates, world summary) as a collapsed context notice, and the life_react tool lets the agent record feelings, thoughts and actions back into its life log for the next round of world evolution — turning a DSH agent into a roleplay character with a persistent daily life.

resources.name: Jonah-Wu23/dsh-gungnir#dsh-plugin
resources.desc: Evidence-driven goal verification plugin for DeepSeek Harness. Locks goals via /ultragoal and verifies completion against command exit codes and generated artifacts, preventing the model from falsely reporting task completion.

resources.name: Kanadego/dsh-heartbeat
resources.desc: Heartbeat loop for DeepSeek Harness: every 20 minutes (by default) the agent wakes on its own to keep a local profile of your interests and preferences, search the web for things you care about, and keep what it finds. When it has something worth sharing, it sends a short package of notes to the sessions you link it to. A set of rules in code - quiet hours, busy windows, a daily limit, a cooldown - decides whether it may speak at all, and the agent in that session decides whether to actually say anything. Windows only.

resources.name: kenz1117/dsh-engram
resources.desc: Cross-session long-term memory as a local SQLite store: dual scopes (user + per-git-origin project), hybrid FTS5 + local-vector retrieval fused with RRF, an evidence gate that forces an explicit sufficiency judgement, provenance audit chains, SM-2 spaced-repetition review, consolidation distillation and decay forgetting, and a nine-view "Memory Palace" sidebar panel. 22 narrow-parameter tools, no external service, no API key, no Docker.

resources.name: leeyoung1/dsh-advisor-plugin
resources.desc: Pairs the running executor with a stronger reviewer model through zero-parameter advisor() calls and step-based patrol checks, returning plan, correction, or stop guidance.

resources.name: lifangjin/dsh-maoying
resources.desc: Web-novel writing assistant preset for DeepSeek Harness: the main agent acts as editor-in-chief and delegates outlining, drafting, review, lore-keeping and research to five helpers across a seven-phase workflow, with the whole novel kept as a structured markdown/YAML novel/ directory (character cards, a foreshadowing state machine, timeline, narrative memory), plus a sidebar creator panel and six zero-dependency CLI commands.

resources.name: LittleAlety/dsh-team-conductor
resources.desc: Control plane for the harness's own Agent Teams: members are ordinary independent sessions created through the same seam the GUI uses, each with its own model, so they open and continue like any other conversation while a sidecar roster and task board coordinate them. Task entries carry a definition of done, a member's completion is submitted and waits for the Lead's review, and availability tells idle apart from awaiting-review or a failed last turn. With delegationEngine=auto it uses independent sessions, continuable subagents, or the kernel roster depending on what the composition provides.

resources.name: mazov2love/dsh-remote-control
resources.desc: Let Agents directly control independent local DSH instances with zero intrusion—no plugins or components required on the target. Isolated environments enable autonomous configuration and testing, while Agents with different models and personalities can chat, role-play, or form nested control chains. Supports conversational setup, user-like operations, incremental reading, saved references, and remote session/workspace search.

resources.name: MichengAI/dsh-pua
resources.desc: Adds /pua to steer the agent to try another approach and verify results before claiming completion, with 15 company styles, persona modes, global and per-conversation settings, and an optional loop that continues until a verification command passes, the iteration limit is reached, or the user cancels.

resources.name: mrzturn/dsh-switchman
resources.desc: Turns the main model into a dispatcher: six pools (economy/mechanical/main/hard/vision/review) route each subtask to the right model, with ranking and per-route reasoning-effort pins. A context watermark (50k/90k/130k) nudges delegation early and, at the force level, forks a backup session, writes a handover doc, compacts, and continues without losing in-flight subagent work; /ctx-pause, /ctx-resume and /ctx-handover pause, resume or trigger the same machinery by hand. Optional Agent Teams mode adds persistent teammates and a shared task board; /vision lets text-only models handle images via the vision pool; tiered verification sends bigger diffs to a tester and an independent reviewer. Settings UI, READMEs and the conversation / code-comment / document language preferences all cover the same 11 languages (en, zh, zh-TW, ja, ko, de, es, fr, it, pt, ru); the plugin UI follows the DSH app locale unless forced otherwise. Bundles three skills: read-only MySQL/Redis verification, commit-message generation, and a requirements/design document convention.

resources.name: NEINC1/muche-dsh-plugin
resources.desc: Chat panel for the MuChe companion with per-user backend settings, plus an outbound bridge that runs tasks on the user's local dsh.

resources.name: nlflora/dsh-empty-turn-guard
resources.desc: Recovers a DeepSeek Harness turn that ended with reasoning only, with no text and no tool call, by steering the same turn one more step. Structure-only detection, so it costs no extra model call.

resources.name: panando/dsh-pua
resources.desc: Fork of @michengai/dsh-pua that removes the upstream global kill-switch so the composer entry is always visible while the feature stays off by default and can be toggled per session; the entry is a dropdown (Turn on / Turn off / Options) with a more compact options panel.

resources.name: pk14742952-AD/dsh-host-rsi
resources.desc: Reflective self-evolution plugin for local Qwen3.8 27B/3.8 Flash and online APIs: a coding-loop convergence steerer curbs Qwen3.8 27B/Flash repeated-verification deep-thinking to converge faster and cut thinking time; a five-state delivery guard detects and corrects stuck turns and infinite loops; model-agnostic host logic, mostly compatible with online APIs; per-use continual self-improvement with counter-reason self-checks, critic escalation, inverted-index memory retrieval, coding-loop convergence steering, and a five-state delivery guard.

resources.name: qian-dsh/dsh-as-mcp-server
resources.desc: Exposes DSH as an MCP server so another agent can watch its thinking, tool calls and file writes in real time, share intent, take a floor lock that denies DSH's write/edit/git tools, inject mid-turn alerts, and delegate reviews.

resources.name: qian-dsh/dsh-outer-brain
resources.desc: A philosopher's way of thinking made executable: dialectics and practice-testing to govern hallucination and long-session drift, so done is a verifiable fact rather than a claim.

resources.name: Qulierm/orbital-agents
resources.desc: Persistent Endeavour and Challenger peer sessions for DeepSeek Harness that plan, execute sequential tasks, and verify reported results.

resources.name: rootsbymenda/dsh-second-angle
resources.desc: Checks each claim in a finished answer against the tool output that same turn read: a contradiction whose quote is found in that output steers one correction in the same turn, and claims the output does not back are flagged in the session log and on stderr. A free scan for absolute words and unmatched numbers runs first, and a turn that ran no tool never reaches the model.

resources.name: samirliu/dsh-goalloop-agentteams
resources.desc: Deterministic goal-completion gate for DSH: a contract-first AC grammar with named failable check commands, a gate that re-runs every check itself (zero model trust), verdicts bound to a tree digest so file changes void passing verdicts, and a hard deny on false completion at update_goal via tools/pre-execute with a false-complete counter that blocks after two catches; scope-aware task-level claim handling (strict or goal-only) keeps multi-task Agent Teams loops from deadlocking.

resources.name: sososilencing/dsh-network-engineer
resources.desc: Standalone Network Engineer Assistant agent preset plus a bundled 32-doc command knowledge base skill for DPtech, H3C, Huawei and Ruijie switches and routers: KB-first retrieval, cross-vendor command translation, topology and CLI-output screenshot reading, online manual lookup with cited sources, and mandatory risk annotations for dangerous commands; answers networking topics only.

resources.name: STARDUSTLC666/dsh-dream
resources.desc: Experience memory and reflection for DSH agents: automatically extracts candidate lessons after tasks and recalls user-reviewed lessons in relevant later tasks. Supports source provenance, project-scoped retrieval, conflict handling, usage feedback and expiry review; capture and recall have separate controls, and writing lessons to AGENTS.md requires preview and explicit application. A step-by-step first-run guide (4 steps) now opens inside its settings panel.

resources.name: starkingcn/dsh-story#story-mode
resources.desc: Story Mode preset for DeepSeek Harness: role-play GM persona, three-way choices, .md character cards and world book, context distillation and prompt wrapping.

resources.name: StellaryToucher/dsh-muse-code
resources.desc: Adds a muse subagent provider and the subagent_muse tool to DeepSeek Harness, so the main agent can hand one self-contained task to the Meta Muse Code CLI and get back only its final report. A patched fork of @pascapone/dsh-muse-code that loads on DSH 0.2.1: it carries local equivalents of the removed settleRun export and subagents.start method, and documents an optional proxy for the gateway stream-phase bug. Needs the muse CLI installed. Install either this fork or the upstream @pascapone/dsh-muse-code, not both: both register the same subagent-muse loader row.

resources.name: syyr1987/dsh-linghun
resources.desc: A judgment core for DeepSeek Harness: a cognition loop that gives every decision a source and attribution and drives planning to a close, hippocampus memory that condenses running experience into knowledge (journal ledger, episodic archive, low-confidence decay), judgment identity responsibilities in the architecture (consistent rubric, judgment bound to its source), and an A2A memory-management team via dsh-linghun-assembler. Requires DSH ^0.1.0-rc.7 (rc.2 supported).

resources.name: syyr1987/dsh-linghun-assembler
resources.desc: Memory-assembly team for DeepSeek Harness: every message triggers a five-step cognition loop (judge, retrieve, assemble, feedback, calibrate) carried by role-playing subagents (judge, retriever, archivist, advocate, editor, scribe), using BM25 retrieval, time-ordered material, and LLM assembly to build useful material packs injected into linghun. Works with dsh-linghun.

resources.name: Tests4gptplay/deepseek-servant
resources.desc: Autonomous AI assistant with Foreground, Planner and Worker roles, persistent tasks, restart recovery, on-demand working memory, and optional private-Git collaboration.

resources.name: Tisitan/dsh-my-go
resources.desc: Multi-agent orchestration preset: a lead agent dispatches subagents from a built-in role roster over separate read and write lane pools with per-role model binding, and collects each subagent report on a shared board; adds go_work/continue/need_help/forward tools, a tree-view panel and a settings page.

resources.name: WDahah/portable-dsh-multi-agent-plugin
resources.desc: Route each task to one model and its review to a different one, with qualification evidence, failover and a durable journal.

resources.name: ws1234567891011/dsh-interim-narration
resources.desc: Makes the agent narrate its process: every turn opens with how it reads the message and what it will do first, then short interim notes between tool-call batches, with in-app settings for style, sentence cap and toggles.

resources.name: wuanthony397-hash/dsh-codex-peer
resources.desc: Peer collaboration between a DeepSeek Harness agent and the local Codex CLI: split a goal into a shared work list, hand tasks over, review what comes back, and keep every prompt, event stream, and answer on disk.

resources.name: yunxiyang/dsh-loop-continue
resources.desc: Resumes an agent turn that ended after narrating its next action without calling a tool: the guard replays the turn log on agent/turn-stopping, asks a judge model one true/false question, and steers the same turn to run one more step.

resources.name: zhoulvyuan/dsh-plugin#dsh-claude-code-web
resources.desc: Claude Code-style workbench in DSH: workspace/session sidebar, streaming document-style transcript with unified tool cards and thinking, Markdown and Mermaid rendering, dark theme, and a draggable overlay panel backed by an in-host HTTP/WebSocket service.

resources.name: 01Virex/dsh-status-rotator
resources.desc: Rotates the dsh turn-status label through 1059 bilingual phrases with typewriter output, an animated rainbow gradient, danmaku, 12 toggleable theme packs, live placeholders and tab-title rotation. Two star packs ship disabled by default; the stargazer pack carries one phrase per stargazer, refreshed weekly by a workflow.

resources.name: 0imzero/dsh-workspace-menu
resources.desc: Workspace/chat context menu for the DSH home page: pin, rename, open in file explorer, archive, fork, copy, and open in a new window.

resources.name: 0x7A7A6572/dsh-forge-studio#plugin-notes
resources.desc: Sticky-notes board for DeepSeek Harness: a sidebar entry opens a Markdown note panel with auto-save, colors, image paste and task-list rendering.

resources.name: 0xsline/dsh-spotlight
resources.desc: Keyboard-first command palette for the DSH Web UI.

resources.name: 1010n111/dsh-about
resources.desc: Adds an "About" settings page to the DeepSeek Harness web interface, showing the running DSH version and recent release notes.

resources.name: 1070296335-create/dph-taskboard
resources.desc: Session-based task board in the sidebar: drag sessions into todo/doing/review/done columns, create sessions with model and reasoning-effort selection, trash with restore, notes, export/import.

resources.name: 1186258278/dsh-zh-ui
resources.desc: Chinese frontend UI design spec for dsh: injects the zh-ui-design skill and prompt rules (section-name headings, no filler copy, one signature element), plus a 10-rule UI copy/style linter.

resources.name: 13071301808/dsh-composer-expand
resources.desc: Composer expand/collapse toggle for the Web UI: a ⬆/⬇ button in the composer tool row grows the input to a tall 70vh writing view for long drafts.

resources.name: 1321928757/dsh-prompt-polish
resources.desc: Input-bar prompt optimizer: rewrites drafts with 6 strategies × 3 languages plus custom instructions, optional goal/todo/compaction-summary/tool-result and chat context, a confirm dialog, last-5 history and three-tier settings persistence.

resources.name: 13520rygvv/dsh-restart-button
resources.desc: Restarts the DeepSeek Harness desktop app from three places: a Settings row, the account menu above Sign out, and a configurable keyboard shortcut. Asks before interrupting running tasks. If a newer update is already downloaded and waiting, restarting installs it first. Windows desktop app only.

resources.name: 1420079678-ctrl/agent-body#dsh-anatomy-panel
resources.desc: Anatomy panel for the Agent-Body organs: serves a live vitals dashboard at /anatomy inside the harness itself - organs, heartbeat, healing ledger, self-training counters and the real pulse stream - read straight from the runtime files rather than retyped. Host-only, no client bundle and no build step.

resources.name: 1497105876/dsh-text-inject
resources.desc: Adds a "Text Injection" section to the DSH Settings sidebar: user-maintained blocks in a standalone Markdown file are injected into the system prompt every turn or into session context with keyword gating, with hot reload and automatic history backups.

resources.name: 1700563146/dsh-plugin-rightbar-divider
resources.desc: Restores the DSH right sidebar divider drag after whole-interface zoom shifts the host handle off it, and widens the hit area to 12px with a hover affordance.

resources.name: 1700563146/dsh-plugin-ui-zoom
resources.desc: Whole-interface zoom for the DSH Web UI from 70% to 160%, driven by Ctrl+wheel, DSH's shortcut center or an inline pill, with content-width compensation so zooming out fits more text instead of narrowing the column.

resources.name: 1834395550/dsh-chat-search
resources.desc: Find text inside the open conversation with Ctrl+F: matches are highlighted in the message text, previous/next step through them, clicking the count lists the matches and jumps to any of them, and the count grows while the scan runs. No collapsed block is opened and the reading position does not move.

resources.name: 1834395550/dsh-session-tabs
resources.desc: Browser-style Session tab bar for the DSH Web GUI - one tab per Session in a full-width strip at the top of the window, Sessions grouped per Workspace in collapsible boxes, tabs created only for the Sessions you actually open.

resources.name: 18569663yz-web/dsh-plugin-crypto-ticker
resources.desc: A live crypto ticker card in the DeepSeek Harness sidebar footer, above the balance and Settings, showing BTC, ETH, SOL and JUP prices, 24-hour change and 24-point sparklines, with a pulse on each price tick, zero dependencies and no API key.

resources.name: 18840024879/dsh-float
resources.desc: Windows desktop floating assistant for DeepSeek Harness: an always-on-top chat panel with streaming answers, model switching, and region-screenshot questions.

resources.name: 1985899182/dsh-harness-chat-control
resources.desc: Adds ChatGPT-style stop, edit-and-resend, native quote annotations, and an independent sidebar follow-up chat with model and image input for DeepSeek Harness Desktop.

resources.name: 2002XiaoYu/dsh-session-diff
resources.desc: Session-scoped diff view for the DSH Web right sidebar: opening a file the current conversation changed renders it in place with git-style added/removed line backgrounds, +/− gutter markers and dual old/new line numbers under syntax colouring, a header with +added −removed counts, a Changes only / Whole file toggle and a Re-read button, plus a companion tab that lists every file the session changed and opens each one in the same view. Files the conversation did not touch keep the shipped text viewer.

resources.name: 2026heshao/dsh-draft-attachments
resources.desc: Persists unsent composer attachments per session, so images and files pasted into the input box survive page switches, conversation switches and app restarts: the bytes are mirrored in IndexedDB and handed back through the official createDrafts/addAttachments channel, and are dropped as soon as the message is sent or you remove them.

resources.name: 2384418321/dsh-integration-settings
resources.desc: Adds two visual pages to DSH Settings. MCP servers are kept as a JSON source of truth that rewrites the profile patch managed block, with YAML validation and timestamped backups, plus import of a pasted mcpServers JSON that first lists what will be added or overwritten. Thinking unlock probes each OpenAI-compatible gateway for the reasoning efforts it really declares and writes the per-level config back while leaving other hand-written YAML byte ranges untouched; the available model list syncs from a separate button that previews additions and removals, then writes levels and models in one atomic pass, and can also run on the page schedule.

resources.name: 2404376192/dsh-dian-du
resources.desc: Marks paragraphs or a single code line in an answer and asks the model about it in a docked right-hand column, leaving the conversation itself unmodified.

resources.name: 2768651338/dsh-effort-slider
resources.desc: A Claude Code-style reasoning-effort slider for the DSH Web UI: stepless drag, snap-on-release, a WebGL fire trail, and real, working thinking-effort control for any custom third-party model or provider.

resources.name: 2nd1st/dsh-plugin-open-app
resources.desc: Runs open-mcp-apps inside DSH: every MCP app gets its own sidebar container with a separate workspace, session, and App mode, an agent status strip under the app, and inline app rendering in ordinary chats.

resources.name: 3361805598-gif/dsh-workspace-archive
resources.desc: Batch-archive or restore all conversations of a workspace from a sidebar panel or its row menu, hide a workspace from the sidebar once every conversation in it is archived, and pin workspaces to the top. Hiding never deletes logs, moves directories, or changes membership.

resources.name: 3450892121/dsh-task-monitor#dsh-task-monitor
resources.desc: Right-side overlay panel for DSH sessions showing git status, background jobs, skills and MCP usage, artifacts and visited pages, with a commit/push dialog and one-click GitHub publish.

resources.name: 379385796-sys/dsh-chat-comfort
resources.desc: Adjust chat bubbles and message spacing with comfortable or compact density on verified Windows Desktop RC2/RC3 layouts, retaining native styles for unknown host fingerprints.

resources.name: 3Tiga3/dsh-plugin-namecards
resources.desc: Icon, Chinese display name and a one-line note for every DSH plugin, organized with folders, favorites, drag or pinyin ordering, list and grid views. Icons are auto-assigned to all installed plugins and can be overridden; import and export cover icons, names, notes, folders and order. Display-only: plugin files and cordis config are never modified; enable switches call the official plugin manager.

resources.name: 439436269-ctrl/dsh-blend-preview
resources.desc: Opens .blend files in the right-Sidebar document preview: Blender headless exports a cached GLB with scene statistics, rendered by a dependency-free WebGL viewport. Requires Blender 3.6+ on PATH (or set blenderPath).

resources.name: 439436269-ctrl/dsh-pinned-sessions
resources.desc: A pinned-sessions group in the sidebar, above the workspace list: every pinned session across all workspaces in one collapsible, searchable list, with click-to-open and a hover-revealed unpin button.

resources.name: 439436269-ctrl/dsh-preview-blender
resources.desc: Open .blend files in the right-Sidebar document preview: cached Blender headless GLB export plus a dependency-free WebGL viewport and scene statistics. Requires Blender 3.6 or later installed locally.

resources.name: 439436269-ctrl/dsh-preview-media
resources.desc: Play video and audio in the right-Sidebar document preview, streamed over an authenticated HTTP Range route with desktop seek.

resources.name: 439436269-ctrl/dsh-preview-stl
resources.desc: Open STL meshes in the right-Sidebar document preview: browser-side binary/ASCII parsing, a WebGL viewport, and size/volume/surface-area/watertightness statistics.

resources.name: 439436269-ctrl/dsh-stl-preview
resources.desc: Opens STL meshes in the right-Sidebar document preview: binary/ASCII parsing in the browser, a WebGL viewport, and size, volume, surface-area and watertightness statistics.

resources.name: 5101good/amoji#amoji
resources.desc: AI-native expressions for two-way chat: people see images, while text-only models read fixed meanings; includes a picker, custom expressions, import/export, and two visual styles.

resources.name: 514006234/dsh-weekly-check#dsh-weekly-panel
resources.desc: Sidebar panel for a weekly, human-curated Chinese ranking of the DSH ecosystem: 31 tracked projects (17 installable plugins plus tools/skills) ranked by live GitHub stars with week-over-week deltas, and a real-call availability survey of the "free" models. Sponsor slots are labelled and sit outside the ranking.

resources.name: 534119219/chicheng-peak
resources.desc: Edge breathing border showing DeepSeek peak/valley hours, with flowing light and scheduled push reminders.

resources.name: 534119219/chicheng-quickinput
resources.desc: Vault button beside the DSH composer: save keys, servers, phone numbers, addresses and URLs, auto-collected from conversations, password-protected with WebDAV backup; click to insert, Ctrl+click to send.

resources.name: 535408248-oss/dsh-douyin-webview
resources.desc: An embedded Douyin window docked in the DSH sidebar: a real Electron webview guest, so douyin.com's X-Frame-Options: DENY no longer applies.

resources.name: 654970/dsh-typing-studio
resources.desc: Bilingual Chinese and English typing practice with timed passages, IME-aware scoring, per-character feedback, and locally stored records.

resources.name: 6pofx/dsh-tool-explorer
resources.desc: Skills and MCP management console in the settings panel: merged skill catalog across every provider (hierarchical browse by source, online create/edit, independent model and user invocation switches, recoverable trash), GitHub install with multi-select batch install and update checks, MCP server add/edit/remove and enable/disable through the profile patch layer, cross-agent import from Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Cline, Roo Code, Continue and Windsurf, and an independent SDK connection probe.

resources.name: 6shenhonghong9/dsh-startup-screen
resources.desc: Rhine Lab-style boot animation for DeepSeek Harness: six acts from a black title plate through irradiated white-out to a warm dossier panel, five access-authorization steps (the first two can wait for a click or Enter, and Esc skips), real-voice recordings for the first five lines, and a settings page that switches between warm-light and dark themes and live-edits 33 playback, identity, voice and visual options.

resources.name: 764475881/dsh-chat-width
resources.desc: Drag-to-resize the chat content width in the DeepSeek Harness web UI: a handle on the column right edge overrides the built-in 748px width (default 1040px, 520-2400 range, persisted per browser, double-click resets).

resources.name: 778672151/dsh-session-turn-eta
resources.desc: Live progress bar under the composer with a percentage and an estimated time left for the current DeepSeek Harness turn; the estimate re-anchors as the turn runs and never reads 100% until the turn ends, and the bar turns red when the turn fails or is interrupted.

resources.name: 7AAAAAH/dsh-restart-app
resources.desc: A restart button in the window title strip, right of the sidebar toggle, that stops every process the desktop app owns (Electron shell, Host, renderers and tool subprocesses) and starts the executable again, then reloads the page once the new instance answers. Windows desktop app only, and it hides itself on any other Host.

resources.name: dsh-my-plugins
resources.desc: See what you actually installed: a chip shows how many plugins your profile really loads, and a searchable panel lists every one with its version, its author-written one-liner, and whether it is built-in or third-party. Read-only, zero config.

resources.name: 9426Haruka/dsh-markdown-live
resources.desc: Live Markdown rendering inside the DSH composer plus Markdown-rendered user messages; the submitted text stays literal Markdown.

resources.name: 978064659/dsh-restart-button
resources.desc: Adds a restart button to the Windows title bar, left of the minimize control, that stops and relaunches the desktop shell together with its Harness Host so a newly installed plugin takes effect.

resources.name: A-f-ish/dsh-emotion-feedback
resources.desc: Judges the working model's own emotion each turn and silently re-injects it before the next turn, closing a self-observation → state carry-over → behavior shift loop. Ships a host plugin plus a composer-dock panel, a read-only emotion_status tool and an optional read-only HTTP route.

resources.name: a1073097082/dsh-model-search
resources.desc: Adds searchable filtering to the model selector by provider, model name, and model ID; spaces act as wildcards.

resources.name: a179-sanae/dsh-auto-collapse
resources.desc: Codex-style workflow auto-collapse: finished turns fold into a single "processed in Xs" row leaving only the final answer; tool calls and think blocks collapse into live-summary chips that follow streaming; expand level by level, fully reversible on uninstall.

resources.name: A2chitect/dsh-openviking-enhance
resources.desc: OpenViking in the DSH web GUI: a Studio panel, a per-session memory-commit status pill with its commit timeline, and a right-sidebar tab showing what the current session retrieves.

resources.name: a735624258/dsh-skill-picker
resources.desc: WorkBuddy-style skill picker: a button beside the composer opens a searchable list of installed skills; picking one inserts the official /skill-name gesture, so the skill loads with your message.

resources.name: a792883583/dsh-chat-toc
resources.desc: Interactive chat table of contents with bookmarks, turn pinning, global shortcuts, and heading extraction.

resources.name: a903067276-rgb/dsh-file-mentions
resources.desc: Clickable file paths in DSH replies: Codex-style inline open, reveal in file manager, and a mentioned-files chip list at the turn tail.

resources.name: a903067276-rgb/dsh-hud
resources.desc: HUD status panel: Git status, MCP servers, skills, model and token usage in a floating side panel.

resources.name: a903067276-rgb/dsh-plan-switch
resources.desc: One-click enter/exit Plan mode for the DSH web input bar, a quick-click shortcut for /plan.

resources.name: aa2246740/dsh-better-display
resources.desc: A calmer reading view for DeepSeek Harness: native process details, live reasoning, and clean final answers.

resources.name: aa2246740/dsh-dragndrop-attachments
resources.desc: Adds drag-and-drop attachments for local files, folders, ZIP archives and Office documents.

resources.name: aa2246740/dsh-watcher
resources.desc: Read-only session work-path observer: fold turns into stage, run, duration and tok/s summaries, then expand parallel branches, tool results and vendor-visible reasoning.

resources.name: aadmin61-design/dsh-selection-chat
resources.desc: Adds text-selection quote cards above the composer and temporary native sidebar chats, with a Save button to keep a chat in its source workspace.

resources.name: Aafff623/dsh-callout
resources.desc: GitHub-style alert cards for DSH assistant Markdown: a qualifying > [!NOTE], TIP, IMPORTANT, WARNING, or CAUTION blockquote becomes a theme-aware card. Stored session content is left unchanged.

resources.name: Aafff623/dsh-keyboard-manager
resources.desc: Keyboard shortcuts for the DSH Web UI: Ctrl+Q toggles the left sidebar, Ctrl+E toggles the right panel, and Ctrl+S opens Settings. Physical key codes can be overridden in the profile patch.

resources.name: abbccdd/dsh-panel-tint
resources.desc: Add independent opacity controls for the sidebar, message panels and composer in dsh web.

resources.name: AbelKeithsun/dsh-question-nav
resources.desc: In-session question navigator for the DSH Web UI: a dot minimap on the conversation edge (left or right, configurable in settings), one dot per user question — hover shows the full question text, click jumps to it.

resources.name: acdsh4869/dsh-deepseek-web-relay
resources.desc: Adds a native sidebar menu item in DSH that opens chat.deepseek.com in a standalone browser window with persistent login, and supports bidirectional text selection transfer between DSH and the web page.

resources.name: ACGsu/dsh-sidebar-panel-fold
resources.desc: Folds the DeepSeek Harness sidebar's global panel list into a single row, with a popover to switch panels.

resources.name: AcidGr/dsh-web-mobile-fix
resources.desc: Mobile layout fixes for the Web UI on narrow screens: full-screen settings panel, one-row plugin nav, full-screen sidebar, centered popups, icon-only session-log button.

resources.name: adcx222/dsh-enhance-prompt
resources.desc: Adds a sparkle button to the DSH composer that rewrites the current draft into a clearer, more specific prompt with a single tool-free LLM call, then writes the result back into the input.

resources.name: addie-ace/dsh-livebench-rankings
resources.desc: LiveBench leaderboard for DSH — discovers the release the official site currently publishes, then reads its CSV and category JSON, and renders model rankings in an isolated same-origin iframe opened from a button beside the composer. Search, organization / open-weight / reasoning filters, per-category sorting, task-level detail, up to four models side by side, CSV export; refreshes every 60 s by default (configurable 30–3600) and caches only to the plugin's own .cache/rankings.json.

resources.name: AdilAlmahmoud/dsh-rtl-chat
resources.desc: Right-to-left reading mode for the conversation answer area, with a button to switch back to left-to-right.

resources.name: adithyanraj03/dsh-verbose
resources.desc: A session-header 3-dots menu: download the session log, switch each chat's transcript between Normal and Verbose, and define what Verbose expands (thinking blocks, tool calls, terminal output).

resources.name: Admilkk/dsh-sidechat
resources.desc: Temporary side conversations seeded from the main context, with quoted questions, main-task status updates, and replies returned to the main draft.

resources.name: adrian-atlas/dsh-avatar-balance
resources.desc: DeepSeek account balance in the sidebar foot, directly above the account avatar. The row shows the top-up balance plus any bonus, turns amber with a warning mark below an adjustable threshold and green above it, and refreshes when a task finishes.

resources.name: adrianleb/dsh-tmux-cc
resources.desc: Persistent tmux control-mode cockpit for DSH Web that mirrors native panes in a dock.

resources.name: advance-lion/dsh-brand
resources.desc: One-click brand replacement for the DSH web GUI — logo, product name, version badge, hero headline, tab title and favicon.

resources.name: Aealen/dsh-coding-workspace
resources.desc: Coding workbench for DSH: docked workspace panels, a grouped project sidebar, split editor tab groups with hibernate/resume, file preview and diff views — built on parallel git worktree development with cross-session collaboration primitives.

resources.name: afawfawffaf/dsh-plugin-lx-music
resources.desc: Shows the lyrics LX Music is playing in a floating panel on the right of the DSH conversation page, with previous / play-pause / next controls. Scroll the lyric window to read ahead, double-click a line to start the song there, and if the player is not running, pressing play starts it in the system tray. Windows only, and LX Music has to be installed with its local Open API enabled.

resources.name: afoxsss/dsh-conversation-map
resources.desc: Conversation minimap docked on the right edge of the dsh Web chat: colour-block and to-scale thumbnail modes, drag-to-resize (10–320px), hover loupe preview, click-to-jump and drag-to-scroll with a live viewport indicator, and collapse to a 4px strip.

resources.name: ags-neto/dsh-status-telemetry
resources.desc: Adds a session status pill to the composer dock that expands into a panel of turn, token, performance and context readings.

resources.name: AhaCrazy/dsh-nav-history
resources.desc: Global back/forward navigation for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI: remembers every session and whole-page panel you visit, shows a configurable 1-7 entry history strip you can click, and supports browser-style shortcuts plus mouse side buttons.

resources.name: AhaCrazy/dsh-stock-quotes
resources.desc: Watchlist panel for A-share, Hong Kong and US quotes plus Eastmoney boards, with intraday sparklines and an agent stock_quote tool.

resources.name: ai-eks/dsh-docking-layout
resources.desc: Dockable DSH Web UI layout that organizes conversations as tabs across draggable split groups.

resources.name: Aicksion/dsh-clean-desktop-shell-pro
resources.desc: Enhanced desktop shell for DSH: auto-starts the local backend on launch (no browser tab), asks before closing the backend on quit, and starts the backend in parallel with Electron for faster cold start. Fork of dsh-clean-desktop-shell.

resources.name: Aik358/dsh-anchored-monitor
resources.desc: A whip for DeepSeek V4 Pro: it watches the reasoning fingerprint of every thinking block and pulls the model back when it slips from focused "We will / I will" mode into scattered "let me" mode.

resources.name: AikenFra/dsh-alive
resources.desc: Zero-token online status indicator for the DeepSeek Harness web UI: an always-visible online/offline dot in the conversation header, auto-refreshed every 15 seconds with no LLM calls.

resources.name: AirPineApplea/feiyu-chat-companion
resources.desc: Desktop companion for DeepSeek Harness: a Win32 layered window that keeps a whale-girl above other applications, speaks through a bubble, comments on its own when you stay on one window for ten seconds, and answers a single question typed into a right-click input box.

resources.name: Aisland-SJL/dsh-worktable#01_content
resources.desc: Workbench plugin for the DeepSeek Harness web UI: collects your own projects and mounted plugin entries with rename, icon, sort, show/hide, project-to-session binding and a per-project file cabinet, adds a split-pane workspace engine with draggable panes, tabbed windows and built-in Explorer, terminal, browser, animation and custom panes, and auto-mounts an agent output into the matching window when it writes widget-result.json.

resources.name: aiyacharley/dsh-at-sider
resources.desc: Enhances the native right-sidebar Files tab rather than replacing it: each row gets an @ reference button that inserts the canonical path mention into the composer, plus a size column, a sortable modification-time column, and a status dot for untracked, unstaged and staged files. Below the tree a git bar shows the branch with ahead/behind counts and expands upward into the 20 most recent commits, with a repository selector when a workspace has independent repositories in subdirectories. A header search box walks the workspace recursively and can open a result or expand the tree at it, preview tabs offer reveal-in-tree and one-click @, the tree is keyboard navigable with ARIA tree semantics, and a right-click entry on the Files tab switches back to the native tree at runtime.

resources.name: AK-blank/dsh-plugin-offpeak-badge
resources.desc: Shows whether the DeepSeek API is currently billing at the off-peak or peak rate in the sidebar brand row, with the Chinese statutory-holiday calendar built in and zh/en copy.

resources.name: akilonewbility/dsh-workspace-optimize
resources.desc: Redraw the left-hand workspace sidebar to add color highlighting, sorting, status indicators, and system notifications. You can also switch back to the original sidebar, which likewise implements some of these features.

resources.name: AKIRACOD/dsh-drag-and-drop
resources.desc: File-drag fork: drop documents as removable chips above the composer, send without typing.

resources.name: aklnaaw/dsh-xiaoke-widget
resources.desc: A Claude-persona desktop pet pinned to the bottom-right corner of the DSH web GUI — shows balance, today's usage, peak/off-peak pricing and per-turn cost, with editable bubbles (text, balance, usage, pricing, images, random lines and weighted choices), per-line styles and fonts, a floating quick editor, sound effects, and custom character/audio. Ships animated roles that breathe and blink, plus a balance-alert variant that switches to a crying face when the balance falls below the alert line; 256/384 animation tiers and an optional 512 HD pack installed from the resource manager. 63 Claude-flavored lines. A derivative of MeteorNOX/DeepSeek-Balance-Whale-Widget (MIT).

resources.name: AKS1st/dock
resources.desc: VSCode-style workbench shell for the DSH Web UI: activity bar, side bar, editor area, panel and status bar, with a registry service (ctx.workbench) for mounting panels, views and commands.

resources.name: AKS1st/dock-editor
resources.desc: Text viewer and editor for the dock workbench: undo/redo, Ctrl+S save, unsaved-change confirmation and binary detection, registered as the default file viewer.

resources.name: AKS1st/dock-files
resources.desc: File explorer for the dock workbench: tree browsing of the session workspace with create/rename/copy-paste/delete, drag-and-drop import and paste of local files and clipboard images.

resources.name: AKS1st/dock-git
resources.desc: Git history visualization for the dock workbench: swimlane commit graph, branch and tag management, stage/commit/push and remote operations.

resources.name: AKS1st/dock-images
resources.desc: Image viewer for the dock workbench: PNG, JPEG, GIF, WebP, BMP, SVG, ICO and AVIF, with SVG rendered as image data only.

resources.name: AKS1st/dock-markdown
resources.desc: Markdown viewer for the dock workbench: GFM rendering with DOMPurify sanitization, document outline and relative-path image/link resolution, with one-click switch to editing.

resources.name: AKS1st/dock-spreadsheet
resources.desc: Read-only XLSX, XLS, ODS, CSV and TSV viewer for dock-files with worksheet tabs, sorting, filters, search and cell links.

resources.name: AKS1st/dsh-sysmon
resources.desc: System status floating widget: live CPU/memory/disk usage in the bottom-right corner of the DSH Web UI with threshold colour warnings.

resources.name: AL-Yichen/dsh-fullscreen-input
resources.desc: Adds a full-screen panel to the DSH composer for writing multi-line text, movable and resizable, sharing one draft with the composer; Enter inserts a newline and only Ctrl+Enter sends, so an IME cannot turn Shift+Enter into a send.

resources.name: AL1ghtm3ter/dsh-right-click-menu
resources.desc: Adds a right-click menu to the DSH web UI for files and for links: a file-tree row, a file path or file mention in a chat message, or a hyperlink opens a menu that previews a file in DSH, opens it in the default application or a chosen associated one, reveals it in the file manager, copies the path, the workspace-relative path, the file name, the link address, the link text or the file contents, saves a copy elsewhere, and opens an HTTP(S) link in the sidebar browser or in the system browser, while a right-click that is not on a file or a link keeps the browser's own menu.

resources.name: AlannerFranklin/dsh-cutout-pet
resources.desc: Turns an uploaded picture into a floating desk pet by cutting out its background in the page, with idle animation and a live account-balance bubble.

resources.name: alccs/dsh-visual-intelligence-engine
resources.desc: Render interactive diagrams, charts and staged learning visuals alongside native prose in DeepSeek Harness.

resources.name: AlexPeng07/dsh-custom-plugin
resources.desc: Web GUI convenience suite with appearance controls, timeline navigation, project folders, prompts, conversation export, Mermaid rendering, quote reply, and DeepSeek balance and daily token usage.

resources.name: AlexYin-Tongji/dsh-ui-enhancer
resources.desc: Desktop-style UI enhancements for the DSH Web client: adaptive wallpapers, a desktop pet companion with an activity feed and feeding economy, @file workspace references, and the resizable file/preview right panel.

resources.name: Aliboder/dsh-prompt-forge
resources.desc: Composer prompt refinement: rewrite the draft through the harness LLM, preview the result, then apply or send it, with style presets, model-aware reasoning effort, cost estimate and a settings page.

resources.name: AliceLJY/dsh-thumb
resources.desc: A phone shell for the web GUI - the sidebar becomes an overlay drawer that closes when a session is tapped, the settings sheet goes full-screen single column, and the transcript is retuned for phone reading.

resources.name: alingalingling/ui-status-label
resources.desc: Customize the "deep diving" thinking status label to anything you like.

resources.name: Aliuyanfeng/dsh-soul
resources.desc: Personalization for the agent: a Web UI panel (about-you, reply style & tone, traits for headings/lists and emoji, output language, custom instructions) and /soul commands, with nickname/occupation/bio/style/traits/language compiled into a system prompt and re-injected into active sessions. Exposes soulConfig for other plugins and a set_persona tool the agent can call.

resources.name: ALIve114514awa/dsh-prompt-optimizer
resources.desc: Refine prompts with guided questions and editable previews using Harness AI or native Codex across Web, desktop and TUI, applying drafts only after user confirmation.

resources.name: All3nCN/dsh-better-sidebar-N23
resources.desc: Full workbench fork of dsh-better-sidebar: explorer, editor, terminal, Git, browser and split panes, plus a VSCode-like shell refactor with a full-width compact header and activity rail; publishes as @all3cn/dsh-better-sidebar-n23 on npm.

resources.name: AlLHHH/dsh-perf-boost
resources.desc: Performance optimization and smoothness enhancement for DSH Desktop (renderer-side only; host code untouched, no on-disk config): skips offscreen message rendering, stops frames and timers while the window is hidden, lazily loads media, coalesces session-list repaints and pre-warms large session files; shows the measured main-thread saving in settings. A lightweight speed-up for lag, dropped frames, slow large-session opening and background CPU use.

resources.name: Alone-show/dsh-quick-keys
resources.desc: Two composer actions for the DSH Web UI: /new in the slash-command menu starts a new conversation without sending anything to the model, and Shift+Tab toggles plan mode while the conversation has focus.

resources.name: AloneFu/dsh-calendar-plugin
resources.desc: Obsidian daily notes, tasks and Day Planner time blocks in the DSH sidebar: a Monday-first month grid with per-day word-count and task dots, a compact timeline for HH:mm time blocks, the selected day's diary excerpt and task list, and write-back of checkbox state, task text and times to the Markdown files; a first-run wizard detects the vault or accepts a path.

resources.name: AlyceStocking/hover-glossary
resources.desc: Shows local glossary definitions when hovering over terms in chat messages.

resources.name: amazing-fish/dsh-piano-nav
resources.desc: Conversation navigation with full-history turns, collapsible process steps, final-result and structured question-and-answer keys, and pointer-following piano interaction.

resources.name: Amengclass/dsh-settings-hub
resources.desc: Unify third-party plugin settings in DeepSeek Harness. Auto-discover, group, and reorder plugin settings under one collapsible nav entry with drag-and-drop support.

resources.name: amstlkqp114514/dsh-desktop-tweaks
resources.desc: Desktop tweaks: F11 fullscreen toggle; enables Ctrl+C / Ctrl+V copy and paste in the terminal, both switchable in the General settings.

resources.name: an-an-618/dsh-hook-followup
resources.desc: Adds a lightweight follow-up row under each DSH answer: one anchor question plus 1-3 user-voice quick replies, so the next turn is one click away; supports always / balanced / conservative strategies and optional refusal or emotional-context skips.

resources.name: an-an-618/dsh-intelligent-ui
resources.desc: Declarative interactive cards for DSH: the model writes a spec, the Host compiles it into a JSON program, and the client renders forms, tables, charts and lists with local state and explicit submit.

resources.name: Andor-Z/dsh-turn-outline
resources.desc: Adds a sidebar tab that folds a session into user turns (input, tool steps, output) with one-click jump back into the conversation.

resources.name: androidly/dsh-restart-control
resources.desc: Adds a restart control at the DSH Web sidebar foot: the host exits through its own graceful path and the detected supervisor (systemd, Kubernetes or Docker) boots the replacement, or the plugin starts one directly when it finds no supervisor; a frame-wide notice polls the host pid until a new process answers.

resources.name: AngleNaris/fanframe
resources.desc: FanFrame (繁界, “Fanxing’s realm”) lightly polishes the DeepSeek Harness Desktop UI for a more comfortable everyday experience.

resources.name: anitman/dsh-plugin-video-player
resources.desc: TikTok-style video feed in a floating sidebar window: swipe local or SMB-NAS folders, or paste online video URLs (yt-dlp, bilibili/YouTube, cookies.txt login state); the window auto-fits the video aspect ratio, with fullscreen, drag-resize, Range streaming and an agent video-queue endpoint.

resources.name: ankesu/dsh-live2d-pet
resources.desc: Live2D companion for DSH: a floating Cubism model with state-driven expressions and mouse tracking; config-driven geometry (size/position from the plugin config); official Haru sample bundled (© Live2D Inc.).

resources.name: Anna-la/dsh-simplify
resources.desc: Clean-mode for the Web GUI: hover any element and right-click to remove it; removals survive reloads and are restorable from the settings page.

resources.name: anneheartrecord/dsh-desk-pet
resources.desc: macOS desk pet that lives outside the DSH page: a real always-on-top window that clears fullscreen Spaces, six states driven by local DSH, a native right-click menu with quiet mode and a session list, and a bundled skill that turns one photo into a full eighteen-pose skin on your own image tool and credentials; system Python and ctypes, no Electron and no dependencies.

resources.name: anonamerjaxon-dev/dsh-model-grid
resources.desc: Responsive card grid for the DeepSeek Harness composer model picker, grouped by provider. Host-only: injects a stylesheet through webserver/index-inject without rebuilding the client bundle, and supports both the stock picker and the dsh-peakrate menu.

resources.name: antnesswcm/dsh-shell-card-plus
resources.desc: Replaces the stock bash/pwsh terminal rows in the DSH web UI with shell command cards: long commands soft-wrap with line numbers instead of truncating, plus separate copy-command and copy-output buttons.

resources.name: anye-99/dsh-next-step-suggest
resources.desc: Next-step suggestions for the DSH composer: after each completed turn, one auxiliary call on the session's current model returns 3 clickable follow-up suggestions above the input box, and clicking one fills the draft.

resources.name: anzhaohao/DragView
resources.desc: Drag-and-drop file attachments as Codex-style cards, with in-app PDF/text/video/audio previews and system-default opening for other formats.

resources.name: AomiRaku/dsh-accountDisplayName-edit
resources.desc: Customize the username (phone number or email) and avatar shown at the bottom-left account row — for personalization, or to keep screenshots from exposing them. The editor opens from the menu you get by clicking that row.

resources.name: apanzinc/dsh-no-preview-badge
resources.desc: Removes the Preview badge on DSH.

resources.name: AppliedYuu/dsh-WallpaperAndCost
resources.desc: Merged plugin: wallpaper customization (original-resolution uploads, crop editor, per-area opacity, MP4/WebM dynamic wallpapers) + Steam Workshop wallpaper extraction (parses scene.pkg/.tex via a bundled Python script, preview/download) + DeepSeek balance & usage widget + OpenCode Go plan usage (rolling/weekly/monthly percents in a top header pill; expand for progress bars & reset countdowns). API keys are read from DSH's credential store by the host — never stored in source or the browser.

resources.name: appthin/dsh-mcp-manager-plus
resources.desc: MCP management page in DSH Settings: list, enable/disable, restart and delete MCP servers, edit them in form or JSON mode, expand a server to see the tools it registers, and paste-import MCP configs from 14 tools (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, VS Code and more) in one go.

resources.name: AprilCrystal/dsh-client-ui-font-scale
resources.desc: Conversation font-size controls for the Web UI: a stepper in the composer row, keyboard shortcuts, and Ctrl+wheel zoom, all writing through the theme service setFontSize.

resources.name: AprilCrystal/dsh-client-ui-gpt-helper
resources.desc: ChatGPT-desktop-style model picker whose thinking-level slider carries a particle trail, plus a visual-only fast-mode toggle and a hold-to-lock for it.

resources.name: ArcaneOrion/dsh-model-selector-search
resources.desc: Session model selector with search: two-stage loose matching (normalised substring first, subsequence as fallback, so glm53 finds GLM-5.3 and ds finds DeepSeek), providers with recent successful calls pinned first, and a reasoning-effort pane that remembers each model's last explicitly chosen effort.

resources.name: ArcaneOrion/dsh-teaching-board
resources.desc: Teaching board view: agent-generated self-contained HTML is projected into a sandboxed iframe as a board, annotated by hand (brush, four colours, eraser, undo), extended in place across several tool calls, and screenshotted back into the conversation as a real user message.

resources.name: Archaofan/dsh-source-deck
resources.desc: In-conversation source deck for DSH Desktop: the current chat model runs LLM search rounds, candidates render as GitHub-aware cards, and keep/exclude feedback, favorites, and the selected sources stay in the same conversation.

resources.name: arcnapan/dsh-chat-answer-anchor
resources.desc: Freezes the DSH chat scroll position: new replies no longer drag the viewport to the bottom — it stays where you left it. Only after you send a message does it follow to the bottom so you can see your own input, then it locks again once the answer starts streaming. Each session remembers its own position (persisted across reloads), a settings toggle turns it off, and it never intercepts your own scrolling.

resources.name: ardesp0630/dsh-work-progress
resources.desc: Persistent work-progress row in the band below the composer: task completion, a progress bar, and what the agent is doing right now (generating a reply or running a tool), expandable into the full task list with turns, steps, timings and context usage.

resources.name: Arfrsa/dsh-sidebar-sections
resources.desc: Split the DSH sidebar workspace list into Active, Session tasks and Inactive sections with manual pins and an activity threshold, keeping the official search, archive filters, row menus and drag and drop, with a one-click switch back to the shipped list. The Session tasks section uses a fixed Windows workspace at D:\files\history-tasks; other platforms must create that directory manually.

resources.name: ArimaKana-Akane/dsh-whale-tools
resources.desc: Replace the dsh-whale-widget mascot with your own image through a built-in cutout pipeline, plus a session-header restart button, a browser heartbeat, and an opt-in patch self-heal that is off by default.

resources.name: Arrosam/dsh-better-workspace-file-manager
resources.desc: Adds upload, download, new folder, delete, drag-to-move, drag-to-chat and in-place text editing with auto-save to the workspace Files tab and file previews.

resources.name: Arrosam/dsh-smart-prompt
resources.desc: One-click prompt refinement for the DSH composer: the ✦ button next to Send rewrites the draft into an agent-ready prompt in Standard or Light mode, with Revert and Retry; asks follow-up questions through the question card when the draft is missing information; checks that paths, identifiers, numbers, URLs, inline code and @mentions survive the rewrite and adds back any that were dropped; runs on the conversation model or a dedicated model chosen on the Plugins page.

resources.name: asd13006/dsh-multi-lang-ui
resources.desc: Add six languages (繁體中文, 日本語, 한국어, Français, Deutsch, Español) to the DeepSeek Harness Web UI language options, with hand-polished per-language translations and automatic fallbacks (Simplified-to-Traditional conversion for zh-TW, English for the others) covering upstream updates and third-party plugins.

resources.name: asfre/dsh-mcp-global-manager
resources.desc: Scans MCP configs from the tools it knows (28 built-in sources plus custom ones), syncs diffs into DSH, and lets you import, write back, or edit MCP servers from the DSH sidebar.

resources.name: ashz555/dsh-term-glossary
resources.desc: Select a term in a DeepSeek Harness conversation and press the Search button beside it to read the explanation in place: basic meaning, purpose and usage, with the token cost of that answer. The call is auxiliary — it writes nothing to the session log.

resources.name: Asteroid-Code-Channel/dsh-workspace-atlas
resources.desc: AGENTS & Skills Studio: edit AGENTS.md, create spec-compliant SKILL.md files with structured frontmatter, manage and rename skill folders, and install from Anthropic, OpenAI, Cursor, and Matt Pocock catalogs.

resources.name: asukasec/dsh-message-preview
resources.desc: Right-edge user-message navigator with an adaptive block layout that fits the available height, plus hover previews, keyboard controls, and click-to-jump navigation.

resources.name: asun-labs/dsh-plugin-agent-switch
resources.desc: Adds interactive agent-switch CLI terminals with tab and grid layouts, Codex delegation cards, and live or saved task output in the right sidebar. Requires agent-switch on PATH, at least one target coding CLI, and a node-pty build allowlist; implemented and tested on Windows.

resources.name: asxiuxiu/dsh-quick-open
resources.desc: Quick-open palette for the Web GUI: Ctrl+P fuzzy-searches an in-memory index of the session workspace (about 51k entries, median query 5 ms) with per-segment path anchoring, dir: and file: prefixes, Tab directory drilling and :line jumps, opens the picked file in the native right sidebar, and drops a file reference into the conversation draft with Ctrl+Enter. Also adds in-file find (Ctrl+F) and a selection-to-reference action to the built-in file preview.

resources.name: Asza-other/dsh-narrator
resources.desc: Watches a turn for long silences and, once the threshold passes, injects a user message asking the model to state in prose what it is doing before carrying on, so the turn keeps going. The same text is mirrored in a lower-left overlay above the composer. The silence threshold and the minimum gap between reports are set in minutes, the prompt can be replaced wholesale, and it runs with no runtime dependencies. Requires DSH 0.2.1+ and Node.js 18+.

resources.name: Audrey-cn/dsh-bot-codex-ui
resources.desc: Unified install for DS Bot and the Codex-style sidebar: one package that mounts both and fixes their layout conflicts (composer alignment, sidebar footer, account entry, conversation width).

resources.name: AumiSatori/dsh-ui-beautify
resources.desc: Personalize DSH with glass surfaces, independent light and dark themes, image/video/HTML backgrounds, particles, custom greetings, overlay sidebars, task and Artifact cards, message bubbles, smooth answer streaming, and settings import/export.

resources.name: awaYFawa/dsh-plugins-folders
resources.desc: Folders for the DSH Plugins page: group installed plugins, toggle a whole group, batch move with undo, search across groups, long-press drag to reorder, reinstall removed plugins from their record, and restart Harness with one click.

resources.name: AWL-MC2/DSH-Plugin_awl
resources.desc: Wallpaper-aware readability repair for the DSH Web GUI: it lifts the three low-contrast secondary text tokens with color-mix plus an adjustable text halo, adds content rules (bold, permanently underlined or recoloured links, tinted headings and body text) scoped to conversation Markdown only, offers adjustable rainbow-edge and gradient-fill heading effects, loads custom fonts from the plugin folder or the DSH home, and ships a draggable WYSIWYG preview with a WCAG contrast badge.

resources.name: Awu12277/dsh-sleep-send
resources.desc: Schedule-send button and panel to the right of the composer, with smart time slots, a custom date/time picker, several queued sends at once, and localStorage persistence that restores pending tasks after a page reload.

resources.name: ayahunter/dsh-trail#bundle
resources.desc: Replaces the Web GUI trajectory tab with a new-user-friendly round-by-round storyline, plain-language tool labels, category filters and fuzzy search.

resources.name: ayingQAQ/dsh-web-launcher
resources.desc: Windows desktop launcher bundle for DSH Web that creates a managed shortcut, then restarts DSH in the background and refreshes the existing browser page.

resources.name: ayuanxx-max/dsh-session-accordion
resources.desc: Chat turn accordion: every interaction folds into one row with a time pill and question summary, only the newest turn stays open, and switching sessions or starting a new turn resets the open state; the execution process opens only on its own click.

resources.name: azazo1/dsh-deep-diving-back
resources.desc: Restores the blue shimmering Deep diving turn status row that DSH 0.1.6 and earlier showed at the end of the transcript.

resources.name: azazo1/dsh-reduce-effects
resources.desc: Adds a UI effects page to Settings that switches off DSH Web animations and transitions, loading and progress animations, backdrop blur, smooth scrolling, hover title scroll, shadows, gradients and JS motion one category at a time, to cut browser rendering cost.

resources.name: Azetus/dsh-quorfloat
resources.desc: System-level desktop floating-window plugin for DeepSeek Harness (DSH): a global hotkey opens a floating window; the plugin supports workspace and session switching, approval and follow-up handling, and export of its own diagnostic logs for plugin troubleshooting.

resources.name: azkbzxf/dsh-account-balance-pill
resources.desc: Shows the signed-in DeepSeek account's remaining balance in the DSH composer bottom bar, next to the shipped turn/step and token-usage pills, and refreshes it periodically and after each turn.

resources.name: azkbzxf/dsh-vscode-scrollbar
resources.desc: Gives the DSH conversation the Visual Studio Code editor chrome: a 14px always-visible scrollbar with a flat, translucent thumb, plus a VS Code-style minimap in the right margin (half-window column, media not painted, hover-only minimapSlider, click/wheel scrolling) and auto-expanded older pages.

resources.name: AzureSkyHuHu/dsh-chinese-mode-modern
resources.desc: Adds a Chinese-mode toggle beside the composer that opens a panel for switching reply, reasoning, and tool-narration language, persisted in the profile.

resources.name: B612wang/dsh-ui-transparency
resources.desc: Whole-window opacity for the DSH desktop window from one button at the sidebar foot: a 0-90% slider whose value is remembered between runs. It only sets the window alpha - no restyling, no extra panels, and no other feature is touched. Windows only.

resources.name: bagpipe1289/dsh-paperflight#plugin
resources.desc: PaperFlight is an experimental future-retro DSH Web workbench with session management, file previews, approvals, and optional preset-scoped browser and terminal tools.

resources.name: Bai-2008/dsh-better-panel
resources.desc: Replaces the model button in the DSH composer with its own two-level panel (provider list, then a searchable model list) built around a continuous draggable reasoning-effort slider: blue-to-violet fill, nebula and star particles on higher levels, and a distinct color per level. Picking a model keeps the panel open and moves the slider to that model's middle level. The implementation started from Microqian2th/dsh-codex-effort-slider 1.0.0 (credited in the README); the panel, the seat takeover, the offline test suite and the docs are new here.

resources.name: baifagg/dsh-plugin-busy-workspace
resources.desc: Ranks workspaces holding a session that wants attention to the top of the sidebar session list - waiting on you first, then running, then finished-but-unopened, then just read - and draws those rows with a state bar, tinted surface and coloured title, plus a one-shot settle pulse when a run stops. Every colour is taken from the active theme's own tokens, and the three windows that decide how long a finished session stays promoted are settings.

resources.name: bainianlaoyao/easy-archive
resources.desc: Two-step inline archive on workspace sidebar rows — one click arms a red confirm, the second click archives; the archive entry is removed from the ⋮ menu.

resources.name: baisama-cloud/dsh-composer-history
resources.desc: Command history for the DSH composer: press Up/Down to cycle through previously sent instructions, then restore the draft at the end of the history; works in the official desktop app and web-profile builds.

resources.name: Baisbt/dsh-GreaterClarity-plugin
resources.desc: Enhances the DSH web session view — one-click collapse of reasoning and tool chains, numbered history quick-jump, Markdown export, AI avatars.

resources.name: balue8246-maker/dsDragPasteALL
resources.desc: Drag or paste any local file onto the DSH page; it resolves the real absolute path (Spotlight + size/mtime + head/tail fingerprint match) and inserts it into the composer, with a content-cache fallback.

resources.name: BangBang-03/dsh-client-ui-quote
resources.desc: Turn any DSH selection into a reviewable quote — chat, file preview, terminal and diff; code quotes carry path#line. A sent quote keeps a source highlight and ordinal and jumps back, then joins a searchable review list with status, tags, multi-select insert, and Markdown/JSON export. Quotes collect above the composer as a 引用 ×N bar with per-chip edit and remove; side threads can bring their conclusion back to the main draft; a sent quote can be revised, with the old capsule marked superseded; replies can answer each quote by number.

resources.name: BaoBao1996121/dsh-huaci-pinglun
resources.desc: Selection comments and quoted conversations (dsh划词评论 / dsh-huaci-pinglun), based on the MIT-licensed BangBang-03/dsh-client-ui-quote 0.11.1 with attached textarea measurement, border-aware height and long-text scrolling.

resources.name: BaoBao1996121/dsh-restart-ui
resources.desc: Adds a restart button to the DSH Web UI through a loopback-only endpoint that requests a relaunch using the current process executable, arguments and working directory.

resources.name: dsh-keep-awake
resources.desc: Holds the OS wake lock while any agent, subagent, or background job runs, releases it after a configurable grace period, and provides a bilingual web settings page with live status, manual hold, and display-on options.

resources.name: Beership/dsh-download-progress
resources.desc: Live download progress in the DSH session header — percentage, transfer speed, ETA and phase per download, with file-size probing before a transfer starts and byte-range resume after an interruption. The progress cards render as a fixed overlay at the top-right of the chat window.

resources.name: BEIDAOU/dsh-boot-animation-custom
resources.desc: Customizable startup animation for DeepSeek Harness with eight bundled clips, random rotation, tail fade and time-of-day greetings. Based on lxj5820/dsh-boot-animation, so do not install it with the upstream plugin; bundled clips and the welcome voice carry their own media terms.

resources.name: BestQ-A/dsh-session-tree
resources.desc: Hierarchical session tree for the sidebar - native subagent trees plus an optional organization-derived hierarchy, with collapsed branch counters and orphan/cycle defense.

resources.name: better-er/dsh-classic-coding
resources.desc: Slides out a Monaco editor plus a lazy-loaded file-tree panel in the DSH Web conversation, so you can edit the local workspace inline without switching to an external editor.

resources.name: better-er/dsh-edit-diff
resources.desc: Client-side re-render of edit/write tool cards with a near-linear line-level diff that drops duplicate unchanged lines and underlines the actual changed characters inside replaced lines.

resources.name: better-er/dsh-mobile-drawer
resources.desc: Below 1024px the sidebar collapses to a 44px floating square and expands into a 280px overlay drawer; picking a session collapses it again and the focus grab that would raise the soft keyboard after a session switch is suppressed.

resources.name: better-er/dsh-tool-autoexpand
resources.desc: Auto-expands newly arrived tool-call cards in the DSH Web UI, with a sidebar toggle cycling no-op/expand/collapse and the state persisted to localStorage.

resources.name: BeyondandSharp/dsh-plugin-scaling
resources.desc: Independent per-pane zoom for the DSH web shell: Ctrl+wheel over a pane, Ctrl+± / Ctrl+0 for the focused pane. Works with the official look and every skin.

resources.name: bf185003/dsh-favicon-status
resources.desc: Browser tab status indicator for dsh web: paints the document favicon from the session list (blue spinning while work runs, amber while waiting on the user, green when finished).

resources.name: big-head-pigeon/dsh-session-menu
resources.desc: Adds mark-unread, copy session info, reveal in Finder or open with your IDE, and permanent delete (with child sessions) to the DSH sidebar session menu, plus error and unread status dots, hover-card details, one-click delete for archived rows, and a settings panel that switches each menu item on or off; the interface is available in English and Chinese.

resources.name: bigbigman-001/dsh-quote-to-composer
resources.desc: Select text anywhere in DeepSeek Harness, click the quote pill next to the pointer, and the selection lands in the composer as a small quote chip; hover the chip to read the full quote.

resources.name: biggerboy/dsh-conversation-anchors
resources.desc: Codex-style left-gutter tick rail for each user turn, with hover preview and click-to-scroll.

resources.name: bilbillm/dsh-steam-startup-animation
resources.desc: Steam Big Picture-style six-second Canvas startup animation for DSH Desktop with a variable-width terminal-to-whale transition, optional stereo startup audio, volume controls, preview, Escape skip, and reduced-motion support.

resources.name: bill9109/dsh-drag-and-drop
resources.desc: Cross-platform file drag-and-drop with raw path insertion, no file copying.

resources.name: bitterSmilezzz/dsh-model-selector
resources.desc: Enhanced model selector for the DSH composer with searchable provider groups, keyboard and accessibility support, and an inline reasoning-effort slider.

resources.name: bitxeno/dsh-github-picker
resources.desc: Composer GitHub picker: click the GitHub icon at the bottom-right of the input box to search the workspace repository's issues and pull requests via the gh CLI, and insert the reference as a URL or @owner/repo#number mention.

resources.name: BlackBearCC/dsh-pet-sprite
resources.desc: A pixel companion living in the chat area: hatches from an egg into one of three sprites or an LLM-drawn custom one from a text description, platform-jumps over message bubbles on its own, WASD controllable, chats in character through the models you already configured, and carries a nurture system (mood/power/health, levels, shop) driven by real token usage.

resources.name: Blackman99/codsh#codsh-bundle
resources.desc: Terminal coding agent for DeepSeek Harness with a full-screen alternate-screen UI, turn-aware session navigation, and a gated /ship workflow that takes one-line requirements through specification, TDD, and rerun acceptance checks.

resources.name: blacktaoK/dsh-skill-zh-overlay
resources.desc: Chinese summaries for the dsh-skill-mcp-panel skill cards: each expanded card gets a short Chinese overview, a category tag and a few bullet points, while the English description the panel already renders is folded behind a "原文" toggle.
