Skills missing from the bundled map are translated on demand by the host with your current default model and cached on disk, keyed by a hash of the original text, so a new skill needs no manual entry. Skills whose own description is already Chinese are skipped.

resources.name: blueziii/dsh-peakvalley
resources.desc: Composer-dock badge showing DeepSeek peak/off-peak pricing on a Beijing-time calendar whose China holiday schedule is fetched online at runtime (off-peak costs half the peak rate); auto-hides for non-DeepSeek models and cycles seven readouts on click.

resources.name: Bobnemimimmi/dsh-always-status-bar
resources.desc: Keeps the native per-message status line always visible without hovering — date and time on every message, run duration, TTFT, and tokens per second on assistant messages.

resources.name: boogoo619/dsh-focus-overlay
resources.desc: Focus mode with a full-screen reading overlay that hides the header and composer and folds AI tool calls into summaries.

resources.name: BrianHIO-x/dsh-think-expand
resources.desc: Auto-expands every Think row after switching sessions, with a header switch to turn it on or off.

resources.name: BroCC57/dsh-pending-review-glow
resources.desc: Highlights sidebar session rows by state (pending approval, running, just finished) with color, animation and a matching status dot.

resources.name: btsd321/dsh-oh-my-terminal
resources.desc: Bottom terminal panel for the DSH Web GUI, providing multi-tab interactive terminals powered by node-pty (Windows ConPTY / POSIX openpty) with split panes, a side terminal list, and a dropdown new/split menu. Also compatible with DSH-better-sidebar — auto-detected at runtime, it switches to a bottom workbench tab so PTY sessions do not bind the DSH session write handle.

resources.name: buaaflyaway/dsh-question-note
resources.desc: Adds an optional note field under each selected option in the DSH Web UI ask_user_question popup; submitted notes travel to the model in the answer's custom field.

resources.name: BuildWithAIHub/dsh-boot-animation-plus
resources.desc: A fork of dsh-boot-animation that plays an intro clip when DSH opens, ships four embedded clips with an in-app library, and adds batch deletion for clips you added yourself. It reuses the same plugin id as upstream, so the two cannot be installed together.

resources.name: burningg/dsh-workspace-categories
resources.desc: Sidebar category groups for DSH workspaces: the flat project list becomes collapsible named sections, workspaces re-file by dragging a row onto a group or picking one from a dropdown, one toolbar button collapses every group at once, an appearance panel sets font size, text color and background tint for each of the three levels, and Ctrl+Tab cycles recently opened sessions.

resources.name: dsh-code-collector
resources.desc: Session code collector for DeepSeek Harness: a composer-side panel gathering every code block the model produced in the current session, with by-language / by-file views, per-file version history, live search, per-entry copy, copy-all, download-all as Markdown, and click-to-jump back to the exact turn (Alt+Shift+C).

resources.name: dsh-conversation-timeline
resources.desc: Conversation timeline dock bar for DeepSeek Harness: a turn-level timeline above the composer with user-prompt hover tooltips and click-to-jump back to the exact chat position.

resources.name: CAI-MH/dsh-agent-group-panel
resources.desc: Feishu multi-agent robot console: start, stop and reconnect the daemon, view status and recent activity, and jump to the task workspace.

resources.name: caimc21069065-prog/dsh-my-music
resources.desc: Full-page NetEase Cloud Music player for DSH: daily recommendations, playlist browsing by category, charts, new releases, search, playlist/album/artist pages, QR-code login, synced lyrics, queue and downloads, plus four agent tools for search, song URLs, lyrics and playlist tracks.

resources.name: caisiyang123/dsh-tick-rail
resources.desc: Tick-rail conversation navigator: one tick per message you sent, a lit peak that follows the mouse with an even falloff, hover previews, click or keyboard to jump.

resources.name: Canary-Builds/dsh-mobile-ui
resources.desc: Adds touch-friendly navigation, layout refinements, and standalone PWA styling to the existing DeepSeek Harness web interface.

resources.name: CAOGGL/dsh-port-token
resources.desc: Puts a key badge in the bottom-right corner of the dsh Web GUI that shows the port this instance is listening on and the remote-access token printed by dsh web at startup, with a copy button per value; clicking the badge rotates the key into a cross, and clicking it again or anywhere beside it collapses the panel.

resources.name: CarrotFish/dsh-file-and-terminal
resources.desc: Adds host file management and an interactive Bash terminal to the DSH WebUI.

resources.name: CaT-Hode/DSH-app
resources.desc: Windows Electron companion sharing the DSH Web profile, conversations and plugins, with startup logs, update recovery and diagnostics.

resources.name: CatLollipop/dsh-composer-draft-cache
resources.desc: Composer enhancements: caches unsent drafts per workspace for new sessions and per Session id for existing ones, restoring them after switching away and dropping them once sent or cleared; adds an @plugin completion group that mentions an installed plugin so the agent receives that plugin's metadata as runtime context for the turn.

resources.name: causebefore/dsh-pomodoro
resources.desc: Pomodoro focus-and-break timer for DSH Web with configurable cycles, a draggable mini panel, and in-app, sound, and browser notifications.

resources.name: cayan0x/dsh-fold-context
resources.desc: Auto-fold context/system messages in DSH conversation — collapse think blocks, tool calls, and tool results into grouped expandable bars.

resources.name: ccch1mneyyy/dsh-TUI
resources.desc: Claude Code-style full-screen terminal UI: pixel-whale header, live status line, and streaming thought expansion.

resources.name: ccll/dsh-activity-pane
resources.desc: Activity overview pane for the DSH web UI: running, awaiting-response and recent sessions with child agents, progress, model and reasoning level in one sidebar pane.

resources.name: ccq1/dsh-side-panel
resources.desc: Side panel with file browser, terminal, and Git review for quick file previews.

resources.name: cdredfox/dsh-prompt-shortcuts
resources.desc: Pinned prompt shortcuts in a single row above the composer — one click replaces the draft with the saved text — plus a searchable panel for pinning, editing and deleting prompts, overflow collapsed into a "More" menu, storage in a Host-side JSON file, and a prompt_shortcuts agent tool that reads and writes the same file.

resources.name: Ceelog/dsh-plugins#dsh-plugin-setting-mcp
resources.desc: Manage MCP servers from the Web settings panel: view, add, edit, remove, enable or disable them, with hot reload on save.

resources.name: Celebrate-W/dsh-topic-trail
resources.desc: Turns each long dsh conversation into a three-level trail (topic to progress steps to milestone timeline) and shows it in a draggable overlay, where one click jumps back to the matching message in the transcript. Topics are distilled by the DeepSeek model with a zero-cost rule-based fallback, can be renamed, locked, merged by drag and drop, and support per-conversation notes plus a vector drawing board.

resources.name: Centaurea5547196/dsh-page-zoom
resources.desc: Page zoom for the DSH Web UI: Ctrl+mouse wheel scales the entire interface in 5% steps (30%-200%), remembers the zoom level locally, and shows a magnifier with the percentage in the bottom-right corner.

resources.name: CH4ACKO3/dsh-turn-fold
resources.desc: Codex-style turn folding for the DSH Web UI: keeps final answers visible, groups consecutive reasoning and tool activity, and shows configurable live duration, tool-call, and token metrics with multilingual summaries.

resources.name: Chaiyahang/dsh-scratchpad
resources.desc: Scratchpad panel for DeepSeek Harness: tagged notes, image/file attachments, Markdown task lists, send-to-chat, a wake-up shortcut, JSON export/import, and Agent tools.

resources.name: chaochaokongbai/dsh-beginner-hub
resources.desc: Beginner panel for DeepSeek Harness: routes a plain-language request into ready-to-use plans (prompt variants, matching skills, advanced moves) with a local keyword engine and fills the chosen plan into a new session in one click.

resources.name: chargeduck/xechat-dsh
resources.desc: Dockable side panel that keeps an XEChat chat session connected over a single WebSocket: markdown messages with images and emoji, server switching through #showServer and #login, an online member list, a full-screen panic overlay, and dock side, width and visibility persisted to localStorage.

resources.name: charliesbyte/dsh-workspace-activity
resources.desc: Shows a spinner on a sidebar workspace row while any of its sessions are running, and a short-lived finished mark after they stop.

resources.name: charrywhite/dsh-sticky-notes
resources.desc: Draggable sticky notes with 9 skins, image notes, and agent-readable to-do lists for DeepSeek Harness.

resources.name: CheeseFox259/dsh-better-composer
resources.desc: Markdown visual enhancement and session workbench for DSH Web Composer: live syntax presentation with caret-row source reveal (inactive-line markers can be hidden or faded), deterministic local completions, and list/quote continuation on line break with ordered-list renumbering; long pastes fold into persistent chips with inline context or file-mode delivery (@path across 50+ extensions) plus sidebar LLM rewrites (stop, preview diff, undo/redo); real-time context map with token gauge, composition breakdown, per-turn growth chart with anchor lines, in-place /compact, turn forking, and a Context Doctor workspace (overview, diagnostics, analysis, feedback).

resources.name: chen731215-dev/dsh-muv-engine
resources.desc: MUV engine for DeepSeek Harness: runs the regex_scripts from a character card against model output, tracks variables, renders a status bar, expands macros and LaTeX, and styles tagged code blocks such as letter, terminal, newspaper and phone. Needs dsh-muv-table installed as well, which is its companion plugin.

resources.name: chen731215-dev/dsh-muv-table
resources.desc: MUV variable table editor for DeepSeek Harness: a tree view of the variables being tracked, a macro test panel for random, pick and roll, a dice shortcut bar and pick-cache management. Companion plugin for dsh-muv-engine.

resources.name: chen8923/dsh-task-progress
resources.desc: Live progress for long-running DSH tasks: a script appends JSON lines to a per-session progress file, the Web UI draws them in a floating overlay and a right-sidebar tab that also lists background jobs which reported nothing, and dsh-progress run -- <cmd> wraps a command that cannot report for itself.

resources.name: ChendarCe/dsh-perf-hud
resources.desc: A transparent, draggable performance HUD for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI: CPU, GPU and memory usage in three compact rows that float directly over the interface without any card background, snapping to the nearest window corner so resizing or maximising keeps them in place; CPU package temperature comes from an optional elevated helper (LibreHardwareMonitor + PawnIO) and the plugin itself stays at a fraction of a percent of CPU. Windows only.

resources.name: chendefine/dsh-composer-markdown
resources.desc: Markdown editing aids for the DSH web composer: ordered and unordered list continuation with continuous renumbering, Tab-nested list levels, inline-code styling, and code-fence auto-closing, with the sent draft kept as literal Markdown.

resources.name: ChengX0721/dsh-client-ui-skin-alice-greyrat
resources.desc: A pale rose-and-gold Mushoku Tensei skin for the DSH web GUI: an arcane sigil and two full-body Eris figures behind the conversation, a young Eris standee and gilt plugin glyphs in the sidebar, and its own settings card.

resources.name: chengzhi43/dsh-file
resources.desc: VS Code-style file manager: browse the conversation workspace in a sidebar tree and edit files in the center column with Monaco, with theme import/export and Markdown preview.

resources.name: chengzhicao/llm-capture
resources.desc: Web UI for capturing and reviewing raw LLM requests, streamed responses, token usage and tool calls.

resources.name: chenxiachan/thoughtdag#dsh
resources.desc: Adds an editable conversation canvas to DeepSeek Harness, where graph connections select context for canvas requests, with branching, merging, and local agent session imports.

resources.name: ChenYiming-aaa/dsh-ui-ux-pro-max
resources.desc: Offline-first UI/UX design intelligence library for DeepSeek Harness: design_recommend, design_review and design_search tools with a built-in database of 84 design styles, 192 color palettes, 74 font pairings, 99 UX guidelines, 25 chart types and 22 tech stacks, Chinese-first with zero runtime dependencies.

resources.name: ChiffonOwO/dsh-diff-review
resources.desc: Change review for a turn's edited files: a pill above the composer counts this turn's files and lines and floats the file list up on hover, and a right-sidebar page shows each file's diff with syntax highlighting and a one-click revert.

resources.name: choco9527/dsh-add-to-chat
resources.desc: Adds lightweight selected-text references to DSH assistant replies: selections stay outside the editor as removable draft contexts, remain marked beside the source, and render as hoverable annotations after submission.

resources.name: choco9527/dsh-product-preview
resources.desc: Browse local image, video, and SVGA artifacts from conversation nodes in a Finder-style column view.

resources.name: Choi-Peng/dsh-footer-order
resources.desc: DSH sidebar footer ordering: forces the sidebar.footer.action slot into a vertical stack and lets users configure the top-to-bottom order of its entries.

resources.name: cholot-Zhou/dsh-ui-overrides
resources.desc: File-based CSS overrides for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI — edit ~/.dsh/ui-overrides.css and reload to restyle any plugin's elements, for example making the quote bar fully opaque.

resources.name: chongfengdy-dev/dsh-message-outline
resources.desc: Current-session message outline rail for the DSH web UI — your messages show as slim bars on the left edge; hover to expand the full outline (line number + text), click to jump instantly to that message. Pure frontend, zero external service dependencies, sessions-snapshot driven with zero polling.

resources.name: chopperH0824/dsh-annotate-sync
resources.desc: In-place HTML document preview annotation: pick elements, leave notes saved per file, send batches to the conversation, and let the agent apply changes directly.

resources.name: chriswang/dsh-conversation-tree
resources.desc: A collapsible column beside the conversation that organises conversations into a workspace/topic tree, opens the real sessions in place, and exposes the tree to the assistant through 9 model tools.

resources.name: ChuanTianML/dsh-chat-tidy
resources.desc: One stylesheet that retypesets the DSH conversation to measured Codex metrics: 14/22 px body, tighter headings, lists and blocks, a rounded quote bar, and Tidy Tables with a themed header, row/column rules, full-width short tables and contained scrolling for wide tables; no settings or DOM rewriting, with real before/after captures.

resources.name: ChuanTianML/dsh-open-with
resources.desc: Open the current registered Workspace from the Session Header or Workspace menu in a detected or configured editor, with hot re-detection and a remembered browser preference.

resources.name: ChuanTianML/prompt-for-me
resources.desc: Context-aware next-message suggestions in the DSH composer, with repeated Trigger cycling and explicit user review before sending.

resources.name: chzisnull/dsh-file-finder
resources.desc: File search palette for the DSH workspace: find files by name or content, open results in DSH's native right-sidebar preview, and edit text files inline with version-conflict checks.

resources.name: Cieux/dsh-zoom-scale
resources.desc: Whole-interface zoom from 75% to 200% in 5% steps via a Settings row, a session-header stepper or Ctrl/⌘+wheel, with a shim that converts rects, viewport units, media queries and pointer coordinates so fixed overlays stay anchored to their triggers.

resources.name: cjm-m/dsh-paste-code-block
resources.desc: Cherry Studio-style paste: multi-line/indented/fenced text or code pasted into the DSH Web composer collapses into a bordered, collapsible, language-tagged card and is restored as a fenced code block on send.

resources.name: Cjrrrrrrrr/dsh-plugins#dsh-sidebar-tidy
resources.desc: Sidebar layout fix for the DSH Web UI: caps and scrolls the plugin-action area, shrinks the inline pairing QR code and tightens the brand row, so the workspace and session list stays clickable when footer plugins grow tall.

resources.name: clarag0d/dsh-locale-multilingual
resources.desc: Adds four extra UI locales to DeepSeek Harness — Traditional Chinese (zh-TW), Japanese, Korean and French. All translation data is bundled, so it works fully offline.

resources.name: Cloud017/dsh-prompt-reforge
resources.desc: Adds a reforge control to the DSH composer that rewrites the current draft into a sharper prompt in place, as one undoable edit, with one-click revert and cancellation.

resources.name: clown139880/dsh-live2d-avatar
resources.desc: Live2D avatar stage and desktop companion for DSH: bundled Haru sample, custom Cubism 2/3+ model loading with scale and position controls, a draggable in-page pet, an optional transparent always-on-top desktop pet window, per-conversation expression prompt control, and opt-in voice with self-hosted ASR/TTS.

resources.name: cm860712ch-cloud/dsh-quick-input
resources.desc: A 3×3 pad of saved phrases sitting to the left of the composer and tracking the input box's height: clicking a cell inserts its text at the caret as one undoable edit. Presets are editable in place, 9 cells per page up to 12 pages, and the UI follows the DSH language setting. Falls back to a panel above the composer when the window leaves no room.

resources.name: CMoyuer/dsh-cad-viewer
resources.desc: Adds a 3D model library in its own conversation tab, where agents store models built from CadQuery scripts or supplied as tessellated meshes; the library previews them with three-cad-viewer, organises them into folders and exports them to 10 formats including STEP, BREP, STL and DXF.

resources.name: CNSeniorious000/dsh-generative-ui
resources.desc: Lets the AI insert streaming-generated UI into the conversation or a side panel, written in TSX — already one of the model's native languages, so there is no JSON schema to teach it. Rendered without flicker, state kept across frames with no hard remount, and a click in the card driving the next chat turn. Inline is where streaming matters most; the side Canvas is the more agentic shape. Cards get agentic capabilities of their own — run bash, curl, call the model, read and write files.

resources.name: coii08o0o/dsh-bot-board
resources.desc: A floating board over the chat for DS Bot's team: who is running and on which tool, who is waiting for another Bot to hand work back, who needs your approval or answer, and who failed, with a hand-off table grouped by sender, a per-Bot drawer showing the pending command or question, and a collapsed one-line pill. Read-only — it never writes to DS Bot's data. Needs the DS Bot plugin installed (built against 0.1.7 and 0.2.0); the panel stays hidden without it.

resources.name: ComlaiGonnann/dsh-codex-rail
resources.desc: Transforms DSH into a dual-column Codex workspace with an integrated Activity Bar, unified topbar, avatar quick access, session history navigation.

resources.name: Como44/dsh-zh-more
resources.desc: Chinese-first UI enhancement: translates slash-command names and plugin-inventory cards with three display modes (Chinese only / Chinese + English / off), switching instantly without losing English.

resources.name: converk/dsh-tweaks#git-bash-terminal-tool
resources.desc: Replaces the terminal tool on Windows with Git Bash.

resources.name: converk/dsh-tweaks#prompt-history
resources.desc: Recalls prompts sent earlier in the current session with the up and down keys in an empty composer, and shows a position badge while browsing.

resources.name: converk/dsh-tweaks#smart-list
resources.desc: Continues numbered and bulleted lists in the DSH composer, so Shift+Enter after "1. item" starts a new line with the next marker.

resources.name: cookiesheep/whale-on-desk
resources.desc: Pixel-art whale desktop companion with 29 frame-audited states — taps the glass and flashes the tab title when an approval waits, speaks a completion report when a turn ends, and adds a slash-command palette to the web client.

resources.name: Coprexist/Copree#dsh-copree
resources.desc: Embeds Copree (formerly AIsChat) into the DSH web UI as a native sidebar board. Copree is an open-source framework for AI group chat and programmable worlds: the AIs are residents, not tools — each has its own memory, state and personality, they talk to each other on their own, and you can watch or join in. Group World goes further: every group chat can bind a living world (its own web page + world AI + code + clock) that the world AI builds and edits through DSH workspace tools. This plugin ships the native sidebar board (contacts, pinned DMs and groups), real-time chat over a same-origin HTTP/WS proxy, Markdown/LaTeX rendering, group invites and image messages, immersive full-frame pages, and one-click mirroring of your worlds into DSH workspaces (folder + DSH session + world_* tools). Front end only: it proxies to a Copree backend you run yourself (default 127.0.0.1:5228, same repository).

resources.name: copylee711/dsh-better-display
resources.desc: Renders assistant replies with numbered citation chips and a sources panel for web-search results, inline pictures with their source captions, and KaTeX formulas, Mermaid diagrams and highlighted code in streaming Markdown.

resources.name: cosmoliu2002/dsh-prompt-enhancer
resources.desc: Adds a ✨ button and an /enhance command to the composer that rewrite the draft into a structured prompt, flag open questions below the input, follow the current session model, and offer an undo.

resources.name: cozylove-girl/dsh-appearance-master
resources.desc: Manage skins, themes, backgrounds, and widgets in separate layers and save appearance presets for DeepSeek Harness.

resources.name: crisvollerei/dsh-persona-shell
resources.desc: Re-speaks each assistant report in a chosen persona outside the working prompt, with four built-in presets, per-session switches, and the original available on demand.

resources.name: Crosery/dsh-drop
resources.desc: Drag or paste files into the Web composer with one image-and-file preview rail; native PNG/JPEG/WebP/GIF keep the image attachment path, while other files reuse a matching local path or stream to Host staging and become @ references only at send time. Includes browser media/PDF and bounded text previews; Office and archives show identity cards, and unsent file entries are page-local.

resources.name: Crosery/dsh-viewer
resources.desc: Model-facing display_file tool that renders 36 file extensions inline in the web UI: images with a click-to-zoom lightbox, seekable video, audio, PDF, Office and OpenDocument files converted to PDF on the host via LibreOffice, and local HTML in a sandboxed frame; bytes stream from a signed HTTP route with range support, and PNG/JPEG/WebP/GIF also enter model context on image-capable routes.

resources.name: cshengyi023-collab/dsh-deepsea-echo
resources.desc: Arknights-flavoured startup animation for the DSH Web GUI: a PRTS terminal boot, sonar scan, hologram lock-on and an operator-file splash that end in a deep-sea lockup, about 4.6 seconds, with four selectable original score presets (or sound off), skippable with a click or Esc and switchable, re-timed or replayed from Settings.

resources.name: cshengyi023-collab/dsh-pet-companion
resources.desc: Adds a low-key companion panel with a pomodoro timer, a todo list, drink-water and stand-up reminders, plus lesson explanations and homework tutoring through the installed desktop pet.

resources.name: cspyz/dsh-terse-mode
resources.desc: Four adjustable terse levels plus independent switches for reasoning effort, web search and subagents, on the conversation header and in the Settings page. No output ceiling.

resources.name: CTX666666/dsh-prompt-polish
resources.desc: Polish button in the composer that rewrites the draft with the model the current conversation already uses: four styles, a fidelity guard that keeps every concrete fact verbatim, one-click revert, and no API key of its own.

resources.name: cuhaitiang0405-collab/dsh-indexbookmark
resources.desc: Conversation question index for the DSH Web UI: every question you asked in a session, searchable, paginated, with one-click jump to the exact message.

resources.name: cxv117793-blip/dsh-sidebar-overflow
resources.desc: Puts a More row at the end of the sidebar main panel list and lets you decide, entry by entry, which panels stay visible and which move into it: a menu lists every entry with a one-click switch in either direction, a search box filters long lists, and a single Restore all clears both kinds of key. Also hides the footer action buttons, keeps the plugins entry un-collapsible, and writes each choice to the profile config so it survives a restart.

resources.name: CXZAAA/dsh-radio
resources.desc: Adds a 24px capsule to the composer status row that plays seven preset internet radio stations, with a live spectrum, now-playing metadata for Nightride FM and Radio Paradise, and remembered volume and station.

resources.name: cyh3436332528/dsh-float-chat
resources.desc: Pops the DSH side chat into a frameless, always-on-top Windows desktop window that can sit over any other application, with its own settings page for appearance, pinning, remembered geometry, opacity, ephemeral threads and cache cleanup.

resources.name: cyjyyd/dsh-ssh-tui
resources.desc: Terminal UI for DeepSeek Harness on jump hosts and high-latency links: plain ANSI, incremental repaint, and a session that survives a dropped SSH connection (resume it from the log).

resources.name: cyrus123456/dsh-johari-cognition-quadrant-dialog-composer
resources.desc: Johari cognition-quadrant dialog prompt composer — adds a button above the composer that opens a 2×2 quadrant panel (known/unknown × AI-known/AI-unknown) to groom conversation context into a structured prompt written back into the draft.

resources.name: czxgg0630/dsh-html-annotate
resources.desc: Preview local HTML in the right sidebar, annotate elements or regions, and send the selections with current and target styles into the current session.

resources.name: CZY1326/dsh-restart-button
resources.desc: Adds a circular restart button to the session header, plus an optional app.asar patch that also puts a Restart row in the tray menu.

resources.name: d0ublecl1ck/dsh-flow
resources.desc: Small DeepSeek Harness affordances for everyday actions — locate the current session from the sidebar header (Cmd/Ctrl+Shift+D), copy a session ID from the session row menu (Cmd/Ctrl+Shift+C), open links in the system default program including localhost, open or copy inline code from a context menu, open changed-file cards with a local IDE or reveal them in the file manager, swap Enter with Cmd/Ctrl+Enter, recall sent messages with Up/Down, and show the current workspace name inside the header open button; every one of them has its own switch in a Flow settings page.

resources.name: d0ublecl1ck/dsh-hide-empty-workspace
resources.desc: Auto-hide a sidebar workspace the moment its last unarchived session is archived, and add a "隐藏工作区" entry to each workspace row's own "..." menu. The restore entry sits at the bottom of the sidebar. It only toggles display and never archives, deletes or rewrites a workspace.

resources.name: d0ublecl1ck/dsh-scratchpad-plus
resources.desc: Workspace-free chats that promote real files into their own project workspace - a maintained fork of dsh-scratchpad, kept working on current DSH.

resources.name: d0ublecl1ck/dsh-search-enhance
resources.desc: Search inside the New-Session workspace picker: pinyin initials and full pinyin spelling for Chinese titles, substring matching anywhere for English titles, and separator-insensitive matching.

resources.name: dadazhangn/dsh-prompt-snippets
resources.desc: Save reusable prompt snippets with categories and {{placeholders}}; manage them with /snippet commands (add, list, rm, optimize) and insert into the composer from a draggable dock panel, with one-click AI refinement through the default model.

resources.name: dadgrand/dsh-agent-teams-dashboard
resources.desc: Adds a Teams sidebar dashboard that lists every Agent Teams chat with its roster and task roadmap, token spend in USD and RUB, work and online time, and an archive of older teams. Requires the Agent Teams plugin.

resources.name: daetz-coder/dsh-multi-chat
resources.desc: Multi-window wall for the DSH Web UI: run and monitor N conversations side-by-side in one screen, with auto-discovery, per-window controls, and an authenticated LAN gateway for phone/tablet access.

resources.name: damlys99/dsh-morning-paper
resources.desc: A newspaper-style front page for a session you left running, as a Conversation View tab beside Chat and Trajectory: a per-turn timeline (duration, steps, tools, tokens, outcome), file churn counted per file, where the wall clock went and how much of it was the model rather than tools, which single turn ate the spend, failures nobody retried quoted with their failing command, and a context-pressure gauge measured against the routed model's own declared capacity. The briefing is folded from the durable session log and never generated by a model, so it costs no tokens, cannot hallucinate, and is byte-identical for the same log and clock; it appends nothing to the session and reaches no model, and it reports a pending approval without ever answering it. Pages are offered only when they have content, and the tab refreshes itself on turn settle and on a two-speed poll backed by a metadata-only tail probe.

resources.name: damlys99/dsh-queue-reorder
resources.desc: Reorder the messages queued while a DSH agent is busy, from inside the official queue dock: a drag handle and per-row ↑ / ↓ buttons on the dock's own rows, applied on the host as one concurrency-checked inbox splice. The dock is decorated rather than replaced, so previews, inline editing, steering, removal and attachments stay as shipped. A move is refused when the queue has changed since the caller last saw it, when the row is not a user prompt (a goal round prompt, for example), or when the queue belongs to a subagent session.

resources.name: DamonKoy/dsh-web-ui#dsh-aionui-panel
resources.desc: Right-panel system for the dsh web GUI: a pixel-faithful AionUi Explorer + Preview (file tree, diff view, preview).

resources.name: DamonKoy/dsh-web-ui#dsh-liangshen
resources.desc: LiangShen (梁神) agent preset for the dsh web GUI: a two-phase anchored-standard preset.

resources.name: DamonKoy/dsh-web-ui#dsh-task-board
resources.desc: Task board for the dsh web GUI: a sidebar entry plus a multi-column kanban view with local persistence.

resources.name: DamonKoy/dsh-web-ui#dsh-web-ui-settings
resources.desc: Web UI plugin group card in the dsh settings page: enable switches and config for the dsh-web-ui family.

resources.name: Daneel0001/dsh-plugin-zh-cn
resources.desc: Renders installed DSH plugin titles and descriptions in Simplified Chinese: at startup it translates the plugins the local JSON cache lacks through the harness LLM service, then projects { en, zh } metadata for resolveText() to render — no DOM changes, no third-party API.

resources.name: DanZai233/dsh-webask
resources.desc: Adds a button beside the composer and a global hotkey palette (default mod+shift+k) that hand one-off questions to a web chat instead of into the harness context: the draft is lifted out of the composer, copied to the clipboard and opened in the templated URL. Ships target-site presets (DeepSeek, Kimi, Qwen, 豆包, 腾讯元宝, GLM, Gemini), a local question history that can be re-opened, copied, or inserted back into the composer, and a settings tab for site, URL template, hotkey, clipboard and history.

resources.name: datit309/dsh-live-inspector
resources.desc: Real-time inspector of the files the agent reads and edits, with a file tree, in the DeepSeek Harness right sidebar: M/A/R badges, side-by-side diffs and live agent activity tracking.

resources.name: day-day-dream/dsh-page-refresh#dsh-page-refresh
resources.desc: Adds a refresh button and a power menu (restart / close DeepSeek Harness) to the conversation header. Client-only, zero tokens, no dependencies. The power menu is Windows-only.

resources.name: dcrzsy/dsh-enhance-tool
resources.desc: All-in-one UI enhancement layer for DeepSeek Harness web: prompt library with quick-insert and management, two-step AI polish, predicted-reply dock with click-to-send, MCP tool management, scheduled automation, smart session titles, adjustable chat width, full-width AI messages without gray background, auto-collapse for long user messages with smooth expand/collapse animations, and scene-specific entrance animations across all plugin surfaces.

resources.name: DDSG-X/dsh-workspace-dir
resources.desc: Shows the current conversation's working directory in a draggable directory panel with adjustable opacity.

resources.name: ddy-007/dsh-client-resume-button
resources.desc: Adds a Continue button left of the model selector: after a turn ends aborted by the user, interrupted by a crash or errored, one click sends notices asking the model to pick that turn back up, and the button collapses while you type or attach a file.

resources.name: deanzhang2026-max/dsh-lived-pet#dsh-pet-bridge
resources.desc: Writes the harness agent live state (thinking, working, waiting, done, error) to a state file that a bundled Electron Live2D desktop pet polls, so the pet bubble and face follow what the agent is doing.

resources.name: DedsecLemon/dsh-obsidian
resources.desc: Your real Obsidian vault in the DSH right Sidebar: vault tree, full-vault search, read-view typography, wikilinks and heading anchors, properties, backlinks, highlights, in-place editing, an outline, and a right-click menu for handoff, rename and .trash.

resources.name: deepseekbluefish/dsh-screenshot-plugin
resources.desc: WeChat-style in-app screenshot button: drag a region, fine-tune with 8 resize handles, Enter to capture and Esc to cancel; auto-numbered PNGs plus a \[Shot N HH:mm] marker written into the composer. Windows-only, tested on DeepSeek Harness Desktop.

resources.name: delaydai/dsh-jumpbar
resources.desc: User message jump bar for the DSH web GUI: a minimap-style dash strip on the right edge of the conversation, with hover preview, click-to-jump, drag-to-scrub and a viewport marker.

resources.name: demacia1314/dsh-airdrop
resources.desc: ⭐ Drag-and-drop uploads of any file or whole folders, anywhere in the window; remote-safe — bytes go straight into the session workspace on the server, so a DSH deployed on a remote machine works exactly like localhost.

resources.name: Dengzi555/dsh-quotalk
resources.desc: Select response text or code to ask contextual follow-ups with streaming replies in a native sidebar.

resources.name: dennisrongo/dsh-plugins#dsh-weather
resources.desc: Draggable weather bar in the shell overlay with forecast and geocoding from Open-Meteo; the position persists across sessions.

resources.name: DeveloperYe/dsh-local-files
resources.desc: Local file manager served by the DSH web server itself: whole-disk browsing, previews for images, PDF, video and audio, text, Markdown, JSON, CSV, sandboxed HTML, docx and xlsx, Range downloads, folder ZIP, drag-and-drop upload, copy/paste, conflict-checked text editing, create/rename/delete-to-trash, and xlsx cell editing saved as a copy.

resources.name: Devin-AXIS/deepseek-design#deepseek-idesign
resources.desc: Visual design studio for websites, app prototypes, posters, cards, reports, and magazines, with templates, direct element editing, selection-aware AI draft handoff, and export.

resources.name: Devin-AXIS/deepseek-design#deepseek-ivideo
resources.desc: Visual video studio with an editable timeline, animation and media controls, 27 templates, whole-video and selection-aware AI draft handoff, validation, preview, and export.

resources.name: DevinMx520/dsh-selection-translator
resources.desc: Adds a right-click menu to selected text in the Harness Web UI that replaces it with a Simplified Chinese translation in place, and restores the original on a second right-click.

resources.name: dgy970516/dsh-status-turbo
resources.desc: A status bar in the composer footer showing the current phase, how long it has been running, the current step token count and a no-progress warning, projected from session logs without polling the host, plus a detail panel that opens on click.

resources.name: dhb861832993-star/pbr-render
resources.desc: PBR 3D model preview for game art: GLB/GLTF with textures, IBL environment lighting, orbit controls, and a material channel inspector (baseColor/normal/roughness/metallic/AO/emissive/wireframe); scalar channels shown as grayscale per PBR spec, via the pbr3d fence and pbr_render tool.

resources.name: dhdkfkfkf/dsh-pull-to-send
resources.desc: Send by dragging instead of clicking. Press the composer and pull up to arm the gesture; releasing sends, dragging back into the composer cancels, and dragging outside the conversation area cancels on the spot. Mouse and pen only.

resources.name: dhdkfkfkf/dsh-qbuddy-prompt-enhance
resources.desc: Button beside the composer that rewrites the current draft into a more executable prompt in place. Ships four built-in presets spanning light polish to aggressive expansion, accepts user-defined presets, and switches preset, prompt model and reasoning effort directly from the button without leaving the composer. The button appears only when the draft has content, shows a running timer while enhancing, and surfaces failures with a retry.

resources.name: DIAG5/dsh-better-input
resources.desc: Input experience enhancement: voice input, AI polish, anti-overwrite, prompt optimization with diff preview, and auto locale switching following DSH UI language.

resources.name: dialling/dsh-galaxy-view
resources.desc: Draws workspaces and conversations as a 3D star map in the stock panel slot: eight layouts (spiral, rings, armillary sphere, solar system, double helix, irregular web, cubic lattice, radial tree), eight colour themes, a memory-library map of instruction files, skills and skill calls, star-to-star fly-throughs, and a 中/EN switch. Links are drawn only where a workspace owns a conversation or one conversation descends from another.

resources.name: diexianxiang/dsh-custom-splash
resources.desc: A customizable video splash screen plugin for DSH. Replace the default startup with your own local video.

resources.name: dingchenhui0618-arch/dsh-market-sidebar
resources.desc: Adds the dshmarket plugin market to the DSH sidebar as a panel of its own, ordered above the built-in Plugins entry. Clicking the entry renders the market through the client service dshmarket publishes for hosts, so the catalog, category filters, comments and install and update flows are the ones dshmarket ships rather than a copy of them. Nothing to learn or configure: the panel is the market, with its own sidebar entry, label in Chinese or English to match the interface language, and icon. If dshmarket is not loaded the panel says so instead of failing client composition, and its locale keys, slots and style tag are released when the plugin unloads.

resources.name: dingchenhui0618-arch/dsh-signal-pet
resources.desc: A small pet in the corner of the interface that reads the real event stream instead of guessing: it drifts when idle, speeds up while the agent is thinking, draws a flowing line per running tool call, turns red and shakes with the error summary on a failure, and celebrates a turn that ran longer than ten seconds. The same widget is the at-a-glance busy and error indicator, so there is no spinner to stare at. The host half folds real harness events into a snapshot and the client half only draws it; it performs no content recognition, and it positions itself away from the composer so it never sits over what you are typing.

resources.name: DingL0312/dsh-long-input-window
resources.desc: Adds a full-screen dialog for writing long messages: Markdown on the left rendered live by marked on the right, with a draggable splitter that remembers its ratio. Confirming writes the text back to the composer draft, keeping command tokens and @-reference chips as a fixed prefix; Esc asks whether to discard or write back before closing.

resources.name: dingyi580/dsh-conversation-rail
resources.desc: Left-edge conversation rail for the Web UI: one bar per turn, length scaled to the turn text, hover for a question and answer preview, click to jump; bars come from a host-side outline of the whole session log, so turns outside the loaded window are drawn too and history is paged in on click.

resources.name: djs326/dsh-plugin-width-slider
resources.desc: All-in-one UI plugin for DSH Desktop (Windows): conversation-width slider with fullscreen preview and follow-window mode, thinking-block enhancements (forced Chinese, expand/collapse, Markdown rendering), an Open With header button, UI label localization, a resizable settings dialog, session delete, and workspace tabs.

resources.name: Dkrillex/dsh-macos-pet
resources.desc: macOS desk pet forked from anneheartrecord/dsh-desk-pet, in a real always-on-top window that covers fullscreen Spaces: the pose follows whatever the local DSH is doing across six states, the right-click menu is a real AppKit one carrying quiet mode and a session list, and seven skins ship with it. Two of the seven are drawn from geometry by a script in the repo rather than generated, so making a skin needs no image model and no API credits; the bundled skill still expands one photo into all eighteen poses on your own image tool and credentials. There is no Electron and nothing to install alongside it: the window is driven through ctypes on the Python that ships with macOS.

resources.name: dmscode/dsh-peak-valley
resources.desc: Tints the strip above the composer green or red to match DeepSeek's off-peak and peak billing windows, shows the remaining time of the current window as a progress bar, and ships six themes plus a custom-CSS hook.

resources.name: dmscode/dsh-rightbar-tab-gestures
resources.desc: Closes right-sidebar tabs with a middle click or a left double click, reusing the built-in close button so the native rules (such as the last docked guide card being unclosable) still apply.

resources.name: Dogwind221/img2img-studio#dsh-img2img-config
resources.desc: Adds two UI surfaces: a composer image editor (numbered edit marks with per-mark instructions, solid-background removal, brush-mask erase, resize and crop presets; results return to the composer as attachments plus a manifest capsule) and a Settings → vision/generation provider panel (three priority tiers, drag reordering, per-channel model fallback chains, arrears-aware balance probing, ChatGPT-web account store) that writes the resolved providers back to the skills .env files.

resources.name: domitor-syh/dsh-ui-skin-switcher
resources.desc: Replaces the model button with a Claude Desktop-style model and reasoning-effort switcher, with per-model effort memory, theme-aware styling, smooth slider feel, rounded track, hover highlight, and pixel-dot animation.

resources.name: domparent/OLEDCare
resources.desc: OLED burn-in care for the Web GUI with pure-black surfaces, gamma-aware text dimming on an idle/focus ladder, a true-black nap screensaver with live agent status, and slow accent-hue rotation.

resources.name: dongasai/dsh_editor
resources.desc: The writable half of the right-sidebar document preview: edit and save any text file in place. Every save carries the version that was opened, so when the file changed on disk during the edit it stops and asks instead of overwriting. The preview toolbar gains an edit button and a two-step delete button. A separate File editor sidebar tool brings its own file tree: create, rename or move, copy, cut and paste (including a file taken from the system clipboard), delete, and drag to reorganize. Two renderer bands cover 107 plain-text, config and source extensions; the second is offered only as an open-with choice, leaving the shipped Markdown and highlighted-code views as the default. Mutations run through the plugin own trusted host routes, behind the connection fence, the workspace containment check and the sandbox policy.

resources.name: dongasai/dsh_setting_pro
resources.desc: Enlarges the DSH web settings dialog (default 1180x920, 20px steps, remembered per browser) and adds an Advanced Settings page that resizes it and hosts Host operations: restart dsh with a 3-second delay and a busy confirmation, restart once all sessions have been idle for 10s (cancellable, repeat clicks idempotent), last start time with uptime, and a dsh version/update check that compares npm dist-tags across selectable channels without upgrading. The same bundle replaces the sidebar brand area with a machine name, adds a read-only provider, model and thinking-level cell beside the composer stats pills, and a switch that registers or unregisters the three dsh_restart_* agent tools at runtime. Zero dependencies, no build step; all routes sit behind the connection trust fence.

resources.name: DONGBIN007/dsh-sidebar-restart
resources.desc: Adds a Restart row to the desktop app's sidebar foot beside Settings that restarts the app and reloads the page onto the newly installed plugin bundle.

resources.name: dongfangxy/dsh-agents-md-settings
resources.desc: Adds a Settings → General row that opens ~/.dsh/AGENTS.md in the system editor, so the instruction file can be opened without hunting for it. On Windows it launches Notepad and raises the window.

resources.name: dongfangxy/dsh-open-project
resources.desc: Adds a Windows Explorer folder context-menu entry that registers the folder as a DSH project, with a switch for the menu entry in Settings → General. Windows only, and nothing extra has to be installed.

resources.name: dongwenxiu83-web/dsh-friendly-steps
resources.desc: Folds Think and tool-call rows into a floating summary pill with red failure counts, for a cleaner writer-friendly chat view.

resources.name: donyue7/dsh-aoci-panel
resources.desc: AOCI cognition panel for DSH: multi-workspace AOCI overview, per-repo index and governance view, MCP binding diagnosis, and guided or batch initialization. Governance, verification and guided/batch initialization require the external aoci CLI on the host; index browsing works without it.

resources.name: DQS-PUBLIC/dsh-price-chip
resources.desc: Sidebar chip showing the current DeepSeek price period (peak or off-peak), the selected model's price per million tokens for cache hits, cache misses and output, the account balance and today's spend.

resources.name: dreamfarer-space/deepseek-harness-intelligent-ui
resources.desc: Generative, interactive UI for DeepSeek Harness: the agent picks per reply between 26 validated native components and sandboxed streaming HTML widgets, patches a rendered UI in place by component ID, restores tabs, sorts, filters and form values after a reload, and computes slider and filter changes in the browser without another model call.

resources.name: DreamLoomStudio/dsh-primitive-pulse
resources.desc: A floating panel that lights up which HowNet semantic primitives the current answer touches, as a brain-shaped node graph, EEG-style channel traces and a composition card.

resources.name: dreammaker2016/dsh-file-menu
resources.desc: Right-click menus for the DSH Web UI — copy, cut, paste and select all on text and input areas, plus copy path, reveal in the file manager and open with the default app on file references and links.

resources.name: drliuhuan/dsh-plugin-zoom
resources.desc: Manually zoom the Harness Web UI from 75% to 200% via a Settings row, Ctrl+wheel, or a Session-header control, keeping text crisp and readable on high-DPI displays.

resources.name: drowsylazy/dsh-thinking-effort-rheostat
resources.desc: A Claude Desktop-inspired composer slider for adjusting model reasoning effort with click, drag, or keyboard controls.

resources.name: drscrewdriver/dsh-arrowkey-nav
resources.desc: Arrow-key navigation for the DSH Web GUI: Up/Down switch sessions inside the current workspace and Left/Right switch workspaces, reading session identity from the client controllers rather than the DOM, and yielding the keys back to the composer while a draft is being edited.

resources.name: drscrewdriver/dsh-brief-sidebar
resources.desc: A dsh-better-sidebar tab that renders a session brief — a todo board read from the todos projection plus a deliverables section listing the files written this turn — and hides the official todo panel above the composer while it is mounted.

resources.name: drscrewdriver/dsh-canvas-tsx-sidebar
resources.desc: A dsh-better-sidebar tab that statically parses Qoder Canvas *.canvas.tsx files into structured pages in the DSH right sidebar (the source is never executed: no eval, no bundler, no sandbox iframe), with a file-viewer takeover for .tsx and a bundled Skill for authoring the format.

resources.name: drscrewdriver/dsh-input-traffic
resources.desc: Three-tier now/next/later input planning dock for the DeepSeek Harness web GUI: a red/yellow/green priority strip replaces the busy-Enter queue, plain Enter queues to later, with in-place multi-line editing, drag reorder, and session-isolated freeze/resume; the freeze button bridges a separate plugin, dsh-session-guard (installable from dsh-market), via stopNextTurn/resume RPC + composer lock for a real per-session lock, pairing with its global peak-hour auto-pause to stop sessions during DeepSeek's high-cost windows and resume off-peak.

resources.name: drscrewdriver/dsh-paste-dock
resources.desc: Turns large text pastes into pastes/*.txt attachments with a dock above the composer and a minimal, recognisable badge in the draft.

resources.name: drscrewdriver/dsh-sidebar-fold
resources.desc: Folds the sidebar's add-on panel rows (schedules, agent teams, plugin market, context pages, …) under the shipped "More" row: a 28x28 chevron toggle on that row collapses them into a single header line and expands them back, the fold state persists per window, the rows kept visible are chosen with per-row switches read from the live sidebar, and each managed row's icon + label can be aligned left, centre or right. Client-only plugin: adds DOM, patches no host bundle, and uninstalls back to the shipped sidebar. Requires DSH 0.2.1-rc.3 exactly; other versions install but stay inert.

resources.name: drscrewdriver/dsh-tidy-display
resources.desc: Honest merge of two community plugins into one calmer display: the streaming reading view from dsh-better-display (fork) and the message rail from dsh-tidychat. For theme lovers it wraps reasoning prose and tool-call output in translucent message bubbles, so text no longer sits directly on busy wallpapers or skins where it is hard to read. Cross-version rc adaptation attempted across DSH 0.1.0-0.2.0 (all rc); no obvious problems so far.

resources.name: dsh-blue/blue#blue
resources.desc: Plugin-tree terminal UI for DeepSeek Harness — streaming markdown transcript, tool cards, fuzzy slash commands, and live theming, with every component a hot-swappable Cordis plugin.

resources.name: dsh-niao/dsh-niao-quick-open
resources.desc: UI enhancement suite for DeepSeek Harness: one-click workspace open (copy path, reveal in Finder, open in an auto-discovered editor), DeepSeek-web-style user-message nav rail, session to-do marks, flat-list polish, and a hard-restart button.

resources.name: dsh-plugin-collection/dsh-group-status
resources.desc: Aggregated status badges on collapsed sidebar groups in DSH: a folded folder row shows in-progress / awaiting-approval / done / scheduled / review-pending counts, with numbers and hover detail. (sidebar badge / group status / aggregate)

resources.name: dsh-plugin-collection/dsh-suggest-ghost
resources.desc: Input prediction for the DSH composer: your next prompt suggested as ghost text after each turn, accepted with Tab. (autocomplete / input prediction / prompt suggestion)

resources.name: du-u-uck/DSH-Prompt-Optimization
resources.desc: Adds a one-click prompt optimization button to the DSH composer, with undo and an optional dedicated optimizer model.

resources.name: duanyunlun/dsh-session-actions
resources.desc: Sidebar conversation actions: open the row menu on right-click, rename by double-click, copy the session id, and delete a conversation together with its storage after a confirmation.

resources.name: DWJZ/dsh-restart
resources.desc: Adds a Restart page to the DSH Web settings panel. The page shows the PID, port, start time and uptime of the running host and restarts it through a detached helper that waits until the port stops answering before replaying the same launch invocation; the page reloads itself once the replacement host answers with a new boot id.

resources.name: dygin/dsh-recover-context
resources.desc: Roll back to before any of your questions or edit the last one and resubmit, with the workspace files of the discarded turns restored.

resources.name: e2mcc/dsh-popout-sidebar
resources.desc: Pop-out sidebar: lists artifacts and a file tree with multiple preview formats, pops out into a separate browser tab you can drag to another monitor, and coexists with other sidebar plugins simultaneously.

resources.name: EastMG/dsh-gacha-calendar
resources.desc: Gacha banner and event schedule lookup for anime games: sidebar button with current banners, events and countdowns for 28 gacha games, with auto-refresh, search, Windows expiry reminders and .ics export.

resources.name: ecbob/dsh-window-size-keeper
resources.desc: Keeps the DSH desktop window the size you left it: records the last outer frame of the main window in physical pixels and restores it, centred on the work area, on the next start - and it acts before the window is ever shown, so the boot animation plays at the right size. The settings page offers 12 presets (1024x768 to 3840x2160), free-form custom width and height, a centre-on-restore switch and an apply-now action; a choice takes effect immediately and persists. Resizing goes through a small helper executable compiled on the user's own machine: the C# source ships inside the plugin, is built on first run with the in-box Windows csc.exe (measured ~110 ms once, cached next to the state file, ~90 ms to start), and falls back to a short-lived powershell.exe process when that is not possible. The package ships no binary, declares no npm dependencies and makes no outbound network request. Windows only.

resources.name: ECNU/EduWork#dsh-annotation
resources.desc: Select reply text, edit numbered annotations, and send several with a question using native DSH composer references, draft persistence, and submission; requires DSH 0.2.1-rc.2 or later within the 0.2.x series.

resources.name: Edge-HH/GrokBot_in_DeepseekHerness
resources.desc: Bring GrokBot into DeepSeek harness.

resources.name: EdwardXiao-bit/dsh-run-button
resources.desc: Adds a Run button to shell code blocks in replies, executing the snippet through the host shell service and showing its output in a floating bottom-right dock, or in one bottom-panel tab per run.

resources.name: el16z3c/dsh-think-ux
resources.desc: Smooth think-row experience for the DSH Web UI: think rows expand as a capped 24-line preview that glides to the bottom while reasoning streams, collapse with a short height animation on settle, and the main conversation view follows with a reader-safe smooth chase (no snaps, no yanks).

resources.name: elangan1997-cmyk/canvas-workbench#canvas-workbench
resources.desc: Pluggable design canvas inside DSH — standalone Excalidraw board, session image tools (edit, erase, background removal, OCR, vectorize, PSD/text rebuild), project asset library, and a Photoshop/Illustrator ⇄ canvas bridge.

resources.name: Elefseus/dsh-pet-progress
resources.desc: Folds the durable todo and goal events the dsh pet ignores into a percentage bubble on the pet, and falls back to a one-line activity summary for a session that never wrote a todo list. Requires the dsh web pet plugin (@linxin666/dsh-pet >= 0.4.0).

resources.name: eloimovo/better-dsh-codex-effort-slider
resources.desc: Takes over the model button in the DSH composer and opens its own two-level panel (provider list, then model list with search) built around a continuous draggable reasoning-effort slider: the fill runs blue to violet, higher levels add nebula and dust particles, and every level has its own color. Drag moves one level at a time, and picking a model keeps the panel open and repositions the slider to that model's middle level.

resources.name: enteguo/dsh-plugin-quick-chat
resources.desc: Adds a Quick Chat entry to the Web UI sidebar that opens a floating chat window with its own model and reasoning-effort picker, optionally seeded with the current session's transcript, and keeps every side conversation in a resumable, renamable, deletable history.

resources.name: enterhalf/dsh-session-colorful-unread-pin-jobs
resources.desc: Colors each DSH sidebar session title by state: unread (blue while the model is running, green once it has finished) and pinned (yellow, read from DSH's own pinned set), composed into one left-to-right gradient. Pinning, archiving and ordering stay with DSH itself — the plugin reimplements no pinning and rewrites no official bundle — and a settings section lists every unread session.

resources.name: eomis/packhub-workbench-assistant
resources.desc: Adds quick installation and switching for workbench templates in DSH Desktop.

resources.name: Ephemeral-AI-Lab/mayfly#mayfly
resources.desc: Interactive terminal UI for DeepSeek Harness: tables, Mermaid and chart rendering, side conversations, and the same Cordis plugin model as dsh Web.

resources.name: Ernesto-yuan/dsh-conversation-tools
resources.desc: A floating in-conversation find bar docked over the DSH composer (Ctrl/⌘+F or the magnifier beside the input): hits list with a match counter as you type, Enter jumps to the next hit, hovering a hit pops a scrollable full-text card with a one-click copy of the whole message, the up arrow in an empty composer recalls previously sent messages one at a time with their image and file attachments restored as drafts, hovering any image in the conversation shows a copy button that writes it to the clipboard as PNG, and every finished answer gains a regenerate button while the newest also gets continue. Client-side only, searches the messages already loaded in the conversation, and never jumps.

resources.name: EternalNight996/dsh-theme
resources.desc: Theme skin plugin for DeepSeek Harness — built-in themes / static image / dynamic 360°-follow video, one-click from the sidebar & Settings; imports persist, default skins protected.

resources.name: EternalNight996/dsh-ui-agents-pixe
resources.desc: Adds a "Work Roles" tab and a pixel-art office overlay to the DeepSeek Harness Web UI: 508 built-in role cards (The Agency 255 + agency-agents-zh 253) with search, EN/ZH toggle and department filter; draggable Canvas 2D pixel characters that stand, type and pace, with idle chat that can plug into AI. One-command npm install, no dsh source changes.

resources.name: EternalNight996/dsh-ui-three-body
resources.desc: Adds a sentient floating eye to DeepSeek Harness — injects a taming kernel that makes the AI truly understand you, with 11 dynamic eye skins, ghost mode, and zero token cost when AI mode is off.

resources.name: EugeneVl/dsh_session_folders
resources.desc: One-level session folders for the web sidebar - group sessions per workspace, move them by drag-and-drop or context menu, archive and restore, server-side persistence.

resources.name: EventHorizonXT/dsh-model-navigator
resources.desc: Replace the model picker with global search, favorites, recent selections, model-family navigation, and reasoning effort selection.

resources.name: exoticknight/dsh-just-chat
resources.desc: One-click native conversations with independent workspaces for DeepSeek Harness.

resources.name: Eyeing0721/dsh-cot-en2cn
resources.desc: Shows a Chinese translation under each English thinking block in the DSH web chat, without modifying the session transcript; per-chunk caching, a configurable translation model, and a settings panel.

resources.name: Faide-cyber/dsh-model-in-use
resources.desc: Marks models in use by other running sessions in the DSH model menu, and restores the remembered reasoning effort and group collapse state for each model.

resources.name: Fakek0f3sT/dsh-mcp-diff
resources.desc: Renders every file mutation in the web chat as one collapsed diff card with per-line highlighting — MCP filesystem edit_file/write_file and the built-in edit/write.

resources.name: FallenWings27/dsh-provider-card-release
resources.desc: Plays a character entrance card beside the composer when you switch model: identity name, six scored axes (intelligence, coding, speed, stability, cost, context), quota hint and a dialogue line. 23 curated cards across 15 providers; models without a curated card fall back to a data card derived from public benchmarks, or a generic card when no benchmark data exists. A web client plugin with no dependencies and no hooks.

resources.name: fan56/dsh-tui-pi
resources.desc: Full-featured TUI for DeepSeek Harness: streaming conversation, powerline status bar, real-time think/tool/todo panels, subagent dual-view, theme hot-switch — all as pure cordis plugins with zero upstream patches.

resources.name: fangwen9527/dsh-composer-ux
resources.desc: Configurable send and newline keys, a composer context menu with three sources (leave it to DSH and other plugins / browser menu / plugin-styled custom menu), a quick-command panel with categorized prompt lists where each prompt can append on every send or only on the first message of a session, a create-and-move row at the bottom of each category, a prompt optimizer that rewrites the draft with a separate model call, settings-panel size memory, and automatic x-opencode-session header injection for OpenCode routes. Prompt lists live in a global ~/.dsh/quick-prompts.json that is independent of the session and the project.

resources.name: FanXi1230/fanxi#dsh-nova
resources.desc: A cosmic reasoning-effort slider for the DeepSeek Harness composer. Off, Low, High, and Max each have their own starfield and aurora, with smooth cross-fades and real per-session model selection.

resources.name: FAVKTOXIC/dsh-caption-bar
resources.desc: Moves conversation views into the Windows caption row and header utilities into a compact right rail on DSH Desktop with Codex UI, reclaiming a full row of vertical space while preserving the session title, fullscreen control, dynamic status counts and menus.

resources.name: faxble/dsh-model-picker
resources.desc: Model quick picker for DeepSeek Harness: a button left of the model dropdown opens a full model-selection dialog with provider grouping, live search, provider filter, capability tags read from the user's own input config, reasoning badges, recent-model shortcuts and a reasoning-effort picker; the choice writes back to the native dropdown immediately.

resources.name: faxble/dsh-open-with-vscode
resources.desc: Adds a button left of the built-in Open In... in the session header that opens the current workspace directory in VS Code, fixing the desktop ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE environment leak that makes the built-in open-in-app fail with HTTP 502. Windows only: it locates Code.exe, so macOS and Linux are not supported yet.

resources.name: Fayelin12/dsh-office
resources.desc: Office workspace & session dashboard: a floating 6-column sprite panel visualizing workspaces, sessions, token usage and subagents, plus Agent Mail and an office log tab. Feishu/Lark views (message feed, meeting schedules, transcripts) additionally require the @larksuite/cli tool installed and authenticated separately.

resources.name: FeatherHunter/dsh-im-companion
resources.desc: IM Companion for dsh-im: groups Feishu/WeChat/QQ bots by Agent in DSH workspaces and enhances DSH native session states (blue/orange/red rail markers for running, needs-review and error), with left badges, one-click filter, fleet overview and drag-to-move. Clean uninstall.

resources.name: FeatherHunter/dsh-prompt
resources.desc: 🌹 Save every repetitive, tiresome templated prompt — one mouse click injects it into the composer and spares you the effort.

resources.name: FeatherHunter/ilife#dsh-life-pack
resources.desc: ⚠️ Internal beta, do not download ⚠️ iLife: one DSH settings card for the iLife home-life suite — memo, calorie, chef, home, schedule and bill in a tab bar — covering every part of your home life.

resources.name: feiyaochang123-sys/dsh-starred-turns
resources.desc: Right-click a dash in the conversation's right-edge turn rail to bookmark that turn: the dash grows to the rail's full width and takes the accent colour so it stays easy to find, and right-clicking again unbookmarks it. Bookmarks are scoped per conversation, keyed by the selected Session id, and persisted so they survive reloads. No layout shift - the rail keeps its fixed pitch.

resources.name: Feizhaiqianqian/dsh-email-board
resources.desc: Read-only unread-mail board for the accounts configured in dsh-email — unread messages appear as per-account cards in the DSH right sidebar (sender, subject, time) and refresh on demand.

resources.name: FeiZhuNiU-INFJA/dsh-stock-ticker
resources.desc: A floating, semi-transparent market ticker for DeepSeek Harness showing real-time level and change percentage for the Shanghai Composite, ChiNext, STAR 50 and Hang Seng Tech indices.

resources.name: FelixJiashengFu/dsh-recent-deliverables
resources.desc: Draggable recent-deliverables panel for DSH Web that merges declared deliverables with recently modified workspace files, with filename search, type filters, inline PDF/HTML/image/text previews, and desktop open or reveal actions.

resources.name: feng-yifan/dsh-plugins#dsh-ask-highlight
resources.desc: Highlights answered ask blocks (question n/n answered) in the conversation with a soft card style; pending asks and other tool blocks keep their native look; optional expand-by-default and a settings page.

resources.name: feng-yifan/dsh-plugins#dsh-pwa-icon
resources.desc: PWA icon: sets the icon (and manifest app name) used when the Web GUI is installed or added to the desktop; ships a default icon set and accepts a custom image.

resources.name: feng-yifan/dsh-plugins#dsh-vertical-layout
resources.desc: Portrait layout for desktop windows: navigation takes the full left column, the file/terminal panel moves above the conversation, and a draggable splitter sets its height; touch devices are unaffected.

resources.name: fengb3/dsh-session-icons
resources.desc: Sidebar session-title icons: an auxiliary model call on the same route as title generation draws a 24x24 monochrome SVG metaphor shown before each session row title, with disk caching.

resources.name: fengMax1997/dsh-line-select
resources.desc: Line-range selection: browse workspace files, preview code with line numbers, visually select a line range, and write a @path:start-end reference into the composer; the agent receives the exact selected lines on send.

resources.name: ferrisching/dsh-prompt-predict
resources.desc: Predicts the user's next prompt after each assistant reply and shows it as gray ghost text inside the composer; accept it whole with Tab, accept it piece by piece with Alt+→, reroll it, or dismiss it with Esc.

resources.name: fewoot/dsh-whale-particles
resources.desc: Dot-matrix backdrop for the DSH Web UI: the dots form the DeepSeek whale or a transparent PNG you import (alpha-masked), each dot carries its own low-frequency force and follows the cursor in manual mode, while an auto screensaver mode sweeps 360-degree waves and full-screen breathing across the artwork; sliders and toggles live under Settings > Plugins.

resources.name: FideFeiPlane/dsh-auto-maximize
resources.desc: Maximizes the DeepSeek Harness desktop window automatically on startup, equivalent to clicking the maximize button once. Cross-platform (Windows/macOS/Linux), best-effort, host-only.

resources.name: fightingFirefox/dsh-web-terminal
resources.desc: Claude-styled terminal panel for the DSH web GUI: agent shell commands run in a persistent real PTY with a genuine prompt, echo and exit codes, auto-open in the right sidebar and are scoped per conversation; optional live_terminal_* tools for reading, searching and screenshotting. Fork of Lancang-hzau/dsh-live-terminal (MIT); it shares its live_terminal_* tools and right-sidebar panel, so do not install it together with the upstream plugin in the same profile.

resources.name: FinalLawer/dsh-native-code-workbench#dsh-code-workbench
resources.desc: Code workbench in the right sidebar: a workspace file tree and a multi-tab Monaco editor with syntax highlighting and version-guarded saving, Tab completion from DeepSeek fill-in-the-middle, per-save checkpoints with rollback, codebase search (plus a codebase_search tool for the agent), and reference chips that insert a selection into the chat as an @path mention.

resources.name: Findly-qwb/dsh-model-picker
resources.desc: Two-pane model picker that replaces the composer model menu with a searchable provider-grouped list on the left and a detail card on the right showing the selected model's context window, output cap, capability tags and reasoning-effort levels, all read from that model's own provider. The npm name dsh-model-picker belongs to another author; install through this GitHub source.

resources.name: Firefly-TheHerta/dsh-boot-video-manager
resources.desc: A companion playlist panel for the dsh-boot-animation intro-video plugin: add clips without leaving the app, order them, and switch between sequential, random and single-clip playback. Sequential order is made deterministic by parking every clip except the one due to play in a disabled/ subdirectory of the same asset folder and rotating it back in on each boot, leaving the upstream plugin unpatched. Also supports recycling instead of deleting, pinning one clip for every launch, per-clip opt-out, and .mp4/.webm/.m4v/.mov files including non-ASCII names.

resources.name: fishcg/dsh-input-prediction
resources.desc: Input prediction: the likely continuation of your draft appears as grey ghost text after the caret and Tab accepts it, and after each assistant turn 1-3 clickable follow-up suggestions appear above the input box and send on click. Ghost completion, suggestions and the suggestion count can be toggled in Settings, Built-in plugins.

resources.name: fishcg/dsh-recent-tasks
resources.desc: A collapsible Recent tasks folder at the top of the sidebar above 工作区: the most recently updated sessions, pinning that ignores recency, running-state spinners, and a per-row menu with rename, fork and archive.

resources.name: flowers-59f/dsh-petpal
resources.desc: Download pets from petdex.dev and keep one on the desktop, following the DSH session status; the appearance is adjustable and an enterprise WeChat bot can push a notification when the agent needs confirmation or finishes a turn. Desktop mode needs macOS 12+ or Windows 10 1903+; the bundled companion is prebuilt.

resources.name: flycucu/dsh-icon-changer
resources.desc: Replaces the DeepSeek Harness desktop app icon (exe, tray and Start Menu) with any uploaded .ico, and restores the stock icon on demand.

resources.name: flyhigao/dsh-file-transfer
resources.desc: Adds download buttons to the document preview toolbar and the Files tree, packs a folder download into a streamed ZIP, and adds a Files-tree upload button that streams to the Host one file at a time, capped at 1 GiB and renamed with an (n) suffix instead of overwriting.

resources.name: flyhigao/dsh-sticky-notes
resources.desc: Workspace sticky notes for DSH, saved as multiple Markdown files under the current workspace.

resources.name: foooold/dsh-message-nav
resources.desc: Adds a Codex-style message navigation rail for quickly locating earlier prompts in long DeepSeek Harness Web UI conversations.

resources.name: foreee/dsh-app-restart
resources.desc: Adds a Restart application section to the desktop app Settings; quits gracefully and relaunches the whole application.

resources.name: FragrantLotus/dsh-plugin-chinese
resources.desc: Fills in a Chinese description for every installed DSH plugin that ships only an English one, at startup and again after each plugin change, and never rewrites a plugin name. Plugins that already export a locale folder show the new text on refresh; the rest are patched too — the in-memory layer shows Chinese immediately, and the on-disk locale pack it writes needs one restart.

resources.name: FragrantLotus/dsh-sidebar-entries
resources.desc: Sidebar overhaul for the dsh web UI: long-press drag to reorder the panel icon rail, one arrow to fold it away, whole-row height caps on both the panel list and the pinned section (30% of the rail, rounded down to whole rows), a pinned-session section that mirrors the shipped row's live status (spinner, waiting-for-reply, relative time), drag-to-reorder conversation view tabs, archived Sessions sunk to the bottom of each group newest-first, forked child Sessions following their parent into the pinned section, and a generic lift that moves any plugin's sidebar-footer entry up into the rail. Each subsystem starts behind its own guard, so one that fails returns null and the rest of the plugin still mounts.

resources.name: framefutura/dsh-mode-seat
resources.desc: Persistent agent-preset (mode) selector docked in the composer input bar: switch the mode for new tasks, and set the new-task default from any running session.

resources.name: Free-corner/dsh-chat-tools
resources.desc: Chat column width and alignment control, numbered question history with keyboard navigation and auto-load of older questions, and markdown outline rails for both the conversation and the file preview.

resources.name: Frog755/dsh-prompt-vault
resources.desc: Prompt library above the DSH composer — a 📚 button expands a searchable panel to insert saved prompts into the draft with one click (appends, never overwrites), persisted in a host-side JSON file.

resources.name: Frog755/dsh-wallpaper
resources.desc: Persistent image or MP4 wallpaper for the DSH Web profile: a wallpaper card under Settings -> General selects a local image or MP4 (up to 300 MB), tunes surface opacity and blur, compresses video locally to H.264 when ffmpeg/ffprobe are on PATH, stores media under ~/.dsh/wallpapers, and pins the Web server to port 9191 so the saved wallpaper survives restarts.

resources.name: FSMargoo/dsh-at-file
resources.desc: Codex-style @file mentions: search workspace files in the composer and attach their contents to prompts.

resources.name: FujiwaraReisen/dsh-live2dwaifu
resources.desc: Shows a Live2D character in the bottom-right corner of the DSH web UI: blinking, breathing, lip-sync while talking, seven moods, and a speech bubble with its own chat, memory, corpus and stickers. Models are never bundled; every user drops in their own folder.

resources.name: functy23/dsh-fullscreen-settings
resources.desc: Opens the DSH settings dialog as a full-page screen and moves the close control to a back row at the top left.

resources.name: FunnyDiodio/dsh-workspace-picker-path
resources.desc: Adds a General settings row choosing where the Add-workspace directory picker opens: a fixed custom path (typed, pasted, or picked visually) or the last directory you confirmed. Quoted and CJK paths are accepted, and a This PC level reaches other Windows drives.

resources.name: funswe/dsh-resizable-settings
