resources.name: huhu23333/dsh-plugin-subagent-model-route
resources.desc: Annotates every subagent with the model route it actually ran on: a badge line in each parent-catalog row and a readout in a child session's own header.

resources.name: HuiHuangDDFS/dsh-codex-mini-pet
resources.desc: Adds separate Chat and Work modes to DeepSeek Harness, embeds DeepSeek's official chat page, and provides an animated desktop companion with quick chat and task-completion notifications.

resources.name: huihuangdi/dsh-model-provider-badge
resources.desc: Shows the provider behind a session's current model as a compact badge in the DSH Web composer tool row, left of the model selector.

resources.name: huiliyi37/dsh-tianshu-tui
resources.desc: A terminal UI (TUI) for DeepSeek Harness.

resources.name: HUITianYi/dsh-whale-desktop-launcher
resources.desc: Windows desktop launcher for DSH with a whale-girl icon, background server startup, and a Chromium app-mode window without browser chrome.

resources.name: hulibuld/dsh-lifecard#plugin
resources.desc: Local-first character archive in the DSH sidebar: it interviews you about someone and writes the answers into Markdown cards, imports SillyTavern character cards, writes a novel chapter by chapter, and roleplays with a card plus its world book; anything written into a card has to be quotable from material you wrote.

resources.name: hulibuld/dsh-reading
resources.desc: Reads EPUB, MOBI, AZW3, TXT and PDF books in a side panel with pagination, table-of-contents jumping, highlights, notes, bookmarks, full-text search, anchored AI questions and per-chapter distillation. PDF support is text-based only; scanned or encrypted PDFs are rejected.

resources.name: hulibuld/dsh-refresh-restart
resources.desc: Adds two buttons beside the sidebar toggle at the top-left of the DSH desktop UI, on macOS, Windows and Linux. Reload refreshes only the UI layer while a turn already generating keeps running; restart asks for one confirmation, quits the whole app and reopens it with sessions and workspaces intact. Restart is a POST that must carry a random per-boot token read from the plugin's status route. The plugin makes no network calls, reads no session content and has zero runtime dependencies.

resources.name: HumXC/dsh-nestquay
resources.desc: Workspace groups for the DSH sidebar with group navigation and session status indicators.

resources.name: hunter118/dsh-s7r
resources.desc: A retro macOS System 7-style workstation UI for DeepSeek Harness with desktop windows, Workspace and Agent management, Finder, Terminal, Monitor, context tools, and desk accessories.

resources.name: Huuuuung/dsh-artifact-index
resources.desc: The missing backend for the dsh-artifacts sidebar tab — serves the /report artifact index and the artifact bytes it renders.

resources.name: huzhengcai471-crypto/dsh-startup-secret
resources.desc: Full-screen Changzhengji-themed boot animation for DSH with a six-step authorization sequence, seven built-in real-voice packs, two switchable emblems, five switchable character portraits, and an optional access-password gate.

resources.name: HwFee/HwFee-dsh#genui
resources.desc: Generative UI: the model calls render_ui with a React snippet and the answer renders as an interactive card in the conversation. The snippet runs in a sandboxed iframe with an opaque origin, so it cannot read the host page, its storage or its cookies, and the frame CSP blocks the network; a message from a card is only sent after the user confirms it, and a failing card shows its error with the source behind a toggle.

resources.name: HwFee/HwFee-dsh#predict
resources.desc: Next-prompt suggestions: after each answer it predicts your next message as grey ghost text in the composer. Tab fills it without sending, and the prediction model is selectable.

resources.name: HwFee/HwFee-dsh#system-fonts
resources.desc: Separate font slots for content, code and terminal text, plus an interface font, an interface-size stepper and an inline-code size stepper, with line-height and letter-spacing controls. Typography only — it never touches colour.

resources.name: hyperion2144/dsh-desktop-tauriapp
resources.desc: Tauri 2 desktop app for DeepSeek Harness (macOS + Windows; installers on the repository's Releases page) with a built-in dsh runtime: tray-resident launcher with per-profile ports and windows, a process guardian that auto-heals up to three times, local or remote dsh, task-completion notifications with a Dock badge, and a live startup console. This plugin is the app's in-page half — its desktop chrome and notification bridge only take effect when DSH runs inside the desktop app; added to a regular DSH with dsh plugin add, it provides the bundled skill for packaging a DSH Web GUI as a Tauri app.

resources.name: hyrinx/dsh-plugin-open-with
resources.desc: Adds a capsule split-button to the conversation header: launch VS Code, terminal, or File Explorer at the current workspace directory in one click.

resources.name: hytime/dsh-client-ui-shortcuts
resources.desc: Profile-aware keyboard shortcuts for DSH Web: supports Question and Approval cards, Standard/Vim/Custom profiles, and capability-gated Session and Workspace navigation.

resources.name: hyzyn/dsh-plugin-kit#kit-settings
resources.desc: Host page for kit plugin configuration in the DSH Web GUI: registers a "Plugin configuration" section in Settings — peer to the built-in General section — through the official settings.section slot and declares a settings.kit.item child slot, which dsh-plugin-kit plugins render their own config cards into. Installing it alone shows an empty page; cards appear as slot-registering kit plugins are installed.

resources.name: hyzyn/dsh-plugin-kit#tty
resources.desc: Terminal panel for the DSH Web GUI: a sidebar "Terminal" entry opens a multi-tab xterm.js interactive terminal over a real PTY (node-pty), with SSH remote tabs (ssh2, agent / key / password auth), a cwd following the current session, and tty_list / tty_capture / tty_send agent tools.

resources.name: hzys7/dsh-prompt-expander
resources.desc: Adds a sparkle button beside the model picker that rewrites the current draft into a spec sized to the draft — two or three steps for a small ask, a longer checklist only when the request has several parts — and puts the original text back when pressed again. Greetings and small talk pass through untouched without calling the model.

resources.name: Iambatman1928/dsh-lawagent-ui
resources.desc: Legal training workbench: three-pane academic UI that reads the "Minglü" (lawagent preset) learning profile (case dossiers, flashcards, wrong-answer book, notes) and sends instructions into a Minglü session with one click.

resources.name: Iambatman1928/dsh-lawkb-ui
resources.desc: Legal knowledge-base workbench: hybrid keyword/statistical/vector retrieval over local statute .doc/.docx corpora, faceted filtering, charge-name and civil-cause trees, a document editor, and four AI tools (citation check, contract review, AI analysis, AI drafting).

resources.name: Iambatman1928/dsh-xingye
resources.desc: Chat agent for a DeepSeek Harness session: create characters and write their personas, keep several archive threads per character, undo or rewind the locally stored transcript, and record story beats in an event book.

resources.name: Icather/dsh-clean-desktop-shell
resources.desc: Clean desktop shell for DSH: launch by double-clicking a desktop shortcut like any normal desktop app, live backend monitoring with one-click tray start/restart/stop (progress dialogs), offline auto-reconnect, single instance. Reuses your existing web profile, no restyling of the web UI. Windows + macOS.

resources.name: ice5kysl/dsh-file-explorer-kit
resources.desc: In-session "Files" tab (conversation.view, order 20) for dsh Web that browses the active session's workspace directory with breadcrumbs and previews files inline — sanitized Markdown (marked + DOMPurify), images, line-numbered text and PDF — served by read-only /dsh-files host routes registered on ctx.webServer; no write endpoints. Bilingual zh/en.

resources.name: ice5kysl/dsh-workspace-kit
resources.desc: Workspace-first enhanced sidebar for dsh Web that shadows the built-in workspace browser at low priority (one-click toggle back to the official one) and adds soft workspace archive/restore, per-workspace SVG icons and accent colors, drag reorder and title/path/session-content search, plus a ⌘K Spotlight palette fuzzy-searching workspaces and sessions; the host half ships read-only workspace_find/workspace_list model tools and /workspace-find /workspace-list slash commands. Bilingual zh/en.

resources.name: iceriverlin/dsh-session-upload
resources.desc: Composer attach button for DSH Web: multi-file picks become inline draft capsules, files are stored under the workspace uploads root with an auto-extracted UTF-8 .txt sidecar (txt/docx/xlsx/pptx/zip/odt, zero dependencies), and sent messages carry only the file name — never a raw path.

resources.name: IDKURLOVE/dsh-reset-button
resources.desc: Adds a Restart button beside the permission control in the composer toolbar that relaunches DSH in one click, so freshly installed plugins apply without closing and reopening the app.

resources.name: idoall/dsh-quick-replies
resources.desc: Manageable one-tap text chips above the session composer; idle sessions queue the message and running sessions steer at the next safe boundary without rewriting the draft.

resources.name: idoall/dsh-update-status
resources.desc: Read-only DeepSeek Harness Web sidebar version chip that shows the running DSH version, npm latest/next/alpha channels, compatibility labels, and a copy-only upgrade command.

resources.name: iimaguest/dsh-contradictions-indicator
resources.desc: Shows a 0-100 conversation coherence badge and commentary by running parallel contradiction analysis on the live DSH session, with a manual trigger and interval-based auto-analysis (on by default, editable per session or globally).

resources.name: imkingjh999/dsh-shorts-wall
resources.desc: Adds a docked-first vertical shorts wall to the DSH Web UI with YouTube Shorts and Bilibili sources, keyword rotation, four-corner resizing, and Alt+S/Alt+M shortcuts.

resources.name: Imnotndesh/dsh-peak-pricing-warning
resources.desc: Shows DeepSeek peak/off-peak pricing status, a countdown to the next rate change, and the estimated session cost as inline text beside the model selector.

resources.name: IndieXiaoLong/DSH-Enhance
resources.desc: Adds conversation naming, file drag references, edit-and-resend, a message timeline, and a floating settings panel to the DSH Web GUI.

resources.name: ingeb0rga/dsh-sidebar-hover
resources.desc: Claude Code-style sidebar for the macOS desktop app: hovering the collapsed sidebar toggle peeks the sidebar over the content, selecting a session collapses it, clicking the toggle pins it; plus back/forward session history arrows (⌘\[ / ⌘]).

resources.name: Inoue-Cyrene/dsh-ctrl-wheel-zoom
resources.desc: Hold Ctrl and roll the mouse wheel to zoom the whole Harness Web UI around the pointer, 50-200% in 10% steps; Ctrl +/- and Ctrl 0 from the keyboard; a bottom-right chip and a Page zoom row in Settings → General show and reset the level.

resources.name: iqingyoung/search2chart-mcp#dsh
resources.desc: Native DSH plugin that renders structured data as inline charts directly inside the conversation, with zero runtime dependencies.

resources.name: Isilsolme/dsh-splash-launcher
resources.desc: Windows one-click launcher with a borderless WPF startup animation (stroke-by-stroke HARNESS lettering) that starts dsh web in the background and fades into the GUI once ready, plus a desktop_launch tool.

resources.name: it-glen/dsh-custom-fonts
resources.desc: Fonts and code-font settings for the UI with an English-only glyph scale (100-160%), a -4..+8 px content-size offset that actually applies, and settings kept across refreshes - a maintained fork of lsh2002/dsh-custom-fonts.

resources.name: itchenshi/dsh-keys-setting
resources.desc: Configures from the settings window's General page whether Enter, Shift+Enter and Ctrl/Cmd+Enter send the message or insert a line break; the engine default is kept until you change it.

resources.name: ivanant/dsh-workspace-sidebar
resources.desc: Shares one right-sidebar across every conversation in the same workspace, so you don't have to reopen it when creating or switching conversations, with a switch in Settings → General.

resources.name: ivanlebedvideo/dsh-pushups
resources.desc: Counts the prompts you send in the Web GUI and turns them into a push-up debt, shown as a chip under the composer with one-click pay-off, partial payments and a day streak.

resources.name: iwanant/dsh-emotion-ball
resources.desc: A 44x44 always-on-top desktop ball for DSH that reflects what the agent is actually doing (thinking, searching, web fetch, error, waiting for input) and shows an exclamation or question-mark badge when a task finishes or needs an answer while you are away. Windows only; it downloads its own Electron runtime on first use.

resources.name: Iwctwbh/dsh-flowglass
resources.desc: Live flowgraph visualization for DeepSeek Harness sessions, including tool calls, parallel groups, subagent branches, and drill-down details.

resources.name: j62268781-alt/dsh-skills-mcp-manager
resources.desc: Manage skills and MCP servers from one DSH settings panel. Skills are read from disk: browse, search, preview the body, create, rename and delete, with a backup written before every removal. Global MCP servers are the real cordis.patch.yml loader rows; per-project entries mount only for sessions in that project. Each expanded card lists the tools that server actually registered, and a per-server allow/deny rule keeps only the ones you need — a blocked tool never enters the tool registry, so it costs no context on every turn. Every MCP card carries a connection status tag (connected with a tool count, retrying, gave up, activation failed) plus a one-click reconnect, so a server that fails at startup is visible instead of silently missing its tools. Imports existing configs from 26 other MCP clients.

resources.name: JackEngineer/dsh-quick-screenshot
resources.desc: One-click screenshot button that floats over every DSH page, with a second one in the composer tool row: it captures the DeepSeek Harness window (or the whole desktop with a modifier) using the host capture tooling and puts the PNG where it is useful — straight into the composer draft as an attachment, or on the clipboard when no composer is mounted. Windows-verified, with macOS and Linux backends; no dependencies and no build step.

resources.name: JackieJam/dsh-iridescent-model-selector
resources.desc: Replaces the composer model button with one panel holding a provider-grouped model list with search, pinned favorite models, and a reasoning-effort slider with one stop per level the model advertises, whose aurora gradient and glow grow with the level; the last effort used with each model is restored when switching back, and the built-in selector stays registered underneath as a fallback.

resources.name: jackma5477001/dsh-system-monitor
resources.desc: Displays real-time CPU and memory usage for the machine running the DSH Web server.

resources.name: JackWoods-code/dsh-bot-toggle
resources.desc: A floating Bot / ADE switch for the DSH web UI. One click moves between ds-bot's Bot surface and the classic DSH Agent surface, while ds-bot keeps running with its data untouched.

resources.name: jaikensai888/dsh-drawio
resources.desc: A draw.io editor as a .drawio file viewer in the DSH sidebar: diagrams are ordinary workspace files (new ones default to docs/diagrams/), edits autosave, and a file changed outside the editor is refused with a conflict bar instead of being overwritten; the editor is downloaded once from a pinned upstream release with a SHA-256 check and then runs fully offline.

resources.name: jameswatt139240-crypto/dsh-ATLAS
resources.desc: Beyond the built-in @: line ranges (@src/a.ts:12-40), skills, plugins and any git repo — with the token cost of each reference shown before you send.

resources.name: jan0107/dsh-compact-window
resources.desc: Small-window mode for DSH NEXT on Windows: a 425px-wide always-on-top sticky window with a drawer sidebar and animated transitions. Requires DSH NEXT; the other desktop client (dsh desktop) is not supported.

resources.name: JanEickholt/dsh-inline-diff
resources.desc: Renders edit and write tool calls as always-expanded side-by-side diffs styled like git diff, with optional syntax coloring and word-level highlighting.

resources.name: jasondu/dsh-ui-mobile
resources.desc: Mobile-first DeepSeek Harness UI with an installable PWA, responsive navigation, and Web Push notifications when an agent completes successfully.

resources.name: JasperPengC/dsh-agent-blackbox
resources.desc: Flight recorder panel for DSH sessions: live monitoring, timeline replay with a tool waterfall and event inspector, per-agent cost attribution, and a cross-session cost overview.

resources.name: JasperPengC/dsh-mcp-skills-board
resources.desc: MCP server and skill management for DeepSeek Harness: a sidebar panel and a plugin-page config section with search, status lights, per-row switches, expandable details, and an add-server form following Codex mcp_servers fields.

resources.name: JayYuen666/dsh-dir-prep-organize
resources.desc: Two buttons beside the chat input: one rewrites the draft with the current directory in view, the other inserts a role template from 85 curated entries generated from the bundled agents/ role library, which the settings card can extend with your own .md role files.

resources.name: jcx3915-pixel/dsh-subtopic
resources.desc: Select any text in a DSH conversation and tap Ctrl to get an inline sub-topic card: streaming answer, follow-up tree, and drag-to-quote reference chips.

resources.name: jeffreyren1/dsh-custom-js
resources.desc: Load, edit, manage, and hot-reload trusted JavaScript and TypeScript userscripts in DeepSeek Harness.

resources.name: jhuanxx44/dsh-paste-path
resources.desc: Finder clipboard paste for macOS: Cmd+C files or folders in Finder, then Ctrl+V in the DSH composer inserts their absolute paths; ordinary text paste with Cmd+V is untouched.

resources.name: jiangnanquan/dsh-ux
resources.desc: Solarized light theme, compact layout, think/tool-chain collapse capsules, and balance, session cost, and usage dashboards for the DSH web UI.

resources.name: JianGuo396/dsh-control-bar
resources.desc: Pins an always-on-top progress bar while the agent runs a turn — the percentage is estimated from tool calls and filled to 100% when the turn ends — and badges the DeepSeek peak/off-peak pricing window so large token operations ask for confirmation only during peak hours. The bar runs as a separate Electron process and is skipped when no Electron binary is found.

resources.name: jiangyinluwei/dsh-plugInOne
resources.desc: Gathers custom plugin settings pages and cards into draggable top tabs under a unified Plugin settings navigation row.

resources.name: JianhangLy/dsh-prompt-boost
resources.desc: Prompt enhancement for the DSH Web GUI composer: pick a style before generating (logic-only, structured, or concise), or supply or clear a custom system prompt in settings; a sparkle button rewrites the current draft through the harness model, streams the result into an inline preview (original vs enhanced) with a live thinking timer, fills it back with one click, keeps an undo bar, and offers settings for model route, temperature, length limits, context awareness, undo-bar behavior and shortcuts.

resources.name: JianhangLy/dsh-prompt-library
resources.desc: Composer-side prompt library: a button next to the input opens a picker with group chips and word-split AND search over saved snippets, inserting one into the draft or appending it, filling {{variables}} before insertion, with 13 built-in templates. Snippets live in one local JSON file behind a rev lock, a per-save backup, and whole-library JSON import/export; a settings page handles editing, grouping, pinning and a 6-second delete undo.

resources.name: jianjianzhu/dsh-harness-ui
resources.desc: A full-page console panel opened from the sidebar, with eight tabs: an overview; a session list read from the sessions service (title, directory, running state, updated time, with filters); installed bundles and Loader entries from pluginInventory and pluginManager, with per-bundle enable switches; a plugin market listing public topic:dsh-plugin repositories from the GitHub search API; a model and provider editor that writes the llm-pi-ai settings namespace through remote.settings.mutate (switch a session model, add or edit providers and their model lists, and store API keys via remote.credentials, merging over the stored profile so fields the form does not expose survive an edit); MCP and skills tabs; and a usage tab that reads the host's loopback /api/dsh-usage/overview document. Services are declared through ctx.inject, so a deployment that omits one mounts without the console rather than crashing.

resources.name: JianYiAG/dsh-prompt-enhancer#dsh-prompt-enhancer
resources.desc: Composer prompt enhancement for DeepSeek Harness: a button beside the model selector rewrites the draft through one auxiliary LLM call and writes the result back in place, with composer undo left intact; a /prompt-enhance slash command returns the rewritten prompt as a command result line without touching the draft; the enhancement call can be pinned to its own fast provider and model in the profile patch; the rewrite policy is faithful - original intent, language and information are kept, code, commands and paths are preserved verbatim, and nothing is invented or padded with placeholder text.

resources.name: JiayuREN1127/dsh-file-drag
resources.desc: Drag files and folders from the sidebar Files pane into the message composer. A dropped file becomes an inline chip inside the sentence, an uploaded attachment card, or a plain @ path, switchable in Settings.

resources.name: jide315/dsh-reasoning-language
resources.desc: Uses a configurable system-prompt section to request a chosen reasoning language (Simplified Chinese by default), and expands thinking rows by default while preserving rows the user manually collapses.

resources.name: jidekaixin2dian/dsh-file-actions
resources.desc: Right-click any file reference in the chat to open it, open it with an associated application, reveal it in the file manager, copy its path or contents, and save it.

resources.name: jin1254/dsh-annotations
resources.desc: Select completed assistant text, add comments, and send compact annotation labels with source navigation in official DSH 0.2.1-rc.2 Web; no host patches required.

resources.name: JinYihang1011/dsh-plugins#dsh-refresh-button
resources.desc: Windows only; needs PowerShell and the bundled install.ps1. Adds an interface menu to the left of the model selector with three actions that run immediately: reload the interface, restart DSH, and close DSH. The Windows build ships no built-in reload or restart entry, so this adds one.

resources.name: JinYihang1011/dsh-plugins#dsh-ui-tweaks
resources.desc: One stylesheet plus two small DOM patches that line third-party sidebar entries up with the host: matching row height, padding and icon size, one consistent active background, and mutual exclusion so the cron panel and the host panels never overlap.

resources.name: JiuRiWu/dsh-restart
resources.desc: Adds a Restart button to the DSH Desktop sidebar. It opens the same native confirmation dialog as the tray Exit item and, once approved, shuts the app down gracefully and relaunches it. This plugin only draws the button: it also needs the companion shell patch shipped in shell-patch/ in the same repository, which has to be applied from outside DSH while the app is closed. Installed on its own, the button stays disabled and a tooltip explains why. The companion shell patch is Windows only and rewrites the installed app.asar.

resources.name: jiuyuechuwuhao/dsh-canvas-preview
resources.desc: Conversation Canvas tab: live-preview workspace HTML artifacts and export PNG/JPG/SVG locally (npx dsh-canvas-preview).

resources.name: Jiyr0119/dsh-workspace-explorer
resources.desc: Standalone workspace file-tree panel for the DSH web UI: a session-header icon opens an animated popup of the current workspace tree; click or drag a file to insert its reference into the composer, with search, inline preview, live settings, and zh/en i18n; single-purpose, zero-config, one-command install.

resources.name: jjoni12/dsh-locale-ko
resources.desc: Korean UI language pack that adds 한국어 to Settings → General → Language through the official language-pack API.

resources.name: jjt98118-beep/dsh-moss-boot
resources.desc: Plays an intro full-frame when you open DSH, when you open a new conversation, or every time you open the one you pinned. The built-in footage is themed on a Wandering Earth-style space station and the quantum AI MOSS (550W): a red single eye ignites while the Earth’s curve slides past the viewport. Four clips ship embedded in the code — no separate video files — and the library lets you tick any number to rotate at random (never the same clip twice in a row), preview the rotation, or swap in your own videos. Sound plays without a click; the pin button sits beside Settings.

resources.name: jjxjjjjiik-bot/dsh-chat-timeline
resources.desc: 1:1 port of DeepSeek's official web right-side chat navigation rail (ScrollNav): hover-expandable rail, reading-position highlight, click-to-jump.

resources.name: jkamkk/dsh-liquid-glass-input
resources.desc: Liquid Glass refraction input card for the DSH web GUI, with coupled-spring press animation. Published on npm: dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-liquid-glass-input.

resources.name: JNNarrator/dsh-deckseek
resources.desc: A calmer reading view for DeepSeek Harness with auto-collapsing process, a minimap-style message navigation rail, in-page search, unified failure cards, and generative MCP Apps (SEP-1865) in sandboxed iframes.

resources.name: JoblessJoe/dsh-vitals
resources.desc: Live btop-style CPU/memory/temperature/GPU monitor tab for the DeepSeek Harness web GUI.

resources.name: john-walks-slow/dsh-qol
resources.desc: Mobile-first Web UI quality-of-life pack for the DeepSeek Harness: a Chrome-style active-session tab bar, full-screen sidebar swipe open/close, overlay sidebar, collapsed-sidebar recents, keyboard-suppressing session switching, viewport/IME keyboard adaptation, touch feedback, code/table inner scrolling, hidden permission dropdown, a full-screen settings rewrite with tab memory, and a compositor-driven status pulse, no-touch-drag long-press protection — 14 features, each independently toggleable from the Settings QoL section with instant effect, persisted per browser in localStorage; pure client-side CSS/JS, mobile rules locked to viewports of 768px and below so desktop stays untouched.

resources.name: john-walks-slow/dsh-zen
resources.desc: Zen Mode view tab and foreground time tracker for DeepSeek Harness: while the agent works, a calm conversation view shows running/done status, your latest user message, live activity hints and the final AI reply in markdown with one-line turn stats, plus screen-watching (focus) time tracking with daily/weekly Zen scores, a chat-hide toggle that hides tool calls and reasoning rows, auto enter/exit Zen on task start/complete, an Alt+Z shortcut and a Zen settings panel — pure client-side, stored in localStorage, no network.

resources.name: johnnycls/dsh-no-setup-mode
resources.desc: No-setup mode for the DSH web UI: hides advanced surfaces, auto-applies best defaults (chat mode, full access, account balance), and one-click role-play personas (maid/butler).

resources.name: JosephHy/dsh-md-plus
resources.desc: Markdown display enhancements for the DSH Web chat, applied on top of the host renderer rather than replacing it: code blocks become cards with a language label and icon-only wrap and copy buttons, long code blocks, tables and Mermaid diagrams fold behind an expand control, Mermaid fences render as SVG with a diagram and code toggle, a fullscreen viewer with wheel zoom, drag and double-click to fit, and SVG or PNG export, tables get a sticky header and CSV or Markdown copy buttons, and a settings panel adjusts the diagram palette, code font size, the default diagram view and the three fold thresholds.

resources.name: joshua05100413-cmd/dsh-AcidCore-plugins#dsh-composer-meter
resources.desc: Composer meter for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI: a pill under the input shows draft character count, estimated tokens and this session's estimated cost from DeepSeek's published prices (peak/off-peak, Flash/Pro or custom rates), and opens a panel with the token breakdown, a six-snapshot per-session draft vault and a draft cleaner; every write goes through the host setDraft API instead of touching the editor DOM.

resources.name: Js2Hou/dsh-mcp-manager
resources.desc: Visual MCP manager for the DSH web UI: inspect, add, remove, enable/disable MCP servers and view their live connection status from Settings → MCP.

resources.name: jsdvjx/dsh-strata
resources.desc: Session minimap in the scrollbar gutter: to-scale bands coloured by event kind, anchor dots for user messages and failures, auto-loading history at the top, a hover wall of every prompt in the session, and a three-step map scale switcher.

resources.name: juliankang4/dsh-locale-ko
resources.desc: Adds Korean (한국어) as a native option in Settings - General - Language and translates all 2,775 Web UI strings of dsh 0.2.0-rc.2 and 0.2.1-alpha.2, experimental features included. Works in dsh web and the desktop app.

resources.name: juliankang4/dsh-ui-scale
resources.desc: Scales the whole DeepSeek Harness interface from 50% to 200%, menus and pop-ups included, set from Settings - General with a slider, a percent field or presets. Works in dsh web and the desktop app, which has no zoom of its own.

resources.name: Justin-Mai/dsh-stock-view
resources.desc: A collapsible, draggable popup in the top-right corner of the DSH web interface for watching A-shares, ETFs, Hong Kong and US stocks and OKX spot crypto side by side: real-time quotes, intraday and daily/weekly/monthly candlestick charts with moving averages, buy/sell target prices, group switching with drag-to-reorder, rename and delete, cross-market search, and light/dark themes. A fork of Awu12277/dsh-stock-watch that adds US quotes via Eastmoney and crypto via OKX.

resources.name: JuYueYe/dsh-personal-model-picker
resources.desc: Switch providers from the left column and choose a model from the right; hover, focus or click a provider to update the model list.

resources.name: k-ying/dsh-vsceditor
resources.desc: Embeds a real VSCode editor (code-server, or your local desktop VS Code via the bundled bridge extension) as a GUI tab: agent file edits open turn-scoped red/green diffs that survive tab closes and page reloads, files lock while the agent writes, and a watchdog supervisor keeps zero orphan processes.

resources.name: Kadima-code/dsh-subagent-fold

resources.name: kahomesl/dsh-chat-diff-summary-legacy
resources.desc: A per-turn change bar above the composer showing which files the turn changed and the line deltas, for DeepSeek Harness 0.1.5-rc.1 through 0.1.7.

resources.name: Kaiji-Z/dsh-plugin-lookatstudy
resources.desc: A study tab with course-map, tutor and blackboard columns that turns markdown files, local folders or GitHub repos into guided courses, with lesson unlocking, mastery tracking, spaced repetition and a tutor-designed course import.

resources.name: kaijia323/dsh-mobile-ui

resources.name: kankezhiyan/dsh-awesome-fonts

resources.name: KDDKBD/DeepSeek-splash-animation
resources.desc: Plays a video while DSH opens, then dissolves over 0.3 seconds once it has played out. Ships with a default video so it works on install, and the path can be changed or cleared from the plugin settings page.

resources.name: kelearns/dsh-navigation-bar
