resources.name: kenz1117/dsh-ui-rainbowspeak
resources.desc: RainbowSpeak — a flowing rainbow marquee border around the chat composer card, driven by a conic-gradient ring. Live settings for speed, width, seven color schemes, direction, sides and breathing, plus session-state awareness that reacts to running, attention, error and celebration moments.

resources.name: KevinZhangNothing/dsh-task-graph
resources.desc: Adds a Graph tab that renders one session's execution as an interactive DAG of turns, LLM steps, tools, skills, subagents, code changes and tests, with live status, retry aggregation, critical path and trajectory linkage.

resources.name: kfirsch/dsh-hebrew-rtl
resources.desc: Hebrew RTL rendering for the web GUI: any line with Hebrew reads right-to-left (messages, GenUI, question cards, the composer and input fields), and RTL-aware Cmd+Left/Right line navigation.

resources.name: kgwdonkey/dsh-header-controls
resources.desc: Restart / exit power buttons in the conversation header.

resources.name: kialajin-l/DSH_Plus#dsh-quote-selection
resources.desc: Floating toolbar on text selection in conversations: add the quote to the composer, start a new discussion from it, or copy it; quotes collapse into a card aligned to the composer and double-clicking jumps back to the quoted turn.

resources.name: kiefeng/dsh-avatar-top
resources.desc: Moves the sidebar account avatar out of the bottom strip with four placements, including a zero-height inline mode in the brand row, and three heights down to an avatar-only row, with adjustable spacing and a settings card on the Plugins page, while other plugins' footer widgets stay pinned at the bottom.

resources.name: kingofpowers/dsh-chat-ctxmenu
resources.desc: Right-click menu for DeepSeek Harness conversation content: copy the selection or the whole message, copy message images and the preview lightbox to the clipboard as PNG (or save them), open file paths (absolute, relative to the session working directory, or ~/), reveal them in the file manager, open them with another registered application, and copy paths or links. Every candidate path is verified by the Host filesystem before an open action appears.

resources.name: Kirkice/dsh-plugin-makima-tui
resources.desc: A terminal workbench for dsh with streaming chat, tool execution, session management, provider management, and image input.

resources.name: kk112222/dsh-chat-index
resources.desc: Per-session question index for the DSH Web UI: a time-proportional dot rail on the right edge and an expandable chain panel showing every user question with its time, including branch/subagent sessions; clicking a node jumps to that message and highlights it.

resources.name: kkbsgg/dsh-balance
resources.desc: Shows the selected model provider's account balance next to the composer's model seat once a model and reasoning effort are selected.

resources.name: kkhsu/dsh-conversation-icons
resources.desc: Assign per-session duotone SVG icons and colors from the sidebar menu or a model tool, with browser-local persistence and cross-tab updates.

resources.name: kkisok0123/dsh-sidechat
resources.desc: Side conversations forked from the main session, with native conversation rendering, selection annotations and handback.

resources.name: KNGLOKIKO/dsh-plugin-approval-zh
resources.desc: Localizes the DeepSeek Harness approval panel in the web client and translates authorization reasons from English to Chinese, with a built-in phrase dictionary first and a model-router fallback for reasons the dictionary does not cover.

resources.name: Knight-Zjy/dsh-workspace-categories
resources.desc: Category tree for the DSH sidebar workspace browser: workspaces and their sessions nest under user-made categories (collapsed state remembered), rows drag between categories, a new workspace can be created straight into one through the directory picker, categories rename and delete in place, sessions archive and unarchive from their own row (the built-in browser's stop-active-work confirmation included) alongside a hide / show / only-archived filter, row buttons carry the app's own hover tooltips, and a footer toggle switches the panel back to the built-in list.

resources.name: kongbai-shike/dsh-novel-wallpaper
resources.desc: Renders a TXT novel as a dim text layer behind the DSH chat, with a draggable controller for table of contents, chapter paging, auto-scroll and reading settings.

resources.name: kongbaiming5/dsh-pet-button
resources.desc: macOS arm64 only; requires dsh-pet installed (the bundled binary is a closed prebuilt). Desktop switch for the dsh-pet pet: one click to show or hide it, and it can start DeepSeek Harness when that is closed.

resources.name: kongdexu/dsh-nav-pointer
resources.desc: Vertical message pointer rail on the left edge of the chat: one dash per user message, click to scroll to that message, hover for a preview bubble.

resources.name: kongkongya367-glitch/dsh-bingo-ren
resources.desc: Adds a draggable restart button and a plugin panel to the DeepSeek Harness desktop app: it prompts when the profile plugin list changes, records additions and removals per profile, tracks trials, reports host startup state, and offers rollback, minimal boot and recoverable cleanup.

resources.name: konglong87/dsh-input-list
resources.desc: DSH prompt library and reusable snippets plugin: save, edit, delete, and append prompt templates, workflow instructions, and reusable text from a button beside the composer without sending.

resources.name: konnga/dsh-hud
resources.desc: Read-only Git panel for the current workspace — branch, changed files, diffs and image before/after compare — plus three capsules above the composer (Git status, tool and skill activity, session running time) and per-session change attribution with review progress.

resources.name: kouyichi/dsh-tui-app
resources.desc: Interactive terminal chat app for dsh: streaming conversation, tool cards, jobs panel, full-text search, trajectory replay, multi-session tabs, and A2A dispatch (Ink-based).

resources.name: KouzakiUmi/dsh-code-pill
resources.desc: Renders inline code in DSH chat as pills with syntax colours and optional file badges, styles chat file paths, and offers optional folded-row tinting and thinking-text ink, with a settings page for six presets, colours and fonts.

resources.name: kouzerror/dsh-retry
resources.desc: Adds a native Restart DeepSeek Harness item to the Windows system tray menu and the account menu of the DSH desktop app: the plugin prepares a patched resources/app.asar at startup, a detached helper backs up the original and swaps it in after a normal exit, the patch is re-applied after each desktop update, and either item relaunches the app gracefully on the next launch. Windows desktop only; other hosts report 409 not_desktop.

resources.name: kuanfu0430/dsh-sidebar-branch-chat
resources.desc: Adds a Branch Chat tab to dsh-better-sidebar that opens independent archived sessions with a head/middle/tail context digest and the same tools as the main agent.

resources.name: KukaNo996/dsh-prompt-optimization
resources.desc: Composer prompt refinement for DSH: rewrites a rough draft into a structured, unambiguous prompt with one-click undo, reference-chip protection, three model sources (composer / account / any OpenAI-compatible endpoint) and disconnect-aware cancellation.

resources.name: kw12121212/writing-anything#dsh-writing-viewer
resources.desc: Read-only writing-workspace panel for projects that contain a .writing-anything/ workspace: per-work overview cards, a unit tree, YAML artifact views as semantic cards or highlighted source, the source list and the decision/review queues, and in-panel unit review whose feedback is written back by wa-cli.

resources.name: kw78/academic-agent#academic-dsh-ui
resources.desc: DSH sidebar and panel for courses, tasks, plans, connections, course materials, automation and settings.

resources.name: kyanray-dev/dsh-markdown-input
resources.desc: Markdown input for the composer that keeps the typed Markdown as the sent text while drawing bullets and checkboxes, styling bold, italic, inline code, strikethrough, headings, quotes and fenced code blocks, continuing lists on Shift+Enter, and wrapping selections with Cmd/Ctrl+B, I and E.

resources.name: KylinQ01/dsh-startup-animation
resources.desc: Startup splash for DeepSeek Harness: an animated avatar with aurora, stardust, pointer parallax and a module-assembly entrance, plus the same image as the main-UI wallpaper; both images can be swapped from a settings page that previews the animation live.

resources.name: kyoukisu/dsh-rich-ui
resources.desc: ChatGPT-style rich answers inside DeepSeek Harness: entity panels, KPI cards, series charts, sortable tables, nested layers, flow diagrams and local controls.

resources.name: kyrsieger/dsh-up-session
resources.desc: Adds cross-workspace pinned and recent session sections to the DSH sidebar, with status indicators and display settings.

resources.name: l541402398/dsh-file-uploads
resources.desc: Upload arbitrary local files from the Web composer, show pending cards, and manage stored files in Settings.

resources.name: Lacquervii/smooth-cursor
resources.desc: Smooth comet-mode animated caret for the DSH Web composer: a glowing comet trail replaces the native blinking caret and glides across the input as you type, with configurable accent color, thickness, and trail, IME-aware for CJK input.

resources.name: lakabuji-arch/dsh-model-accordion
resources.desc: Provider-folded model selector for the DSH Web composer with catalog-driven reasoning effort choices.

resources.name: lalalaleo/dsh-draft
resources.desc: A Markdown-based draft-board plugin for dsh: live-preview editing and local persistence.

resources.name: Lancang-hzau/dsh-live-terminal
resources.desc: Visible terminal panel that streams the agent's shell commands into an in-app terminal and lets the agent capture the terminal screen as text.

resources.name: LanFeng97/dsh-workspace-create-dialog
resources.desc: Codex-style Create Workspace dialog: name it and the folder is created for you, or pick one with a native chooser that remembers where you were (the native chooser is Windows-only; elsewhere use the name field).

resources.name: langyo/dsh-mobile-upgrade
resources.desc: Requires DSH 0.1.5-rc.1. Mobile UI fixes for the dsh web profile: narrow-screen drawer and settings tabs, a full-width model menu, a stuck-request network chip, and a narrow-header collector that folds the lineage, subagent and background-job chips into one tappable sheet.

resources.name: LaoganR/dsh-novel-reader
resources.desc: Local TXT novel reader in the DSH right sidebar: bookshelf with file, directory and path import, chapter table of contents with jump, click-to-turn or vertical-scroll paging, reading progress restored across restarts, and font, line-spacing, background and night themes.

resources.name: laoye666-6/dsh-plugin-media-wallpaper
resources.desc: Image and video wallpapers for the DSH web workspace: auto-detected GIF/APNG/animated WebP/PNG/JPEG/MP4/WebM backgrounds with blur, brightness and dimming, tint-following UI, per-component transparency, and one-click preset wallpapers.

resources.name: Laplace-bit/dsh-smooth-stream
resources.desc: Fluid streaming rendering and smooth scrolling for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI.

resources.name: latte03/dsh-select-quote
resources.desc: Select text in the dsh web conversation to attach it as an annotation to your next message. The source text keeps a dashed highlight with an ordinal badge in place, and the composer summary lists, edits and jumps back to each annotation.

resources.name: laughmaker/dsh-enhance
resources.desc: DeepSeek Harness UI polish: one Markdown style across every renderer, select-text annotations with numbered pins, a sidebar that drags down to 214px and remembers its width, a first launch that fills the screen, sidebar panel and plugin icons collected into one top row of five, and a colour-cycling marker for running sessions.

resources.name: lavapapa/dsh-composer-layout
resources.desc: Web Composer placement for long prompts: keep it at the bottom or dock it in a resizable right column beside a long answer.

resources.name: LCQ-1024/dsh-prompt-enhancer
resources.desc: Adds a prompt-enhancement button to the DSH composer that rewrites drafts into agent-ready prompts.

resources.name: lcthe/dsh-skills-hub
resources.desc: DSH Skill Manager: browse, enable/disable, import from Codex/Claude Code/ZCode/WorkBuddy/QCoderWork, auto-discover skills with symlink support.

resources.name: lcthe/dsh-timeline-rail
resources.desc: Message timeline rail for DeepSeek Harness web chat: evenly spaced ticks for each user message on the right edge, click to jump, hover to preview.

resources.name: Ledas-as/dsh-claude-video-slider
resources.desc: Unofficial Claude UI-inspired model and reasoning-effort selector using the current model's available levels, with animated purple pixel effects.

resources.name: lee259/dsh-workbench
resources.desc: A right-side file workspace for DeepSeek Harness Web with source previews, captured DSH diffs, tabs, and a workspace tree.

resources.name: LeemanCheung/dsh-whale-animation
resources.desc: A 60-frame theme-aware monochrome whale-dive animation with reactive water for the DSH Web turn status: embedded assets, seamless closed-loop playback, a reduced-motion PNG fallback, and lifecycle-clean removal.

resources.name: leexiaode4/dsh-launch-buttons
resources.desc: Multiple named launch targets in the DSH composer: left-click starts the default target, right-click opens the list.

resources.name: left0ver/dsh-file-review
resources.desc: Review agent file changes in a Diff panel, add comments for follow-up edits, and undo edited or newly created files.

resources.name: lemonorangeapple/dsh-effort-switcher
resources.desc: A Codex-like effort switcher for Deepseek Harness.

resources.name: lenrendre/dsh-screenshot-native
resources.desc: WeChat-style screenshot: freeze the desktop, drag a region or click a window, and the crop lands in the composer. A Windows-only fork of Durandalw/dsh-plugin-screenshot; do not install it alongside the upstream plugin.

resources.name: leogottadothebest/dsh-settings-beautify
resources.desc: Normalize the DSH settings UI onto one design language: unified typography, cards, controls, focus and motion across every settings page, including pages contributed by other plugins.

resources.name: lerwa2025-a11y/dsh-plugin-groups
resources.desc: Adds a My Groups tab to the DSH Installed plugins page: custom groups with drag reordering, colored text tags, Chinese notes, group locking, real enable switches, and two preset snapshot slots.

resources.name: Lessthinker66/dsh-open-native
resources.desc: Click a delivered-file card to open the file with the system default application instead of DSH's built-in sidebar preview; hold Shift to keep the original preview.

resources.name: levodoubt/dsh-longtext-input
resources.desc: Adds a Long text button to the composer tool row: write or paste the body in an editor overlay, and on save it is written to <workspace>/.dsh-longtext/<timestamp>_<title>.md and an @ path reference to that file is appended to the composer, leaving the conversation free of the long text itself.

resources.name: LHF198/dsh-prompt-optimizer
resources.desc: Improve the current chat draft before sending with a confirm-before-apply comparison.

resources.name: lhuans/dsh-genui
resources.desc: Renders OpenTiny GenUI charts, forms, calculators and mini apps inline in DSH replies via schemaJson fences, with user actions flowing back into the conversation.

resources.name: Li-Mingshuang/dsh-audio-control
resources.desc: Floating audio control panel in the Web GUI: play/pause/next/previous for Windows media sessions (SMTC) and the system master volume/mute, served by a Node route half that runs a PowerShell helper.

resources.name: LiangshouX/dsh-ide-workbench
resources.desc: JetBrains-style IDE workbench in the DSH sidebar: Project file tree, Commit panel, Git history with a swimlane graph, a real PTY terminal and an embedded editor with Markdown preview and Find in Files, plus chat file links and send-to-chat references.

resources.name: liaohongrao/dsh-session-dates
resources.desc: Groups the sessions of every workspace in the DSH sidebar by day, with explicit date labels, a live running indicator and date-based search.

resources.name: liaoyuqing/dsh-shutdown-idle
resources.desc: Runs a chosen power action (shutdown / restart / hibernate / sleep / lock / logoff) once every Agent session and background job has gone idle: the plugin samples in-process sessions once per second, counts running sessions as always busy, checks running background jobs through a configurable option (considerJobs, on by default, shown with its live count in Settings), waits a confirm window and then a cancellable countdown, and shows a draggable bottom-right card with the current phase and remaining seconds; the enable toggle never survives a host restart, any newly started session or Cancel aborts the countdown, and if the agents service is unavailable the machine is treated as busy so nothing ever fires. Windows only (the built-in shutdown / rundll32 actions); every action except none degrades to none elsewhere.

resources.name: liggest/dsh-alt-enter-newline
resources.desc: Adds Alt+Enter as a newline to the DeepSeek Harness (dsh) web composer.

resources.name: Light-EI/dsh-chat-perf-css
resources.desc: A long conversation that renders many LaTeX formulas at once can become laggy, because the browser keeps styling, laying out and painting content that is off screen. This plugin applies content-visibility: auto to the off-screen message bodies and block formulas, so that work is skipped and the lag is reduced.

resources.name: liguobao/dsh-file-viewer
resources.desc: Read-only Web client file-preview panel with image, PDF, CSV/TSV, text, source-code, Markdown, JSON and YAML renderers, large-file range loading, and a provider API for non-local content.

resources.name: lihang-lh/dsh-moon-light
resources.desc: A marquee mood-light ring around the DSH web UI edge that reacts to session state, turning green while the agent works, pink when done, and yellow when something needs attention, with colors, ring width, rotation speed, and flash frequency configurable from the settings panel.

resources.name: lihang-lh/dsh-task-panel
resources.desc: Task panel for the DSH Web sidebar: publish tasks, auto-distill related sessions, and drive plan/develop/review stages with subagents plus in-panel acceptance.

resources.name: LihiHe/dsh-thinking-slider
resources.desc: Turns the composer's reasoning-effort menu into a draggable slider and takes over the stock model-and-reasoning-level chip. Dragging follows the pointer continuously; releasing snaps to the nearest level and submits one session update per drag. The track draws its own fill, tick marks and white knob, only the highest levels (xhigh, max, ultra) get a flowing brand-colour gradient, and both ends carry the lowest and highest level names. The same card expands into the official model list. Arrow keys step one level, PageUp and PageDown two, Home and End jump to the ends, and each move submits. A generation counter on the directory object discards late responses, and reduced-motion turns the animations off. All data comes from the stock modelDirectories directory; no new capabilities are added.

resources.name: lihongxu0221/dsh-workspace-browser
resources.desc: Replaces the shipped sidebar workspace browser with Recents, a project editor that adds extra source folders, and pin, rename, fork, and archive row actions.

resources.name: lijinhao315/dsh-question-index
resources.desc: Question index: an ordered, collapsible list of your asked questions floating on the right side of the conversation; click a question to jump the session to that point. Auto-indexes each session's full history on open, persists it locally, and jumps to older questions by growing the window on demand.

resources.name: lilcandi/dsh-continue-button
resources.desc: A continue button in the composer tool row, immediately left of the send key: one click writes an interruption-aware prompt into the draft and submits it, so an interrupted task resumes without retyping the context. The prompt names the interruption and appends the current task plus the tail of the last reply; Alt-click or right-click sends a bare 继续, and a non-empty draft is appended to rather than overwritten.

resources.name: lilcandi/dsh-music-on
resources.desc: A music dock for the DSH web GUI. A draggable capsule in the bottom-right corner opens into a player card with a queue, previous and next, a draggable progress bar, a volume knob driven by drag or mouse wheel, three loop modes and per-track cover art for resolved links (local files show a vinyl placeholder); audio files dropped onto the card play immediately. Paste a Bilibili, NetEase Cloud Music or QQ Music track or playlist link to resolve it: NetEase and QQ audio is signed by the host into an opaque HMAC token, so the browser never receives a plain CDN address and cannot forge one. A spectrum canvas along the page bottom reads a real AnalyserNode and draws in six styles (dots, bars, blocks, mirror, line, wave) with adjustable width, bar count, sensitivity, glow, height, frame rate and placement; the row is fitted to the container width, falling back to a slight overflow when the gaps would fall below half a pixel. Seven colour themes (whale blue-white, aurora, mint, sunset, rose, neon, mono). The settings section is grouped into interface, theme, playback, links and spectrum, and carries favorites and history tables.

resources.name: lilcandi/dsh-session-live
resources.desc: Live preview inside the sidebar session hover card: what the session is doing right now (running tool with elapsed time, thinking, last tool duration), an attachment thumbnail with click-to-enlarge, the latest user prompt and assistant reply with injected system scaffolding stripped out, a recent-tool icon strip, turn count plus token totals plus model name on one line, and a 12-item settings page (11 switches plus a slider) persisted to the profile.

resources.name: liliuCourier/dsh-chat-outline
resources.desc: Persistent conversation outline: per-turn questions and final replies, keyword filter, one-click jump, light/full history modes, and Ctrl/Shift+click to open the same position in the Trajectory view.

resources.name: Limitinfinitude/DSH-Right-Sidebar
resources.desc: DSH Web right-side output dock: session-scoped tabs for reports, images, data, video, and audio, with inline previews, output quality checks, and a searchable per-turn history.

resources.name: linandadada-pixel/dsh-screenshot
resources.desc: Native, instant region-screenshot button for the DeepSeek Harness composer: one click freezes the screen, a WeChat-style overlay (gray mask, green selection) appears, and the cropped PNG is inserted into the current draft. An optional eye toggle hides the whole DSH window before capturing, then restores it. No ms-screenclip, about 10 ms per drag frame, coexists with voice input. Windows 10/11 x64 only; the first capture compiles a helper with the built-in .NET Framework csc.exe.

resources.name: linglanxin/dsh-feng-gu-lite
resources.desc: Offline Beijing-time peak/idle indicator below the conversation composer, with a 2026 calendar, uncertainty labels, and brief peak reminders; no API key or runtime network access required.

resources.name: lingr7/dsh-reversed-chat
resources.desc: Moves the composer to the top of an active conversation and renders the transcript plus the turn navigator newest-first, so replies appear right under the composer.

resources.name: linhx1999/dsh-writing-pad
resources.desc: Session-scoped Markdown writing pad docked beside the conversation, with edit/preview modes, selection-based AI rewrites, diff review, undo, and draft recovery.

resources.name: LinJohn8/dsh-model-group-collapse
resources.desc: Makes the provider groups in the composer model menu collapsible, keeping only the provider of the current model expanded.

resources.name: linkbag/dsh-capyreporter
resources.desc: Always-on-top capybara task reporter for DSH Web — a transparent floating pet that narrates each trajectory step in a speech bubble, names the project it reports for, and alerts you when a task completes while you work elsewhere.

resources.name: linshufan21/dsh-boot-compass
resources.desc: Desktop full-screen boot splash. It covers DSH's loading card before first paint, plays a 4.5 s five-stage compass sequence, then hands off to the app; clicking anywhere skips ahead, and reopening the window from the tray replays it. The first cold start may hitch once, then runs smoothly.

resources.name: liqiGeGe/dsh-plugin-execution-graph
resources.desc: Adds an Execution graph conversation-view tab that renders each turn's prompts, replies, and tool calls/results as a foldable timeline with a detail panel and PNG export.

resources.name: liqiming-whu/dsh-status-card
resources.desc: Adds a configurable dsh-ui status card before each DSH agent reply, with bilingual templates and a live settings preview. Requires @omdsh-dev/dsh-genui from dsh-market; without it, the card markup is emitted unrendered.

resources.name: lisniuse/dsh-modal-enhancer
resources.desc: Window-like controls for every Web UI modal: drag by title bar, eight-way resize, pin against outside clicks, maximize to the full viewport, removable backdrop blur, and per-dialog persistent state.

resources.name: littleboylittlegirl/dsh-community-hot
resources.desc: Floating community panel for the Web UI: 24h hot topics and hot plugins TOP10 with a draggable, always-on-top button.

resources.name: liu19666/dsh-model-block-picker
resources.desc: Composer model selector grouped by provider: pick a provider card, then drill into that provider to choose a model, with cross-provider search and Reasoning Effort kept.

resources.name: liu19666/dsh-screenshot
resources.desc: Windows screenshot overlay: highlights the window, screen or taskbar under the cursor and dims the rest, then annotates (shapes, arrows, pen, text, mosaic) and drops the image into the composer without sending it.

resources.name: liu3734/jira-tasks-dsh-plugin
resources.desc: JIRA task panel under the DSH composer: per-workspace project key and optional JQL, listing the issues assigned to the current user with status, priority and issue-type chips, a total count, collapse and refresh, links to JIRA, plus a settings card for the base URL and token with a connection probe.

resources.name: liudapeng0311/dsh-pwa-launcher
resources.desc: Turns the browser PWA shortcut already on your desktop into a real launcher: it adopts that shortcut and keeps its icon, then starts dsh web silently on double-click and opens the app window; adds restart and dsh self-update (with rollback) controls to the web UI. Windows only.

resources.name: liuhaolong16/dsh-quote-reply
resources.desc: Keeps quotes out of the message body: quoting any passage from an assistant turn opens an editable quote tray above the composer, the quotes are injected into the next turn as system-prompt context (attributed with source and time), and an expandable quote row under that turn shows exactly which quotes were used. Quotes persist across page reloads and are claimed per turn; the host and client halves hand-shake on version and report a compatibility verdict.

resources.name: liuhusk/dsh-status-card
resources.desc: A permanent status card in the top-right corner of the DSH content area: one line for where this turn's time went (model, tools, waiting), plus collapsible to-dos with a progress bar, the session goal (edit/pause/resume/clear), submitted plans that open in the preview pane, the files this session changed, and subagents with their token and duration figures; it yields space to the content as the area narrows and folds into a round button at the limit.

resources.name: liujia-io/dsh-image-picker
resources.desc: Adds a paperclip image-picker button to the conversation composer - pick reference images through the system file dialog and feed them straight into the official attachment pipeline (thumbnails, limit checks, upload with message).

resources.name: liuming-dev/dsh-plugins#annotation-rewind-scroll
resources.desc: Annotate replies and documents for the next message, edit past user messages and rerun from that point, and use keyboard shortcuts to navigate user messages or recall previous inputs in the composer.

resources.name: liumorrisclaw/dsh-composer-input-history
resources.desc: Recalls messages you already sent in the DSH composer with ArrowUp; ArrowDown walks forward, restores the draft you were writing, and one more press discards it and clears the composer.

resources.name: liushQAQ/dsh-prompt-optimizer
resources.desc: Smart prompt optimization & dynamic thinking effort adaptation with composer capsule, DSH/custom models, undo/re-optimize, and native settings.

resources.name: liushuchang-2012/dsh-boot-splash
resources.desc: Boot film for the web UI: a blue whale floods black from below as the page loads, then glides left and pulls the | deepseek HARNESS wordmark out of itself before the app appears.

resources.name: liuzwZYW/dsh-pwa-ui
resources.desc: Gives an installed dsh web app a native-looking window caption through Window Controls Overlay - the manifest route is served with display_override, the app's own sidebar brand row and session header become the drag region, and the app's own trailing controls are inset clear of the browser's caption chrome.

resources.name: liwangzimo/dsh-calendar-diary
resources.desc: A plain-notebook calendar in the DSH sidebar: a 70-day, Monday-first grid whose cells print that day's note; one note per day is stored in a .xlsx you choose, in the DesktopCal two-column layout (Excel date serial plus free text, newest date first). Clicking a day opens the editor for it, and import/export move that same format in and out, with a preview step and a conflict policy (keep, overwrite, concat or skip).

resources.name: liweidong1722/dsh-work-list
resources.desc: Local-first DSH Web work checklist with rich-text notes, categories, folding, drag reordering, search, JSON import/export, and a restorable trash.

resources.name: liyansong0015/dsh-sao-link-start
resources.desc: Adds a configurable SAO-inspired full-screen startup animation to DeepSeek Harness.

resources.name: lizilong1993/dsh-unlimited-effort
resources.desc: Composer infinity switch: while the highest reasoning effort is selected, one click appends a configurable notice to the system prompt.

resources.name: lizixuan200410-cmd/dsh-ink-whale-leap
resources.desc: Plays a short ink-wash whale-leap animation over the DeepSeek Harness web UI when it loads, then fades out on its own.

resources.name: lj100886/dsh-team-canvas
resources.desc: Renders an Agent Teams swimlane canvas above the composer: lead centred with members below, tasks laid out in lanes by longest dependency path, and four SVG connector families drawn as dashed paths (task dependency as a cubic bezier from the upstream card edge to the downstream card edge, lead bus, peer bus, member-to-task tether). Cards are absolutely positioned DOM, connectors are one SVG layer sharing the same geometry constants. Layout constants and path algorithms are ported from cc-haha. Reads the live per-session agentTeam projection (roster, shared tasks, dependency edges, running state) and falls back to the session todo list when the session has no team; team messages are not part of the projection yet, so the communication panel shows an empty state. Body colours come from host theme tokens; the eight member identity colours are the deliberate exception — fixed hues mixed with the theme accent via color-mix, declared as CSS variables because the same values feed an SVG stroke attribute that rejects colour functions. Ships zh/en dictionaries with identical keys.

resources.name: ljxdsg12/dsh-composer-polish
resources.desc: Adds a Polish button to the composer tool row right of the permission control: it reads the draft you have already typed, has the current model infer your intent and rewrite the draft into a clearer prompt, then turns the button into Cancel so one click restores the exact pre-polish text.

resources.name: lk251066/dsh-tui-pro
resources.desc: A full-screen terminal workbench for DeepSeek Harness with a durable assistant, workspace-grouped project sessions, transcript-only scrolling, and structured thinking, tool, diff, plan, and subagent views.

resources.name: Lkrain821/dsh-pixelwhale
resources.desc: Turns the "deep diving" thinking status into a pixel font, with an animated pixel blue whale spouting and wagging its tail beside it.

resources.name: lmmzss-jk/dsh-plugin-balance
resources.desc: Balance and live session usage for the DSH web UI: header balance button (left of the Session log), dropdown with account balance, real-time token breakdown (cache miss/hit, cache write, output), cache hit rate, and official-rate cost estimates with peak/off-peak auto-switch.

resources.name: lo2589/dsh-plugin-rightbar
resources.desc: A shared right sidebar for the DSH web client — other plugins register tabs into the rightbar.tab slot instead of each pinning a position:fixed panel; ships a rightbar-tab skill for agents and an opt-in mode that moves legacy fixed panels aside.

resources.name: loadingvx/deepseeh-harness-ultra-slash
resources.desc: Separate slash-command group in the Web UI composer: /steer injects text on the agent's next step without interrupting the turn, /new starts a blank session, /skill and /docs wrap /steer with post-turn skill or docs tasks, and custom /steer aliases are configurable in Settings.

resources.name: loadingvx/deepseek-harness-workbench-plugin
resources.desc: Fills in the Web UI's missing IDE workbench: resizable chat / editor / files-and-Git columns in Conversation, multi-tab file editing with save and new-file, workspace Terminal, a file tree with name filter and open-in-external-editor, SCM (stage/commit/push/pull, branch switch, Git graph, inline diffs), a status bar, and git_* model tools.

resources.name: lof6yo/dsh-just-settings
resources.desc: Replaces the sidebar's More menu with a single button that opens Settings.

resources.name: lokih1028/dsh-plugin-canvas-pro
resources.desc: Adds a Canvas drawer and eight model tools to create, patch, version, and export HTML, Markdown, Mermaid, SVG, and React artifacts.

resources.name: lokih1028/dsh-prompt-optimizer
resources.desc: One-click prompt enhancement and structuring button for DSH composer.

resources.name: LonelyHerbivore/dsh-image-question#plugin
resources.desc: Ask the user a question about a local image; the DSH Web card offers zoom, pan, box, brush and lasso annotation, NG/OK/unsure verdicts and a note, and the agent receives annotations back in source-image pixel coordinates.

resources.name: long6177/dsh-markdown-input
resources.desc: Markdown live rendering for the DSH Web UI composer: typed Markdown (bold, lists, code fences) renders as you type in a CodeMirror-based takeover composer; sent user messages render as Markdown; pasted rich text becomes clean Markdown.

resources.name: Lostforest7/dsh-revise
resources.desc: Visual frontend revision workbench: point at a real page element, describe the change, send it into the current DSH session, then review fixed-viewport before/after screenshots (1280x800 and 390x844) beside a captured source diff, accepting each revision item by item. Revision records are kept per session under .dsh-revise/ and export as a single portable HTML report.

resources.name: lov0vo/dsh-composer-autopair
resources.desc: Auto-pairs brackets and quotes in the DSH chat composer, inserting the closing half with the caret in between; it also wraps selected text with the typed pair and handles brackets committed by an IME.

resources.name: LoveIrishCoffee/dsh-effort-ultra
resources.desc: A native reasoning-effort control for the composer: a blue-to-violet tier bar with a starfield and a sheen sweep. It owns the model seat and drives the official model-directories service, so the ladder comes from each model's own reasoning declaration and no other plugin is required.

resources.name: lovvvve/dsh-quick-actions#composer-quick-actions
resources.desc: Global Quick Actions beside every session-backed composer in DSH. One press sends a preset or your own saved text, with per-action send confirmation.

resources.name: loyalchiiina/dsh-artifact-linker
resources.desc: Turns every file artifact the agent names in chat into a clickable entry — and refuses to paint one that does not resolve. Hover resolves asynchronously, and only a file that really exists becomes a hand pointer with a dashed blue outline (30 s TTL cache, so repeated hovers cost nothing); confirmed non-artifacts stay plain text and the right-click falls through to the host menu untouched. Left click reveals the file in Explorer already selected (Shell.Application Explore plus SelectItem with SVSI_ENSUREVISIBLE, so the pane scrolls to it; explorer.exe /select is deliberately not used because it silently drops the selection when an instance is already running). Right click offers seven actions: preview in DSH's built-in sidebar, open with the default app, reveal in Explorer, save as, copy the file itself to the clipboard, copy the absolute path, or insert the path into the composer. Ctrl or Shift with left click opens with the default app, Alt with left click copies the path. Names resolve through the absolute path, the session workspace and every profile workspace, then a cached basename index built with a depth budget, shrinking from the left when a mention swallows leading words. The host half also keeps six system-prompt rules resident, so absolute paths stay in tool arguments while the body shows only file names, and every route is loopback-only.

resources.name: loyalchiiina/dsh-chat-image-lightbox
resources.desc: Full-screen lightbox for chat images: click any image to open the full-resolution original with zoom (wheel, buttons, shortcuts), drag panning, prev/next paging, filename caption and download, plus keyboard-arrow and touch-swipe navigation. One "image display control" popover next to the composer collapses every image in the conversation into a thumbnail grid whose column count (1-12) is configurable and remembered, or hides them entirely so the space closes up and restores them later; images are styled in place and no node is ever moved or reparented. The host-side display_image tool takes a local path or directory (TIFF/HEIC transcoded, originals still saved on download), a remote URL, or a keyword search over Bing, Huaban and Sogou that samples loadability before picking a source, re-saves images blocked by hotlink protection and drops dead links after a magic-byte check, returning paste-ready Markdown. It also keeps a system-prompt rule that every delivered image must appear in the reply body as ![](…) markdown, because collapsed tool rows are invisible to the reader.

resources.name: loyalchiiina/dsh-font-enhancer
resources.desc: DIY the DSH UI typography and colours: 10 built-in regions plus box-select region creation, each with its own Chinese and English font, size, line-height, weight (100-900), italic switch and text colour picker; 18 Chinese and 18 English fonts ship in the pickers, every region can be overridden by one unified setting, and named theme presets can be saved, applied, renamed and deleted. Random font assignment and random colour generation work for the whole UI or per region, and 8 fonts (LXGW WenKai, Smiley Sans, ZCOOL KuaiLe, Comic Neue, Baloo 2, Fredoka, Nunito, Caveat) can be downloaded and installed with one click (only Comic Neue ships in the package) alongside your own .ttf/.otf files, with a factory-default reset that restores the shipped palette. A 字 floating ball opens the panel, which carries a collapsible quick-start guide, and position and settings persist across restarts. The ball is shown or hidden from the DSH settings floating-ball section together with the other two balls, which share one 130-skin catalogue with a per-ball sync switch.

resources.name: loyalchiiina/dsh-lobsterai-daddy
resources.desc: Turns the LobsterDaddy multi-account console into a floating ball in the DSH window: drag it anywhere and the position persists, and the panel can be set to follow the ball. Clicking it slides out a drawer that renders the console as native DOM (no iframe) from the loopback-only same-origin proxy, showing action buttons, the account LobsterAI is currently signed in as, and a per-account list with balance, check-in state and last check-in time; a resizable persisted drawer, a live online/offline dot and an account-count badge are included.

resources.name: loyalchiiina/dsh-skill-browser
resources.desc: Browse and govern the skill library from a floating-ball panel with three tabs — skills, call ledger and quick start. You choose the skill root yourself through a native directory chooser (defaults to ~/.dsh/skills, no path is shipped with the plugin); skills are grouped into two levels of categories, with manual, keyword-based and AI grouping available and a tree or flat view toggle, and grouping is purely visual so no skill file is ever moved. Descriptions are read from each SKILL.md frontmatter, search filters by skill name, description or original text, and a card opens the full SKILL.md. Skills can be switched on and off per card, per category or for the whole library — the toggle rewrites disable-model-invocation in that SKILL.md and writes a SKILL.md.bak-toggle-<timestamp> backup before saving, rolling back if the write fails; disabled cards grey out until restored. The call ledger separates automatic from manual entries, records skill successes and failures by listening to tools/result events, and reports call counts, success rate, trend and a ranking, reusing an existing ledger file found in the library. Hot reload picks up skill edits without a restart. The DSH settings page gains a floating-ball section that shows or hides the three balls, offers one-click restore of a ball dragged off-screen, and picks the shared 130-skin catalogue for all three balls.

resources.name: loyalchiiina/dsh-todo-float-ball
resources.desc: Draggable floating ball that shows the current DSH session todo checklist live — done/total on its face (capsule mode also shows the running task title) plus a matching progress ring. Click to expand or fold the full list, right-click to switch capsule mode, and state colours mark in-progress (pulsing), done, pending and empty. Replaced plans are archived as history rows that can be hidden one by one, cleared and restored instead of counting towards progress, and other sessions can be pinned side by side. Data comes from the runtime sessions projection first with the official todo panel as a fallback, so the full list survives even when the official strip is collapsed. Text colour can be forced to auto, black or white, the ball snaps back to the bottom-right corner on demand, and it stays draggable right up to the top edge of the window. 130 shared skins — including two official dark and light skins that follow the client light/dark theme automatically, plus a per-ball sync switch so each ball either follows the shared skin or keeps its own — with Shadow DOM style isolation and position remembered per profile, identical on desktop and web.

resources.name: Lphehe/dsh-composer-assist
resources.desc: DSH input assistant for next-message prediction, draft autocomplete (text completion), and prompt polishing/rewrite. Session-local suggestions; Tab accepts into the draft without sending. Requires a configured model; calls may incur charges. Source-available; modifications require prior written permission.

resources.name: lrplrplrp/dsh-live2d
resources.desc: A Live2D waifu plugin for DSH.

resources.name: lsdt45/dsh-plan-plus
resources.desc: Plan review enhancement for DeepSeek Harness Web: reply to the plan-review card inline to have the model revise the plan, and browse, compare, edit and archive every plan version in a full-screen overlay.

resources.name: lsdt45/dsh-workspace-plus
resources.desc: Hierarchical workspace tree plus browser-style session tabs for the DSH sidebar: a "/" in a workspace or session title creates a virtual folder, with sections, pinning, time buckets, drag ordering, unified 6px status dots, per-row appearance customization (colour, glow, weight, icon) and a floating full-text search over session titles and message bodies. Several settings switches restore any behaviour to the host default, and a host-side route deletes sessions permanently (DSH ships archive only). Fork of KannaKuron/dsh-better-workspace.

resources.name: lsfcy/dsh-composer-predictions
resources.desc: Shows a dimmed suggestion of the user's next message in the empty composer after a settled turn; Tab accepts it into the draft and Escape or typing dismisses it.

resources.name: lsh2002/dsh-custom-fonts
resources.desc: Customize the UI's Chinese and English fonts, code font, and global font-size offset on a settings page, with a live preview and one-click reset.

resources.name: lsq-dsh-plugins/dsh-workbench-layout
resources.desc: Rearranges DSH Web into a three-column workbench with file editing, Git views, Markdown preview, and workspace terminals.

resources.name: Luaphes/dsh-web-attention-badge
resources.desc: Attention reminders: frame badge, tab-title count, and a status-colored whale favicon for sessions waiting for input or finished unopened.

resources.name: lucas07814-hub/dsh-pet-guardian-dragon
resources.desc: A draggable desktop pet for the DSH web interface with interactive actions and growth states.

resources.name: lucky01222/dsh-workbench-shell
resources.desc: Compact 56px app navigation rail with a separate conversation list and sidebar collapse control for the DSH web UI; also hides embedding, rerank and image/video generation models from the chat model menu and /model.

resources.name: LUgABeEEE/dsh-global-todo
resources.desc: Global cross-session todo list in the sidebar that the person and the agent both write to: ten global_todo_* tools add, batch-capture, update, attach documents and links to, append progress notes to and complete items from any session, and each item can be handed to an agent session in one of four modes with the outcome recorded on the item. The list is a single JSON file.

resources.name: LUgABeEEE/dsh-sidebar-density
resources.desc: Lightweight sidebar UI for DeepSeek Harness: five fold switches, three density presets and three width presets, served from one footer row plus a settings section — no dependencies and no background service.

resources.name: LUMIAO9527/DSH-suggestions
resources.desc: Context-based next-message suggestions and draft rewriting for DeepSeek Harness, with candidate paging, shortcut recording, and companion MCP tools.

resources.name: lumine-423/dsh-session-popout
resources.desc: Drag a session out of the DSH sidebar and it opens in its own native OS window, showing the full standard conversation UI (Markdown, toolbar, settings) with only the sidebar trimmed away, so several sessions can be watched side by side instead of switching back and forth. Windows verified; macOS and Linux untested. Runs in the DSH desktop app (Electron).

resources.name: Luminet-LT/dsh-inapp-chat
resources.desc: Adds a sidebar entry that opens DeepSeek web chat in an in-app window for quick questions while working. Fork of zerorigin-studio/dsh-deepseek-chat (already listed); it uses its own settings namespace, so both can coexist. Needs the desktop bridge (window.dsh.desktop.openWindow).

resources.name: lumoping/dsh-todo-inbox
resources.desc: Global cross-session todo inbox for DSH web: any session's agent records human-action todos (merge MRs, approve work orders, reviews) via inbox_add/inbox_done/inbox_list; a sidebar entry shows a count badge and an expandable list to open and complete them, persisted to ~/.dsh/todo-inbox.json.

resources.name: luoshuizhiwei/dsh-desktop-restart
resources.desc: Adds a restart button to the DeepSeek Harness desktop app — it asks before restarting while work is running, and afterwards reports how long the app was down. Entries can live in the sidebar, the conversation header, the account menu or the settings page, and each one can be turned off. Extras include checking how much sign-in data is stored (a cause of startup failures) and previewing leftover temp files, counted but never deleted. Desktop app only.

resources.name: Lushdawn/dsh-effort-dial
resources.desc: Codex-style reasoning-effort card for the composer: takes over the model selector and shows the current level, the model row and a segmented slider over the model's own adapter-provided levels, with a model list, a reset, and a purple aurora with twinkling particles at the maximum level.

resources.name: LUX09947-CMYK/dsh-re
resources.desc: Adds a refresh button to the DeepSeek Harness desktop title bar next to the Edit menu, reloading the interface without restarting the app.

resources.name: luxi233/dsh-settings-nav-scroll
resources.desc: Adds a visible vertical scrollbar to the DSH Web settings navigation when its sections exceed the viewport.

resources.name: luyiheng1111/dsh-context-window-picker
resources.desc: Adds a session-scoped context window selector next to the reasoning-effort row in the DeepSeek Harness model popup: a pill showing the effective window opens a dropdown of presets below the model default, the choice applies to the next request of that session only, and a new session falls back to the profile default. It writes no config file and appends nothing to the session log.

resources.name: LWLAymh/dsh-tool-emoji
resources.desc: Replace tool-card leading icons with emoji while preserving the original cards.

resources.name: lxj5820/dsh-boot-animation
resources.desc: Replaces the kernel boot page with a full-window video clip that dissolves into the app; the clip pool, enter mode and fade length are configurable in Settings → Plugins.

resources.name: ly14278/dsh-prompt-brief
resources.desc: Adds an Optimize button to the composer that rewrites a one-line idea into a structured product brief: a positioning sentence, 3–6 key features, visual references and design tokens; it sits beside your original text in a compare dialog where you can accept it into the input, generate another version, or cancel and keep the draft untouched. No settings page and no API keys — it calls the model channel you already configured.

resources.name: LyaxZ/dsh-fonttune
resources.desc: A font plugin for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI: the conversation gets its own font, size, line height, weight, tracking, word gap, paragraph gap and first-line indent, the interface font follows it, code keeps its own axis with ligature control; light and dark can each hold their own set, whole setups save as presets, and a floating panel puts every axis a dot away.

resources.name: LyaxZ/dsh-goodies
resources.desc: Effort slider in the model menu, a live tokens-per-second and turn-total readout beside the running status, a per-answer input/output/cached report, and a completion notification when a turn finishes, for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI.

resources.name: LyaxZ/dsh-quick-toc
resources.desc: Conversation outline for DeepSeek Harness: the Markdown headings of the whole session, grouped by turn, in a side panel or a full-width curtain; hover previews can be pinned for comparison, bookmarks keep the places you come back to, and a right-click jumps to a section or copies a heading and the levels below it. Six theme colours and a translucent material, title/prompt/full-text/cross-session search, reading-position follow and a Chinese/English interface.

resources.name: lyhue1991/dsh-soup
resources.desc: Project file explorer in the details column (multi-select, drag-move, upload, download, rename, trash, system-open) with an in-session read-only preview tab for Markdown/HTML/JSON/CSV/notebook/PDF + code highlighting, a live model throughput badge, and a multiline GoalBar.

resources.name: lyonleeeee/dsh-steer
resources.desc: Adds a live status badge to the session header and delivers guidance added mid-task without interrupting the turn.

resources.name: lyx0717/dsh-washer
resources.desc: Renders DeepSeek Harness session state as a washing machine: a desktop floating widget animates live session activity, with three skins (precision, anime, pixel). The overlay offers two sizes, optional click-through, and follows the host app's dark mode. Settings live inside the DSH UI.

resources.name: Lzh3070/dsh-file-review-tab
resources.desc: Review agent file changes as a dsh-better-sidebar sidebar tab or chat turn-tail row — line-level diffs and undo.

resources.name: lzpway-jpg/dsh-plugin-brand-custom
resources.desc: Custom brand icon and name for the DSH Web sidebar and conversation hero, editable live from a settings card on the plugin detail page.

resources.name: Lzz2133/dsh-manutd-fixtures
resources.desc: Manchester United 2026/27 fixtures in the sidebar with kickoff times in your local timezone, finished matches with W/L/D results.

resources.name: mackwan84/dsh-ui-mockup#ui-mockup
resources.desc: Generates UI wireframes and high-fidelity mockups in DeepSeek Harness with selectable DashScope and Volcengine image providers.

resources.name: magian1127/deepseek-harness-zh_pro
resources.desc: UI enhancement suite for the DSH web client: Chinese locale completion, one-row stats, auto-expanded thinking, chat width, session archiving and delete, plus an optional prompt-injection switch (off by default).

resources.name: magicOF2/dsh-autoload-history
resources.desc: Automatically loads the full conversation history when a session opens, so older messages are ready without clicking "Load earlier".

resources.name: magicOF2/dsh-chat-width-customizer
resources.desc: Session-header button that cycles the conversation width (748-1600px), widening the chat column, composer, and user bubbles together.

resources.name: magicOF2/dsh-schedule
resources.desc: Local long-term schedule panel: top-bar "日程" text button, today/week/history month-calendar views with stats, completion checkmarks with per-day history, schedule↔conversation links with click-to-jump, recurring tasks (daily/weekly), optional auto carry-over for unfinished one-time tasks, and dailytask_* agent tools.

resources.name: magicOF2/dsh-turn-marks
resources.desc: Left-edge turn-marks strip in chat: one bar per user message, click to jump to that message, hover for a preview, active bar turns white.

resources.name: maimaiqwe/prompt-enhancer#dsh-prompt-enhance-cn
resources.desc: Four-tier prompt enhancer for the composer — the system tier always emits a LangGPT-structured system prompt (# Role / Profile / Skills / Rules / Workflows / Initialization), upgrading task drafts into the system prompt of the agent that runs them, while the other tiers rewrite as a light tidy-up, a single paragraph, or a five-section brief; the iterate workbench refines an editable base under an optional requirement, with fill-back and undo. Never changes intent, never invents requirements.

resources.name: Makk9609/dsh-find-viewer
resources.desc: Find bar in the sidebar text preview, with whole-file match counts for plain text and code, highlighted hits, and jumps between them.

resources.name: MannixHu/dsh-statusbar-config
resources.desc: Configurable statistics row below the composer via a ${variable} display template — which segments appear and how they are labelled is fully user-defined.

resources.name: maqian1632/dsh-tray-restart
resources.desc: Adds a single “Restart DeepSeek Harness” item to the Windows system tray menu of the DSH desktop app by patching the installed app.asar in place and re-applying that patch after each desktop update; it needs a writable DSH installation directory and adds no other tray actions.

resources.name: MarchLiu/dsh-rich-editor
resources.desc: Rich Markdown notebook for the composer region: a tool-row toggle plus a CodeMirror editor card with Codex-style list editing, submitted through the conversation service.

resources.name: MaRi23333/dsh-agent-instructions-editor
resources.desc: Edit global AGENTS.md and project AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md custom instructions in DeepSeek Harness settings, with project-chain discovery, byte-budget display, and save-conflict handling.

resources.name: MarkTina/dsh-activity-heat
resources.desc: Scores sessions and workspaces 0-100% by time since their last activity, then shows that heat as a sidebar icon, a small heat dot before every session title, a heat line in the session hover card, and a filterable sessions/workspaces panel that also totals the turns, steps, tokens and conversation time of each workspace.

resources.name: Martlet-Tech/dsh-open-folder-fix
resources.desc: Fixes the Windows workspace-open action. The shipped opener runs explorer.exe "<file:// URI>", which on some hosts reports success without raising a window — the exit-code verdict cannot tell an opened window from nothing happening. This routes that one action to explorer.exe /e,<dir>, which raises a window reliably, and leaves every other application in the menu on the shipped path.

resources.name: MarushiruDonato/dsh-rgb
resources.desc: RGB lighting effects for DeepSeek Harness: animated composer ring, sidebar rail, session indicator, and glowing brand logo.

resources.name: matata2017/dsh-paste-collapse
resources.desc: Codex-style paste collapse for the DeepSeek Harness composer: a paste of more than 1000 characters becomes a [Pasted Content N chars] placeholder, a second paste of the same size is numbered #2, and the host expands it back to the full text before the model reads it, so the model still receives every character. A pill on the top edge of the composer shows the preview, the sent message shows the same pill, and clicking either opens the whole paste in a side panel with a copy button. Pure in memory: nothing is written to disk and no token is saved.

resources.name: Matcha-Eason/dsh-answer-highlighter
resources.desc: Automatically highlights key points, definitions, warnings, and questions in completed assistant answers using one separate model call.

resources.name: Max-Null/dsh-chat-rail
resources.desc: Scroll-painting message rail for DeepSeek Harness: a slim right-edge rail with one indicator per user message, scroll-spy follows the reading position, hover unfolds a canvas with full message previews, and clicking jumps to any history message; animates in sync with better-sidebar panels.

resources.name: Max-Null/dsh-node-appearance
resources.desc: Conversation node appearance for the DeepSeek Harness web GUI: configurable per-category and per-tool colors (left accent bar + tinted background), plus a show-thinking toggle; pure frontend rendering, takes effect instantly and persists to the DSH user settings file.

resources.name: Max-Null/dsh-quick-toolbar
resources.desc: Plugin-button aggregator with carrier + on-site-LLM extensibility: gather any plugin's scattered buttons into one entry (SSiD title bar / web floating ball), LLM registers per environment, right-click deregisters — pure data, no plugin source touched.

resources.name: MDR-EX1000/dsh-desktop-kit
resources.desc: macOS desktop shell for the DSH web UI: a plugin plus a small Tauri/WKWebView window over the loopback web surface — real macOS fullscreen, single instance, external links delegated to the system browser, and browser-style zoom.

resources.name: meihaoyidian/life-workbench
resources.desc: Personal workbench panel with an overview dashboard, custom kanban boards, a note pad and a file library, persisted to local JSON by the host.

resources.name: melt502/DSH-Session-Reference-UX-Patch
resources.desc: Durable, reversible installer that patches DSH Desktop session-reference UX — workspace-prioritized @ candidates, title-first display, two-line menu layout, and sidebar drag-to-composer session references.

resources.name: MEMZ-JZY/DSH-Claude-Style-Reasoning-Slider
resources.desc: Animated Claude-style reasoning-effort slider and model picker that replaces the native DSH model selector.

resources.name: mengqinlol/dsh-mobile-shell

resources.name: omdsh-dev/dsh-genui

resources.name: omdsh-dev/ex-setting

resources.name: OolongBlackCoffee/dsh-wuwa-pet
resources.desc: Puts a WuwaTappo desktop pet's bubbles to work: shows the DeepSeek balance, today's spend and a per-turn cost bubble, and keeps an amber reminder bubble up while the agent waits for an answer or an approval. Talks to the pet over CDP, enabling its debug port with a one-time, revertible byte patch.

resources.name: openAGFS/dsh-agfs
resources.desc: File-browser web app for DSH: React frontend and REST API served by the host webserver, a /dsh-agfs command that opens at the current session workspace, and a browse_files model tool.

resources.name: opencues/opencues#integrations-dsh
resources.desc: Word alternatives and underscore-gated fill-ins in the composer. End a line with _ and it is filled; misspellings are flagged as you type. Routes through the model dsh is already configured with, so it needs no API key.

resources.name: openma-ai/Martty#npm
resources.desc: A DSH-first Rust/ratatui agent TUI with streamed tool calls, subagents, durable sessions, and a Cordis-extensible client UI.

resources.name: OrderG-X/dsh-design-studio
resources.desc: Design workbench in the right sidebar. When the model builds web pages, app screens, posters, slides or emails, each HTML file shows up as a screen on a canvas inside a device frame and refreshes when the file changes; local dev servers are proxied with hot reload intact. Click an element or drag a region to put its selector, source file and styles into the composer. It can extract a brand design system from your website or project (colors by role, fonts, type scale, radius, shadows, buttons, inputs and cards) and use it for every new design. The model adds a few tweak sliders to each design (spacing, radius, brand color, layout variants) that update all screens live and write back to the stylesheet in one click. A finished design can be turned into React, Vue, Next.js or plain HTML code, with each built screen diffed pixel by pixel against the design. Also has a design tokens panel, nine style presets, a style panel (font size, colors, radius, padding and more) that writes back to the HTML or hands the change to the model together with the CSS rule and line behind each property, versions saved before and after each turn with drag-to-compare and restore, export to images, PDF and PPTX (links between screens stay clickable), a LAN QR link for viewing on a phone, link arrows and a click-through demo mode, a multi-size view, in-place text editing, reference-image palettes, and a design check (overflowing, clipped or overlapping text, contrast, tap target size and more). Bundles a ui-design skill and six tools: preview_page opens a preview; check_design measures every screen at real sizes in a hidden local Chrome or Edge (bars covering content, script errors, missing assets, dead links; CSS file and line for contrast and font-size issues; cropped screenshots of serious problems); look_design hands real screenshots to the model; extract_design_system builds a design system from a site or project; handoff_design writes a handoff pack (screenshots, routes, tokens, shared components); compare_design diffs the built local page against the design and marks what differs. Adds a Design mode for new sessions (Standard mode's tools plus the skill, the six tools and a design persona); each part has its own switch on the Plugins page. When DSH is opened from a phone or another computer, local-file designs are bundled into a sandboxed frame so they still show.

resources.name: OrderG-X/dsh-pages
resources.desc: Lets the model turn an answer into a web page that lives right inside the chat. The show_page tool saves a page (comparisons, checklists, calculators, quizzes, charts) and it appears under the reply at its content height, interactive and following DSH's light/dark theme. The page's localStorage is stored in DSH per page, so what users tick or type survives reopening and new versions, and the same page open in the chat and the right sidebar stays in sync. Each edit is saved as a new version you can flip back to. After saving, the page is checked in a hidden local Chrome or Edge (script errors, horizontal overflow, dark mode not applied) and problems go back to the model. The right sidebar shows the page full-size with versions, a gallery of all pages and export to PNG, PDF or HTML. Pages run in a sandboxed, separate-origin frame with a strict CSP: no access to DSH data and no fetch, XHR or WebSocket. Works on phones with dsh-mobile.

resources.name: OrderG-X/dsh-video-preview
resources.desc: Plays local video and audio inside the conversation. Media files the model writes during a turn - screen recordings, transcodes, voiceovers - get a player under its final reply automatically when their paths appear in its commands, the command output or the reply; the play_video tool plays any other file. Video shows as compact cards with a hover preview, audio as a slim seek bar, streamed over HTTP Range so long files seek instead of loading into memory. Also registers a sidebar media preview renderer, since the built-in previewer treats mp4 as unviewable. The look_video tool lets the model see a video itself: a hidden local Chrome or Edge grabs frames into a time-labelled contact sheet (or big frames at given times, or a short range frame by frame), checks the audio (silence, too quiet, clipping, one channel only) and the picture (black or frozen frames), and reads MP4 / MOV headers for phone compatibility (codec, HDR, faststart and more), with ffmpeg fixes.

resources.name: orphiczhou/dsh-region-probe
resources.desc: A read-only Cordis Inspect provider that lets an agent see the interface it is driving: outline() reports which UI regions the running shell actually rendered, with occupancy, geometry and current or past failure state; snapshot() returns one region's rendered node tree (tag, role, aria-label, own text, geometry, computed styles) addressed by slot key or CSS selector; failures() keeps a history of regions that failed to render and whether they recovered. Regions are addressed by the anchor the shell already writes for every slot, so it needs no region list and covers regions added later or contributed by other plugins. No UI, no tools, no dependencies, no network access.

resources.name: orphiczhou/dsh-session-tree
resources.desc: Replaces the left sidebar session list with a tree of every session and its nested subagent descendants, with click-through to each conversation's multi-turn history and a tree_send tool for messaging any continuable session anywhere in the tree.

resources.name: oumaekumiko0821/dsh-splash-gojo
resources.desc: Full-screen boot animation for the DSH web client: the boot HTML paints a cover-fit artwork on its first frame, adds a slow settle, a scanning light sweep and a progress HUD, then hands the viewport over when the app mounts. Click or press Esc / space / Enter to skip.

resources.name: outmanwt/dsh-team-fishbone
resources.desc: Session-header fishbone panel for sub-agent assignments, live status, available token and duration metrics, shared task-board entries, and native child-session navigation.

resources.name: overact/dsh-statusline-plus
resources.desc: Displays account quotas, Git state, context usage, public API reference costs, Subagent activity, and streaming speed in DeepSeek Harness Web.

resources.name: oxlyn/dsh-flyout-sidebar
resources.desc: Flyout sidebar with a file tree, uncommitted-changes list and multi-tab file/diff previews; pops out into a standalone browser tab.

resources.name: Oxygen-Wang/dsh-cursorlike-sidebar
resources.desc: A Cursor-like sidebar for DeepSeek Harness with file browsing, code editing, Git diffs, terminal, side chat, and Ctrl+L references.

resources.name: oxygenforce/dsh-agent-activity
resources.desc: Live done/now/next card above the composer while the agent is still working.

resources.name: OZONGO/dsh-keyboard-shortcut
resources.desc: Adds a Keyboard Shortcuts page to the DSH Settings panel with six rebindable commands — permission-mode cycling, reasoning-effort stepping, a status-page and a task-list shortcut — plus PgUp/PgDn input navigation and an optional composer Enter remap.

resources.name: P1gG0dG0d/dsh-study-ask
resources.desc: Opens a dedicated question chat in the right sidebar for text selected in a DSH conversation, so follow-up questions do not push the main conversation away and never appear in the session list.

resources.name: p56568833/dsh-plugin-groups
resources.desc: Category tabs (All, Appearance & UI, Usage & account and more) for the Installed list on the Plugins page, remembering the chosen tab; patch plugins named in an editable parent table are indented under the plugin they patch. Display-only, writes no files.

resources.name: Paimonshen/dsh-coding-plugin
resources.desc: Coding-learn floating panel: edits and runs Python/JavaScript/TypeScript/PowerShell with exit code and timing, grades JSON course lessons with progress export, keeps Markdown notes and snippet library, and sends code plus a question into the current conversation for the main model to answer.

resources.name: panando/dsh-prompt-optimizer
resources.desc: One-button prompt optimizer: rewrites the composer draft via a configurable strategy, with an editable template, few-shot examples, pinned models and reasoning effort.

resources.name: panando/dsh-quote-sidechat
resources.desc: Select text in a reply and quote it into the composer as an atomic reference chip: delete the whole chip in one keystroke, click it to scroll back and highlight the quoted turn, and expand it into a bounded reference block at send time so the model can tell the quote apart from what the user typed. Also opens the snippet in a side chat, or copies it to the clipboard.

resources.name: PangXitong/dsh-restart-button
resources.desc: Power button in the DSH Web UI session header that lets you close or restart the whole DSH process.

resources.name: PaoMoXML/dsh-paste-names
resources.desc: Paste non-image files or folders into the chat composer as native @path references, or drag them in as absolute paths, instead of the images-only error.

resources.name: Pasumao/dsh-plugin-workbench

resources.name: pc439527/dsh-model-provider
resources.desc: Provider-first three-level model selector for the DSH Web model seat: pick a provider, then a model from that provider, with inline search on both levels, failed-provider retry rows, and a Model · Provider trigger.

resources.name: pc439527/dsh-side-monitor
resources.desc: Sidebar system monitor for the DSH Web UI: live host overview (CPU/memory/network/disk), process list, and Docker container status, all read-only.

resources.name: penguin-oo/dsh-pathlink
resources.desc: Ctrl+click file paths and links in chat: paths open their folder in the OS file manager (with the file selected), links open in a new browser tab.

resources.name: pengyue-polaron/deepseek-harness-genui
resources.desc: Code-first React and TypeScript task apps rendered inline, in Canvas, full screen, or on localhost, with interaction state available to later agent turns and approval-gated MCP and API access.

resources.name: perdakovich/dsh-prompt-edit
resources.desc: In-place prompt editing in the web chat: cleanly forks session history at the edited turn, preserves image and file attachments, and auto-archives the superseded branch.

resources.name: PerryLink/dsh-community-bench
resources.desc: Adds a Community Bench tab that reads the public task-conditioned registry and shows the same score everyone sees; it does not compute a local score.

resources.name: PerryLink/dsh-composer-history
resources.desc: Terminal-style input history for the web composer: edge-first arrow-key recall with exact draft/caret restore, browser-local persisted history, Ctrl+R reverse search, and sliding-context awareness; 0.5.0 adds a smart input layer — cross-session snippets (/save, /load), prompt templates with variables, reuse insights, and compaction-summary highlighting.

resources.name: ph4310822/dsh-edex-jarvis-ui#bundle
resources.desc: JARVIS-style sci-fi HUD shell over the DSH web GUI: electric-cyan VITAL SIGNS / RT-MONITOR / RT-LOG left bar, POWER CORE gauges and a rotating RADAR scan disc on the right with up/down traffic chart, filesystem browser with file preview, and a terminal-styled composer with a JARVIS header strip that follows the active workspace.

resources.name: ph4310822/dsh-edex-ui#bundle
resources.desc: eDEX-UI-style shell over the DSH web GUI: system-telemetry left bar with per-core CPU sparklines, encom-globe world-map right bar with up/down traffic chart, filesystem browser with file preview, and a terminal-styled composer that follows the active workspace.

resources.name: Phant0Meow/dsh-meow-smooth
resources.desc: Mobile-first UX polish for the DSH Web UI: composer auto-fold, enter-as-newline on phones, compact sidebar/header/settings, zoom and overscroll lock, plus approval/question/completion notifications via in-page cards, Web Push, and webhook — zero dsh changes.

resources.name: Phoeky/dsh-refresh-plugin
resources.desc: Adds F5 / Ctrl+R page reload to the DeepSeek Harness desktop web UI, which production builds lack by default (the "Reload Page" menu item and bare-F5 accelerator are development-gated). Binds soft reload (F5, Ctrl+R) and cache-busted hard reload (F5 with a modifier, Ctrl+Shift+R, appending a _dsh_refresh timestamp) through a capture-phase client key listener.

resources.name: Physicolor/dsh-lifeline
resources.desc: Right-side message navigation rail for DeepSeek Harness: per-message tick marks, hover-to-expand preview drawer, smooth jump to any historical message, star bookmarks, realtime slide animation with interrupt support, full session index with virtualization, dynamic panel avoidance, official --dsw-* token styling.

resources.name: Physicolor/dsh-ui-harmonizer
resources.desc: UI harmonizer for DeepSeek Harness: normalizes unfinished or self-contradictory official UI, reconciles style conflicts between installed plugins, and unifies the visual language via official design tokens — with live-customizable chat width, markdown font size, workspace scale, UI font stack and a rounded center-column card from Settings → General; client-only dsh bundle, zero model cost, no host side, removable without residue.

resources.name: Physicolor/dsh-widgets
resources.desc: A customizable widget rail for the right side of DeepSeek Harness: 61 cards covering session stats, tokens and cache, context, background jobs, subagents, machine metrics, OpenCode Go and Command Code quota, session cost, peak pricing and the GitHub review queue. Cards install from an in-rail market into 1-4 column grids and 2x2 or 2x4 tiles, with per-instance settings, a magnification wave under the pointer and a one-click hide. resources.name: plolpl789/dsh-raw-html
