resources.name: plyflai/dsh-ux-plus
resources.desc: A UX enhancement pack for the DSH web chat: one plugin that collects small interface conveniences, each with its own switch under Settings → UX Plus applied immediately — chat-area font size and reading width under Settings → General → Chat area, a session-row menu that copies the session ID or inherits the conversation into a new session on a chosen model, workspace and session rows ordered by recent activity with 24-hour idle auto-collapse and age labels, and settled ask_user_question cards left expanded. The switch list is generated from its own feature registry, so the pack grows as conveniences are added instead of being fixed at a count.

resources.name: pomelo-ccc/dsh-pi-composer
resources.desc: Swaps the composer's model control for a PI-Desktop style picker: a two-pane menu with search and provider grouping, a reasoning-effort slider, ArrowUp/ArrowDown prompt-history recall, and a prompt-rewrite button with undo.

resources.name: PPsz-qqq/dsh-restart-button
resources.desc: Restart button at the right end of the session header that restarts the whole client: the Windows desktop app (Electron shell and Host, through the Host's own graceful shutdown) or the dsh web server. It can wait until running turns and background jobs finish, reopens the open session afterwards with one-click continue for interrupted sessions, flags plugin updates that only take effect after a restart, and shows Host uptime and memory on hover.

resources.name: prettyfox/dsh-selection-quote-auto
resources.desc: Copies selected assistant text to the clipboard and shows a Comment chip that opens the inline comment box in DeepSeek Harness; the right-click quote menu and Cmd+L still work.

resources.name: prgrmrwy/dsh-sidebar-session-provider-icon
resources.desc: DeepSeek Harness plugin: show a provider + model icon in the sidebar for every session, updated live from the composer model selector with a last-request fallback for history sessions; aggregator routes render the provider logo with a 10px model logo in the corner.

resources.name: psychiiii/dsh-three-window#personal-web
resources.desc: Three-window workbench for dsh web: chat, construct, and a read-only review window side by side for each workspace, per-window hooks, and an anonymous multi-model review that asks before it runs, groups findings by issue, and reports in Markdown.

resources.name: Pudge1996/dsh-composer-stretch
resources.desc: Expand button for the DSH Web UI composer — appears at 3+ lines, stretches to near-fullscreen height, auto-collapses on send, and inserts a newline on Enter or Shift+Enter in expanded mode while Cmd/Ctrl+Enter sends.

resources.name: pure-craft/dsh-actions
resources.desc: Deterministic project actions shared by people and agents: one actions.json, a right-sidebar run panel, and agent tools.

resources.name: pure-craft/dsh-capability-panel
resources.desc: Manage MCP servers, skills, and tools for your agent — true in-context state (loaded/truncated/evicted) and per-session switches.

resources.name: pyf2818/dsh-bili-widget
resources.desc: Floating Bilibili video mini-player for DSH — always-on-top window with discover/search/follow-UP channels, auto-playlist, mini & focus modes, persisted watch history and window minimize-to-ball.

resources.name: python3603/dsh-weather-panel
resources.desc: Sidebar weather panel: current conditions, 5-day and 24-hour forecasts, an hourly rain chart, temperature history, CMA alerts with graded reminders and county-level matching, a radar mosaic, FY-4B satellite imagery, typhoon tracks, and ECMWF / NW Pacific sea surface temperature charts.

resources.name: Qcsj777/dsh-process-panel
resources.desc: Adds a per-answer Process drawer that streams, in Simplified Chinese, the agent thinking, tool calls and errors for that turn.

resources.name: QDNBD/dsh-panel-pins
resources.desc: Sidebar panel management for DeepSeek Harness: a grouped Panels launcher collects global panel rows and third-party plugin entry rows into one menu (clicks the original buttons), with persistent pin/unpin, a capped scrollable panel list, a toggleable compact footer, and a full Settings page — height sliders, a keep-in-place whitelist and bidirectional pin management.

resources.name: qgd1850890306-rgb/dsh-todo-checklist
resources.desc: Todo sidecar for DeepSeek Harness: turn selected text into a todo, capture todos from a conversation, review them in a left sidebar panel, get due reminders as an in-app popup or an IM bot message, and export everything to HTML, Markdown, Excel, CSV or JSON.

resources.name: qgx1992/dsh-ui-tools
resources.desc: Five web UI tools in one plugin: a provider + model two-button selector with reasoning-level control, collapse/expand-all for sidebar workspace groups, a session tab listing the files the session changed (needs kernel 0.1.2-alpha.1+, silently absent on older kernels), a workspace badge next to the session title, and a settings page that toggles them.

resources.name: qgynisc/dsh-inline-pastes
resources.desc: Inline image chips for the DeepSeek Harness composer — paste an image and it lands in the text as a numbered chip (image-1.png) with hover preview. Images still ship through the official attachment pipeline, names restart per message, the dock and sent-message thumbnails carry a sequence badge, and a pre-send self-check warns when the names in the text no longer match the images in that message.

resources.name: QianLuo-Ly/dsh-weather
resources.desc: Top-centered weather bar for the DSH Web UI: geolocation, current conditions, 12h/7d forecasts and severe-weather notifications via Open-Meteo (free, no API key).

resources.name: QiaoSchoco/dsh-lit-shot
resources.desc: Screenshot button for the DSH composer on Windows: drag a region over the frozen screen and the picture lands in the draft as a normal image attachment, with a global hotkey and an editable shortcut.

resources.name: qichuang321/dsh-web-terminal
resources.desc: Windows terminal dock inside the DSH web GUI. It is the occupant of the shipped shell.bottom slot: showing it splits the screen (the columns shrink instead of being covered), hiding it returns the space and keeps the PTY session alive. Each session is a local ConPTY child spawned through node-pty and rendered by xterm.js over a loopback-fenced WebSocket (backpressure, debounced resize). Other plugins can add terminal or DOM views through a host registerView API and a window CustomEvent channel.

resources.name: qinpeizhan77/deepseek-harness-novel-studio
resources.desc: Local-first fiction workspace that links outlines, chapters, characters, timelines, writing rules, and continuity checks to the conversation.

resources.name: qipengxiang/dsh-chat-actions
resources.desc: Hide or show each button under an assistant reply, reorder them by dragging, and collect the hidden ones behind a single ⋯ button.

resources.name: qipengxiang/dsh-enter-combination
resources.desc: Rebind which key sends a message and which key starts a new line in the DeepSeek Harness composer; Enter sends and Cmd/Ctrl+Enter breaks the line by default, and either chord can be re-recorded from a settings page.

resources.name: qipengxiang/dsh-message-quote
resources.desc: Quote any message of the current conversation into the composer: pick one from the @ menu, click the quote button on a user or assistant message, or select text and use Quote in the right-click menu. Quotes show as numbered chips in the composer and as summary bubbles above it; after sending, each quote becomes a fenced block so the model can tell quoted text from new text.

resources.name: QIRSHENG/dsh-tray-restart
resources.desc: Adds Restart App and Host, Reload Page and Force Quit items to the Windows system tray of the official DSH desktop app by patching app.asar in place, and re-applies that patch after each desktop update.

resources.name: QIUZAIYOU/dsh-composer-rewind
resources.desc: Composer history that restores the whole input state: composer contents, image and file attachments, @ references and slash commands, plus the model, thinking effort, permission and agent preset used.

resources.name: qiweiii/dsh-brand-studio
resources.desc: Custom branding for the shared DSH Web UI: a Settings → Branding panel for the name, badge, and local logo/wordmark images with size and rounding, live preview, optional page-title brand, and reset to the official look.

resources.name: qjcnmd/dsh-reasoning-slider
resources.desc: Codex-style reasoning-effort slider embedded in the model selector.

resources.name: qrxf/dsh-workspace-graph
resources.desc: Draggable bubble graph of DeepSeek Harness workspaces and sessions in the Web UI: workspaces are large bubbles, sessions are small ones, and lines show real membership. The canvas supports pan, zoom and fit; filters cover workspace, status, type and archive state; search covers workspace names, paths and session titles; native actions open or create sessions, rename workspaces, and archive or restore sessions. Layouts are saved in the browser.

resources.name: qt9494/dsh-seeyon-workbench
resources.desc: Seeyon workbench that mounts OA to-dos and meetings, the skill catalog, and one-click aTrust VPN in one panel. Its vendored modules replace the author's dsh-seeyon-todo, dsh-skillhub and dsh-vpn — install this bundle or those plugins, not both. Requires a Seeyon OA account; the VPN part is Windows-only and needs the Sangfor aTrust client.

resources.name: Quinn2006/dsh-guise
resources.desc: Persona wardrobe for DeepSeek Harness: save multiple personas, apply them globally or per workspace, with a master switch, an adjustable API balance guard, and a lazy token-loving tired mode that speaks on the agent's behalf when quota runs out. Files-as-config, hot reload, zero dependencies.

resources.name: Qulierm/dsh-macos-settings-shortcut
resources.desc: Restores Cmd+, to open the existing Settings dialog in DeepSeek Harness on macOS.

resources.name: qwert702/dsh-auto-translate
resources.desc: Full-pipeline Chinese translation for the dsh web GUI: live translation of the model reasoning as it streams, in-place Chinese below each English reply, and one-line Chinese summaries for tool outputs and tool-call glosses — a standalone provider request that never enters the session transcript.

resources.name: qwerty-k-de/dsh-attach-picker
resources.desc: Toolbar picture button in the DSH Web composer: click to pick multiple images through the native file dialog — they join the same draft-image rail as drag-and-drop and paste, with the host image-format, per-message-count and per-image-size limits enforced inline.

resources.name: qwh15622336051/dsh-prompt-optimizer
resources.desc: Rewrites the composer draft into a precise prompt with a configurable model and a fully editable rewriting instruction; reads the content behind @file, @folder and @session references for context and keeps the reference chips intact; offers a one-click undo that restores the text you wrote yourself, and places the button in either composer toolbar with an adjustable colour and size.

resources.name: qwq-wny/dsh-eta-forecast
resources.desc: Adds an ETA widget to the DSH web and desktop UI that estimates when the current turn will finish from the todo list and step pace, and shows the remaining time, a progress bar and a confidence badge.

resources.name: qwq1999/dsh-panellist
resources.desc: Panellist manager: reorder the entries on the left rail, rename them, replace their icons, hide them, and fold several into a Group with a flyout menu, from a Settings tab.

resources.name: qys0012/dsh-hotspots
resources.desc: Real-time hot topics panel for the DSH web GUI: AI news and engineering news, each item with a distilled summary and the source link, shown from a sidebar entry with three views, keyword/source filters, read-state marking and hotkeys.

resources.name: qyw233/dsh-deeplink
resources.desc: Deep links: open a specific session or workspace via ?session= / ?workspace=.

resources.name: qzz19970504/dsh-model-picker-control
resources.desc: Model picker control for the DSH composer: a settings section beside the built-in Models page renames model display names and provider group names, adds a short coloured suffix capsule after a name, groups models from different providers into a new partition, reorders provider groups by drag or keyboard, sorts models inside a group by catalog order or name, and hides a provider or a single model without removing it from the catalog. Edits stay in a draft until you press Save, and the built-in 1017 tag and a custom capsule can be shown side by side.

resources.name: Rabbit-bot-No-002/dsh-chat-avatar
resources.desc: Adds an avatar to the left of each turn's final AI reply and to the right of each user message; upload your own image and set its size and circle or square frame.

resources.name: RadicalGitter/dsh-ui-translate
resources.desc: Translates visible Chinese UI and content in DeepSeek Harness Web, using a browser-local OPUS-MT model for session titles, workspace names, messages, search results, and opted-in plugin prose while keeping remote translation limited to allowlisted UI labels.

resources.name: RAFOLIE/dsh-desktop-windowos
resources.desc: Windows tray desktop shell: auto-installs and auto-updates the exe from GitHub Releases, creates desktop shortcuts for both the app and the web UI, and exposes a desktop_launch tool to start it from the conversation.

resources.name: Ragnoryok1/dsh-client-locale-ru
resources.desc: Russian for the dsh web GUI: the whole interface plus the menus of 520 third-party plugins — 584 sections, 67,666 strings.

resources.name: RAK7S/dsh-task-tree
resources.desc: A draggable task-tree panel inside the chat page: capture tasks by voice or text, drag to reorder, edge-snapping collapse, and a plain-text queue file you can edit or version yourself.

resources.name: RAK7S/dsh-weather-whisper
resources.desc: Weather card once per session: remembers your home city so a VPN never moves it, inline city picker, theme presets, custom separators, optional TTS hook for third-party voices.

resources.name: Rakanrkk/dsh-sidebar-scroll
resources.desc: Scrolls DSH sidebar navigation and project/conversation lists together while keeping the header and account footer fixed (DSH 0.2.1-rc.3).

resources.name: rakibulrocky14/dsh-cli
resources.desc: Full-screen terminal TUI for DeepSeek Harness with Web-GUI parity, live streaming, agent presets, and DeepSeek blue styling.

resources.name: ramwin/dsh-workspace-tree-status

resources.name: rans725/dsh-workspace-ranswork

resources.name: Raphaelutumn/dsh-mood

resources.name: Ratevoid/dsh-aseprite
resources.desc: A browser pixel-art and sprite animation editor with Aseprite-compatible files, local crop/outline blueprints, and optional LLM workflow nodes.

resources.name: RaulLazaro/dsh-preview-plugin
resources.desc: Live preview tab for DSH — embed any dev server in an iframe with transparent SPA proxying.

resources.name: raven3005672/dsh-plugin-highlight-notes
resources.desc: Highlight or quote any passage of an answer, attach a note to it, then send the excerpt back to the composer as a quoted instruction.

resources.name: rayafriandion/dsh-oc-tui
resources.desc: An opencode-inspired terminal UI for DeepSeek Harness that boots as a dsh profile app plugin, with a session sidebar, streaming chat, markdown tool cards, todo lists, slash-command suggestions, a telemetry footer with a context meter and inline approval prompts.

resources.name: RCYD857/857-dsh-file-attach
resources.desc: Drag or paste files or pictures into the DSH Web composer as one scrolling row of chips, sent as @path references.

resources.name: ReachGa0/dsh-desktop#plugin
resources.desc: DSH plugin (dsh-desktop-launcher) that launches the dsh-desktop Windows Electron shell from the conversation: double-click to run the DSH web in a standalone window, region screenshot with GPU-accelerated selection that auto-pastes into the chat (works with vision bridges), system tray, session manager, auto environment setup, configurable port, single-instance lock.

resources.name: realguan/dsh-deepseek-chat-embed
resources.desc: Embeds chat.deepseek.com directly inside DeepSeek Harness desktop with persistent login sessions and dual-entry chat panels.

resources.name: realguan/dsh-mermaid-preview
resources.desc: Render Mermaid fenced code blocks as native diagram cards with 8 design-system themes and adaptive layout.

resources.name: realhacker/dsh-theme-colorizer
resources.desc: A Deepseek Harness plugin that gives its UI color themes.

resources.name: REALOIYO/dsh-ember
resources.desc: Composer UI for DeepSeek Harness that does two things. The reasoning-effort row in the model menu becomes a continuous slider drawn on the row itself, with the rungs read live from the model adapter so any ladder length works; each rung paints its own ember plume into a canvas behind the knob. Separately, the permission trigger renders in the theme error colour whenever full access is the active preset, including its row in the permission menu.

resources.name: REALOIYO/dsh-settings-button
resources.desc: Adds a gear button beside the sidebar account row that opens the Settings panel in one click. It runs the host's own settings.open command, so it reaches the shell store directly instead of going through the account menu, and the behaviour is identical on desktop and on a phone over the LAN where no keyboard shortcut is available.

resources.name: redfox-data/redfox-skill-gallery
resources.desc: Adds a sidebar entry that opens a card gallery of all Red Fox Community skills from the redfox-community-dsh plugin.

resources.name: reg4916/dsh-bar#plugin
resources.desc: Host plugin for the macOS menu bar companion: live DeepSeek Harness session state, Approve/Deny for tool approvals, stop the current turn, open the exact session. The native app is a free universal build in GitHub Releases.

resources.name: regrevia/dsh-chat-link-actions
resources.desc: Right-click any attachment or path in the transcript and hand it to your own action: send it to a WeChat contact, open it in Chrome, or anything else you configure — one right-click, anything you want. Ships with quote-into-composer, reveal in the OS file manager, copy path and Send to…, and lets you add your own entries (command, open with, shortcut, link, PowerShell). Menus are drawn in the app's own style, never the system one.

resources.name: regrevia/dsh-vantage
resources.desc: A read-only overview tab beside the conversation: what this round asked, what was observed, what still needs checking, and a bounded history you can step through round by round.

resources.name: renat3u/dsh-web-archive
resources.desc: Collapse noisy messages (Think, Bash, etc.) in conversations.

resources.name: researchrepo-backup/dsh-countup-pomodoro
resources.desc: Count-up Pomodoro: focus counts up with no ceiling and never stops itself at 25 minutes, finishing drops straight into a short break, and a status board plus the four quadrants keep the task list in view.

resources.name: rex178178/dsh-turnbar
resources.desc: Video-style turn navigation for the Web UI: full-map progress bar with hover preview cards (tools/files/tokens), drag scrub, ⌘K in-conversation search, ⌘↑/⌘↓ stepping, Esc-return. Event-log powered — works beyond the loaded window. Dual-half plugin on the official composer.dock slot.

resources.name: rezon-aki/dsh-streamfold
resources.desc: Streaming fold for the DSH web transcript: the newest thinking window opens itself, older process rows fold into one summary, and a finished turn glides back to your prompt, which stays pinned while you read.

resources.name: rg2304luyue/dsh-pa
resources.desc: A diamond button in the composer that rewrites your draft into a structured prompt and puts the original draft back when clicked again.

resources.name: Ri0n72Y/dsh-workspace-scope
resources.desc: Per-workspace Skill and MCP enablement for DeepSeek Harness: control which skills and MCP servers new sessions load, per project.

resources.name: Rice00/dsh-job-progress
resources.desc: Live progress for long-running background jobs in the DSH web GUI: a draggable floating ball in the session that owns the job, expanding into a panel with done/total, speed and ETA.

resources.name: Rice00/dsh-loupe
resources.desc: Explain a selected word or sentence from a DSH conversation in a floating window: a channel of its own that leaves the session untouched, and the answer can be pinned to a session of its own.

resources.name: Rick1125/dsh-beads-viewer
resources.desc: Beads issue browser in the right sidebar: filter and search the tracker with live ready and waiting counts, read issue Markdown with clickable project-file and issue links, and copy or insert the issue id. Requires the bd CLI on PATH and a project with a Beads workspace.

resources.name: Ricketts-Guo/dsh-shortcuts
resources.desc: Fully customizable keyboard shortcuts for the Web UI: 34 pre-registered features (sessions, views, clipboard, models, silent permission cycling, settings), one-click recording to bind your own, and a shortcut cheatsheet with built-in diagnostics.

resources.name: riesbri/dshline#dshline
resources.desc: Terminal-native TUI frontend for DeepSeek Harness that presents sessions, models, plugins, jobs, subagents, todos, and provider configuration through Harness capabilities while preserving real terminal scrollback.

resources.name: rinsoraa/dsh-pulse-rail
resources.desc: Turns the DSH turn-navigation rail into a music visualiser: each thin bar grows and thickens with its own frequency band, from system audio captured with WASAPI loopback. Geometry only, no colour or glow, and the rail keeps its native hover preview, click-to-jump and wheel scrolling.

resources.name: rivenshanghai/dsh-toomuch-plugins
resources.desc: Collapses the global panel entries above the workspace in the DSH Web sidebar into a single toggle in the sidebar footer.

resources.name: romany-saad/dsh-plugins#dsh-drafts
resources.desc: Get back what you typed and walked away from: a new Web conversation you leave before sending never appears in the sidebar, so its draft is out of reach. This plugin lists those drafts above the composer of the next new conversation, newest first, with their workspace and time; Open takes you back with the text and chips in place, and Discard drops one, with Undo.

resources.name: rsbsnv/dsh-mobile-adapt
resources.desc: Mobile layer for DSH Web: swipe-gesture drawer sidebar with adjustable width, layered back key, bigger tap targets, Enter inserts a newline instead of sending, keyboard avoidance and a 15px font floor.

resources.name: ruaibeite/dsh-files-to-chat
resources.desc: Right-click a file or folder in the right sidebar file tree to add it to the composer as an @ reference (⌘/Ctrl and Shift multi-select insert a whole batch), open it with the default application, or reveal it in the system file manager. Open and reveal go through the built-in open-in-app host capability, so those entries appear unless the host explicitly reports the capability as unsupported.

resources.name: ruaibeite/dsh-input-polish
resources.desc: A polish button in the composer trailing controls that rewrites the draft in place with the model. Context is matched by topic, not by recency: anchors from the draft (paths, identifiers, quoted text, CJK bigrams) pick the earlier messages about the same task, so a session that interleaves several tasks does not leak another task goal or files into the rewrite — and the prompt explicitly lets the model ignore the extract when it does not fit. The result goes back through the same undo-able editor path a human edit uses. Drafts holding reference chips (@file, folder, session) or a claimed /command, and drafts mid-submission, disable the button instead of silently dropping references.

resources.name: ruanimal/dsh-sidebar-panel-buttons
resources.desc: Collapses the DSH Web sidebar panel menu (plugins, extensions, scheduled tasks, IM) from a vertical labelled list into a horizontal row of 36×36 icon buttons with hover tooltips; a Settings → General option switches back to the list and is remembered per browser.

resources.name: Rudyy898/dsh-drag-path
resources.desc: Like Codex/Claude Code: drag any file or folder (no format limit) onto the DSH web page and its real absolute path is inserted into the composer instantly — no typing paths by hand. Workspace-first smart lookup, size checks, same-name picker, batch and clipboard paste support, Windows/macOS.

resources.name: Ruiming-cn/dsh-ask-in-sidebar
resources.desc: Ask a sidebar assistant about selected assistant text: an ephemeral right-side panel answers from a snapshot of the main conversation's LLM history with streaming Markdown, collapsible thinking and multi-turn follow-ups, without touching the main conversation.

resources.name: Ruiming-cn/dsh-better-at
resources.desc: Fast @ file/session reference caching for the DSH Web GUI: preloaded indexes, browser-local keystroke filtering and native mention serialization.

resources.name: ruisenbai/dsh-turn-fold
resources.desc: Folds streaming reasoning and tool calls into collapsed step bars and collapses each finished turn into a single summary bar; step bars show native tool icons, filenames, edited line counts, and failure counts, finished turns restore duration, first-token time, token usage, generation speed, and cache hit metrics from recorded Session events, and preferences persist on the Host. Changes browser presentation only. Requires DSH 0.1.5-alpha.1.

resources.name: ruiyukirin/dsh-prompt-optimization-master
resources.desc: Adds a button to the composer that rewrites the unsent draft into a clearer, more specific prompt, with one-click restore, a settings page and an optional per-request model override.

resources.name: runcat-tommy/dsh-chinese-poetry
resources.desc: Token-free Chinese classical poetry tab in the DSH conversation view with search, filters, 飞花令, daily poem, favorites, festival topics and a share-card image; AI explanation reuses your own DSH session.

resources.name: runcat-tommy/dsh-panda-calendar
resources.desc: A conversation-view tab for DeepSeek Harness Web showing solar/lunar dates, ganzhi year/month/day, Chinese zodiac, 24 solar terms, festivals, China public holidays including make-up workdays, multi-city weather, an epoch↔date timestamp converter with a time-zone picker, and bundled offline "on this day" history from free sources without an API key.

resources.name: runcat-tommy/dsh-view-manager
resources.desc: View tab manager for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI session header: enable, hide, reorder and rename the conversation view tabs (Chat / Trajectory), with locale-aware zh/en copy and npm update reminders.

resources.name: Ryuu-64/dsh-find-all
resources.desc: Search titles and saved text across ordinary DeepSeek Harness (DSH) conversations in all workspaces, optionally including archived chats, with Ctrl+F / Cmd+F search inside the current conversation.

resources.name: S-anZZz/dsh-deepseek-web-sync
resources.desc: Desktop only. DeepSeek Web in the Harness right Sidebar with synchronized theme, automatic launch, one-time web sign-in, and one-click question transfer.

resources.name: s3yf1337/dsh-desktop#bundle
resources.desc: Desktop profile for dsh: native Tauri window over the harness web surface with tray, native notifications, a file-manager panel, and one-click updates.

resources.name: SA1992X/dsh-ctrl-enter-submit
resources.desc: Makes plain Enter insert a newline in the composer and Ctrl/Cmd+Enter submit, toggleable in settings.

resources.name: sailoumili/dsh-file-opener
resources.desc: Turns file and directory paths in DSH chat into clickable buttons: click one to preview the file in the right sidebar, or open it with the system default application.

resources.name: sailoumili/dsh-sidebar-plus
resources.desc: A file-view enhancement plugin that extends the official DSH sidebar, providing source view, in-place editing, line number display, search, and font zoom.

resources.name: Saknutella/dsh-thinking-quips
resources.desc: Personalises the DSH running-turn status line: rotating bilingual quips, a configurable animated loading icon (5 styles x 3 sizes) and one-click matching to the active theme colour, all in a General-settings panel, plus a # Chinese / # English sectioned quips editor. Ships with no dependencies, no build step and no config file.

resources.name: sakuraqqq/dsh-auto-paste
resources.desc: Auto-saves large pasted text as an attachment file in the DeepSeek Harness web input box; with dsh-better-sidebar installed, the paste pill opens the file in the sidebar editor and saves it back.

resources.name: Sama05/dsh-download-progress
resources.desc: Shows download, install, fetch and search progress in a floating overlay or in a compact chip above the composer, and lists background jobs that have no progress to draw.

resources.name: samsam560/chat-share-card
resources.desc: Turn any DeepSeek Harness answer into a polished PNG share card: click a button under the reply, the answer is re-typeset on a canvas (8 gradient presets, light/dark, three fonts, width 720/880/1080, radius, padding, font size, line height, 1x-3x export, code wrap/highlight/line numbers, custom title and footer). Fully local rendering — no upload, no third-party dependency.

resources.name: samsam560/dog-kjdh
resources.desc: Splash and exit animations for DeepSeek Harness. Five hand-drawn styles (whale light-sweep, pulse, stardust, typewriter, radar rings) — or drop in your own video / GIF. A settings panel controls speed, particle count, accent colour, wording, mute and fit. The exit animation needs the bundled one-time desktop-shell patch (node tools/patch-asar.mjs --apply, reversible); without it closing only hides the window.

resources.name: sanlisanxun/dsh-plugin-nickname
resources.desc: Custom Chinese nicknames for dsh plugins, displayed directly in the native plugin list.

resources.name: Sanqi-normal/dsh-model-picker
resources.desc: Provider-tabbed model picker for the dsh web composer: left provider column and right model list, both independently scrollable, with cross-provider search.

resources.name: sanqiPanax/dsh-sticker-board
resources.desc: Fridge-magnet quick-task stickers docked above the composer: one-click sends a preloaded prompt into the current session, grouped long-term/short-term.

resources.name: sanshanya/better-model-provider
resources.desc: Settings page for per-model capabilities: reasoning-effort levels with their wire spellings, input modalities, and token capacities, written as declarations or sparse catalog overrides.

resources.name: SanYe-SanJiu/dsh-power-switch
resources.desc: Windows-only process control for the harness: a sidebar button that shuts DSH down through the host's own graceful exit path, an app-window / normal-tab switch on the Plugins card that rewrites the desktop shortcut and restarts, and advanced settings for the wait before exit, the process exit code and a force-quit option.

resources.name: Saretheya/dsh-settings-nav-order
resources.desc: Reorder the settings panel nav by long-pressing and dragging a section: the dragged row turns translucent and follows the pointer, the order is saved to the plugin's own folder, and uninstalling restores the official order.

resources.name: sbVAN/dsh-latex
resources.desc: Renders latex / tex code blocks in the chat as KaTeX formulae, and injects a system-prompt section that tells the model to write $...$ and $$...$$ instead of fenced code blocks.

resources.name: scottzx/feature-blueprint
resources.desc: Adds mind maps and an Excalidraw canvas to the DSH sidebar, with local blueprint-file editing, Excalidraw file previews and standalone CLIs.

resources.name: secyborg/dsh-find-bar
resources.desc: Browser-style in-page find bar (Cmd/Ctrl+F) for the desktop app, with highlight-all, a match counter, and a scope picker for the conversation or the right panel.

resources.name: seeingrain/dsh-media-inline-preview
resources.desc: All-in-one inline media previewer for mip-img/mip-video/mip-audio fences with streaming playback, ffmpeg transcoding fallback, lightbox, and trust-fenced LAN/mobile access.

resources.name: seeingrain/dsh-upload-file
resources.desc: Upload any file to DSH, isolated per workspace and session — a composer file library with server-side thumbnails and a context menu to open, copy, re-download or delete.

resources.name: Semidia/dsh-sampling-sliders
resources.desc: Model sampling sliders (temperature / maxTokens) in the composer: override every model request for all providers via the agent/request hook, with hot/persist modes.

resources.name: senyayume/dsh-edit-diff
resources.desc: Redraws line-level diffs on edit, write, insert and str_replace_editor tool cards — unchanged lines render once and changed characters are underlined — covers run_code (PTC) sub-calls, adds a per-turn changed-files card, and opens or copies any of those paths from the card rows and the tool rows through a host route the plugin serves itself.

resources.name: sereinmono/dsh-desktop-pet
resources.desc: A plugin that adds a desktop pet to your DeepSeek Harness, supporting the Codex pet format, you can use hatch-pet or Petdex to add your pets.

resources.name: SereneJi/dsh-host-paths
resources.desc: Publishes the desktop shell's file-path bridge as the host-path seam the composer reads, so files and folders dropped into the composer become @path references instead of uploaded copies (images still upload through the native image channel).

resources.name: sevenhsu7/dsh-codex-like-markdown
resources.desc: In-place Markdown editing for the right-sidebar document preview: a file keeps the shipped renderer's look, clicking a paragraph, heading, list, fence, or table cell puts the caret exactly where you clicked, and only the edited range is written back through ctx.fs.writeText, optionally guarded by the version it read.

resources.name: SeverusZh/dsh-skills-mcp-group-manager
resources.desc: Group installed skills and manage MCP servers from a left-panel UI: filter the model skill catalog by enabled groups (union-deduped) and toggle MCP servers independently.

resources.name: Sevyn-Star/dsh-receipt
resources.desc: Adds a corner card that estimates how much a session spent repeating a failed or empty tool call with the same arguments.

resources.name: SHAN5246992ZHUI/dsh-select-translate
resources.desc: Select text in any Windows app and read the translation in an always-on-top card next to the cursor: streaming text follows the newest line, up to 15000 characters per request. Windows only.

resources.name: shengyvself/dsh-reading-pad
resources.desc: Immersive read-only reading panel for DSH — the model delivers pre-formatted Markdown to a native right-sidebar tab via reading_pad_send, with three low-blue-light themes and 30em measure typography; also browse manuscript chapters read-only.

resources.name: shenj13/dsh-book-library
resources.desc: Read books in the DSH sidebar - import EPUB/TXT/Markdown, get a five-part close reading for every chapter (paragraph summary, best sentences, what the author is doing, the AI's own opinion, what is missing), listen with TTS, ask questions while listening, and export the whole book to one HTML page. Export collects the chapters that already have a close reading rather than unread chapters.

resources.name: SherUnlocked-4869/dsh-plugin-msg-nav
resources.desc: Conversation node navigation rail for the DSH Web UI: one dash per user message on the right edge, reading-position tracking, hover preview card, click-to-jump with highlight line, sliding window, and auto-hide.

resources.name: shijiacheng520/dsh-skill-groups
resources.desc: Grouped skill picker for the composer. A button beside the input box opens a panel that browses every installed skill by scene (research, office, data, writing, media, dev), with auto-classification for new skills, Chinese annotations, search and drill-down; picking one inserts the /skill-name gesture.

resources.name: shimingming520/dsh-conversation-process-collapse
resources.desc: Collapses each settled turn's process rows into one expandable disclosure in the DeepSeek Harness Web conversation while keeping the final answer visible.

resources.name: shinelon/dsh-mcp-plugin
resources.desc: Manage DSH MCP servers from the web settings panel: list, add, edit, remove, enable/disable with live status.

resources.name: shinelon/dsh-mermaid-plugin
resources.desc: Renders mermaid code blocks in DSH Web chat as SVG diagrams, with a diagram/source toggle, light/dark theme following and source-preserving error fallback.

resources.name: shinelon/dsh-workspace-group-plugin
resources.desc: Custom sidebar workspace groups for DeepSeek Harness - group directories, drag to regroup and reorder, per-group session browsing and content search, with a one-click fallback to the official workspace list.

resources.name: shuuul/dsh-bioviewer
resources.desc: Registers Mol* file viewers with dsh-better-sidebar for PDB, mmCIF, MRC maps, small molecules and Chimera .cmm markers, including .gz, with a BioViewer workspace tab and bio_open / bio_add tools.

resources.name: shyuan-hub/dsh-compact-button
resources.desc: Adds a Compact context button and a New session button to the context meter panel; compact submits /compact through the same command channel, and new session starts a fresh session in the same workspace.

resources.name: shZhang1614/dsh-float-lamp
resources.desc: Windows floating status lamp outside the DSH window: a borderless always-on-top glowing orb on a fully transparent background — green with a breathing halo while tasks run, orange shaking for approval, blue floating for your input, dim grey idle, dark grey host offline; hovering lists each session's latest task, drag to move, and the lamp self-extinguishes within seconds when the plugin is switched off.

resources.name: siberiah2o/dsh-plugin-terminal
resources.desc: Bottom multi-tab terminal panel (node-pty + xterm.js) pinned to the viewport bottom, always below the input box.

resources.name: simmon-clap/dsh-intelligent-ui
resources.desc: Renders model answers as interactive cards inside DeepSeek Harness chat, with 24 whitelisted components and persistent turn cards.

resources.name: SiriLee/dsh-approval-hotkeys
resources.desc: Panel hotkeys for the web UI: Enter presses the confirm action and Esc presses the cancel action on every interaction panel (approval, question, plan review).

resources.name: sixzjd/dsh-folder-attach
resources.desc: Drag folders into the DeepSeek Harness web composer instead of hitting 'only the desktop app supports folders'. Adds a host folder dialog, /folder, and drag/paste into @path mentions. Plain browser, no desktop app.

resources.name: sjrslh/dsh-ui-zoom
resources.desc: Ctrl+wheel page zoom (60–180%, remembered) for the whole DSH UI, plus a bottom-right Settings entry that opens the host settings panel, with Ctrl+0 to reset.

resources.name: SkyblueeeLabs/dsh-iconic-launcher
resources.desc: Customize the DeepSeek Harness desktop shortcut icon: pick a preset or upload an image, auto-remove the white backdrop, build a multi-size ICO, and write the shortcut in one click.

resources.name: skyhancloud/dsh-client-ui-quote
resources.desc: Adds a removable quote banner above the web chat composer for text selected from an AI reply, included in the next message.

resources.name: skyline66/dsh-desktop-clock
resources.desc: A draggable floating clock for the DSH Web GUI with analog and digital faces, a focus timer, four themes, and persistent placement.

resources.name: SmailPang/dsh-effort-slider
resources.desc: Replaces the native DSH reasoning-level option list in place with a draggable Off, Low, High, and Max slider while preserving the official model-selection flow.

resources.name: SmileBuild/dsh-planchart
resources.desc: Publishes a project plan the agent writes: ordered steps in a panel docked to the right of the frame, and the framework graph as an auto-laid-out diagram in its own centre tab, downloadable as SVG or PNG. Charts are rebuilt from the session log, so they survive restart and resume.

resources.name: smj-1680/dsh-plugin-liquid-glass
resources.desc: A liquid glass UI plugin for the DSH desktop app. Works alongside most wallpaper plugins. Currently supports dark mode only.

resources.name: SMSMy/dsh-arabic
resources.desc: Bidi-safe RTL rendering for mixed Arabic and English text, a full Arabic interface pack (3,307 strings) registered through the DSH locale service, and three thmanyah cuts — Sans for the interface, Serif Text for reading, Serif Display for headings — placed behind whatever font the app itself is set to.

resources.name: SnowCrescenter-tech/dsh-milestone
resources.desc: Git-style dot timeline on the right edge of the DSH web UI: one dot per user message, hover for content and metadata (time, turn, duration, TTFT, tokens), click to jump. Also adds a full-session message list, in-session and cross-session search, bookmarks with #msg= deep links, and keyboard navigation.

resources.name: snowowowo/dsh-manim-card
resources.desc: Adds a manim_card tool that renders Manim Python into a playable animation card in the chat stream; the code runs in the browser on a bundled runtime, so no local Python is needed, and video export goes through the local Manim CLI when installed or frame by frame in the browser otherwise.

resources.name: Sodapopper-pixel/dsh-cot-translator-plus
resources.desc: Reasoning translation for the DSH Web UI: template HTTP translation sites, or a model route through a Harness-registered provider or a custom OpenAI-compatible provider declared in the plugin.

resources.name: SOH4C4759/dsh-ui-sound
resources.desc: Audible feedback for the DSH web interface: button presses are classified by semantics (normal, primary, toggle, send, close, danger, link) and the current session's task transitions (started, finished, failed) plus any pending interaction play a cue, each scenario with its own cue picker and switch on a settings page. All 78 cues and 12 sound packs are synthesised in the browser with the Web Audio API, so the package ships no audio files and makes no network request. A community port of dsh-plugin-uisfx to DSH 0.2.0, with the ported changes recorded in PROVENANCE.md.

resources.name: Somnus678/dsh-input-assistant
resources.desc: Prompt optimization, next-sentence prediction, inline completion, and per-session draft stashing for the DSH input box.

resources.name: SongMiao-tech/dsh-prompt-optimizer
resources.desc: Optimize Prompt button under the composer: one click rewrites your draft into a clearer, more executable prompt, with a before-and-after dialog and one-click replacement.

resources.name: songoao25/dsh-bottom-info-bar#plugin
resources.desc: Bottom info bar for the DSH Web UI: provider/model, live balance, peak/off-peak pricing with countdown, and real persisted per-session spend in a single line.

resources.name: songshuhuoban/dsh-next-input
resources.desc: Suggests the next user reply in an empty composer after the assistant finishes, using the session model and rolling context summaries, with Tab to accept.

resources.name: SouthernSibyl/dsh-quick-prompt
resources.desc: Adds a composer button that rewrites the current draft into a precise prompt in place, in one click, with a revert action.

resources.name: southsnowL/dsh-bulletin#dsh-bulletin-panel
resources.desc: Sidebar panel for the announcement file and the ticket status table. It lists the announcements together with how many sessions have seen each one, shows the delivery status, and lets the user post, edit and delete entries. Requires the third-party dsh-better-sidebar plugin.

resources.name: SOVLOOKUP/dsh-cloud-download
resources.desc: Adds download actions to DSH delivery cards, changed-file review, and the document preview, and hides native open controls that cannot work when the Host is remote or headless. Needs DSH Web; the native open controls are hidden by default and can be restored per browser.

resources.name: SOVLOOKUP/dsh-settings-footer
resources.desc: Moves Settings out of the sidebar footer account menu into its own row at the top of the sidebar, hides the 新会话 new-session button, and hides the sidebar footer: the account launcher, the footer settings cell, and the plugin-runtime badge. Cmd/Ctrl+N still starts a session and Settings is still reachable.

resources.name: spidu-lee/dsh-refresh
resources.desc: Make F5, Ctrl+F5, and Ctrl+Shift+R reload the DeepSeek Harness page.

resources.name: SpookySandwich/dsh-plugin-smooth-stream
resources.desc: Better streaming text animation for DeepSeek Harness.

resources.name: sqfcyily/dsh-workspace-files

resources.name: Stylelinzzz/dsh-chat-history
resources.desc: Adds a "History" conversation view tab listing the session's user messages as a clickable directory, with auto-paging and click-to-jump back into the chat.

resources.name: sueqet/dsh-todo-board
resources.desc: Cross-session TODO board as a draggable floating panel: tasks are grouped by working directory and reorderable by drag, each one carries a run mode (remind only, continue in the current session, or open a new session in the same directory), up to four attached images sent to the model as real image attachments, and an optional local time it may run at; two checkboxes track AI-done and user-verified, and the agent picks up the next unfinished task in that directory when it finishes one.

resources.name: Suibianlilili/dsh-always-on-top

resources.name: sujalmandal/dsh-tab-plan-toggle

resources.name: sunnystarye-ui/dsh-plugin-text-quote

resources.name: suntianc/dsh-ui-settings-icons

resources.name: VanlxyG/dsh-hover-sidebar
