resources.name: weimingyu9312/DSHSwitch
resources.desc: Adds customizable switch shortcut buttons to the left of the DSH Web GUI chat input for one-click slash-command insertion.

resources.name: weiYe-exployer/dsh-model-picker-2level
resources.desc: Two-level model picker for the DeepSeek Harness composer: browse providers, then models, search across all providers or within one provider, select supported reasoning-effort levels, and navigate with arrow keys, Enter and Esc.

resources.name: WelY1/dsh-topbar
resources.desc: Per-session status chips in the GNOME top bar for DeepSeek Harness — gray for running, green for done, yellow for waiting — configurable from the sidebar, with a self-installed GNOME extension.

resources.name: Wenaixi/dsh-prompt-history
resources.desc: Claude Code-style prompt history, double-Esc picker, selection quote/copy & right-click paste.

resources.name: wenhaolin-svg/dsh-background
resources.desc: Replace the DSH solid background with a local image, with a draggable editor for fit, blur, veil and interface opacity.

resources.name: weshopai/weshop-dsh-plugin
resources.desc: Infinite-canvas e-commerce visual workspace for product photography, virtual try-on, background edits, and video, synced live with the Harness conversation.

resources.name: wf-ping/dsh-message-injector
resources.desc: Presets message-injection content combos and auto-injects them into every message.

resources.name: wfz2006/dsh-status-bar#dsh-status-bar
resources.desc: Floating glass status bar for DSH on Windows 11 x64: an always-on-top capsule that mirrors session progress, the current step and pending approvals from a local DSH web profile, with peek and detail views; approval cards stay read-only until DSH returns its own decision receipt, and connecting to the official Desktop app is experimental and unverified.

resources.name: WhatCannotBeSaid/dsh-im-workspace-buttons
resources.desc: Adds one 28x28 icon button per dsh-im channel that holds an account to the official Workspaces header row. Pressing one puts the sidebar into that channel's view, drawing only its conversations and hiding every other row; pressing it again drops back to the official list. Buttons appear only for channels with a connected account.

resources.name: WhatCannotBeSaid/dsh-session-eva-status
resources.desc: Colors DSH sidebar Session rows by their official status, in an Evangelion-flavored palette: a blue left rail for a row awaiting interaction, red for the session open in the main view, purple for finished-but-unviewed, and a static rainbow title for pinned rows. Every colour is mode-scoped — dark keeps the vivid stop, light takes a darker variant solved to clear 4.5:1 against the light wall — and the split reads DSH's own dark marker. Reads official Client services only: it owns no state, never polls, and ships no host-side half.

resources.name: whiteguo233/dsh-openbiliclaw
resources.desc: OpenBiliClaw consumer panel for DSH: recommendations, saved lists, Socratic dialogue, profile views, and Agent Bridge tools.

resources.name: WhitePlusMS/dsh-input-plus
resources.desc: Search and insert workspace file and directory paths with @, plus a /h menu for reusing prompts from the current session.

resources.name: whiteS18/dsh-mcp-servers-panel
resources.desc: MCP server management panel in Settings: add, edit, enable/disable and delete servers across user and workspace scopes with form or JSON editing, and auto-register discovered MCP tools as native conversation tools.

resources.name: whiteS18/dsh-terminal-button
resources.desc: Embedded terminal for DeepSeek Harness: opens an in-app terminal panel in the right sidebar (DockKit) or bottom composer dock, with PSReadLine geometry protection and full theme sync.

resources.name: whybebabo/dsh-better-workspace
resources.desc: Topic grouping layered over the native workspace list: emoji folder groups, filtering and search, batch archive, and safe permanent deletion.

resources.name: whybebabo/dsh-code-nav
resources.desc: Code preview for dsh-better-sidebar with per-language syntax highlighting, symbol outline, in-file search, and selection-to-conversation.

resources.name: wilsonchengassistant/dsh-media-web-preview
resources.desc: Plays video and audio files in the right Sidebar preview pane, streamed over an authenticated HTTP Range route so a remote browser can play and seek a large file without launching a native player on the Host.

resources.name: wilsonchengassistant/dsh-mobile-sidebar
resources.desc: Below 1024px the sidebar leaves the shell frame entirely and is opened as an overlay drawer from a header button, so the conversation gets the full viewport width; wider layouts are untouched.

resources.name: wilsonchengassistant/dsh-quick-workspace
resources.desc: Replaces the host-side folder chooser in the Add workspace flow with a name dialog, so a remote browser can create and open a workspace instead of an OS dialog appearing on the Host screen.

resources.name: wilsonchengassistant/dsh-zh-hant
resources.desc: Adds a Traditional Chinese (zh-Hant) language to the web GUI, registered through the locale service with one dictionary per namespace and selectable in Settings, General, Language.

resources.name: winditer/dsh-paste-spill
resources.desc: Folds each 4-50 KB paste in the DSH composer into its own chip (expand or delete it individually), and turns a paste of 50 KB or more into a real file attachment. Declares DSH >=0.1.7-rc.2 <0.3.0-0, so it stays visible on the 0.2 release line.

resources.name: winditer/dsh-prompt-optimizer
resources.desc: Polishes the draft in the composer into a clearer, better-structured prompt from the ✨ button or Alt+O; streams the result live over SSE with reasoning shown first, and follows the session's default model with zero configuration or any OpenAI-compatible endpoint.

resources.name: winditer/dsh-recent-tasks
resources.desc: An always-last, collapsible Recent tasks workspace group in the DSH sidebar: a sidebar entry and the Mod+Alt+N / Mod+Shift+N shortcut start a chat in a dedicated folder, so it lands in that group instead of 未分组. The group is a genuine workspace record rather than a plugin-drawn look-alike, so collapse, rename, search and drag order behave normally, and its folder, group name, pin-last and auto-repair are live settings.

resources.name: winditer/dsh-temp-chat
resources.desc: Floating translucent DeepSeek whale elf on the DSH page that opens a draggable, minimizable temporary chat window using the session model or a custom OpenAI-compatible endpoint, with real-time streaming.

resources.name: windrover/dsh-minimal-UI-panels
resources.desc: Four right-Sidebar panels for the dsh web client: artifacts, long-term memory, terminal and notes. They pair two per tab with a draggable split, so two panes show all four at once. The host half ships nine memory_* tools, artifacts_list, the /memory command, and the /api/artifacts/* and /api/terminal-notes/* routes. The terminal runs one bash command per line, with a default 120-second deadline and a stop button. Requires dsh 0.1.5 or newer, and 0.2.

resources.name: windrover/dsh-prompt-optimizer
resources.desc: A prompt optimizer in the composer input tool row: pick a category and a template, then ✨ rewrites the draft in place with one-click undo. Pick from the Basic, Context and Image categories; you can cancel a run, and it shows elapsed time and token usage. Ships 15 templates covering task-instruction rewriting, step planning, safety-research framing, system-prompt role cards, and text-to-image / image-to-image prompts; context templates read the recent turns of the session for coreference resolution. Calls go through the host model service, and a settings section exposes the model and the budgets. Output guards check that user-written constraints survive, warning rather than auto-retrying. Adapted for dsh 0.1.7 and 0.2.

resources.name: WindyPro-rourou/dsh-code-studio
resources.desc: File-change monitor and code editor for the DSH Web UI. Agent edits appear beside your conversation as real-time line-by-line diffs, with a syntax-highlighted editor, one-click revert, change history, workspace switcher, and per-session isolation.

resources.name: Wine-Red/dsh-codex-timeline
resources.desc: Left-edge user-Turn navigation rail with reading-position highlighting, hover previews of per-turn metrics and model-answer excerpts, keyboard and click-to-jump controls, and local conversation search.

resources.name: Winter-And-You-Gone/dsh-deep-verbs
resources.desc: Rotates the model status line through a 53-phrase English/Chinese deep-theme pool: a random pick at turn start, event-driven switching on new thinking segments or tool calls (3s throttle), and a click on the status line toggles the language.

resources.name: Winter-And-You-Gone/dsh-turn-fold
resources.desc: A better fold bar: automatically folds tool calls and Think segments into step fold bars, and collapses each finished turn into a single turn header with live metrics (duration, TTFT, token, tok/s, cache hit) — only the final summary stays visible; customizable leading icons with animated poker cards built in (suit-cycling card animation while running, a deck when collapsed, a fan when expanded), a settings row for the official fold mode, compatible with both new and old DSH versions. Zero intrusion into DSH source.

resources.name: Witherwithwinter/DeepSeek-Balance-Whale-Widget-Bowl
resources.desc: A fixed-corner DeepSeek balance whale widget for the DSH web GUI: three switchable skins (default / bowl-on-head / bowl-in-hand), balance with today usage, per-turn cost popups, peak/off-peak price conversion, press sound effects and random talk lines. Modified from MeteorNOX/DeepSeek-Balance-Whale-Widget.

resources.name: Witherwithwinter/DSH-Codinput
resources.desc: Replaces the chat composer with an editor-style input panel on CodeMirror 6: line numbers, edit + markdown-preview split, a floating window mode and a full-height sidebar tab — one input surface at a time. Drafts ride the official input machine; the official voice-input button is rendered when the host provides one, and the stats row and context meter read the same data as the official dock.

resources.name: wjf1/dsh-prompt-enhance
resources.desc: Sparkle button immediately left of the model selector that rewrites the composer draft into an executable prompt in place, modelled on WorkBuddy: the host calls the conversation LLM with a prompt-engineering system prompt, multi-level undo keeps up to 8 previous drafts, and a token-level diff card shows added and removed spans, the number of changed spots and the net character delta. Runs on the session model, is disabled while the draft is empty, and keeps the browser-session cookie fence in front of the LLM call.

resources.name: wjingshan/dsh-dock-launcher#dsh-dock-bridge
resources.desc: Publishes the running dsh Web server's PID, port and tokenized URL to a runtime file for the DeepSeek Harness Switch Dock app, and removes it on shutdown.

resources.name: wjingshan/dsh-sidebar-focus
resources.desc: Orders and folds the DSH left sidebar by what is actually running — a workspace floats to the top when one of its sessions starts and keeps that place when the session finishes, only the N most recently active workspaces stay expanded, and six switches plus one count control each rule.

resources.name: WJNCT55555/dsh-web-preview-float
resources.desc: Google AI Studio-style floating preview for the Web UI: a draggable/resizable iframe preview with aspect-ratio and resolution presets, plus a VS Code-style code window with direct editing, confirmed writes, and session-log recording.

resources.name: WJZ-P/dsh-attachments
resources.desc: Adds file and folder drag-and-drop attachments to the Web UI, with composer cards, persistent history, and workspace-backed paths.

resources.name: wlj521/dsh-ui-tweaks
resources.desc: Live-tune the DSH Web conversation UI from Settings: message font size, Claude Desktop-style markdown tables, dialog width, an optional timeline rail, and a GitBar with branch management, per-file diff, and commit & push.

resources.name: wlllyj/dsh-prompt-forge
resources.desc: Adds one Prompt button beside the composer: clicking it rewrites the draft with an editable prompt-engineering doctrine and returns the result as pickable rows instead of overwriting the draft, and the same panel edits the plugin's own settings in place.

resources.name: WLV-ZEDD/dsh-btw
resources.desc: Interactive Side-Assistant Dock to ask quick side questions via /btw with real-time thinking status and history pagination without interrupting the active agent loop.

resources.name: wmengxiang/dsh-prompt-optimizer
resources.desc: Adds an icon button to the composer that optimizes the current draft prompt through the active model.

resources.name: WMXS-A/dsh-utility-plugins#dsh-skill-cheatsheet
resources.desc: Composer button that opens a panel listing every skill available to the current session with Chinese titles, purposes and usage examples, and lets you catalogue newly installed skills in one click (saved locally).

resources.name: wodongx123/dsh-desktop-tray
resources.desc: Adds a system tray icon to DSH Desktop, with settings to hide the main window to the tray on minimize or close and self-healing after app updates.

resources.name: Woeful001/dsh-refresh
resources.desc: Adds a refresh button to the sidebar footer that reloads the plugin list and the page so newly installed plugins take effect without restarting the desktop app.

resources.name: WolfGenerals/ncm-player
resources.desc: Floating NetEase Cloud Music player for DSH Web: draggable collapsible window with mini mode, playlist discovery with search and hot lists, synced lyrics with translations, persistent playback queue, QR-code or Cookie login, colors following the DSH skin theme.

resources.name: WongYuYe/dsh-composer-recall
resources.desc: Arrow-key input history for DSH 0.1.2-alpha.1: press ↑ in an empty composer to recall this session's prompts, ↓ to go forward, Esc to restore the draft.

resources.name: WongYuYe/dsh-diff-card
resources.desc: Per-turn file-change card for DSH Desktop: +N −M badges, aligned diffs, and Mac/Windows file open (system app, Finder/Explorer, VS Code).

resources.name: wood007924/dsh-approval-enter
resources.desc: Keyboard confirmation for approval cards: the card takes focus when it appears, so Enter allows once and Esc rejects, and those two keys are forwarded through the card handler when focus has moved elsewhere. It never auto-approves and never steals focus from a text field.

resources.name: woody-dx/dsh-pdf-bookmarks
resources.desc: PDF outline navigation and local reading bookmarks in the existing right-sidebar file preview; supports adding, renaming, deleting and revisiting page positions, with version and integrity guards. Verified on macOS Apple Silicon with dsh Desktop 0.2.1-rc.2 and 0.2.1-rc.3.

resources.name: wqx-txdsyl/dsh-ds-attach
resources.desc: DeepSeek Chat (chat.deepseek.com) same-style attachments: paperclip upload button, 240×64 DS-style file cards with official colored doc icons (PDF/DOCX/XLSX/PPT/IMG extracted from the DS frontend bundle), drag-and-drop, text extraction (PDF/DOCX/XLSX/TXT) injected into the message, and real attachment cards rendered in the transcript (custom user renderer) with the model reading full content.

resources.name: WSL043/dsh-reasoning-slider
resources.desc: Adds a model-aware reasoning effort slider with native and animated modes, light and dark palettes, and shared or per-model colors.

resources.name: WsTe47/dsh-step-clock
resources.desc: Shows the running agent step above the web composer as a Chinese sentence: its step number, the tools it is running, and how long it has been going. A finished step keeps its duration on screen until the next one starts, so a slow step can be identified after the fact.

resources.name: wsxwj123/dsh-plugins#dsh-composer-tools
resources.desc: Composer input toolkit: arrow-key session history (first/last-line gated, IME and command-menu safe), an instructions viewer/editor for global and project AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md, and a prompt library of 780 Chinese prompts (Cherry Studio agents-zh corpus, AGPL-3.0) inserted into the composer in one click. Ships on npm as dsh-composer-tools.

resources.name: wsxwj123/dsh-plugins#dsh-turn-scrubber
resources.desc: Compact right-edge turn rail with hover summaries and click-to-jump navigation. Ships on npm as dsh-turn-scrubber.

resources.name: wszhoho/dsh-file-attachment
resources.desc: Drag-and-drop / paste / upload files and images; on non-multimodal models images are auto-described by a configured VLM.

resources.name: wt0812/dsh-vocab-study
resources.desc: Offline vocabulary panel: a capsule beside the composer opens a word card, and a dockable tabbed panel tracks today, progress, the mistake book and settings.

resources.name: wuaisaber/dsh-think-zh-plus
resources.desc: Keeps DSH reasoning in Simplified Chinese and auto-expands every Think row in the Web UI.

resources.name: wucl12/dsh-side-branch
resources.desc: Read-only side branch in the right sidebar: quote text to ask follow-ups without polluting the model context of the main session; every follow-up rebuilds the branch from the latest settled turns of the main session, and writes are refused at the tool-execution layer so the prompt prefix stays cacheable.

resources.name: WuHututu/dsh-side-chat
resources.desc: Opens a temporary side conversation in the right Sidebar that reuses the host conversation UI, so answers render with the same markdown, tool steps, timing and token usage as the main thread. Selecting part of an answer opens that conversation side chat with the passage quoted: the quote waits as a pill inside the composer, rides along with the next message, and joins the side chat context. The side chat runs on its own memory-only session: the parent snapshot is reference context only, and nothing is written to the session log.

resources.name: wukiQAQ/dsh-enter-using
resources.desc: Codex-style keyboard answers for the pending command-approval panel — 1 allows once, 2 rejects, Enter confirms the highlighted choice, arrow keys move it, and Esc rejects, with the buttons still usable by mouse.

resources.name: wuuuuu123-32/dsh-open-artifacts
resources.desc: Adds an action to the session menu and the session title bar that opens the artifacts folder of that conversation: it reads the session log, works out which directories the conversation wrote files to, and opens them in Explorer.

resources.name: wuwaka/dsh-clipboard-menu
resources.desc: Adds a right-click menu to DeepSeek Harness inside desktop shells that ship no context menu: cut, copy, paste and select all in the composer, copy and copy-as-plain-text on selected text elsewhere, and a search entry that opens the default browser with a configurable engine.

resources.name: WWFZS/dsh-plugin-startup-animation
resources.desc: Full-screen boot animation covering the loading page until the app UI is ready. Ships a built-in video/wallpaper/audio library, accepts your own files, and adds uninstall and one-click update buttons on its settings page.

resources.name: wwumit/dsh-phone#client
resources.desc: iPhone-style agent phone: dual-panel calls & SMS, RCS group chat with trust gates, cross-device agent messaging via the registry inbox bridge, L0–L4 trust badges and evidence audit. Experimental: trust summaries are not a security guarantee, and SMS/signalling is relayed through the operator's inbox (visible to them); E2E encryption is planned.

resources.name: www02310/dsh-go
resources.desc: Launch splash screen for DSH — a row of white marquee dots lights up, then the DeepSeek Harness wordmark is written stroke by stroke before the main window takes over. Installs as a runtime-injected overlay plugin; the repository also ships an optional native build.

resources.name: wwwangzilin/dsh-role-cards
resources.desc: Replaces the new-session hero with a combined picker: role cards for the agent presets and a workspace card, collapsed into capsule buttons that expand into two scrollable rows.

resources.name: wx-yss/dsh-message-rail
resources.desc: Codex-style left-side message navigation rail for the Web UI: one tick per user message, hover previews, and click-to-jump across the whole history.

resources.name: wydddddcool/dsh-hover-approve
resources.desc: Anchors an approve/answer bubble to each DSH Web sidebar session row — one-click handling of authorization, questions, plan reviews and blocked goals without opening the conversation.

resources.name: wyzh0117/dsh-notebook
resources.desc: Sidebar notebook with titled notes and inline images (videos rejected); click a title to copy its body to the clipboard, reference a note in the composer with @, and optionally open the notebook for every new session.

resources.name: Wzh0718/dsh-minimal-transcript
resources.desc: Minimal DSH Web transcript toggle: hide thinking, tool-call, and turn-process rows from the session header while preserving assistant answer text.

resources.name: wzn16/dsh-task-capsule
resources.desc: Session-header task capsule with color-coded run states, click-to-jump and a multi-task dropdown, plus task notification cards (done / error / waiting-for-confirmation) with synthesized sound and optional system notifications.

resources.name: wzz3034026545/dsh-rule-manager
resources.desc: Manage DSH rules from the web settings panel — edit global/project AGENTS.md, or auto-split pasted rules into layered AGENTS.md and skills via LLM.

resources.name: x2802490130-prog/dsh-client-ui-writing
resources.desc: Client-side writing panel for the Web UI: project volumes and stats, corpus library, full-text search, evolution version-chain diffs, and an SVG thread graph, shown only in writing-preset sessions.

resources.name: xchannel1987/dsh-sdd-progress-xc
resources.desc: SDD task progress (todos) and progress ledger (sdd/progress.md) as a right-sidebar tab bound to the current session, rendered with the official MarkdownText, auto-refresh every 5s.

resources.name: XcodeFish/dsh-file-link-menu
resources.desc: Adds a right-click menu on file references in chat output, listing registered applications with icons for open-with, revealing files in the file manager, and copying absolute or relative paths resolved against the session workspace, while code blocks, plain text and external links keep the native menu.

resources.name: XenoPhonLau/dsh-activity-bar
resources.desc: VS Code style 44px icon rails for the side panels DSH collapses: the left rail keeps the sidebar navigation and the bottom action rows, the right rail lists the sidebarRightTabs ledger so third-party tabs appear on their own, and the right panel is drag-resizable between 300px and 60% of the window. Two switches under Settings → Activity Bar, saved in this browser.

resources.name: XHR666/dsh-mpkg-wallpaper
resources.desc: Load Wallpaper Engine .mpkg files as the DSH web background: embedded video, time-of-day switching, unified frosted blur, local wallpaper library & rotation.

resources.name: xi-zhao/OpenQuantum#openquantum-web-branding
resources.desc: Applies OpenQuantum branding, browser metadata, and PWA assets to the native DeepSeek Harness web UI.

resources.name: xiaheng1/dsh-turn-nav
resources.desc: Turn histogram navigation rail for DeepSeek Harness Web with mixed, DeepSeek, and Codex visual variants.

resources.name: xiamubumu/dsh-composer-launcher
resources.desc: A launcher panel for DSH: manages the capability composer, the plugin inventory and the MCP bridge, and walks you through installing the browser tab-bridge extension.

resources.name: XIANGDEEN/dsh-sidebar-video-player
resources.desc: A right-Sidebar video player with a folder playlist (first-frame thumbnails, duration badges, sort by name/duration/modified/size, fullscreen, and a context menu for rename/copy/delete/refresh when the folder is opened with write access), live playback telemetry (buffered range, decoded FPS, dropped frames) and a read-only MP4/MOV reader for codec profile/level, exact frame count, per-track bitrate and rotation. Registers no agent tool; file writes use the browser File System Access API only after a write-permission folder choice.

resources.name: xianrui69/dsh-quick-phrases
resources.desc: Adds a draggable, position-persisted chip bar of configurable quick phrases to DeepSeek Harness, plus a /-triggered phrase menu with per-phrase pin, slash-menu, bar-visibility, and click-to-send toggles.

resources.name: Xiaofei-fei/dsh-prompt-history
resources.desc: Terminal-style composer for the DSH web GUI: shell prompt history (↑/↓, prefix search, Ctrl+R), Codex-style completion and next-prompt prediction (Tab or → to accept), selection toolbar (copy / quote / ask in side chat), right-click paste, draggable chat TOC, and a parallel side-chat thread in the right sidebar.

resources.name: xiaokaizhou/dsh-media-preview
resources.desc: Renders local audio/video paths as inline, playable previews in DSH chat: replaces paths with <audio>/<video> players backed by same-origin /api/media-preview/* route, with explicit error statuses.

resources.name: xiaomujiang/dsh-user-question-nav
resources.desc: ChatGPT-style question nav rail with up/down arrow buttons — per-question tick marks on the chat edge, hover-triggered drawer listing every user question with real-time search filter, one-click smooth-scroll jump, and active-question highlight synced to scroll position.

resources.name: XiaoOu2024/dsh-novel-generator
resources.desc: Novel generator: builds a world snapshot along a story timeline and, from the latest snapshot and the most recent chapters, deduces the next chapter. Requires DSH >=0.2.1-rc.2.

resources.name: XiaoSHang05/dsh-sidebar-fold
resources.desc: Puts one collapsible row above the sidebar panel icons. Click it to hide the icons, click again to show them. The choice is remembered in the browser. Because folding is done in CSS, icons from plugins you install later are folded too. It does not depend on any other plugin.

resources.name: xiaoshihou514/dsh-tui
resources.desc: Clean and simple TUI.

resources.name: xiaosurongjia/dsh-improved-inline-edit
resources.desc: A mid-run steer input for DeepSeek Harness Web: while the agent works, an input bar appears above the composer to inject modification requests into the next decision via agent.steer(), without stopping the conversation. Drafts persist per session, unread injected messages can be recalled from the bubble, and an optional guiding prefix is supported.

resources.name: xiaotuchu/dsh-file-tree
resources.desc: Adds a resizable workspace file tree beside the native preview, with directory expansion, filtering of loaded files, and refresh.

resources.name: xiaoxin3309/dsh-mini
resources.desc: Windows only (needs the Edge WebView2 Runtime): pop the current session into an always-on-top WebView2 mini window with a self-drawn title bar, free resizing and a jump back to the main window; adds full-screen and region screenshots that paste straight into the composer, a "ask about selection" pill for text selected in any application, global hotkeys and a settings section.

resources.name: xiaoyangcheng84-svg/dsh-skin-manager
resources.desc: Skin manager for the DSH web GUI: discovers installed skins and switches the active one from a dedicated Settings page, mutually exclusive, hot-reloaded without restart.

resources.name: xiaoyi-xx/dsh-peak-status
resources.desc: Header chip for the DSH web GUI that shows whether the current Beijing time is inside DeepSeek's API peak window, with a live clock and countdown to the next transition.

resources.name: xiaoyuer3921/dsh-showreel
resources.desc: Turns the latest completed DSH session turn into a shareable vertical recap video: editable five-scene storyboard, host-side privacy redaction, optional AI polish and TTS narration, MP4/WebM export with PNG cover.

resources.name: xiex16070-jpg/dsh-prompt-enhance
resources.desc: Adds an enhancement chip to the composer input action row, left of the model selector: it rewrites the draft in place using the model already selected in the session, in five styles, with one-click undo and an /enhance slash command.

resources.name: xiezouqu12/agent-trees
resources.desc: Live multi-way tree of the current session's agents in the DeepSeek Harness conversation view and right sidebar, with status, plan progress, tokens, cost (requires dsh-cost-meter), and runtime on every card.

resources.name: XiLuovo/dsh-session-timeline
resources.desc: Session timeline down the left of the conversation: every user message at a glance, current-message tracking, hover preview of the message and its reply, click to jump, collapsible.

resources.name: xindady/dsh-prompt-enhancer
resources.desc: Adds a prompt enhancement button to the composer toolbar that rewrites the draft through a model call, keeps @file references verbatim, and offers one-click undo.

resources.name: DSH Canvas
resources.desc: An AI-native multimodal canvas for DSH: preview images, video, audio, 3D models, PDFs, documents, and code; connect ideas and collaborate with agents in a persistent local workspace.

resources.name: xing-shuyin/dsh-ui-tools
resources.desc: Developer tools panel for the DSH web UI: file browser with preview, edit, and path-only file mentions; multi-tab terminals with quick commands; Git panel with commit, push, pull, and branch switching; and background job management. UI ported from pi-web-ui.

resources.name: Xingkong42/dsh-open-workspace
resources.desc: Adds Open workspace entries to the sidebar session-row menu and the session header actions slot, opening the session workspace folder in the system file manager.

resources.name: Xingkong42/dsh-zh-labels
resources.desc: Re-applies Chinese UI labels to the DSH client modules on every start, so translations survive upgrades.

resources.name: xingxingbk-git/dsh-deepseek-chat
resources.desc: Adds a switch between DeepSeek web chat and the Harness workspace in DSH Desktop.

resources.name: xinming-chenniang/dsh-button
resources.desc: Editable quick-action buttons beside the DSH composer: send preset text or insert it into the draft, then reorder, move, or resize the buttons. Text-only: runs no host commands and never overwrites an existing draft.

resources.name: xinspark/dsh-better-session-topbar
resources.desc: Better Session Topbar: replaces the session topbar title with a workspace and session breadcrumb, switching workspaces, sessions and subagents from topbar dropdowns; adding a workspace hands off to the host's own directory picker, which is the OS folder dialog on desktop.

resources.name: xintingcui/dsh-sidebar-panels-fold
resources.desc: Collapses the sidebar global-panel rows to a few visible entries and adds a picker for choosing which ones stay, so a long panel list stops squeezing the workspace and session area; rows are hidden only, never unregistered.

resources.name: Xinyuan-Gao/xy-dsh#xy-dsh-lamp
resources.desc: Always-on-top lamp board for macOS: one lamp per agent, one row per session, collapsing to one lamp per running task; a lamp turns blue and blinks while an approval or a question is waiting on you, and the root agent finishing raises a system notification.

resources.name: Xinyuan-Gao/xy-dsh#xy-dsh-question-nav
resources.desc: Keeps the question you are currently on pinned above the composer, with a dropdown of every earlier question that scrolls the conversation back to that turn; questions folded into process groups are expanded first, and Escape, scrolling or clicking outside collapses the panel.

resources.name: xiong356/dsh-draft-optimizer
resources.desc: Adds a ✦ button below the DSH composer that rewrites the current draft into a more complete prompt with a single call to the configured default model, keeping the original intent and language, and replaces the draft in place without sending it.

resources.name: XIUDENBENNY/dsh-claude-quote
resources.desc: Claude Code Desktop-style selection quoting: select text in a conversation to reply to that passage from a popover, or fork the session into a side chat in the right sidebar with the selection quoted. Quotes sit above the composer as removable cards, are sent as plain Markdown blockquotes in the same format as Claude Code Desktop, and render as clamped quote blocks in sent messages.

resources.name: xixingyingmie/dsh-gpt-niang-widget
resources.desc: A GPT/ChatGPT-persona desktop pet pinned to the bottom-right corner of the DSH web GUI — shows balance, today's usage, peak/off-peak pricing and per-turn cost, with editable bubbles (text, balance, usage, pricing, images, random lines and weighted choices), per-line styles and fonts, a floating quick editor, sound effects, custom character art/animation/audio, and snapping/flipping. 54 GPT-flavored lines across five groups. Its routes, bundle id and data files are namespaced so it can run alongside the whale and Xiaoke widgets. A derivative of MeteorNOX/DeepSeek-Balance-Whale-Widget (MIT).

resources.name: xiyuepcl/dsh-approval-translator
resources.desc: DSH审批汉化 — approval dialogs translated to Chinese before they render: DeepSeek-powered, host-side, nothing for React to revert.

resources.name: xkjxziochu/dsh-input-optimizer
resources.desc: Rewrites the draft in the DSH composer into a clearer, more executable prompt through the harness's own LLM routes, showing an original/optimized comparison before you adopt it.

resources.name: xlennart/dsh-goal-mode-enhance
resources.desc: Visual goal lifecycle for the DSH web UI: a composer dock to create, multiline-edit, pause, resume, complete and clear session goals with live round progress, plus a phase-dot composer entry and a settings-page goal overview.

resources.name: xlennart/dsh-side-chat
resources.desc: Native side-by-side chat beside the main conversation: an independent archived DSH session with full native UI, on-demand parent-context retrieval, selection quoting, and a keep-or-delete lifecycle.

resources.name: Xliecc/dsh-session-theme
resources.desc: Shows every session theme in the DSH Web left sidebar immediately on page load by warming the session projection cache at startup; no need to click into a conversation first.

resources.name: xmlans/dsh-xmlans
resources.desc: Desktop pet for DSH: 兰酱, an angel-winged maid in a transparent always-on-top window who reacts to session states (thinking, working, waiting, done, error), shows task progress and DeepSeek balance, and responds to drags, head pats, pokes and wing touches.

resources.name: xmmtr/dsh-better-right-click
resources.desc: Better Right-Click: right-click menu on file references in the DSH transcript. Copies the absolute path, reveals the file selected in Explorer by reusing and focusing an existing window, and lists every app registered for that file type so you can open it with the one you want. Menu labels follow the DSH display language (Chinese and English). Windows only (Explorer reveal and the registered-apps list use PowerShell).

resources.name: XMoon/dsh-pi-tui
resources.desc: Third-party TUI mode for DeepSeek Harness (dsh --profile pi-tui), built on a vendored pi-tui fork: covers the main session loop plus approvals, commands, session switching and full-text search, as well as presets, skills, model/settings menus and slash commands.

resources.name: xmwengxing/dsh-client-ui-sidebar-perfmon
resources.desc: Host performance monitor in the right Sidebar: CPU, memory and swap gauges, a GPU clock and VRAM bar, CPU / GPU / motherboard / drive temperatures, and a process table sortable by CPU, memory or name.

resources.name: xmwengxing/dsh-sidebar-enhancement
resources.desc: Enhanced right-sidebar files panel: rename, create, upload, download (a directory is zipped on the fly), copy the full path and delete from the tree; an editable document renderer for 128 text extensions with Ctrl/Cmd+S save and conflict detection; plus an independent bottom terminal panel with tabs and a quick-command library persisted under the DSH home.

resources.name: xswt442-cmd/dsh-xswt-tauriapp#dsh-desktop-app
resources.desc: Installer entry for the dsh-xswt-tauriapp desktop shell, a Tauri desktop shell for DeepSeek Harness: on the first dsh start after installation it downloads this platform's installer from the release, checks it against the release SHA256SUMS before writing it, and opens it with the system installer. It installs nothing itself and adds no UI to dsh.

resources.name: xt765/dsh-message-edit
resources.desc: Inline user message editor: adds a pencil edit button next to Copy below sent user bubbles, switches the bubble in-place into a rounded editor card, and resends via session branch fork or in-session follow-up.

resources.name: xt765/dsh-selection-quote
resources.desc: Cursor and GitHub PR Review style selection toolbar: quote selected text to chat (Cmd+L), write inline comments (Shift+Cmd+L), and batch-insert from a composer dock.

resources.name: xuanfu-web/dsh-metaphysics
resources.desc: Chinese metaphysics (xuanxue) divination panel and agent tool with nineteen systems: eight chart systems (BaZi, Zi Wei Dou Shu, LiuYao, MeiHua, Da Liu Ren, Qi Men Dun Jia, compatibility charts, Tarot) plus eleven quick references (almanac, solar–lunar conversion, date selection, bone-weight fortune, Xiao Liu Ren, horoscope, numerology, life-curve, feng shui, name analysis, an MBTI-style 16-type questionnaire), with ask-driven, report-style interpretation. BaZi adds exact dayun handover dates, annual suiyun hints, "passing-through" (通关), three-book classical cross-reference, four-mausoleum (杂气) month pattern selection and daily "human element" (人元司权); Zi Wei adds 34 patterns, nine switchable school variants, chained flying transformations and three-way-four-corner composite flights; LiuYao adds yongshen strength, whole-hexagram per-line strength, hidden-spirit release conditions and response-time clues (应期); feng shui covers eight-mansion and Xuan Kong flying stars; name analysis ships a 391-character library with five-grid (五格) numerology and phonetics checks. The DSH panel and the offline page share the same grouped first screen (ask / read a person / pick a date) with recent-used entries and narrow-width folding. All computed locally; networking is off by default. The npm package also ships an offline single-file page (命理排盘.html): double-click to open, every tab included, no server and no network needed.

resources.name: xuexiaolei1997/dsh-plugin-stock-x
resources.desc: Financial quantitative workbench and stock ticker: floating ball and drawer panel, real-time A/HK/US/global market quotes, multi-period K-lines and 5-day intraday charts, depth order book, capital flow, sector heat map, and AI investment research.

resources.name: xufu5438-netizen/dsh-boot-video
resources.desc: Full-screen video boot splash — play an mp4 at startup, skip with a click, import your own clip, and non-playable codecs are transcoded to H.264 automatically.

resources.name: xuguangyao/dsh-prompt-deck
resources.desc: Turn your recurring one-liners into capsules above the composer. They reorder themselves by how often you use them, and ask you to fill in {{placeholder}} values before the snippet lands in the draft. Clicking appends rather than replaces, so a half-written draft survives. A drawer adds search, grouping and editing, and everything lives in a Host-side JSON file you can edit by hand.

resources.name: xwh5/dsh-diff-review
resources.desc: Session change-review for DeepSeek Harness: tracks write/edit tool calls and renders VS Code-style side-by-side diffs via diff2html, auto-following the theme, with subagent aggregation and one-click revert.

resources.name: XWIDE/dsh-draft-keeper
resources.desc: Keeps the images you pasted or attached in the composer, per session: they are mirrored locally in the browser and handed back through the official draft channel when you return to the conversation or the composer remounts, and dropped as soon as the message is sent or you remove them.

resources.name: XWIDE/dsh-picflow
resources.desc: Pasted screenshots become numbered references: each Ctrl+V image is stored in the attachment library under a stable number, listed in a composer-dock thumbnail panel with an image source in the @ menu, and inserted as a reference chip at the caret — automatically after paste when the auto-insert switch is on.

resources.name: XWIDE/dsh-xwide-annotation
resources.desc: Select text in a conversation to attach a numbered highlight with a colour stored per note, keep every mark in an outline panel that jumps back to its quote, and let a corner self-check badge report style, selector and saved-key problems without opening dev tools.

resources.name: xx529/dsh-capability-settings
resources.desc: Adds a capability panel to the DSH web GUI: browse, install (upload, zip, host path or URL), enable, edit and export skills, and add or edit Claude Code-compatible MCP servers, at global and per-project scope — with project copies, per-project shadow stubs, live mount status and a zero-side-effect connection probe. A session view toggles capabilities for the current conversation only, and a TypeSafe Jev tab scores skills and MCP servers for the session from the input draft. Requires the dsh web shell 0.2.0-rc.2 or later. Forked from chengdb/dsh-plugin-capability-panel; it shares a patch id with that plugin and with pure-craft/dsh-capability-panel, so do not install them together.

resources.name: xx529/dsh-shell-cmd
resources.desc: /cmd <command> in the composer runs that shell command in the session working directory, sends the command and its output to the model as a user message, and renders the input as a terminal card with exit status, expandable output and copy buttons; a bare /cmd opens an interactive terminal whose transcript is sent to the model with Ctrl+Enter. Runs with its own terminal permissions (danger-full-access) by default; set useSessionPolicy: true to use the session sandbox.

resources.name: xx529/dsh-task-gantt
resources.desc: Agent-team task Gantt chart for the DSH sidebar - one swimlane per teammate, real session-log time on the x-axis, and every shared task drawn with its title and summary. Requires dsh-better-sidebar 0.4.0 or later (the tab has nowhere to register without it).

resources.name: xx529/dsh-terminal-panel
resources.desc: Read-only terminal view tab in the conversation header: aggregates bash output, background jobs and persistent terminal sessions from the current session, subagents and Agent Team teammates into one filterable panel, with type and session-scope filters, command/output search, auto-collapse, follow-scroll and a maximize dialog; foreground bash shows final output only. Requires DeepSeek Harness 0.2.1-rc.2 or later (0.2.x).

resources.name: XXP-AI-SPACE/dsh-snip
resources.desc: Snipaste-style screenshot for DeepSeek Harness: press F1 (a real Windows global hotkey) to freeze and dim the whole screen, drag a region, then draw red boxes and click-to-type text annotations with wheel-resizable font; the annotated PNG drops into the composer at native resolution. Esc exits. Windows 10/11.

resources.name: Xxsttb/dsh-input-optimizer
resources.desc: Adds a four-pointed-star button left of the composer's model selector that rewrites the unsent draft in place — grammar, wording, punctuation and execution order — preserving code, commands, paths, identifiers, numbers and URLs byte-for-byte, answering nothing and never overwriting text typed while it runs. A pencil under every user message reopens that message for editing without touching the draft; because the Harness session log is append-only, an edit forks the conversation before that message rather than rewriting it. A circular restart icon under every reply asks that one question again in a fresh conversation that carries none of the earlier turns. Both are refused while a turn is still answering, and disabled when the reply used a tool that can leave a trace or when the files the message named have since changed. A right-sidebar memory tree draws the conversation as turns, showing what was actually asked and answered, every answer to one question on its own line labelled original, edited or memory-free, newest first, with arrows that re-read an answer in place; right-clicking jumps to a branch or removes it from the plugin's own history.

resources.name: Xxsttb/dsh-sillytavern-presets
resources.desc: Imports SillyTavern AI presets as switchable, editable prompt layers: preserves the raw JSON, edits prompt order and sampler parameters, previews the injected System Prompt, exports back to SillyTavern-compatible JSON, and archives or permanently deletes presets with confirmation. Applies temperature and maximum output tokens to Harness requests; other sampler fields are preserved and exported but not applied.

resources.name: xxxSnack/dsh-market-dock
resources.desc: A stock market panel for DeepSeek Harness, forked from dsh-xueqiu: A-share/HK/US quotes, K-line and intraday charts, hot lists, search and 7x24 news, plus local holdings with live-computed P&L, host-side price alerts, and a hide switch that unmounts the panel and stops market polling while alerts still fire. Replaces dsh-xueqiu; do not install both.

resources.name: XXXXXQ-0206/dsh-prompt-for-me
resources.desc: Adds a composer button that optimizes the current prompt or designs the next one from the current session and project context.

resources.name: xxxyz/DeepSeekHarness-MCP-Manager
resources.desc: MCP server manager for DeepSeek Harness: add, edit, enable/disable, restart and delete MCP servers from Settings → MCP 管理, with JSON export/import, four mcp_manager_* model tools and an HTTP API; install via npx, npm or cross-platform scripts.

resources.name: xyAxzy/dsh-conversation-map
resources.desc: A live conversation map for DeepSeek Harness web: real-time session tree with subagent lineage, running state, and one-click navigation.

resources.name: xyzYaeMiko/dsh-deepsleep-progress
resources.desc: Shows an elapsed/budget progress bar with a moving head picture under blocking tool calls in the DSH Web conversation flow, and adds a graphical settings page for its style and tool list.

resources.name: xyzYaeMiko/dsh-session-groups
resources.desc: Edge-style tab groups for the DSH sidebar on Web and Desktop, with nested groups up to three levels, workspace tree, single-list view, recursive sorting, RGB colors, collapsed status summaries, subagent expansion with status, and an approval-gated agent tool for organizing groups.

resources.name: Y1X1n/dsh-prompt-optimizer
resources.desc: Adds an optimize button beside the composer that analyzes and rewrites the prompt draft with SSE streaming, conversation-context awareness (template vs intent-polish strategies), an edit-continuity memory chain, undo, and model routing with fallback and a connectivity test.

resources.name: yangdongzhen590/dsh-knj-menu
resources.desc: Third-party menu manager for the DSH Web UI: collects new menu entries added by other plugins into one place, with fold/collapse and pinned menu items.

resources.name: yangdongzhen590/dsh-knj-prompts
resources.desc: Prompt scene picker for DSH: choose a scene from a dropdown and it opens a new session with the prompt already filled in (with {variable} placeholders), so you only tweak and send.

resources.name: yanglingrise/dsh-erii-boot-splash
resources.desc: Erii (Sakura) themed boot splash animation — falling sakura petals, a mint monster mascot with a blossom on its head, and a soft pink progress bar; fades out after ~3 seconds without blocking input.

resources.name: YangShen-SWE/dsh-plugin-chat-zoom
resources.desc: Zoom only DSH chat messages and input (80%–200%) using Ctrl shortcuts or settings, with local memory and no sidebar scaling.

resources.name: yangshen830-eng/dsh-editor
resources.desc: VS Code-style code editor: sidebar file tree over the workspace, Monaco editing, file read/write, Git status and diff, search, and Markdown preview.

resources.name: yangzhenyu0817/dsh-session-color
resources.desc: Right-click any session row in the DeepSeek Harness sidebar to color-tag it with a default red, ten palette colors or a custom picker, persisted locally.

resources.name: yangzhenyu0817/dsh-settings-drag
resources.desc: Moves and resizes the DeepSeek Harness settings panel; its position and size are remembered per browser.

resources.name: yanli-nyan/dsh-open-in-app-fix
resources.desc: Removes the inherited ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE variable from the environment the open-in-app package hands to launched editors, so the desktop host's "Open in ..." launches stop failing with HTTP 502 launch-failed; app.asar is untouched.

resources.name: yanli-nyan/dsh-sidebar-entry-manager
resources.desc: Per-row display switches for the DeepSeek Harness sidebar's panel entries: a hidden row is still reachable from the More menu, and the choice is kept in localStorage across reloads and restarts.

resources.name: yannicksong0106/dsh-550c-boot
resources.desc: Full-screen 550C boot intro for DSH: a 4-second simple cut and a 16-second rewrite sequence, skippable by click or Esc, with four phosphor palettes. The host half injects the opening frame while the document is still parsing, so the built-in loading card never shows; the desktop caption strip turns transparent, so those window buttons float on the animation.

resources.name: YannZhou/dsh-about
resources.desc: About section for the DeepSeek Harness settings: version info, npm latest/next update check with one-click install and auto-restart, and GitHub release history.

resources.name: yaoshuo530/dsh-prompt-enhancer
resources.desc: Prompt enhancement for the composer: an "✨ Enhance" button rewrites your draft prompt into a clearer, more structured version with first-principles thinking, grounded in session context, memory and recent conversation; asks clarifying questions in a card when key info is missing, then previews the result before applying it to the input.

resources.name: Yaoxxxxxxx/dsh-plugins#dsh-focus-composer
resources.desc: Returns the caret to the session composer on Ctrl+I; the key is rebindable in Settings and works from any region of the desktop window.

resources.name: YaphetHayate/codeRDD#dsh-rdd-goal-tree
resources.desc: Read-only goal-tree status strip above the composer: planners see the full node tree, workers see their claimed node, and worker reports call back to the planner session.

resources.name: YearnCy/dsh-question-tree
resources.desc: Tree-style questioning for DSH: click "Ask in tree" on a selection to add a node to the right-sidebar tree and ask inline under it; clicking another node makes it the current parent, so later selections nest there, Alt+click opens a root node, Ctrl+click appends another passage to the same node, double-click jumps back to the quoted text, a red/green dot marks each node as understood or not, and the panel switches between a list view and a horizontal branch graph. "Add to composer" instead puts the quote into the input box as a reference chip, without creating a node. Nodes live in localStorage and nothing is injected into the prompt.

resources.name: yefengliu1/dsh-agent-grid
resources.desc: Replaces the DSH sidebar with a fixed 2×4 board of eight standing agent seats; each seat shows its own status, latest tool call, reasoning and result, and a settings switch restores the stock sidebar at any time.

resources.name: YEYEYEYESHIFU/dsh-result-only-view
resources.desc: Results-only conversation toggle for the Web GUI: hides thinking and tool-call process rows, keeps one live status line while the agent works, restores working animations under prefers-reduced-motion, zh-CN/en localized. Works in the stock composer and inside dsh-split-screen panes; verified on DSH 0.1.1 and 0.1.5.

resources.name: YEYEYEYESHIFU/dsh-split-screen
resources.desc: Split-screen workspace for the DeepSeek Harness web GUI - chat with several agents side by side in panes that look and behave exactly like the stock conversation: drag-to-split, live sessions with queued messages and in-pane ask_user/approval cards, per-pane view tabs (Chat/Trajectory/plugin views), a compact TUI composer mode (Alt+T) and pane-focus shortcuts. Requires DSH 0.1.5+.

resources.name: yezitotempeace/dsh-auto-think
resources.desc: Expands the assistant reasoning block while it streams and folds it back when done, animated in both directions; the sidebar switch only controls whether that happens automatically.

resources.name: yezitotempeace/dsh-job-progress
resources.desc: Draggable floating card that follows background jobs: a progress bar and percentage parsed from wget/curl/apt/pip output, elapsed time, ETA when present, and the latest output line.

resources.name: yfwu2020/dsh-full-view
resources.desc: Keeps the current chat in a movable, resizable floating window when the right file or browser panel enters full view, with a compact input bar, a whale restore button and a return to the original split layout.

resources.name: yfwu2020/dsh-recent-sessions
resources.desc: Opens the recent sessions in a sheet that floats over the sidebar workspace list, from one row above Settings: rows sorted by last activity with their run state, a draggable height, and a list that settles onto whole rows after stopping. The sheet paints no surface of its own, so it reads as part of the sidebar.

resources.name: yfwu2020/dsh-selection-explain
resources.desc: Select text in the DSH web UI to stream a translation and an explanation of what it means in that specific context, read against the conversation it came from; the panel keeps a replayable history and can be promoted into a full session.

resources.name: yfwu2020/dsh-think-flow
resources.desc: Chain-of-thought panel for the DSH Web right sidebar: folds the live reasoning stream of each session into turn → step groups carrying the reasoning text and the tool calls made in that step. Only the newest turn is expanded by default and earlier turns collapse to one line; steps are grouped into activity phases by a local rule, the step waiting on a tool is marked, tool failures show their reason, full reasoning text is fetched per step on demand, an all-turn directory searches turn titles, user text and turn numbers locally, and a whole turn can be summarised into a Chinese title with one model call.

resources.name: Ygritteee/dsh-ygritte-boot
resources.desc: Full-screen ice-and-fire boot intro for DSH: a frost-to-ember boot sequence with typed bilingual logs and a hairline progress line, then Ygritte's five-step identity authorization. Esc skips, Enter or click fast-forwards, and a settings page switches it off/quick/full or replays it; the host half paints the opening frame while the document parses, so the built-in loading card never shows.

resources.name: Yhx888/dsh-quote-context
resources.desc: Chat quotes for DSH: select text in any message to quote or comment; quotes wait above the composer and become jump-back quote cards in the sent message.

resources.name: yi-yezhiqiu/dsh-prompt-market
resources.desc: Prompt market beside the composer: browse and search three built-in online prompt sources, bookmark or write your own, and insert into the input box.

resources.name: yicun0316/dsh-claude-slider
resources.desc: Replaces the reasoning-effort dropdown with a draggable snapping slider, and draws 13 canvas effects across five style families (thrust, fluid, fantasy, tech, texture) with three tiers that unlock as the effort level rises. Custom mode combines 10 particle forms with 8 flow trajectories; 9 accent presets and a hex picker recolor every effect, and optional key sounds cover two voice clips, a synthesized duck squeak, a mechanical click and a local audio file.

resources.name: Yinxe/deepseek-harness-plugins#archive/file-change-viewer
resources.desc: Takes over the edit/write rows in the chat stream with the official native row shell and collapse behavior; expanding shows per-file code cards with file-type icon, add/delete stats, per-block collapse, highlight/plus-minus toggle, syntax-highlighted unified diff with real file line numbers, and a configurable context margin. Also ships a patch tool (beta, off by default) that applies multi-spot multi-file patches atomically via the * Begin Patch envelope. Frozen archive: keep the pinned version, as the author no longer adapts it to newer DSH releases.

resources.name: YiRan0/dsh-mobile-glass
resources.desc: Mobile adaptation for the DSH Web UI on narrow screens: reveal drawer with the chat layer on top, drag gestures, bottom-sheet settings panel, composer and header fixes, zero desktop impact.

resources.name: yishengjun8/dsh-workspace-studio
resources.desc: Three-pane workspace layout with file-tree browsing, file editing, a non-linear conversation mindmap view, and mobile mode support.

resources.name: YizhouLouisLu/dsh-math-copy
resources.desc: Copying rendered math from the chat puts the formula's LaTeX source on the clipboard instead of KaTeX's visual glyph text.

resources.name: YizhouLouisLu/dsh-select-ask
resources.desc: Select text in the chat to quote it into the composer as an annotation, or to ask about it in a throwaway side panel that leaves no record.

resources.name: ylw-ux/dsh-pins-fixtool
resources.desc: Pins passages selected in a conversation into a per-conversation right-sidebar panel, marks them in the transcript, jumps back to the source passage on click, and quotes a pinned passage into the composer from the selection toolbar or by typing @; the panel tags, searches, filters and exports the pins as a Markdown outline.

resources.name: Yocaihua8/dsh-prompt-improver
resources.desc: Improves conversation drafts with optional conversation, memory and project context, side-by-side previews, a dedicated model and one-step restore; never sends messages automatically.

resources.name: Yokira404/dsh-thinking-highlight
resources.desc: Counts keywords inside thinking rows and highlights them once a row is expanded, with a count chip per keyword on the title line that doubles as an on/off switch for that word, per-keyword tint, text colour and text size (10-22px, the same range the host body-text setting uses), typeface, bold / italic / underline and whole-word matching, plus a dedicated settings section.

resources.name: YokosWY/dsh-calibration-tier
resources.desc: Adds a tier bar to the DSH composer with three thinking tiers (normal, strict, max), an exclusive loop mode whose three levels run 3, 5 or 8 self-review rounds, and a counter-review toggle that stacks on either; the model reads the current tier through the clarify_tier and forge_level tools.

resources.name: yongfanbeta/dsh-pomodoro
resources.desc: Classic 25/5/15 pomodoro timer for DSH that ties each run to the current session task or a manual project name, with a stats panel, a 365-day heatmap, a draggable floating timer and a corner pill, local JSON storage, and CSV export.

resources.name: YooRarely/dsh-open-explorer
resources.desc: Adds buttons to open the current DSH workspace root in the host file manager.

resources.name: youqisibun/dsh-claude-effort-slider
resources.desc: A six-stop reasoning-effort slider for DeepSeek Harness, with a pixel-texture Ultracode mode that sweeps in from right to left and adapts to light and dark themes.

resources.name: youyaemmm-pixel/dsh-custom-lists
resources.desc: Groups the composer model picker into customizable official, plugin and relay sources, with hierarchical navigation, an Our Free Model four-category view, and a dedicated settings page. The Our Free Model view needs dsh-our-free-model installed.

resources.name: YQing0123/dsh-artifact-center
resources.desc: Artifact center: search, preview and open files produced by DSH conversations.

resources.name: ysqp6-lang/dsh-attachment-panel
resources.desc: Delivery panel in the DSH sidebar: indexes every image and file sent to the harness (content-addressed attachments plus @-mentioned local paths), rebuilds Taildrop send history per target device from tailscale file cp calls in the session logs, lists incoming files (the Tailscale inbox plus unmarked files in ~/Downloads), and sends new files to a device from the panel with online status and upload progress.

resources.name: ysyyhhh/dsh-pet
resources.desc: Native desktop pet for DSH that follows agent activity, supports Codex pet packages, and imports approved pets directly from Petdex without its CLI.

resources.name: Yu-tao-Li/dsh-read-image-view
resources.desc: Display read_image results in DSH Web and Desktop: complete previews, grouped multi-image galleries, transparency checkerboards, keyboard and touch zoom, and session-authorized loading. Verified with DSH Desktop 0.11.1 / Harness 0.2.0-rc.2.

resources.name: yu-wenchao/dsh-free-models-hub
resources.desc: A drawer panel for the DSH web UI with a paginated list of free LLMs; one-click or batch writes each as a custom model provider into Settings, plus a local multi-key rotation proxy.

resources.name: yuanbaoerer/dsh-decision-split
resources.desc: Decision split view for DSH web UI: a decision summary card in the main window plus the full plan in an independently scrollable side panel, so you can review the whole plan while writing decisions and send them back to the agent with one click.

resources.name: yuanyiHY/deepseek-media-gallery
resources.desc: Sidebar button that opens a semi-transparent popup for browsing, previewing, downloading and deleting generated images and videos, with a settings page for the media, record and download directories.

resources.name: yuanyiHY/dsh-rail-equalizer
resources.desc: System-audio visualizer for the turn navigator rail: the rail reacts in real time to whatever the default playback device is rendering, with four motion modes (spectrum, pulse, sway, travelling wave), a 16-band logarithmic spectrum from a 2048-point FFT on the host, and live sensitivity, strength, bass-punch and wave-speed controls. Audio is captured host-side through WASAPI loopback, so there is no permission prompt, no microphone and no screen capture. resources.desc: Claude Code Desktop-style theme for DeepSeek Harness (DSH) Desktop 0.2.0-rc.2 on macOS and Windows, with compact sidebar and chat layouts, light and dark themes, model and reasoning-effort controls, and an interactive pixel whale with spout, hop and tail-wag reactions on new sessions.

resources.name: zys2026/dsh-theme-tide
resources.desc: Coastal light and dark palette for the DeepSeek Harness web GUI, built as a token-only ThemeRuntime overlay covering all 107 official alias tokens.

resources.name: 11zld22/dsh-model-info-fill

resources.name: 1624318455/dsh-plugin-adapter
resources.desc: Exposes OpenCode Zen free models to DeepSeek Harness with no API key, tracking Zen gateway changes.

resources.name: 2239058652/dsh-loomy-connect
resources.desc: Registers the models bundled with the Xunfei Loomy desktop app as a loomy provider in DSH, reading the app's local sign-in session instead of an API key. Fork of gdrpzym/dsh-loomy-connect adapted to DSH 0.2.1, adding a per-model enable/disable switch. Requires the Loomy desktop app installed and signed in; it cannot be installed alongside gdrpzym/dsh-loomy-connect because both register the same loomy provider.

resources.name: 2404723600/dsh-router-loomy
resources.desc: Registers the Xunfei Loomy cloud channel as an OpenAI-compatible supplier in dsh-router, adding model listing and streaming chat completions.

resources.name: 2861292267/DSH-Official-WorkBuddy-Credit-Proxy
resources.desc: Pools every WorkBuddy account signed in on this machine into one auto-failing-over provider, serving OpenAI Chat, OpenAI Responses and Anthropic Messages from the same pool, with model aliases, usage statistics and scheduled credit automation.

resources.name: 643048695/dsh-auto-retry
resources.desc: Retry failed model requests automatically: intercepts every request error and replays the same step after a 2s / 5s / 10s / 20s backoff ladder, so gateway blips and rate limits no longer end the turn.

resources.name: 643048695/dsh-subagent-role-router
resources.desc: Route DSH subagent delegations to configured models with per-role routing for explore, plan and patch subagents, round-robin or random distribution, cross-provider failover, and active-window slicing of fork seeds.

resources.name: 66rapper/dsh-model-auto-enricher
resources.desc: Model channel auto-enricher for DeepSeek Harness: eliminates manually configuring contextWindow, maxTokens, \[text, image] multimodal input, and {low, high, max} reasoning effort tiers model by model after adding a provider channel, with live auto-enrichment on save, a Settings UI page, and timestamped backups.

resources.name: a1141171521/dsh-multi-agent-gateway
resources.desc: Adds six AI coding platforms to DSH — OpenCode, Qoder, Qoder CN, TRAE, WorkBuddy and WorkBuddy International — each as its own group in the native model picker, and manages their accounts from one settings page, with daily check-in where the platform has one, credit balance lookups, and retry on another account of the same platform when one is rate-limited. Models carry their credit multiplier where the platform declares one. OpenCode's anonymous free tier works with no credential, and TRAE stays hidden by default until it is enabled in the settings.

resources.name: a2580vb/dsh-llm-opencode-go
resources.desc: OpenCode Go in the DeepSeek Harness model list, providing subscription quota display, model discovery, session affinity, and more.

resources.name: a331266223/dsh-multi-model-discussion
resources.desc: Multi-model deliberation pipeline for DeepSeek Harness: independent proposals, blind peer review, program-executed evidence verification, immutable revision and independent acceptance on a fresh context.

resources.name: A42Null/dsh-opencode-zen-plugin
resources.desc: OpenCode Console (Zen) models for DeepSeek Harness: paste a Console API key under Settings → Plugins and the Console's chat models become selectable, with the catalog synced automatically, each model routed to the endpoint the official docs assign, and free *-free models hidden by default because they only run inside the OpenCode client.

resources.name: a981008/dsh-switch
resources.desc: Mirrors cc-switch providers and models into DeepSeek Harness the moment they are saved, and shows each provider's plan windows, account balance, or custom usage script in the composer and the settings card.

resources.name: aa2246740/dsh-antigravity-oauth
resources.desc: Unofficial Gemini Cloud Code Assist OAuth integration with isolated account storage; carries account-ban risk.

resources.name: aa2246740/dsh-model-fusion
resources.desc: Adds a model route where a Lead plans and reviews while a Sidekick performs code changes.

resources.name: aa2246740/dsh-oauth-login
resources.desc: Adds subscription OAuth and provider Plan API-key logins through Pi adapters, using a DSH-owned credential store.

resources.name: AdonisSheldon/dsh-openai-oauth
resources.desc: Connect a ChatGPT account to Codex models in DeepSeek Harness through browser PKCE or device-code OAuth, with automatic token refresh and Web or headless login.

resources.name: aerince/dsh-models-dev-reasoning
resources.desc: Adds models.dev reasoning levels to unconfigured third-party DeepSeek Harness models.

resources.name: ai-yukin/dsh-0-tools
resources.desc: One-click free-model setup for DSH web, built for coding beginners: one-click installer for Windows (install.bat) and macOS/Linux (install.sh, v1.7.0+); four permanently free channels — Zhipu GLM (text + image), SiliconFlow (Qwen3-8B plus 15+ sub-9B models), iFlytek Spark Lite and the OpenRouter free pool, which routes through openrouter/auto and picks from a pool that changes over time; bottom-left setup hint hides once any free model is connected; real-time DeepSeek peak/off-peak pricing reminder; bundled beginner help center.

resources.name: AIcivilization/dsh-model
resources.desc: One authenticated OpenAI-compatible endpoint (built on CLIProxyAPI) for dsh and other tools: gathers WorkBuddy, OpenCode Zen, local Ollama / LM Studio and CLI subscriptions such as Codex and Kimi, signs in from the dsh page without installing their CLIs, and syncs the picked models into dsh grouped by source. The settings page has a switch per source with free / paid tags, plan usage, API keys with 24-hour stats, per-source model picking, and update / uninstall. Runs on macOS, Linux (including next to dsh-vps) and Windows.

resources.name: AidenOrz/dsh-workbuddy-connect
resources.desc: Drop-in successor to the now-deleted corrinehu/dsh-workbuddy-connect, keeping its package name, config row id and provider ids so an existing install upgrades in place. Also fixes the 400/11128 channel check by neutralising the DSH identity sentences and scrubbing the product name from system messages, and reads the real Windows client and bundled CLI versions instead of a compiled constant, unlike the functy and community forks. Verified 2026-10-21 on Windows, WorkBuddy 5.8.3, DSH 0.2.1-rc.2.

resources.name: Akiyuki1130/dsh-ark-coding-provider
resources.desc: Unofficial Volcengine Ark Coding Plan LLM provider: registers an ark-coding route with 12 models (capacity facts measured per model), multi-account with automatic rotation, a bundled pinned arkcli for the official model catalog and live plan quota, plus a settings wizard and a sidebar usage card.

resources.name: AkutagawaKoyori/dsh-zcode-start
resources.desc: Uses Z.ai / ZCode Start Plan quota inside DeepSeek Harness as a GLM model provider (GLM-5.3-Flash, GLM-5.3) with tool calling and reasoning levels; the settings page shows quota bars, gifted-plan claiming, refresh opportunities and a redacted request log. Requires the ZCode desktop app installed and signed in at least once (the plugin reads its local credential store) and an account with an active Z.ai / Start Plan entitlement.

resources.name: Alice-Marx/dsh-model-router
resources.desc: Routes DeepSeek Harness work across configured model APIs and supported vendor CLIs with dependency-aware packages and cost previews.

resources.name: AlyceStocking/dsh-harness-switch
resources.desc: Adds Kimi models to native DSH sessions with per-model selection of the embedded Kimi core or DSH native execution.

resources.name: amlyczz/dsh-agy-link
resources.desc: Google Antigravity (agy CLI) models for DSH — streaming chat with Gemini/Claude/GPT-OSS subscriptions, native tool cards, thinking turns, and in-GUI Google OAuth login.

resources.name: Ansonfishing/dsh-model-manager
resources.desc: Control panel for local LLM inference servers in the DSH web view: service registry with health checks and stop controls, named parameter profiles for llama.cpp, SGLang and vLLM with pre-save KV/VRAM validation, GPU detection, and tok/s benchmarks.

resources.name: antonio-mastropaolo/dsh-anthropic-membership
resources.desc: Sign in to DeepSeek Harness with a Claude Pro/Max membership (no API key), downscale Anthropic request images to a 2000px long edge, slim /compact summarizer payloads, and show 5-hour/weekly plan usage plus DSH message counts.

resources.name: anye-99/dsh-codearts-auth
resources.desc: Signs in to Huawei Cloud CodeArts and registers CodeBuddy, WorkBuddy, LobsterAI, Qoder (global and China), TRAE, Cline, Loomy, Raccoon Work, MiniMax Code, TeleAgent, ZCode, Step Code and Antigravity as LLM providers, with per-provider account pools; several of them also show quota balance and daily check-in in the same panel.

resources.name: apolenkov/dsh-provider-proxy
resources.desc: Routes outbound model traffic per provider host or per model ID through chosen proxies, loopback or direct, configured from a Plugins settings page.

resources.name: ArcaneOrion/dsh-model-channel-manager
resources.desc: Model channel manager: several provider/model candidates share one virtual route (roundrobin/<group>) with failover, retry, timeout and cooldown; a settings tab edits providers and groups, runs per-model speed tests and real single-model request tests, and a seven-day health panel aggregates latency, failures and upstream token usage (input, output, cache and reasoning).

resources.name: architect-xyz/liquid-dsh-plugin
resources.desc: Adds the Liquid Inference auction exchange as a model route, with liquid.auto and its ranking variants, and four tools that read offers, markets, routers and job receipts. Requires a Liquid Inference API key (LIQUID_API_KEY, spend scope).

resources.name: arnen7000/dsh-workbuddy-model
resources.desc: Adds the models available in a signed-in WorkBuddy desktop app to DeepSeek Harness as a model provider, with the CN and international apps as separate groups. It is a rebuilt derivative of the npm package dsh-workbuddy-connect@0.7.9 (originally corrinehu/dsh-workbuddy-connect); it registers the same workbuddy / workbuddy-ai provider ids, so it cannot be installed alongside other WorkBuddy bridges.

resources.name: Asheblog/dsh-ollama-cloud
resources.desc: Ollama Cloud provider for DeepSeek Harness: adds the chat route on install, publishes each model's own thinking levels for the composer effort control, keeps the model list current from the endpoint (/api/tags and /api/show, cached for offline boots), shows the account allowance with an API-key field in the Models page and sidebar, and offers Ollama's web search and fetch as selectable DSH web providers.

resources.name: Ayelsh/reasoning-setup
resources.desc: Edit reasoning effort levels and thinking formats for models that declare none.

resources.name: Ayowait/dsh-official-reasoning-effort
resources.desc: Official-style model + reasoning-effort control for the composer. Reuses the official picker and always offers Off/Low/High/Max — exactly like the official DeepSeek control — even when a gateway model declares no reasoning effort, with a small hint at the panel bottom when upstream does not natively support it.

resources.name: Ayowait/dsh-reasoning-effort-new
resources.desc: Fork of dsh-reasoning-effort with a two-level model picker in the composer: a provider list, a model pane that slides out beside it, search, and compact rows, alongside the reasoning-effort slider and its max-level effects.

resources.name: Ayowait/dsh-send-photos
resources.desc: Declares image input on relay routes whose endpoint omits modality metadata, so models that can see photos stop being rejected as text-only. This also overrides routes that are explicitly declared text-only.

resources.name: bainianlaoyao/dsh-codex-harness
resources.desc: Codex-shaped coding tools and agent presets for GPT models on DeepSeek Harness: exec_command, write_stdin, apply_patch and view_image, plus OpenAI Chat Completions and Responses API routes, bridged to DSH-native plan, ask, approval and compaction. Long-running commands become DSH background jobs with bounded head/tail output readable through job_output, and each subagent type can be pinned to its own preset, provider, model and reasoning effort.

resources.name: bainianlaoyao/dsh-llm-api-pool
resources.desc: Pools several OpenCode Go API keys and hot-switches each request to the least-used one, with official usage and balance lookup plus a graphical settings page.

resources.name: BaoBao1996121/dsh-chatgpt-subscription
resources.desc: Adds native Codex OAuth sign-in, main-Agent default model selection, and direct or local-proxy settings for DSH Desktop 0.2.0-rc.2 on Windows.

resources.name: Bazley13/dsh-multi-model-orchestrator
resources.desc: Multi-model orchestrator: the main brain decomposes complex tasks and dispatches subtasks to GLM / Kimi / Qwen sub-agents by each model's strengths, with per-model token usage.

resources.name: beibing173/dsh-codex-gpt
resources.desc: OpenAI OAuth login for ChatGPT Codex that adds ChatGPT as a selectable LLM provider (streaming, Off/Low/High/Max reasoning effort, image input) and a codex tool for per-session DeepSeek escalation, with optional light-task delegation to DeepSeek and subscription usage and reset-credit management.

resources.name: beijingwahw/dsh-proactive
resources.desc: Proactive multi-model scheduling plugin: multi-source signal intake with dedup and urgency ranking, a four-way execute/defer/dismiss/ask-user decision engine, DAG plan generation with parallel model execution, quality reflection with automatic retry and model switch, long-term memory for task patterns and lessons, and strategy evolution via genetic algorithms with sandboxed evaluation and canary rollout.

resources.name: bill277048-hash/DSH-model-router
resources.desc: Rule-based multi-provider model routing for DeepSeek Harness with pre-first-token failover, cooldown circuit-breaking, usage accounting, and a status API.

resources.name: bitxeno/dsh-magpie-connect
resources.desc: Magpie gateway provider for DSH: syncs gateway models into the picker with visibility control, image input and thinking levels.

resources.name: boe1900/owndsh#owndsh-plugin
resources.desc: Early-stage plugin connecting DeepSeek Harness to a separately deployed, self-hosted OwnDsh server for team identity, model access control, quotas, and usage auditing.

resources.name: Boomerangz/dsh-openrouter-live
resources.desc: OpenRouter provider that reads the live /models list, so new models appear without a harness release: models sorted by name with input/output prices, per-model reasoning levels, image input, reasoning_details replay, Anthropic prompt caching, and actual spend per session including subagents from OpenRouter usage.cost, shown under the Web UI composer and by /cost.

resources.name: BruceLanLan/dsh-tier-router
resources.desc: Two-tier model routing: a strong tier plans, advises and reviews while a cheap tier implements, with plan-mode-aware auto routing, a high-impact escalation guard, failure auto-escalation, and subagent tiering.

resources.name: bushizhanghan/dsh-workbuddy-harness
resources.desc: Brings WorkBuddy free/paid models (domestic + international) into DSH without the desktop app, published as @bushizhanghan/dsh-workmate.
