resources.name: callqh/dsh-codex-oauth
resources.desc: Adds a Codex sign-in page to DSH settings, driving the built-in llm-pi-ai OAuth flow for browser or device-code login and showing masked account status without a separate provider or credential store.

resources.name: CARVIN94/dsh-router
resources.desc: An AI routing gateway that runs as a DSH plugin. Adds a Routing System sidebar panel for suppliers, account pool, fallback combos and API keys, and serves an OpenAI-compatible endpoint at http://localhost:3080/v1.

resources.name: CARVIN94/dsh-router-codebuddy
resources.desc: CodeBuddy supplier plugin for dsh-router. Handles one account at a time with polling OAuth login and token refresh, leaving account selection, cooldown and check-in to dsh-router core.

resources.name: CARVIN94/dsh-router-qoder
resources.desc: Qoder supplier plugin for dsh-router, covering both the CN and international regions. Uses a personal access token for authentication, signs requests to the Qoder cosy gateway and converts upstream SSE to OpenAI SSE; the model list reports the upstream display name alongside the key, while account selection and cooldown stay in dsh-router core.

resources.name: CARVIN94/dsh-router-traework
resources.desc: TRAE SOLO supplier plugin for dsh-router, ported from traework2api. Provides the traework supplier, a free SOLO chat channel, and reports single-account status to dsh-router core.

resources.name: ccccwwwxx/dsh-bifenggang
resources.desc: Time-based model routing: a settings panel defines weekday peak and off-peak windows and the provider/model each one uses, the choices are read from the harness registry (API keys and subscription logins alike), and a global switch decides whether that policy sets the model and reasoning effort of every request. The switch is independent per session, each session row carries a light showing its own state, and the settings panel names the model in force right now and why. A day no window matches — every weekend and holiday — uses the primary model of the first plan; the advanced thinking model is a separate axis, used only when a session itself asks for max reasoning.

resources.name: Cci-65/deepseek-harness-plugin
resources.desc: Adds configurable reasoning levels for third-party models and a model-strength picker in the composer.

resources.name: ccl4-56-23-5/DSH-Plugins#api-switcher
resources.desc: Manage API providers and enabled models, with provider-grouped model switching and keyword search in the native model menu.

resources.name: ccsert/dsh-subagent-hub#subagent-hub
resources.desc: Named subagent presets bound to model-route allowlists, where an out-of-list child model is refused before a delegation starts and each child conversation shows the model its last request actually used.

resources.name: ChaYeWuu/dsh-hyperworkbuddy
resources.desc: Bring the WorkBuddy accounts signed in on this machine into DSH, managing CN and international accounts separately. Supports automatic failover between accounts, one-click refresh of model catalogs and credits, the CN daily check-in, and a togglable OpenAI-compatible endpoint.

resources.name: chen704290901chen/dsh-newapi-video
resources.desc: Call a new-api (one-api style) relay station's video model from the conversation with @-referenced image/video materials, supporting Seedance 2.0 and Happyhorse text-to-video and image-to-video across four relay protocols.

resources.name: chengshenyangtai/dsh-workbuddy-trae-qoder-connect

resources.name: chengzhi-c/dsh-wtq-pool
resources.desc: Brings the WorkBuddy, Trae and Qoder desktop logins on this machine into DeepSeek Harness as OpenAI-compatible local endpoints, with an account pool, automatic account switching when WorkBuddy is rate limited, and a settings panel.

resources.name: ChimeSky/dsh-effort-keeper
resources.desc: Remembers the reasoning effort you explicitly chose for each provider and model and restores it when you switch back, without replacing DSH's own model picker.

resources.name: chimneyQ/dsh-model-rotator
resources.desc: Ranks the models a DeepSeek Harness install already discovered by measured connectivity and speed, and switches to the next candidate inside the same turn when the one in use fails without producing any output. Ships a settings page with a grouped model list, per-model and per-channel switches, and a quota-aware cooldown that rests an exhausted model until the next day.

resources.name: ckanner/dsh-plugin-chatgpt
resources.desc: Signs in to a ChatGPT account over OAuth and serves that plan's models as a DeepSeek Harness provider route, calling api.openai.com/v1/responses with the account's plan scope rather than the Codex backend.

resources.name: Clukay-Fun/dsh-gpt-link

resources.name: CREAIT-nl/dsh-plugins#gen-limit
resources.desc: Per provider/model generation concurrency, with a settings card: a cap on how many sessions may stream at once, enforced at the stream and again at subagent spawn, where a fan-out past the cap waits in a FIFO queue instead of failing.

resources.name: CREAIT-nl/dsh-plugins#think-level
resources.desc: A thinking level stored per provider and model, so reasoning effort outlives the session it was set in and also reaches subagents, which dsh never asks. The in-session picker still wins, and a model with no row keeps its provider default.

resources.name: ct-jyjntc/dsh-model-modality
resources.desc: Declare whether a configured third-party model accepts image (multimodal) input; writes the modality into the owning provider settings and verifies it through runtime model resolution.

resources.name: ctianye/dsh_gearbox
resources.desc: Reasoning-effort gear presets for third-party models: 16 vendor/model presets with per-mode custom wire values, written into dsh-llm-pi-ai with pre-write validation and per-rule rejection; per-model switching between OpenAI Chat Completions, OpenAI Responses and Anthropic Messages with automatic route regrouping; plus a composer Optimize button and a settings section that rewrite the input text with a model you pick.

resources.name: cuboteam/dsh-plugin-dit
resources.desc: DIT.ai provider bundle for DeepSeek Harness: installs 29 OpenAI Chat Completions models and 10 Anthropic Messages models from one DIT_API_KEY, with protocol-specific thinking configuration.

resources.name: cv-superding/dsh-deepseek-web-login
resources.desc: Adds a deepseek-web provider that uses chat.deepseek.com web models in DSH, with browser login capture, PoW request signing, SSE streaming, and prompting-based tool calls.

resources.name: cybtachyon/dsh-plugin-local-infer
resources.desc: A DeepSeek Harness plugin that manages local inference engines.

resources.name: CynthiaYX/dsh-plan-act-models
resources.desc: A simplified version of the Plan/Act feature in the RooCode and Cline VS Code extensions, binding one provider, model and reasoning effort to plan mode and another to act mode, with per-workspace overrides.

resources.name: CypherNaught-0x/DSH-Subagent-Model-Router
resources.desc: Automatically and intelligently routes each delegated task to the best configured model using aliases, capability tags, and usage guidance—keeping routine work fast and affordable while sending complex work to stronger specialists. Configure your model team in the Web UI or guided setup, run specialists in parallel with reliable result joining, and see the chosen model at a glance in subagent views and inline in Better Sidebar's Tasks tree.

resources.name: Dalizi2026/dsh-factory-provider
resources.desc: Factory (Droid) subscription quota as native DSH model providers, with three protocol routes, your own API key through a loopback gateway, and a settings page for connection status, quota, per-model token statistics and key switching.

resources.name: darkings/dsh-agy-provider
resources.desc: DSH model provider for the locally authenticated AGY CLI: Gemini/Claude model discovery, independent reasoning effort, DSH-owned tools, bounded context and tool-result handling, and Windows-safe streaming. Report problems in GitHub Issues: https://github.com/darkings/dsh-agy-provider/issues.

resources.name: dat-lequoc/dsh-kiro
resources.desc: Kiro model provider with Builder ID, Identity Center, Google, GitHub and credential-import sign-in, automatic token and profile refresh, account usage, live model discovery, selectable reasoning efforts, streaming tool calls, provider stop-reason and context-overflow handling, and token accounting that uses Kiro's exact counters when it sends them and otherwise scales the context-usage percentage it does send by the model's advertised window.

resources.name: DavidRm1911/dsh-llm-subscription
resources.desc: Adds Claude, Gemini, and a local Ollama model to DSH's native model picker, using your existing Claude Code / Antigravity CLI logins instead of a metered API key, with a working reasoning-effort selector for Claude.

resources.name: dawnliming/dsh-chinese-mode
resources.desc: Global Chinese mode: a compact pill switch beside the composer that injects a language requirement into any preset's system prompt (complete personas excepted); reply, thinking and tool output each toggle between Chinese and English, and anchored presets are supported.

resources.name: DeepseekDays/dsh-ofm-model-manager
resources.desc: Per-model enable/disable and renaming for every provider in DeepSeek Harness: a panel at the bottom of Settings - Models with a search box, status chips with counts, a provider filter, collapsible provider groups with group-level switches, and batch actions scoped to the current view. Disabled models leave the model picker and custom names replace the built-in ones. Preferences persist in the profile and apply immediately, without reloading the page or restarting DSH.

resources.name: DeepseekDays/dsh-provider-toggle
resources.desc: Adds a one-click switch to every provider row in Settings - Models: turn a provider off and it leaves the model picker, turn it back on and it returns. It works by wrapping the model catalog call, so it affects the catalog and the picker only, never routing, keys or provider config; existing sessions that already use such a model keep working.

resources.name: DeZhou123/dsh-model-orchestrator
resources.desc: Two-level model routing: pick the best model group first, then the best channel within that model; a failure switches channel before switching model. Preference mode pins one model across its channels, a status bar under the composer shows the live model, channel health and the day's token usage, and a speed/intelligence report can be imported as the routing prior. Exposes a model_orchestrator tool and a /route command.

resources.name: dingminhua/dsh-connect-qoder
resources.desc: Connects Qoder (Lingma CN / international) models to DSH through their PATs, with a per-region multi-account pool, daily check-in, automatic failover, and read-only credit visibility.

resources.name: dingminhua/dsh-connect-trae
resources.desc: Connects locally signed-in Trae CN models to DSH, supports DSH-executed tool calls, account switching, and Work/general credit visibility.

resources.name: dingminhua/dsh-connect-workbuddy
resources.desc: Connects locally signed-in WorkBuddy models, CN and international alike, to DSH, reading each model's credit multiplier from the upstream catalog on every refresh, with per-model image input toggles, account switching backed by an auto-failing-over pool, manual daily check-in, and read-only credit overviews shown as compact pills on the card and in the composer.

resources.name: dingminhua/dsh-subagent-default-model#plugin
resources.desc: Configurable default model for subagent delegations via settings.yaml, with single-model and multi-model round-robin or random strategies.

resources.name: DragonHorizon-xtihc/dsh-connect-opencode-free
resources.desc: Connect OpenCode Zen free-tier models into DeepSeek Harness. Real-time model discovery, per-model toggle in settings, one-click provider write. No API key required.

resources.name: DragonHorizon-xtihc/dsh-connect-trae-models
resources.desc: Aggregates all local Trae accounts into one auto-failover model provider, with manual and automated daily check-in, credits and expiry monitoring, and a model selection settings card.

resources.name: DragonHorizon-xtihc/dsh-connect-workbuddy-models
resources.desc: Aggregates every WorkBuddy account already signed in on this machine into one model pool, with manual and scheduled check-in, credits and expiry monitoring, per-model credit multipliers, and account switching with remaining credits right below the composer.

resources.name: drscrewdriver/dsh-llm-openai-completions
resources.desc: OpenAI-completions-compatible adapter for custom gateways (vLLM / LM Studio / self-hosted proxies): always role:"system", thinking driven by the model config, Qwen-style response split, and vision-model image input (single / multiple).

resources.name: drscrewdriver/dsh-thinking-levels
resources.desc: Per-round thinking-level (reasoning_effort) control for DeepSeek Harness: pick Auto and it schedules low/high/max from the recent tool-call history, or fix a wire level (off/on/minimal/low/medium/high/xhigh/max) manually, with custom wire mapping, a model-aware capability guard, and context-window presets (64K–1M); its per-model capability card pairs with a separate plugin, dsh-llm-openai-completions (installable from dsh-market), so custom OpenAI-compatible gateways (vLLM / LM Studio / self-hosted) can try reasoning — the card writes llm-pi-ai capabilities, the adapter drives the wire (compat.thinkingFormat), and this plugin auto-maintains the takeover list.

resources.name: dsh-plugin-lab/dsh-workbuddy-bridge
resources.desc: Brings WorkBuddy desktop-app models into DeepSeek Harness: the China and international builds each appear as their own group in the model picker, with the reasoning tiers the upstream declares, per-reply credit cost and remaining balance, per-account model visibility, and image input where supported.

resources.name: du-yuxuan/OneKey-Models
resources.desc: One-click TokenDance gateway access for DeepSeek Harness: OAuth sign-in stores the API key, a live model catalog with per-model visibility, and agent tools for chat, image generation, video generation and typed decisions.

resources.name: Duskriver/dsh-opencode-go
resources.desc: OpenCode Go provider with live gateway model discovery, online models.dev capability metadata, session routing, and Web settings with subscription usage.

resources.name: dylan121322/llm-adaptive
resources.desc: Adaptive model routing: per-request complexity classification with automatic provider routing.

resources.name: DZQJOKER/dsh-plugin-local-model
resources.desc: Local model plugin for DeepSeek Harness: manage GGUF models in settings, auto-launch llama.cpp on first message, and auto-unload after 5 minutes of idle time to free VRAM.

resources.name: ebluffy/dsh-model-router
resources.desc: English-only fork of dsh-model-router. Routes each agent step across a configurable model pool and adjusts reasoning effort based on task complexity, tool failures, and cost.

resources.name: Ebony-Vinyl/dsh-our-free-model
resources.desc: Adds free model lanes to DeepSeek Harness — DeepSeek V4.1 Flash, Kimi K3 and others — with no login, sign-up or API key, plus a local OpenAI-compatible gateway, fallback routing and a usage dashboard.

resources.name: edge-sky/dsh-oauth-adapter
resources.desc: Provides an OAuth account page for DSH Web, currently supporting OpenAI Codex, GitHub Copilot, Anthropic, Kimi For Coding, OpenRouter, and xAI.

resources.name: eghrhegpe/dsh-connect-agnes-token-plan
resources.desc: One-tap connect Agnes language, image and video models into DSH (off by default), with image recognition and thinking level filled in automatically. After signing in to the Agnes console (re-login uses AGNES_PASSWORD), you can see the quota windows (5-hour requests, weekly requests, daily images, video), account-wide cumulative usage, and a usage pill beside the input box. AgnesCode desktop models can be connected too (Windows only), re-reading the desktop app login when the token expires, with rate-limit hits backing off on their own.

resources.name: eghrhegpe/dsh-connect-modelscope-token-plan
resources.desc: One-tap connect ModelScope language and image-generation models into DSH (off by default), with image recognition and context window filled in automatically. You can also see the free Magicube balance, jump to a model's info page, and record local call counts, trends and rate-limit events, with a usage pill beside the input box showing the balance and today's local count. All of it needs only an API key, with no account sign-in.

resources.name: eghrhegpe/dsh-connect-qoder
resources.desc: Registers Qoder CN and international language models into DSH, fetching each model's rate automatically as it shifts with off-peak hours. It also provides a daily check-in, a usage pill and a credit lookup. Needs the Qoder login state on this machine, or one browser login.

resources.name: eghrhegpe/dsh-connect-sensenova-token-plan
resources.desc: One-tap connect SenseNova Token Plan language and image models into DSH (off by default), with image recognition and thinking level filled in automatically. On a rate limit it backs off and retries on its own instead of misreading it as an exhausted quota. After signing in to the SenseNova console you can see the usage pill, credit pools and per-model consumption. Xiaohuanxiong can also be signed in by QR code, bringing in its models and their consumption multipliers, and taking over DSH web search.

resources.name: elegant01/dsh-codearts
resources.desc: Connects Huawei Cloud CodeArts to DeepSeek Harness with built-in OAuth2 sign-in (PKCE + DPoP) or a pasted token, after which CodeArts models are available in the DSH conversation window. Reads per-account credit balance, expiring credits and daily check-in from the CodeArts credit API, counts requests and tokens locally, and shows a per-account credits popover under the chat input box; the credits line and the upstream queue hint can each be turned off in settings.

resources.name: EliteOtaku/dsh-opendesign-go
resources.desc: OpenDesign Go provider: 12 subscription models over Chat Completions, the real 5-hour and 7-day quota read from the local OpenDesign app, per-model parameters and switches, and multi-account failover.

resources.name: elizax/dsh-http-proxy
resources.desc: Wraps globalThis.fetch to route DeepSeek Harness model-API requests through an HTTP/SOCKS proxy by target domain, leaving all other requests on the direct connection, without modifying Harness source.

resources.name: EmotionG/dsh-llm-config
resources.desc: Requires DSH >= 0.2.0-rc.2 < 0.3.0. Declare any number of LLM providers, each with its own endpoint, credential and per-model parameters (reasoning-effort vocabulary, image input, retry policy), across the OpenAI Chat, OpenAI Responses, Anthropic Messages and Google Gemini wire formats, configured from a settings page.

resources.name: ethanweave/dsh-connect-workbuddy
resources.desc: Runs a local OpenAI-compatible gateway so DSH can use the model quota of a logged-in Tencent CodeBuddy (WorkBuddy) account: one-shot installer with SHA256 verification, logon scheduled task with duplicate-launch guard, manage.ps1 for status/start/stop/restart/logs/update/uninstall, and an agent skill that drives setup and troubleshooting.

resources.name: Eve-146T/DSH-CODEX-SUBSCRIPTION-POOL
resources.desc: Use your ChatGPT/Codex subscriptions in DSH, with image generation and web search support.

resources.name: Faide-cyber/dsh-workbuddy
resources.desc: Bring WorkBuddy's free and paid models (domestic and international) into DSH — no WorkBuddy desktop app required.

resources.name: FelixJiashengFu/dsh-haoba-mode
resources.desc: A gold switch beside the composer that raises every model request to the strongest reasoning effort the current model declares and to its default max output tokens, and adds a system-prompt section asking for exhaustive, self-checked work.

resources.name: ffyuuu/dsh-llm-longcat
resources.desc: LongCat-2.0 LLM adapter: 1M context, binary thinking mode, tool calling, and streaming over the OpenAI-compatible endpoint.

resources.name: fieldnote-ops/keyringseam
resources.desc: macOS Keychain credential provider that replaces the local-file provider and uses a signed, notarized universal helper.

resources.name: Firefox2100/dsh-ai-providers#anthropic
resources.desc: Anthropic provider using the native Messages API for language models in DSH. Requires Firefox2100/dsh-ai-providers#runtime to be installed and enabled.

resources.name: Firefox2100/dsh-ai-providers#cohere
resources.desc: Cohere provider for language models, embeddings, and reranking through Cohere's native APIs in DSH. Requires Firefox2100/dsh-ai-providers#runtime to be installed and enabled.

resources.name: Firefox2100/dsh-ai-providers#dashscope
resources.desc: Alibaba Cloud DashScope provider for Qwen language models, embeddings, reranking, speech, and image generation through native APIs in DSH. Requires Firefox2100/dsh-ai-providers#runtime to be installed and enabled.

resources.name: Firefox2100/dsh-ai-providers#jina
resources.desc: Jina provider for embeddings and reranking in DSH. Requires Firefox2100/dsh-ai-providers#runtime to be installed and enabled.

resources.name: Firefox2100/dsh-ai-providers#localai
resources.desc: LocalAI provider for language models, embeddings, reranking, speech, and image generation with LocalAI-specific controls in DSH. Requires Firefox2100/dsh-ai-providers#runtime to be installed and enabled.

resources.name: Firefox2100/dsh-ai-providers#ollama
resources.desc: Ollama provider for language models and embeddings, with model discovery, loading, and unloading in DSH. Requires Firefox2100/dsh-ai-providers#runtime to be installed and enabled.

resources.name: Firefox2100/dsh-ai-providers#openai
resources.desc: OpenAI provider for language models, embeddings, text-to-speech, speech-to-text, and image generation in DSH. Requires Firefox2100/dsh-ai-providers#runtime to be installed and enabled.

resources.name: Firefox2100/dsh-ai-providers#runtime
resources.desc: AI provider runtime and configuration UI for shared credentials and embedding, reranking, speech, and image generation services in DSH.

resources.name: Firefox2100/dsh-ai-providers#typesafe
resources.desc: TypeSafe AI Jev decision provider for typed probabilistic choices and scores in DSH. Requires Firefox2100/dsh-ai-providers#runtime to be installed and enabled.

resources.name: FishBottle7/opencode2dsh
resources.desc: Exposes OpenCode Zen free models to DeepSeek Harness, with no API key.

resources.name: FitBBC/dsh-plugin-tokenmarket
resources.desc: Adds Token Market as an OpenAI-compatible model provider with DeepSeek V4 Pro, Kimi K3, and GLM-5.3.

resources.name: Fleey/deepseek-harness-acp
resources.desc: Registers external ACP (Agent Client Protocol) agents such as Codex, Claude Code and Gemini CLI as DSH model providers: maps each agent's thought_level options to the reasoning-effort selector, forwards images when the agent advertises promptCapabilities.image, and routes permission requests to DSH's approval dialog; ships an ACP Agents settings page that imports Zed agent_servers JSON and discovers models.

resources.name: Fleey/deepseek-harness-trae
resources.desc: Connects Trae enterprise models to DeepSeek Harness from a personal access token alone, calling llm_raw_chat directly with no trae2api or traecli process; fetches the model catalog from upstream on startup and shows remaining quota for personal packs and enterprise seats.

resources.name: fortran2005/dsh-baipiao-shigege
resources.desc: Tiers free-channel models into three 1M fallback chains plus a custom chain; orders them by measured throughput, drops models below throughput or error-rate thresholds, and rotates accounts. Requires an OpenAI-compatible gateway (default :8326).

resources.name: franksong2702/dsh-codex-connect
resources.desc: Connect ChatGPT OAuth and OpenAI Codex models to DeepSeek Harness, with opt-in search and image tools.

resources.name: frederico-kluser/dsh-orquestrator
resources.desc: Pick the model your subagents run on — with a reasoning-effort ceiling and an output-token cap — enforced in code on every child DSH starts, whichever tool starts it.

resources.name: fu827707013/dsh-codebuddy-cli
resources.desc: Reuses the CodeBuddy CLI sign-in to bring its models into DeepSeek Harness, with a settings card showing account, token expiry, and remaining credit.

resources.name: functy23/dsh-workbuddy-panel
resources.desc: Hosts the WorkBuddy2API gateway in DSH with a native panel, a separately updatable kernel, and outbound fingerprint alignment with WorkBuddy Desktop 5.9.2.

resources.name: FuSheng-cs/Trae2api-dsh
resources.desc: Use TRAE account model quota in dsh, with multi-account management, daily check-in, rotation, usage statistics, reasoning levels and model visibility. Requires Python 3.10+; the first run downloads Python dependencies.

resources.name: GaoHu1997/dsh-model-think-level
resources.desc: Third-party model settings for DeepSeek Harness: pick a provider and a model in the composer menu, gate a model's thinking level with one switch on the official Models page card, and configure per-route request headers.

resources.name: Garybot126/dsh-subagent-models
resources.desc: Set the provider, model and reasoning effort delegated subagents run with, from one chip beside the composer: a per-conversation override and a profile-wide default share the same two controls, and the chip always shows the effective route. Applied on the agent/request hook to every in-process child; no settings page, no preset edits, no model-facing tool parameters.

resources.name: Gaudi-XIX/dsh-agy-cli
resources.desc: Windows-only model provider for Google Antigravity CLI, continuing Darkings/dsh-agy-provider (install as dsh-agy-cli; do not install alongside the original). It reads the Antigravity token from the Windows Credential Manager and sends it only to the Google Cloud Code endpoints, lets DSH own the harness tool policy, streams the tail without rollback, and tracks the real quota windows.

resources.name: Gaudi-XIX/dsh-zcode-cli
resources.desc: Runs the locally installed ZCode CLI as a zcode model route in DSH: all traffic is signed by the official binary, the plugin never sends its own request, forges client requests or sends credentials off the machine (the plan token is decrypted in memory only to hand back to the official CLI), no API key is needed, and both a paid one-shot and a free app-server channel are supported. Since v0.3.0 it ships an HTTP MCP bridge so tool calls run through the DSH approval surface. Backed by a contract document and a node --test gate.

resources.name: GeekRicardo/claude-in-dsh
resources.desc: Hand a DSH web session to the locally installed Claude Code CLI: a per-session engine selector (DSH | Claude Code), Claude models and reasoning effort in the model seat, Claude permission modes in place of the access-mode selector, and permission requests, AskUserQuestion and ExitPlanMode routed to the native DSH approval, question and plan-review cards. The stream is written as native DSH session events, so the built-in transcript, tool cards and nested subagents render it; Claude slash commands merge into the command palette; the CLI is held by a detached broker, so plugin updates and DSH restarts do not interrupt a running turn.

resources.name: gentle-knight/dsh-cannbot-connect
resources.desc: Connects CANNBOT gateway models to DSH by reusing the sign-in CANNWork already establishes for opencode: the JWT and virtual key are read from disk on every request, so no separate OAuth flow or extra key is needed, and the account's visible models are registered in the model picker.

resources.name: GnaneshKunal/dsh-openrouter-plus
resources.desc: Per-Session OpenRouter routing: a loopback relay writes service_tier, provider.sort and the :floor variant into each request from one of nine presets picked on the composer chip, with a pinned base URL per preset for route-level defaults.

resources.name: GodD6366/dsh-sub2api
resources.desc: Connect a sub2api gateway to DeepSeek Harness: OpenAI-compatible multi-provider routes (OpenAI / Claude / Grok / Gemini) behind one base URL, with per-key model discovery, usage lookup, and global vision/image tools.

resources.name: GooDAnDReaDY/dsh-clinebot
resources.desc: ClineBot and ClinePass integration for DeepSeek Harness: dedicated settings page, live quota dashboard, in-UI key saving, curated and custom model selection, and a /cline command.

resources.name: GooDAnDReaDY/dsh-key-rotation
resources.desc: Keeps a pool of API keys per provider with auto-created clone routes, switches to the next key on quota or rate-limit errors, probes cooled keys for recovery, and exposes the pools, cooldown and switch codes in a Settings section.

resources.name: GooDAnDReaDY/dsh-model-sync
resources.desc: Synchronizes the model catalog of API-key providers from the provider itself instead of maintaining the model list by hand.

resources.name: GooDAnDReaDY/dsh-ollama-cloud-provider
resources.desc: Ollama Cloud provider for DeepSeek Harness with native and OpenAI-compatible transports.

resources.name: GooDAnDReaDY/dsh-opencode-provider
resources.desc: OpenCode Console and OpenCode Go provider for DeepSeek Harness.

resources.name: GooDAnDReaDY/dsh-subscriptions
resources.desc: Registers ChatGPT Codex, Claude, Grok and Antigravity subscriptions as DeepSeek Harness LLM providers through OAuth, so no API key is needed for them.

resources.name: GrannyProgramming/dsh-dario-sidecar
resources.desc: Harness-owned lifecycle for the dario proxy — starts it with your harness, readiness-gates it, and stops it when the harness stops, so subscription-backed (Claude/ChatGPT) model routes just work.

resources.name: greatyao/dsh-connect-cursor
resources.desc: Connects a locally-signed-in Cursor desktop app to dsh as a native LlmAdapter — reads the Cursor login token from state.vscdb or auth.json, drives the private agent.v1.AgentService/Run HTTP/2 bidi stream, and translates InteractionUpdate deltas into dsh StreamChunks. No loopback proxy. macOS, Windows and Linux.

resources.name: guhanfei-ai/dsh-model-http-proxy
resources.desc: Only the domains you list go through a proxy: add a model host that needs the proxy to be reachable, and web search plus every other request stays on the normal network. Multiple named proxies can serve different domains, with a never-proxy list on top; saved settings apply on the next request without a restart.

resources.name: gulagala001/dsh-response-id-reuse
resources.desc: Reuses stored Responses IDs for continuation, with retry and branch isolation and verified history replay.

resources.name: HAN102300/dsh-opencode-zen-free
resources.desc: OpenCode Zen free-tier models for DeepSeek Harness with anonymous no-key access, a loopback OpenAI-compatible shim, and real bash/read gate tools.

resources.name: HaoyueQin/dsh-better-reasoning-effort
resources.desc: Per-model reasoning-effort and input-modality configuration for third-party providers: suggestions fused from a model knowledge base and raw /models endpoint evidence with confidence labels, edited inside the official Models page card.

resources.name: HateYouLittle/dsh-clinepass
resources.desc: ClinePass provider for DeepSeek Harness: 15 bundled subscription and free models, a settings page with per-model capacity overrides, subscription usage for the 5-hour, weekly and monthly windows, and multi-account failover to a backup account.

resources.name: HaydenSmith1121/dsh-opencode-go-plus
resources.desc: OpenCode Go subscription models as a DeepSeek Harness provider: re-resolves the live gateway catalog every few minutes, auto-adapts models the built-in table has not seen, and covers streaming, tool calls, image input and subscription usage. A maintained fork of dsh-opencode-go: a clash with the upstream package over the llm-opencode-go settings namespace makes it withdraw quietly instead of failing the whole plugin tree, and an already-claimed opencode-go route makes it serve on opencode-go-plus.

resources.name: HB00/dsh-llm-failover
resources.desc: Automatic provider failover on rate limits or quota exhaustion: switch between providers with configurable per-provider models, a cooldown, and a permanent last-entry fallback.

resources.name: Headmaster218/dsh-llm-moe4all
resources.desc: Runs MoE4All models locally in DSH with automatic engine installation, model discovery and downloads, inference settings, and live speed monitoring, or connects to an existing service.

resources.name: henrikdukefoss/dsh-standardcompute
resources.desc: Adds Standard Compute as an OpenAI-compatible model provider through the built-in pi-ai adapter, with its standardcompute router model and two direct model pins; configuration only, no code.

resources.name: Henta111/dsh-more-models-thinking-level
resources.desc: Per-model reasoning effort (off/minimal/low/medium/high/xhigh) for GPT, Codex, Gemini and OpenAI-compatible models. Installs a helper, not a runtime adapter: run enable-capabilities.ps1 once per profile (Windows) and restart — it declares the levels in ~/.dsh/settings.yaml, with a disable script and a backup to revert.

resources.name: heywalter/dsh-domain-proxy
resources.desc: Choose API hostnames from configured providers or add them manually to route matching DSH backend Fetch/Undici requests through an existing local HTTP(S) proxy, leaving other routes unchanged; optional in-memory records show actual dispatch paths, first-content wait, token throughput and usage without storing prompts, responses or API keys.

resources.name: hi-fangj/dsh-models-radar
resources.desc: Displays CodexRadar model capability benchmarks in a Settings page and shows the selected session model's DeepSWE score beside the composer.

resources.name: HimA6652/dsh-workbuddy2api-hub
resources.desc: Registers the models of a local workbuddy2api-hub gateway into DSH as one OpenAI-compatible provider per gateway API key, each key keeping its own model selection, and shows the main key's credit balance plus today's and this week's tokens, credits and API-equivalent cost in a sidebar badge. Requires workbuddy2api-hub running locally.

resources.name: HiSeax/dsh-better-model-setting
resources.desc: Replaces the official Models settings page with provider lifecycle management, per-model reasoning effort tiers, retry overrides, drag reorder and upstream model sync.

resources.name: hmtxj/dsh-model-modality
resources.desc: Per-model input type and thinking level declarations on the 模型 settings page — 输入类型 checkboxes on every provider card, and a 思考等级 field in the provider 编辑 dialog. Writes the official pi-ai input and reasoningEfforts fields.

resources.name: Hoemr/dsh-llm-cc-switch
resources.desc: Exposes the accounts in a local CC Switch database to DeepSeek Harness: every account (Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Grok Build) becomes a model category in the picker, and the SQLite database is re-read on every model listing and request, so switching accounts in CC Switch needs no DSH restart. Requires CC Switch and the DSH desktop app.

resources.name: home-river/dsh-opencode-cli-bridge
resources.desc: Bridge DSH to OpenCode-compatible models via the local OpenCode CLI: native LlmAdapter passthrough, persistent OC sessions with cross-turn tool results, tool mirroring, and a CLI environment check panel. Requires the OpenCode CLI installed locally.

resources.name: HOWILLMAKEIT/dsh-model-context-catalog
resources.desc: Match context windows for configured DSH models in one click, show capacity sources, and support selective bulk configuration, manual editing, and continuous synchronization.

resources.name: Howthemeaning/dsh-model-settings
resources.desc: Model settings panel for DeepSeek Harness: set the default model for new sessions, plus separate provider/model/reasoning-effort overrides for subagents and goal rounds, with live reload.

resources.name: hoyyang/dsh-glm-mode
resources.desc: GLM Mode agent preset for zhipuai/glm-5.3-flash: PTC/Code Mode tool presentation, a reasoning loop guard and a tool spin guard (live-incident driven), and GLM-specific auto-compaction at 75%/22%.

resources.name: hpfs0/dsh-provider-proxy
resources.desc: Configures forward proxies per enabled provider in Settings (HTTP/HTTPS/SOCKS5), keeping unconfigured providers and other traffic direct.

resources.name: hualuo520-h/dsh-connect-scnet
resources.desc: Brings the models of the SCNet (超算互联网) Computing Service desktop client into DSH by reusing the API key that client already wrote, with a 30-model catalog and a per-model default thinking level.

resources.name: huhaodong/dsh-auto-driving
resources.desc: Model failover and turn keep-alive for DeepSeek Harness: a request that fails with a model error before any visible output falls through the models of the configured provider groups (then the next provider) until one streams; transient failures retry with backoff under a liveness watchdog, a dead turn self-resumes with templated 「继续」 wake-ups, and an optional full-auto mode auto-answers permission, question and plan approvals with every decision appended to an AUTO-MODE.md audit log.

resources.name: hytime/dsh-thinking-effort
resources.desc: Configure reasoning-effort levels and sub-agent defaults for custom DSH models.

resources.name: hZsFN/dsh-default-model-lock
resources.desc: Keeps the shared default model pinned, so switching the model inside a chat no longer rewrites the global default and no longer lowers that default's reasoning effort.

resources.name: Ianzhyh/workbuddy-to-dsh#dsh-plugin
resources.desc: Registers a local OpenAI-compatible bridge as a native dsh model provider: reuses the models already signed in on the desktop app on this machine, manages the bridge and its local dashboard process, and adds five tools, a /workbuddy command and a nine-tab settings panel. Requires the desktop app to be installed and signed in on the same machine; the bridge binds 127.0.0.1 only.

resources.name: iasiv5/dsh-copilot-auth
resources.desc: Adds a web device-code sign-in and sign-out entry for the built-in GitHub Copilot provider in DSH, presets an out-of-the-box Copilot provider route, keeps credentials in the built-in credential store, and manages the model catalog as a first-login fallback that never overwrites customized model entries.

resources.name: IcedWatermelonJuice/dsh-provider-veark
resources.desc: Volcengine Ark Coding Plan LLM provider for DeepSeek Harness: provider-scoped PDF and image input, with Responses API streaming support.

resources.name: iJetLi/dsh-providers-hub
resources.desc: Signs in and manages accounts for 16 AI coding providers, plus a cross-provider rotation channel: multi-account pools, automatic credential refresh, credit claiming where the provider offers it, and a local OpenAI-compatible gateway.

resources.name: ijry/DeepSeek-Harness-Desktop-Ultra#dsh-plugin-ai-switch
resources.desc: Pool AI provider accounts per platform and route them through a local loopback proxy that bridges the OpenAI, OpenAI-Responses, Anthropic and Gemini protocols, then write the proxy into Codex, Claude Code, Gemini CLI, Grok, OpenCode, OpenClaw and Hermes config files with snapshot-and-rollback safe writes; registers no agent tools.

resources.name: itchenshi/dsh-gateway-models
resources.desc: Declares the OpenCode Go and Command Code route wire protocol and endpoint (so the API address never has to be typed), adds the DeepSeek V4.1 models to the OpenCode Go route and puts them first, completes the Command Code model list from its public catalog, and attaches a per-conversation x-opencode-session header to OpenCode requests (fixes 400 MissingSessionID).

resources.name: itongxiaojun/dsh-openrouter-free-models
resources.desc: Discovers OpenRouter's free models, measures their real speed and context size, and writes them into the DeepSeek Harness model list fastest-first, with speed and context in each display name, plus a Settings section to configure and run it.

resources.name: Jaylor-Wang/dsh-tool-antigravity
resources.desc: Connect Google Antigravity OAuth accounts to DeepSeek Harness with smart multi-account quota rotation, multi-model LLM routing, and Nano Banana 2 image generation.

resources.name: JeffTsuiCUG/dsh-connect-minimaxcode
resources.desc: Connects the MiniMax Code models to DSH - reusing the desktop app's sign-in or signing in on its own - with Anthropic-compatible model access, a live model catalog, the daily check-in that grants the free credits, and a credit balance that follows the model you selected.

resources.name: Jensen-Yao/dsh-model-palette
resources.desc: Global Alt+M model command palette for DeepSeek Harness Web: fuzzy search over models and providers, favorites and recents, per-model reasoning effort, provider and model configuration, request retries, capacity presets, and optional OpenRouter image/video generation tools.

resources.name: Jerry2262/dsh-fingerprint
resources.desc: Captures and compares single-token behavioral fingerprints of configured DSH model routes using the One Token Is Enough protocol.

resources.name: jerry9692/dsh-workbuddy2api-panel
resources.desc: Reads a running workbuddy2api-panel over its HTTP API and syncs its models into the DSH model picker with credit multipliers, CN/international realm labels and per-model reasoning-effort levels; also shows remaining credits and usage in a settings page and a sidebar badge.

resources.name: Jesse-njx/dsh-polyglot
resources.desc: The model switch for DSH: point it at any OpenAI-compatible endpoint, with curated free/cheap DeepSeek provider presets and automatic fallback when a free tier rate-limits you.

resources.name: jiay98528-dev/dsh-model-sync
resources.desc: Writes live provider model lists into DSH settings and shows 5h/7d plan windows or metered balance for the current session model.

resources.name: jiay98528-dev/dsh-plugin-weaknet-adaptor
resources.desc: Weak-network adaptor: transparent long-backoff model-stream retries (10-min cap), local response replay cache, heartbeat auto-reconnect, and degraded-mode token economy, with a bilingual (zh/en) settings page.

resources.name: john-walks-slow/dsh-set-model
resources.desc: Model switching and reasoning-effort control for DeepSeek Harness: set_model and list_models agent tools let the agent autonomously change its provider, model or thinking depth (reasoning effort) mid-task with a mandatory reason, a provider whitelist and a context-window token-pressure guard, the active model is injected into the runtime context, and Plan Mode auto-transition switches to a configured planning model on entering plan mode and restores the previous execution model on exit.

resources.name: Jonah-Wu23/dsh-agy-safe
resources.desc: Compliantly use your own Antigravity quota in dsh: bridges your local logged-in official Antigravity CLI (agy) session as the chat and subagent model provider.

resources.name: juliankang4/dsh-spark-scope
resources.desc: Shows a Spark Scope card at the bottom of the dsh sidebar: model server decode and prefill rates with sparklines, running and queued requests, KV cache, TTFT and TPOT p95, and GPU temperature, power, load and memory for each DGX Spark node. Read-only; needs a running Spark Scope server. Works in dsh web and the desktop app.

resources.name: JUNQINGV587/dsh-maestro
resources.desc: Planner/executor delegation with named roles: a strong planner steers, disposable executor sub-agents (per-role routes and prompts) implement. Default role plus per-delegation override, a global reasoning-effort knob in the composer chip, and a settings page for role management.

resources.name: jyao-SUSE-power-group/dsh-provider-rate-limit
resources.desc: Rate-limits LLM requests per provider and per model using a reservation-based token bucket, with queue or reject modes, plus gateway identity rules that rewrite user-agent and inject custom headers.

resources.name: Kalospacer/dsh-model-capabilities
resources.desc: Adds a settings page for declaring per-model reasoning efforts and vision support on pi-ai provider routes.

resources.name: kam74515-boop/dsh-everything-oauth
resources.desc: Import local Codex, Grok, Claude, OpenCode, and CC Switch logins into DSH; pick sources and enable models in Settings.

resources.name: kangjiazhen/workbuddy2everything
resources.desc: Registers the workbuddy model provider by mounting dsh-llm-workbuddy and supervises the local wb2api gateway, then bundles two protocol bridges onto that same gateway: Responses for OpenAI Codex CLI, and Anthropic Messages for Claude Code and Claude Desktop, which see the gateway models under generated claude-wb-… ids. Skips work that is already running or already registered, and reports each part through a status tool. Requires a local wb2api gateway and a WorkBuddy account.

resources.name: KannaKuron/dsh-agent-lang
resources.desc: Three independent language channels for model output — tool-call descriptions (every tool-call card title, including run_code in PTC-style presets), thinking, and replies — each set to follow the web GUI language, force a specific language, or turn off (default: only descriptions, following the GUI). One global runtime-context prompt directive on the host; the client half reports the GUI language; a Settings plugin card switches the modes.

resources.name: katsos/dsh-claude-cli
resources.desc: LLM provider that runs the locally installed Claude Code CLI as the model backend, so requests go through an existing Claude subscription instead of a metered API key; native tool calls are bridged over MCP.

resources.name: ken95573/dsh-model-show
resources.desc: Shows Provider/Model in the DSH Web composer model selector trigger; the dropdown list and its search are unchanged.

resources.name: kennethfan/dsh-bailian-catalog
resources.desc: Bailian (DashScope / Model Studio) model catalog in the DSH settings page: lists every model the configured API key can reach, groups them by model family, probes whether a model is actually callable (an unopened model answers 403, which DSH reports as an invalid key), refuses to add models that fail the probe, and shows the active session's context window and remaining budget. An sk- key has no balance endpoint, so quota here means context quota.

resources.name: kialajin-l/DSH_Plus#dsh-model-picker
resources.desc: Codex-style model selector for the composer listing every provider/model in the profile, with four reasoning-effort levels and per-session persistence; disabling of the native selector ships inside the package.

resources.name: kinoward/dsh-plugin-subhub
resources.desc: Use third-party subscription accounts in DeepSeek Harness: chat, image understanding, image generation, and image editing with the models your subscription covers, with available models and reasoning levels synced from your account; currently supports OpenAI/ChatGPT subscriptions, more providers planned.

resources.name: kkj-luna/dsh-image-bridge
resources.desc: Text-to-image and image-to-image for a model that cannot draw, through any OpenAI-compatible image API, with multiple providers and an automatic fallback model.

resources.name: knyazev741/knyazevai-dsh
resources.desc: Adds the KnyazevAI API provider and its DeepSeek, GLM, and MiniMax model catalog to DeepSeek Harness.

resources.name: koliy82/dsh-rustvy
resources.desc: Vendor marks in the model picker plus a model list kept in step with the provider: mirrors the public catalog and logos to loopback, and regenerates the pi-ai route's models from that route's own endpoint, showing the drift before anything is written.

resources.name: KouzakiUmi/dsh-antigravity-acp
resources.desc: Adds the official Google Antigravity ACP agent as a DeepSeek Harness model provider, with tool execution and approval kept in DSH, Node 22.19+ and a signed-in Antigravity account required, a per-model quota pill and a settings page.

resources.name: kyle123740/dsh-zcode-cli-proxy
resources.desc: Relays the ZCode CLI (the client-bundled coding agent) into DeepSeek Harness as a model provider: a resident app-server session injects the Start Plan account and signs each request with the OAuth plan token, so model requests burn ZCode Start Plan / Coding Plan quota directly — real streaming, image input, per-session resume, no API key.

resources.name: lcestou/dsh-oh-my-claude
resources.desc: Runs your logged-in Claude Code CLI as a dsh model provider: live model list, session resume, approval relay, rewind, memory panel and remote SSH workspaces.

resources.name: Leafyezi233/dsh-model-gateway
resources.desc: Exposes the models already configured in DeepSeek Harness through an OpenAI-compatible gateway, so other local projects can call them with any standard OpenAI client. Multiple provider candidates share one named group with ordered, balanced or random dispatch; upstream failures before any output switch to the next candidate transparently, and rate-limited requests are retried after the provider's backoff. Per-candidate call statistics (attempts, answers, failures, token/TTFT totals) appear as badges in the settings page, and daily aggregates persist to a local file with a 30-day heatmap and trend view. Until you create a key in the UI, the endpoint accepts calls from anyone who can reach it; keys (stored as SHA-256 hashes) then turn authentication on, and the endpoint stays locked even after the last key is revoked. Exposing the optional LAN listener without a key leaves the port open to the whole network. Runs on DSH 0.1.2-rc.1 through 0.1.7-alpha.1 and later.

resources.name: Lequait/dsh-glm-web
resources.desc: Unofficial Zhipu Qingyan (chatglm.cn) web provider — run DeepSeek Harness on web-app credits with a login token, streaming and prompt-bridged tool calls included.

resources.name: liaoyuqing/dsh-llm-error-retry
resources.desc: LLM request retry plugin for DeepSeek Harness: when a model request fails with a configured HTTP status code, machine code, or provider field=value match, it sleeps for the per-rule delay and re-issues the request automatically, so subscription quota and rate-limit errors (429 / insufficient_quota) do not interrupt a run.

resources.name: liaoyuqing/model-failover-manager
resources.desc: Model routing groups for the session model picker: bind a group to a session, and once a model exhausts every retry policy the plugin records the failure with its error code, switches to the next usable model in the group and continues the same turn. Groups carry per-model priority, Beijing-time active windows and expiry dates; subagents inherit their parent session's group and can also pick models or bind their own; models served by dsh-our-free-model retry another account before failing over.

resources.name: libre-webui/dsh-native-provider
resources.desc: Use your DSH models in Libre WebUI for chat, sandboxed Work and usage tracking, with provider credentials kept in DSH. Requires Libre WebUI 0.37.0 or later.

resources.name: LightingHa/dsh-cc-switch
resources.desc: Brings the providers you already configured in cc-switch into DeepSeek Harness: reads the cc-switch database, converts Claude / Codex / OpenClaw / MCode / Pi entries into llm-pi-ai routes with their API keys, and adds a health check that measures time-to-first-byte and whether each stream completes.

resources.name: liqiaohuia/dsh-proxy-routes
resources.desc: Per-provider (account) proxy routing for DSH. SOCKS5/HTTP proxy pool with account-level routing based on API keys. Supports forced direct connections and hot-swapping built-in web tools proxies. Managed via a graphical settings page in DSH.

resources.name: liubaicai/dsh-codebuddy-link
resources.desc: Connects Tencent CodeBuddy CLI to DeepSeek Harness through ACP, with native CLI tool execution, multi-account management, and a standalone codebuddy_ask tool.

resources.name: LiZhenNet/dsh-antigravity
resources.desc: Google Antigravity / Cloud Code Assist model provider with quota management and model selector.

resources.name: lj100886/dsh-framework-doctor
resources.desc: Configure model providers by probing their endpoint, check DeepSeek Harness health, and repair what can be fixed.

resources.name: llmpolska/oh-my-dsh
resources.desc: Tiered model routing for DeepSeek Harness: think/build model tiers, vision delegation (the vision model only describes images; the working model acts), image generation, and a high-impact guard.

resources.name: lninghaha/dsh-coding-subscription-oauth
resources.desc: Coding-subscription OAuth for SuperGrok/Grok Build, ChatGPT Plus Codex, Kimi Code and Claude Code, plus an opt-in loopback OpenAI/Anthropic gateway: local login without pasting tokens, AUTH refresh-and-retry, grok-4.6 xhigh, and API-key route coexistence.

resources.name: log-li/dsh-peakrate
resources.desc: Peak / off-peak rate badges for the model selector (every row) and the composer tool row, judged per provider by its own time zone and schedule; the live catalog is served from the host over a fenced route.

resources.name: lornwolf/dsh-claude-subscription
resources.desc: Adds a Claude Pro/Max OAuth provider with multiple accounts, optional account failover, cached quota reporting, live model catalogs, and quota UI in settings and conversations. Uses the Claude Code client identity; quota reporting uses an experimental endpoint.

resources.name: lovezi0/dsh-model-extension
resources.desc: Models+ settings page for the DSH web UI: per-model reasoning-effort tables, input modalities and compat flags saved through the official settings pipeline, with models.dev metadata prefill and API key management.

resources.name: loyalchiiina/dsh-deepseek-web-free
resources.desc: Registers a deepseek-web provider that drives your own signed-in chat.deepseek.com account as an extra model in DSH, so no Open Platform API key is needed: the sidebar footer lists your Web conversations, Fork to Workspace opens an independent Harness session that never writes back to the original conversation, native search stays on for the default model, and /clean is a session toggle that sends only the human text. Fork of y-wi/dsh-deepseek-web, kept working on DSH 0.2.1-alpha.2: the peer ranges are widened so the compatibility gate no longer rejects the whole bundle, the removed settings API is replaced with ctx.settings.configure() plus .volatile() config fields, the renamed client icons are updated, and an upstream SSE error now surfaces as a real error instead of an empty message that poisoned the session history. The fork also repairs what the rename to -free left behind: the session-list route used to derive its suffix from a hard-coded length inherited from the old package name, which had turned every conversation request into a 404 while sign-in still worked; and the sidebar conversation panel now paints on an opaque surface token instead of the host's translucent menu token, which only reads as a menu beside the backdrop blur a body-mounted panel cannot install.

resources.name: loyalchiiina/dsh-model-fold
resources.desc: Groups the DSH model picker by provider: the menu lists sources with their model counts, and hovering a source slides that provider's models out in a side panel (default); in panel mode a click opens the same panel, and double-clicking a source title cycles hover -> panel -> inline (expand below the title). The active model stays visible at a glance. Pure DOM enhancement with zero intrusion - the panel is plugin-owned DOM mounted on body and selection happens by programmatically clicking the real menu buttons, so no React-managed node is moved or removed, keeping the host rendering intact and coexisting with other UI plugins. Styling follows the host by reusing the official --dsw-* theme tokens, with an enforced opaque background, sufficient contrast, and one shared set of sizing and colour tokens for both menu levels. No network access and no telemetry. Built for DSH kernel 2.0.15-next.

resources.name: lsdt45/dsh-model-config
resources.desc: Configure thinking toggles and reasoning efforts per model for llm-pi-ai and official DeepSeek, and specify input modalities (input or inputModalities) in the DSH settings panel.

resources.name: lujianjun19/dsh-llm-github-copilot
resources.desc: GitHub Copilot LLM adapter: OAuth device-flow sign-in, live model discovery from the Copilot API, vision support for image-capable models (gpt-4.1, gpt-4o), and two wire protocols (Chat Completions and Responses API) with automatic endpoint routing per model.

resources.name: MaRi23333/dsh-grok-kit
resources.desc: Unofficial Grok integration for eligible X Subscription, SuperGrok, or X Premium accounts: shared Grok CLI OAuth, chat with optional main-loop web/X search, and experimental image generation, image editing, and video generation (all media features disabled by default).

resources.name: Mars-Sea/dsh-commandcode-provider
resources.desc: Unofficial Command Code LLM provider: registers a commandcode route with a live model catalog and reasoning-effort support.

resources.name: marsma-101/dsh-qoder-connect
resources.desc: Connects Qoder CN desktop app models to DeepSeek Harness with zero user interaction: decrypts local OSCrypt credentials, signs requests with the COSY scheme against the CN gateway, and lists 14 models with free-tier badges.

resources.name: marsma-101/dsh-trae-connect
resources.desc: Connects Trae CN desktop app models to DeepSeek Harness with no OAuth flow: reuses the desktop sign-in, exposes 17 models (including deepseek-v4.1-flash) with consumption-rate badges and reasoning-effort mapping.

resources.name: masknull/dsh-qoder-connect
resources.desc: Connects Qoder (China and Global) subscriptions to DSH through personal access tokens, keeping each variant on its own credentials and catalog, with saved-token switching, sidebar quota cards, per-model toggles, a context-window preference and a daily check-in.

resources.name: mengge237/dsh-model-priority
resources.desc: Reorder your own models: drag inside a provider card on the Models settings page, or use the Model order section when another plugin already occupies that card. The order is written through the host settings service with a revision check, so the settings page and the model picker stay in sync. The settings left nav can be reordered by drag as well.

resources.name: mia-wong1016/dsh-codex-plus
resources.desc: Brings the Codex (ChatGPT Plus/Pro) subscription already signed in on this machine into DSH. It (1) shows the 5-hour and weekly windows with their reset times and the remaining reset credits in a sidebar panel, with one-click reset that consumes a credit; (2) registers the subscription route in llm-pi-ai (openai-codex) when the quota is read, so the Codex models appear in the model picker; (3) refreshes the OAuth access token before expiry and writes it back atomically, so no key has to be replaced by hand; and (4) adds a codex tool that delegates a task to the local Codex agent. No API key has to be entered.

resources.name: minutiae3/dsh-tier-brain
resources.desc: Rates how hard the current message is and shows the cheapest model and reasoning effort that still fits, above the composer, before you send.

resources.name: Missher12/Missher-DSH-Reasoning-Effort
resources.desc: Adds a thinking-depth slider mapped to declared model levels, configuration guidance, and optional inline model settings.

resources.name: mo-n/dsh-provider-qoder
resources.desc: Connects Qoder subscriptions to DeepSeek Harness, supporting Global and China regions, multimodal input, and tool calls.

resources.name: Modellix/dsh-modellix
resources.desc: Modellix integration for DSH: schema-driven image, video and audio generation in a split Design workspace, a live LLM model catalog, and native web search and fetch providers through one API key.

resources.name: MoonlitDropOfBlood/dsh-model-prompt-injector
resources.desc: Per-model system prompt injector for DeepSeek Harness: append custom prompt text to the END of the system prompt for locally configured models, matched by exact provider/model route or a provider-wide provider/* rule (both stack in order). A Settings page lists every configured provider and its models for per-route editing with instant effect, and rules persist to DSH_HOME so they survive restarts. Applies to main sessions, subagents, and workflow children alike.

resources.name: MoRanYue/dsh-openrouter-providers
resources.desc: Route OpenRouter requests through a configured provider list and quantization cap, injected as provider.only/order with allow_fallbacks, plus provider.quantizations.

resources.name: MoruTeaven/dsh-model-quickslots
resources.desc: A row of model preset buttons above the composer: left-click switches the session to that preset's provider, model and reasoning effort, right-click opens an editor for it, and each preset can carry a custom name instead of the model id. The editor reads the session's live model catalog, and presets are stored locally.

resources.name: moxiaoren/dsh-xiaoyiwork-connect
resources.desc: Reuses the local model proxy of a logged-in XiaoyiWork desktop app (Windows only) so its models appear in DeepSeek Harness without a separate API key.

resources.name: Mu-scorpio/dsh-reasoning-effort
resources.desc: Configures provider and model reasoning-effort mappings for DeepSeek Harness, with a grouped model picker and composer slider.

resources.name: Mutx163/dsh-model-memory
resources.desc: Reasoning-effort tier manager for custom API models plus cross-session preference memory: inline low/medium/high/max toggles inside Settings → Models, with atomic settings writes.

resources.name: mzzsfy/dsh-plugin#dsh-llm-pi-gateway
resources.desc: Session-affinity routing for LLM gateways: injects the session ID into every request sent to NewApi-style gateways so the gateway can pin requests per session and raise prompt-cache hits; takes over the official pi-ai routing on install and restores it on uninstall.

resources.name: NEETnina/dsh-model-master
resources.desc: Model selector for the DSH composer that keeps the native button and menu and takes over only when the small dropdown would open: search across providers, probe any model with a real streaming request to measure TTFT and TPS, and browse a leaderboard of up to 100 rows built from OpenRouter's catalogue, where clicking a row searches local channels of that name.

resources.name: Neptune810/dsh-model-router
resources.desc: Keeps a pool of models and routes every agent step to one of them with its reasoning effort set — configured by clicking in the composer, no JSON needed. The router takes over the composer's model cell, so one control shows the session's model and reasoning effort alongside the router's own settings. Three authorization scopes (model / effort / full) where a manual pick only counts in the scope that owns it, and in effort scope the router is bound to the one model you choose. Task presets with per-model weights, vision routing for image steps, session signals (active todo, context pressure, token budget, subagent depth), and an optional semantic task classifier. Thinking stays on, because DeepSeek rejects a thinking-enabled request whose history contains a tool call made with thinking off.

resources.name: nickhelion/dsh-plugins#qwen-token-plan-cn-responses
resources.desc: Qwen Token Plan CN Responses provider for DeepSeek Harness via the OpenAI Responses API, with Qwen server-side tools, DSH local function tools, text/reasoning/tool-call multi-turn history, persisted image attachments, and a per-release official model catalog snapshot.

resources.name: NingYuanLee/dsh-grok-byapi
resources.desc: Grok model provider for DeepSeek Harness with model discovery, image and video generation, text-to-speech tools, and durable local media tasks over an OpenAI-compatible gateway.

resources.name: nobu121/dsh-opencode-session
resources.desc: Attaches a stable per-conversation x-opencode-session header to OpenCode / OpenCode Go provider requests, fixing 400 MissingSessionID errors and keeping session affinity and prompt-cache routing intact.

resources.name: NOirBRight/dsh-llm-codex
resources.desc: ChatGPT Codex subscription chat: official OAuth, a Sol/Terra/Luna catalog with Fast rows, live usage limits, and optional search and view_image tools.

resources.name: NOirBRight/dsh-llm-commandcode
resources.desc: Command Code Provider API chat for DSH with a Host-held API key, discovered model catalog, effort defaults, an optional zero-data-retention header, quota meters, and per-model OpenAI or Anthropic protocol selection.

resources.name: NOirBRight/dsh-llm-cursor
resources.desc: Unofficial Cursor subscription chat: Host-owned CLI session login, a displayed model catalog, and subscription usage rails. Cursor staff treat this class of private-client usage as against ToS.

resources.name: NOirBRight/dsh-llm-grok
resources.desc: xAI Grok subscription chat: SuperGrok or X Premium+ OAuth, a displayed model subset, Responses through the Grok CLI proxy, and always-on server-side web_search and x_search.

resources.name: NOirBRight/dsh-llm-ollama
resources.desc: Ollama Cloud native chat adapter: direct NDJSON translation of the Ollama /api/chat wire format, model discovery with context windows and capabilities, and web search/fetch providers under the ollama-cloud id, plus a Web settings card.

resources.name: NOirBRight/dsh-llm-opencode-go
resources.desc: OpenCode Go subscription chat for DSH with per-model Completions, Responses, or Anthropic protocol selection, model discovery, context, vision and thinking metadata, effort defaults, and usage meters.

resources.name: NOirBRight/dsh-model-switch
resources.desc: Explicit model routing for Main, Subagents, web_search, and image generation, plus a catalog-driven Composer and Plan Review picker with Model, Effort, Context, Fast, and Thinking variants.

resources.name: omdsh-dev/dsh-llm-fallbacks
resources.desc: Role-based LLM retry & fallback strategies.

resources.name: omdsh-dev/Qwen-MM-Plugins
resources.desc: Qwen multi-modal plugin support.

resources.name: OPaimon/dsh-model-gate
resources.desc: Single-model disable gate: hides denied models from DSH catalogs, blocks direct dispatch with an in-protocol error chunk, and exposes a settings UI for the denylist.

resources.name: OpenTritium/dsh-codex-shim
resources.desc: Simulates a Codex environment for selected model routes to improve GPT-family model tool-call success.

resources.name: oppnc/dsh-kernel-mesh
resources.desc: Registers Kimi, Grok, Codex, and MiniMax as DeepSeek Harness model routes, vendor subagent recipes, and kernel_status / kernel_run / kernel_switch tools.

resources.name: orzgithub/dsh-ollama
resources.desc: Use local Ollama in DSH with Ollama native API and params support.

resources.name: oxlyn/dsh-model-health
resources.desc: Model Health panel in Settings: lists every model configured in settings.yaml and batch-tests availability and latency for each.

resources.name: passingby000/dsh-nl-model-switch
resources.desc: Switch the current DSH session's model with a natural-language sentence, on web, TUI, or IM bridges (WeChat, Feishu), without touching the panel.

resources.name: penguin-oo/dsh-delegate-router
resources.desc: Automatic Flash/Pro routing for DeepSeek Harness subagent calls: light tasks run on a cheap model (e.g. V4 Flash), heavy tasks stay on the strong model — with per-call overrides and /delegate session modes.

resources.name: PerryLink/dsh-autotier
resources.desc: Automatic model-tier routing for DeepSeek Harness: one user instruction enters, one tier decision comes out — complex intent is planned on the strong tier and implemented on the cheap tier, simple intent stays cheap throughout, with a deterministic guard and a TTL escalation fallback.

resources.name: PerryLink/dsh-local-ai
resources.desc: Ollama provider for DeepSeek Harness with model management, health checks, rule-based local routing, and cloud fallback.

resources.name: PerseusNana7mi/dsh-model-kit
resources.desc: Fills missing model parameters from models.dev, imports models from configured providers, and writes per-field overrides for built-in models, with prices in USD or native CNY set as manual rates or a reference price times a multiplier.

resources.name: pgjh/dsh-model-metadata
resources.desc: DSH plugin: matches a model you declared on a custom gateway to the capability metadata it should have — context window, output cap, reasoning levels and image support — by looking the bare model name up at runtime; the plugin never writes your settings document.

resources.name: Phoeky/dsh-sensenova-pool
resources.desc: Brings SenseNova (日日新) models into dsh with a per-key rotation pool: paste any number of API keys and requests rotate across them, a 429 rate-limit immediately retries on the next key with per-key exponential-backoff cooldown, local RPM pre-throttling avoids the limit instead of reacting to it, and an exhausted pool answers 503 with Retry-After so a 429 never reaches the caller. Ships a built-in model catalogue that works offline and refreshes from /v1/models, plus a settings card with masked keys, per-key probing and removal.

resources.name: pigman18/dsh-openai-gateway
resources.desc: Exposes every model of every provider configured in DeepSeek Harness through one OpenAI-compatible endpoint on a fixed loopback port, with a sidebar page for the base URL, key, port and model ids.

resources.name: Plocr/dsh-commandcode
resources.desc: Command Code for DSH connects Go / GOAT / Pro / Max subscriptions through llm-pi-ai provider profiles, with model sync previews, favorites and hidden models, per-model reasoning presets, explicit request diagnostics, usage alerts, configuration import/export and web search.

resources.name: prgrmrwy/dsh-auto-model-routing
resources.desc: Use Jev to adjust main-chat reasoning effort without switching its model, independently select and apply fresh sub-agent capability and effort, and inspect decisions with per-reply allocation feedback.

resources.name: prgrmrwy/dsh-magpie-connector
resources.desc: Connect a self-hosted Magpie gateway with one provider route per upstream owner, so the stock model picker shows Magpie (Claude), Magpie (Codex) and other groups, plus automatic multi-line failover, read-only usage cards, per-model default effort, a per-session fast switch for priority-tier models, and optional Cloudflare Access.

resources.name: Pummelchen/TinyTitan#dsh-tinytitan
resources.desc: Keeps a local TinyTitan model server reachable from the harness: refreshes the llm-pi-ai route from the installed models and mounts a compaction backend that does not think.

resources.name: pyh-pan/dsh-openai-oauth
resources.desc: Use ChatGPT subscriptions in DeepSeek Harness Desktop via official Sign in with ChatGPT, with dynamic Agent registration and native model and reasoning selection.

resources.name: shuang-ying/dsh-ThirdApi-ThinkingMode
resources.desc: Reads each third-party endpoint's own model listing and keeps llm-pi-ai's per-model reasoningEfforts in sync, so the composer offers the thinking levels a model actually has.

resources.name: shuind/dsh-codex-harness
resources.desc: Compact Codex coding mode for DSH: light prompt guardrails against GPT over-explaining, with an editable prompt and native Codex-style tools.

resources.name: SISCHOI/daruma#dsh-daruma
resources.desc: Keeps long DSH sessions alive when a model channel starts failing: daruma takes over after the in-box retry gives up, trips a self-healing circuit breaker on repeated 429/5xx or a terminal error, and moves the next request to another channel in your chain. The backup can be picked in Settings or from a panel beside the composer — both stay in sync — with a durable JSONL audit log for every switch. Channel switches are recorded in that audit log instead of as in-conversation notice rows, because a plugin session event of a type the host does not know makes it refuse to load the whole session.

resources.name: SkylerFee/dsh-llm-opencode-go-live

resources.name: SnailMann/dsh-quick-model-selector
resources.desc: Search-first model selector with favorites, recent models, collapsible provider groups and keyboard navigation.

resources.name: SpookySandwich/dsh-plugin-rollout-scout

resources.desc: Per-step model router: named presets with ordered image/keyword-group rules route each agent step across every mounted provider and model, adding collaboration flows for image transcription, an image guard, a multi-plan quota panel, and per-step decision observability.

resources.name: tangyixiao/dsh-workbuddy-connect-community

resources.name: tangyixiao/dsh-zcode-plan-bridge
resources.desc: Requires the ZCode CLI installed and signed in. Relays the ZCode CLI agent into DeepSeek Harness as a model provider. A resident app-server session streams each turn, and the model catalogue is read from the CLI at runtime, so context windows, image support and provider routes follow the installed CLI and account. Stable 0.5.2 declares DSH compatibility through engines.dsh; ZCode CLI 3.16.3 is the documented reference version. Tool permission requests are denied by default; unknown approval or permission methods are always denied, and full-auto requires an explicit opt-in. DSH approval UI does not mediate this separately spawned app-server process, and the policy is not an OS sandbox.

resources.name: tearslee/dsh-workbuddy2api
resources.desc: Supervises a local workbuddy2api gateway process and exposes its models as an LLM provider, reading context windows and reasoning efforts from the gateway's own model endpoint.

resources.name: Tests4gptplay/dsh-codex-native
resources.desc: Connect OpenAI Codex app-server as a DSH main model with ChatGPT sign-in, HTTP transport, automatic official Codex latest runtime updates, on-demand live Codex model catalog, native tools, settings, selectable questions and automatic chat replies, on-demand local and connector skills, Windows Computer Use recovery, context management, quota and Token usage history.

resources.name: TheStreamCode/dsh-muse-code
resources.desc: Adds Meta's Muse Code subscription as a DSH model provider: the bundle declares the shipped Meta route under Settings > Models, syncs the account chat catalog (Muse Wonder included) into the model picker, and adds a Sign in card plus the /muse-login command that run DSH's built-in Meta device-code flow, keep the minted key renewed, and show a red or green credential dot. resources.name: thibautrey/multivibe#dsh-multivibe

resources.name: tonylee2022/dsh-xai-oauth

resources.name: TonyWu2333/dsh-mercury-diffusion

Support is detected per provider/model with a probe that is rejected before any token is generated, a floating per-model toggle turns it on, and attachments, auxiliary calls or unsupported routes fall back to the original adapter. Replaces the assistant-message renderer for all models while enabled.

resources.name: troytse/dsh-plugin-subagent-roles
resources.desc: File-defined subagent roles for DeepSeek Harness: roles live in project and global .dsh/roles files, a delegating agent sees one catalog line per role, and each role's tool policy decides which tools its child can see.

resources.name: uio-o/dsh-model-control
resources.desc: Replaces the composer model seat with a search-first picker and adds a model management page: create and edit llm-pi-ai channels, choose which of an endpoint's models exist, and declare per-model thinking ladders and capabilities.

resources.name: upJiang/dsh-ccswitch

resources.name: Vikrant-Aleph/dsh-opencode-bridge

Built-in DeepSeek providers are not managed.

resources.name: wangyemen/agnes-ai-for-dsh
resources.desc: Agnes AI provider for llm-pi-ai: 4 multimodal chat models declared in the bundle patch, plus image and video generation tools.

resources.name: webkubor/dsh-llm-hub
resources.desc: Fills in what the official pi-ai adapter leaves out on the Models page: gateway reachability probing with latency, one-click pull of the gateway model catalog with checkbox write-back into settings, DeepSeek balance and provider quota shown in place, the protocol and endpoint each provider is actually wired to, and a model dropdown that lists only what works right now — a dead key, an empty balance or an exhausted quota is hidden until you fix it, and comes back on its own.

resources.name: welsione/dsh-model-router
resources.desc: Unified model routing for DeepSeek Harness: one logical ModelID over multiple providers with first-token failover and cooldown, health-aware candidate ranking, three tiers (tier1/tier2/tier3) auto-selected by purpose, per-candidate reasoning effort, and a settings-page management panel.

resources.name: wenheguo2/dsh-delegation-suite
resources.desc: Ranked subagent delegation: role-based model routing with failover, per-route reasoning effort, model-transparent labels, fork delegation, and a visual route editor.

resources.name: wenzetan/dsh-llm-newapi
resources.desc: NewAPI (OpenAI-compatible gateway) LLM provider: registers a newapi route with chat-only model discovery, auto-fills model parameters (context window, reasoning effort) from models.dev, and adds a Web settings section for the base URL and API key.

resources.name: whoiszzj/dsh-opencodego
resources.desc: OpenCode Go provider that verifies a model against the gateway rather than treating a recommendation as a measurement: the models.dev protocol suggestion is probed before it is used, reasoning levels follow a measured contract, and requests run through an ordered protocol fallback chain. Context window, max output and image-input numbers are declared by a runtime-refreshed models.dev layer rather than probed, with operator overrides above both. Several OpenCode Go credentials can be stored and switched from the settings page.

resources.name: Willmylife/dsh-model-connection-test
resources.desc: Adds a connection-test panel under Settings -> Models: reads the deployment's model catalog and probes each configured model with one minimal chat round-trip (a short "ping" with a small output cap) through the Host LLM service, verifying connectivity with a real request. Each row reports success/failure with the harness failure code (NO_ADAPTER, MISSING_CREDENTIAL, AUTH, RATE_LIMIT, TIMEOUT, ...) plus first-token/total latency; single-model and concurrent test-all (3) are supported. Credentials are resolved inside the Host process and never reach the browser; probes are independent per model behind a same-origin-fenced route with a body-size cap. Pure JS, no build step, MIT.

resources.name: WiseXin/dsh-antigravity
resources.desc: Google Antigravity and Cloud Code Assist model provider with Gemini 3.8 Flash, sandbox failover, and multi-account quota management.

resources.name: wjf1/dsh-commandcode

resources.name: XDTrees/dsh-xdpool

Accounts persist across restarts.

resources.name: xiaobbl/dsh-opencode-go-model-list

resources.name: xiaozhe7772222/dsh-opencode-zen

resources.name: yoshino-xiao7/dsh-grok-provider

resources.name: young-tim/dsh-llm-governor

resources.name: yu-wenchao/dsh-opencode-free-models#dsh-opencode-free-models

resources.name: YUEYUEXYS/dsh-think-ultra

Distributed as an obfuscated build; commercial use allowed, reverse engineering closed.

resources.name: yuioi666/dsh-plugin-model-capability
