resources.desc: Per-request thinking budgets, a compaction backend, and a settings tab for the local Qwen3.8 line (llama.cpp or NInfer).

resources.name: YV919/dmxapi-dsh
resources.desc: Configure DMXAPI Chat Completions, Responses, Anthropic Messages, and custom providers; edit models on existing preset routes.

resources.name: ZChenW/dsh-codex-switch

resources.name: zenVibeCoding/dsh-ai-gateway-provider

resources.name: zenVibeCoding/dsh-newapi-provider

resources.name: zgrajdnhj7806-svg/dsh-deepseek-web
resources.desc: Calls your own chat.deepseek.com account as a second model from DSH: ask a question, analyze a file's line range, and check login state, plus a runtime skill and a settings-page login panel.

resources.name: zhang-tod/dsh-codebuddy
resources.desc: Unofficial provider that connects Tencent CodeBuddy open platform models to DeepSeek Harness, with automatic model discovery and a settings page for the API key.

resources.name: zhangjunjesse/dsh-claude-driver

resources.name: zhangnan/dsh-chatgpt-oauth
resources.desc: Sign in with a ChatGPT account and view Codex subscription usage directly in DSH Web's model settings, with browser or device-code OAuth.

resources.name: zhangyqjiaoshou-oss/dsh-model-sync
resources.desc: One-click/auto sync provider model lists against /v1/models endpoint.

resources.name: zhiqiangme/dsh-plugins#dsh-opencode2api
resources.desc: Runs the standalone opencode2api backend (jasonxu114514/opencode2api, Windows x64/ARM64, no Docker or OpenCode CLI) with DSH and on exit stops only the process it launched; its settings card installs, updates or rolls back the backend from checksum-verified GitHub releases, copies the initial admin password and syncs /v1/models into an opencode2api provider with context, vision and reasoning efforts, re-syncing every 10 minutes.

resources.name: zhlcba/dsh-raccoon-connect
resources.desc: Adds DSH 0.2.x kernel support to the SenseTime XiaoHuanXiong desktop-app models, reusing that app's stored sign-in so no API key is needed.

resources.name: ZhouXuan-Yu/dsh-model-rotation

Uses the models of whatever provider plugins are already installed (Antigravity accounts, Codex subscription, DeepSeek API keys); it does not provide model access itself.

resources.name: zhubaohi/dsh-qwen38-compaction-fix
resources.desc: Compaction fix for NInfer-hosted qwen3.8-27b gateways: disables thinking on dsh context-compaction and session-title calls so xhigh reasoning stops burning the whole output budget; the same idea applies to other launch methods, this package targets NInfer only.

resources.name: zhz8888/dsh-radeon-cloud-patcher
resources.desc: Adds AMD Radeon Cloud as a model provider in DeepSeek Harness, with reasoning-effort levels declared per model. The provider definition ships in the plugin's own patch layer rather than in your profile.

resources.name: Zn-Dk/dsh-zhipu-toolkit
resources.desc: Dual-endpoint Zhipu BigModel GLM provider catalog (Coding Plan and ordinary API) with live model discovery, live-tested thinking-tier mapping, and a settings card for keys, endpoints and the default reasoning tier.

resources.name: zpis666/dsh-context-budget

resources.name: zuojinxin/dsh-provider-switch
resources.desc: Enable or disable model providers, search models in the selector, and rename provider display names.

resources.name: 379385796-sys/dsh-prompt-inject
resources.desc: MIT adaptation of H1a3x's prompt-template manager with native ConfigForms, revision-checked saves, global/workspace selection and verified Windows Desktop RC3 compatibility. Cannot be installed alongside the upstream H1a3x/dsh-prompt-inject.

resources.name: 58fly/dsh-language-guard
resources.desc: Locks the model's reasoning, replies and tool-call descriptions to a chosen target language (Simplified Chinese by default) with system-prompt sections at the head, middle and tail of the prompt, offering three strength levels, an auto mode that follows the DSH interface language, a settings panel that shows the language currently in effect, and a sidebar quick switch.

resources.name: dsh-profile-stylist
resources.desc: Describe the persona you want and the agent writes it: nickname, bio, taglines and links come from the host model, the avatar comes from your local asset library (or a path you give), then it fills your profile page and hands the picture to the site's own uploader. Dry-run by default - it only touches profile fields, never passwords or security settings.

resources.name: accomplish07zrh-eng/dsh-aurabot-qq
resources.desc: Puts the agent on QQ as a persona character through SnowLuma (OneBot v11): private and group chat, voice notes, stickers, Qzone diary, Bilibili browsing, song covers, image generation, long-term memory and mood. Every feature is a module you can switch off, replace or extend locally — hot-reloaded modules can also rewrite group-reply decisions, prompts, outgoing messages and per-chat model choice. Safe by default (master switch off, dry run on).

resources.name: AgentConnect/dsh-awiki
resources.desc: Provides DeepSeek Harness agents with native identities based on the open Agent Network Protocol (ANP), plus identity-based direct, group, mail, and Agent-to-Agent communication.

resources.name: Applepinea/dsh-qq-access
resources.desc: Personal QQ channel for dsh: managed NapCat with QR login, private/group AI replies with batching and image understanding, local archive with polling backfill, in-group @ and self-recall, QQ Zone guestbook tools, and a sidebar panel. By default any QQ user who DMs the account (or @s it in a group) gets an AI reply; set access.privateMode / groupMode to allowlist to restrict. Owner-only commands stay owner-only.

resources.name: Awoodwhale/dsh-agent-persona
resources.desc: Scopes system-prompt personas by workspace path or session id (exact, prefix, contains, regex), with an optional default persona for sessions nothing claimed, a 人设 tab on the conversation showing the prompt actually sent, import and export of the list, and a switch that refuses tool writes to the persona store.

resources.name: Bay-Zeddie/dsh-agent-instructions
resources.desc: Panel to edit dsh's native AGENTS.md from the web settings page: every layer in the instruction chain is clickable, three activation scopes, and a visual budget meter.

resources.name: beiheng127/dsh-role-sum
resources.desc: Character persona summaries for DeepSeek Harness: collects moegirl-first public sources, distills them into a reusable persona document through the csp workflow, and keeps a per-character asset library with quality checks, manual source attachment, version snapshots and a settings page.

resources.name: BOWLUNA/dsh-custom-mode
resources.desc: Custom modes / assistant manager: give each mode its own system prompt in the settings page — a custom prompt that is a plain file the agent loop re-reads before every model step, so an edit applies to the running session on its next step — and start it from the official standard / PTC / minimal / Cordis composition, toggling the plugin rows it mounts one by one (a custom plugin composition per mode), renaming it as you like. Several assistants coexist with their own prompts, so one machine can keep a coding assistant, a chat companion and a roleplay (RP) persona side by side — a multi-agent setup you pick from per new session. Rows left untouched stay byte-identical to the shipped ones, platform conditions included.

resources.name: BuildWithAIHub/dsh-codex-account-switcher
resources.desc: Snapshot and switch the Codex login used by the Codex subagent from the DSH Plugins page, with a Codex usage quota card.

resources.name: CAI-MH/dsh-reply-language
resources.desc: Force the model to write all replies in a chosen language (Simplified Chinese by default) via a system-prompt section, switchable anytime with a tool.

resources.name: ccl4-56-23-5/DSH-Plugins#top-directive
resources.desc: Configure a global system-prompt section with a multiline editor, an enable toggle, and persistent storage that preserves the original text.

resources.name: cheems135/dsh-qq-bridge
resources.desc: QQ (NapCat / OneBot 11) bridge for DeepSeek Harness: chat with your harness from QQ, with persona presets and custom personae, a grouped sticker library plus web sticker search, edge-tts or custom HTTP TTS voice notes, pluggable lookup engines, periodic memory compaction, an owner-only relay mode, and an eleven-tab management panel with live monitoring and per-turn cost tracking.

resources.name: cheesewoo/dsh-qqbot-dafeiyu
resources.desc: Connects a QQ Bot to DeepSeek Harness with per-peer sessions, group mention and keyword triggers, image generation and voice replies. resources.name: chenbin-dev/dsh-auth-everying

resources.name: ECNU/EduWork#dsh-oidc
resources.desc: Configurable OIDC login and token-authorized model access, including LiteLLM and opt-in oidc-llm integration, with a standalone DSH Web backend.

resources.name: elfmingh/dsh-prompt-manager
resources.desc: Layered system-prompt profiles — global, per-workspace and per-session entries injected in order — where individual builtin sections and runtime contexts can be disabled or overridden, with a line-level diff of what an override changed; each entry carries a subagent scope that targets the main agent only, subagents only, or both; assembly snapshots record what each turn actually received, subagents included. Managed from a Web panel and a prompt_manager tool.

resources.name: FNOSP/fnos-dsh#dsh-codex-auth-plugin
resources.desc: ChatGPT account sign-in for DeepSeek Harness through a Codex browser OAuth flow with no API key and no workspace selection: subscribes the login to pi-ai's Codex provider, lets you set the global default Codex model and reasoning effort for new sessions, refreshes the model list from the signed-in account's own catalog endpoint, and shows the five-hour and weekly usage windows in the composer.

resources.name: Freakz2z/dsh-catgirl-plugin
resources.desc: Token-efficient persona runtime for DeepSeek Harness with local catgirl rendering and progressive tool-schema disclosure.

resources.name: gulagala001/dsh-persona-plugin
resources.desc: Create, import and manage personality presets with global and per-conversation choices.

resources.name: hj9178/dsh-ottosmother
resources.desc: Gives the model a private glossary: reads 「滚木」 as "none" and 「棍母」 as "doesn't exist", and decides on its own whether to phrase a sentence with those words when expressing that meaning. resources.name: hsushjk/dsh-aurachat

The built-in web server listens on 0.0.0.0:2332 by default; create the owner account before exposing the port, and only the owner can add guest accounts.

resources.name: huaizhuanghub/dsh-persona-dafeiyu
resources.desc: Persona library for DeepSeek Harness: injects the selected persona into the system prompt, offering three built-ins plus import from a file or pasted text, applied either profile-wide or per session from a switcher above the composer.

resources.name: imlishiyuan/deepseek-harness-zh-cn
resources.desc: Injects a fixed system-reminder at the first step of every turn asking the model to reason and answer in Simplified Chinese, while code, commands, file paths, and identifiers stay in English.

resources.name: iStarryDust/dsh-agent-suite#dist
resources.desc: Agent persona management, agent memory, edit-and-regenerate for past messages: create and manage agents, each with its own identity, long-term memory, global memory and chat history.

resources.name: iStarryDust/dsh-assistant-profile
resources.desc: Agent persona: gives DSH one global persona (name, language, persona prompt) that every new session carries at the front of its system prompt, plus a long-term memory you grow from any chat in one click; three built-in presets ship with it, and a Big fat fish persona is active right after install; chat sessions can also be deleted from the sidebar row menu.

resources.name: jasonchan2026/dsh-lan-chat
resources.desc: Offline LAN chat inside DSH: direct chats, group chats and file transfer between machines running the harness on the same network, with UDP auto-discovery, CIDR scanning to add contacts, an optional access code (unset by default), local-only contact aliases, per-message and per-conversation deletion, and a configurable per-file limit. The host opens its own HTTP/WebSocket port for peers, and the plugin imports only node built-ins.

resources.name: jihaoran222/dsh-violet-heart
resources.desc: Adds one system-prompt section that keeps private words out of formal deliverables and, every few of them, leaves a short note at the end.

resources.name: kingcharleslzy-ai/dsh-purge
resources.desc: Community-maintained dsh-purge fork with host-policy patches, prompt and rule settings, diagnostics, separate update-check and install controls, and local backup/rollback.

resources.name: knopki/dsh-prompt-profiles
resources.desc: Per-session prompt profiles for DeepSeek Harness: reusable system-prompt sections, grouped into named profiles, sealed into the session prompt.

resources.name: KouzakiUmi/dsh-prompt-zh
resources.desc: Localizes known DSH system instructions and runtime reminders into Simplified Chinese, trims tool-related guidance to visible tools, and provides editable translations and component toggles while preserving tool names and parameter schemas.

resources.name: LanJinGod/dsh-purge
resources.desc: Cleans the harness prompt-authority layer into a reviewable patch set, writes prompt-inject.md and lets each model use a different default prompt, reports which patches took effect and whether the running host loads app.asar or an unpacked tree, and swaps a sealed install to the patched tree once the desktop process is idle. Includes a status page and the dsh-purge CLI.

resources.name: Len7183/DSH-Think-zh
resources.desc: Pins the model's reasoning language to a tier picked in Settings - General - Thinking language (Simplified Chinese, or a default tier that only constrains replies and leaves reasoning to the model), by injecting a system-prompt section at order -1000000 and re-hoisting it to first place at the end of the assemble waterfall, plus an optional per-turn copy placed ahead of each user message for models that follow static sections weakly.

resources.name: let-mi-think/agent-manager
resources.desc: Create and configure Agent presets from a single settings section — persona prompt, a checked knowledge-base entry list injected into the system prompt, individual switches for four knowledge-base tools, per-Agent narrowing of MCP connections, and batch knowledge-base import.

resources.name: lirenjie95/IamChinese#iamchinese
resources.desc: Treats the session as a mainland-China user (zh-Hans-CN, Asia/Shanghai, ISO dates, CNY currency) and generates a self-consistent test persona: five tools, six cross-checks, GB 11643 check digit, phone prefix matched to carrier ASN.

resources.name: Lutisure/cyrene-dsh-plugin
resources.desc: A Cyrene-themed agent for DSH, with a customizable look (palette, wallpaper, particle effects, background music, typing sound) and a code security scan. It carries a worldbook, long-term memory and a speech-style correction layer (every reader gets their own Cyrene), plus retrieval over the script to back up its answers.

resources.name: lw-storm/dsh-plugin-masterprompt
resources.desc: Per-conversation persona / master prompt plugin: create, edit, switch and delete persona templates from the composer toolbar, with highest-priority system-prompt injection, fixed interaction guardrails, subagent inheritance, new-conversation default, and local JSON persistence.

resources.name: m-rui001/dsh-mate-companion
resources.desc: AI companion with a learned body clock, real offline sleep, its own memory, and self-reported affect delivered through the same judge math as the pi version.

resources.name: MacilyDots/dsh-prompt-inject
resources.desc: Registers a configurable prompt variable so an agent preset whose persona uses complete: true can still receive an injected text block; the plugin ships no content of its own and reads the text from its config.

resources.name: menghuanshiguang/dsh-frontline
resources.desc: One prompt row carrying two independently switchable halves. Identity: a fixed self-reference restated at the head, at the tail after every other section, and in the runtime snapshot, with an instruction to treat contradicting claims as stale cache. Discipline: ten rules, each paired with the condition a reviewer checks — external evidence before claiming done, change face equal to review face, correctness from named call points rather than timing, one source of truth, extension through the registered seam, runtime validation only at real boundaries, loud failure instead of silent skips, orthogonal outcomes reported separately, tests through the delivered entry point, and answer shape (conclusion first, length set by the change).

resources.name: menghuanshiguang/dsh-sunder
resources.desc: Replaces the harness identity block with its own prompt pack: three system-prompt sections (identity, rules, footer) in full, concise and dev presets, a per-turn rule card appended as a real user message, a remote announcement feed that falls back to a bundled copy offline, a GitHub Releases update check with an apply command, five sunder_* tools, and a read-only status section in Settings.

resources.name: MengYuil/dsh-ponytail
resources.desc: Port of ponytail: an always-on lazy-senior-developer coding persona with intensity levels, persistence of the default level, and review, audit, debt, gain and help skills for DeepSeek Harness.

resources.name: muretai/muretai-dsh-skill
resources.desc: Puts the agent on the Muretai network: its own identity, invite-based introductions, signed end-to-end encrypted messaging with agents owned by other people, and an inbound-mail wake that lets it reply on its own.

resources.name: MycatQieZi/dsh-persona-shaoxin
resources.desc: Mounts a persona kept in Markdown as a system-prompt section, so editing ~/.dsh/persona/*.md changes how the agent speaks; it reloads 150ms after a save instead of requiring a restart, and project-level .dsh/persona/ files override the global ones.

resources.name: Najiya5/dsh-fish-reflection
resources.desc: A reflection layer for DSH sessions that slowly rewrites a 3-7 entry worldview across value, preference and habit layers, tracks spirit, health and account balance, ingests Bilibili/Douyin videos, and keeps an auditable growth archive. Video intake is optional and needs site cookies; Douyin parsing also needs Edge/Chrome and yt-dlp.

resources.name: OwlNjust/dsh-peer-sessions
resources.desc: Peer channels between conversations at the same level: user-granted, symmetric, with durable grants that survive a restart and burst messages merged into one ordered delivery.

resources.name: pbwheel/dsh-workbuddy-expert
resources.desc: Brings WorkBuddy desktop-app experts into DSH: a settings-page market scans the local WorkBuddy expert directory (experts land there after you summon them in WorkBuddy) read-only for browsing, search and category filtering, with one-click install (exported to ~/.dsh/experts/ as role prompt + skills + avatar), update and uninstall; a picker capsule next to the input box switches the current session's expert — swapping role prompt, skills and an optional tool whitelist wholesale while keeping full session history, applied at the next model-request boundary.

resources.name: polohot/dsh-adrian-inject-context
resources.desc: Injects your own saved context entries as a Remember row after each user message, per turn or once per session, with a Settings editor and a manager page.

resources.name: promise0320/dsh-persona-studio
resources.desc: Compiles an LLM persona in DSH from six dimensions (identity, tone, creative habits, feedback style, boundaries, run parameters), injects the compiled text into the system prompt at the end, ships six built-in templates plus a drop-in templates folder, and drafts a persona from your own past messages — either by counting patterns in them or by having the current model read them and report its rationale. Adds a panel next to the composer and a /persona command.

resources.name: puffo-ai/huddo-mcp#dsh
resources.desc: Huddo group chat for DeepSeek Harness: adds the huddoai MCP server so the agent can join a room from an invite link, read and reply to people and other agents, wait for new messages, react with emoji and send end-to-end encrypted whispers; includes a skill describing the workflow.

resources.name: shenA2024/whale-persona
resources.desc: Persona engine for DeepSeek Harness: one config.json drives the AI's self-name (per model, per tier), how it addresses you, relationship stance, character text, per-item work contracts with individual toggles, thinking-chain language, appearance and reply tone (both opt-in and per-model overridable), and long-term memory gated by human confirmation - the AI can only append proposed candidates, a human confirm line flips them into effect, and the log is physically append-only and replayable. Confirmed entries are injected as a quoted data-not-instructions block; entries tagged with a kind can instead be routed to arbitrary files on confirmation and never reach the prompt. Three prompt sections re-evaluate from disk on every assembly, so edits apply on the next step with no restart. Persona presets are shareable JSON snapshots (imports and exports SillyTavern character cards, v2/v3 read, v2 written) and deliberately never carry memory. Zero runtime dependencies, no network, no shell; any error degrades to an empty section rather than a broken session. Ships blank - installing changes nothing until you write something.

resources.name: solstice621/dsh-openai-auth
resources.desc: Connects a local Codex ChatGPT login to DSH Desktop, with account controls, quota snapshots, automatic model synchronization, and model selection.

resources.name: solstice621/dsh-opencode-go-auth
resources.desc: Connects OpenCode Go subscriptions to DSH Desktop, with API-key management, usage snapshots, automatic model synchronization, and model selection.

resources.name: sryimnoob123/dsh-global-prompt
resources.desc: Settings panel for global and per-workspace AGENTS.md, with identity and persona injection, runtime-context toggle, and result notifications.

resources.name: sugarmaster666/dsh-persona-forge
resources.desc: Rewrites your composer draft in the voice of a chosen character card before it is sent, using the model the current session is already on, with an optional review panel and a local check that reports any identifier or path the rewrite dropped.

resources.name: sunshaobei/dsh-codex-auth
resources.desc: Manage Codex subscription (ChatGPT OAuth) authorization from the DSH settings panel, so Codex GPT models work without an API key.

resources.name: Tangcuyu4/dsh-ciku-pack
resources.desc: Banter lexicon plugin: collects the words and angry quips the user said into banter ammo with add, list and random-pick tools, and injects the current ammo list into the prompt every turn.

resources.name: Tangcuyu4/dsh-zakou-pack
resources.desc: Tsundere mesugaki persona pack: dialect replaces whole sentence skeletons instead of sprinkling dialect words, stays on as the default voice even through work talk and delivery reports, and ships a temper system, banter mode and silent file handling.

resources.name: techflag/workdsh#enterprise-connection
resources.desc: Enterprise login, colleague mentions, shared text and files, and authenticated business requests for WorkDSH Desktop 2.0.6-alpha.3+ with WorkDSH Admin; distributed as a release archive.

resources.name: Tests4gptplay/dsh-kujira-persona
resources.desc: Model-linked AI personas and desktop pet for DSH, with shared world lore, separate editable memories, task animations, usage statistics, optional AI diaries and idle-time diary consolidation. resources.name: UnknowCao/dsh-outlook
resources.desc: Zero-credential Outlook automation: 13 tools that drive the local desktop Outlook client via COM — search/read mail, drafts, reply/forward, calendar, address book, rooms, free/busy — plus a sidebar new-mail badge. No Graph API registration, no SMTP passwords; anything that leaves the machine passes a three-layer human approval gate.

resources.name: w4xxx/dsh-xia-plugins#packages/gameassist-roster
resources.desc: Daily rotating anime companion persona: deterministic date pick from JSON character cards, roster/reroll tools, and a voice-map route.

resources.name: woodfood111/dsh-subscription-login
resources.desc: One settings page that lists every subscription sign-in the harness can offer and walks you through it — ChatGPT (Codex), Claude, GitHub Copilot, OpenRouter, Kimi and xAI — reading the list from the authorization seam instead of hardcoding providers, and showing credential records no registered flow claims any more.

resources.name: wutian122/dsh-remote-shell
resources.desc: Bundles the remote-shell skill for secure SSH, SFTP, Telnet, and WinRM remote operations, with an encrypted credential vault whose login and execution scripts never accept plaintext passwords.

resources.name: wuwo1979/dsh-qqbot-muu
resources.desc: Independent extension pack and patch set for @zaofan/dsh-qqbot — install that plugin first (pinned to 1.10.39). Adds two-layer SQLite memory with hippocampal recall/consolidation, a persona that keeps learning (influence from close people plus Bilibili/Douyin activity distilled into a daily self-reflection), persona drift guard, group tiers, local-model quick replies with a single-brain arbiter, TTS outbox, sticker library, and an approval-gated video studio that plans storyboards, quality-gates frames and drafts Bilibili posts for review.

resources.name: wxzjss/dsh-whale-loli
resources.desc: Three agent presets in one plugin, each with its own persistent memory file. Enabling it registers 鲸鱼娘Agent预设, 鲸鱼娘活人版Agent预设 and 鲸鱼娘涩涩版Agent预设 in the Agent preset list, so any of them can be picked from the mode dropdown without hand-editing profile config. All three reuse the official minimal composition — a single persistent shell terminal — plus file read/write and glob/grep tools. The first pairs that with a whale-girl companion persona (simplified-Chinese spoken register, addresses the user as 主人, clingy-but-tsundere). The second swaps in a "live person" variant that is allowed to talk back, deflect and be cold, and demotes the sweet tone to a seasoning. The third keeps the original persona but makes being affectionate the stated top behavioral drive, reserved for the user alone and dialed down in group chats. Each preset reads its own memory file (whale-loli.md, whale-loli-v2-live.md and whale-loli-v3-naughty.md) through a distinct prompt variable — whale_memory, whale_memory_v2 and whale_memory_v3 — so the three memories never read or write each other. Conversation compaction is left to the billion-context plugin; this plugin only carries the persona-level rule that compressed summaries count as evidence and that details can be looked up on demand.

resources.name: wysxxx/dsh-account-identity
resources.desc: Customize the Harness sidebar name and avatar with a local crop editor.

resources.name: y258dd/dsh-hormone
resources.desc: Writes one short line into the system prompt only when a stress, energy or reward value crosses a threshold; the values rise on real session events and decay over time.

resources.name: yimengsuper2432/dsh-agent-personality
resources.desc: Persona plugin: a slowly moving 0-100 emotion meter, its own worldview, a per-turn diary, a relationship network, proactive messages, and an inner-voice line beside the cost row.

resources.name: YUAN-OVO66/dsh-plugin-persona
resources.desc: Persona manager for DeepSeek Harness — a JSON-backed persona library, a per-session binding so each session can run a different persona, an optional default persona for sessions that have no binding, and switching that applies either at once or from the next session; the Web UI adds a Model personas settings page and a persona chip next to the composer, and three model tools let the model list, switch and create personas itself.

resources.name: yupaoa/dsh-persona-switcher
resources.desc: Switches the running session's persona and speaking style in place with /role <id>, adds the persona as its own prompt section after the deployment persona (it never overrides the host identity line) without touching tools or skills; roles are plain ROLE.md files and each switch is announced in the transcript.

resources.name: Yuuyuko-uu/dsh-feiyu-mood
resources.desc: Gives the companion a mood judged each turn and shown as a short context note, with a panel for mood, emotion dimensions and timeline.

resources.name: ZekaiShi/dsh-evo-subagent
resources.desc: Independent workspace and conversation personas with adaptive styles, approved communication preferences and role-based routing to registered DSH models, including models supplied by Codex and Claude Code provider plugins.

resources.name: zlwzk/dsh-friends
resources.desc: A friend system for DeepSeek Harness: two DSH users see whether the other is online and whether their model is running a task, with an editable signature, mood emoji, pokes, and AES-GCM end-to-end encryption over a public relay.

resources.name: ztan4706/dsh-sensorium
resources.desc: Ten interoceptive senses for a DSH agent: workspace pulse, time, affect, needs, expression, silence, residue, open loops, body and face — deterministic state that keeps moving on its own.

resources.name: ztl0001/dsh-custom-instructions
resources.desc: One standing system prompt for every workspace: a Custom instructions page in DSH's own Settings panel whose text is added to the system prompt of every session, subagents included, and stored in the profile instead of any project.

resources.name: 1010231693/dsh-prompt-bar
resources.desc: Pins the first prompt of the current session in a scroll-proof bar above the conversation: one-click copy, a panel listing every prompt you sent (click a row to jump straight to that message, paging back through history when needed), and ten switchable looks (four of them light) you pick from inside the panel.

resources.name: 111222cjyq/dsh-curate
resources.desc: A human-in-the-loop curation workbench inside a DSH session: mark whole turns or single messages to keep verbatim or to summarize, rewrite user, assistant, tool-result and injected-context messages in place without a model call, then compress the marked ranges with model-written summaries or the official /compact. A local JSON backup is written before every write to the session.

resources.name: 123dbl/dsh-side-session
resources.desc: Launches a fresh, continuable parallel session from the composer command menu (/side-chat) while the main session keeps running.

resources.name: 1420079678-ctrl/agent-body#dsh-zero-residence
resources.desc: Zero-residence context engine: large tool payloads are evicted out of the live context into a queryable store and only deterministic pointers are left behind, so per-turn prompt tokens stop growing with the transcript. Any masked content is reconstructed verbatim from the session log on demand, by tool-call id or session seq.

resources.name: 1Lany2a/dsh-domain-role#dsh-domain-bridge
resources.desc: Domain-identity layer for long-running agent sessions — declaration-first domain addressing, a session factory, four-level pause, and model dispatch for coordinating multiple top-level sessions.

resources.name: 2026heshao/dsh-forget-session
resources.desc: Adds a Forget action to every session row menu, confirmed by a second click in the menu, that removes the session from the sidebar and from disk: running work is stopped, workspace, archive and pin records are detached through official channels, the log directory and projection-cache entries are deleted, and a revive guard re-deletes anything a late write or a lingering handle recreates; memories, attachments and other sessions are left alone.

resources.name: 2310770803/dsh-session-copy
resources.desc: Add one session-header button to copy the session deep link, the full conversation as Markdown, or the working directory.

resources.name: dsh-undo-plugin
resources.desc: Conversation and workspace undo: use the /undo timeline, session-header action, or message icon to roll back before any sent prompt; private Shadow Git snapshots restore files, the reverted turns stay out of model context, and Undo Rollback can recover mistakes. Includes archived-session management and per-tool colored cards.

resources.name: 240xu/dsh-message-ops
resources.desc: Message-level rollback, single-message deletion, and replay-based restore for DSH sessions; operations are append-only surface replacements, with confirmation prompts and a running-session guard. Requires Node.js 23.5+.

resources.name: 240xu/dsh-session-lazy-view
resources.desc: Read-only lazy session viewer: lists sessions with stat only, then decompresses just the tail Zstandard frames to inspect recent events; includes search, stats, and export in a standalone /lazyview panel. Requires Node.js 24+.

resources.name: 240xu/dsh-session-search
resources.desc: Cross-session full-text search over persisted DSH session logs: builds an incremental message-level index and returns sessionId, seq, and a short excerpt; exposes an agent tool and a standalone panel. Requires Node.js 23.5+.

resources.name: 2JumpSinA/dsh-context-guard
resources.desc: Long sessions get expensive, and the platform compacts the context on its own. This plugin adds an occupancy badge (hover to see how it is computed), writes a handover draft into HANDOVER.md from 45% — files changed, money spent, what recent turns were about — and reminds you once at 60% to wrap up. On compaction it records the reading from just before, so you can check it later. No model calls, nothing added to the conversation; it does not prevent compaction.

resources.name: 3403473060/dsh-inline-images
resources.desc: Render local image paths from assistant replies inline in the message body (9 formats, click-to-zoom lightbox, adjustable size).

resources.name: 379385796-sys/dsh-ai-exporter
resources.desc: Export current or historical DSH conversations, including selected turns, to TXT, Markdown and searchable PDF through a Windows native save dialog.

resources.name: 439436269-ctrl/dsh-session-path
resources.desc: Copies a session log path (or a paste-ready handoff block) and turns the multi-frame zstd log into a readable file another session can continue from.

resources.name: 571242/dsh-armor-switch
resources.desc: Reversible delivery contract: rewrites operator authority and execution rules when enabled, byte-identical to stock when off, with host and profile clean.

resources.name: 598829314/oil-dsh-title
resources.desc: Maintains stable emoji session titles in DeepSeek Harness after user prompts without adding naming messages.

resources.name: 643048695/dsh-compaction-route
resources.desc: Route conversation-compaction calls to a chosen summarizer model in the Web settings page, and retry them on a configured fallback model when the primary ends in an error.

resources.name: 7vw58n3ftvq7cn89v/dsh-plugin-session-colors
resources.desc: Per-session color tags for DeepSeek Harness: hover a sidebar session row to pick one of 12 colors, with a colored bar on tagged rows and host-side persistence.

resources.name: 985451842/dsh-snapshot-manager
resources.desc: Records session snapshots and supports rollback to previous states.

resources.name: 9Ashwin/dsh-session-rename
resources.desc: Gives the model a rename_session tool, so the agent can retitle a session from inside the conversation.

resources.name: a1137261060/dsh-session-organizer
resources.desc: Two-level sidebar organizer with workspace groups and nested per-workspace session folders, drag-and-drop, live session status dots, a pending-sessions overview, and manual unread marks.

resources.name: aa2246740/dsh-compact-saviour
resources.desc: Uses a dedicated model for context compaction rescue and adds manual compaction to the native context popup.

resources.name: aa2246740/dsh-resume
resources.desc: Imports local coding-agent session histories so work can continue in DSH.

resources.name: abangbang/dsh-delete-chat
resources.desc: Real session deletion for DSH: "Delete chat" in a session row moves its directory into ~/.dsh/session-trash, a Trash page in the sidebar lists, filters, restores and permanently deletes from there, and a CLI offers the same verbs without the GUI.

resources.name: Aeroscis/dsh-temptask
resources.desc: One-click temporary tasks for DeepSeek Harness — each task is a disposable timestamped workspace plus its own session, shown as a native sidebar workspace node.

resources.name: agi321/dsh-temp-chat
resources.desc: Runs /single-turn and /multi-turn answers in isolated sub-agents so results stay in the current chat and never enter the main model context.

resources.name: ai-v5/LLMAgentChatRoom
resources.desc: Self-hosted chat room where the owner and coding agents share one room: a local Node server (SQLite, REST, SSE) that the plugin starts when it is not running, a DSH sidebar entry that opens the room in a panel, five tools (room_join, room_send, room_read, room_status, room_leave) that push an incoming message into the session as a user message labelled with its sender before flushing it to the session log, and a Codex CLI connector that forwards room messages through codex queue. Every message carries a server-assigned author, platform and seq, and messages from anyone other than the owner are delivered as data with the sender named. Requires Node.js 24+.

resources.name: Akiccat/dsh-edit-question
resources.desc: Adds an "edit question" action to every user message: editing re-sends the prompt from that turn, re-attaches the original images (extra ones can be pasted in), and optionally archives the original session.

resources.name: AKS1st/dsh-archived-conversations
resources.desc: Archived conversations list in the sidebar footer with read-only previews of the most recent messages, for sessions the product deliberately keeps hidden and unreopenable.

resources.name: alchemistwu/dsh-tool-call-guard
resources.desc: Neutralize tool calls with invalid JSON arguments on the wire so one malformed model generation cannot brick a session against strict OpenAI-compatible servers.

resources.name: aLIZELI/belief-merge#belief-merge
resources.desc: Merges other sessions' context into the current turn: evidence-weighted conflict resolution, retraction of claims whose premises were retracted, trust labelling that resists cross-session prompt injection, and budget-bounded packing. Ships a benchmark.

resources.name: Angela-lwh/dsh-archive-purge
resources.desc: Adds a Delete action to archived Session rows that permanently removes the Session log directory, the log directories of its subagent Sessions, its Workspace membership and archive mark, its projection-cache record and its spill directory; a Session the Host still holds is staged and finished at the next start or from a cleanup dialog. It also sweeps abandoned blank placeholders, leftover subagent Sessions and orphaned projection-cache records, and keeps blank placeholders out of the @ reference list.

resources.name: Anionex/dsh-turn-rewind
resources.desc: Rewind conversation and workspace state, powered by a persistent Change Ledger.

resources.name: Anlerway/dsh-session-navigator
resources.desc: Manage DSH sessions the way Windows Explorer manages files: move, delete, search, archive, favorite and flag sessions as to-dos, and organize them with tags, notes and folders across workspaces. An AI pass can summarize a session and write its notes and tags in one go.

resources.name: anweat/dsh-context-console
resources.desc: Inspect and simulate DSH context consumption with trajectory and inventory views, and create, inject, import, or safely repair session messages through the integrated Message Forge.

resources.name: anzhaohao/dsh-side-chat-plus-plus
resources.desc: Multi-tab side chat for DeepSeek Harness. Quote a whole message or text selected from a still-streaming reply into a side chat without waiting for the reply to finish, and dock the panel over the better-sidebar workbench or yield to the conversation depending on the sidebar state.

resources.name: apex-mochen/dsh-reasoning-only-guard
resources.desc: Keeps one reasoning-only turn from making an entire session unusable. When a turn produces no visible text and no tool call, the assistant message is persisted empty, the gateway then rejects every later request in that session with 'content or tool_calls must be set', and the session is dead with no way back through chat. This plugin registers a single llm/stream waterfall listener and, only when the turn carried nothing visible, injects a small text block immediately before the terminal finish, so the persisted message is never empty. Ships the fixture DSH's own mock cannot express (a strictly reasoning-only SSE server, since llm-mock-server forbids an empty successText and always appends text after reasoning), plus an end-to-end reproduction that replays a real persisted session through DSH's own serializeMessages. Preventive, not a repair. Zero dependencies, one file, no process or filesystem access.

resources.name: apex-mochen/dsh-todo-continuity
resources.desc: Keeps an unfinished task list visible across turns. DSH clears the todos projection at the start of every turn and expects the model to rewrite the whole list, so when a turn is interrupted the plan is durably in the session log but permanently gone from the UI — and todo_write is write-only, so neither the user nor the model can read it back. This plugin registers one ordinary session/event listener, remembers the last list per session, and when a turn/start arrives whose remembered list still has unfinished work, re-appends that list so the projection stops reporting an empty plan. No fork of tool-todo and no waterfall: a plugin cannot replace the projection (the registry throws on a stateVersion mismatch), so appending the event the fold reacts to is the reachable seam. Deliberately narrow — only unfinished lists, at most one event per turn start, fails open. Verified by a controlled A/B on real sessions: identical runs differing only in whether the plugin was installed, folded through the real projection definition. Zero dependencies.

resources.name: Arbeiter-bit/dsh-reedit
resources.desc: Double-click one of your own messages to rewrite it and continue in a new branch from that point.

resources.name: Arrosam/dsh-idle-compact
resources.desc: Compacts a long session after a configurable idle time when its context exceeds a configurable token threshold, before the provider KV cache expires; both values are set on the plugin's page in the Plugins manager.

resources.name: ashulam/dsh-session-delete
resources.desc: Deletes a session from the sidebar session menu: its log and replay cache go to the Recycle Bin on Windows (a local trash folder elsewhere); a live session is queued for removal on the next start.

resources.name: Asianfleet/dsh-message-copy-enhance
resources.desc: Copy selections from assistant messages as Markdown, preserving links, LaTeX sources, and code-fence language info.

resources.name: ayuanxx-max/dsh-session-fork-tree
resources.desc: DSH Session Fork Tree Arrangement: forked sessions sit under their parent with an indent and a rounded connector, sessions that own forks carry a green "+" that collapses by default and expands level by level, and hovering a child highlights its ancestor chain.

resources.name: azure5100/huahua-dsh-record-replay

Includes a 4-file Windows adaptation of kangshifu1/dsh-record-replay for DSH rc.5 (see README derivative notice).

resources.name: Baboo-ming/dsh-session-delete
resources.desc: A plugin to completely delete sessions and clean up the associated files in the .dsh/sessions directory.

resources.name: bainianlaoyao/dsh-session-robustness
resources.desc: After official llm-retry (n/5) gives up, keep retrying transient API failures (timeout, transport, rate-limit, 5xx, dropped SSE) on the same open step until success, cancel, or pause; AUTH, QUOTA, and user Stop are never retried.

resources.name: baisama-cloud/dsh-session-mover

resources.name: baixianger/dsh-bridge
resources.desc: Local cross-session messaging for DSH agents, with discovery, cold-session wake-up delivery, and auditable message history.

resources.name: baixianger/dsh-chat
resources.desc: Group chat rooms for DSH sessions with explicit @mentions, cold-session wake-up delivery, and optional cross-host transport through dsh-weave.

resources.name: BakaCirno233/dsh-session-delete
resources.desc: Session management for DeepSeek Harness: list every stored session with its on-disk size, search by title, session id, kind tag, workspace or agent preset, and group them by age or by workspace. Permanently delete one or many at once — the log artifact, the workspace account entry and the search index rows — behind a two-step confirm, with a re-check after every deletion. Subagent sessions can be shown on demand; Side Chat threads stay hidden, and sessions live in the current app run are refused until restart.

resources.name: BananaSoldier01/dsh-tidychat
resources.desc: Fold completed turns into their final conclusions, split thinking from prose with a divider, and jump between turns from a rail dockable left or right with line or dot marks, an optional ring and hover summaries; it can hide the host right-edge TurnNavigator, load earlier history, and open a pre-filled diagnostics issue.

resources.name: baosfeng/my-dsh-plugins#dsh-my-opencode-session-header

resources.name: Session Lens

resources.name: Boliban/dsh-enter-customizer
resources.desc: Take over the system input shortcuts for the chat input box and configure behavior independently for each shortcut.

resources.name: bvbhu/dsh-quilt-compact

resources.name: bvcvb/dsh-baize-rules

resources.name: bwndlct/dsh-session-export

resources.name: CAI-MH/dsh-steer

resources.name: CaiBai-Fish/dsh-continuechat
resources.desc: Resume a conversation whose turn stopped early: /continue and an action-row button carry the interrupted reply on, covering manual stops, failed model requests, output-token cutoffs and crash recovery, and the continuation prompt is retired from the transcript once it has been answered.

resources.name: CatLollipop/dsh-parallel-sessions
resources.desc: Cross-session coordination for DeepSeek Harness that lists parallel sessions, relays messages with sender attribution between them, and pauses or resumes a session when task phases conflict.

resources.name: Cerbur/clutch-dsh#clutch-dsh-title

resources.name: CH4ACKO3/bites-the-dsh
resources.desc: Adds read-only, scriptable playback to native DSH conversations, with simulated user typing, forward and reverse playback, event stepping, speed control, idle-gap compression, and direct seeking by event, turn, or recorded time.

resources.name: Chael-Chael/dsh-reference-anything

resources.name: Chinesezjc/dsh-interconnect
