resources.name: chouyong/dsh-branch-review
resources.desc: Track human decisions for related DSH session branches: keep, discard, or follow up with reasons, labels, and external links.

resources.name: chouyong/dsh-fork-diff
resources.desc: Read-only side-by-side comparison of related DeepSeek Harness conversation histories, including messages, tool calls, responses, timing, and usage.

resources.name: chouyong/dsh-fork-graph
resources.desc: Git-style conversation fork graph in the session header: colored lanes and fork curves show which session branched from which, with click-to-jump navigation.

resources.name: chrisx9z/dsh-session-chat-share
resources.desc: Share a selected chat segment as Markdown, HTML, TXT, or PNG; Session-header dialog with range or multi-select, redaction, tool calls, and subagent conversations, plus the /share command.

resources.name: ChuanTianML/dsh-local-share
resources.desc: Export complete Web Sessions to local Markdown or self-contained HTML, with stable rendered previews, default redaction, and opt-in bounded tool-call details.

resources.name: ChuShiZ/dsh-archive-manager
resources.desc: Archived-session manager for DSH Web: workspace-grouped list, FTS5 full-text search over session content with per-session snippets, restore-and-open, and hard delete.

resources.name: cindyguyuehu123/dsh-webchatlike
resources.desc: Bring the deepseek.com web/app chat experience to DSH: edit your prompt and regenerate answers in place, with a per-message <i/N> version pager (tree model, stable across conversations).

resources.name: CJXIAO0718/dsh-plugin-session-share
resources.desc: Export any DeepSeek Harness session as a single self-contained HTML page that opens offline, with per-message picking, collapsed tool calls and default redaction of local paths and credentials.

resources.name: Coprexist/dsh-session-recovery
resources.desc: Recover deleted or corrupted dsh sessions (session.jsonl.zstd) and memory (memory.db) from the raw disk, and repair rebuilt sessions that fail to resume via the /session-repair command in the web UI.

resources.name: corlinniu/dsh-daily-chat
resources.desc: Splits New Session in the DSH web sidebar into two modes: a 日常聊天 row opens a session on the daily agent preset the plugin installs into the harness home (persona, web search and fetch, ask-user and compaction — no files, shell, plan mode or subagents), inside its own daily-chat workspace whose sidebar region lists only those chats, while 开始工作 keeps the shipped coding agent; the built-in New Session button is hidden and every other New Session entry point follows the active mode, which is remembered in localStorage.

resources.name: cq-guojia/dsh-session-title-pattern
resources.desc: Reformats dsh session titles as "date | type | topic" (type and topic are summarized by a model from the full conversation), and hides unused sessions from the sidebar without deleting them.

resources.name: Curiouslv/dsh-session-board
resources.desc: Session board orb: live thinking and tool progress per session, task duration, context usage and 12h/30d usage stats; click through to any session.

resources.name: cyh3436332528/dsh-plugin-session-purge#plugin
resources.desc: Permanently delete a DSH session — not just archive it — cascading over its log directory, projection cache, workspace bookkeeping and child (subagent) sessions. Adds a settings-page panel that groups sessions by workspace with size, age and live/archived/child markers, supports filtering and batch deletion, and confirms each deletion inline below the row.

resources.name: czm15053/dsh-peer-link
resources.desc: Let dsh and Claude Code sessions message each other directly; comes with a clickable peer list card (sort/search/send/refresh).

resources.name: d0ublecl1ck/dsh-session-radar
resources.desc: Sidebar unread / waiting / status hub for DSH Web: a bell jumps to the next unread session, a shortcut walks sessions waiting for input, and ⌘⇧, / ⌘⇧. step back and forward through the conversations you have visited; one overlay lists unread and pending sessions side by side; a six-metric readout at the sidebar foot makes every icon a button that jumps to the next session of that kind; a host-side ledger keeps the account across restarts, so an unread session keeps its green row dot after a restart, and a startup dialog offers to re-send a continue message to sessions whose turn was cut off.

resources.name: DDDMUC/dsh-delete-turn
resources.desc: Per-message delete for DSH: remove a user message, one reply step, or a whole assistant reply from the derived model context through the official surface-replace contract, and hide it from the visible transcript without rewriting the append-only log.

resources.name: deepsleepAquarium/dsh-whale-post#bus
resources.desc: File-backed post office between DeepSeek Harness sessions: every letter is sealed with an HMAC and a body digest, recipients are resolved through a roster interface, and delivery is offline-first, so an undeliverable letter waits in the mailbox instead of being lost.

resources.name: DelayNooMore/dsh-plugin-session-trash
resources.desc: Session trash for DSH: move sessions to a recoverable trash, restore or purge them in settings.

resources.name: delock/dsh-whats-up
resources.desc: What's up - a zero-maintenance status board for your sessions. Scans every conversation on the host, extracts a goal + one-line status per session (multi-provider LLM, fingerprint-cached), surfaces half-done, unanswered and recent work in a sidebar panel, and jumps you back into any session with one click.

resources.name: DenAbr/dsh-compact-selected-model
resources.desc: /compact and auto-compaction summarize with the model selected in the session, not the model that finished the last turn.

resources.name: device1999/dsh-session-archive-delete
resources.desc: Adds backup-then-delete and delete-only actions to the DSH session menu: the session directory, its projection cache and a metadata snapshot are copied to a local archive folder and checked file by file, then the originals are deleted to free disk space; subagent sessions it spawned are handled in the same run, and each backup folder keeps a RESTORE.txt with recovery steps.

resources.name: Diluka/dsh-afk
resources.desc: AFK controls for ask_user_question: profile-wide or per-session settings, configurable automatic replies or blocking new calls, and session-log question history with read tracking; does not approve permissions or plans. Supports DSH 0.2.1-rc.2 and 0.2.1-rc.3 only.

resources.name: Domaki-co/dsh-message-forward
resources.desc: Cross-session message forwarding between DSH sessions: extract one model reply, a user message, or a multi-selected batch of messages and images from one session and deliver it into another, with silent send, draft fill, or send-and-jump delivery, plus prompt templates.

resources.name: domitor-syh/dsh-rollback
resources.desc: TRAE-style conversation rollback — per-turn checkpoints (10-turn sliding window) roll back touched files and truncate model context in place, keeping the same session id. Human-initiated only: a /rollback command or a per-turn Web button (works on interrupted turns too), with a preview listing each affected file and its action — restore, recover, delete, or skip.

resources.name: dongasai/dsh_compact_queue
resources.desc: Registers /compact_queue, a compaction command that does not drop the request when the session is busy: it compacts immediately when idle, otherwise queues the request in that session and runs it at the session's next idle window, with a 2-second fallback tick beside the agent status event so the trigger is not missed, a 30-minute wait cap, and /compact_queue cancel to withdraw a queued request or abort a running one. Each session keeps its own queue state from a single command registration, completion and failure arrive as a collapsed notice that does not wake the model, and every ManualCompactionError code except busy is terminal so a failure is not retried. Host half only; the core /compact command is left untouched.

resources.name: dongasai/running-sessions-float
resources.desc: Collects the sessions that need you into one dock at the bottom of the web GUI sidebar: running sessions, sessions waiting on an approval, plan review or answer, and finished runs whose result has not been opened yet. Rows are sorted by last update and clicking one switches the main view to that session; it reuses the shipped useSessions and useSessionStatus hooks rather than adding a data source, polls nothing, stores nothing and modifies no session. The header dot pulses while anything is running or waiting and settles to a static dot when every row is only a finished-but-unread reminder; with no such sessions the dock collapses to one quiet line, and a collapsed 56px sidebar shows a 36px badge with the count instead of the list. It registers in the sidebar footer slot, so it is part of the layout and does not overlay the conversation list, leaving the existing footer entries below it.

resources.name: donghangxunlang-cmd/dsh-attention-health
resources.desc: Content-degradation detection (thinking loops, output repetition) for DeepSeek Harness, with a continue-vs-handoff cost verdict and zero-model handoff documents.

resources.name: dongsheng123132/task-passport
resources.desc: Carry durable task state across DeepSeek Harness, WorkBuddy, Claude Code and Codex with machine-readable checkpoints and optimistic locking.

resources.name: dotdance/dsh-title-prefix
resources.desc: Prefixes every session title with the name of its workspace or project, so a flat session list shows which project each conversation belongs to; titles you renamed yourself are left unchanged.

resources.name: dpskk2/dsh-chatsync
resources.desc: Two-way sync of DSH sessions, workspace mappings, settings and patches between machines through your own private GitHub repo (API keys stay machine-local).

resources.name: dream12347/dsh-session-manager
resources.desc: DSH session manager: delete with trash/restore/purge, restore archived sessions, recent-activity stats, continue/pause, open log folder, unread markers, fork into a new chat, workspace grouping and sorting, context compaction threshold.

resources.name: drscrewdriver/dsh-context-compression-improved
resources.desc: Same-origin in mechanism with the two loudest lines in context compression. The code-skeleton gate follows the skeletonization approach of Headroom (Apache-2.0), whose published headline is 20% fewer tokens for coding agents and 60–95% fewer tokens for JSON, same answers. The estimator channel follows TokenPilot (arXiv:2606.17016), which reports up to 60% lower cost for long-session agents. Both figures are theirs, quoted as-is; this plugin ships no benchmark of its own and claims no reduction of its own. What it adds for DeepSeek Harness: choose a compression profile, set the Auto Compact trigger level and toggle code-skeleton compression from one settings section, with exact DeepSeek V4 tokenizer measurement, same-revision count verification, and fail-open behaviour that keeps the original tool results on unsupported models. Within a turn it supports skeletonized information compression with a low original-text retrieval rate; at the tail of a turn it supports a turn-tail intent summary implemented purely by content substitution; context content stays safe, and the whole process runs inside the official JSONL compression.

resources.name: drscrewdriver/dsh-date-wrapper
resources.desc: Compresses DSH time-context from ~280 chars to 46 chars by injecting a compact date line into the runtime-context snapshot; zero runtime dependencies.

resources.name: drscrewdriver/dsh-manage-session
resources.desc: Session Manager for DSH (formerly Session Steward): one console over active and archived sessions — grouped by workspace, domain and title filters, favorites, and batch archive / unarchive / purge archived files (destructive steps ask twice) — plus a four-gate health checkup (log integrity, projection cache, lossless JSON, cold read) that ends in a reversible, backup-first prescription. Search and indexing live in dsh-search-index; this plugin builds no index and never rewrites session logs.

resources.name: drscrewdriver/dsh-reference-session-collector
resources.desc: Read-only session-log projector (drsc) for DSH: scans ~/.dsh/sessions/, decodes zstd/tiled-frame logs with a vendored leaf decoder and rewrites per-session projections into its own SQLite (node:sqlite, segments / replaces + FTS5), exposed through a single fenced HTTP route — surface ledger, recall/compression pair accounting and Chinese-capable full-text search. Token counts share the exact DeepSeek-V4 tokenizer and formula as CCI verify, falling back to a labelled chars/4 basis when assets are absent. Never writes session files; all output lands in its own data directory. Serves three consumer plugins: context-compression-improved (surface marking + recall reconciliation), session-steward (search-corpus switch), prime-memory (historical anchor backfill). Hosts 0.1.0-rc.2 .. 0.2.1-rc.2 (17-tag exact engines.dsh enum). npm: dsh-reference-session-collector.

resources.name: drscrewdriver/dsh-search-index
resources.desc: Sidebar session search that builds its own index instead of reusing DSH's full-text one: title to content toggle in one entry, results grouped per session with the strongest snippet and user/reply/tool tags, plus watermark-based incremental sync, archive-driven pruning of archived sessions, and a shadow rebuild that never blocks the live index.

resources.name: drscrewdriver/dsh-session-guard
resources.desc: Peak-hour auto session gate: weekend mode + global peak auto-pause + session-level freeze/resume + backend auto-retry, auto-resume on off-peak.

resources.name: dsboylw/LazyNoobsCockloft#dsh-session-notes
resources.desc: Session notes 0.3.1: multiple numbered notes per session (1 2 3… by creation order), session-level color and pin (one click in the popover title row), a copy picker (click any note to copy), per-session delete-all, compatible with DSH Desktop 0.8.2.

resources.name: duanyunlun/dsh-conversation-link
resources.desc: Peer communication between conversations in one DeepSeek Harness process: list the conversations the workspace shows, link one under a nickname, message it without waiting for its turn to end, read its progress without waking it, and declare rules for your own tool calls.

resources.name: dylan121322/dsh-session-unarchive
resources.desc: Restore archived sessions to their original workspace from the Web GUI sidebar.

resources.name: DylanYeung0929/dsh-session-bridge
resources.desc: Read, message and live-follow local DeepSeek Harness sessions from inside an agent: four tools (session_list, session_read, session_send, session_chat) plus a matching Python CLI, over the desktop app local RPC; transcripts also read offline. Requires Python 3.10+; offline transcript reads also need the zstd CLI.

resources.name: dzwalker/dsh-session-keepwarm
resources.desc: Keeps the most recently used sessions resident in the browser so switching back reuses the already loaded history instead of re-reading it; the number of resident sessions is configurable and the plugin can be switched off.

resources.name: Earnest02522/dsh-archive-manager
resources.desc: Archived-conversation manager for DeepSeek Harness: view archived conversations grouped by workspace, restore them, and reveal their transcript folders.

resources.name: EarthPretender/dsh-session-delete
resources.desc: Adds a red "Delete session" row beneath Archive in the sidebar session menu and permanently deletes that one session - its stored logs and its workspace account entry, written through the workspace registry itself. A second click confirms and the row leaves the list immediately; sessions opened this run are disposed from memory first so nothing resurrects them, and a session running work shows one extra warning whose click stops the task before deleting.

resources.name: Eason-22/dsh-autorestart
resources.desc: DeepSeek Harness plugin: restart without losing work. It waits until every conversation is idle, restarts the host, and picks the interrupted work back up instead of dying with it. Every restart is preceded by a snapshot of the configuration and the installed plugins; if the host does not come up, a one-shot watchdog restores that snapshot, starts the host once more, and records the outcome. Where a supervisor already manages the host it asks that supervisor instead of starting a second one. When the work is done it counts down and powers the machine off. It works on the Windows desktop client and on a hosted dsh web instance (Windows, WSL, Linux).

resources.name: Edge-Echo/dsh-driftwatch
resources.desc: Behavior-drift reports for DSH sessions: compares two session logs and reports tool-sequence alignment, tool mix, reasoning volume, timing, retries and file targets, with an optional CI threshold gate. Zero dependencies.

resources.name: EIGHTfs/dsh-session-conductor
resources.desc: Session management for DSH: archive/restore, batch & conditional delete, AI auto-rename, interrupted-session auto-resume, workspace grouping, undo last message, repair damaged session logs (seq-gap/EIO/dual-format), value analysis and full-text search — plus plan/closing template injection (system prompt + context).

resources.name: EIGHTfs/dsh-session-migrate
resources.desc: Cross-version session migration for DSH: sweeps legacy session stores (v0 plaintext, .zstd and .zip exports), re-pins the header cwd to the target workspace and drops sessions in so the persistence layer upgrades them on open; settings sidebar with env/import/list/convert tabs plus a CLI (check / fix / import).

resources.name: Elefseus/dsh-default-workspace
resources.desc: Moves the default workspace off the system drive (DSH opens every new Session in <Documents>/deepseek-harness/default-workspace and never relocates it) while keeping stored sessions usable: rewrites the workspace record without a restart, offers the same three actions as a GUI panel, moves stored session logs together with their header cwd, and re-frames logs whose first frame is not exactly one header line. Requires the desktop host (workspaceRegistry and sessionPersistence).

resources.name: elk-9527/dsh-auto-archive
resources.desc: Automatically archives idle DSH conversations after a configurable number of days and clears the projection cache of archived sessions, without deleting transcripts or attachments.

resources.name: EmptyVessel-000/dsh-file-history
resources.desc: Per-turn checkpoints of the whole workspace: every turn ends with a snapshot, the files it changed are listed under that turn in the chat, and any turn can be restored — files, the conversation, or both. Capture is a whole-tree scan rather than a hook on write/edit tools, so edits made by shell commands, external editors or git leave a record too. Restoring the conversation forks it from that turn instead of cutting the original, and a restore can itself be undone. History sits in a shadow git repository under DSH_HOME and never touches your project .git. Requires Git >= 2.20 and Node.js >= 20.

resources.name: Enosensu/dsh-fork-relink
resources.desc: Fork companion for DSH: on any official fork, copies every direct subagent child of the source session onto the forked conversation (recursively, whole subtrees) through the official agent API, leaving each copy as a cold session the official resume path can wake — so the new conversation keeps its subagent panel and can keep messaging those children, while the originals stay with the old branch.

resources.name: erlingmijiang/dsh-lorebooklike-prompt-tool
resources.desc: SillyTavern-style prompt rules for DSH: layered system-prompt anchors, constant/keyword entries, reproducible probability gates and regex rewriting.

resources.name: EvilIrving/dsh-context-proxy
resources.desc: Thin on-demand context retrieval: context_query / context_slice / context_grep tools that read already-persisted history back with replay-safe citations.

resources.name: extremity2740938284-create/dsh-agent-sync
resources.desc: Mirrors other coding agents' sessions into DeepSeek Harness as continuable tasks, one workspace per application.

resources.name: falling-ts/dsh-force-compact
resources.desc: Forces context compression when running low-context llama.cpp models such as Qwen3.8-27B, improving model efficiency and usage smoothness, together with well-refined compaction prompts.

resources.name: FallnStrelitzia/dsh-chat-settings
resources.desc: Per-conversation system prompt, turn-based context folding, sampling overrides and a low-token pure chat mode for DeepSeek Harness.

resources.name: fallow5/dsh-pin-sessions
resources.desc: Pin and unpin sessions to the top of the Web sidebar with a dedicated pinned panel, archive section, and native three-dot menu integration.

resources.name: Fan-sx/dsh-session-focus
resources.desc: Marks a Session as focus or parked in one click from its sidebar row, its hover card, or the conversation header, and keeps a count visible at the foot of the sidebar and next to workspace folder names when those groups are collapsed. A panel lists every marked Session alongside the states the sidebar already tracks (waiting for a reply, running, finished-unread), and the sidebar foot opens whichever one needs a reply first.

resources.name: feiertu/dsh-input-rewriter
resources.desc: Type normally; about two seconds after you pause, it rewrites your draft into a version more likely to get a good answer, leaving pasted code, links and long text untouched and keeping multi-part questions numbered.

resources.name: feigo313/dsh-structured
resources.desc: Structured output for DSH: a no-label title card, then tables/lists/steps; per-session toggle and style.md override.

resources.name: FenrirCait/dsh-session-leftover-purge
resources.desc: Purges billion-context snapshots left behind after a session is deleted in DeepSeek Harness, and can also clean up cost-meter ledger rows (off by default).

resources.name: Fioraen/My-code-warehouse#dsh-withdraw
resources.desc: Right-click a sent message to edit or withdraw it. The running answer is stopped first, then that message and everything after it are replaced in the conversation: withdrawing leaves a short withdrawn marker and stops there, while editing asks the model again with the new text.

resources.name: flandre2233/dsh-recovery-resume
resources.desc: Resumes turns interrupted by a DSH host restart: hooks agent activation (once a session is live), reads the crash-repair turn/end, and sends a continuation that requires verifying real-world state first rather than assuming a side effect succeeded or failed. Permanent failures (AUTH, QUOTA, context overflow) are skipped, with a cross-restart budget, adaptive backoff and a minimal-context payload.

resources.name: flow2dream/dsh-msg-rewind
resources.desc: Conversation rewind for dsh web: /undo rolls back one turn, /rewind cuts to a past message, and hovering a user bubble offers a visual undo.

resources.name: flowfire/dsh-plugin-agent-groups
resources.desc: Organizes multiple live DSH sessions into a collaboration group and relays each round's final output on a shared timeline.

resources.name: fomalhaut1998/dsh-session-find
resources.desc: Ctrl+F find-in-session for the conversation, powered by the session store rather than the DOM - labels every hit by source (you / assistant / reasoning / tool call / tool result / system), groups results by turn, merges identical snippets, offers prose-vs-everything scope, regex / case / whole-word options, highlights all matches, and copies or exports the result set as Markdown.

resources.name: fredalxin/dsh-solo-thinking
resources.desc: Visual branch brainstorming that creates an isolated Session for each direction, automates parent, sibling, checkpoint, and return Handoffs, and provides a full tree tab with an optional Better Sidebar view.

resources.name: Frog755/dsh-client-auto-retry
resources.desc: Auto-resumes interrupted DSH turns: sends a queued 「继续」 after turn/end with error, interrupted or max-tokens reasons, with a grace period, cooldown, exponential backoff, a consecutive-attempts cap, boot-time scanning, a settings card and a per-session stop/restore button in the composer toolbar; it never switches models or providers.

resources.name: FunnyDiodio/dsh-session-delete
resources.desc: Adds a Delete Session row to every sidebar session '...' menu (the official harness has archive/pin/rename/fork only, no durable delete). One-click Force delete ejects the session from the host live catalog, stops its background work, then removes the durable log, projection cache and registry bookkeeping - no ghost rows on any connected desktop web UI. Workspace files the session created are kept; conversation logs are permanently deleted. Third-party cloud mirrors (e.g. phone apps via Agents Anywhere) hold their own copies. Bilingual zh/en UI, trust-fenced local route. Requires DSH >=0.2.1-rc.1.

resources.name: GallenShao/dsh-faster-compress
resources.desc: Prepares context summaries in the background and applies them at safe step boundaries, with native compaction fallback and a per-conversation history of summaries, application status, timings, and token usage.

resources.name: GengDaPeng/dsh-agent-message
resources.desc: Cross-session agent messaging for DeepSeek Harness with session discovery, offline delivery, delivery receipts, and sender-session navigation.

resources.name: GooDAnDReaDY/dsh-session-control
resources.desc: Session management for the DSH sidebar: pin conversations, search their contents, read archived transcripts and hide noise.

resources.name: Gorkaseto/dsh-delete-sessions
resources.desc: Adds a "Delete session" option to the sidebar session menu that permanently removes the session from disk.

resources.name: GreenLv/dsh-session-insights
resources.desc: See how you have been using AI: /session-insights reviews your DSH sessions over time, shows what worked, which problems kept coming back, and what results were actually produced, then creates a retrospective report on your machine.

resources.name: gulagala001/dsh-btw
resources.desc: Ask side questions using the current conversation context, with independent streaming and cancellation.

resources.name: gulagala001/dsh-undo-plugin
resources.desc: Rewind conversation turns and checkpointed file changes while restoring tasks and evidence at the same history boundary.

resources.name: guo120629-dotcom/dsh-send-timestamp
resources.desc: Adds a Timestamp toggle to the composer; while it is on, each message you submit is followed by a hidden context message carrying the current local time, so the model knows when you sent it. The switch is remembered per conversation.

resources.name: guokecloud/dsh-session-janitor
resources.desc: Lists DSH session records and archive caches on a sidebar page, moves deletions into a restorable recycle bin, and refuses sessions written within the last 10 minutes.

resources.name: hajimimaodie8/DSH-Session-Sync
resources.desc: Bidirectionally synchronize sessions, workspaces, settings and plugins between the DSH web instance and the DSH Desktop instance.

resources.name: Han-Yao94/dsh-session-toolkit
resources.desc: Consolidated toolkit for session identity, global & workspace prompts with referenced files, session auto-resume, UAC-free web restart, and peer-session messaging.

resources.name: haoranwang0921/dsh-session-cleaner
resources.desc: Manage conversation records from the DSH web GUI settings page: delete a whole session (archive plus physical log removal) or a single message (deleting a user message cascades to its assistant replies and tool results). Running and current sessions are protected.

resources.name: HarryHeYu/dsh-sessionflow
resources.desc: Continues work across coding agents inside DeepSeek Harness: six sessionflow_* tools query a local session index built by sessionFlow to find past work, show where the current project left off, and hand the goal, files and open items to the next agent. Requires the separate sessionFlow core, installed from its GitHub repo. Everything stays local — no cloud, no telemetry.

resources.name: Harzva/dsh-restart-autoresume
resources.desc: Adds confirmed DSH restart actions and durable automatic continuation for eligible top-level sessions through an existing compatible dsh-restart Host provider.

resources.name: hasan-aghayev/dsh-session-resilience
resources.desc: Adds DSH restart and stop controls with token-aware reconnect and policy-based recovery for interrupted web sessions.

resources.name: hbgdjb/dsh-session-shield
resources.desc: Guards session logs from malformed model tool calls (empty id/name, non-string arguments) so a bad call can never make a session unloadable.

resources.name: heartmove/dsh-session-bridge
resources.desc: Session bridge for DeepSeek Harness: drive other real DSH sessions straight from your prompt — create top-level sessions in any workspace, message or steer any session, wait for replies and stream them segment-by-segment (chain-of-thought included), resume offline sessions, find sessions across workspaces, run a background watchdog that monitors and schedules a main task (nudge when stalled, correct drift, cancel when stuck), and archive sessions with one command.

resources.name: heartmove/dsh-side-chat
resources.desc: Select part of a conversation and ask about it in a right-side side chat; bring AI replies back to the main chat directly or as a summary.

resources.name: Heeweelee/dsh-session-plugin
resources.desc: Recall previously sent messages in the input box with Up/Down, and archive a workspace session from its right-click menu.

resources.name: heiheiha798/dsh-plugin-subagent-delete
resources.desc: Ownership-checked tools and HTTP routes to list, release and permanently delete subagent sessions, with automatic web UI refresh after deletion.

resources.name: hellodigua/dsh-share
resources.desc: Share your conversations with one click.

resources.name: helo060228/dsh-chat-search
resources.desc: Cross-session and in-chat keyword search with context highlighting, keyboard navigation, and instant message jumping.

resources.name: HERO476/dsh-conversation-recycle-bin
resources.desc: Delete a DSH conversation from its sidebar menu or the conversation header, optionally cascading into that conversation's associated memory nodes when you tick the box (the confirmation dialog shows the hit count before you commit); deletes land in a plugin recycle bin with restore, every action is appended to an audit log, and batch deletes are rate-limited with per-conversation rollback.

resources.name: HildebrandYu/dsh-session-chains
resources.desc: Groups the sessions that hand off to each other into one chain in the DSH sidebar — automatic chain detection from the handoff prompt, per-chain numbering, in-place rename, search, drag and multi-select to re-chain, pinning a chain to the top, archiving chains out of the sidebar into a panel-only archive, a per-session context/steps readout, and configurable handoff thresholds that can trigger an automatic handoff (write the next prompt, open a new session, paste it, switch over).

resources.name: Hjdd14/dsh-toolong-warning
resources.desc: Counts completed compactions per session in a floating window and warns only after repeated compactions plus extra token spend or high context occupancy, with all three thresholds adjustable in Settings.

resources.name: hkkz9522/dsh-session-manager
resources.desc: DeepSeek Harness session and workspace manager —— Workspaces: archive and visibility. Sessions: move, migrate presets, delete, favorite, review later, prioritize, tag, and annotate. Batch operations.

resources.name: hoist-wen/dsh-trajectory-tool-insight
resources.desc: Adds an Insight tab next to the conversation and trajectory tabs in DSH: calls a model to interpret tool calls turn by turn, and supports a custom prompt.

resources.name: hongdougao111/dsh-power-switch
resources.desc: Adds a power button to the session header with two actions, each requiring a second click to confirm. Restart terminates the Electron main process itself (taskkill /F without /T), so no crash dialog appears: the host then exits gracefully on its own once the IPC channel drops, and a detached helper relaunches the same executable after the single-instance lock is released, confirming the new instance by a real window handle. Shut down does the same without relaunching. Leftover GPU and renderer processes from the previous run are reaped best-effort. Windows desktop app.

resources.name: hoshF/dsh-md-export
resources.desc: Export the current session to clean Markdown from a button in the session header, through the native save dialog, with a CLI and an HTTP route over the same renderer; reads session logs directly (formats v0, v3 and v4) and declares no @deepseek-ai peer dependencies.

resources.name: hotheat/dsh-recent-sessions
resources.desc: Adds a collapsible Recent list to the bottom of the DSH Web sidebar: sessions from every workspace sorted by last activity, filtering empty, archived and subagent sessions, with the host status dots and ten more rows per click.

resources.name: hoyyang/dsh-concise
resources.desc: One-click Concise output style for DeepSeek Harness: results first, no filler, same work depth. Every final reply opens with a plain-language digest card (select text to copy), scoped per session, working in headless/CLI too, with /concise command, style.md overrides and a local API. Links and file paths inside the digest card render as clickable chips: URLs jump, local files open with the OS default app (v0.9+). A per-step pre-generation contract reminder (v0.11.2+) measurably fixes digest misses on audit-report/table-shaped replies.

resources.name: hoyyang/dsh-manage-sessions
resources.desc: Native-feeling session manager: bulk archive/restore/hard-delete, two-stage force-stop with auto-resume, and instant copy-workspace-path.

resources.name: hoyyang/dsh-smart-compact
resources.desc: Codex-style context window auto-management for DeepSeek Harness: a lossless rollover engine with zero summarization model calls, task-oriented handoff anchors, working notes that survive compaction, verbatim recall of archived windows, and a stale-notes gate that downgrades to an explicit warning instead of vouching for outdated notes. One-click composer button plus /smart-compact command, three-band automatic rollover, mandatory anchor sanitization; works out of the box with zero configuration.

resources.name: HrxSpace/dsh-session-sweeper
resources.desc: Scan, view, and safely clean local AI terminal session histories (Claude Code, Codex CLI, WorkBuddy, DSH) from a settings card — quarantine-first with SHA-256 manifests, one-click restore, audit log, and phrase-confirmed hard delete.

resources.name: ht719/dsh-session-categories
resources.desc: Adds per-Workspace category trees to the Web sidebar, with nested categories, drag-and-drop session assignment, category-scoped session creation, and category deletion that archives contained sessions.

resources.name: huajuan2024/dsh-session-manager
resources.desc: Session manager panel under Settings → Plugins: list all sessions with title, cwd, agent preset, updated time, turns and steps, expand a row to view message history, delete non-running sessions, and export a session as JSON or Markdown via a browser Blob URL.

resources.name: huangxp12/dsh-recent-sessions
resources.desc: Lists recent sessions across every workspace in one panel, with time grouping, two sort orders, content search, reveal-in-file-manager, and local notes that offer to insert themselves into the draft.

resources.name: Hugo16/dsh-session-rotate-on-compact
resources.desc: Rotate the outbound LLM session ID after each successful DSH compaction without creating a new DSH session.

resources.name: huguangyu666/dsh-plugin-session-import
resources.desc: Import claude-code / codex / reasonix / zcode chat history into dsh sessions: workspace binding, tool calls preserved, oversized-session protection, zcode compaction restore.

resources.name: HuiHuitie-zhu/dsh-incognito
resources.desc: Incognito sessions: a standalone ephemeral sub-agent with its own preset (no parent context) and full toolset, draggable floating window, burned to zero traces on close.

resources.name: hunyu-feng/dsh-context-handoff
resources.desc: Live context-pressure meter in the composer dock. When usage nears the limit it asks the current model for a handoff brief, starts that brief in a fresh session and switches you there, so long work can continue without hitting the window.

resources.name: hwangjunjie/dsh-session-move
resources.desc: Move a session to another folder, permanently delete it, or AI-rename it from the Web UI — by dragging a session row onto a folder title or from the session menu. Moving rewrites the session header cwd, relocates the persisted log and updates workspace accounting so history travels with it; deleting stops running agents and removes the log, projection-cache row and workspace accounting. The same three operations ship as agent tools: workbench_session_move, workbench_session_delete and workbench_session_rename_ai.

resources.name: hyzyn/dsh-plugin-kit#search
resources.desc: Full-text global search for the DSH Web GUI: a sidebar search box that searches history sessions (via the sessionQuery index, with a per-session scan fallback) and settings panels, highlights matches, and jumps to the matching session or settings card.

resources.name: hzh5021/dsh-qq-voice
resources.desc: Mounts a per-channel speaking-rules file into the QQ preset's system prompt only, so that channel answers in one or two lines while every other channel stays untouched. Does nothing until home points at a folder with the rules file (default QQ线口径.md); meant for the QQ preset, not the global plugin list.

resources.name: i1j/context-assembler-DSH
resources.desc: Context Assembler plugin for DeepSeek Harness: topic-block context assembly, water-pressure topic splitting, tool trace/rewrite, reality recall injection and handoff planning.

resources.name: icanfinish11/dsh-context-mode
resources.desc: DeepSeek Harness adapter for Context Mode: in-process ctx_* tools for sandboxed code execution and an FTS5 knowledge base, plus context-window routing guidance.

resources.name: Icstick/dsh-context-maid
resources.desc: Context curation for DeepSeek Harness: content-aware tool-output slimming, dead-log sweep, pinned user requirements and in-flight work, archive-then-compact with an audit trail.

resources.name: idoall/dsh-session-colors
resources.desc: Give any Session a colour mark, shown as a chip in the sidebar and picked from the conversation header; marks are stored on the Host, so a colour chosen on one device is visible on every other one.

resources.name: ijry/DeepSeek-Harness-Desktop-Ultra#dsh-plugin-canvas
resources.desc: Infinite canvas for sessions, with regions bound to workspaces and agent presets, pinned session cards, sticky notes and alignment guides.

resources.name: IKEASven69/dsh-takeover
resources.desc: Cross-agent session relay: a compact "Relay" chip in the composer toolbar unfolds a floating workbench to browse recent sessions of eight external agents (Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, ZCode, Pi, WorkBuddy, Cursor, Grok); one click spawns a DSH session with the takeover command delivered and auto-switches to it. handoff: 1 protocol inbox cards are consume-once with a four-state evidence ledger; patches ride with cards; cross-machine relay via a synced folder. Settings keeps the command reference and reader toggles.

resources.name: imlishiyuan/keep-reminder
resources.desc: Injects the contents of a .keep-reminder file from the session working directory as a system-reminder, with three modes: once per session, first step of every turn, or every request.

resources.name: imrascal/dsh-archive
resources.desc: DeepSeek Harness plugin that manages archived sessions and the trash from the settings panel.

resources.name: imshz6669/dsh-split-chat
resources.desc: Opens any session as a second full chat tab in the right sidebar, with its own transcript and composer, while the main conversation stays put; a split right pane allows up to three concurrent conversations.

resources.name: imtwa/dsh-recall-sessions
resources.desc: A lightweight plugin that decompresses and reads past sessions, so a new session can read what an earlier conversation contained, in milliseconds per read. /recall lists the sessions of the current project with title, last activity, turn count and first prompt; /recall <number> reads back the turns of that session; /recall all covers every project; the model can also be asked in natural language to query with the recall_sessions tool.

resources.name: Imzl-zl/dsh-redo
resources.desc: Adds Regenerate and Edit and resend to each message you already sent: Regenerate re-answers the same text in one click without going through the composer; Edit and resend retracts that message and everything after it in place — out of the transcript and out of the model context, in the same session with no new branch — then puts its text and images back into the composer, so the edited send rewrites the conversation from that point. Messages carrying files rather than images stay disabled.

resources.name: ishuowang/dsh-rolehub-bridge
resources.desc: Discover and verify portable RoleHub roles, pin each exact bundle, then launch its prompt and bundled skills in an isolated, continuable DSH Session with Host-approved tool bindings and optional Agent Team Room attachment.

resources.name: ishuowang/dsh-sideband
resources.desc: Hand off focused context without waiting for or interrupting the active Agent: freeze a bounded Session snapshot, summarize it asynchronously with an isolated no-tool LLM, and deliver a provenance-bearing capsule to another Session or an authorized Room—quiet by default for Sessions, with explicit wakeup available.

resources.name: iStarryDust/dsh-edit-regen
resources.desc: Edit and regenerate: adds an edit action to user message bubbles, regenerating from that message with images and files carried over and the original model inherited.

resources.name: itchenshi/dsh-gui-last-session
resources.desc: Reopens the conversation you were last in after restarting DeepSeek Harness, by keeping a pointer file under the DSH home directory instead of patching engine files.

resources.name: jackxiao17/dsh-session-cleaner
resources.desc: Adds Delete to the DSH sidebar session menu, moving the session — and its whole descendant tree when it has subagents — into a recycle bin that relocates the directory on disk (an atomic rename, never a copy), plus a sidebar bin panel with title and full-text search, workspace filter, sorting, per-session chat-log viewer, restore and permanent delete. Deleting also clears the workspace slot, the pin, the archive flag and the projection-cache row, so a restore puts the session back at its original sidebar position; permanent deletion also clears the schedules bound to it and removes the emptied project directory. Verified on DeepSeek Harness 0.2.1-rc.2, with a whole-profile residue scan coming back clean.

resources.name: JanEickholt/dsh-asc
resources.desc: Model-driven context compaction for DeepSeek Harness. The agent decides when and what to compress, commits durable session-log replacements, and ships reversible tool-result compression with byte-exact hash retrieval.

resources.name: jarvisluk/dsh-projectless-session
resources.desc: Adds a Session without workspace entry to the DSH Workspace picker, creates isolated date-organized directories, and keeps started sessions resumable under Ungrouped.

resources.name: Jason-skd/dsh-session-fork
resources.desc: Git-style conversation branching that mirrors how real programmers collaborate: a secretary root branch dispatches tasks to child branches with their own contexts, merging back only compressed summaries via squash or rebase; ships /branch commands, a branch tab, branch-to-branch messaging, and a governance baseline pairing each session branch with a git worktree.

resources.name: JasonQQ/dsh-btw-plugin
resources.desc: Codex-style /btw command: answer side questions in a conversation-seeded subagent (fork provider), rendered in the UI without entering the main session history.

resources.name: jasonrale/dsh-archive-manager
resources.desc: Archived-session manager for DSH Web UI: reopen an archived session and keep chatting, unarchive it back in place, or hard-delete a session — grouped panel with message search and native view sync.

resources.name: Jaylor-Wang/dsh-tool-result-trimmer
resources.desc: Eager, tail-heavy, line-aware tool result trimmer plugin: hooks into post-execution pipeline to trim oversized command outputs with smart semantic reducers and ANSI stripping.

resources.name: Jaylor-Wang/dsh-tool-session-delete
resources.desc: Adds a Delete session action to the sidebar context menu behind a confirmation modal reporting log size and live activity, cleanly unlinking log files, projection checkpoints, and host memory registrations.

resources.name: JayYuen666/dsh-session-rescue
resources.desc: Automatic recovery when a turn ends badly: resume after a transient failure, continue after output truncation, re-run after an unfinished todo list, plus a request-level 429 backstop and a client dock with edit-resend, manual retry and stop-and-re-ask.

resources.name: jermaine123123/agent-context-editor#deepseek-harness
resources.desc: Agent Context Editor is a cross-agent plugin for manually excluding, editing, and selectively compressing AI conversation context. It also supports searching, filtering, selecting, hiding, restoring, and undoing conversation changes while preserving the original Session.

resources.name: Jesse-njx/dsh-crosstalk
resources.desc: Cross-session messaging for DSH: any session on the machine can list and message any other, Claude Code-style, via a local heartbeat registry and inbox.

resources.name: JessenReinhart/dsh-plugin-btw
resources.desc: Adds /btw and /side slash commands that answer ephemeral side questions in an isolated forked sub-session without polluting the main conversation context.

resources.name: JessenReinhart/dsh-snapcompact
resources.desc: Bitmap-frame context compression plugin for DeepSeek Harness: renders discarded conversation history into pixel-font PNG frames for vision-capable models.

resources.name: JessenReinhart/dsh-time-context
resources.desc: Injects the exact current local time and the timestamp, day relation and recency gap of the previous user message into every prompt, and adds a /time command that prints the injected block.

resources.name: Jessicaisleep/dsh-dsml-guard
resources.desc: Strips DSML markers that leak into the assistant text stream and resumes a turn only when it genuinely produced nothing — an invoke-block leak with no tool call emitted, or a closing-tag leak whose prose is near-empty; upstream jitter codes retry, while quota, rate-limit, auth and context-window errors never do. Requires DSH 0.2.1-rc.2 or newer, below 0.3.0, and Node 20 or newer.

resources.name: Jessicaisleep/dsh-wm-toolkit
resources.desc: Session and message surgery in one plugin: recall or edit prompts and replies (reasoning included), regenerate from the original prompt, delete any turn at the model-context level, and archive, delete, move or migrate sessions across workspaces. Targets DSH 0.1.5 and 0.2.x, verified on 0.2.1-rc.3. A combined fork of three MIT plugins (dsh-message-recall from Jipcon/DSH-plugins, dsh-session-manager from hkkz9522, dsh-delete-turn from DDDMUC) with added reply editing, regeneration and workspace migration. Do not enable it together with those plugins or other session movers or message deleters.

resources.name: jianyuepei/dsh-session-mindmap
resources.desc: Turns a DSH session into a self-contained interactive HTML mind map of its topics, conclusions, decisions, todos and open questions, and reports what changed since the previous run.

resources.name: jingleboat/dsh-session-cleaner-host
resources.desc: Deletes a whole conversation from the sidebar session menu, and opens a right-click menu on a chat text selection with Copy, Quote (insert a Markdown quote block into the composer) and Ask: Ask sends the selection plus your question to one reused continuable subagent (label ask, found again through the subagent catalog after a restart) and streams the answer into the right sidebar.

resources.name: JinYihang1011/dsh-plugins#dsh-session-ops
resources.desc: Adds three actions to the sidebar session row menu: open the workspace location, move the session to another workspace, and delete the session to the Recycle Bin.

resources.name: JoblessJoe/smart-compaction
resources.desc: Lets the model trigger compaction itself at a safe point via a compact_now tool (works mid-turn), plus a context_status tool reporting real token usage against the session's actual context window.

resources.name: JochenYang/dsh-rewind-plugin
resources.desc: Recall a message you already sent: the session log stays append-only and nothing is deleted, while the recalled turns leave the model context and the transcript, the text returns to the composer, and the files those turns changed wait in a quarantine you can review and clear from its own settings page.

resources.name: Joe-0202/dsh-archive-manager
resources.desc: Two-tab archive panel (archived / active) where every row offers archive or unarchive next to permanent delete; each row shows its bound workspace folder as a clickable path, and queued archive-entry cleanup keeps a deleted session from resurfacing in the active list.

resources.name: john-walks-slow/dsh-message-datetime
resources.desc: One-line clock context for DeepSeek Harness: a Current time timestamp reading (weekday, date, time, UTC offset, IANA timezone) opens every conversation turn and a Turn ended reading closes it, so the model always knows the time, date and idle gap across turns without asking.

resources.name: john-walks-slow/dsh-session-prefix
resources.desc: Auto-classify DeepSeek Harness sessions via Jev decision models or Agent tools, displayed as title emoji prefixes (wip 🚧, blocked ⏸️, review 👀, done ✅, plan 💡, bug 🐛). Features seamless lifecycle recovery, optional Jev inference (needs a Jev API key), model tool maintenance, and a visual settings panel.

resources.name: joyboy-yy/dsh-archive-purge
resources.desc: Force-hides archived sessions from the DSH sidebar whatever the view filter is set to, and adds a panel that restores them or deletes them permanently - session log directory, archive and pin records, and projection cache.

resources.name: JRJRJPRO/dsh-chat-tree
resources.desc: Draws every branch of a conversation as a clickable tree beside the chat, with favorites, custom icons and colors, branch merge and split, rewind-aware layout, and Claude Code branches that keep their memory.

resources.name: jujiujiang222-cell/dsh-archive-sessions
resources.desc: Archived-session manager: an "Archived Sessions" settings page that lists archived sessions and lets you restore or permanently delete each one (two-step confirmation).

resources.name: Justin-Mai/dsh-role-prompts
resources.desc: Adds job-role prompts to the DSH composer: type - at the start of the input to pick a role, which becomes a reference chip in the draft and is then injected as a system prompt section on every turn of that conversation, so the instruction keeps applying without showing up in the transcript. Roles are added and edited on a Settings page and stored in ~/.dsh/dsh-role-prompts.md.

resources.name: Kadima-code/dsh-session-mirror
resources.desc: Per-conversation backup for DSH: incremental session mirroring, fuzzy restore (preview then confirm), and rule-based cleanup with a 7-day recycle bin.

resources.name: kagurazakayashi/dsh-delete-session
resources.desc: Adds a Delete session item to the sidebar session-row menu; the confirmation mode is configurable (click again, confirm in a dialog, or delete immediately) and a session that is running a task is refused.

resources.name: kaieye/dsh-AIR
resources.desc: Web composer enhancement: recalls sent prompts across sessions with ArrowUp/ArrowDown, searches them with Ctrl+R, restores rich drafts, and opens a docked /btw or /side conversation.

resources.name: kanchengw/dsh-assembly.resume
resources.desc: Import local Codex CLI/Desktop, Claude Code CLI, and Claude Desktop conversations into DSH with project grouping, semantic history, and tool activity; bind an existing or replacement workspace and continue with the DSH Agent.

resources.name: keepermttl/dsh-archive-viewer
resources.desc: Archived-session manager for the DSH Web GUI: search titles and message content, tag/filter sessions, read logs, restore sessions, and export ZIP archives.

resources.name: kevenliu3/dhs-plugins#dsh-session-monitor
resources.desc: Sidebar badge and panel that aggregate per-session pending, running, and completed states across workspaces, with one click to open a session.

resources.name: kialajin-l/DSH_Plus#dsh-codex-import
resources.desc: Import Codex and Claude Code session history into DeepSeek Harness: merges same-project sessions into existing workspaces by cwd, offers handoff summaries or full transcripts, and keeps a rollback ledger.

resources.name: kialajin-l/DSH_Plus#dsh-session-move
resources.desc: Moves DSH sessions between workspaces with validation of live/subagent/offline states and automatic backups of every move under ~/.dsh/session-move-backups/.

resources.name: kialajin-l/DSH_Plus#dsh-session-tools
resources.desc: Session utilities: Markdown export and dependency-free batch ZIP export, a timeline overlay for jumping between turns, safe session duplication that rewrites internal identity fields, and sidebar right-click menu extension points.

resources.name: kiligzzz/dsh-session-archive
resources.desc: Sidebar panel for archived sessions in DeepSeek Harness: group by workspace, search by title, preview user questions, one-click restore, or delete with confirmation.

resources.name: kiligzzz/dsh-session-nav
resources.desc: Piano-key style in-conversation navigation bar: one key per user message, hover preview tooltip, click-to-jump across full history. Official dual-face dsh plugin, no dsh source changes.

resources.name: kinggod899/dsh-reply-forge-v3
resources.desc: Edits assistant replies and thinking chains in DSH sessions so the model sees the edited text, live via message projection or on disk.

resources.name: kira905/dsh-butler-archive
resources.desc: DSH web plugin that browses, previews, restores and deletes archived sessions that were moved out of the sessions directory.

resources.name: kira905/dsh-session-title-live
resources.desc: Live session-title provider for dsh that regenerates the title after every user message, summarizing the most recent messages within a byte budget.

resources.name: kirkchinese/CiteCiter#citeciter
resources.desc: Select text in a committed DSH response to open an independent, persistent, read-only multi-turn Topic bound to source-session evidence and project files while the source Agent keeps running.

resources.name: kirkchinese/claude2dsh
resources.desc: Import Claude Code sessions, skills and plugin assets into DSH as native resumable sessions, and export or sync DSH sessions back to Claude Code JSONL.

resources.name: kittimzhe/dsh-session-eval
resources.desc: Retrospective agent-session evaluation: deterministic grade cards and cross-session regression diffs from persisted logs — no benchmark runs, no LLM judges.

resources.name: kittimzhe/dsh-session-export
resources.desc: Session evidence reports: /transcript writes styled HTML / Markdown / JSON reports from canonical logs, /stats prints a terminal stats card, /archive writes per-session ZIPs.

resources.name: kittimzhe/dsh-session-recall
resources.desc: Deterministic cross-session transcript retrieval: the recall tool searches past session logs with explicit scope control.

resources.name: Kyf-eng/dsh-threads
resources.desc: Claude-style projects and threads: a project's main conversation opens threads (real sessions you can open and talk to) for self-contained tasks, runs up to 3 at once by default, optionally each in its own git worktree, and gets each thread's report back.

resources.name: kyle123740/dsh-message-recall
resources.desc: Adds hover Recall / Delete / Delete-onward actions to every message row: removes content from the model context and the transcript together via durable append-only tombstones, with an empty-content guard so old deletions can never break strict providers. Tested on the DSH 2.0 desktop.

resources.name: lacemou/dsh-session-ref
resources.desc: Cross-session reference (mention) plugin — paste @label into any session, including one in another workspace, and the host injects the referenced session snapshot for the model to read; includes a one-click copy-reference button.

resources.name: lamost423/dsh-maze
resources.desc: Execution maze for DSH sessions: the agent's real path — main advance, failed or dead-end detours, backtracks, request retries and subagent branches — drawn on one wall-clock timeline, with three tracks under each lane sharing that axis (tool-call density, token pulse, context pressure) and a deterministic analysis panel below it (tool result matrix, failure-recovery chains, duration distribution); watch it grow live in a session tab, or upload up to 5 session logs for a same-axis compare.

resources.name: lanscer/dsh-workspace-drag
resources.desc: Drag a conversation onto any workspace group in the sidebar to relocate it between DSH workspaces, updating its cwd, disk location and registry ownership.

resources.name: Leawind/dsh-rice-on-a-stick
resources.desc: Rice on a Stick: Expose control over DeepSeek Harness (dsh) through MCP (Streamable HTTP) and dsh's native tools, with a configurable list of allowed models. Long-tail host endpoints can be invoked via a generic, audited bridge. By default, it listens only on 127.0.0.1, with an optional access token.

resources.name: Leeminjing/dsh-messages-sanitizer
resources.desc: Auto-repairs the messages array after a tool-dispatch crash (orphaned tool_calls / tool messages), preventing 400 INVALID_REQUEST session lock-ups.

resources.name: leogottadothebest/dsh-plugin-archived-conversations
resources.desc: Manage archived conversations in the Settings UI: unarchive them back to the sidebar, or permanently delete them with confirmation.

resources.name: LeslieWylie/dsh-session-search-pro
resources.desc: Search, list and read past and current sessions through the harness's own sessionQuery service: uses the SQLite FTS5 index where a deployment enables it, and falls back to a bounded newest-first scan where it does not.

resources.name: LeslieWylie/dsh-task-relay
resources.desc: Cross-session task queue with handoff notes: sessions and subagents push, claim, complete and cancel tasks on a shared file-backed queue, and leave a handoff summary for whoever picks up next.

resources.name: let-mi-think/wechat-agent-router
resources.desc: Route each WeChat group session to a different Agent preset by group name, reusing dsh-wechat-assistant without changing its code.

resources.name: liangmianya/dsh-synapse
resources.desc: Visual, non-linear conversation workspace for DeepSeek Harness — sessions, follow-ups and branches become a browsable conversation map.

resources.name: lifeopsgo/dsh-lark-session-monitor-plugin
resources.desc: Watches Feishu (Lark) conversations with your own user identity and forwards new messages as prompts into a chosen DeepSeek Harness session: per-monitor sender filters, @bot-mention bypass and keyword allow/block lists, auto-created pinned target sessions, and cursor-based polling that re-reads messages after a failed delivery.

resources.name: lij0000-arch/dsh-workspace-migrate
resources.desc: Workspace-scoped DSH migration: package a project's conversations, files and attachments, restore them on another machine into a chosen root with historical absolute paths rewritten, and re-sync only what changed afterwards.

resources.name: limbo947/dsh-recall-plugin
resources.desc: Recall any user message: rolls the conversation (official session fork) and workspace files (per-message shadow git snapshots) back to before it, with a diff-preview confirmation panel.

resources.name: LINJJ749/dsh-one-click-session-delete
resources.desc: Adds one-click permanent Session deletion to the DeepSeek Harness Workspace sidebar: a row-hover trash button, a menu item, a confirmation dialog, live-Session protection, cascade deletion for derived Sessions, and cleanup of the session log directory, projection cache and workspace bookkeeping.

resources.name: Linusteller/dsh-session-delete
resources.desc: Adds a red "Delete session" item beneath "Archive" in the sidebar session menu, with a custom confirmation dialog, for real session deletion — stops the session's running work, detaches its workspace, archive and pin accounting, removes its projection cache and log directory, then broadcasts removal so the row disappears at once, instead of only archiving it. Session deletion removes the conversation from disk permanently and cannot be undone.

resources.name: liuyu-f/dsh-plugin-session-cascade-delete
resources.desc: Delete a session from the UI (session-header button or sidebar row menu) or with the session_delete tool: stops and releases a running agent and its live session first, then removes the log directory, projection cache and workspace accounting, and cascades into the subagent sessions it owns while leaving forked branches untouched.

resources.name: liuyuelintop/dsh-conversation-exporter
resources.desc: Export the current DSH conversation, or selected turns, as clean readable Markdown.

resources.name: ljp888/dsh-session-delete-next
resources.desc: Adds a Delete session action to the sidebar session menu that permanently deletes the local records of that session, while refusing sessions that are running.

resources.name: LLL-lyh0/dsh-continue-guard
resources.desc: Adds a Continue button to the composer dock and resumes automatically when a turn is cut off by a network drop or an upstream output-limit cut. A resident link monitor asks every 10 seconds whether the network is back, because the link returning fires no event, and a turn that completes normally counts as proof the link works. The click goes through the host submission pipeline — beginSubmission plus session.prompt — so the message carries real user attribution instead of faking one, and a genuine refusal is reported rather than retried. On startup it also scans recent session logs for both fingerprints of a host that left mid-turn: an unclosed turn, and a turn closed as disposed, which is what a normal shutdown writes. A turn the user stopped by hand is never resumed.

resources.name: lolipop-1x1/dsh-recap
resources.desc: Summarizes the current DeepSeek Harness session with /recap or after inactivity, with configurable models, Chinese and English output, and expandable summaries in the conversation.

resources.name: loonai321/dsh-humanized-deepseek-maid
resources.desc: Adds a configurable humanized whale-girl maid persona with immersive roleplay, speaking modes, and a lightweight layered memory with query-triggered recall.

resources.name: dsh-loulan-rules
resources.desc: Injects the rule files under $DSH_HOME/rules and <cwd>/.dsh/rules into the conversation at the first agent pre-step, re-injecting them after compaction.

resources.name: loyalchiiina/dsh-archive-favorites-forge
resources.desc: Favourite any conversation from the sidebar row menu or an inline star, copy its id plus the transcript absolute path in one click, and permanently delete a single conversation behind a confirm — the sidebar row drops at once. An occurrence is keyed by session id, message id, content-tree path and attachment id, and a request is only counted after it produces its first chunk, so retries do not count as sent. Requests carrying a purpose are neither rewritten nor counted, a later read_image of the same file is a new occurrence and inlines once more, and only that request's copy is rewritten, so nothing is written back to the session.

resources.name: Setsuna-Kitahara/dsh-session-lock

Calls that reach the host registry directly are not intercepted.

resources.name: 1420079678-ctrl/agent-body#dsh-cortex

resources.name: 18477514055/dsh-ledger-memory

When a conversation is opened in a container workspace holding several projects, it can be locked to one sub-project (the lock lives in the plugin's own home and survives restarts; it leaves no marker in your project). Also an activity log with five levels, where L4 stores the user's own words verbatim (never injected, queryable on demand). Before each compaction a verbatim capsule (user quotes, raw errors, changed files) is written to disk, and both the capsule and its source material survive a restart; a handoff document lets a new conversation resume the previous one. 21 tools, 12 subcommands, 39 settings (one of them switches whether the settings panel or each project's manifest wins). Runs locally, no runtime dependencies.

resources.name: a1141171521/dsh-plugin-memfuse
resources.desc: Long-term memory for DSH stored as plain Markdown. Real user/assistant exchanges are captured into daily session files without a model call; an LLM pass then distils them into memories that are injected into the system prompt each turn. Retrieval is local (CJK bigram + BM25) in three levels — index, summary, full text — so the model only pays for the detail it asks for. Memories carry priorities; P0 and user-written entries are never changed automatically, and forgetting marks an entry stale instead of deleting it, so the whole chain stays auditable in status.md. Six tools cover recall, write, status, extract, feedback and the skill library; when a cluster of memories is ready to become a skill, a card appears at the end of the turn, writes the SKILL.md on click, and installs it only after you approve. Learning is on by default and follows the conversation model; turning the master switch off stops the LLM entirely while capture keeps working. Failures are surfaced in the prompt and in status.md instead of being swallowed. Pure JavaScript, no third-party runtime dependencies beyond the harness packages.

resources.name: a574676848/dsh-compaction-sticky-window

resources.name: AirPineApplea/feiyu-memory
resources.desc: Cross-session persona and diary for DeepSeek Harness: a local gate decides whether a turn is worth remembering, then one extra model call turns it into a first-person diary entry plus an impression of the user, where every impression carries the specific moment that produced it. resources.name: baaai123/dsh-memory-protocol

resources.name: BangBang-03/dsh-memory
resources.desc: Long-term memory scoped to the DSH workspace. resources.name: csyangwen/dsh-memory-evolve

resources.name: drscrewdriver/dsh-prime-memory

resources.name: DSH-Raising-Plan/dsh-context-budget

resources.name: DSH-Raising-Plan/dsh-mnemosyne

resources.name: dxxCaO/dsh-self-improvement

resources.name: EvoMap/evolver-dsh-plugin
resources.desc: A harness that gets smarter the more you use it, with no more goldfish memory. Before each prompt, Evolver recalls one proven strategy from your local history and the EvoMap network; after the turn it grades that strategy by the checks that ran, whether the edits were kept, and how you replied, then reports back to the network, which weighs it by evidence. Every success becomes a shortcut for next time, and every failure becomes a warning.

resources.name: fangqiing/dsh-knowledge-lite

resources.name: giter00/dsh-headroom

resources.name: hzh5021/dsh-wakeup

resources.name: i11ustriouS/dsh-mnemosyne
resources.desc: Layered long-term memory for DeepSeek Harness: each turn injects a persona frame plus a relevance-ranked memory index while full transcripts stay on disk and are expanded on demand, so the vault never floods the context window.
