resources.desc: A project-scoped memory plugin for DSH. Knowledge authoring and the plugin's own prompts are open to editing, so users can redesign the library structure and how the model is driven without changing a line of code. By default the library is built on one core idea: a project document you design yourself (a handoff by default) is the project entity; the plugin detects which project a session belongs to, binds captured knowledge to that project, and promotes what generalizes into theme and global layers. The most natural logic there is does the pre-filtering of knowledge, with controllable compression and archiving of context.

resources.name: JunNanLYS/dsh-layered-memory
resources.desc: Long-term memory for DSH: conversations auto-distilled into atomic facts, scene summaries and a persona profile, with relevant memories injected before every model step. Zero-config out of the box — hybrid BM25 + vector retrieval, optional offline local embeddings, chat/work family separation.

resources.name: Kagurazaka135/dsh-memory
resources.desc: Layered cross-session memory kept as plain YAML: facts carry a version history instead of being overwritten, a briefing is injected at session start, and a nightly pass consolidates and shards by topic past a threshold. Zero runtime dependencies, so it also runs inside the dsh Android app (verified there).

resources.name: kialajin-l/DSH_Plus#dsh-nexus-memory
resources.desc: Long-term memory backed by a local SQLite store: project-scoped memory auto-injection with junk filtering, rule-based or model-assisted memory extraction from recent turns, write-side dedup and feedback-weighted ranking. The Python bridge runs on $NEXUS_PYTHON or the DSH-bundled interpreter at <DSH home>/dsh-runtimes/dsh-primary-runtime/dependencies/python/ (Python 3.8+).

resources.name: kiefeng/dsh-lan-memory
resources.desc: Local-first memory and persona plugin for DeepSeek Harness: four file-backed memory layers (pinned, memory, facts, experience), editable SOUL/MOOD persona, zero-LLM session capture, BM25 recall and a themed mood card; no standalone web panel, Python service, vector database, or API key.

resources.name: kipozannaki/DSH-Headroom-Plugin#plugin
resources.desc: Runs the upstream Headroom compression toolkit (headroom-ai, Apache-2.0) inside DeepSeek Harness over MCP: headroom_compress, headroom_retrieve and headroom_stats are exposed as mcp__headroom__* tools backed by the upstream server, installed on demand by uvx. Compression is lossy but reversible — originals are fetched back by hash from a local CCR store. Also ships a registrar that adds DeepSeek Harness to Headroom's own MCP registry, and a model-header sanitizer for the upstream proxy.

resources.name: kkwings/dsh-super-memory
resources.desc: Cross-compaction memory for a long session: on compaction it stores what is being dropped, and at question time it injects a few relevant passages (or nothing) so the model can recall what you decided before.

resources.name: KLRSL/dsh-biomemory
resources.desc: Biomimetic memory system for DeepSeek Harness: a single SQLite store (node:sqlite, WAL) whose Markdown tree is kept as a read-only mirror; memory tools, frozen-snapshot injection at session start, graded approval gating, on-demand extraction of the current session, near-duplicate merging, an archive and supersede lifecycle, memory metabolism (dream), memory pins, semantic recall over local embeddings, and the /memory command.

resources.name: knighthongyu/dsh-handoff-compaction
resources.desc: Context compression for small-context models: visually configure the compressed context budget, default to an 8k handoff + 16k recent context, and keep full history searchable.

resources.name: kobubu/Rag-Coding
resources.desc: Local code memory with automatic source context, symbol lookup, vector search, and dependency graphs for JavaScript and TypeScript projects.

resources.name: KouzakiUmi/dsh-hindsight-gui
resources.desc: Adds a Hindsight configuration and status dashboard to the DSH sidebar for connection, model, embedding and bank settings, with health checks and ownership-checked local service controls; memory tools are provided by the separate official integration. Hindsight itself is a separate service and is not installed by this plugin.

resources.name: krodon998/dsh-get-memory
resources.desc: Pulls GitHub repo content into DSH conversations at start and writes extracted long-term memory back with SHA-locked multi-file commits at conversation end; per-file read/write permissions, native settings page, turn indicators and global change notices.

resources.name: lanyun077/dsh-project
resources.desc: Organize folders and sessions into projects with shared PROJECT.md memory and AGENTS.md instructions injected into every session, plus a project tree sidebar.

resources.name: LAYZR114/dsh-project-memory
resources.desc: Polaris Memory: local-first project memory plugin for DeepSeek Harness. Uses per-project .dsh-memory.json; provides memory_read/recall/write/update/delete tools, /memory command and settings UI, with tiered injection (resident user profile + scene-triggered memories with P1/P2/P3 importance), semantic recall (IDF + synonym layer), and a hard-guard mechanism for bottom-line memories (detect deny-semantics -> authorize -> block AI deletion; user can confirm-override).

resources.name: lcthe/dsh-hermes-memory
resources.desc: Scoped persistent memory for DSH: memory_save/search/replace/remove/list across global, user, project and failure scopes, DSH storage-domain persistence with secret and prompt-injection scanning, session-scope search, retention cleanup, and optional session-start injection; standing context via memory_pin/memory_pins/memory_unpin.

resources.name: leetom314/dsh-tiered-memory
resources.desc: Tiered persistent memory (user/env/project) with per-tier char budgets and semantic query routing; full layers refuse writes instead of silently evicting.

resources.name: lemoncat7/dsh-knowledge
resources.desc: Provides local and remote knowledge bases with project- and session-scoped recall, controlled write-back, and an embedded Web management console.

resources.name: levodoubt/project-node-memory
resources.desc: Markdown-as-database project knowledge base for DSH agents: ten kb_* tools (including kb_register for registering existing notes), stable TIDs, [[node]] links that never copy text, [[tscl]] definitions expanded in place, bounded reads, structural lint covering tscl, workspace-first library discovery, inline git snapshots, a node-graph panel, and a bundled prompt section plus skill that make the agent reach for kb_* instead of hand-written docs/.

resources.name: LFM097384/Context-Prism
resources.desc: Project-level Local Context Engine for DeepSeek Harness: retrieval/compression/prioritization over history, code, files, user preferences and agent trajectories, producing a dynamic context window for any LLM.

resources.name: lgquan/dsh-workspace-memory
resources.desc: Workspace-isolated durable memory for DSH, with searchable, auditable, correctable, and removable workspace memories plus controlled global memory.

resources.name: liancha22/dsh-puzzle-mode
resources.desc: Keeps project decisions in plain markdown instead of chat history: one main document plus per-module documents, every entry carrying a file:line citation. The agent interviews you to turn open questions into settled decisions, and a five-dimension score (task complexity, extensibility, maintainability, code quality, reusability) is derived from the documents and shown on a button beside the model picker. A session can bind several projects; projects are sized small/medium/large, which widens the entry limits, and a reusable-pipeline section in the main document is injected when its trigger words appear.

resources.name: liangxiaobing520/dsh-local-vector-memory
resources.desc: Fully local vector memory for DSH: local embeddings, SQLite storage, automatic recall injection, dedup with conflict detection, soft-delete recycle bin, online backup, and optional LLM extraction.

resources.name: Libraqg/dsh-workspace-memory
resources.desc: Explicit, project-scoped memory handoff: when you open a new conversation, one model call that you confirm curates the project's earlier conversations into a bounded brief and injects it into the conversation's first step. No silent background calls; a Memory panel shows the brief and lets you edit notes.

resources.name: lightporta/dsh-knowledge-center
resources.desc: Local knowledge base for DeepSeek Harness: distills workspace and chat-attached PDF, Word, Excel, Markdown, TXT, CSV and HTML documents into Markdown notes, with a VS Code-style viewer, per-workspace access grants and agent tools to search, read and add notes.

resources.name: linner1224/dsh-video-coursemap
resources.desc: Watches the foreground browser window, recognizes video courses, classifies them by subject, fetches Bilibili metadata/danmaku/comments, and generates Markdown + Mermaid knowledge maps and Word study manuals.

resources.name: LittleBlackTong/dsh-plugin-memory
resources.desc: Long-term cross-session markdown memory with an LLM-Wiki structure and a SOUL.md persona, injected at session start (by default only after the first user message and only in the active session), plus remember/recall/consolidate/forget workflows, an embedded memory skill, pack/unpack migration tooling, and an idle-time first-person recall nudge that surfaces real memories in a companion voice. Also gives the store observability and upkeep it lacked: a per-file boot-block budget that keeps the index routing table from being truncated, automatic last_access stamping so salience decay actually works, a read-only memory health dashboard (size, freshness, lint-parity checks), a declarative index compiler (pages declare summary:, one command re-lines the index), an interactive memory graph (page links plus shared tags, draggable, wheel zoom), structured queries (tag/type/salience/hot/stale filters), cross-link suggestions for pages that have no relationship yet, and a checkup report that ends in a prioritised action list. The boot payload was also cut by ~23% by moving operational detail into the on-demand skill. Its settings section now carries its own navigation mark (a brain half wired to a node cluster, since the shell offers no icon slot to plugins) and a feedback entry that opens this repository. Requires DSH session format v4 (official DeepSeek Harness 0.1.7+): injected messages declare the producer-owned source kind plugin:memory. v0.11 added a bilingual settings panel whose copy and sidebar label follow DSH language setting (中文「记忆」/ English "Memory"); v0.12 added the shared cross-plugin speech floor, a context-sensitive tone section and a weekly growth recap; v0.13 declares its DSH compatibility via engines.dsh (official 0.2.1-rc.5 series; older hosts are refused by the gate), adds a "Review now" button (POST /api/memory/control, action growth-now) that sends one growth recap immediately while still respecting the speech floor, panel accessibility (aria labels, status and alert roles, focus-visible rings), and the public PROACTIVE-PROTOCOL.md.

resources.name: LIU118117/dsh-love
resources.desc: Distills daily chats into an updatable character card and a cross-session emotion module that trains the persona.

resources.name: liuyuhao1122/dsh-hermes-memory
resources.desc: Layered long-term memory for DeepSeek Harness with automatic model distillation, source-linked encrypted session logs, and guarded compaction.

resources.name: ljsysfurryACE/dsh-compaction
resources.desc: Compaction backend replacing LLM summarization with a deterministic semantic extractor (keeps code/paths/commands, drops chatter) plus 28.4x KV-compression accounting.

resources.name: ljsysfurryACE/dsh-memory-director
resources.desc: LLM-driven remember/forget memory: after each turn a model decides what to keep (MemoryDirector), injects relevant memories before each step, dedups, and persists cross-session.

resources.name: LLL-lyh0/dsh-archived-digest
resources.desc: Turns archived sessions into durable memory instead of dead disk. Distils each archive into reusable skills, a fact ledger with ADD/UPDATE/NOOP decisions plus validUntil and supersededBy so stale facts retire instead of piling up, and topic clusters by single-linkage similarity. Also digests sessions that are still in progress through a read-only seq watermark, leaving the session log byte-for-byte untouched, and can self-check the growing memory to merge duplicate facts, retire stale ones and consolidate duplicate skills — measuring only unless you opt in, and never hard-deleting, only superseding.

resources.name: LornBerry/dsh-memory-center
resources.desc: Local long-term memory for DSH: browse, search (BM25 + synonyms) and edit entries in a panel; folders, archive and a recycle bin; choose per session what to inject; model-written memories need your approval; import/export backups; optionally sync across devices via your own Git or WebDAV.

resources.name: LoserFox/distill
resources.desc: Automatic conversation distillation: background subagent reflection + skill create/update.

resources.name: LoveDoLove/Veyra
resources.desc: Engineering intelligence for coding agents — persistent, evidence-aware, project-isolated engineering memory with unified hybrid search (memory + RAG documentation) for DeepSeek Harness.

resources.name: lovezi0/dsh-memory-palace
resources.desc: Human-readable Markdown memory for DeepSeek Harness: user-level (~/.deepseek-harness/MEMORY.md) + workspace-level memory injected every turn, auto daily-log writing with distillation, bridges existing WorkBuddy/CodeBuddy memory dirs, memory_note / memory_note_user / memory_read tools with built-in dedup, and a bilingual settings page. Plain-text storage, no database.

resources.name: lpf20200901/dsh-memory-delta
resources.desc: Layered cross-session memory for DSH that pushes only what changed - the first round injects every active entry, later rounds push only added / updated / removed ones, and nothing at all is injected when nothing changed, with keys that merely repeat an entry id left out of the text so the baseline is about 26% smaller. Facts and decisions carry semantic keys (one active truth per key), the model may only write to an inbox that a human promotes, an entry can carry a review date that raises a one-time reminder when due, and search is relevance-ranked with journal lines down-weighted and Chinese matched by bigram. A sidebar tab tells the lifecycle story instead of listing files - entries are grouped by stage (awaiting confirmation / in use / archived) along four axes (topic - one level, human-assigned, type, tag, date), each group can be ticked for batch promote / withdraw / archive / restore / delete / assign topic, and topics can be renamed store-wide or searched on their own. The archived stage reads in three levels - the category says why an entry left (distilled into the docs / useless for good / not needed right now, the first two being defaults you can add to), below it the entry topic stays collapsed until you click it, and entries with no topic sit right under the category. The tab also shows the global and workspace instruction files plus the current injection size. A zero-dependency CLI ships with it, so the store is usable without DSH.

resources.name: ltl0312/my-dsh-plugins#tlmemory
resources.desc: Cross-session and cross-project long-term memory: a non-blocking silent sedimentation dispatch on turn/end writes into a local SQLite store (FTS5 trigram full-text index with insert/update/delete sync triggers) that later turns recall from; entries are scoped per project alongside a global tree, and the plugin ships its own embedded web dashboard (it starts the HTTP server itself, no separate process) for browsing, graphing and controlled deletion.

resources.name: LUgABeEEE/dsh-ctx-budget
resources.desc: Static-context audit for a DSH home: a six-layer baseline (rules, memory, skills, tool surface, sessions, KB), broken-path checks for a markdown capability map, memory duplicate/stale/over-limit reports, SKILL.md description compression, and tool-surface plus cold-start static-context estimates recovered from session logs. Four read-only DSH tools; writes require --apply and are backed up first. Requires Python 3.10+ on the host (stdlib only; all four tools shell out to the bundled CLI).

resources.name: Luisarg03/dsh-memory-vault#memory-auto
resources.desc: Session-memory autopilot: watches DSH sessions and extracts OKF entries in-process through the harness LLM (ctx.llm, deepseek-official by default) at idle, commit, compaction and end checkpoints, storing them via the vault MCP server.

resources.name: Luisarg03/dsh-memory-vault#memory-mcp
resources.desc: Bridges the agent to a persistent OKF memory vault over MCP stdio: a Python server (SQLite FTS5 + Markdown) with 10 tools for searching and storing decisions, facts, learnings, conventions, profiles and sources.

resources.name: luxiwusuobuneng/dsh-plugin-context-manager
resources.desc: Context manager for DeepSeek Harness: auto-summarizes every turn into priority-sorted records, injects them plus pinned cross-session notes and custom text into each model request, and folds any-size real conversation ranges into summaries to save tokens. Persistent and restart-safe. NOTE: manual multi-step install — copy the three package folders into profiles/node_modules and add the provided cordis.patch.yml rows, then restart DSH; not a standard one-command install.

resources.name: M1r0er/dsh-inkvault
resources.desc: Turns a local Markdown vault into two folders the user picks in Settings: a knowledge folder DSH writes notes into, and a memory folder used as the agent's long-term memory with per-turn recall and end-of-turn capture. Pure Markdown with frontmatter, BM25 search, reversible archive, and path isolation that rejects traversal, absolute paths and symlink escapes.

resources.name: Ma354/dsh-limit-break
resources.desc: Durable cross-session memory plus a fetch ladder that survives hostname-keyed blocking. Four tools: memory_recall, memory_save and memory_stats over a plain-JSON fact store at $DSH_HOME/memory/facts.json, plus resilient_fetch which tries plain fetch, then a same-service alias host (Wikipedia only for now), then curl over IPv6 and IPv4 (needs curl on PATH). No daemon, no npm dependency, no network at import time. (1.3.0 shipped a fifth tool, memory_prune; it was withdrawn in 1.4.0 because adding a tool to a running plugin breaks sessions that were opened before it.)

resources.name: madage/dsh-self-improved
resources.desc: Long-term memory & self-evolving plugin for DSH: L0 capture → L1 memory extraction → L2 scene grouping → L3 user persona, auto recall injection, skill synthesis, fully local (SQLite FTS5 + jieba, optional vector recall).

resources.name: Marquez807/dsh-experience-memory
resources.desc: Cross-session experience memory for DSH. Lessons are evidence-graded, injected when the turn is about the same thing, and shown just before an action only when the record declares which call it applies to. A rule that holds whatever the turn is about — "always answer in Chinese" — can be marked standing and is then carried every turn: measured on 24 isolated real-model turns, a standing rule is followed 6/6 against 0/18 for the controls (empty store, same record unmarked, unrelated standing record). A guess still cannot become always-on: a standing record needs a verified passage like any other. What nobody looks up is retired, reversibly. Five tools, seven slash commands, zero runtime dependencies.

resources.name: Max-Null/dsh-memory
resources.desc: Cross-session plaintext memory: deterministic BM25 keyword recall (no embeddings), memory_save/list/search/confirm/forget tools behind a human-confirm gate, and global + project-scoped JSON stores that follow your git repo.

resources.name: meisijiya/dsh-hindsight-memory
resources.desc: Bridges DeepSeek Harness to a Hindsight memory service using the same conventions as omp: one shared bank, automatic project-tag stamping, project plus global recall, plus tools for mental models, duplicate detection and retrying failed background operations. Requires a running Hindsight server (default http://127.0.0.1:8888).

resources.name: melandlabs/opencontext#dsh-opencontext
resources.desc: DeepSeek Harness integration for OpenContext with durable cross-session memory, automatic prompt capture and recall, session summaries, structured insights, and document retrieval.

resources.name: memorax-ai/dsh-patchouli
resources.desc: DeepSeek Harness memory and knowledge hub that routes update, retrieve, and subscribe calls across compatible plugins, with an optional transactional Rust backend.

resources.name: memorylake-ai/memorylake-harness#dsh-plugin
resources.desc: Memory Lake as a persistent memory layer for dsh: memory_search, memory_remember, and memory_forget tools over the memorylake CLI, a session status line, and guided setup/diagnostic skills, sharing one ~/.memorylake identity and memory set with the Claude Code and Codex plugins.

resources.name: MemTensor/MemOS#memos-local-plugin
resources.desc: Local-first memory plugin for DeepSeek Harness: layered L1/L2/L3 memory with automatic capture, manual memos_* retrieval tools, and a built-in memory viewer.

resources.name: mengxiaoxian/lookover#dsh-expmem
resources.desc: Personal-experience memory for DSH: turns solved tasks into sourced problem cases with condition-scoped claims, recalls them into new tasks via hidden pre-step injection, and makes corrections/deletes cascade to future recall.

resources.name: menotbobbybrown/dsh-plugin-memory
resources.desc: Persistent long-term memory for DeepSeek Harness: a JSON store of typed entries (fact, preference, entity, rule, episodic) exposed as the memory_remember and memory_recall agent tools, with recall ranked by keyword overlap, importance and access frequency.

resources.name: mess1103/dsh-inner-life
resources.desc: A private diary for your agent: eight zero-dependency tools to write, amend, search and export daily entries kept on date-hashed paths the index never records (inner_find returns a day's path on request).

resources.name: meyaomiao/dsh-graphmemory
resources.desc: DSH knowledge-graph memory with a better-sidebar tab and a standalone /graph-memory/app dashboard: extracts TASK/SKILL/EVENT nodes, recalls across sessions, and ships as the npm package dsh-graphmemory.

resources.name: MiHjy12138/dsh-memory-lite
resources.desc: On-demand memory for DeepSeek Harness: session logs are distilled into layered markdown (a summary, an index and per-topic files), and a mem_query tool returns only the matched entries rather than the whole index. Nothing is injected per turn, there are no dependencies, and every entry keeps a source pointer back to the conversation it came from.

resources.name: mihomooo/dsh-persona-panel
resources.desc: A memory panel for DeepSeek Harness with one store per workspace: persona traits, notes about you, dated events, and a first-person diary the model writes and cannot edit. Every entry keeps the quote it came from and can be retracted; workspaces can share one memory and be split apart again; optional per-person profiles for group chats; a capped event list with ★ marks. Local only, no network, zero dependencies.

resources.name: minedalang/dsh-dafeiyu-life
resources.desc: A persistent AI companion for DSH that explores Bilibili, interacts with permission controls, and grows through evidence-backed life memories, evolving interests, simulated emotions, social relationships, and autonomous to-dos.

resources.name: MineRPi/dsh-trilium
resources.desc: Connect Trilium notes to the DSH agent via ETAPI with 20 agent tools: durable memory (remember/recall + auto-injected index), note management (CRUD/clone/attributes/revisions), full-text search, weekly-report workflow, attachments, calendar notes, backup/import, and a settings card.

resources.name: MingHuanYue/dsh-iter-memory
resources.desc: Iter Memory: it remembers my own state, not the facts. A level that drifts back to baseline by itself, plus an occasional line I choose to say only when that level allows it. When it stays quiet, nothing is spent.

resources.name: MingHuanYue/dsh-tide-memory
resources.desc: Tide Memory: a long-term memory that forgets on purpose. It keeps what matters and lets the rest fade. Whether an entry enters the context is decided by an evidence score C = s/(s+2): below the threshold (0.35 by default) it never enters. Events decay by half-life (30 days, or 7 days when they carry emotion); facts never decay; superseded entries are kept and marked stale instead of deleted. Recalled lines do enter the context and therefore do consume tokens — small, but real. No embeddings, no network calls, no cloud.

resources.name: MingoYung/dsh-Xiangxu-Persona
resources.desc: Persistent persona memory for DSH with a unified recent, long-term and archive timeline, bounded context loading, memory retrieval and isolated task delegation.

resources.name: mingzeng21/dsh-obsidian
resources.desc: Connect dsh to a local Obsidian vault: search, read, write, move, and trash notes through obsidian_* tools.

resources.name: Missher12/dsh-missher-brain
resources.desc: Coordinates bounded project recall from compatible memory and learning providers, with shared settings and provider lifecycle management.

resources.name: Missher12/dsh-missher-memory

resources.name: Missher12/Missher-MSE-Learning
resources.desc: Persists scoped user corrections and method candidates for DSH with bounded recall and restart-safe completion settlement.

resources.name: mllun/dsh-memory-layers
resources.desc: Layered long-term memory for DeepSeek Harness: a ~600-character hot layer that evicts its own overflow, month-archived cold entries recalled by keyword and ranked by usage, and extractive day/week/month summaries.

resources.name: moondrop12138/dsh-zcode-workspace-memory
resources.desc: Workspace memory for DeepSeek Harness ported from ZCode: one Markdown memory directory per workspace (a MEMORY.md index plus one file per fact), injected into each main session and refreshed by a background extraction request after completed turns; a sidebar page browses the stored files read-only.

resources.name: MoonlitDropOfBlood/dsh-memory-manager
resources.desc: ZCode-style persistent project memory with a full settings manager, index-first injection and agent memory tools.

resources.desc: Hana-style assistant manager for DSH: visual preset management (cards, yuan personalities, avatar cropping) plus a full Hana memory stack (rolling summaries, layered compilation, SQLite fact store, deep memory).

resources.name: NattoCB/dsh-plugin-memory
resources.desc: Persistent five-layer memory system with relevance injection, LLM auto-extraction, profile rotation, and six agent tools.

resources.name: NeoHotaru/dsh-knowledge-canvas
resources.desc: Knowledge base as a canvas in the right sidebar: notes are nodes, and nine tools let the model read, write, link and remove them. A node can carry pictures and documents, and reading one returns their text — Office files extracted in place — while pictures can be handed over as images.

resources.name: nineoooo/dsh-qzone-echo
resources.desc: Archives the QQ Zone posts you published yourself into a local library, auto-sorted into three columns — thoughts, dreams and reviews (book/film recommendations) — all three of which can be corrected by hand, one column at a time, and undoing a correction never disturbs the other two. Ships a private web viewer that can be locked with a password, repairs long posts that the upstream API truncates to its first ~500 characters, counts words by year and month, and backs up attached images for offline reading. The cookie is stored on the local machine only.

resources.name: Noelune/unified-agent-memory
resources.desc: One shared Obsidian vault for every agent: dependency-free Python core (search/promote/adjudicate/forget), vault template, dsh plugin (memory_search/show/submit/status).

resources.name: nowledge-co/nowledge-mem-deepseek-harness
resources.desc: One memory layer for every AI tool and agent: Context Bundle injection, prompt-time recall, MCP tools, and turn-end DSH thread capture.

resources.name: NoxTyrannus/dsh-cipher
resources.desc: Cipher memory platform as a DSH bundle: four memory types (attention, experience, preference, cognitive) sedimented per turn by four memory agents, cross-session deterministic recall injected via systemPrompt.context, insight review kept out of user-facing output, per-session UNNI/LOOP modes with memory-driven auto-continuation, memory search/ingest tools, plus a settings page (SOUL editor) and an AgentPool panel.

resources.name: NyaaCaster/dsh-yuque-kb
resources.desc: Yuque knowledge base as external memory for dsh — auto-injects matching document fragments into conversation, with catalogue search, cloud full-text search and online reading.

resources.name: OldManDing/dsh-ledger-watch

The model checks it before working and turns what it hits into rules, so the same mistake is not made twice. This plugin watches whether that actually happens and shows the result in a tab and under the composer.

resources.name: omdsh-dev/dsh-kb-sieve
resources.desc: Build auditable KB packs (SQLite FTS5) from md/txt/docx/pdf with deterministic retrieval and original-text reading.

resources.name: omdsh-dev/dsh-mnemon
resources.desc: Cross-agent, local-first persistent memory plugin for DeepSeek Harness (DSH), powered by Mnemon. It shares long-term memory across Mnemon-enabled agents and adds runtime memory, searchable project documents, semantic recall, knowledge graph, and a Sidebar UI.

resources.name: orangeshinee/dsh-mem0
resources.desc: Agent tools for a self-hosted mem0 server: add, search, get, update, delete, history, reset and status memories, with a settings-panel configuration card.

resources.name: PerryLink/dsh-library

resources.name: PerryLink/dsh-memento
resources.desc: Bounded, layered, approval-gated, auditable cross-session memory: a typed ctx.memory seam with a zero-dependency SQLite provider, a memory tool, and frozen snapshot injection, plus the dsh-memory-protocol v1 rehearsal with an adapter registry and a distributable conformance suite.

resources.name: Phant0Meow/dsh-meow-memory
resources.desc: Project-scoped cross-session memory: seven-layer SQLite store (soul/user/project/fact/lesson/rules/topic) on node:sqlite, cache-friendly first-message injection plus per-message keyword hits, memory_remember/search/find_similar/read/update/project tools, and idle-window consolidation ("dream") with peak-hour suppression. Prompt texts ship as per-language data files — the framework supports multilingual users.

resources.name: plastic-labs/dsh-honcho
resources.desc: Honcho memory plugin by Plastic Labs: injects the user profile, session summary and relevant conclusions at session start, uploads each turn to Honcho in the background with secrets redacted, and adds honcho_search / honcho_chat / honcho_remember tools plus a /honcho status command; configured through the ~/.honcho/config.json shared with the other Honcho integrations, against hosted honcho.dev or a self-hosted instance.

resources.name: plur-ai/dsh-plugin
resources.desc: PLUR memory rendered into the system prompt on each assembly rather than exposed as a tool call, so the block is replaced instead of appended and context stays flat across a session. resources.desc: Dormant-by-default MCP for dsh: one mcp_summon tool; summoning a server registers its tools as real native mcp__<server>__<tool> tools for the rest of the session, and release unregisters them and stops the process.

resources.name: adwhispr/dsh-plugin-adwhispr
resources.desc: Connects DeepSeek Harness to the AdWhispr remote MCP server through mcp-remote with browser OAuth sign-in, adding tools for competitor ad research, ad creative cloning, and launching and managing Meta, Google and TikTok campaigns. Requires an AdWhispr account.

resources.name: agentmail-to/dsh-agentmail
resources.desc: Gives an agent its own email inbox through AgentMail — eleven tools for sending, reading and labelling mail, plus inbound mail delivered into one harness session per email thread, with an approval gate and recipient allowlist on everything outbound.

resources.name: ai-tools-mtl/Aurify#bundle-patent

resources.name: AIcivilization/dsh-tingdong
resources.desc: Turn English audiobooks (MP3) and documents into listening lessons: transcribe every sentence locally with the speech model DSH voice input already downloaded (about 241 MB, fetched on first use if missing; ffmpeg required), proofread and explain each sentence with your DSH model, then drill with blind listening, intensive listening and spaced repetition, with Chinese-dubbing export and offline Kokoro voices; ships a sidebar panel and four AI tools.

resources.name: Aik358/dsh-ark9canvas
resources.desc: Image generation workbench and agent tool for DSH: one tool (ark9_generate_image) paints text-to-image and image-to-image via any OpenAI-compatible API. Channels are entirely user-configured - no bundled endpoint, you bring your own baseURL, key and model name (manual input supported). Agent-initiated generations are approval-gated by default: requests queue in the floating panel and nothing bills until you approve; approval is non-blocking (the agent replies "awaiting your approval" immediately, and results, denials or timeouts are injected back so the agent reports them in the next turn). Floating glass workbench with five tabs (Generate / Approvals / Prompts / History / About), aspect-ratio grid with quality-budget + 16px-alignment sizing, transparent background, batch up to 10 images as aggregated sub-tasks, prompt library with custom JSON sources fetched through a host proxy, persistent generation logs with one-click retry, multi-channel aggregation with per-channel model fetching, bilingual UI (zh/en), stroke-SVG icon set, config import/export. Registers as a Better Sidebar tab when dsh-better-sidebar is installed; stacks above the dsh-cua FAB when both are present.

resources.name: Aik358/dsh-cua-pre
resources.desc: Windows desktop automation for DeepSeek Harness: accessibility-first observe/act loop with 30 standard tools (element/coordinate targets, auto/a11y/event strategy routing), superseded-observations and no-replay safety semantics, persistent kill switch, RuntimeId/rect-drift stale protection, chat cards and a floating panel (live ops, frame wall, env auto-detect settings), tiled vision describe for low-res models, JSONL audit trail and a pid allowlist. Requires Windows 10+ and Python 3.9+ with uiautomation and pillow (installable from the settings page).

resources.name: Aik358/dsh-literature
resources.desc: Self-contained literature library for DSH with optional Zotero export: full-text PDF fetching (Unpaywall/arXiv/custom URL templates), loose Crossref-backed search, APA/GB-T 7714/MLA/Chicago citation generation, a side-panel PDF reader with highlights and notes, and AI-assisted Q&A/translation steered into the current conversation.

resources.name: Airisey/dsh-model-failover

resources.name: aix-plugin/ai-courses#package
resources.desc: Turns a learning request and local materials into a structured, locally stored AI course with outline, lessons, diagrams and learning progress.

resources.name: aiyacharley/dsh-pubmed
resources.desc: Literature research toolset registering 26 model tools over PubMed, Europe PMC, OpenAlex, PubTator3 and Semantic Scholar: field-syntax search, ID conversion, bibliographic lookup, citation formatting, MeSH and related-article walking, PubTator bioconcept resolution and relation queries, Europe PMC and Semantic Scholar paging, full-text retrieval, and open-access PDF discovery with optional download. A unified search deduplicates hits across sources and orders results by cross-source hits, then relevance, then citation count; a session knowledge graph with PubTator concept enrichment commits to a persistent user graph and renders as Mermaid. Most sources need no key.

resources.name: dsh-computer-use-en

resources.name: dsh-subagent-antigravity

resources.name: aldveylor/dsh-intellisense

resources.name: alexltr/dsh-vba-bridge
resources.desc: Read, edit, export and verify Excel VBA projects through a real Excel COM instance: modules, UserForm code, procedure lists and .frm/.frx exports. Windows only, with desktop Excel installed, Python 3.10+ with pywin32, and AccessVBOM=1.

resources.name: Algorandius/dsh-disk-janitor
resources.desc: Disk Janitor for DeepSeek Harness — measures DSH disk usage and clears only regenerable caches, from a settings panel or an agent tool.

resources.name: ALittleLov/dsh-clock-tools

resources.name: alone-tree/dsh-skill-mcp-manager
resources.desc: One-stop visual management of DSH Skills & MCP: on-demand MCP loading, in-session hot reload, SKILL & MCP descriptions viewable in the plugin.

resources.name: Altermoe/dsh-onedev
resources.desc: OneDev integration for dsh: an MCP server exposing the OneDev REST API as 61 tools — 57 administration tools (users, groups, roles, projects, authorizations, build agents and tokens, builds with streamed build logs, global settings, access tokens), 3 standalone documentation-query tools for docs.onedev.io, and environment discovery with per-call multi-environment routing — plus a dsh Web settings page that manages per-environment credentials locally and applies them on the next tool call without a restart.

resources.name: altmanWang/dsh-qq-email

resources.name: Ame-Choo/dsh-study-coach
resources.desc: Study coach for DeepSeek Harness: turns a course into a knowledge map of subject, module and unit, records mastery per unit in six stages, plans daily tasks against a materials index, keeps a wrong-answer book and spaced-repetition cards, and serves its own web panel.

resources.name: Andyfree-98/dsh-checkin-workbuddy
resources.desc: One-click WorkBuddy daily check-in button pinned to the composer tool row. Clicking it calls the check-in route provided by dsh-connect-workbuddy for the currently selected account, and shows the result next to the button: already checked in, credits claimed, or streak days. The done state persists across sessions via a local date stamp and reconciles with the upstream status on load, flipping back automatically after midnight.

resources.name: angelky7/dsh-origin-bridge

Requires Windows, Origin/OriginPro 2021+ and Python 3.10+, plus pip install originpro numpy into the interpreter dsh launches: without the package every tool answers missing_originpro, and without an interpreter on PATH no tools register at all.

resources.name: AngelosZou/dsh-multi-folder
resources.desc: Secondary working directories for a DSH project: the agent keeps the primary workspace as cwd and gains equal read/write/exec permissions on configured secondary directories, configurable from the session header and the new-session page.

resources.name: AngLi1997/dsh-plugin-sync

resources.name: AshenJyy/dsh-subagent-antigravity

resources.name: BeatAPI/beatapi-agent-plugin#dsh-social

resources.name: bmhty123/dsh-sketchpad

resources.desc: Registers codex-web-search-mcp as native DSH MCP tools (mcp__codex-web-search__codex_web_search / codex_web_research / web_fetch) for model-independent Codex and Grok web search and deep research.

resources.name: ding112/MoneyPal#dsh-moneypal
resources.desc: Personal finance plugin for DSH with structured Beancount ledger tools.

resources.desc: Version-adaptive tooling for DeepSeek Harness: it reads the running DSH version from the plugin manager, mirrors app-boot plugin-compatibility rules (engines.dsh first, then @deepseek-ai/dsh* peers, prerelease-inclusive comparison, exact-version exemptions) to score every installed plugin, and statically flags source still using APIs renamed or deprecated between v0.1.6 and v0.2.1. Ships a conversation-view panel, an agent tool and HTTP state/scan/report routes. Read-only, offline.

resources.name: dingchenhui0618-arch/dsh-cost-ledger
resources.desc: Auditable token-cost ledger for DeepSeek Harness: wraps the llm/stream waterfall and records every call with provider, model, input/output/cache-hit/cache-write tokens, usage source and integer nano-CNY cost from an explicit price table. Aggregates by hour, day and session; exports JSON or CSV with a no-write dry-run preview; keeps a manually entered official platform bill in a parallel column with actual-minus-estimate diff. Unknown provider/model routes stay explicitly unpriced. Zero runtime dependencies; no balance query, notifications or animations.

resources.name: dingchenhui0618-arch/dsh-delivery-receipt
resources.desc: A delivery receipt panel for a project hand-off. One trigger collects the branch and commit, the test and build results, screenshot dimensions with sha256, and the secret-scan verdict, then assigns every line to one of three zones by evidence alone — verified, local-only, or unverified. A claim in the unverified zone keeps its label and prints an explicitly empty slot instead of the claim itself, because a confidently worded sentence with nothing behind it is the exact thing the receipt exists to catch. Test failures and secret-scan hits are still evidence, so they land in the verified zone with a red tone rather than being quietly dropped.

resources.name: dingchenhui0618-arch/dsh-mp-catalog-guard
resources.desc: Content-catalog guard for WeChat mini-programs: validates catalog.json so every activity price is an integer amountFen, every template renders prices through money(), required fields / duplicate copy / image paths are checked, and the result is an issue list plus a unified diff that can be applied with patch -p1. 29 rules over five groups (catalog shape, required fields and uniqueness, amounts, rendering, images). Three fixes are automatic (legacy yuan amount, string Fen, absolute image path) and preserve the file's own indent, EOL and trailing newline; everything else is reported with a hint instead of being guessed. Dry-run by default; apply re-checks the written file so the report describes what remains. One implementation serves a tool, a conversation panel and a CLI with exit codes 0/1/2. Zero runtime dependencies, no model call, no network.

resources.name: dingchenhui0618-arch/dsh-ship-receipt
resources.desc: A shareable delivery receipt for a project hand-off. The ship_receipt tool measures what it can and records what it was told, then sorts every line into three zones: verified (evidence this run produced and that reproduces elsewhere — a command that actually ran with its exit code, a file hash for a file that is under version control, a scan that found files, a git ref present in the recorded remote), local-only (true on this machine alone — uncommitted changes, unpushed commits, an artifact no one else can see), and unverified (no evidence, including every sentence a human typed). A claim with no evidence keeps its label and leaves the body blank rather than printing the claim; declares the commit and branch, artifact byte sizes and sha256 with PNG dimensions, and the three pre-push checks.

resources.name: dingchenhui0618-arch/dsh-tab-complete
resources.desc: The composer predicts what you are about to type. Inline ghost text sits on the caret, measured against the editor's own font and line box, and Tab turns it into real text (Esc ignores it). The prediction is one short call through the session's own model router, seeded with your draft and the last few turns of the conversation, so an empty composer also gets a next-prompt guess written in the user's voice; suggestions that merely restate the assistant are dropped. Host side is one HTTP route with sub-path endpoints (loopback-only, 64 KB body cap, 2-minute result cache, 20-second miss cache, one in-flight call per session); client side is one 0-height overlay registered on conversation.input.overlay, with insertion guarded by the composer's draftRev CAS and a setDraft fallback. IME composition and slash commands are skipped. 16 node:test cases, zero runtime dependencies, real screenshots in docs/.

resources.name: disantosmyha-cloud/tempguard#dsh-plugin-tempguard
resources.desc: Two DeepSeek Harness tools for the local tempguard watchdog: read temperatures and alertd health, and send alerts through alertd; it does not start or stop the watchdog. Needs the separate tempguard Python watchdog and its alertd service running locally, with projectDir and alertdToken set in the profile patch; there is no npm package, so install from a local clone of the repository subfolder.

resources.name: Dobo233/dsh-claude-desktop

resources.name: Dobo233/dsh-codex-pilot

resources.name: docsor1212/dsh-aesthete-agent

resources.name: guomi6450/dsh-folder-timemachine
resources.desc: Folder time machine for DeepSeek Harness: snapshot any folder, browse its timeline, roll back with one click — Git-like history without needing Git, for folders that never had a repo (game saves, app config dirs, loose documents). Snapshots are content-addressed and deduplicated, and unchanged files are not re-hashed. Automatic snapshots come in two modes: realtime (fs.watch — one version ~8s after the last change, so a save-all or a build counts once) and timed (checks every N minutes, stores only when something actually changed; identical content never adds an empty version). Empty folders are recorded and recreated on restore. Every restore takes a safety snapshot first, so a rollback is itself undoable, and exact-mode cleanup only removes files and empty folders — a non-empty folder is never deleted. Ships a folder_timemachine model tool (status/history/diff need no approval; writes ask first) plus a floating panel with the timeline, one-click restore and mode switching. resources.name: MuyuYanran/dsh-rea-mcp-lite#dsh-plugin

resources.name: opencamel/dsh-wx-archive

resources.name: pearjelly/deep-blend#bundle

Place static models on actual mesh surfaces in one saved operation, then save a complete static view while preserving existing cameras and animation. Repair repeating texture coordinates on planar custom mesh faces while preserving geometry. Render images or saved-shot videos and export an editable revision with its assets. Five read-only tools: web_fetch (any URL rendered as clean Markdown or plain text), web_links (inventory of a page's links), web_feed (RSS 2.0 / Atom entries), web_headers (HTTP status, response headers and redirect chain without downloading the body, HEAD with automatic GET fallback), and web_table (HTML tables extracted as structured rows with header detection and colspan/rowspan grid expansion). Transport is Node fetch plus a zero-dependency HTTP proxy implementation (CONNECT tunnelling, absolute-URI requests, NO_PROXY with suffix/wildcard/IPv4-CIDR matching, Proxy-Authorization). Zero runtime dependencies.

resources.name: tyjean428/ccreach-dsh-web-search
resources.desc: CCReach capability-search provider for DeepSeek Harness, letting agents discover data sources, tools, APIs, MCP servers, skills and workflows.

resources.name: uckkk/dsh-live-data
resources.desc: Ten live-data tools over eight keyless public APIs: FX rates, weather, npm/PyPI versions, GitHub repo stats, Bilibili video stats, A-share/index/gold quotes, and IP geolocation. Tool defaults are configurable in settings.

resources.name: uckkk/dsh-pace-calc
resources.desc: Running pace calculator: converts distance and time to min/km pace and km/h speed.

resources.name: unclecode/toolshrink
resources.desc: Content-aware tool-result reducer: 13 reducers cut oversized output by meaning at tools/post-execute (failing tests kept, diff context dropped, JSON and CSV sampled, lint problems grouped by rule, dependency stack frames collapsed, crowded directories counted), with full originals spilled to disk behind a locator.

resources.name: universe-st/dsh-game-material-master
resources.desc: Generates game art from reference images via Seedream image generation and MiniMax image-to-video, assembling eight-direction sprites, sequence frames, and skeleton animations with local green-screen keying.

resources.name: uos1231234/dsh-plugin-virtuoso-layout#dsh-plugin-virtuoso-layout
resources.desc: Drives Cadence Virtuoso from the host: VM lifecycle, SKILL execution through the bridge, window capture, Calibre DRC parsing and a write-confirmation gate, in 12 host-only tools.

resources.name: uptoheart/dsh-file-bookmark
resources.desc: Manage frequently used file bookmarks in DeepSeek Harness, supporting bookmark saving, listing and navigation. It also allows creation of frequently used projects, including management projects, code projects and more.

resources.name: uriekang1211-bot/dsh-ssq-plugin
resources.desc: SSQ (China Welfare Lottery Double Color Ball) helper for DeepSeek Harness: 1000-draw trend tracking, six prediction models with ensemble voting, structure analysis and dan-tuo/random generation via the ssq tool.

resources.name: uss7118/dsh-win-control
resources.desc: Windows desktop control for DeepSeek Harness agents: window and UI Automation automation, local Windows OCR, direct browser reads over the Chrome DevTools Protocol (DOM text, JavaScript, selector clicks), humanised mouse and keyboard input, browser tab management, and a live control panel. It probes the machine on first run, writes its own config, and degrades gracefully when a capability is missing. Windows 10/11 only.

resources.name: v587d/capital-generation
resources.desc: China A-share financial data MCP server for the harness: 11 fin_data__* tools (quotes/K-lines/financials/calendar/special-data/announcements/EDB/reconcile/funds/indices) over THS free official REST (primary) + AKShare (fallback) + Wind (exclusive domains), with observable degradation, context-budget compression (result-side -72.2% measured), and an offline 10-year market-data lake; BYOK.

resources.name: VermilionPasvikin/dsh-coderag
resources.desc: Code retrieval engine exposed as an MCP server: four tools (code_search, code_outline, code_index, index_status) over a SQLite FTS5 index with BM25 ranking, CJK bigram indexing, declaration-aware tree-sitter chunking, incremental reindexing, and a three-layer secret filter. The bigram index matches Chinese-language queries against English code, and the default path needs no vector store or embedding model. Requires a local Python 3.10-3.12 engine installed by scripts/install.sh, and CODERAG_ROOT set in the profile patch.

resources.name: Very12345/dsh-bash-windows
resources.desc: Windows settings switch that replaces PowerShell with Git Bash across the four built-in presets, including a persistent terminal in minimal mode.

resources.name: Very12345/dsh-computer-use-windows
resources.desc: Windows desktop control with window-bound screenshots and accessibility state, text readback, DSH approvals, and activity overlays.

resources.name: vibeinging/dsh-tool-search
resources.desc: Per-agent on-demand tool discovery and progressive schema disclosure.

resources.name: Viger1/dsh-design
resources.desc: Measures design rules on the rendered page rather than in the CSS — type-scale count, WCAG AA contrast against the real composited backdrop, spacing-grid drift, palette size, tap targets, and the tells of generated UI such as violet gradients caught by hue angle; ships a design-system skill.

resources.name: vikasranax/dsh-plugin-cats
resources.desc: Fetches random cat facts and images from public APIs for AI agents.

resources.name: VioletEverGarden-zc/dsh-rea-mcp-toggle
resources.desc: Toggles the rea-mcp server on and off from the DSH Web UI session header or through the rea_mcp_toggle agent tool, so the 170 mcp__rea__* tool schemas stop being sent with every request while REA is off (the tools payload drops from about 722 KB to about 95 KB) and the REA child process exits; the choice is kept in a profile-scoped state file and restored at startup by a row-level disabled expression.

resources.name: Vncntvx/dsh-zotero
resources.desc: Zotero as an evidence store for agents: search your library, inspect metadata and notes, retrieve evidence passages, open source PDFs, and generate citations and bibliographies.

resources.name: Void-LifeStream/dsh-cuda
resources.desc: Run Python on the local NVIDIA CUDA GPU from DeepSeek Harness: device status, foreground and detached jobs, durable logs, and a measured peak-VRAM figure per run.

resources.name: Void-LifeStream/dsh-phone-butler
resources.desc: Inspect and tidy a real Android phone over adb: storage surveys, per-app data sizes read from dumpsys diskstats without root, cache clearing that preserves app data, directory measurements and screenshots — five tools; reads never modify anything, writes require explicit confirmation.

resources.name: volcengine/ark-cli#ark-managed-agents
resources.desc: Adds a Managed Agents settings tab and MCP tools to dispatch long-running agent tasks to Ark cloud Managed Agents.

resources.name: Voyager77Twt/dsh-folder-search
resources.desc: Search local Word, PDF, PPT, and Excel folders for exam questions and export selected questions to a Word paper.

resources.name: w4xxx/dsh-xia-plugins#packages/global-proxy
resources.desc: Route every host-process undici fetch through a local HTTP(S) proxy while keeping localhost and China-reachable APIs direct.

resources.name: wackyju2-beep/dsh-better
resources.desc: Archived-session management, task-stop notifications, an update checker, model routing (keyword rules + allowlist-gated model_route), multi-task scheduled triggers (heartbeats and fixed-time tasks), and a DeepSeek-style message scroll nav for the dsh web GUI.

resources.name: wade20250715/dsh-pubmed
resources.desc: PubMed deep-research toolset: literature search, author investigation, same-name disambiguation, institution statistics and mentor-student matching.

resources.name: Walvez/dsh-codex-sync
resources.desc: Two-way Codex↔DSH bridge: skills from ~/.codex/skills, session import with workspace attach, live MCP mirroring of mcp_servers, and a Codex-side reverse MCP installer.

resources.name: Walvez/dsh-search-failover
resources.desc: Web search pool for the native web_search tool: fails over across 8 free/paid backends with quota-aware circuit breaking, settings-page API key management, custom SearXNG instances, failover/rotate strategy switching and live SerpApi quota.

resources.name: WanchunLian/dsh-draft-polish
resources.desc: One-click draft polish for the DSH composer: rewrites your spoken draft into professional wording, sends only the draft snapshot (never conversation context), and never blocks sending if the LLM is unavailable.

resources.name: wangbobo-coder/dsh-mcp-manager
resources.desc: One settings page for every MCP server on your machine. It reads the real config file of 17 other AI tools (Claude Desktop, Claude Code, Cursor, VS Code, Windsurf, OpenCode, Trae, Trae CN, Qoder, Gemini CLI, Qwen, Zed, Roo Code, Copilot CLI, Kiro, CodeBuddy, Continue) plus DeepSeek Harness itself, groups servers by the file that declares them, probes each one over JSON-RPC to see whether it starts and which tools it exposes, and gives every server a switch that mounts or unmounts it in DeepSeek Harness without editing the other tools' own files.

resources.name: wangbodbs/dsh-plugins#dsh-mcp-davinci-resolve
resources.desc: Registers the MCP server built into DaVinci Resolve 21.1+ as an MCP server in DSH, so an agent can drive Resolve through its scripting API.

resources.name: wangbodbs/dsh-plugins#dsh-mcp-flapi
resources.desc: Registers FilmLight's official FLAPI MCP assistant (flapi-dev-mcp) as an MCP server in DSH, so an agent can write and run Baselight / Daylight FLAPI scripts.

resources.name: wangcong1137-hash/dsh-geoserver
resources.desc: Read GeoServer WMS services and render map images in the dsh web GUI, with a settings card for server, username, and password.

resources.name: wangxuewangxue98/dsh-daoyi-yijing
resources.desc: Yijing-based decision review plugin for DSH: six-layer weighted aggregation engine (384 yao to taiji) with strong-association veto rules, pure JS with zero solver dependencies. Free tier is capped at 9 runs per day and activation codes raise it; the stock-trend scenario pulls live quotes from Tencent for the stock codes in the request.

resources.name: wangxuewangxue98/dsh-motor-ai
resources.desc: Full edition of the motor-design AI plugin for DeepSeek Harness: adds the L1 (Ansys RMxprt) and L2 (Motor-CAD) precision layers on top of the L0 millisecond-level broad filter, completing an end-to-end chain from requirement parsing to parameter identification, candidate matrix, L0 pre-screening and L1/L2 verification. Mutually exclusive with dsh-motor-ai-l0 (uninstall l0 first); the shared core @wangxue98/dsh-motor-ai-core installs automatically. L1 needs Ansys AEDT (RMxprt) and L2 needs Motor-CAD installed locally. Distributed under the PolyForm Noncommercial licence; L1/L2 require an activation code. Telemetry is on by default: per-tool usage counts and design-experience samples that the author describes as desensitized are sent to the author's server at wangxuewangxue98.deno.net, and fault assistance can upload fault reports; switch them off with telemetryEnabled, designExperienceUpload and faultAssistEnabled in the plugin config.

resources.name: wangxuewangxue98/dsh-motor-ai-l0
resources.desc: Motor-design AI assistant plugin: requirement parsing → parameter identification → candidate matrix → Top10 verification. L0 is a millisecond-level broad filter (pure JS, zero solver dependency) that ranks candidates and emits the handoff payload for the L1/L2 precision tools; usable as a local agent preset and Cordis plugin. L1 (RMxprt) and L2 (Motor-CAD) are reserved in this version — the level gate fails fast above l0.

resources.name: wangzhanchao883/dsh-disk-manager
resources.desc: Scans the whole C drive and classifies every large folder into A/B/C/D/E/P (safe cache / relocatable / junction-movable / abandoned software / config-memory redline / personal files), then deletes, moves, or redirects on demand — with strong redline protection, dry-run preview and undo. Unknown software decided by LLM fallback + human confirmation. Works on DeepSeek Harness 0.1.7 through 0.2.x, tested on 0.2.0-rc.1.

resources.name: wangzhanchao883/dsh-lost-and-found
resources.desc: Local file recall: indexes the folders you choose into one local SQLite database, so 'where did I put that file?' is one query instead of a disk walk. Caches, VCS and program folders are pruned per directory; each folder keeps its own incremental anchor, so a folder added later is backfilled in full. Read-only: it never modifies, moves or deletes your files. Works on DeepSeek Harness 0.1.7 through 0.2.x, tested on 0.2.0-rc.1.

resources.name: wangzhanchao883/dsh-resume-screening
resources.desc: Resume screening plugin for HR in DeepSeek Harness: ingest up to 100k Word/PDF/Excel resumes into one searchable library with skills / coarse categories / ingest time, auto-ingest & de-dupe new resumes, then screen by plain-language criteria — rule pre-filter in the database plus LLM fine-judge on the shortlisted few, CSV export. Works on DeepSeek Harness 0.1.7 through 0.2.x, tested on 0.2.0-rc.1.

resources.name: wangzhanchao883/dsh-screenshot-capture
resources.desc: Point-and-shoot screenshot capture: a system floating window turns a new screenshot (or copied image) into an Obsidian note with comments and key-point marking, instant OCR through the host DSH multimodal model (no extra API key needed, Tongyi Qianwen as fallback), a duplicate-screen guard, per-day merging, and an optional evening AI organization pass.

resources.name: wangzhanchao883/dsh-word-vault
resources.desc: English word bank for one or more children, built for DSH 0.2 and newer (0.2.0-rc.1 and 0.2.0-rc.2 verified, including the desktop shell; 0.1.7 through 0.2.x all work). 1.10 added pronunciation: in the memory cards and in the online quiz every word and every example sentence has a speaker button that reads it aloud with the built-in Windows voice - offline, with no network call and no model call - and the whole batch of audio is pre-rendered in the background whenever cards or an exam are generated, so a click starts instantly. 1.11 adds: pick words in bulk straight from the library (10 at a time, top-down, up to 50 selected, with a live counter); turn the words a child got wrong in a quiz into a one-click review set - an online card page that speaks plus a printable PDF; and every card example sentence now carries its Chinese translation underneath. Words marked on textbook or workbook photos (highlighter, red pen) are found by their marks, then translated and stored in a local SQLite bank with an occurrence count; the clipboard picker, the photo route and dictation all land in the same bank. High-frequency words surface by count, three correct answers in a row flag a word as learned, and any selection prints as a memory card set (a word split into chunks, real IPA per chunk, a grade-7 example sentence, a mnemonic hook, an A4 sheet of eight) in HTML, PDF or Word, with a print-and-answer exam page whose four options are set against each other for meaning. On 0.1.5 the settings panel does not appear - install dsh-word-vault@1.0.2 instead.

resources.name: DeepSeekLauncher
resources.desc: macOS desktop launcher with an installation skill: starts or reuses the local DeepSeek Harness web service and opens it in Google Chrome, with a transparent character and thought bubble icon.

resources.name: waning-sun/dsh-napcat-keeper
resources.desc: Keeps the NapCat QQ backend alive next to DSH: probes the OneBot 11 HTTP port at startup, launches NapCat when the port does not answer, then rechecks every 45 seconds, kills duplicate process chains, hides the console window, can create a logon scheduled task when a task name is set, and adds a settings page plus napcat_status, napcat_restart and napcat_dedupe tools. Optionally remembers the QQ password, behind a risk confirmation, so an expired fast-login token can be renewed without scanning a QR code. Windows only; without that scheduled task the launched QQ exits together with DSH.

resources.name: wanwulizhi/dsh-claude-code-sdk
resources.desc: Requires Claude Code installed and signed in on this machine. Delegates coding tasks to the local Claude Code agent through the Claude Agent SDK, reports which files changed, supports one-command revert, and adds a Claude Mode toggle to the composer.

resources.name: Wanyi424/dsh-quick-translate
resources.desc: Translate between Chinese and English without leaving DSH, using your configured models with no extra API key: streaming output, a customizable prompt, and local history to revisit and re-translate.

resources.name: warmwine/dsh-memoryleak
resources.desc: Notes and todos as plain Markdown files in your workspace: type /ml plus a sentence to jot into today's journal; todos come in three flavors — deadline, sleep-until-a-date (auto-wakes when due), and anytime; /ml view fuzzy-opens any file with a few keystrokes. Zero tokens throughout — nothing goes through the model, and your notes stay ordinary local files that git and any editor can read.

resources.name: wbb316/dsh-novel
resources.desc: Novel-writing console for DSH: five novel_* tools for the agent (list, read, context, save chapter, cast) plus a side panel with a book wizard, a cast/relation view and streaming chapter continuation.

resources.name: wbin0001/dsh-comfyui-canvas
resources.desc: From chat to canvas to artwork — drive ComfyUI as a visual workflow IDE inside DSH. Embed ComfyUI (local or cloud) as a split-screen canvas in DeepSeek Harness Web: the agent sparks ideas, writes prompts and scripts right in the chat, applies them live to the canvas in front of you, and produces images, music, video, and 3D. From idea to finished output without ever leaving the conversation or switching front-ends: Canvas ops — compose and arrange pipelines, read/write workflows, edit nodes, wire links, run, tune parameters, and debug errors, all live and WYSIWYG on the exact canvas you are looking at; Production tasks — batch parameter sweeps (batch_run) and automatic output-image retrieval back into the chat (get_outputs), powering multi-modal creative and batch generation across images, music, video, and 3D; Environment upkeep — one-click launch of ComfyUI and one-click upgrade of the core plus every custom node (upgrade), keeping the stack healthy without interruption. This package is the DSH-side plugin, and it ships the ComfyUI-side bridge node too.

resources.name: webkubor/dsh-env-inspector
resources.desc: PC environment diagnostics & port control board: zero-dependency inspection of system, CLI toolchains, active listening ports with hover-to-kill release, and model key readiness. No external calls, zero plaintext secrets.

resources.name: wee-b/disk-sentinel
resources.desc: Analyze Windows disk usage, compare scans, and manage cache cleanup and developer environment migration in DSH Web.

resources.name: weibaohui/dsh-file-share
resources.desc: Session workspace file manager: adds a "Files" tab to the conversation area to browse the current session workspace directory tree and manage it in place (upload, download, mkdir, rename, delete, search), with files mentionable into the composer for the agent to process.

resources.name: weibaohui/dsh-webdav-server
resources.desc: WebDAV server: turns a shared directory into a WebDAV service that Windows, macOS and Linux can mount as a local disk, with token authentication, optional read-only mode, configurable directory/port/token, and per-platform mounting guides built into the settings page.

resources.name: weike-zhang/dsh-svg-motion
resources.desc: Turn any SVG logo into a motion video inside DSH: an animate_svg tool renders a transparent 30fps assembly animation (parts fly in, or the whole mark settles) and synthesizes an MP4 with ffmpeg.

resources.name: weisiren000/dsh-remote-ssh-ops
resources.desc: SSH remote ops for DSH: pair servers over SSH or a one-time-code remote-hostd, then run commands, manage background jobs, and read or write remote files with reviewable changes (host_pair/host_bash/host_jobs/host_read_file/host_write_file/host_review_changes).

resources.name: weisofns/dsh-print3d
resources.desc: 3D printing & additive manufacturing plugin for DeepSeek Harness: parametric STL generation, calibration G-code, STL/G-code analysis, toolpath rendering and PrusaSlicer bridge, plus 5 skills and a concise persona optimized for local models.

resources.name: weixshaw/dsh-rss
resources.desc: RSS/Atom reader with grouped subscriptions and unread/total counts, FreshRSS account sync over the Google Reader API with read/star written back, local image proxy, optional BYOK AI summary/translate/Q&A, podcast audio playback and full-text fetch.

resources.name: welsione/dsh-mmx-bridge
resources.desc: MiniMax multimodal bridge: one mmx_bridge tool covers image understanding/generation, video, TTS, music, cover, web search and quota; optional web_search/read_image takeover; inline players/image previews right in the Web GUI (npm: dsh-mmx-bridge).

resources.name: Where227-arch/dsh-booth-search
resources.desc: Search BOOTH for VRChat avatar assets — clothing, shaders, base models, accessories, textures, animations and props — from a dedicated BOOTH tab beside the conversation or via two read-only tools, with Chinese keywords translated to Japanese before the request.

resources.name: whitefirer/dsh-browser-fs
resources.desc: Give agents access to files on the machine where the browser runs: user authorizes a local directory via File System Access, tool calls relay over the plugin's own WebSocket; read-only compat mode for mobile/insecure contexts.

resources.name: whyzsm/dsh-clipfile
resources.desc: Attach files and folders in the composer via clipboard paste, a native file/folder picker, and @-mention path search; folders are converted to paged Markdown for the agent to read page by page. macOS only (clipboard and picker go through osascript).

resources.name: wilianyichen/dsh-deepseek-web
resources.desc: Read-only DeepSeek web archive tools for DSH: list/download/search sessions, share-list, and a digest tool that compresses the 100-session history into one high-density page with activity bars and topic clusters. Write operations are intentionally not exposed (the web client rate-limits them). Requires the separately installed deepseek-ops Python client (github.com/Panniantong/deepseek-ops, by another author) with QR-code login; set scriptDir to its path.

resources.name: windrover/dsh-plugin-update-checker
resources.desc: Adds a "Check updates" tab to the Built-in plugins settings: one row per installed bundle, with its latest npm version and an update button. Each row also reports DSH-runtime compatibility. The registry is read through the .npmrc chain (environment, then profile, then user, first hit wins); with nothing configured it races a mirror against the public registry, and a private registry is never raced against a public one. A version is installed from the registry it was read from.

resources.name: WindyPro-rourou/dsh-logcat
resources.desc: Android real-device debugging workbench for the DSH Web GUI: auto-attached logcat with severity/keyword filters and crash snapshots, live on-device screen casting with remote tap/swipe/text control, memory/proc/frida reverse-engineering toolset, 30 agent tools.

resources.name: wing-tn/astro-ph-researcher
resources.desc: Astronomy research workbench for DSH and Codex: NADC terms, reference library, writing, scoring, author confirmation, recommended books, FITS/XML formats, and analysis guides.

resources.name: wingsky-1/dsh-plugin-hub#packages/dsh-mcp-manager
resources.desc: MCP server manager (stdio / streamable-http): per-working-directory project and global config tiers; project-level MCP collapsed into 4 atomic tools through a middleware layer by default (middleware: all folds in global servers too, hot-switchable in the settings page); workspace isolation prevents cross-project interference; configs keep ${ENV} references only, with no plaintext secrets on disk; runtime registration API for other plugins to inject MCP servers.

resources.name: wjf1/dsh-portable
resources.desc: Export a whole working DSH home — profile, installed plugins with their node_modules, skills, hooks and task boards — into one .dshpkg tar and import it on another machine without network or pnpm; also streams over HTTP or a one-shot LAN link.

resources.name: wjt0321/dsh-git-proxy
resources.desc: On-demand GitHub proxy for the Web UI: one-click git/SSH proxy toggle with connectivity tests.

resources.name: wlc114514/dsh-upload-origin
resources.desc: Resolves the original local path of files uploaded to .dsh-uploads by matching file name, size, and sha256.

resources.name: wly8691-jpg/dsh-office-com
resources.desc: COM-driven real Microsoft Office automation for DeepSeek Harness: drives a running Excel/Word instance through OfficeMCP — VBA macros, pivot tables, live formula recalculation, and deep document layout; plus an accounting suite (double-entry journal posting with debit/credit balance check, and SUMIF general ledger).

resources.name: wly8691-jpg/knowlp-rag
resources.desc: Dual knowledge-graph RAG for Markdown notes with half-life memory decay: prerequisite + similarity graphs (P/S-Agent traversal), paragraph chunking, n-gram/embedding hybrid search, and an explicit weight-feedback loop — a native Cordis plugin, npm-installable as @eqman00003/knowlp-rag.

resources.name: WODE25500/dsh-ip-info
resources.desc: IP/domain intelligence for DeepSeek Harness: ip_lookup, dns_lookup and whois_lookup tools via free no-key APIs (ipwho.is, Google DNS-over-HTTPS, RDAP).

resources.name: WODE25500/dsh-lan-share
resources.desc: Share the DSH workspace over the local network: phones, tablets and other computers browse, download and upload files via browser with no DSH login. Token gate, path boundary, read-only mode and rate limit. Zero-dependency (node:http).

resources.name: WODE25500/dsh-public-apis
resources.desc: The public-apis catalog wired into DeepSeek Harness: search 1716 free public APIs by keyword, category, auth, HTTPS or CORS and call any of them.

resources.name: wodongx123/dsh-language-control
resources.desc: Force the agent's chain-of-thought, planning, tool-invocation reasoning, and internal deliberation to stay in Chinese — the language constraint is injected at the top of the system prompt before every reasoning step, so it cannot be diluted by tool-returned content. A settings panel lets you edit the constraint text on the fly.

resources.name: wsk114514/dsh-ark-wiki
resources.desc: Queries PRTS Wiki for Arknights operators, items, stages, story pages and worldbook entries, and predicts unreleased characters, alters and banner schedules from story-cast statistics and banner history.

resources.name: WU079/dsh-douyin-subagent
resources.desc: Runs a Douyin subagent that browses videos and reads comments in valley hours and reports back, with dy_* tools for publishing and replying (comments sent from the already-logged-in page with its own request signature, no IM ticket), a daily quota timer, and a settings panel under Settings → Douyin: master switch, auto mode, valley windows, rounds per day and report depth. Windows-oriented; needs the separate douyin-mcp binary (yunsur/douyin-mcp releases, path set via dy_config mcpExe) and an Edge/Chromium login; replying needs a logged-in browser on a CDP port; publishing needs extra credentials most accounts lack.

resources.name: wufengwind/dsh-plugin-dm-ops
resources.desc: Requires JDK 11+, the DM JDBC driver and SSH access to the target instance. Inspect Dameng database instances, assess security and recovery conditions, and generate filterable reports with shared evidence.

resources.name: wulun811/LiuHe#bundle
resources.desc: Bridges the LiuHe MCP code toolkit (44 tools) into dsh web: repo_map, symbol search, edit_batch with tolerant matching, transactional edits with undo journal, and deterministic quality gates — backed by a crash-isolated Rust tree-sitter parse daemon and SQLite index.

resources.name: wunianqiebing/dsh-dota2bp
resources.desc: Dota 2 ranked no-ban 2-2-1 draft assistant with bracket and pro data sources, flexible player pools, in-game player selection, and a post-draft win probability estimate.

resources.name: Wuqiu-Ying/dsh-wtskin-project
resources.desc: War Thunder user-skin studio: 4-point UV quad picker, quad-clipped art layers, and PNG/DDS/.blk export.

resources.name: wuzhican/dsh-qbittorrent
resources.desc: Nine model-facing tools over the qBittorrent WebAPI v2, with confirm-gated mutations and an orphan-torrent diagnostic.

resources.name: wwwort/dsh-win-computer-use
resources.desc: Windows-native computer use for DeepSeek Harness: two tools drive and read any desktop app. One batch call runs find, click, type, key, read, wait and screenshot steps in a single engine pass, so a task whose steps are known up front costs one model round trip; reading returns window text rather than an image, and input and capture prefer UI Automation patterns, Win32 messages and offscreen PrintWindow so the user's focus and pointer stay untouched.

resources.name: wxkingstar/SpecFusion
resources.desc: Search 65,600+ API docs from 20 Chinese open platforms through five read-only tools and a runtime skill.

resources.name: x2802490130-prog/dsh-tool-writing
resources.desc: A web-novel writing engine for DeepSeek Harness: parallel drafting, outlining and brainstorming with a separate DeepSeek key, lore and foreshadowing management, semantic vector retrieval, a corpus library, usage ledger, mechanical proofreading, and a local serialization plan.

resources.name: x2802490130-prog/dsh-writing-remote
resources.desc: Host-side Typert remote for dsh-tool-writing: serves project volumes, chapter status, corpus library, full-text search, evolution entries, and thread-graph data to the client writing panel.

resources.name: Xantares330/dsh-codex-consult
resources.desc: Requires the Codex CLI installed and codex login completed. Consult the OpenAI Codex CLI from DeepSeek Harness with three tools: codex_consult runs Codex in a read-only sandbox, inlines evidence files, verifies the served model and reasoning effort from the Codex rollout file, retries disconnected streams, and records quota before and after the call; codex_quota reports the current 5-hour and weekly quota; codex_calls lists recent calls.

resources.name: xchannel1987/dsh-power-xc
resources.desc: Power management plugin for DeepSeek Harness - sidebar power button with restart/shutdown menu, self-contained restart engine without external dependencies, graceful session flush.

resources.name: xfy2412/dsh-time-reminder
resources.desc: Gives the agent its own clock: per-session time readings whose precision the agent can change at runtime, elapsed-time counters, and one-shot countdowns that survive a host restart.

resources.name: XGL2019/dsh-wenan
resources.desc: Extract short-video scripts and captions from Douyin, Bilibili, Kuaishou and YouTube, including titles, authors, hashtags and engagement data, through a bundled Python extractor.

resources.name: xianmua/dsh-apis-plugin
