resources.name: xianyuyijinban/boardwise#dsh-plugin
resources.desc: Offline schematic review for EasyEDA Pro, exposed to dsh as four tools — one-shot checkup reports, architecture skeletons, an install doctor, and a live-editor bridge that prefers read-only actions, all driven by the local boardwise CLI.

resources.name: xiaomao361/dsh-capability-gateway
resources.desc: Hides opted-in third-party skills and MCP servers from the model-facing catalogs and serves them through one capability tool: search by intent, read the schema or the skill instructions, then call. A local journal records metadata only, never query text or arguments.

resources.name: xiaoshi7915/dsh-kb-manager
resources.desc: Local knowledge base manager for DSH agents: multi-format import, CJK-aware chunking, sqlite-vec vector + BM25 hybrid search with bge-reranker-base rerank, snapshots, kbpack export/import and cross-KB search — 22 agent tools plus a Web panel.

resources.name: xiaoxiao150/vram-switcher
resources.desc: AstrBot/DSH-native GPU coordination for local AI companions: LLM, IndexTTS and ComfyUI take turns, no proxy.

resources.name: xiaoyuink/dsh-image-create
resources.desc: Text-to-image and image-to-image generation inside DSH through OpenAI-compatible endpoints, with an agent tool, multi-provider fallback, and a side-panel workspace with history.

resources.name: xie129716/computer-user-vision
resources.desc: Windows computer use forked from computer-user: 13 computer_* tools that read the screen and drive the mouse and keyboard. Image-capable routes get the screenshot as a real image with an exact image-to-screen mapping, so no external OCR; elements return as UI Automation refs so a click lands on the exact control rectangle; Ctrl+Alt+Esc stops every call.

resources.name: xiehuan123/dsh-deepread
resources.desc: Deep-read books and articles in five modes (quick, deep, knowledge map, Feynman, full book) with claim-evidence-data reports, Mermaid/XMind mindmaps, batch comparison, budget preflight, transparent background-job progress, and MD/HTML exports from URLs, files, or pasted text.

resources.name: xienda/dsh-jev-verify
resources.desc: 0.8.6 fixes a startup crash: the host runtime package is an optional peer, never an installed dependency. TypeSafe Jev (System One decision model) wired end to end into DeepSeek Harness (0.8.6). Seven tools: jev_decision (1-25 parallel atomic verdicts in one call; noul/choice/score; typed answers with calibrated confidence; measured median 266-484 ms; verdicts only, never prose), jev_choose (rank 2-10 candidate approaches - fit 0-3 and risk - into an explicit composite with a recommended pick), jev_batch (NEW in 0.8.6: one set of 1-5 judgments over 1-20 texts, one real call per text at bounded concurrency, returning a paste-ready markdown table sortable by a judged dimension; built-in sentiment/priority/intent/pii/spam presets; a failed row is reported as failed with the raw error, never guessed), jev_usage (locally measured usage: calls, tokens, estimated cost, latency median and p95, per-tool mix, rolling windows, projected burn rate, optional local hard budgets, and a declared-balance remainder), jev_overview (session ledger), jev_guard_status (guard counters plus a registrations block that surfaces per-surface registration failures) and jev_verify (frozen 27-question live benchmark at concurrency 6: 96.3%, 26/27). WHAT IS NEW IN 0.8.6 - the ledger survives a restart, the remainder is derived instead of invented, and the plugin can now do batch paperwork. (1) The local ledger persists to $DSH_HOME/jev-usage.json BY DEFAULT, so the cumulative total no longer resets when the host restarts. Two real bugs behind the old silent zero were found and fixed: the ledger path only honoured DSH_HOME (absent inside the host process, so persistence was silently disabled and the file name was null), and save() wrote the still-empty in-memory ring over the history file because it ran before the first load while the debounce window swallowed the follow-up write. (2) Remaining is derived, never invented: TypeSafe exposes no balance endpoint - /v1/usage, /v1/quota, /v1/account, /v1/account/balance, /v1/balance, /v1/credits, /v1/billing, /v1/me, /v1/limits and a dozen more all return 404, and only /v1/models answers, with no balance headers - so the panel shows the remainder as your declared balance (quota.declaredBalanceUsd) minus locally measured spend since quota.balanceSince, and says plainly that it cannot be fetched instead of printing a number. (3) The composer pill re-reads every 20 s instead of every 60 s, so a call you just made shows up while you are still looking at it. (4) The collapsed pill leads with the remainder once you declare a balance, and the cumulative row is renamed when the ledger is on disk. Every tool has an in-conversation structured view; the Settings > Plugins card covers credentials, tool switches, the auto-guard, the dashboard, the prompt section, usage/quota and auto-triage. Honest by design: no API key means an explicit error, never fabricated results; every registration is quarantined so a failure degrades one surface. Tests 38/38 (npm test, ~2.5 s). Client half applies on refresh; server half needs a host restart.

resources.name: Xin-kon/dsh-lang-guard
resources.desc: Pins a Chinese (zh-CN) thinking and answering constraint into the system prompt, and registers a per-step runtime reminder so the agent does not drift back to English after tool output. Zero runtime dependencies, single file; falls back to a second registration path and only logs a warning when the host API changes.

resources.name: xing-he888/dsh-database-explorer
resources.desc: Database explorer panel for DeepSeek Harness: connect SQLite, MySQL/MariaDB, PostgreSQL, SQL Server, MongoDB, ClickHouse, Redis, Elasticsearch and Qdrant from a third Conversation tab — browse schemas, page through data, edit cells, insert rows, design and drop tables, run SQL, import/export CSV/JSON/SQL/Markdown, and draw editable E-R diagrams. Read-only connections enforce statement-level allowlists, agent tools ship read-only by default with an opt-in write flag, and every write (including refused attempts) lands in an auditable log. Ships an MCP stdio server exposing the same connections to external AI clients.

resources.name: xing666173/dsh-vision-hub#file-drop
resources.desc: Drag-and-drop file upload for PDF, Word, Excel and images: dropped files are saved to a local directory and referenced by path, no base64 bloat in the chat.

resources.name: xinming-chenniang/dsh-outcomes
resources.desc: Deliverables registry for DeepSeek Harness: agents register the final artifacts of a task (reports, pages, documents, sheets, images, datasets) into one settings section and manager page that store paths only, never copies, and remove recoverably; a standalone CLI (add, list, stats, check, remove, restore) reads and audits the same registry outside the app.

resources.name: XMoon/dsh-profile-settings
resources.desc: Per-profile settings overlay for DeepSeek Harness: global settings.yaml stays the baseline while each profile overrides any namespace through its own profiles/<name>/settings.patch.yml — object sections merge recursively, scalars and arrays replace wholesale, and !unset masks an inherited value. The overlay is transparent to existing plugins (they keep reading ctx.settings unchanged), writes land in the profile overlay only, and official schema validation, revision semantics, expectedRevision conflicts, watchers and events are untouched. Ships a settings command family (get/set/unset/mask/unmask/promote/demote/migrate/diff/layers) plus a Profile Settings section in the web Settings panel over a loopback RPC channel.

resources.name: xmutfyh/dsh-plugin-writing-guard
resources.desc: Academic writing guard (EN/ZH bilingual): removes AI-style defensive writing, protects scientific evidence (numbers, citations, claim strength, null findings, scope) during polishing, and calibrates writing toward a target journal (Journal Profile + Journal Fit). Deterministic local regex/statistics, zero network/LLM; writing_rules / writing_audit / writing_style_profile / writing_journal_profile with auto-audit on paper writes.

resources.name: xtt-xt/dsh-custom-tool-studio
resources.desc: Author Python tools in a web page or through an agent tool and register them as DSH tools without a restart; dangerous tools need built-in approval on every run, tools can be grouped into packs, and an optional unlock mode exposes them per conversation. Needs Python 3 on PATH.

resources.name: xuezuoys/dsh-blender-mcp-bridge
resources.desc: This project aims to bridge the Blender MCP Add-on, so that models on DSH can conveniently connect to the current user's working Blender to assist creation, while meeting basic security requirements.

resources.name: yangdw2024/gaussian-dsh-plugin
resources.desc: DSH plugin for Gaussian 16: SMILES-to-3D, input generation, serial job management, output parsing, and Multiwfn/VMD post-processing (orbital/ESP/RDG).

resources.name: yanglaofish/dsh-proxy-pro
resources.desc: Routes model requests, web fetches/searches and spawned tools through the Windows system proxy or a custom address — idempotent kernel (reads never rebuild the dispatcher), header one-click toggle, per-URL route diagnosis and NTLM-aware 407 hints.

resources.name: YangRuiYangDan/dsh-media-card
resources.desc: Show local images and short videos in the DSH conversation card with one-click download of the original file, or offer any other local file for download; works over local and remote connections and keeps the media itself out of the model's vision context.

resources.name: yangyunsong023/dsh-sxs-news-collector
resources.desc: Trending-topics collector aggregating Baidu / Toutiao / Douyin / Weibo hot lists in one call (Weibo optional cookie), returning titles with heat values for content creators — tool: sxs_news_hot.

resources.name: yanJ26/dsh-disk-browser
resources.desc: Sidebar disk browser for DeepSeek Harness - browse any folder on the server (including hidden ones) with text preview, streaming download and upload (multi-select / drag-and-drop, overwrite confirm), responsive on desktop and mobile.

resources.name: YaphetHayate/codeRDD#dsh-rdd-explore
resources.desc: Cache-first code exploration: the rdd_explore tool queries the project's .rdd/exploration index and, on a miss, dispatches a read-only worker subagent to explore and register findings; rdd_models serves the live model catalog for dispatch-time model selection.

resources.name: yaways/dsh-subagent-claude-code-wrapper

resources.name: Yeelight/dsh-yeelight-smart-home
resources.desc: Control, organize, diagnose, design, personalize, and answer product knowledge questions for a Yeelight smart home, powered by the local yeelight-home runtime.

The cleaner ships inside the package (bin/tmp-clean, Python 3), so no extra install step is needed.

resources.name: ygunoil/dsh-va-studio
resources.desc: VA Studio integration: ten tools that generate short dramas, images, videos, novels and screenplays, and reverse-engineer prompts from images or videos. Requires a running VA Studio backend.

resources.name: yh01010/dsh-mcp-matlab
resources.desc: Bridges a local MATLAB MCP server into DSH: evaluate MATLAB code, run .m scripts and tests, and inspect installed toolboxes via mcp__matlab__* tools. resources.name: Yijian-quiet/dsh-mol#dsh-bundle
resources.desc: Registers the dsh-mol stdio MCP server, built on RDKit with no network access, into a DSH profile. It exposes 12 tools: three-level SMILES validation with human-readable diagnostics and character positions, molecular properties, drug-likeness and structural alerts, structure rendering to PNG/SVG, multi-molecule grids, format conversion (SMILES, InChI, InChIKey, MOL, SDF, formula), standardisation with a per-step change log, deduplication, SMARTS substructure matching, fingerprint similarity, and batch clean-up that reports every rejected row. The patch only registers the server; the tools live in this repository's Python package and must be installed first — the README gives a pip install route and a from-source route, and until the package is on PyPI the from-source one is what works.

resources.name: Yijian-quiet/dsh-mol#dsh-ui
resources.desc: A chemistry workbench panel in the DSH web UI. Draw structures on a Ketcher canvas (a script downloads the build; it renders locally in the browser with no backend), then compute on the current molecule with RDKit without calling a model — formula, molecular weight, exact mass, logP, TPSA, hydrogen-bond donors and acceptors, ring counts, Fsp3, stereocentres, Lipinski and Veber rule-by-rule checks, QED, PAINS/BRENK structural alerts and the Murcko scaffold, plus SMARTS substructure matching, fingerprint similarity, format conversion, standardisation and batch clean-up. A retrosynthesis tab talks to a pluggable backend (Retro* by default) over a single JSON-in/JSON-out process, and states what is missing when the backend is not installed instead of inventing a route. The calculations run in this repository's Python package (rdkit), which is installed with pip separately.

resources.name: yijiezhong/dsh-testhud
resources.desc: On-screen test-progress HUD for DSH — a click-through panel drawn over the app under test, showing each step's expectation vs actual and whether the waiting human may take back the mouse and keyboard. Ships a universal prebuilt binary (arm64 + x86_64), so no Xcode Command Line Tools are needed; the panel itself requires macOS 14+.

resources.name: Yinxe/deepseek-harness-plugins#archive/mcwiki-search
resources.desc: Query Chinese Minecraft Wiki (MediaWiki API) and convert raw wiki text into clean AI-readable output — search, page intro, full-page Markdown, and random entry; templates, references, images and cross-language links are stripped before reaching the model. resources.name: YiRan0/dsh-bangumi

resources.desc: A 护航 panel in the session header that switches the local dsh-guard watchdog on or off and shows whether scanning is enabled, whether the guard is alive and when it last scanned; the Python watchdog that does the watching is deployed separately and found through the DSH_GUARD_ROOT environment variable. The watchdog defaults to a Windows checkout (D:\AI\Projects\dsh-guard); set DSH_GUARD_ROOT to point at another directory.

resources.name: YongjianWan/dsh-loadout
resources.desc: On-demand tool loadout for DSH: MCP tools are grouped by server and host plugin tools by prefix; grouped tools hide by default and activate with one call, while tools claimed by no rule stay visible. Ships preset modes (coding / writing / ops / review), a trial zone that promotes new tools after repeated use, gated groups that need user confirmation to activate, an outbound cut while reading the web as prompt-injection defense, and built-in search plus proxy call for long-tail tools.

resources.name: yoursc/dsh-siyuan
resources.desc: SiYuan (思源笔记) notes integration: 17 siyuan_* host tools covering notebook and document listing, full-text search, SQL query, reading documents and blocks, creating and appending content, moving and renaming documents, daily notes and block attributes, plus a Web settings page for the SiYuan URL, API token and per-tool switches.

resources.name: Yu-tao-Li/dsh-computer-use-win
resources.desc: Lets the DSH agent operate your Windows apps and web pages: it reads controls through UI Automation, clicks, types, captures the screen and reads text with OCR, and works on web pages in its own browser in the background, without moving your mouse; when it needs your mouse or keyboard, an on-screen indicator appears and Esc stops it.

resources.name: Yu-tao-Li/dsh-reference-checker
resources.desc: Reference verification for DeepSeek Harness (参考文献真实性检查器): the reference_checker model tool checks a paper's bibliography (.pdf/.bib/.tex/.txt or pasted text) against Crossref, OpenAlex and arXiv, reports found / partial / not_found / error per entry, and emits corrected citations in the input's style (APA, GB/T 7714, IEEE, Vancouver, MLA, Chicago, Harvard, ACS, BibTeX).

resources.name: YuanyuanMa03/dsh-funnel
resources.desc: Ingestion-time tool-output curation: keeps error and warning lines plus head and tail, spills the full text to disk with a pointer the model can read back; covers every text tool, small results pass through untouched.

resources.name: Yubickari/dsh-semantic-drift
resources.desc: One versioned vocabulary of a project's business concepts, a read-only drift scan, and the same naming rules in every agent prompt.

resources.name: YUEEEEY/dsh-desktop-tools
resources.desc: DSH environment management: auto-installs a Rust/Tauri desktop host (downloaded per-OS from dsh-desktop-host releases, source build as fallback), one-click runtime updates, Windows platform compatibility, official DeepSeek billing, and a built-in code editor for the workspace.

resources.name: yuehancn/dsh-tool-archive
resources.desc: Pack a directory into a deterministic tar, read an archive's contents without extracting it, unpack while refusing every member that could reach outside the destination, and verify what came out against what went in by SHA-256. No external dependency — the tar format is written and read in this plugin. Extraction is deliberately more permissive on reading than on writing, because a reader's job is to report what an archive says, while a writer must never emit what it cannot read back. A tar has no central index, so the walk tracks whether it reached the end-of-archive marker: without that, a half-file checksums fine and reads as complete.

resources.name: yuehancn/dsh-tool-browser
resources.desc: Open a page, wait for it the way it actually needs, extract the readable article, and take a screenshot. Playwright is optional: when it is absent the tools fall back to a static fetch and say so in the result, because a page whose JavaScript never ran means something different from one that rendered. Content is chosen by scoring candidate subtrees on prose density rather than on tag names, so a container loses to the article inside it instead of winning by containing more of the document.

resources.name: yuehancn/dsh-tool-comfyui
resources.desc: Generate images from chat by calling a fleet of local or LAN ComfyUI workers, with workflow templates, worker health checks and queue control.

resources.name: yuehancn/dsh-tool-epub
resources.desc: Read, build and take apart EPUB 3 books with no external dependency — the ZIP reader/writer and the XML scanner are both built in. Inspect metadata, reading order and TOC for structural problems, assemble a book from chapters, or split one back into per-chapter HTML.

resources.name: yuehancn/dsh-tool-gzh-publisher
resources.desc: WeChat Official Account pipeline: validate a draft against a publish gate, then push it into the draft box.

resources.name: yuehancn/dsh-tool-invoice
resources.desc: Pull invoice number, date, parties, tax IDs and the amount/tax/total triplet out of text, then verify that amount plus tax really equals the total and flag documents that do not reconcile.

resources.name: yuehancn/dsh-tool-media
resources.desc: Drive a local ffmpeg as six structured tools: probe a file's streams, transcode or trim it, pull evenly-spaced frames or the audio track, and compress video to a byte budget with two-pass encoding.

resources.name: yuehancn/dsh-tool-mining
resources.desc: Turn a GitHub repository's raw counts into a defensible judgement — contributor concentration and bus factor with single-author files, merge time reported as a median beside the mean so an outlier is visible rather than hidden, and an issue backlog with pull requests and drafts filtered out. Reads the public REST API with no SDK, and never claims a truncated page is the whole answer.

resources.name: yuehancn/dsh-tool-notion
resources.desc: Convert Notion blocks and Markdown in both directions, with no API client and no external dependency. A Notion paragraph is an array of rich-text runs while Markdown says one string, so the two directions are a split and a merge rather than a pair of inverses — rich-text runs are cut at every annotation boundary one way and re-merged the other, with fences widened when the content already contains backticks. Reports every lossy step instead of swallowing it.

resources.name: yuehancn/dsh-tool-ocr
resources.desc: Extract text from an image or PDF, reading a born-digital text layer directly and falling through to a configured OCR engine for scans.

resources.name: yuehancn/dsh-tool-podcast
resources.desc: Turn a raw recording into a published podcast with a local ffmpeg — detect chapter boundaries from silence, cut at those boundaries, normalise loudness to a broadcast target in two passes, and write an iTunes-compatible RSS feed whose enclosure byte lengths are measured from disk.

resources.name: yuehancn/dsh-tool-protobuf
resources.desc: Read, audit and diff Protocol Buffer definitions without installing protoc: a zero-dependency .proto parser exposing six tools (status, outline, describe, diff, audit, next_number). diff classifies every change as breaking, risky or additive and names the wire-format consequence; audit catches what protoc accepts but a reviewer should not — duplicated or illegal field numbers, reserved-range collisions, unresolved types, and unreserved gaps below the high-water mark.

resources.name: yuehancn/dsh-tool-qrcode
resources.desc: Generate QR codes from a from-scratch ISO/IEC 18004 encoder with no external tools, plan symbol version and error-correction headroom before producing anything, and decode an existing symbol back to text.

resources.name: yuehancn/dsh-tool-subtitle
resources.desc: Read, write, convert and retime a subtitle track across SRT, WebVTT and ASS, audit it for over-long or unreadable cues, and transcribe audio through a configured speech recogniser.

resources.name: yuezhiye/dsh-closet
resources.desc: Per-workspace closet for temporary scripts and their run logs, kept in a .dsh-fix directory inside each project. Registers a script with its language and purpose, scans a project for leftover scratch scripts, backups and log files, runs registered scripts with a timeout and writes each run to a timestamped log, and sweeps chosen files into a reversible trash with per-batch restore. Scanning only lists and never deletes; cleanup moves files instead of deleting them; files already tracked by git are refused unless forced. Ships 7 agent tools and a settings panel.

resources.name: yugejixian/vm-blackbox
resources.desc: Black-box GUI testing for DeepSeek Harness: an AI tester drives a real Windows virtual machine using only screenshots and mouse/keyboard, so its verdicts rest on pixels instead of logs or source code. Ships the dsh-vm-tester plugin with twelve vm_* tools (status, UI tree, screenshot, click, type, type-secret, key, basic key, wait, snapshot, upload, download), a reverse-tunnel guest agent for Windows, and run verification scripts. Needs Windows, VirtualBox 7 and a Windows guest VM with the bundled agent before any vm tool works.

resources.name: yuioi666/dsh-conversation-nav-dots
resources.desc: Navigation dots for DSH Web conversations — quickly jump between user messages.

resources.name: yuloong07-star/dsh-prompt-system
resources.desc: Prompt optimizer in the composer: rewrites the draft into an eleven-section analytical prompt using the conversation, workspace files and the session's selected model, with one-click undo.

resources.name: yunxiyang/dsh-web-search-litellm
resources.desc: Web search provider for the ctx.web seam that routes the DeepSeek web_search tool through a LiteLLM proxy using the OpenAI Responses API, reusing LITELLM_API_KEY.

resources.name: YunzhouLi-hub/dsh-overall-mcp
resources.desc: Host-wide MCP server panel: imports the servers declared in Claude Desktop, Claude Code, Cursor and Codex CLI configs, searches six upstream catalogs and installs from whichever of them declares an install plan, asks only for the fields a server actually declares, and checks each row for whether the mount, the handshake and its tool list really work.

resources.name: Yur0918/dsh-user-addons
resources.desc: Drag-and-drop file upload into the conversation composer, token usage pill with quota tracking, and session archive management — a three-in-one daily-driver addon.

resources.name: Yurzi/dsh-pdf-mineru
resources.desc: Provider-independent DSH document parsing powered by MinerU, with native background jobs, immutable results, and safe request coalescing.

resources.name: Yurzi/dsh-tool-web-enhanced#profile
resources.desc: Switchable backends behind the native web_search and web_fetch, chosen per session from a composer menu or /setup-search and /setup-fetch: DeepSeek, Exa, Firecrawl, Tavily, Tinyfish, OpenAlex, Semantic Scholar and server-side model search for search; local HTTP with a private-network allowlist, the DeepSeek Fetch API, Exa, Firecrawl, Tavily and Tinyfish for fetch.

resources.name: Yuuyuko-uu/dsh-bili-subagent
resources.desc: Lets the agent scan Bilibili through a subagent and report what is worth watching, with per-video notes, a card wall, and an inbox for mentions, replies and shared videos.

resources.name: YV3507/dsh-webui-launcher
resources.desc: Cross-platform Web UI launcher for DeepSeek Harness: webui_start/stop/status/open model tools, a /webui start|stop|status|open slash command, a Settings-page launch card, and an optional desktop shortcut that starts the Web UI hidden and opens the browser once it is fully ready (dsh default icon).

resources.name: Yvesgao/dsh-shortcut-creator
resources.desc: Create a one-click Windows desktop shortcut from the Settings page: a .cmd launcher + desktop icon for DeepSeek Harness or any local server, auto-opens the browser, with taskbar pin hints.

resources.name: ywgATustcbbs/dsh-human-task#dsh-human-task
resources.desc: Human-in-the-loop tools (human_task / human_task_ready_check): pause the agent until the user performs a real-world action or returns an observation (GUI operation, game testing, visual verification, hardware checks), gated by session consent and an AFK presence check, returning a structured JSON result via a web task dialog.

resources.name: yxy050208/multisim-mcp#deepseek-harness
resources.desc: Connects DeepSeek Harness to Multisim MCP for circuit generation, simulation, diagnostics, design optimization, and experiment report export.

resources.name: yybukn/dsh-table-attach
resources.desc: Attach tables and documents (xlsx, csv, pdf, zip…) to the DSH composer via paste or drag-and-drop: files are saved into the session workspace and an @reference is inserted.

resources.name: road-kid/dsh-terminal-shell
resources.desc: Choose which shell backs the Windows terminal tool: PowerShell, the local Git Bash, or cmd.exe.

resources.name: TGWgulugu/dsh-wsl-bridge

resources.name: WilliamShi666/dsh-wsl-workspace-picker

resources.name: 1624318455/dsh-plugin-tavily

resources.name: 16601134718/dsh-codex-cua
resources.desc: Installs the codex-cua skill so DeepSeek Harness can use Codex computer use: drives Chrome and native macOS apps through the runtime bundled with the ChatGPT/Codex desktop app, ships a persistent session client and a doctor self-check. Requires the ChatGPT/Codex desktop app with its Chrome extension, Python 3.9+, and macOS.

resources.name: 240xu/dsh-websearch
resources.desc: Aggregated web search provider that fans one query out to 11 engines (Exa, Parallel, DuckDuckGo, SearXNG, Brave, Tavily, Serper, Mojeek, DeepSeek, Anthropic, OpenAI) concurrently, URL-dedupes and merges the results. Ships a settings card for toggling backends, storing API keys in the credential store, and tuning concurrency and timeouts.

resources.name: 263311487-ux/dsh-verify
resources.desc: Independent browser acceptance testing for agent deliverables: JSON spec in, real-Chromium verdict out.

resources.name: 2672243194/dsh-read-url

resources.name: 27painter/dsh-moli
resources.desc: Drives a locally installed Moli headless browser from DeepSeek Harness: rendered fetch, JavaScript evaluation, Markdown, semantic trees, screenshots and PDFs. Installs Moli when it is missing; verified with a real engine on Windows, Linux and macOS.

resources.name: dsh-inpage-translator

Hold to drag, drop it near an edge and it tucks into a small handle; it is re-injected automatically after navigation. The host LLM service does the translation — the plugin holds no API key.

resources.name: A3Boy/dsh-web-tools

resources.name: alllllinnrann/dsh-inapp-browser

resources.name: angelky7/dsh-browser-control

resources.name: ankye/dsh_use_browser#use-browser

resources.name: ArcaneOrion/dsh-tavily-web

resources.name: ayakadaisuki/dsh-free-search-lite

resources.name: Baisbt/dsh-plugin-webrelay
resources.desc: Embeds external AI chat sites in a DSH side panel through the same-origin reverse proxy with per-site DOM adapters, and adds a composer button that either rewrites the draft with the host model or runs a two-round loop: compress the conversation, optimize, send to the embedded site, capture the reply, then finalize it into the composer.

resources.name: Barry-1212/dsh-webscout
resources.desc: Tavily-backed web search and page fetch for DeepSeek Harness: a Search provider, a Fetch provider with Tavily Extract, Firecrawl and direct HTTP modes, and a settings card. Needs a Tavily API key; Firecrawl is optional.

resources.name: BeatAPI/beatapi-agent-plugin#dsh-browser

resources.name: big0lives/dsh-web-window-companion

resources.name: BitDG/dsh-plugins#reference-library

resources.name: bpc-oss/chrome-faithful#dsh-plugin-chrome-faithful
resources.desc: Exact-profile control of your real logged-in Chrome browser: an MCP server plus MV3 extension and authenticated localhost bridge for tabs, locators, file injection, media export, and durable scroll capture, with no debug profile or remote-debugging port.

resources.name: BrambleXu/dsh-annotate
resources.desc: Select browser elements directly during Vibe Coding and send structured visual feedback to the DeepSeek Harness Agent.

resources.name: bug-huntter/web-search-advanced

resources.name: cfanmaoli/kimi-webbridge-dsh
resources.desc: Provisions the kimi-webbridge bridge daemon (auto-install with SHA-256 verification, auto-start) and registers a 25-action skill that drives the user's real browser through the local bridge.

resources.name: chendefine/dsh-web-fetch-playwright

resources.name: chendefine/dsh-web-search-aggregation
resources.desc: Aggregated web-search provider for the built-in web_search tool: one prioritized queue over nine providers (AnySearch, TinyFish, Tavily, Brave, Exa, Firecrawl, Jina, SerpApi, Serper), with multi-key rotation per provider, ordered fallback on failed attempts, and a live settings card.

resources.name: CJYLZS/dsh-browser
resources.desc: Give the dsh agent a real browser: each conversation gets its own Chrome or Edge process with its own profile and CDP port, driven by six tools and mirrored live in the right sidebar, where you can watch the work and take over by clicking or typing on the picture. resources.name: copylee711/dsh-free-search
resources.desc: Web search provider with switchable engines, several usable without an API key (Bing, DuckDuckGo, SearXNG and others) and a fallback order between them; adds multi_search, platform_search, image_search with an in-chat image wall, page_images and save_images, plus a settings page for engines, keys and per-engine proxy.

resources.name: CREAIT-nl/dsh-plugins#web-fetch
resources.desc: A guarded local fetch provider for the ctx.web seam — the backend dsh does not ship for its own web_fetch tool. Every redirect hop is re-resolved and checked against the non-routable ranges, with a streamed size cap and a content-type allowlist.

resources.name: CREAIT-nl/dsh-plugins#web-search-searxng
resources.desc: Points web_search at a self-hosted SearXNG instance instead of the native route: pages until maxResults is satisfied, and reports degraded coverage when engines fail so a thin result set is not read as a thin web.

resources.name: cslkkl/dsh-web-annotator
resources.desc: Annotate pages inside the existing Harness Browser: click or drag to select, comment or ask, then send marked screenshots or DOM location details to the current session. While enabled it replaces the official Browser, Chat and Layout providers; targets Harness 0.2.1-alpha.2.

resources.name: d342784178/dsh-opencli
resources.desc: Browser tools for DSH that POST to the local OpenCLI daemon instead of spawning the opencli CLI per command, avoiding its cold start: oc_status, oc_exec, oc_navigate, oc_snapshot and oc_tabs, with one persistent automation tab per session.

resources.name: DDDMUC/dsh-free-search
resources.desc: Free, keyless web search for DSH: 7 engines (DuckDuckGo/Bing/SearXNG free + Exa/Perplexity/DeepSeek paid), auto-failover, settings-page UI with API key inputs and official links, web_fetch, and an engine test tool.

resources.name: Decodo/dsh-web-fetch
resources.desc: Decodo Web Data API as the fetch provider behind the built-in web_fetch tool: returns Markdown by default, pins fetchProvider to decodo, and enforces a configurable per-process fetch cap. Requires a Decodo API key; web_search is unchanged.

resources.name: delef/dsh-free-web-search
resources.desc: Free web search with 10 engines (Bing/DuckDuckGo/SearXNG/AnySearch free + Exa/Tavily/Keenable/Perplexity/DeepSeek paid), automatic fallback chain, time-filtered advanced search, platform search (GitHub/Reddit), web page fetching, LRU caching, and a settings UI. No API keys required for basic use.

resources.name: dengpeihua/dsh-browser-use
resources.desc: Real browser tools for DeepSeek Harness: browse and extract web content, fill forms, manage multiple tabs, and execute multi-step tasks, with incremental DOM, session isolation, screenshots, action-result checks, and archived evidence recall.

resources.name: deqingLv/dsh-chrome-attach

resources.name: DightEndless/dsh-browser#packages/browser/bridge-browser
resources.desc: Open the extension side panel and it takes over the page you are browsing right now. On top of upstream it adds: hover, coordinate clicks, drag, batched action chains, whole-page screenshots, local file upload, image listing, and switching between several connected browsers. Pages reach the model as structured text with a numbered element list; actions wait for your approval and sensitive fields stay masked. Ships as the bridge plugin, with the extension in the same release. This project is a fork of omdsh-dev/dsh-browser: https://github.com/omdsh-dev/dsh-browser

resources.name: dougen/dsh-cdp
resources.desc: Drives a Chromium browser you are already running — Chrome, Edge, Brave, Vivaldi, Opera, Chromium, Arc or Thorium — over one long-lived CDP connection, so the remote-debugging approval is asked once instead of per command. Commands for tabs, navigation, JS evaluation, DOM snapshots, clicks, typing, screenshots and CSS/DOM/pixel assertions go over a loopback HTTP route that the agent calls with the shell tool it already has, so no new tools are registered, and the plugin registers its own usage skill with no runtime dependencies.

resources.name: drscrewdriver/dsh-browser-cdp
resources.desc: Visible agent browser over CDP: 30+ bcdp_* automation tools, realtime SSE watch panel with direct click/scroll/IME input, element picking quoted into the composer as balanced @"picks/*.json" references, and human-verification notices.

resources.name: drscrewdriver/dsh-union-search
resources.desc: Union web search for DSH (consolidated successor of DDDMUC/dsh-free-search, which it credits): 28 engines across three tiers — keyless free (Bing/DuckDuckGo/AnySearch/SearXNG multi-instance union, plus Exa/Tavily/Keenable/Firecrawl/Parallel keyless modes), paid-with-key (Zhihu/Perplexity/Serply/DeepSeek official/You.com/Baidu/Kimi/Aliyun/Doubao/Zhipu/Bocha/Metaso), and model built-in search (OpenAI/Gemini/Claude/Grok, explicit opt-in only) — with auto smart routing, per-engine enable/disable & fallback priority, parallel top-3 merge, multi_search, failure-aware fallback, a toggle to block the system built-in search, time filtering, platform search, web_fetch and a web settings UI. Experimental free advance_fetch: whole-page GFM-Markdown or CSS-selector/fields structured extraction with no API key and no per-call billing; fetch identity configurable (custom User-Agent, Referer, per-domain cookies attached only on domain match, never leaked across cross-domain redirects). Hosts 0.1.0-rc.2 through 0.2.1-rc.2 (17-tag exact engines.dsh enum; the rc.2 search-provider takeover goes through volatile config pinning after capability probing, never version branches). Paid engines need your own API keys (optional; free engines work keyless). npm: @drscrewdriver/dsh-union-search and bare dsh-union-search.

resources.name: EdwinDigital/dsh-web-search-microsoft-webiq
resources.desc: Microsoft Web IQ search provider for the built-in web_search tool, with a settings card for the API key, endpoint, language, region, passage length and SafeSearch.

resources.name: elves-ai/dsh-web-search-firecrawl
resources.desc: Firecrawl-backed web search provider for the built-in web_search tool, with a settings card for the API key and result limits.

resources.name: FleatherYu/dsh-webannotate
resources.desc: Annotates pages inside the built-in browser: click an element, write a comment, and send the batch to the conversation as one message, with a cropped screenshot per note where the element can be located.

resources.name: fno2010/dsh-web-search-ext
resources.desc: Multi-backend web_search provider (Exa + Firecrawl) for the built-in web_search tool, with automatic failover, per-backend 429 cooldowns, and key-free anonymous access.

resources.name: Geighlord007/qp-exa-dynamic

resources.name: godchen520/dsh-web-search-bing

resources.name: graydovee/dsh-browser#packages/browser/bridge-browser

This project is a fork of omdsh-dev/dsh-browser: https://github.com/omdsh-dev/dsh-browser

resources.name: GreyRaphael/dsh-web-fetch-moli

resources.name: iStarryDust/dsh-browser

resources.name: JayYuen666/dsh-scrapling

resources.name: jiewaigongxing/dsh-jiey-browser

resources.name: JohnXu22786/browser-automation

resources.name: KNLCXY/dsh-websift

resources.name: kyo615/dsh-browser-control

resources.name: lemoncat7/dsh-web-search

resources.name: Luca4Don3/dsh-web-search

resources.desc: Gives DSH the full 33-tool browser surface (ctx.browser seam -> a self-hosted headless Chromium over CDP: one 127.0.0.1 daemon with Bearer-token auth, request-path whitelist and WebSocket rewriting, no root/GUI/Electron needed), plus a web panel — a real page you can click, scroll and type in, operation/console/network logs with one-click cleanup, a customizable window (border color, transparency, glass, fit-to-picture with no black bars, top-inset and self-centering) and an adjustable page size (1920x1080 by default) — plus a collapsed pill that can be dragged to any spot on the screen (free position), a live view that auto-resumes when you switch back to the web tab, and a 1920px default max edge for the live frame — and two bundled skills (browser, browser-runtime) served through the plugin built-in skill provider, so the skill centre lists them as system-level by default without writing into $DSH_HOME/skills.

resources.name: lyp88997/dsh-moli-browser
resources.desc: Gives DSH the full 33-tool browser surface (ctx.browser seam -> a self-hosted headless moli browser over CDP: one 127.0.0.1 daemon with Bearer-token auth, request-path whitelist and WebSocket rewriting, no root/GUI/Electron needed; single-engine moli serve with auto LD_LIBRARY_PATH/FONTCONFIG_FILE injection and a persistent profile dir for logins), plus a web panel — a real page you can click, scroll and type in, operation/console/network logs with one-click cleanup, a customizable window (border color, transparency, glass, fit-to-picture with no black bars, top-inset and self-centering) and an adjustable page size (1920x1080 by default) — plus a collapsed pill that can be dragged to any spot on the screen (free position), a live view that auto-resumes when you switch back to the web tab, and a 1920px default max edge for the live frame — and two bundled skills (browser, browser-runtime) served through the plugin built-in skill provider, so the skill centre lists them as system-level by default without writing into $DSH_HOME/skills.

resources.name: Lzh3070/dsh-search-hub
resources.desc: Configurable web search hub for the built-in web_search tool: switch the active entry between DeepSeek official native search and Zhipu GLM web_search, with entry and credential management on a Settings page tab.

resources.name: magian1127/deepseek-harness-zhipu_plan_tools
resources.desc: Zhipu (GLM Coding Plan) web suite as native DSH providers and tools: rebinds the built-in web_search and web_fetch to Zhipu web search and Markdown page reading, optionally registers github_search_doc / github_get_repo_structure / github_read_file repo tools, and adds a settings card with toggles and a credential-ref field.

resources.name: maxiaovivi/dsh-cloak-browser
resources.desc: CloakBrowser-powered native browser tools with per-agent isolated sessions, bounded snapshots, ref-based interaction, screenshots, and safe routing.

resources.name: maxwell-feng/dsh-tinyfish-search
resources.desc: TinyFish-backed web search provider for the built-in web_search tool: each search is one GET to the TinyFish Search API, no model call.

resources.name: menotbobbybrown/dsh-plugin-browser
resources.desc: Native headless and visible Chromium browser automation agent for DeepSeek Harness with DOM tree extraction, screenshot capture, and built-in SSRF protection.

resources.name: MicroHEROX/dsh-exa-mcp
resources.desc: Mounts the hosted Exa search MCP endpoint (https://mcp.exa.ai/mcp) through the in-box @deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client bridge: web_search_exa and web_fetch_exa tools, anonymous on the free tier or with your own EXA_API_KEY.

resources.name: MicroHEROX/dsh-Kimi-WebBridge
resources.desc: Drive the user's real browser through the local Kimi WebBridge daemon: navigate, find-tab, snapshot, click, fill, evaluate, CDP, screenshot, network, upload, PDF export and tab-management tools that reuse existing login sessions.

resources.name: miqian-nomad/dsh-browser-playwright-codex
resources.desc: Browser automation for DSH: the agent fills in forms, scrapes lists and works across tabs in real pages, using the logins you already have. It drives its own visible window on your desktop — minimise it and it keeps working without stealing focus — and a sign-in, CAPTCHA or native dialog stops the run and hands the page back to you: it never confirms on your behalf. Login state persists (own profile plus session-cookie re-injection). 23 Playwright tools (20 always on, 3 gated and off by default), with a URL allowlist, dialog suspension and a CDP method allowlist that are mechanism-level and pinned by tests.

resources.name: moguiyu/dsh-tavily#packages/dsh-tavily
resources.desc: Tavily search, extract, map and crawl tools with multi-key rotation, failover on HTTP 401/429/432/433, and a load-balance mode that caps in-flight requests per Tavily account, plus a key and usage card on the Plugins page. The built-in web_search is never replaced.

resources.name: newbeebnb/hermes-web-mcp
resources.desc: Keyless web powers for any MCP client: web_search, JS-rendered web_extract over dual CDP Chrome with proxy failover, and 7 real-browser page_* tools in an isolated context.

resources.name: NingYuanLee/dsh-gui-auth-url
resources.desc: Agent tool that returns the running DSH Web GUI URL including its per-process launch token, so browser automation can open the GUI instead of getting a 401.

resources.name: Noemm/dsh-web-search-glm
resources.desc: Zhipu GLM web search provider: registers as glm on the ctx.web seam and runs the native web_search server tool through GLM's Anthropic-compatible API (Coding Plan billing).

resources.name: Nono-neko/dsh-browser
resources.desc: An AI-native browser workspace for DeepSeek Harness (DSH), combining multi-tab browsing, live page annotations, lightweight code editing, workspace previews, and Agent-assisted iteration across Web and Desktop.

resources.name: omdsh-dev/dsh-browser#packages/browser/bridge-browser
resources.desc: Chrome sidebar extension that lets DSH operate your browser directly, no vision capabilities required.

resources.name: OrderG-X/dsh-chrome-bridge#plugin
resources.desc: Controls the Chrome you are already logged into: the model clicks, types, fills in forms, reads pages, takes screenshots and downloads files in your real tabs, including inside same-origin iframes. Runs on macOS, Windows and Linux; needs Chrome 116+ and Node 18+. Works over native messaging and chrome.debugger instead of a listening port. Ships 12 browser_* tools and a cb CLI, dispatches real CDP input events, draws an on-page cursor that also appears in screenshots, and adds a toolbar panel with live status, the controlled tabs and a pause switch. browser_download saves a link, an element's target or a URL with the site's login cookies (following redirects, keeping the server's file name) to the Downloads folder or the session's working directory; cross-origin iframes are named in the snapshot but not entered. The native host and the MV3 extension travel inside this tarball: on first load the plugin copies them into place and writes the native-messaging registration itself, so there is no clone, no install.sh and no python3 - the one step left is adding the extension to Chrome: install DSH Bridge from the Chrome Web Store (https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/bippcbbbipppmhjkjomgdnjbooecbimo, no Developer mode), or load the bundled unpacked copy at chrome://extensions (the plugin opens that page and puts the folder on the clipboard for you). Until then the tools fail loudly with those steps. On Windows the registration goes into the registry (for Chrome and Edge) and the host talks over a named pipe. A daily CI run on GitHub's macOS, Windows and Linux machines installs the plugin, loads the extension into a real Chrome and reads a page through the browser_* tools.

resources.name: Oxygen640/dsh-plugin-nuaa-search
resources.desc: Zero-key web search provider for the built-in web_search tool: scrapes Bing China, 360 and SearXNG through a backend fallback chain and returns real URLs with snippets and publish dates. No API key and no settings card are required. SearXNG is used only when you set your own instance URL, and installing this plugin switches web_search to it and turns off the official DeepSeek search row.

resources.name: OzzyDeng-JunDeng/dsh-keyless-search
resources.desc: Registers a keyless search provider for the built-in web_search tool so it works without an API key, failing over between the documented no-key tiers of Tavily and Firecrawl; a TAVILY_API_KEY or FIRECRAWL_API_KEY is picked up automatically when present. Two Bing scrape backends are included but off by default.

resources.name: ParticleLight/dsh-browser-plus
resources.desc: Visible Electron browser for DSH with one shared BrowserWindow, isolated task views, explicit human-Agent handoff, snapshot-reference and native navigation tools, operation trails, demand-driven page thumbnails, keyed session recovery for reliable tab switching and closing, and site-scoped cookie clearing for login maintenance.

resources.name: PartinGQAQ/dsh-web-search-zhipu
resources.desc: GLM (Zhipu bigmodel) web search provider - routes ctx.web search through Zhipu's Anthropic-compatible endpoint with the native web_search server tool, billing your existing GLM quota or Coding Plan instead of the DeepSeek platform. Includes a translation layer for Zhipu's non-standard tool_result response layout.

resources.name: PILIHU2022/dsh-proxy-failover
resources.desc: Loopback relay as DSH's process-wide proxy route: web_fetch works under TUN fake-ip; a dead proxy gets same-request direct fallback, and a probe switches back.

resources.name: platonai/dsh-browser4
resources.desc: Installs the browser4-cli runtime and registers the Browser4 skills (browser4-cli, browser4-experience, browser4-plugin, scent-miner) into the DSH skill registry, providing an AI-native browser engine for autonomous agents, intelligent extraction, and large-scale web automation.

resources.name: PyModel/dsh-research-plugins#dsh-mcp-firecrawl
resources.desc: Firecrawl MCP bridge: hosted Firecrawl MCP server with keyless search, scrape and parse; an API key unlocks the full tool surface including crawl and map.

resources.name: PyModel/dsh-research-plugins#dsh-tavily
resources.desc: Tavily Search API as a web search provider (settings toggle with DeepSeek fallback, keyless search) plus a Tavily MCP bridge: keyless search and extract tools, crawl and map with an API key.

resources.name: qikairo7/dsh-web-search-fetch
resources.desc: Aggregated web_search and web_fetch providers for DeepSeek Harness, sitting behind the built-in tools. Search fans one query out to AnySearch, Zhipu and Zhihu concurrently, dedupes URLs, fuses ranks with Reciprocal Rank Fusion and optionally reranks through SiliconFlow. Fetch is URL-aware: static pages pass through the built-in HTTP fetcher, dynamic ones fan out to Firecrawl and AnySearch extract and pick one body by quality. One shared circuit breaker skips an engine for the day after a quota or 429 signal, and a settings card keeps each engine API key in the credential store without ever showing its value.

resources.name: qoqpqpq/dsh-web-preview
resources.desc: Embed a local web server in the DSH GUI through a remote-browser-safe same-origin proxy: any localhost port works, plus a Console/Network/Errors toolbox that captures what the iframe actually does.

resources.name: QuantumKuba/dsh-webstack
resources.desc: SearXNG search and Scrapling multi-tier fetch provider bundle for DeepSeek Harness ctx.web with SSRF protection and markdown conversion.

resources.name: regrevia/dsh-inner-browser-use
resources.desc: Drives the sidebar browser already open on the right: same cookies and same sign-in, a pointer you can watch, no second window.

resources.name: regrevia/Envoy#envoy-dsh
resources.desc: Paste a link; the agent reads it. Xiaohongshu, Douyin, Bilibili, WeChat, articles, PDFs and audio become citable Markdown for a wiki or knowledge base. On 60 turns with vs without: finishes reading 22% -> 92% (+70 points), times out 68% -> 0%, answer quotes a real source fact 23% -> 82% (the A/B is exploratory: different time caps, no human correctness review). On 123 live links 80% came back usable (93% of the pages that answered); an unreachable link reports in 26 s. Codex, Claude Code, DSH.

resources.name: renchengxiang/dsh-web-search-tavily
resources.desc: Tavily-backed search provider for native web_search, with a Settings → Plugins card for API key management and toggling DeepSeek replacement.

resources.name: ricardochen1996/dsh-browser-use
resources.desc: Browser provider for DeepSeek Harness: hand it a web task — open a page, click, type, fill a form, read what is on it — and it drives a real browser step by step, seeing an indexed table of what can be done on the current page instead of raw HTML or screenshots. Each step is one bundled-Jev decision rather than a full model turn (1.1 s median per step versus 2.8–3.6 s for chat-model turns in the repo benchmark), and the main conversation receives only the conclusion, so its context does not grow with the page. Targets come from the page it just read and a changed page is re-read rather than clicked blind, and it runs in the browser that Session owns, leaving your everyday Chrome untouched unless you switch to attach mode.

resources.name: robin421/dsh-html-inspector
resources.desc: Selection mode for HTML preview and browser tabs: click any element in a locally served demo page and its locator (selector, text, HTML snippet) is written into the chat input for precise AI editing.

resources.name: rogerdigital/dsh-searxng
resources.desc: SearXNG-backed web_search provider for the web seam: free, self-hosted, key-less metasearch through your own instance's JSON API, with a bundled loopback-only docker-compose example.

resources.name: SciF-Lin/dsh-browsercontrol-mcp
resources.desc: Mounts Microsoft's Playwright MCP through the official dsh-mcp-client so the agent gets its browser tools over stdio; the one-time CDP authorization is guided by a prompt note, a call guard and the /bw-setup command.

resources.name: Shad0wwa1ker/dsh-browser-mode
resources.desc: Adds a visible-browser Agent preset (persona and toolset for navigating, filling forms, clicking and screenshotting through the Playwright MCP toolset) plus a gate that refuses every browser tool call in other presets until the user approves that Session through the bundled browser_access tool. The bundle mounts the Playwright MCP provider itself, and both a settings page in the Plugins view and the browser_source tool switch the browser at runtime between Microsoft Edge (default), the Chromium shipped with Playwright, and a CDP endpoint. Requires keeping the shared browser-use registration row in the profile (one provider per process).

resources.name: ShallBay/dsh-bridge-browser
resources.desc: Lets DSH drive the Chrome tab you are already browsing, no vision needed: the page reaches the model as structured text with a numbered element list, and clicks, typing, key presses, scrolling, tab handling and navigation wait for your confirmation in the extension side panel while password and payment-card fields stay masked. Fifteen browser_* tools cover snapshot, text, tab list, open, follow, click, type, press, scroll, wait, navigate, back, close, forward and reload. A repack of the bridge plugin from omdsh-dev/dsh-browser, published to npm so it installs with dsh plugin add: the peer ranges the host checks are widened so the install is not refused as incompatible, the bundled extension also probes the DSH Desktop host port 19387 so no bridge address has to be typed, and a script copies the extension to a fixed directory so a profile switch or reinstall cannot break it. The prebuilt release tarball carries the plugin and the built MV3 extension. Upstream: https://github.com/omdsh-dev/dsh-browser.

resources.name: SheepofSheep/dsh-doyourweb
resources.desc: Reference logged-in Chrome/Edge tabs and authorized local HTML with @ for reading, batched actions, screenshots and WebMCP; collect draggable annotations in chat drafts. Upload exact user-supplied local file paths through hidden inputs, custom choosers or iframe selectors. Compact snapshot handles require reading fresh element refs; browser input shows private stop controls. Select running Windows apps, prefer a matching installed MCP or approve installation, then fall back to Cua Driver with text, hotkeys, paged controls and optional readback. Reuses a Windows helper; background input depends on the app.

resources.name: shinjiyu/dsh-plugin-search
resources.desc: Keep the built-in web_search tool without an official DeepSeek API key: disable web-search-deepseek and use Tavily keyless by default.

resources.name: sryimnoob123/dsh-web-search-ollama
resources.desc: Routes the DSH web_search tool through Ollama's web search API, reusing OLLAMA_API_KEY. No DeepSeek official key needed.

resources.name: Starp1ume/dsh-chat-mode
resources.desc: Adds a Chat/Work switch in the DSH Desktop titlebar: Chat embeds the DeepSeek web chat (chat.deepseek.com) in a native webview with no DSH API calls from the plugin and is the default on first launch, Work keeps the native agent UI, the page stays mounted across switches, and a confirm-first dialog can copy chat text into a work-mode draft without sending it.

resources.name: stormbuf/dsh-tavily-pool
resources.desc: Takes over the built-in web_search and web_fetch providers with Tavily, each behind its own toggle: a key pool with balance-aware scheduling that reads real credit balances from /usage, failover with hard exclusion of cooling or exhausted keys, and call history with a 14-day credit chart.

resources.name: stuarthu/dsh-chrome
resources.desc: Chrome side panel that embeds the dsh web UI and lets the agent read the current page, capture HTTP traffic, and drive the browser.

resources.name: Suguyun/dsh-insight
resources.desc: Chrome/Edge companion extension: select text on a page and click the badge to get a Markdown answer from dsh in the side panel or a floating card, with native multi-turn follow-ups; host-side tools let the agent read the current page, capture HTTP traffic and drive the browser. Fork of stuarthu/dsh-chrome (MIT): upstream supplied the bridge, browser tools and page injector, and this fork adds select-to-interpret, native multi-turn follow-up, in-panel settings and appearance options. It registers the same browser_* tool names as the upstream, so the two cannot be installed together.

resources.name: superagents-lab/dsh-s1
resources.desc: Native Search1API (s1) web research tools: search, news, page crawling, sitemap discovery, and trending topics as first-class s1_* tools, with a bundled s1 skill.

resources.name: SZMY-haruhi/dsh-tavily
resources.desc: Tavily web search for DSH with a settings toggle, keyless by default, and a connection test.

resources.name: T-Markus-Liang/dsh-webmcp
resources.desc: WebMCP bridge: your agent discovers & calls site tools exposed over the W3C WebMCP protocol via a built-in headless Chromium.

resources.name: Tabbit-Browser/dsh-tabbit
resources.desc: Gives DeepSeek Harness control of the Tabbit Browser: auto-loads the tabbit-browser skill on install, detects official Tabbit and Tabbit Browser releases (>= 1.9.0), checks the tabbit-cli persistent runtime, diagnoses the per-platform DSH sandbox mode needed to call the CLI, and downloads the region-matched official installer via a background job when no qualifying version is present.

resources.name: tao1020/dsh-chrome-use
resources.desc: Codex-style browser control: drives your own Chrome through a local bridge, so the model can read pages, click, fill inputs, scroll, take screenshots, and inspect console and network logs. Requires Chrome 120+ and loading the bundled extension unpacked at chrome://extensions, then pairing it with an 8-digit code.

resources.name: TC635807/better-crawler4agent
resources.desc: Registers a real-browser URL-to-text MCP server in a DSH profile: fetch_url and fetch_urls render JavaScript-heavy and anti-bot Chinese pages (Zhihu, CSDN, Juejin, cnblogs) and return clean article text as JSON with per-tier diagnostics, and crawler_status reports whether the browser is available. Needs a one-time Python dependency setup after install.

resources.name: Tencent/BrowserSkill#dsh-plugin-browserskill
resources.desc: BrowserSkill bridge for controlling visible Chrome and Edge Agent Windows from DeepSeek Harness, with native browser tools, accessibility and VOM observations, screenshots, owned multi-session control, and a live Web UI overlay.

resources.name: Tests4gptplay/dsh-dots
resources.desc: Open ChatGPT Dots in a native DSH page: Desktop preloads it in the background and keeps the same page alive across panel switches, with a theme-aware toolbar, reload and external-browser controls.

resources.name: TonyDua/dsh-web-search-exa
resources.desc: Zero-config Exa web search provider for the ctx.web seam: anonymous MCP fallback without an API key, plus keyed REST search.

resources.name: TZHR-invest/dsh-plugins#dsh-web-search-metaso
resources.desc: Metaso (秘塔AI搜索) search & reader providers for the web seam: web_search returns page summaries, web_fetch reads full-page markdown, multi-scope search (webpage/document/paper/image/video/podcast).

resources.name: umineko987/dsh-search-enhance
resources.desc: Grok-compatible web search with retained source pagination, Context7 and Exa documentation lookup, bounded page extraction, site mapping, offline research planning, and read-only diagnostics.

resources.name: uugvkbvkdjbsdbvwxxl/dsh-plugin-web-annotate
resources.desc: Annotate elements in the built-in browser — click one, write a comment, then send the whole batch to the session in one message so the model can find and edit the matching source.

resources.name: Viger1/dsh-pilot
resources.desc: Browser operation by accessibility refs: navigate, snapshot the page as a ref tree, act on elements, and wait for conditions; the origin policy follows the session approval stance and is enforced by request interception.

resources.name: Viger1/dsh-preview
resources.desc: Headless-browser verification tools so the agent opens the page it just built, reads the rendered DOM and computed styles, checks the console, and screenshots the result; ships a frontend-verify skill.

resources.name: vitas/dsh-web-search-openrouter
resources.desc: The built-in web_search bills a full model turn against DeepSeek's own endpoint; this runs it on an OpenRouter-compatible gateway instead, so search is billed where your chat already is, at the model and price you pick.

resources.name: WalterYOO/dsh-web-search-yuanbao
resources.desc: Tencent Yuanbao Search provider for the ctx.web seam: one direct Search API request per query returns portable title, URL, snippet and ISO-8601 date, with credentials resolved per search and no auxiliary model turn. Requires a Tencent Cloud WSA API key.

resources.name: wangtheme-coder/dsh-dragon-control
resources.desc: Windows x64 only, 0.5.4 preview: two scoped tools (dragon_browser and dragon_desktop) that drive a visible browser through the DOM or CDP and Windows apps through UI Automation, with per-origin and per-executable read/control scopes, batch steps, a physical-Esc emergency stop and a redacted action log. 0.5.4 only widens the DSH compatibility range to 0.2.0-rc.2 through 0.2.1.x, because 0.5.3 pinned it to an exact DSH version and was silently skipped on DSH Desktop 0.2.1. Two long-lived native processes remove the per-action process spawn, so a single key step takes about 0.7 s on the same machine; when another window steals the foreground the step is aborted instead of typing into the wrong place. The browser side ships its own Edge/Chrome launcher and CDP client, so it no longer needs another browser plugin or the Electron runtime. It is not an OS sandbox; logins, admin windows and secure desktops stay with the user.

resources.name: whiteS18/dsh-bing-search
resources.desc: Maintained fork of godchen520/dsh-web-search-bing adapted to DSH 0.1.5-rc.1: Bing-backed provider for the built-in web_search tool, scraping the public cn.bing.com HTML results page with no API key, reachable from mainland China, and keeping searches off the model's own search quota. Endpoint and result count configurable.

resources.name: wjj-8283/dsh-web-fetch-fakeip-plugin
resources.desc: Makes the built-in web_fetch tool work when Clash / mihomo runs in TUN mode with fake-ip: it lets the fake-ip address ranges (198.18.0.0/15, fdfe:dcba:9876::/64, 2001:2::/48) past the public-address check that otherwise rejects them, while loopback, private and link-local addresses stay blocked as before. Works with no proxy environment variables and no Clash changes.

resources.name: wqty123/dsh-browser
resources.desc: Shared real browser for DSH: a native Electron window the human can watch and take over, driven by the agent over CDP with 20 browser_* tools (open/snapshot/execute/fill/screenshot/download/auth), per-task session isolation, cookie persistence, CAPTCHA detection; self-hosts on plain dsh web without a desktop shell.

resources.name: xiaobai2017666/dsh-chrome-cdp
resources.desc: Chrome DevTools Protocol Plugin for DeepSeek Harness. Use chrome-remote-interface to connect to and control Chrome via CDP. The connection includes a graphical interface.

resources.name: xingzhen199186/dsh-jev-ultrafast
resources.desc: Drive a browser from one natural-language goal: a decision service picks the next operation and target from an indexed element table, so a DSH session spends one tool call instead of one turn per click.

resources.name: yangyunsong023/dsh-sxs-anti-bot-http
resources.desc: Anti-bot HTTP fetch tools hardened by SXS's production scraping stack (millions of requests/day): UA-pool rotation, retry with exponential backoff, anti-bot wall detection (captcha / verification challenges) and adaptive rate limiting — tools: sxs_fetch / sxs_fetch_json / sxs_rate_status.

resources.name: Yingmoon0715/yingmoon-plugins#plugins/rightbar-driver
resources.desc: Drives the DSH right-sidebar built-in browser from the agent side with 38 tools (open, navigate, read page text and interactive elements, accessibility tree, click, fill, select, check, key press, scroll, resize the browser frame by dragging its corner, with the page inside reflowing responsively so a narrowed frame shows the mobile layout, screenshot, full-page screenshot, PDF, markdown export, scrape to JSON, download, cookies, per-step operation records with replay and action whitelisting), serves the built-in web_search from a self-hosted SearXNG over an SSH tunnel with Tavily and a real-browser fallback, and registers a fetch provider that retries blocked GitHub URLs through measured mirrors and sniffs charset from the response header so GBK and GB2312 pages decode correctly.

resources.name: yinnho/aginxbrowser#dsh-aginxbrowser
resources.desc: Web access for DSH agents: fetch JS-rendered or protected pages as clean markdown, aggregated search across 14 engines, and stateful interactive sessions (click, type, scroll, eval, screenshot) against a hosted or self-hosted Rust browser engine. Every session returns a live view URL so a human can watch the agent browse and take over with the mouse.

resources.name: Yokhong/dsh_academic_web_proxy
resources.desc: Opens academic sites through institutional proxy rules and optionally renames eligible new PDFs using matched article metadata, with Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese and US English settings.

resources.name: YokiMohan/dsh-webview
resources.desc: Opens chat.deepseek.com inside DSH Desktop from a conversation view tab (next to Chat / Trajectory / Context, scoped to the open conversation) and from a left-rail globe button — all entries share one embedded page, so switching between them never reloads it. Keeps you signed in across restarts by replaying a localStorage plus readable-cookie snapshot before the page's own scripts run, strips only the Electron/<version> token from the user agent, and keeps navigation inside deepseek.com while sending everything else to the system browser. Pure client code: no host-side script, no file access, no credential service, no server route.

resources.name: youbaiyun/dsh-browser-crossplatform#bridge
resources.desc: Desktop half of the dsh browser extension: mounts a token-authenticated WebSocket bridge on the dsh webserver and exposes the browser_* tools that let the model read the tab you are on as text and act on it, with image recognition off until the user enables it.

resources.name: yugasun/dsh-plugins#dsh-web-search
resources.desc: Registers Baidu, Doubao, Tavily, and Exa backends into ctx.web so official web_search can use them, and routes web_fetch through Tavily Extract or Exa Contents when that backend is active.

resources.name: ywleeo/browser-mcp
resources.desc: Drives a real Chrome through a local MCP server so the agent can search Google/Bing/Sogou, read any page including JS-rendered and login-only content, automate click/scroll/type/key-press/select in a background window, and run platform search/detail/comment/download for Zhihu, Xiaohongshu, Douyin, Bilibili, X and Reddit; resumable comments, SHA-256-verified downloads, cookies never returned, localhost only.

resources.name: zaiwenJ/dsh-cdp-browser
resources.desc: CDP bridge to an already-running Chrome/Edge for DSH: screenshots, pixel assertions, DOM/CSS checks, and page JS evaluation over HTTP + WebSocket, with zero child processes, zero npm dependencies, and zero per-use approval.

resources.name: zengxiaolou/dsh-annotate-browser
resources.desc: Annotation browser in the DSH sidebar: a real Chrome page streamed over CDP with input forwarded, where picking an element or selecting text attaches its source location, component stack, styles and a crop to the chat input. Needs a local Chrome (on Windows set chromePath).

resources.name: zhiqiangme/dsh-plugins#dsh-tavily-search
resources.desc: Tavily backend for the built-in web search: an in-process endpoint at 127.0.0.1:8787/v1 turns its requests into Tavily searches; up to 10 API keys stay in the DSH credential store, rotate per request and switch on auth, rate-limit or quota errors; a settings card manages keys, runs a test search and points web search at the endpoint.

resources.name: zimai233/dsh-image-search
resources.desc: Multi-engine reverse image search aggregator: Google Lens, Baidu, Yandex, TinEye, SauceNAO, IQDB, Ascii2d.

resources.name: zimai233/dsh-video-downloader
resources.desc: Detect and download media from Bilibili/YouTube/Douyin/Xiaohongshu with quality and format analysis.

resources.name: zoe1nan/windowseat

resources.desc: Image previews for DSH sessions: read_image thumbnails plus user, assistant, Markdown and present images in a lightbox with zoom, rotate, pan, download, sidebar and native file actions.

resources.name: ankye/dsh-client-vision#tool-vision

resources.name: BW741/dsh-video-eyes

resources.name: CAI-MH/dsh-gpt-image

Needs Python 3.10+, ffmpeg and the vidlens package (pip install vidlens-mcp); a missing install comes back with the two ways to fix it instead of a bare ImportError.

resources.name: charovo0059/dsh-model-vision
resources.desc: Fills in the vision capability that DSH's "fetch models" step drops, so image-capable models stop being declared text-only, and marks them in the model name.

resources.name: Cheng-cheng9669/dsh-deepseek-vision
resources.desc: Reuses DeepSeek web's built-in vision mode for text-only models: the deepseek_vision tool drives the local deepseek-vision-cli browser automation (manual login helper, deep-think enabled, auto-closes browser) and returns image descriptions as text.

resources.name: ChordXD/dsh-image-compare
resources.desc: Adds a right-column panel that compares a set of images the user picks from the workspace — 1/2/3/4/6 per page, per-image zoom and pan, the zoom and viewed position of one image synced onto the whole set, and a reorderable filmstrip. The browser loads every image, so none of it reaches the model.

resources.name: Ck-epsilon/aura-vision

resources.name: ck99998888/dsh-video-reader
resources.desc: Reads a video or audio file into metadata, sampled stills, subtitles and a multilingual speech transcript with speaker labels, captures the live desktop as frames or a recording, and installs its ffmpeg/whisper.cpp/sherpa-onnx toolchain on first use with per-file sha256 checks; all processing stays local. Automatic toolchain install and desktop capture currently support Windows x64 only, so elsewhere ffmpeg and model paths must be set manually.

resources.name: ConsoleSun/Gemini-Eyes

resources.name: corrinehu/dsh-chat-imagine
resources.desc: Automatically generates and displays images in the DSH chat via API channels or local CLIs (mmx / codex / agy), and can also recognize images using the corresponding CLI.

resources.name: Daive1119/local-ocr
resources.desc: Registers one ocr tool for text-only models: it runs the offline script bundled in the repo over a single image or PDF and returns the recognized text — Windows native OCR first, then RapidOCR, then Tesseract. Recognition runs locally with no network request and no API key. Needs Python 3.11 on PATH plus pip install winocr pillow (winocr is the preferred engine; RapidOCR and Tesseract are fallbacks). Per-line results for images, per-page results for PDFs.

resources.name: dami9527/dsh-image-pathify
resources.desc: Lets text-only models handle pasted chat images, with a native vision experience, batch image viewing, and a built-in OpenAI-compatible analyze_image tool; vision-capable models are unaffected.

resources.name: DamonKoy/dsh-web-ui#dsh-tool-describe-image
resources.desc: Gives a text-only model image understanding via a vision-language model, exposed as a describe_image tool.

resources.name: Destinhue/dsh-video-vision
resources.desc: Four tools for reading a video as raw material rather than as something to watch: video_probe returns metadata and a reading plan without decoding frames; video_storyboard turns a window into one contact sheet plus a text index binding every cell to its timecode, cut count and frame time; video_zoom re-renders 1-9 cells from a short window at a larger scale; and video_read decodes only keyframes, OCRs each screen with the OCR engine Windows already ships, and returns an outline plus \[mm:ss] text -- the path for lectures, slide decks and screen recordings, where the words are the content. Cuts, dissolves and one-frame flashes are found in a single ffmpeg pass, cell numbers are burned in as bitmaps, and subtitle tracks are quoted on the cell their cue falls in. It also takes a B station link (bilibili.com/video/BV..., a bare BV id, an av id or a b23.tv short link) wherever it takes a file: by default a clip of up to 300 seconds is read from the CDN in place with nothing written to disk, while longer videos are downloaded once and cached; a probe on a link answers without downloading. Needs ffmpeg, uses ffprobe when present, and has no other runtime dependencies. Dialogue can come from a supplied SRT/WebVTT/JSON file, the embedded subtitle track, or a speech engine of your own through DSH_ASR_CMD; invented lines are filtered and the manifest reports how many. It is a wire-compatible reimplementation of SAOS-3624/dsh-video-storyboard: it registers the same video_probe / video_storyboard / video_zoom tool names, so the two cannot be enabled together.

resources.name: dickpy/dsh-imagegen
resources.desc: AI image generation for the DSH Web GUI: text-to-image and image-to-image through a configurable OpenAI-compatible endpoint (gpt-image-2 / gpt-image-1 / dall-e-3), with an api_url/api_key settings card and a sidebar split-pane generation studio.

resources.name: dingchenhui0618-arch/dsh-mask-pixel-lock
resources.desc: Prove that a local image edit left every pixel outside its mask untouched. Original, generated and mask PNGs go in; a greppable MASK_PIXEL_LOCK=PASS|FAIL|EMPTY verdict, a difference heatmap, per-channel statistics, a bounding box and the largest changed pixels come out, plus a self-contained HTML report and report.json with a SHA-256 file hash, a canonical protected-pixel digest and a proof digest binding both to the policy. Supports edit and lock mask polarities, a mask threshold, tolerance and alpha-ignoring; PNG color types 0/2/3/4/6, bit depths 1-16, all five filters and Adam7. Zero dependencies, local only — no model call, no network, no upload.

resources.name: dingchenhui0618-arch/dsh-vision-diff
resources.desc: Pixel-level screenshot diff for visual regression. Two local PNGs in; a machine-readable first line (PIXEL_CHANGED=true|false, greppable as an assertion), then the difference ratio, per-region bounding boxes, maximum channel delta and mean absolute error, plus a self-contained HTML comparison page. An ignore-region list with absolute or fractional coordinates excludes clocks, cursors and other per-render noise. It deliberately does no content recognition: it answers only "did this change", which is the part that can be made deterministic. Entirely local — no model call, no network, no upload.

resources.name: dmscode/dsh-cloudflare-media
resources.desc: Cloudflare Workers AI media tools for dsh - text-to-image, text-to-speech and speech-to-text. Per-model price badges, a native settings card, reuse of an existing Cloudflare account, and output files named after the model that made them.

resources.name: do-nothing/media-suite#media-runninghub
resources.desc: RunningHub media tools: synchronous image generation, plus a background workflow pool for image editing, video generation, voice cloning, digital humans, and music.

resources.name: drscrewdriver/dsh-media-lens
resources.desc: All-media (video/audio/image) sibling of liustack/modlens: turns local media into structured evidence (timeline / transcript / layout regions) injected into the conversation so text-only models can cite concrete frames, seconds and speakers — Evidence, not imagination. One failover chain per media, recorded hop-by-hop in meta.attempts (a fallback is never silent): host-registered multimodal models first, then a configured OpenAI-compatible endpoint (comma-separated multi-key rotation), then local ffmpeg frame-sampling / a local ASR CLI, degrading to metadata-only as a last resort. Absorbs modlens battle-tested rules — cooldown keyed only on auth/quota failures and softened to chain-tail (never dropped), redact-before-clip error text, magic-byte sniff that never trusts file extensions. Optional vision-bridge registers a media-lens wrapper into the host model selector so a pure-text model gains image/audio/video sight. Registering / authenticating multimodal models and true inline audio-video upload lean on two companion plugins, declared as optional peers (absence auto-degrades, never errors): dsh-thinking-levels fronts the model config / registration surface, dsh-llm-openai-completions takes over the OpenAI-compatible transport that serializes file blocks into video_url / input_audio. Privacy: media goes to remote providers by default; strictLocalOnly keeps content on-machine. Prerequisites not shipped with the package: ffmpeg/ffprobe on PATH (frame sampling / reencode / duration probe; degrades to metadata when missing) and a user-configured local ASR CLI for the audio fallback. Hosts 0.1.7 / 0.2.0 / 0.2.1 (6 rc, exact engines.dsh enum). npm: dsh-media-lens.

resources.name: DSH-Raising-Plan/dsh-video-storyboard-hp
resources.desc: High-performance fork of SAOS-3624/dsh-video-storyboard — install this or the upstream plugin, not both. Turns a video into addressable storyboard grids (numbered cells, a timestamp and transcript line per cell, audio envelope); needs Node 20+, ffmpeg/ffprobe on PATH, and a configured ASR endpoint when the file has no subtitle track.

resources.name: dttGitHu/dsh-video-android
resources.desc: Video studio for DeepSeek Harness on Android: storyboard editing, multi-provider image/video generation with automatic failover, FFmpeg MP4 export, prompt optimization, and a mobile-first workbench.

resources.name: Einskyle/dsh-llm-vision-bridge

resources.name: Elohia/dsh-plugin-image-input
resources.desc: Image-to-text input for the Web UI: paste or drag an image and it is transcribed into structured text and sent, giving text-only LLMs image-input takeover (OpenAI-compatible vision API).

resources.name: Elohia/dsh-plugin-mm-vision
resources.desc: Synesthesia Encoder for DSH: a vision model translates images into compact structured spatial text (canvas/elements/percentage coordinates), giving text-only LLMs pixel-level image understanding via the mm_vision tool.

resources.name: ethanweave/dsh-vision-better

resources.name: NormanFxxkingRockwell/dsh-auto-vision

resources.name: ns-zzj/dsh-hos-scrcpy

resources.name: ntesicn/dsh-screenshot-xn

resources.name: Okkay712/DSH-dseyes

resources.name: paicat1/dsh-screenshot

resources.name: PerryLink/dsh-draw

resources.name: ALittleLov/dsh-soundcheck
