resources.name: biliye/dsh-voice-call
resources.desc: Voice call assistant for the DSH desktop app and the Web GUI (the same plugin, only the profile name differs): a draggable floating call ball, browser-side VAD that sends each utterance after a pause, speech recognition through the local SenseVoice model already downloaded by the official voice-input plugin (no second model), FunASR HTTP or streaming, or a cloud-compatible API, MiniMax / MiMo-V2.5-TTS (director mode and voice clone) / OpenAI-compatible TTS replies, an optional wake-word mode with auto-sleep, and task dispatch to separate sessions with progress, stop, and spoken completion reports.

resources.name: CAOGGL/dsh-ding
resources.desc: Notifies you when a conversation finishes: plays a sound and shows a Windows notification when the agent goes idle (configurable sound file, volume, debounce/throttle).

resources.name: cccc12138/dsh-read-aloud
resources.desc: Adds a speaker button immediately right of the Like button on every finalized assistant reply; click it to hear the reply through the browser speech engine, and hover it for a speed and voice panel. Text is sent to an unofficial Edge TTS endpoint.

resources.name: chaoge762/dsh-ears-prosody
resources.desc: Local offline prosody analysis for DeepSeek Harness: reports how something was said — speed, pitch, pauses, energy — alongside the transcript.

resources.name: cloudoyx/any-audio
resources.desc: Five tools for agent-driven audio: anyaudio_music renders note-level scores offline from local SoundFont banks, anyaudio_sfx offers 52 SoundFont presets plus 15 procedural generators, anyaudio_tts speaks through Edge or MiMo, anyaudio_mix ducks narration under the bed and normalizes peak level, and anyaudio_sources manages the shared sound-font library.

resources.name: dingchenhui0618-arch/dsh-voice-memo
resources.desc: Dictation that ends up in the repository instead of the chat log: hold the button (or import a WAV), and the plugin archives voice-memos/<id>/ with audio.wav, a rendered waveform.png, memo.md (frontmatter, per-segment timestamps, ready-to-paste quote blocks) and meta.json. Audio is resampled to 16 kHz mono in the browser before it is sent. Transcription stays local — the harness speechToText service with silence-split windows, or a command worker such as faster-whisper — and when no engine is available the memo is still filed with an explicit status and reason rather than a fabricated transcript. Ships a conversation-view 口述 tab with click-to-seek playback and per-segment quote copy, three agent tools (voice_memo_save / voice_memo_list / voice_memo_read) and HTTP routes. Zero runtime dependencies, 52 node:test cases, real screenshots in docs/.

resources.name: do-nothing/media-suite#media-qwen
resources.desc: Qwen media tools: multimodal video and audio understanding, text-to-speech with preset voices, and scene audio generation, through Alibaba Cloud DashScope.

resources.name: duoduoqian708/dsh-voice-talk
resources.desc: Voice conversation mode for the DSH Web GUI: tap the mic to start a full-screen call, talk hands-free, and hear each reply read aloud as it streams. Bilingual (Chinese/English) UI, light and dark themes, adjustable speech rate, and switchable voices.

resources.name: fangqian616/dsh-say
resources.desc: Speaks your agent's reports in a voice you choose, compressing long reports before speaking. Character voices need no training - a 3-10 second reference clip clones one, and community-trained models work too - and no 6.4 GB GPT-SoVITS install: the plugin installs its own runtime and voice. An existing GPT-SoVITS can be used instead, and it is the same voice model.

resources.name: february2015/dsh-dingo
resources.desc: Sound reminders with one-click jump for concurrent sessions: the current session gets crisp dang/dang-dang tones, other sessions a soft ding/ding-ding plus a top-right card that jumps straight to the replying conversation.

resources.name: fenglin-ai/dsh-funasr-voice
resources.desc: Offline voice input for the DSH Web UI: mic to local FunASR (SenseVoiceSmall), one-click install, no cloud.

resources.name: fishcg/dsh-airpod-control
resources.desc: Requires macOS and AirPods with head tracking. Answer DSH permission prompts and questions with AirPods head gestures — nod to allow or confirm, shake to reject or shift the selected option — and install the companion macOS menu-bar app from a card inside the session.

resources.name: flashyiyi/dsh-voice-announcer
resources.desc: Voice announcements when a conversation ends (session title, round, outcome) plus live sentence-by-sentence reading of replies, via built-in edge-tts with zero third-party dependencies.

resources.name: FuzzySoul/dsh-chatvoice
resources.desc: Free voice closed loop for the Web UI: browser SpeechRecognition mic input with live interim results plus read-aloud speaker buttons and auto-read for assistant replies, zero configuration and no API key.

resources.name: FYZB2020/dsh-voice-doubao
resources.desc: Adds two Volcengine Doubao cloud speech recognizers to the DeepSeek Harness voice-input picker, optionally rewriting the transcript with an LLM.

resources.name: GooDAnDReaDY/dsh-tts
resources.desc: Speaks agent replies in the DeepSeek Harness web UI through a provider fallback chain (OpenAI, ElevenLabs, Google, Azure, Groq, Deepgram, OpenRouter, Edge, Piper, eSpeak), so a failing or rate-limited provider falls through to the next instead of going silent.

resources.name: GooDAnDReaDY/dsh-voice
resources.desc: Voice input for the web UI: dictation chunked by pauses and voice messages, each with its own provider fallback chain (Deepgram, Groq, HuggingFace, local whisper.cpp, or an OpenAI-compatible endpoint).

resources.name: haoku123/dsh-voice
resources.desc: Full-duplex voice mode for the Web UI: tap-to-toggle or hold-to-talk dictation (send key or Ctrl) with a live caption, host-side SenseVoice ASR via sherpa-onnx, sentence-by-sentence spoken replies, and speaking interrupts playback and the running turn (true barge-in). No API key.

resources.name: honwee/dsh-plugin-mynah
resources.desc: Give the agent a talking face: seven tools that drive a self-hosted Mynah realtime digital human — speak (queued or interrupting), play a gesture clip, interrupt, list live sessions and channels, check health, add text to its knowledge base.

resources.name: huguangyu666/dsh-plugin-notify
resources.desc: Notification outbox: agent proactively notifies via toast / Chinese TTS voice / sound effects (explosion, victory, alarm), 60s confirmation window voice-calls you back, volume boost, settings panel.

resources.name: huliux/dsh-asr-plugin
resources.desc: Local meeting transcription with microphone and system audio recording, speaker labels, and transcript export for DeepSeek Harness on Apple Silicon macOS.

resources.name: jerryqx/dsh-ximalaya
resources.desc: Listen to Ximalaya podcasts and audiobooks inside the DSH web UI: search albums, browse paginated tracks, and play through a now-playing bar (prev/play/next, seek, volume, rate). After QR login the "Mine" page lists your liked tracks (click to play), subscribed albums with latest-episode hints, and followed anchors with their public albums; the host relays audio streams with Range support and registers an ximalaya_play tool so the agent can search and play on request.

resources.name: Jesse-njx/dsh-voice
resources.desc: Voice notes in, spoken answers out: dictate audio that becomes user messages (transcribe), have the agent read replies aloud (speak), local-first under ~/.dsh/voice.

resources.name: jryang1997/dsh-hold-to-dictate
resources.desc: Hold-to-talk dictation in the composer that ships no recognizer of its own and reuses the speech service the official voice-input bundle already mounts - long-press the input box with mouse or touch, release to write the transcript into the draft, slide up to cancel, and it never sends.

resources.name: Jstn-1g/dsh-live-voice
resources.desc: Consent-bound one-turn voice preview for DSH Web with a credential-free local synthetic demo, optional Qwen Audio, exact Session isolation, and explicit transcript-to-draft handoff without automatic submission.

resources.name: junarch/voice_for_dsh#dsh-plugin-voice
resources.desc: Let DSH speak: every reply is rewritten into natural spoken language before being read aloud, with code, tables, and Markdown handled gracefully. Works out of the box with system TTS; Doubao (third-party API) adds dialects and expressive voices; the local Kokoro engine runs offline to keep content on your device. Supports both DSH desktop and dsh web. Optional session sounds tell you when the agent is working, finished, or waiting for your answer — with swappable built-in tones and support for your own audio.

resources.name: jypjypjypjyp/dsh-music-studio
resources.desc: Music composition inside the conversation: the model writes a score against a bundled composing skill, and a play_score tool renders it as an inline card with a piano roll, Web Audio playback and WAV/JSON export.

resources.name: KeinsteinNUS/dsh-speech-polish
resources.desc: Adds a terminology-aware correction pass to the built-in local speech-to-text: keeps DSH's own microphone and SenseVoice engine (audio never leaves the machine) and fixes homophones, domain terms and malformed numbers in the finished transcript.

resources.name: kekydream/dsh-meeting-room
resources.desc: Meeting notes for dsh: one meeting per conversation, transcribed and speaker-separated on the machine itself, with points, assignments, handwritten notes, reviews and monthly scores in the same panel. Exports SRT/Markdown/Word and packs a meeting into a portable zip another dsh can import; confirmed assignments go to DingTalk/WeCom in one click, following your robot settings. Recognition models are swappable (a stronger local model can be imported from a file), and cloud recognition is off by default with no request made before consent. Word export needs Python and python-docx; the first run downloads a recognition model (28 or 77 MB).

resources.name: kinglhy2006/dsh-voice-bridge
resources.desc: Hands-free voice for DSH on Windows: local wake word, local Chinese speech-to-text inserted and sent into the composer, and spoken replies that can be interrupted and resumed. Requires a one-time run of the bundled install.ps1 (Python speech dependencies plus microphone pick) and a SenseVoice model already downloaded by the DSH voice input (or placed under models/sensevoice-onnx).

resources.name: Laplace-bit/dsh-pianist
resources.desc: Piano performance plugin: ask the agent to play a piece and it renders on a Canvas2D grand piano with real Salamander Grand samples, an immersive stage, and an interactive 88-key keyboard.

resources.name: ldchaowin/dsh-plugin-notify-sound
resources.desc: Per-workspace completion ringtones plus attention sounds for approval, question, plan-review, goal-blocked, and task-failure events, with built-in synth, voice (TTS), and custom audio.

resources.name: lengmodkx/dsh-mimo-tts
resources.desc: MiMo voice for DeepSeek Harness — reads each finished answer aloud, turns composer dictation into text, and offers nine built-in voices plus a cloned-voice slot.

resources.name: lgquan/dsh-voco
resources.desc: Continuous voice conversations for DSH with hands-free listening, push-to-talk, speech recognition, TTS replies, and background Agent delegation.

resources.name: lihua12345670-jpg/dsh-bili-audio
resources.desc: Plays the audio of a Bilibili video from a floating bar in the DSH Web UI, with a queue, seek and speed controls, and a host-side reverse proxy for the CDN Referer check.

resources.name: ljz970803/dsh-voice-wake
resources.desc: Local wake-word voice input for DSH. Say the wake word, wait for the chime, then speak; text is sent to a DSH session. Audio is processed locally by default and not stored. Requires the DSH speech input service (speechToText) to be available.

resources.name: loyalchiiina/dsh-voice-alert
resources.desc: Plays a voice line or a sound when a turn finishes and a failure cue when a tool call or a turn errors — user aborts stay silent by default and subagent sessions are skipped, both configurable. Three alert modes: voice, effects, or off. Effects is the default and ships 20 built-in sounds (10 alert chimes + 10 nature), each assignable to the done, fail or approval event with per-row preview, so it needs no API key and no audio files; the voice route uses Volcengine TTS with cloned or preset voices, batch-imported voice IDs and fingerprint reuse that skips re-synthesis when text, voice and parameters are unchanged. A third approval slot exists but has no automatic trigger — it only plays when called manually. Playback goes through winmm/waveOut as-is, never changing the system volume or mute state, and the player is spawned detached so session teardown cannot silence it. Windows only.

resources.name: Making-acid/dsh-synthv-studio
resources.desc: Connects a local Synthesizer V Studio 2 Pro to the agent through its own Lua script API, with five tools for discovery, a persistent bridge, voice composition, note editing and DAW (VST3/ARA + MIDI) integration. Windows 10/11 only; requires Synthesizer V Studio 2 Pro 2.1.2+ with a project open.

resources.name: maoyuching/dsh-voice-chat
resources.desc: Doubao-style voice chat for DSH: press-and-hold mic in the composer converts speech to text and auto-sends, and AI replies are read aloud. Optional LLM condensing (long replies summarized into short spoken lines, following the current conversation model), TTS-friendly text cleaning, selectable Edge TTS voices, adjustable silence auto-stop, and settings embedded in DSH settings dialog.

resources.name: MaRi23333/dsh-fish-tts
resources.desc: Reads assistant replies aloud via Fish Audio API only (bring your own key): per-message read-aloud, auto-read toggle, and a settings page for model, voice reference_id, encrypted API key, and proxy.

resources.name: martindye/dsh-voice
resources.desc: Two-way voice for the DSH web app: dictate with the unified composer, hear replies with speaker buttons and auto-read, on any device. Needs DSH 0.1.7+, Node 22+, Python 3 with numpy and requests, a TTS model, and a microphone.

resources.name: mhlywxl/dsh-coding-sound
resources.desc: Generative background music while the model streams, plus completion, approval and attention chimes: hear whether the agent is thinking, still working, or waiting for you without watching the screen.

resources.name: naili0712/dsh-gsv-local
resources.desc: Local GPT-SoVITS voice for DeepSeek Harness: boots the engine with DSH and kills it on exit, speaks only the line marked for voice, and ships a default voice, so you only need to point runtimeDir at a local GPT-SoVITS install.

resources.name: NewDaNew/dsh-voice-input
resources.desc: Voice input for the web UI: a mic button in the composer that transcribes speech into the draft via the Web Speech API, with an optional auto-send toggle.

resources.name: Nothree-code/voco-input-sh
resources.desc: Voice input for the Web UI: a mic button that drives local VocoType offline speech recognition and auto-inserts recognized text into the composer (auto-deploy, dedupe, continuous dictation).

resources.name: nsswkj/dsh-typewriter-blip
resources.desc: Turns a streaming assistant reply into short blips, one per character at a configurable minimum spacing, for the reply text only, and keeps sounding when the window is minimized, covered, or in a background tab. Two built-in voices, or a custom one shaped by waveform, or loaded from an audio file.

resources.name: Nuoyi207/dsh-gptsovits-tts

resources.name: OMSociety/dsh-xiaoai-bridge

resources.name: PandaPolo/dsh-voice-call

resources.name: PensiveFei/dsh-voice-scribe
resources.desc: Voice input for the DSH web UI: tap or hold Alt to dictate into the composer. Local SenseVoice ASR by default — offline, zero config, zero key; auto-fallback to browser Web Speech, optional OpenAI-compatible ASR chain, polish through DSH-configured models, settings UI.

resources.name: PerryLink/dsh-talk
resources.desc: Voice I/O for DeepSeek Harness — speech-to-text and text-to-speech over the microphone and audio output.

resources.name: PolinniZhong/dsh-omi-voice
resources.desc: In-chat read-aloud for DeepSeek Harness: tap to read, pause and resume AI replies with natural Doubao TTS voices (BYOK), reading only the final answer with code, tables and diagrams filtered; local engine, plugin keeps no API key.

resources.name: ppy-web/dsh-plugin-xiaomi-mimo-tts
resources.desc: Provides Xiaomi MiMo, Doubao, and browser-local TTS for DSH, with automatic read-aloud, custom voices, UI sound effects, desktop pet integration, and QQBot integration.

resources.name: qishuilalala/dsh-voice-mode#dsh-voice-mode
resources.desc: Full-duplex voice mode for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI: toggle (2s-pause auto-send) or hold-to-talk dictation into an editable draft with zipformer2 streaming ASR, optional wake word; sentence-by-sentence Edge TTS read-aloud with live captions, and speaking interrupts playback and the running turn (true barge-in). On-device ASR, no API key.

resources.name: QT-Chen/dsh-mic-input
resources.desc: Microphone voice input for the composer: browser Web Speech API live transcription, dedupe/auto-continue, smart punctuation, language and auto-send settings.

resources.name: radres/dsh-plugin-call-me
resources.desc: Rings your phone over CallKit: call_me and text_me tools, plus optional turn-end and approval calls whose spoken answer is transcribed back into the session.

resources.name: regrevia/dsh-pet-voice#dsh-pet-voice

Reach the DeepSeek Harness running on your own computer over LAN, your own domain, or a relay server — and chat with the little whale working in your project to put it to work. Travelling without your laptop is no longer a problem.

resources.name: rootryanlau-art/dsh-voice-transcribe
resources.desc: Transcribe local audio and video files offline with a composer panel, a CLI, and an agent skill, powered by SenseVoice int8.

resources.name: scarf1985566475-cloud/dsh-voice
resources.desc: Local English-to-Chinese simultaneous interpretation: on-device Qwen3-ASR bilingual captions with automatic language detection, crash-safe meeting records with minutes, and Obsidian export.

Browser mic streams 16 kHz PCM to the bridge, which runs Alibaba Cloud DashScope ASR (paraformer-realtime-v2); interim text fills the draft at the cursor, silence auto-stop, optional auto-send.

resources.name: shimingming520/dsh-audiogen
resources.desc: AI audio generation for the DeepSeek Harness web GUI — multi-vendor TTS, music, sound effects and voice design with a sidebar panel, model comparison, resource library and Agent tools.

resources.name: STARDUSTLC666/dsh-voice

resources.name: supersyh-sss/dsh-voice-assistant
resources.desc: Voice assistant for dsh web: say the wake phrase (e.g. "小鲸") to activate hands-free dictation — what you say is transcribed and typed into the chat box automatically. resources.name: tangzheng202202/dsh-voice-live

resources.name: wangzhanchao883/dsh-hold-to-talk

Recognition runs fully offline (SenseVoice via sherpa-onnx, no API key, audio never leaves the machine).

resources.name: WayneYu430/dsh-voice-agent#voice-app
resources.desc: A conversational voice frontend Agent for dsh: speak naturally over ByteDance Duplex, delegate requests to background tasks, and hear their asynchronous results reported by voice.

resources.name: WizisCool/dsh-ears
resources.desc: Voice input plugin for DeepSeek Harness (dsh): a microphone button in the composer turns speech into a draft transcript, with a choice of speech-recognition backends, optional polish through dsh own LLM routes, and a native settings page.

resources.name: wwweljf/dsh-plugins#dsh-ding-sound
resources.desc: Turn-end notification sound for DSH: built-in internet meme voices (ni gan ma ai yo, ji ni tai mei, shen ying ge, etc.), Settings panel with preview/switch/random, custom audio folder support.

resources.name: WYR-233/dsh-multi-tts

resources.desc: Composer mic for the Web UI: tap-to-monitor live transcription and hold-to-talk, with host Edge TTS reply reading that streams while the model generates, echo-pause during reading, and tap-to-stop.

resources.name: ziyouti/dsh-read-aloud

Also adds a sound-wave play button to every reply, pause plus previous and next sentence, adjustable speed, and an auto-read toggle.

resources.name: zsenpro/creating#plugin

resources.name: 1741505640/capmap-skills#dsh-capmap-viz

resources.name: baosfeng/my-dsh-plugins#dsh-md-render

resources.name: PolinniZhong/dsh-knit
resources.desc: Puts the Markdown documents, source files, images and video that already exist anywhere in the session workspace into the DSH sidebar, ranked by relevance to the current conversation. The default lexical mode matches your recent messages against title, summary and body locally with IDF weighting (BM25) — no model calls, no network, nothing leaves the machine. The list comes from scanning the workspace rather than from a recent-files list, so restarting DSH or opening a new session does not empty it. Results are organised into a three-tier reading order (primary / supporting / related) with a verifiable reason on every row — which field matched, which document cites this one — and one click opens an in-place preview: Markdown as rendered text, relative-path images actually drawn, source code with the host's own syntax highlighting, video streamed over HTTP Range. The same Context Pack is exposed to the agent as a knit_docs tool. Later versions added read evidence and lifecycle tracking (attribution is frozen at the moment of reading), pin / exclude (exclusion applies before retrieval, and is undoable), relation evidence (references / imports / tests, with line numbers) and an incremental index reused across restarts. Since v0.23 there is also an optional hybrid mode: it is off by default and only runs once you configure an Ollama or OpenAI-compatible embedding provider yourself. When it runs, what leaves the machine is your query text plus each candidate file's title and summary — a Markdown summary is an excerpt of the body's first paragraph (at most 60 characters), a code file's summary is its workspace-relative directory, and an image or video contributes its file name; full bodies and absolute paths are not sent, and a loopback provider keeps everything on this machine. Since v0.24 it also associates uncommitted changes: a read-only git status (fixed argv, no shell, whitelisted child-process environment) combined with the same reference / import / test / mention evidence shows which files a change is likely to drag along, and it is off by default. The benefit of semantic retrieval still awaits a real-provider run, so no recall improvement is claimed.

resources.name: PolinniZhong/dsh-skill-intelligence
resources.desc: Read-only Skill inspector for DeepSeek Harness. It shows which Skills a conversation actually loaded — from observed loading evidence only — and which Skills the current environment can discover, and gives each Skill a detail page whose left column switches between the framework, the evidence, validation, evaluation, step evidence, run logic, the before/after of a modification when there is one, the definition facts and the raw SKILL.md. Declaration and run stay apart: the body is split into structure, declared workflow and progressive disclosure, the run logic is read from local receipts, and every declared step carries its own evidence — no observed evidence is reported as exactly that, not as executed or not executed, and the run's instruction hash sits beside the current definition as match, mismatch or unavailable. The evidence view gives each subject one of three states (declared, observed, unavailable), walks definition → load → use → outcome, names what each stage cannot reach, declines to attribute an outcome to the Skill, and can copy the snapshot out as byte-stable JSON. Validation checks the Agent Skills open standard and the platform profiles separately, each finding on a rule id and labelled standard compliance or platform compatibility. Evaluation keeps repeatable cases with the conditions each run was recorded under and the four stages of runtime evidence, comparing two runs of one case item by item without scoring them. The trigger boundary keeps should-trigger and should-not-trigger prompts, has you run them in a real new session, then records what was observed — whether a load record appeared and whether it was model-invoked or user-explicit; a typed /name is not a natural trigger, and an absent load record is reported as not observed, not as not triggered. The same projections are exposed to the agent as a read-only skill_review tool, which returns a structured review packet and says what it omitted when the packet will not fit whole. The inspector, the evidence chain and these reviews are computed on this machine from the definition and the session receipts; the Chinese reading version sends the body through the host's model when you ask for it, keeping code fences, paths and frontmatter verbatim and storing the result on this machine. A Skill can also be cloned into a local copy. It does not write back to the source Skill and does not run its scripts.

Requires DSH session format v4 (official DeepSeek Harness 0.1.7+): injected messages declare the producer-owned source kind plugin:cron.

resources.name: LittleBlackTong/dsh-plugin-heartbeat
resources.desc: Autonomic heartbeat for each root agent: silent pulses diff the session's todos, Agent Team board and goal against what the last pulse saw, and speak only on a signal — L1 report, L2 ask (ask_user_question), L4 escalate — never starting work. Each message carries a why-now line, an optional one-line physiology signature (time since your last message and how many times it has reached out today) and a compact task snapshot (800-char cap); a dedupe window, quiet hours, a daily budget, refractory/restart cooldowns and persisted vitals keep it quiet, while busy-safe followup injection never stacks. It shares one advisory speech floor with dsh-plugin-memory (~/.dsh/proactive-cooldown.json, 180 s) so the two never talk over each other, stays silent while a child subagent or teammate is still working, and surfaces a "subagents working · N" pill in the conversation header (polling pauses while the tab is hidden). v0.8 adds a diagnostics panel that explains recent quiet pulses and names the current speech-floor holder, plus panel controls for the arbitration window, presence suppression and the physiology line; its settings section carries a stroked heart mark (16×16, stroke 1.3, same spec as dsh-plugin-memory).

resources.name: Athosoo/dsh-git-graph-sidebar
resources.desc: Built on dsh-better-sidebar: the repository graph is a tab inside that sidebar, and this plugin still loads without it - install dsh-better-sidebar to see the tab. Forked from @linxin666/dsh-client-ui-git-graph 0.4.8, which linxin666 develops in zhu1090093659/dsh-web. Both halves own the /git route prefix, so this plugin and the upstream one cannot be installed at the same time - pick one. It discovers the Git repositories up to three levels below the workspace directory (at most 200, skipping node_modules, dist, build, out, coverage, target, vendor and dot-directories), lists them as a tree with branch, head, dirty-file and conflict counts, and draws the selected repository commit graph as an SVG lane canvas with curved cross-lane edges, merge diamonds, ref badges, row zoom and a pinned commit card. The tab writes to the repository: the Initialize Git repository button runs git init, and the conventions picker writes a GIT_CONVENTIONS.md document into the repository (or a workspace-wide .dsh/GIT_CONVENTIONS.md that nested repositories inherit) from six frameworks - Conventional Commits, GitHub Flow, Git Flow, Trunk-based, Conventional Branch, GitLab Flow. The host injects that document into the system prompt before every model step and flags the last 20 commit messages that break the rules the document states - subject length, type prefix, Chinese, English or mixed language, lowercase, trailing period and imperative mood, plus an optional AI attribution policy (ai: required / optional / forbidden) that reads the message trailers, so Assisted-by and Co-authored-by count as attribution while ai: forbidden only rejects AI-specific trailers. When the workspace document, the document of the checked repository and the documents of its parent directories disagree, the panel and the injected prompt both name every disagreement and the agent is told to ask before changing anything; one click then merges them into the workspace .dsh/GIT_CONVENTIONS.md, keeps the union of the machine-checkable rules, leaves a timestamped .bak copy of every rewritten file and replaces the absorbed repository documents with pointers to the workspace one. With the agentTool option enabled the host also registers a git_conventions tool, so a model step can run the same check and stage the same merge. The same graph can also open as a page in the main area of the conversation, opt-in and closable from the tab, beside the views the host ships. The composer branch chip, interactive graph dialog and worktree manager of the upstream plugin are carried over unchanged.

resources.name: aokamoaki/dsh-startup-guard

resources.name: AphyTOT/dsh-plugin-preflight

resources.name: Areium/dsh-fail-logger
resources.desc: Auto-log failed tool calls across native tools, PTC run_code, and inline invocations: dedup and count root causes into a skill so repeated mistakes fade.

resources.name: Arlenman/dsh-backup-sync
resources.desc: Backup, restore and machine-migration for DSH: packs skills (which live outside ~/.dsh, in ~/.agents/skills), plugin manifests, core config, memories, todos and optionally sessions into a tar.gz with a sha256 sidecar, then imports it on another machine as a three-way merge against a baseline, listing per-file differences instead of overwriting changes made there. Credentials never enter an archive (filename deny-list of 27 names plus 7 private-key suffixes plus a content gate, enforced again on the import side), every import writes a pre-restore snapshot first, and an archive can be uploaded to any WebDAV server and pulled back on the new machine. Also includes scheduled backups, a read-only viewer for individual files, and an in-panel cloud card; no npm runtime dependencies (packing uses the system tar).

resources.name: asdf17128/dsh-doctor

resources.name: asdf17128/dshp
resources.desc: Registers list_profiles and export_profile, so the agent can show what setups exist and hand back a whole profile — bundle order, plugin versions and patch — as one portable file to share. Read-only.

resources.name: ayahunter/dsh-plugin-clinic
resources.desc: Read-only health clinic for the installed DSH plugin set: loader health, dependency integrity, version compatibility, install-script risk, duplicates and patch integrity, delivered as a model tool, a Settings dashboard and JSON reports.

resources.name: b1inkie/dsh-rtk-bridge

resources.name: badai147/dsh-global-rules

resources.name: baosfeng/my-dsh-plugins#dsh-file-activity

resources.name: baosfeng/my-dsh-plugins#dsh-my-guardian
resources.desc: Plugin governance: new/updated plugins stage in a candidate area first, then hot-mount after startup — success promotes, failure auto-disables, repeated failures freeze, one-click safe mode, sidebar diagnostics panel (npm: dsh-my-guardian).

resources.name: baosfeng/my-dsh-plugins#dsh-my-observability
resources.desc: Observability and git tooling: a persistent cross-session event audit log with a query API, a resource watchdog sidebar panel, structured Conventional Commits and pre-commit incremental diff review (npm: dsh-my-observability).

resources.name: Bcy2020/dsh-cc-ecosystem
resources.desc: Load Claude Code assets into DSH at runtime — skills, slash commands, rules, permission rules (deny/ask/allow), subagents and hooks from .claude/, plus Claude Code plugins (plugin.json / marketplace / skills / agents / MCP), via an in-memory IR that keeps .claude as the source of truth and writes back only when you opt in. Also surfaces Claude Code auto-memory in the system prompt, read-only by default, with a write-back switch in the /cc-memory panel. Eight packages: one bundle that installs the whole set, plus the loader and six adapters (skills, permissions, agents, hooks, mcp, memory).

resources.name: better-er/dsh-write-create-only
resources.desc: Host-side guard that lets the write tool only create new files: when the target already exists it denies the call before execution and tells the model to use edit instead, applied to all sessions.

resources.name: better-er/dsh-write-rule-guard
resources.desc: Blocks edit/write writes that contain characters matching configurable regex rules, executed before the tool runs, with configurable messages and same-turn pwsh propagation; default rule matches full-width parentheses.

resources.name: BiBoyang/dsh-eval-harness
resources.desc: Evaluation harness for DSH plugins: YAML cases drive real headless agent runs, assert on tool calls, args, results and token usage, with a baseline gate for CI regression.

resources.name: biedongbin/dsh-claude-compat
resources.desc: Bridge Claude Code's .claude/ directories into DSH with zero migration: project and user-level skills, commands, rules (one system-reminder envelope), agent files, hooks (PreToolUse/PostToolUse/UserPromptSubmit/ SessionStart/SessionEnd) and .mcp.json servers, plus Claude Code plugin marketplaces. Ships /cc-plugin for full plugin/marketplace management (claude CLI first, self-implemented fallback), /cc-resume to list and import Claude Code sessions into DSH as native event-sourced logs, and /cc-export to write DSH skills back as Claude Code skills. Two-way Claude Code <-> DSH bridge, versioned and released as dsh-claude-compat.

resources.name: BigBlueBaby/codex2dsh
resources.desc: Migrate Codex (OpenAI Codex CLI / Desktop) MCP servers, skills, instructions, memory and session history into DeepSeek Harness with a visual panel or CLI, with dry-run previews and secrets migrated as-is.

resources.name: BotonJ/dsh-windtunnel
resources.desc: Contract regression harness for plugin authors: a scripted LLM adapter drives the real pipeline in isolated child processes with session-event assertions (load/contract/behavior/fault layers); zero API key, CI-ready.

resources.name: br1nosense/dsh-project-manager
resources.desc: Manage development projects from the DSH web UI in a draggable floating window: add/remove, one-click start/stop/restart, hot-reload restart on file changes, and real-time persistent logs.

resources.name: BrambleXu/dsh-prompt-profile
resources.desc: Reusable Markdown prompt profiles for DeepSeek Harness with per-turn model selection, argument substitution, and state restoration.

resources.name: bujue600-arch/dsh-testgen
resources.desc: Automated unit-test generation: a /testgen command and generate_tests tool that scaffold, run, and fix tests until they pass (LLM + offline template generators; vitest/jest/mocha/node:test).

resources.name: bushizhanghan/dsh-compaction-audit
resources.desc: Audit what context compaction actually lost. Reads the raw session event log and checks session-constraint survival (the standing instructions the user gave — do-not-X, must-Y, only-in-Z — and whether the summary still carries them; arXiv 2608.11242 measured ~17% survival across compactors), summary hallucination (paths, versions, ports and identifiers the summary invents that were never in the history it replaced), ghost references ("see above" pointing at removed text), token accounting (a summary nearly as large as what it claims to free), and unaccounted prunes. Four agent tools including a cross-session sweep that ranks conversations by how much compaction hurt them. Deterministic — no LLM, so a wrong answer is a rule bug with a name.

resources.name: bushizhanghan/dsh-context-budget
resources.desc: Audit how each turn's context budget is spent. Breaks down what a turn pays for AGENTS.md, the skill catalog, tool schemas and runtime context; flags repeated injection of unchanged content as pure waste; ranks skill-catalog bloat (with 60+ skills installed, how many tokens of descriptions does the model read every turn) and tool-schema inflation per plugin. Deterministic — no LLM, so a wrong answer is a rule bug with a name. Four tools including a cross-session sweep.

resources.name: bushizhanghan/dsh-openfoam-doctor
resources.desc: OpenFOAM case doctor for DeepSeek-Harness. Six agent tools: audit a case for 25 classes of silent failure (steadyState paired with timeStep writes, limiters set to 1 that let k/epsilon go negative, unbounded advection of transport scalars, nNonOrthogonalCorrectors 0 on a skewed mesh, loose solver tolerances, blockMesh vertex/block mismatch, stray time directories, purgeWrite 0); read any dictionary as JSON; survey a sweep of cases; run checkMesh/blockMesh/snappyHexMesh/foamRun inside WSL with log parsing; parse logs into the metrics that matter (aspect ratio, non-orthogonality, skewness, residual floor, fatal errors). Deterministic text analysis — no LLM — validated against a real 82k-cell street-canyon snappy case.

resources.name: bushizhanghan/dsh-profile-doctor
resources.desc: Read-only DSH profile doctor: the seven config-tree checks (config-clobber, dead-patch, tool-collision, plugin-not-mounted, plugin-stale, entry diff, explain) plus eight ecosystem checks learned from real failures — pnpm store version conflicts that break dsh plugin add, patch insert names node_modules cannot resolve, broken junctions, duplicate-capability plugins, orphan backup dirs, GitHub-source deps, npm publish-scope hints, and the minimumReleaseAgeExclude gap. Four agent tools; every finding carries its fix.

resources.name: bushizhanghan/dsh-publish-gate
resources.desc: For DSH plugin AUTHORS: run this after you finish writing a plugin and it audits the entire publish path, then hands you the exact GitHub + npm + market commands. Pre-publish gate for DSH plugins. Turns every silent failure in the publish path into a deterministic check: package.json completeness (missing exports\["."], files omitting lib/ so the tarball is empty, no "type": "module", client declared without a ./client export), UTF-8 BOM, JSON/YAML parse errors, cordis.patch.yml insert rows written at the wrong indent (the bug that makes a plugin install and never mount), insert name mismatches, missing entry exports, require() inside ESM, missing LICENSE or README install line, missing tests, unscoped npm names that return a 403 no granular token can diagnose, versions already on the registry, and missing GitHub repos. Six agent tools; every finding carries its fix. Read-only, no LLM.

resources.name: csuwzw/dsh-restart

Windows desktop app only.

resources.name: cyrusgogogo/dsh-codeeek
resources.desc: Read-only code-reading workspace with multi-repository projects, source-linked notes, code maps and Mermaid diagrams.

Lightweight: no parameters, no added context, buttons off by default.

resources.name: duyanta123/dsh-refactor-insight

resources.name: duyanta123/dsh-repo-scanner

resources.name: duyanta123/dsh-test-insight
resources.desc: Test-insight plugin that turns repository facts and change risk into evidence-backed test plans and isolated, reviewable test drafts.

resources.name: dxsdyhm/dsh-adb-logcat
resources.desc: Android Studio-style ADB logcat viewer with live filtering and level colors.

resources.name: EasonMWS/dsh-plugin-health
resources.desc: Multi-host compatibility matrix, official format-1 market index builder, and a read-only plugin_health tool for DeepSeek Harness plugins.

resources.name: edusrez/dsh-smart-restart
resources.desc: Wakes the main agent after any DSH restart so interrupted work resumes automatically — adds a restart tool and an optional canary that validates the boot and aborts with an alert before a broken restart.

resources.name: EIGHTfs/dsh-useful-tools

resources.name: elk-9527/dsh-vscode#dsh-door

resources.name: enterhalf/dsh-web-network-optimizer

resources.name: GaoHu1997/dsh-webdav
resources.desc: Keep a DSH profile identical across machines through any WebDAV server. The plugin collects the five parts that make up a setup — models (the llm-pi-ai line of cordis.patch.yml), defaults (the agent-default-model line), patch (the remaining loader lines), plugins (package.json dependencies plus dsh.profile.bundles) and dirs (extra absolute-path directories picked in the panel, carried whole and restored to the same path, add-only, at most 5 with 2000 files / 8 MiB each) — encrypts them on this machine with a passphrase (AES-256-GCM, PBKDF2-SHA256 at 600000 iterations) and uploads one ciphertext file to <address>/dsh-webdav/dsh-profile.prop, so the server only ever holds the sealed copy (the older dsh-profile.dshsync name is still read). Merging is per part and three-way against the last synced baseline; a conflict keeps the newer copy and archives the losing one under sync/ (latest 5 per tag), every overwrite is sealed beforehand, and deletions propagate except in the plugins part, on the first sync, and in the dirs part, where dropping a directory on one machine only stops syncing it there and never deletes its files. Uploads carry ETag If-Match and If-None-Match so a concurrent change is refused instead of being clobbered. Sync runs on demand or on a 3/15/30/60 minute timer from a settings panel, and an optional local forwarder (off by default, loopback-only) re-serves the same target with locally generated credentials, rewritten PROPFIND hrefs and .prop aliases for extensionless resources. The local state lives in <profileDir>/.dsh-webdav-sync/ (sync.json is written 0600 and holds the WebDAV password and the passphrase).

resources.desc: macOS only: holds a PreventUserIdleSystemSleep assertion (caffeinate -i -w <host pid>) while any DSH session runs, and releases it when the last one stops, so a long turn is not cut off by idle sleep. Termination is refused unless the target belongs to the DSH host tree, is re-sampled and re-checked immediately before the kill (creation time included), and contains no protected descendant, so an allowlisted PID cannot widen the kill scope.

resources.name: xxiaoxiong/dsh-prometheus
resources.desc: Exposes bounded Prometheus metrics for DSH sessions, agents, LLM calls, tools, approvals, subagents, and jobs, with a Grafana dashboard and a loopback-only endpoint by default.

resources.name: xyrrrrr-r/dsh-eval-control
resources.desc: Host-side DSH evaluation control plugin: injects one evaluation trial's variables, budget limits, session root and fork lineage into the agent process, routes its model calls through a host broker under a gateway lease, and writes a schema-versioned bundle descriptor for evidence attribution.

resources.name: yanzhaohui1999/dsh-perf-hud
resources.desc: Client-side performance HUD and always-on recorder for DeepSeek Harness: FPS and worst frame, long tasks with four-leg attribution (React fiber / subtree / DOM writes / scheduler), per-plugin callback rate and sync time, DOM growth and writers, JS heap, host event loop and link RTT, plus a night-watch recorder that keeps the worst stalls and exports incident packs for replay.

resources.name: yishuiliufang/dsh-relaunch
resources.desc: Restart button for the Harness desktop app: one sidebar entry that closes every Harness process and starts the application again, launched without a console window and without a close-confirmation dialog. Windows only.

resources.name: yizhixiaokong/dsh-compose-panel
resources.desc: Lists the Docker Compose projects of your DSH workspaces in the right sidebar, one group per project directory, with container status, project- and service-level up/stop/restart, and streamed per-service logs.

resources.name: yizhixiaokong/dsh-simple-restart
resources.desc: Adds a restart row to Settings → General that relaunches dsh web with the same invocation through a detached helper, refuses under a detected systemd supervisor unless allowRestart is true, and tests whether the listening port is free by connecting to it rather than binding it.

resources.name: yjh051108/dsh-routing-suite
resources.desc: One repository, three parts: a runtime injector for DSH plugin packages (inject, hot-reload, unload, promote a dev staging tool to the front, route self-heal, plus a settings-page plugin manager that lists, unloads and drags folders in to internalize), a task-aware reasoning-mode router agent preset (router-standard / router-spec / router-react), and a graded two-level task protocol whose six tools (commit_star, lock_stage, revise_do, edit_plan, mark_task, redteam_verdict) pin task state to disk. The injector implementation ships in-tree, so the install carries its own behaviour rather than a dependency list.

resources.name: yminghua/dsh-plugin-compare
resources.desc: Compares existing DSH sessions or runs controlled A/B trials between agent presets, showing aligned timelines, paired metric deltas, explicit success checks, and exportable reports.

resources.name: yongshuai0314/dsh-readcache
resources.desc: Version-token-validated in-process result cache for the DSH read tool: repeated reads of unchanged files skip file I/O and line rendering, with a readcache tool for stats and clearing.

resources.name: young-tim/dsh-profile-lab
resources.desc: Runs reproducible DSH profile and patch experiments with guided case authoring, assertions, Web comparison reports, recovery, and policy gates.

resources.name: YTxue/dsh-skill-manager-ytxue
resources.desc: Skill pool manager in the Settings sidebar: enable/disable, folder batch import with rename-conflict prompts, state-driven one-click DSH-spec check & auto-fix, system/project scope labels.

resources.name: YZz-S/dsh-update-checker
resources.desc: Conversation header badge showing the DeepSeek Harness version, checking npm for the latest release and prompting upgrades.

resources.name: zampie/request-frame-preview
resources.desc: Session-header button that previews and downloads the exact request frame DeepSeek Harness sends to the model: the full system prompt, the declared tools array, and the wire message array (system/user/assistant/tool-result) rebuilt from the session log via the same folds the agent loop reads.

resources.name: zebbkira/dsh-skills-mcp-manager
resources.desc: Skills & MCP manager in the DSH web settings: browse/enable/import/delete skills across project and user roots, and manage stdio/streamable-http MCP servers with a real connection (tools registered as mcp__<server>__<tool>, config in ~/.dsh/mcp.json).

resources.name: zehuan-huang/dsh-codex-runs
resources.desc: Read-only panel listing recent Codex CLI runs parsed from the local ~/.codex/sessions rollout files, showing status, duration, token usage and the last assistant message, with no bridge or extra daemon.

resources.name: zengxiaolou/dsh-device-mirror
resources.desc: Mirror an iOS Simulator or Android emulator into DSH as floating overlay windows, several at once, and tap, drag or type on the mirrored screen with the input forwarded back to the device.

resources.name: Zenjibad/dsh-plugin-toggle
resources.desc: Enables or disables DSH plugins from Settings → Plugins: each toggle stops or starts the plugin immediately without a restart and the change persists across restarts.

resources.name: zeroed-07/dsh-memory-guard
resources.desc: Local-only memory guard for the DeepSeek Harness: host heap and session-log monitoring, oversized tool-argument interception, and dry-run by default session vacuum.

resources.name: zhangj1164/dsh-mega-plugins#dsh-github-issue
resources.desc: GitHub issue service for DSH: turns a telemetry failure analysis into a uniform issue report, builds a pre-filled new-issue URL that is shortened when it would exceed a configured length budget, and rewrites a plain description into a structured issue with the deployment's model.

resources.name: zhangj1164/dsh-mega-plugins#dsh-telemetry
resources.desc: Local-only telemetry service for DSH plugins: records operation trails and error events into a storage-domain KV table, applies a configurable redaction rule set before the write and again when the analysis reads back a record stored before a rule existed, and groups one plugin's failures by feature-code anchor, reporting the window it read, the route each group ran on, and the attempts recorded after its last failure in write order.

resources.name: zhangzhenwen1/dsh-task-effort
resources.desc: Auto-adjust model reasoning effort per task (off/low/high/max): task classification, \[effort=...] markers, in-turn error escalation, DeepSeek peak-pricing-period capping with countdown notices, and manual-selection priority.

resources.name: ZhaoZiyangShaanxi/dsh-server-monitor
resources.desc: In-app server monitor window for DSH that tunnels to a lightweight agent on your server: memory, swap, load, disk, per-container usage and QQ status, cache purge and container restarts, plus an embedded VNC desktop for manual QQ QR login and sign-out. The agent ships in the repository (server/monitor.py) and you deploy it yourself.

resources.name: zhengjy01/dsh-start
resources.desc: One-click start/stop launcher for DSH Web on macOS — start (foreground/daemon), stop, status, duplicate-launch guard, auto browser open, plus a Dock-able DSH.app built by script.

resources.name: zhengjy01/dsh-updater
resources.desc: Track DeepSeek Harness's own releases and update in one click: reads the npm dist-tags and the GitHub changelog, shows every change between the running build and the target, grades the risk, then hands the install to a detached helper that backs the current install up with an atomic rename, runs npm, verifies what landed, relaunches, and rolls back when the new build does not come up.

resources.name: zhengqiuyang/dsh-janitor
resources.desc: Registers a janitor_scan tool that returns a deterministic, reviewable cleanup plan for session debris (plan docs, scratch scripts) with per-file verdicts and evidence; scan-only, never deletes.

resources.name: Zhenyu98/dsh-context-doctor
resources.desc: Context injection audit: token costs of instruction chains / skill catalogs / tool schemas, duplicate and conflict detection.

resources.name: Zhr65/dsh-skill-auditor#npm
resources.desc: Audits the skills and plugins you already installed: routes a task description to the tool it needs, flags version drift against the npm registry and runtime faults from host logs, and reports which of a plugin's tools you never call. Registers 9 tools: can, find, status, recommend, check, scan, probe, run and suggest. Runs on Python 3.8+ with no third-party dependencies. Registered tool ids all carry the skill_audit_ prefix, for example skill_audit_can and skill_audit_find.

resources.name: zhxnix/dsh-wx-preview
resources.desc: Preview native WeChat Mini Programs in the DSH sidebar with a local runtime and WXML source locations.

resources.name: zhz8888/dsh-android-emulator-helper
resources.desc: Android development toolchain inside DeepSeek Harness: 23 android_* tools that find the SDK, create and manage AVDs, start and stop emulators, scaffold a Kotlin/Compose project, build and run it with Gradle, then install, launch, screenshot, tail logcat and drive the UI. A settings page holds the SDK, emulator, API-level, build and output parameters.

resources.name: zhz8888/dsh-ios-simulator-helper
resources.desc: The official ZCode ios-simulator plugin ported to native DSH tools: the original 20 ios_* tools keep their names and arguments, plus ios_shutdown_simulator, covering Xcode project discovery and scaffolding, simulator boot and shutdown, build, install, launch and terminate, screenshots, log reading, an in-app settings page and optional idb UI automation. macOS only.

resources.name: zirscard/dsh-macos-signfix
resources.desc: Registers one doc_ocr_sign_fix tool for DeepSeek Harness: on macOS it diagnoses and repairs the condition where the bundled Python cannot load native extensions (onnxruntime, cv2, pypdfium2) because of the hardened runtime and library validation, by injecting the disable-library-validation entitlement and re-signing the interpreter, then verifying the imports. Operations are idempotent and the original binary is backed up first. It never touches the enclosing application bundle.

resources.name: zjukop/dsh-time-machine
resources.desc: Creates local, content-addressed workspace checkpoints with diff previews and two-phase restore confirmation.

resources.name: ZK-Andy/dsh-continual-evolve
resources.desc: Continual self-evolution: versioned, auditable, rollback-safe harness state (prompts, memory, skills, subagent specs) refined from session trajectories, with review gates and hot-reloaded skills.

resources.name: Zlyraz/dsh-ballute
resources.desc: Crash protection for installed plugins: crash cards with one-click disable, static pre-flight inspection, black-box crash telemetry, and a safe-mode rescue profile for a broken UI.

resources.name: zoahdev/dsh-quality-score
resources.desc: Plugin quality scorecard for DeepSeek Harness: 0-100 with grade, 6 components, fix suggestions per deduction, batch leaderboard - CLI plus an agent-callable quality_score tool.

resources.name: zoahdev/dsh-unplug
resources.desc: Plug/unplug any DeepSeek Harness plugin cleanly — list every mounted layer (bundles + patch rows), remove with full cleanup, disable/enable without deleting, and audit for orphaned/dangling state. CLI + agent-callable unplug tool. Read-only by default; destructive operations require explicit confirmation.

resources.name: zqh260619/dsh-dupguard
resources.desc: Stops a streaming model call when the same string repeats ten times in a row (threshold configurable), keeps the partial answer as a normal assistant message, and shows a stop notice with the workspace, session name and the repeated string. Repeat counts can vary by unit length through a piecewise table or a JavaScript module, and code regions (fenced, inline, indented) use a relaxed threshold.

resources.name: zudazhuang/dsh-update-safe
resources.desc: Source-install updater for DeepSeek Harness: checks the official GitHub release and the npm record, builds the target tag in an isolated directory, smoke-starts it, then switches through a supervisor process with rollback, with scheduled checks and a daily idle-only install window. Source install only (macOS/Linux); requires Node.js 22.19+, pnpm and Git.

resources.name: zzy6-a/dsh-upgrade-guard
resources.desc: Audits installed plugin compatibility after a DeepSeek Harness upgrade, repairs or disables incompatible plugins, and keeps an out-of-host supervisor that rescues boot failures or rolls back to the previous host snapshot.

resources.name: 030611/dsh-telemetry-redactor
resources.desc: Redacts supported secret patterns from the session-telemetry/record export copy before configured telemetry backends receive it.

resources.name: 030611/dsh-verification-receipt
resources.desc: Writes local JSONL summaries of per-turn tool counts and coarse verification signals without storing prompts, tool arguments, or result text.

resources.name: 030611/qiushi-dsh-evidence-audit
resources.desc: Appends local hash-chained JSONL receipts for tool results and session events without storing prompts, tool arguments, result text, or raw session IDs.

resources.name: 0QwQ0/dsh-ui-auth
resources.desc: Authentication gateway for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI: the login gate covers pages, /api, /plugins and WebSocket upgrades; PBKDF2 password hashing with per-user salts, HttpOnly SameSite session cookies named per DSH_HOME and IP-based login lockout; invite-code registration; two-factor login with TOTP or passkeys (WebAuthn: several keys per account, phone enrolment by QR, username-less sign-in, and a step-up before any login factor is added or removed); a user-management settings panel (users edit their own profile and manage their own TOTP and passkeys, admins add or remove users, reset passwords, manage invites and clear the passkeys of a lost device); per-user model and API-key configuration whose private entries are encrypted with a key derived from the login password and stay unreadable by any admin, with admin sharing to selected users (usable, balance visible, key never shown, revocation immediate) and unconfigured users blocked rather than falling back to the deployment configuration; per-user isolation on the REST and list APIs and per-frame ownership filtering on the WebSocket mux; session persistence across restarts; a JSONL audit log; and a fail-closed gateway. Requires the DSH 0.2.0 line (the 0.1.1-rc.2 transport line was removed in 0.7.0); passkey login needs a localhost or HTTPS origin because browsers require a secure context.

resources.name: 173787247/dsh-repeat-stop
resources.desc: Hard-stop consecutive identical tool calls after a configurable streak so the agent cannot spin in place.

resources.name: 173787247/dsh-tool-budget
resources.desc: Hard-stops further tool calls after a configurable per-session budget is reached.

resources.name: 7gzgn/dsh-leak-guard
resources.desc: Pre-publish credential audit: walks a directory tree and flags API keys, tokens, private keys, database connection strings and hard-coded passwords before you commit, publish or ship. Zero dependencies, fully offline, findings are redacted to the first six characters.

resources.name: 7starsseeker/dsh-jev-guard
resources.desc: Pre-execution safety valve for DSH that judges with TypeSafe Jev: it hooks tools/pre-execute and decides every bash/pwsh call by first applying offline static rules, then by asking the Jev model — the System One model from TypeSafe, which returns a structured decision instead of prose — one yes-no question ("will this command irreversibly delete or overwrite real data?"), turning the answer into allow, revise, block or escalate; revise hands the model a safer rewrite, escalate offers a one-shot human token; exhausted credit or a missing API key degrades loudly instead of failing silent, and a missing key is requested in the conversation itself (guard key set, read from stdin); every verdict is appended to a shared audit log and the text people read is bilingual zh-CN/en.

resources.name: 863683348/dsh-gov
resources.desc: Agent governance suite: policy-based tool gating (allow/deny/ask with wildcards and priorities), a structured JSONL audit trail, and per-agent token quotas against the host token meter, with state under $DSH_HOME/gov.

resources.name: 863683348/dsh-plugin-gate
resources.desc: Installation safety gate for DSH plugins: antivirus-style scan of install scripts, permissions, secrets and network callbacks on local directories or npm tarballs, returning a BLOCK/WARN/PASS verdict before "dsh plugin add".

resources.name: 940842546/dsh-permissions
resources.desc: Claude Code-style permission rules engine: hard/deny/ask/allow tiers with a hard tier above full access, workspace-scoped rules, wildcard path protection, and a visual staged editor; rules persist in settings.yaml.

resources.name: a903067276-rgb/dsh-perm-guard
resources.desc: Auto-approval permission guard: a middle tier between workspace-write and danger-full-access — auto-allows safe operations inside trust directories, always asks a human for destructive ones, with 11 per-category switches and an audit trail.

resources.name: aa2246740/dsh-auto-review
resources.desc: Adds Auto-review and Approve for me modes for DSH tool calls.

resources.name: accpowered/dsh-auto-review
resources.desc: LLM approval answerer for sandbox escalations beyond workspace-write: a deterministic regex filter first, then a clean-context reviewer model; humans are asked only when it is unsure. Requires the bundled core patches.

resources.name: accpowered/dsh-credential-manager
resources.desc: Named user credentials the model uses by reference: values are entered on a Settings → Credentials page and injected into each shell execution as DSH_CM_* variables instead of being printed into the transcript, with credential_read as the documented last resort.

resources.name: ADWMC/helm-d#helmd
resources.desc: Security-analysis plugin for DeepSeek Harness: 33 tools spanning six security domains, evidence/reporting and toolbox, plus the case lifecycle, routing and tool ledger; a session-bound case workflow with an evidence chain, E-id validation and reproducible findings; 362 on-demand references; three hot-swappable persona profiles; and a four-tab workbench (armor / case / intercept / about) with case-state recovery after context compaction.

resources.name: AHIOSUZ/dsh-workspace-tools
resources.desc: Applies per-workspace default Agent and permission presets to new root sessions automatically (Settings - Workspace defaults), using only official extension points.

resources.name: AhYi8/dsh-agent-recycle-guard
resources.desc: Rewrites agent-issued delete commands (PowerShell Remove-Item and its aliases, Bash rm/unlink/rmdir, CMD del/erase/rd/rmdir) into system recycle-bin operations on Windows, Linux and macOS, best-effort checks scripts for the same operations before they run, and keeps no permanent-delete fallback.

resources.name: alaxrpg/dsh-llm-approve-for-me
resources.desc: Uses an isolated LLM review to approve or reject DSH sandbox permission requests.

resources.name: almazom/dsh-almazom-approve-escalate
resources.desc: One-click Approve & escalate on the approval card: answers the pending request and switches the live session to a permission preset.

resources.name: Alnita-M/dsh-Almost_Full_Access
resources.desc: Permission mode between workspace-write and full access: shell commands are checked by deterministic rules and a subagent review; irreversible or system-level actions require explicit approval.

resources.name: amwangfan/dsh-privacy-guard
resources.desc: Control panel for a local credential-redaction gateway in DeepSeek Harness: gateway and model health, audit metrics, a dry-run leak tester, an exemption whitelist, encrypted key management, credential-protected model entries and deployment controls.

resources.name: Anguis-L/dsh-plugin-trust-audit
resources.desc: Read-only audit of whether a DSH plugin's HTTP routes are actually fenced, discovering the registered routes by reading plugin code and probing loopback only.

resources.name: AntaresCorn/dsh-auto-reviewer
resources.desc: Codex-style auto-review permission mode: adds an auto-review preset that auto-approves safe sandbox escalations, asks on risky or ambiguous ones, and rejects critical unconfirmed operations.

resources.name: apex-mochen/dsh-sandbox-arg-guard
resources.desc: Keeps a redundant sandbox-escalation argument from failing a tool call. Escalating tools (pwsh, bash, write, edit) advertise the full sandbox_permissions enum, but DSH only accepts a level strictly wider than the one already in effect — a check its own source calls 'deliberately not a schema constraint'. A model that reflexively passes the argument therefore picks the level it is already at and the call dies before running with 'sandbox escalation to "workspace-write" is not strictly wider than this call's current "workspace-write" mode', costing some models a whole turn of retries. This plugin registers one tools/execute waterfall listener and, only on that documented rejection and only when the arguments really carried an escalation field, re-issues the identical call once without it. Safe by DSH's own documentation: the rejection precedes any execution ('nothing has run'), and the corrected call cannot match again, so the retry is loop-free. Reproduced and verified end to end — before: isError true, the command never ran; after: the command's real output, isError false, one tool/call and one tool/result. Zero dependencies.

resources.name: ArisuYuuko/dsh-approval-explainer
resources.desc: Writes a model-generated annotation into every DSH escalation approval prompt — what the command does, what the model intends, how risky it is and why, and what each choice means — and keeps a searchable history of past approvals at /dsh-approval/history, with a diagnostics page at /dsh-approval/diag.

resources.name: arrow949/dsh-turn-approval
resources.desc: Turn-scoped “Allow for this task” approvals: automatically allow matching danger-full-access escalations only for the current task, then expire.

resources.name: AskTheWay/dsh-jev-interceptor
resources.desc: Classifies pending tool calls with Jev (TypeSafe AI's non-generative decision model) on tools/pre-execute — confident high-risk calls are denied, ambiguous ones escalated to approval — and auto-approves clearly-granted reversible calls on approval/request behind argument-evidence gating. Also subclasses the session-reference resolver so snapshots keep Jev-scored messages instead of dropping oldest-first. Degrades to stock behavior on any provider failure; shadow mode with a /jev-stats command; TypeSafe or OpenRouter endpoints; 64 tests.

resources.name: ateen18/dsh-plugin-security-review
resources.desc: Pre-install static security review and runtime guard for dsh plugins: deobfuscation decoding, supply-chain checks, web one-click review/install/uninstall, and optional runtime tool-call guard.

resources.name: azazo1/dsh-write-protect
resources.desc: Keep declared workspace subpaths (e.g. .git) read-only, honor a read-only rules file at the workspace root, grant extra writable roots under workspace-write, and let the model request session-scoped write access; enforced for sandboxed CLI commands and the write/edit tools.

resources.name: Baiiduu/dsh-semgrep-sast#semgrep-sast
resources.desc: Workspace-scoped Semgrep SAST tool for DeepSeek Harness with a managed Windows x64 runtime, structured bounded findings, cancellation and timeout controls, and user-approved sandbox escalation. Installs from npm as @aaub-software/dsh-semgrep-sast.

resources.name: BaqiF2/dsh-plugin-precheck
resources.desc: Pre-install compatibility gate for DSH plugins: locks the resolved version, checks peer/engines declarations, dry-installs into an isolated DSH_HOME and boots it with a timeout, blocks on any failure, and restores the profile if the real install fails. Optionally intercepts dsh-market install/update clicks. Compatible with DeepSeek Harness 0.2.x.

resources.name: BeyondandSharp/dsh-plugin-notoken
resources.desc: \!WARNING\! this removes the authentication step !WARNING! Exchanges the process launch token for the browser-session cookie, so a first visit needs no ?token=... in the URL.

resources.name: bigclawd/dsh-security-guard
resources.desc: Static and runtime security guard for dsh: rule-based scans for malicious code, prompt injection and token waste, runtime interception of dangerous tool calls, /scan command, plugin_scan tool, web panel, and allowlist.

resources.name: BotonJ/dsh-plugin-sentinel
resources.desc: Static pre-install security auditor for plugin bundles: lifecycle scripts, dynamic execution, credential-exfiltration combos, and patch-layer hazards, with zero dependencies and in-memory tar parsing.

resources.name: BuvkB/dsh-vaultwarden
resources.desc: Reads and writes a self-hosted Bitwarden/Vaultwarden vault from any session: eleven bitwarden_* tools, real-time WebSocket sync with a polling fallback, a settings panel with readonly, ask and auto write modes, and optional local masking — with masking on, passwords surface as stable placeholders unless revealed one field at a time, and on-disk session logs are swept for bitwarden secrets. Masking and log sweeping are separate switches.

resources.name: cdxiaodong/dsh-guardian
resources.desc: Agent security guardrail: intercepts and audits every tool call, requiring human confirmation on sensitive operations.

resources.name: ChaoJie0/dsh-tm-guard
resources.desc: Zero-intervention permission gate for DeepSeek Harness (DSH) agents on macOS — active on install. Writes that can be undone via a local git baseline or macOS Time Machine are auto-approved and automatically snapshotted; network access, package installs, process/system management, and reads of sensitive credential paths are blocked; every decision is audited — the audit log keeps everything by default, with optional automatic cleanup of the oldest records.

resources.name: ChenLaoshiYF/dsh-mcpguard
resources.desc: Scans skills and MCP configs for prompt injection, homoglyphs, hidden Unicode, dangerous shell, and credential leaks.

resources.name: chjy090/dsh-pairing-gate
resources.desc: Device-pairing gateway for DeepSeek Harness: by default it listens on 127.0.0.1:3443 over plain HTTP and reverse-proxies the local dsh at http://127.0.0.1:3080, so a loopback-only install works without any certificate. Production, cross-machine and app pairing require TLS: configure tlsCert/tlsKey plus an https publicUrl (self-signed is fine). A fronting Caddy/Nginx may terminate the public TLS, but the gate itself still needs tlsCert/tlsKey and the proxy must connect back over HTTPS. Features TOTP-authorised QR device pairing, username/password login, sliding sessions with absolute caps, device revocation, a WebUI admin panel and audit log, and a reverse proxy with WebSocket tunnelling. First-run setup is completed in the WebUI wizard. Tests: 171/171 unit tests, 29-step e2e.

resources.name: COH2357/dsh-workspace-api-key
resources.desc: Binds a separate DeepSeek API key to each workspace or session, warns when an effective key is stale or belongs to another provider, and never swaps a key on its own.

resources.name: couldbeme/dsh-write-gate
resources.desc: Commitment write-gate: operator-authored rules enforced before a tool call runs — a deterministic guard tier plus an LLM-judge tier, fail-closed by default, every block written to a contradictions log.

resources.name: cuddly-guacamole/dsh-auto-approval-llm
resources.desc: LLM-assisted auto approval with countdown fallback for the Auto permission preset: static rules, risk tiers, breaker and file audit.

resources.name: DamonKoy/dsh-plugins#dsh-approve-for-me

resources.name: DamonKoy/dsh-plugins#dsh-secret-redactor

resources.name: Darren-Tang/dsh-provenance
resources.desc: Pre-install supply-chain checks for DeepSeek Harness plugins: verify the tarball you are about to install matches the source you read, before any code runs.

resources.name: devil233-ui/dsh-auto-review-default
resources.desc: Puts sessions into the built-in Auto review permission preset: new sessions at creation, existing root sessions when they are restored.

resources.name: DevilSpiderX/dsh-workspace-only-plugin
resources.desc: Restrict the file access of agents in any sandbox mode (read-only / workspace-write / danger-full-access / auto) to the session workspace, and ask the user to rule on cross-border access. Each session can also use the gear selection box next to the composer to relax the cross-border gate to 「 read-only outside workspace 」 or 「 fully release 」.

resources.name: dingchenhui0618-arch/dsh-warden
resources.desc: Adversarial review gate for tool calls. resources.name: DingZhiQi5596/dsh-plugin-guard
resources.desc: DSH Desktop plugin safety guard: self-repairs plugin load crashes and runs 8 core safety checks (2 optional: deep-config & smoke), prompting you when a plugin changes. Non-commercial source-available.

resources.name: DNAlec/dsh-auto-approve
resources.desc: Automatic approval and review for tool calls that need approval: keyword buckets match red lines without context, then a judge model classifies what was requested and sends it to allow, reject or a human according to the matching row and risk level; a judgment that never ran always goes to a human, and rejections tell the model why.

resources.name: drscrewdriver/dsh-perm-gate
resources.desc: Shipped with cc-safety-net-style mechanical safety-net rules appended; supports both no-model and model-assisted security review, in modes such as 自动审查 (auto-review) and 机械直通 (mechanical pass-through). P0–P4 deterministic-first permission gate with permissive tier, learning sedimentation and approval-history UI; hard-deny credentials and protected paths, auto-allow internal read-only tools.

resources.name: DSH-Raising-Plan/dsh-agent-gate

resources.name: fb0sh/dsh-pentester

resources.name: Jiao-XXX/dsh-auto-approve

resources.name: JimChen-g/dsh-action-outbox

resources.name: jkt-check/dsh-secret-scrub

resources.name: JohnXu22786/safety-net
resources.desc: Destructive-command interception gate for dsh: parses shell semantics, judges risk against 41 built-in rules, and holds irreversible rm -rf, git reset --hard, and git push --force style commands at a confirmation gate.

resources.name: JohnXu22786/secret-guard
resources.desc: Blocks agents from reading or writing sensitive files (.env, credentials, key material), masks leaked secret-shaped values in tool results, keeps an audit journal, and exposes safe sg_* inspection tools that never print raw values.

resources.name: Jueze-2019/dsh-redteam-mode#packages/redteam-bundle
resources.desc: Red-team engagement mode: send one target organization name; a planner session runs five execution roles (recon, asset triage, vulnerability discovery, exploitation, internal pivot) with configurable concurrency; preflight checks skills/resources; scoring uses four stages (recon, internet, boundary, internal) with server-side caps and privilege-wins dedup; findings stay in a local SQLite fact base. resources.name: JW53222/faultseed#dsh

resources.name: jypjypjypjyp/dsh-guardrail
resources.desc: String-matches tool-call input arguments, blocks dangerous tool calls (deny) or allows them with an injected warning (warn), and ships a full rules-management panel.

resources.name: kenryu42/cc-safety-net
resources.desc: Pre-execution guard that blocks destructive Git and filesystem commands and access to secrets such as SSH keys and .env files before a tool call runs.

resources.name: kipozannaki/DSH-PDR-Plugin

Attribution is best-effort, not a guarantee - uncovered calls fall back to host, never to another plugin. Also adds a pre-install health card (capability surface, red-line combinations, PASS/WARN/BLOCK), boundary judging, opt-in pre-execution blocking with a credential-exfil rule, update diff with a trial install in an isolated child process, SARIF/CSV audit export, and multi-source aggregation. Local-only storage, no telemetry; the optional webhook is off by default.

resources.name: KongFangXun/sofagent#cordis-plugin-sofagent-audit
resources.desc: Commit-time audit harness for AI coding agents: 28 git-diff rules (secrets, out-of-scope edits, prompt injection), HMAC-signed audit trail, snapshot rollback, and a full MCP toolset. Installable via dsh plugin add.

resources.name: L-ingqin12/dsh-redaction#dsh-plugin-content-policy
resources.desc: Preventive content policy for tool results: rewrites matched text, and drops or truncates whole fields by path before a result is normalised, rendered or persisted, so an unreviewed payload never enters it. Ships inert with no built-in category or domain blocklist.

resources.name: L-ingqin12/dsh-redaction#dsh-plugin-redact
resources.desc: In-place redaction and row-level rollback for session logs, preserving the seq-equals-row-index invariant that makes deleting a middle row corrupt the entire log. Originals are copied to a quarantine sibling before any write, and the reader's own semantics are replayed as a pre-write gate.

resources.name: laoer/dsh-whitelist-auto-approval

Unlike plugins that answer the approval for you or that widen the writable set for every command, the grant here is scoped to the matched command, the workspace stays writable, and other commands keep their exact behaviour. Matching is by write footprint rather than by command string, so write-neutral pipes like 2>&1 | tail -N still match; rules are edited from a Settings page or the Plugins row. Overlays cover Seatbelt, bubblewrap and Landlock; on Windows the writable root is swapped for $HOME instead.

resources.name: LAwLi3tCoding/dsh-approval-review
resources.desc: Adds an "approve for me" access mode whose approval requests are answered by an independent reviewer model instead of a person: the reviewer can read the workspace read-only, a reviewer that cannot run hands the request back to the human, and every decision is recorded with its rationale in an Approvals tab.

resources.name: Ledas-as/-deep-seek-harness

resources.name: Luawig/dsh-cloudflare-access

resources.name: Phocinae/dsh-evidence

resources.name: Shaky77/KISS_Law-DSH

resources.name: Shaky77/weiwen-law-dsh
