resources.desc: Fine grained per tool permission rules for DSH at the tools/pre-execute gate, deny and ask lists in Claude Code rule syntax (Bash(rm -rf:*), Read(_secrets_), mcp__server__tool), works standalone without migrating.

resources.name: slow-stack/euthyna
resources.desc: Security-audit facts AI coding agents cannot compute, plus a verdict gate: euthyna history attributes deleted lines to commits and flags those from security fixes (--origins finds the first introducer), euthyna coverage reports which changed symbols no test ever invoked, and euthyna gate checks each finding against six gates, downgrading any without evidence to an observation.

resources.name: slywalker2006/dsh-passwords
resources.desc: Turns DeepSeek Harness into a server-grade multi-tenant platform: remote access + auto HTTPS, subuser permissions & token/daily quotas, sandbox enforcement, encrypted auth & audit log.

resources.name: SodaZheng/dsh-totp
resources.desc: TOTP-only access control for personal DeepSeek Harness Web instances, with in-app QR enrollment, single-use recovery codes, live protection controls and lock-all revocation of page access.

resources.name: STARDUSTLC666/dsh-code-security
resources.desc: Deterministic code security review: 40+ rules, secret entropy detection, staged-diff review, SARIF export, baseline acceptance, SBOM-lite dependency inventory and health self-check. A step-by-step first-run guide (4 steps) now opens inside its settings panel.

resources.name: SteelUnion/dsh-confirm-gate
resources.desc: Counts persistent operations within a turn and escalates on the total: a reminder first, then an explicit stop instruction, then an approval prompt. Reads the session sandbox mode on every call, and stays silent under read-only and workspace-write.

resources.name: sujingkpo/dsh-auto-pass
resources.desc: A continuation of simon300000/dsh-auto: the Auto Approve permission preset for the DSH Web UI reviews each approval with one single-shot model call instead of a reviewer subagent, auto-approves only the actions that pass and hands the rest to human approval, and remembers confirmed decisions as project- and global-scope allow/deny lists, with an approval timeline in the right sidebar.

resources.name: SummerSec/dsh-web-auth
resources.desc: Transport-level authentication gate for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI with server-side sessions, HttpOnly cookies, IP-based login throttling, and an scrypt password CLI.

resources.name: tancheng33/dsh-code-runtime-container
resources.desc: Container-isolated backend for the ctx.codeRuntime seam: each Code Mode program runs in a fresh container with no network, a read-only rootfs, dropped capabilities, and kernel-enforced memory, CPU and pid ceilings.

resources.name: tancheng33/dsh-credentials-vault
resources.desc: HashiCorp Vault backend for the credential seam: KV v2/v1, AppRole machine auth, per-operation reads so rotation needs no restart, and compare-and-swap writes.

resources.name: tancheng33/dsh-egress-guard
resources.desc: Runtime security gate on the tool pipeline: denies calls naming hosts outside an egress allowlist, redacts credentials from results at the canonical value rather than only the rendered content, and appends every decision to a JSONL audit log; ships in monitor-only mode.

resources.name: taxueseek/dsh-plugin-guard
resources.desc: Static-only plugin gate and clinic for DSH: audit before install, hash-and-capability lock after install, local fingerprint peer search over GitHub topic:dsh-plugin, and mechanical detox. Never executes the target plugin.

resources.name: TecFancy/dsh-auth-gate
resources.desc: Login gate for the dsh web surface: password or shared-token authentication, session cookies, rate limiting, and a user-management CLI (dsh.bundle manifest since 0.4.1, one-command dsh plugin add mounting).

resources.name: TGYD-helige/dsh-plugins#dsh-policy
resources.desc: Apply configurable allow, deny, and approval rules to dsh tool calls, including shell command patterns.

resources.name: toby-bridges/api-relay-audit
resources.desc: Runs local security audits of AI API relays and LLM proxies from DeepSeek Harness, producing Markdown reports for prompt injection, model substitution signals, tool-call rewriting, error leakage, stream integrity, and profile-gated Web3 risks.

resources.name: Top-Celestial-Company-Ltd/dsh-dros-vajraclaw
resources.desc: Local tool-call failsafe for DSH: blocks a fixed list of high-risk shell patterns and credential-file reads before execution, with a per-session hash-linked JSONL audit log, and an optional external Gateway for centralized policy.

resources.name: truelove-dreamer/dsh-plugin-vetting
resources.desc: Vets third-party plugins before you trust them: static scan for malicious patterns (exfiltration, credential access, obfuscation, persistence) and over-privileged path use, transitive-dependency coverage, official-package hash baseline for supply-chain tamper detection, and an optional plugin-tool call gate.

resources.name: uwu9039/dsh-airbag
resources.desc: Blocks API keys pasted into the composer or written by tools, logs leak events, and scans the workspace for exposed secrets.

resources.name: Vladimir-Kryshchenko/dsh-route-fence-linter
resources.desc: Audits every plugin HTTP route in a profile for a browser-trust fence: plugin routes win the web server's longest-prefix match ahead of the /api gateway, so they never see its trust check and must pin the Host to loopback themselves. Grades PASS/WARN/FAIL per route and fails a fence that compares Origin to Host without pinning it (bypassable by DNS rebinding). Ships as a CLI for CI and a route_fence_scan tool.

resources.name: we39/dsh-jumpserver
resources.desc: Query and manage JumpServer through conversation: assets, users, accounts, permissions, sessions, command audit logs, command filters, and RBAC roles, authenticated with an AccessKeyID/AccessKeySecret pair (HTTP Signature).

resources.name: weibaohui/user-management
resources.desc: Login gate for the dsh web UI: unauthenticated visitors get a login/register page and the first registrant becomes admin; includes user and role management plus login and access audit logs.

resources.name: weisofns/dsh-security-guard
resources.desc: DSH plugin security guard: 28-rule static scanner, risk scoring, whitelist/blacklist policy, local web dashboard and in-DSH risk popups.

resources.name: wulun811/dsh-plugin-vet
resources.desc: Plugin trust pipeline for DeepSeek Harness: deterministic static scan with verdicts, opt-in runtime guard with honeypot lures, agent audit-protocol skill, and a browser shield status light. Alarm-only, never an enforcer.

resources.name: wxlei2004/dsh-plugins#dsh-re-workbench
resources.desc: Reverse-engineering workbench: bridges a local IDA Pro into DeepSeek Harness through @deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client, exposing the ida-pro-mcp toolset (decompile, xref, rename, comment) as mcp__ida__* tools. Auto-selects idalib headless mode (analyses a binary in-process, no IDA GUI) or GUI mode (connects to the IDA plugin RPC on port 13337). Adds re_check, re_open and re_status; the bundled MCP server is a zero-dependency stdio proxy usable from any MCP client.

resources.name: WyattJHayes/dsh-feishu-channel
resources.desc: Security-focused Feishu (Lark) channel for DeepSeek Harness: allowlisted remote-agent access with workspace-scoped paths, symlink checks, risk-based approvals, session isolation, redacted logs, and bounded message queues.

resources.name: WYR-233/dsh-whale-guard
resources.desc: Safety guard that makes self-killing commands impossible: a safe_kill tool that always excludes the caller and every ancestor process, a bash pre-execute check for pkill self-matches, sudo -S stdin grabs, rm -rf / and similar patterns, and an extensible rule library with block / warn / hint severities.

resources.name: wzn16/dsh-fs-allowlist
resources.desc: Approval-free writes into whitelisted directories — wraps the filesystem fence for write/edit tools and auto-answers bash sandbox escalations that touch whitelisted paths, with a settings GUI.

resources.name: x2802490130-prog/dsh-lan-pass
resources.desc: A LAN password gate for the Web UI: phones and tablets on the same network log in with a shared key and see the same sessions in real time, with a built-in randomUUID polyfill for plain-HTTP origins.

resources.name: xbzbing/dsh-auth-gateway
resources.desc: Password + TOTP two-factor authentication gateway for the dsh web UI: every HTTP request and WebSocket upgrade is refused until login, with per-source lockout, global rate limits and one-time backup codes.

resources.name: xevil3301/dsh-chatlock
resources.desc: Session password lock plus an encrypted directory vault for DeepSeek Harness.

resources.name: xgone/dsh-remote
resources.desc: Secure remote access for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI: a login gate, MFA/TOTP, signed session cookies, optional admin/user/guest roles, in-browser workspace selection, and allowlisted remote file previews.

resources.name: XiaoSHang05/dsh-rice-guard
resources.desc: Watches a turn's thinking and output streams and cancels the turn when the model starts repeating itself. Four detectors: a verbatim cycle, a counting loop whose lines differ only by a number, repeated lines separated by other text, and a user-supplied phrase list. A catch raises a manual-dismiss alarm card in the global overlay with an optional tone, and a Monitor tab holds the switches, thresholds and hit history. Detection is local string comparison with no model calls, so it costs no tokens.

resources.name: xiezouqu12/dsh-info-records
resources.desc: Encrypted local credential vault for DeepSeek Harness: sidebar record management, an info_records tool for pre-sign-in lookups, opt-in chat capture, per-record manual-only mode, and AES-256-GCM storage protected by Windows DPAPI, the macOS Keychain, or the Linux Secret Service.

resources.name: xlennart/dsh-auto-review-jev
resources.desc: DeepSeek Harness approval guardian: a reviewer model decides permission requests before they reach you, with a System One decision-API backend (TypeSafe Jev, SiliconFlow, self-hosted Laya), a configurable low-confidence policy and an allow-rule whitelist.

resources.name: xtd1145/dsh-full-access-switch
resources.desc: One-time Full access switch for DeepSeek Harness: new sessions (workspaces and conversations) start with danger-full-access and skip the per-session Full access confirmation; installable as a dsh bundle or via patch scripts.

resources.name: yanli-nyan/dsh-recycle-bin
resources.desc: Sends file deletions to the Windows Recycle Bin, lists and restores them by id, and blocks permanent shell deletes.

resources.name: Yazzyk/dsh-file-shield
resources.desc: Blocks an agent from reading, searching, writing, or editing chosen files and directories, keeping their contents out of the conversation — including sensitive-word files whose text can make later provider requests fail with a 400. Rules are picked from a file/directory browser on the plugin page.

resources.name: ylwl1997/noatmark-dsh-plugin
resources.desc: Text hygiene as a dsh plugin: sanitize untrusted text, scan invisible characters, clean LLM formatting, and escape CSV formula injection.

resources.name: youchen-yc/dsh-security-judge
resources.desc: Code security defense review judge for DeepSeek Harness: detects sessions that are writing code, reviews them against the Code Security Defense Architecture Rules, recommends which security architectures the program needs (one or several), checks conflicts between them, teaches the session AI after repeated failures, and teaches the session AI after repeated failures; once you grant it review authority in its panel, it gates task completion until the review passes (without that authorization it only observes).

resources.name: yuloop/dsh-secret-vault
resources.desc: Hands secrets and PII to the agent without them entering its context, with checksum-validated extraction and masked content classification.

resources.name: Yuuz12/dsh-webui-auth
resources.desc: WebUI authentication enforced at the HTTP/transport layer: four-layer login gate (resources, plugin bundles, /api, WebSocket), server-side sessions with HttpOnly cookies.

resources.name: yyfdfsyyf-source/dsh-hard-gate
resources.desc: An independent permission gate above the built-in sandbox. It blocks writes outside the workspace and to protected paths even under danger-full-access, refuses whole-file overwrites without a complete fresh read, and keeps ZIP restore points plus Recycle Bin copies before destructive actions.

resources.name: yzxxy010/dsh-workspace-write-plus
resources.desc: Adds a workspace-write++ permission that keeps file tools inside the workspace while skipping the Windows process sandbox for wildcard-allowlisted executables such as Git Bash.

resources.name: ZeroClave/zeroclave-dsh-privacy
resources.desc: Detect and redact sensitive message text before sending it to models, with local regex, browser BERT, or ZeroClave API detection and manual review.

resources.name: zhang8019/dsh-permission-matrix
resources.desc: Turns DSH permissions into 9 selectable presets (3 sandbox modes x 4 approval tiers), with rule plus LLM risk classification across four risk levels, password-gated approval for high-risk operations, and a JSONL audit log.

resources.name: zhangmiao03/cloakpack#dsh-cloak
resources.desc: Context firewall for DeepSeek Harness: credentials in successful plain-text tool results become opaque ⟦cloak:category:n⟧ placeholders before they reach the model, with originals kept only in a process-memory, agent-scoped vault. 36 built-in signature families (shared with the cloakpack git pre-push guard), key-name rules for unknown formats, custom regex rules, dry-run mode, an audit log, and the /cloak command.

resources.name: zhengqiuyang/dsh-attest-chain
resources.desc: Signed chain-of-custody for sessions: every watched tool result appends a hash-chained, ed25519-signed record, with commits bound into the chain — tampering with any line or truncating the tail fails deterministic replay verification.

resources.name: zhengqiuyang/dsh-compaction-guard
resources.desc: Compaction integrity: directive lines (never/must/必须 style markers) extracted from the compacted range are verified against the summary — verbatim or by content-word coverage — and every constraint the session silently forgot is reported and written to a JSONL ledger; pinned constraints from config are checked on every compaction.

resources.name: zhengqiuyang/dsh-egress-gate
resources.desc: Deterministic network egress gate: web fetches and searches are checked against a destination allowlist in tools/pre-execute and denied before they run; shell fetch-verbs are observed (enforcement opt-in).

resources.name: zhengqiuyang/dsh-freeze
resources.desc: Hermetic composition lock: fingerprints the profile's dependencies, bundle order, lockfile and patch layer; booting a drifted composition warns, or fails under strict mode (the --frozen posture for CI).

resources.name: zhengqiuyang/dsh-mcp-test
resources.desc: Tool-surface snapshot and drift gate: baselines the full visible tool registry (name/description/parameters, MCP tools included) into a committable JSON file and warns loudly when an upgrade adds, removes or reshapes a tool.

resources.name: zhengqiuyang/dsh-pr-gate
resources.desc: Deterministic write gate: scope policy denies out-of-scope write/edit calls before they touch the disk, residue rules scan the written text, and every decision lands in a content-hashed JSONL ledger; can reuse the repo's agent-pr-gate.yaml so CI and session enforce one policy.

resources.name: zhengqiuyang/dsh-prompt-drift
resources.desc: System-prompt surface drift gate: every section any plugin or preset contributes to the assembled system prompt is hashed and baselined; a silent rewrite of what the model is told fails loud.

resources.name: zhengqiuyang/dsh-read-guard
resources.desc: Deterministic prompt-injection interception: tool results from file reads, repo searches and web fetches are scanned before they enter model context; high-severity findings quarantine-wrap or block, and credential-material files quarantine on the path alone.

resources.name: zhengqiuyang/dsh-trust-panel
resources.desc: Plain-language trust dashboard for the dsh trust family: aggregates the nine channels (injection interception, write denials, egress blocks, custody-chain verification, tool-surface and prompt drift, leftover scans, forgotten compaction constraints, profile composition) into one right-sidebar panel with a single status light and event cards that translate engine jargon into sentences a non-security user can act on; the read and egress engines run from the package's own npm dependencies so those channels work even without the sibling plugins, and absent plugins simply show as not installed.

resources.name: zjuhbh/dsh-full-with-approval
resources.desc: Fourth permission preset for dsh: unconfined, GPU-capable sessions (danger-full-access) with per-operation user approval for writes outside the workspace or to protected paths (.git/, .env*); implemented purely as a bundle over the official tools/pre-execute ask hook, no core edits.

resources.name: zoahdev/dsh-poison-guard
resources.desc: Pre-install supply-chain poison scanner for DSH plugins: AST (JS-X-Ray) + deobfuscation + regex heuristics, exits non-zero on findings for CI gating.

resources.name: zzstar101/dsh-sandbox-noop-escalation
resources.desc: Removes sandbox_permissions / justification arguments that cannot widen the call's current sandbox mode, so calls no longer fail with 'sandbox escalation to "workspace-write" is not strictly wider than this call's current "danger-full-access" mode'. GPT models tend to fill these optional fields on every call and pick workspace-write, which is narrower than danger-full-access. Runs in tools/pre-execute: compares the requested mode with the mode the session's sandbox policy resolves, and drops the fields when the request is the same or narrower (also drops a lone justification). Also understands the values GPT carries over from Codex's own shell tool: null, empty and use_default are treated as no request, and in a danger-full-access session any value (including require_escalated) is dropped because nothing is wider. Real widening requests, unknown modes and tools that do not advertise DSH's escalation schema are left to DSH core. Never widens permissions. Configurable tool list (default bash, pwsh, write, edit, run_code). Zero dependencies.

resources.name: 1032740078/dsh-web-url-view
resources.desc: Adds a View URL page to Settings showing the running session tokenized Web address plus a stable fixed address that survives desktop restarts and is reachable from other devices on the same LAN.

resources.name: 2710586329/dsh-qq
resources.desc: Bridges QQ into DeepSeek Harness over OneBot 11: private and group chats, on-device voice-to-text, image support, and ten interaction tools (poke, react, like, image, file, recall and more). Needs an OneBot 11 implementation such as NapCat running alongside.

resources.name: 452926826/dsh-feishu-bot
resources.desc: Connect Feishu chats to DeepSeek Harness projects, conversations, replies, and scoped tool approvals over WebSocket.

resources.name: 452926826/dsh-ssh-logs
resources.desc: Read and search bounded log output from allowlisted SSH servers and log roots without exposing arbitrary remote commands.

resources.name: 534119219/chicheng-gate
resources.desc: LAN / remote-access control, frpc NAT tunneling, a panel password gate, and mobile UI adaptation for the DSH Web GUI.

resources.name: 6mt/dsh-plugin-loopback-trust
resources.desc: Restores Host-persisted settings when dsh web is reached through a reverse proxy on a non-loopback hostname: marks the page connection as host-owning so the Settings and model pages load instead of reporting "settings are unavailable in this browser". For dsh 0.1.7 – 0.2.x.

resources.name: abbaababa/dsh-mobile-access
resources.desc: Open a Mac or Windows DeepSeek Harness Web instance from iPhone or iPad Safari: 8-digit pairing, a LAN gateway for loopback-only hosts, optional Tailscale Serve, and iOS-only Safari input and touch fixes. Installs with dsh plugin add.

resources.name: AcidGr/dsh-web-lan-access
resources.desc: LAN/remote access for the Web UI: injects a crypto.randomUUID polyfill on plain-HTTP origins so the frontend survives LAN or Tailscale IP direct links.

resources.name: ahian-lee/dsh-ssh-workspace
resources.desc: SSH workspaces for Windows DeepSeek Harness Desktop 0.2: discover OpenSSH hosts, add or browse remote project directories, and route file, search and Bash operations by workspace while the DSH runtime stays local. A Desktop compatibility fork of Yan-Zero/dsh-remote-ssh that preserves local permission defaults.

resources.name: ai-eks/dsh-auth-tunnel
resources.desc: Password-gated public access for the DSH Web GUI through quick or named Cloudflare Tunnels, with HTTP/WebSocket proxying and an in-app directory picker.

resources.name: AIcivilization/dsh-vps
resources.desc: One-command VPS deployment for DeepSeek Harness: a zero-dependency login gateway with automatic HTTPS that proxies the native web UI, a token-protected setup wizard, and one-click DSH upgrades with automatic rollback; as a plugin it adds Settings → VPS Deploy to install DSH on (or remove it from) a VPS over SSH from a form, plus version, upgrade, gateway status and a QR code to add DSH to a phone's home screen.

resources.name: AIcivilization/dsh-vps-manager
resources.desc: Manage VPS servers over SSH key login: 22 zero-token /vps- commands (status queries, recipe installs with a plan and /vps-yes confirmation, reboot that waits for the machine to come back), an in-conversation terminal (xterm.js over ssh -tt) for interactive programs, 5 agent tools with risk-tiered confirmation, file backup with automatic restore and a firewall/SSH safety net, 29 built-in recipes, and a settings page for adding machines.

resources.name: aleksvega/dsh-tg-bridge
resources.desc: Drive a dsh agent from Telegram: one chat topic per project directory, voice and photo input, ordered per-topic job queue, per-topic goals and task checklists, session forks and branches, live progress message, command menu in en/ru/zh, and control commands for models, plugins, sessions and logs. Search the plugin registry, read a package card before installing, and update every plugin with one tap. Requires a Telegram bot token and your numeric user id in allowedUserIds.

resources.name: alextangson/dsh-dispatch#plugin
resources.desc: Phone-side command center rather than a web-UI mirror: dispatch tasks into isolated git worktrees from a PWA, tool-approval push notifications with phone/desktop first-answer-wins racing (never auto-approved), a multi-machine session board, and an end-to-end encrypted zero-knowledge relay you can self-host.

resources.name: andyfan1094/dsh-winrm
resources.desc: Manage Windows hosts over WinRM from a web panel and seven agent tools with PowerShell exec, service and process control, SMB / chunked file transfer with SHA-256 verification, and cluster execution.

resources.name: ANetResearch/ANet#dsh-anet
resources.desc: Connects DSH to a local anet node through a stdio MCP client, with three skills and 14 tools to discover agents on the AgentNetwork, send, track and answer end-to-end encrypted A2A tasks, pay or decline priced skills within the operator's limits, read the local evidence chain and report the node state. Linux/macOS only; requires an anet 0.3.0+ node running locally.

resources.name: AprilCrystal/dsh-remote
resources.desc: OpenAI-compatible HTTP endpoint for DSH sessions plus a phone panel that reads transcripts, browses files, sends or queues messages, and answers approvals and questions.

resources.name: ArimaKana-Akane/dsh-sakurafrp
resources.desc: Manage the SakuraFrp phone-to-desktop link from the DSH interface - link status, mobile gateway switch, one-time pairing QR code, device revoke and gateway self-heal.

resources.name: dsh-qq-bot
resources.desc: Connects DeepSeek Harness to QQ over OneBot 11/12, Satori, Milky or the official QQ bot API, with a separate session per group or private chat and nine built-in tools: group management, chat history with image understanding, web search, page fetching, reverse image search and image generation. Optional proactive chatter reads recent messages on an interval and decides whether to join in, with the judging and speaking stages able to use different models. Models, proxy and allowlists are configured in the DSH settings page. First run requires an owner (auth.owners): with it empty the plugin drives no sessions at all (deny by default, so installing it does not expose the bot); once set, private chats and groups work immediately, guests only reach the guest tool allowlist while qqbot and qqconfig stay owner-only.

resources.name: Artenx/dsh-honeybee#dshb
resources.desc: Routes DSH filesystem, shell, subprocess, and PTY operations to local, SSH, and Docker execution nodes, with a node registry, an authentication gate, a mobile-aware management UI, and per-workspace custom project instructions.

resources.name: Autumn984/dsh-remote
resources.desc: Control DeepSeek Harness from a phone via QR code: read chats, send messages, upload images, over LAN, IPv6, or a Cloudflare tunnel.

resources.name: Aztech-Lab/dsh-3301
resources.desc: Password-optional LAN entry for the DSH Web GUI. DSH stays loopback-only while a settings-card plugin serves its HTTP and WebSocket traffic on port 3301, storing the password only as a scrypt verifier.

resources.name: azure5100/huahua-dsh-chatroom
resources.desc: Install-time patch guard for cross-machine DSH group chat: fixes dsh-weave rc.14 defects (inject crash, random UDP port, 4KB ack frame limit) with four idempotent patches, alongside setup, mechanism and ops docs for the dsh-chat x dsh-weave x dsh-bridge chatroom stack.

resources.name: baixianger/dsh-network
resources.desc: Authenticated LAN, Tailnet, and public HTTPS access for a DSH Host, with persistent host identity, pairing, and QR setup.

resources.name: baixianger/dsh-weave
resources.desc: Trusted Iroh mesh networking for DSH hosts, with encrypted peer discovery, remote session delivery, and reachability status.

resources.name: baosfeng/my-dsh-plugins#dsh-my-remote
resources.desc: Remote control: pushes ask / approval / session-end events to an external channel webhook and lets you answer, approve, query status or continue a session from your phone with token auth (npm: dsh-my-remote).

resources.name: bbtssama/dsh-webui-mobile
resources.desc: Mobile web shell for the DSH Web GUI: overlay drawers, draggable FAB, mobile composer fixes, and a floating image-upload button pinned above the composer (native gallery/camera, integrated with the validated add-images pipeline), zero desktop regression. Published on npm as dsh-webui-mobile.

resources.name: beiheng127/dsh-dfy-qq
resources.desc: QQ chat behaviour layer for DeepSeek Harness over OneBot 11: persona files injected into every turn, a people file keyed by QQ number, sticker picking with probability and pity, optional non-mention replies, sub-personas distilled from group members, and scheduled messages. Enabling the built-in QQ channel accepts private messages from any QQ user and group messages from any group that @s the bot; there is no sender allowlist, so restrict the bot account or keep the channel off.

resources.name: Bernardxu123/dsh-mobile-gate
resources.desc: LAN mobile gateway: isolated child-process reverse proxy with first-visit approval, per-device token binding, rate limiting, and mobile layout injection (compact composer pills, randomUUID polyfill).

resources.name: better-er/dsh-remote-file-system
resources.desc: Model-visible SSH file tools read_remote, write_remote and edit_remote: read a remote UTF-8 file with line-numbered paging, create a new remote file (an existing target is refused, there is no overwrite branch), and apply literal replacements with unique-match checking — all addressed through a single "alias:path" field whose alias comes from ~/.ssh/config.

resources.name: bigbigtooth/DSH-DevOps-Plugin
resources.desc: Remote operations for the DSH Web app: manages SSH servers, collects hardware and process metrics, inspects logs with a read-only AI pass, and deploys a Git repo over SSH using git pull --ff-only plus a health check. Credentials are AES-256-GCM encrypted. Linux and macOS hosts; no Windows support.

resources.name: Blank-not-black/dsh-Remote#plugin
resources.desc: Mobile remote-control suite: bundle plugin with native sidebar entry and admin drawer, self-healing bearer-token gateway over LAN/Tailscale, Android app (sessions/approvals/questions/goals), /fs/* file transfer (Range resume, 2GB upload), latency-based multi-server auto-switch, offline chat cache.

resources.name: BotonJ/dsh-remote-link
resources.desc: Secure remote access for the official Web UI: authenticated LAN/tunnel gateway with QR + HMAC one-time pairing, per-device sessions and revocation, mDNS discovery, and a fork_session tool.

resources.name: btsd321/dsh-remote-explorer
resources.desc: Remote development launcher for DeepSeek Harness: provisions dsh on a remote host via SSH (or a local WSL distro) and connects from the local client, with LLM credentials proxied through a reverse tunnel so they never leave the local machine. Ships as both a standalone CLI and a dsh plugin with a session panel, /remote-explorer slash command and remote_* agent tools.

resources.name: Buzzso/dsh-sev
resources.desc: Manage your own remote DSH host from the local GUI: SSH tunnels, mixed remote session list, one-click remote GUI, auto-healing tunnels.

resources.name: caoyiwei850/dsh-ssh-ops
resources.desc: SSH ops terminal for DSH Web UI: drive a connected server from the main conversation (ssh_connect/ssh_exec/ssh_read/ssh_write/ssh_disconnect) while keeping an interactive xterm.js terminal on the right.

resources.name: cccodder/dsh-remote-console
resources.desc: Right-sidebar SSH terminal for DSH where you and your agent share one PTY: 16 agent tools, configurable transfer limit, session-isolated audit trail, one-click in-place updates.

resources.name: CCYellowStar2/dsh-astrbot-ingress
resources.desc: Drive a local DeepSeek Harness agent from QQ and other IM channels through AstrBot: send tasks with /dsh, continue by quoting or @-mentioning the bot, answer approvals and ask_user_question prompts from chat (in parallel with the DSH web UI), and get results, inline images and file cards back. Ships session / workspace / model / permission commands, /compact and /last recovery, three progress-display modes, and group-shared or per-user session scoping.

resources.name: ChenJun25/dsh-console-plugin
resources.desc: Pair a phone with this computer's DSH instance by QR code or a six-digit code, then drive it remotely — send instructions, view images, answer approvals — from the panel, with public-tunnel support for pairing across networks.

resources.name: chinahhy/DSH-plugins#dsh-tether-ios

resources.name: drscrewdriver/dsh-im-union
resources.desc: Union IM bridge for DSH — an independent implementation uniting the capability sets of community peer plugins (xmanrui/dsh-im, MichengAI/dsh-im-connect). Drive your agent session from 15 channel adapters across 12 platforms (including email; WeCom/DingTalk/QQ each contribute two: bot + self-built app or notify tier) — WeChat (official iLink QR bind), Feishu/Lark (long-connection + streaming cards; the voice tier requires system ffmpeg), Telegram, Discord, WeCom intelligent bot & self-built app (signed callback), DingTalk (stream + AI Card and custom-robot notify), QQ official bot (plus notify tier), Slack (Socket Mode), WhatsApp (Baileys QR pairing; the dependency ships as an optionalDependency of the plugin package), Matrix, iMessage (macOS only), Email (IMAP/SMTP thread routing). The cross-version narrow waist auto-adapts settings gen1/gen2/gen3 across hosts 0.1.2-rc.1→0.2.1-rc.2 (12-tag enum; rc.2 verified by a real desktop-profile install with double read-back) using capability probing only, never version branches. In chat: a 25-command panel, tool-approval and question loops answered in the originating chat (deny-by-default, initiator-only, 5-min expiry), image/file input gated on host model metadata, deliverable file return, a delivery log with bounded retry (uncertain is never re-sent), proactive delivery and fragment composition. It also splits the native sidebar into self-owned Tasks / Channels tabs (standing down entirely when another plugin already owns the slot), registers an im-concise agent preset plus reply sanitisation that keeps GenUI fences and raw HTML out of text-only chats, renders svg fences to PNG images, guards model choice with an allowlist, and mirrors each turn's final answer to notify channels via /relay (addressed by account ID or alias, never guessed on ambiguity). Secrets are one-way into the vault and never echoed back. npm: dsh-im-union.

resources.name: MyRemme/dsh-lan-pair

Remote pages can be forced into a phone layout without changing the local UI, and the official appearance, font size, transcript view, code view and performance settings can be stored in the plugin config and re-applied on every remote page load.

resources.name: mzzsfy/dsh-plugin#dsh-auto-trust-all
resources.desc: Dynamically trusts every Host header that actually arrives and flips the default web binding to 0.0.0.0: wildcard or unenumerable entry domains work without editing the start command, the authentication layer is untouched, and hosts are evicted by LRU beyond a capacity cap.

resources.name: NattoCB/dsh-plugin-wechat-bridge
resources.desc: Bridges WeChat (ilink bot) private chats into DSH agent sessions and streams replies back, with hot-plug and a Settings tab.

resources.name: NelsonLongXiang/dsh-open-a2a-net
resources.desc: Turns a DSH deployment into one node of a decentralized agent network — signed agent cards, peer and zone discovery, direct message-routing model tools, and joinable session nodes in the web sidebar.

resources.name: netbka/local-commander-plugins
resources.desc: Connects DeepSeek Harness to the hosted Local Commander MCP server at localcmd.app via mcp-remote with browser sign-in, to read files and Git, run the checks you approve and check local services on your Windows computers. Requires a Local Commander account and the paired agent running on the Windows PC.

resources.name: NNNNyang/dsh-remote-gpu
resources.desc: Shows how many GPUs on the dsh-remote host are free in the conversation header, and per-GPU utilization, memory, temperature and the owning user in a right-sidebar panel. Adds a remote_gpu tool that returns the same snapshot.

resources.name: NOirBRight/dsh-mobile-pairing
resources.desc: Mobile remote pairing for DSH with QR offers, a loopback Host Gateway, encrypted Relay or Quick Tunnel transport, same-LAN WebRTC Direct, and revocable Device Tokens for the Android client.

resources.name: observer130/dsh-peerbar
resources.desc: Federates a local DeepSeek Harness and multiple remote hosts into the official sidebar: remote workspaces and sessions appear as native rows, open in the official chat pane, and execute entirely on the remote host over HTTP/TLS. Remote hosts need no plugin and the UI is not iframed.

resources.name: OMSociety/dsh-ssh-tunnel
resources.desc: Multi-host SSH workbench: keep remote servers in a host library, grant them per project, and open an interactive terminal or dual-pane SFTP in the right sidebar, while the SSHManager tool runs remote commands and transfers files without exposing keys to the model.

resources.name: onesmash/dsh-remote-bot-bridge
resources.desc: Bot-to-bot messaging across machines on top of ds-harness-remote: five tools let a local Bot list the peer Host Bots, pin a target device and send it a message, without switching the local window.

resources.name: ook826092-cloud/dsh-mobile-css
resources.desc: Mobile adaptation for the DSH Web UI: compact typography, full-width composer with caret fix, drawer sidebar with overlay-close, two-page settings flow, responsive tables and stats, safe touch targets.

resources.name: OrderG-X/dsh-mobile
resources.desc: Use DSH from a phone browser. Turn on phone access from the phone button in the session header (or the plugin card) and scan the QR code; the phone opens the official DSH web UI served by the desktop process, with the same sessions updating live, so you can follow a running task, reply and approve away from the computer. A gateway inside DSH (port 18765) proxies the web UI and handles the desktop login itself. One QR code works on Wi-Fi and on mobile data: turning access on also starts a free Cloudflare quick tunnel (cloudflared is downloaded from Cloudflare's GitHub releases if missing), and its address survives DSH restarts, so phones do not need to rescan. Pairing codes are one-time and expire in 10 minutes, each phone gets its own revocable credential, the header button shows when a phone is connected, and idle connections get keepalive pings. Optional push notifications go to Bark, ntfy, ServerChan, Feishu / WeCom / DingTalk group bots, Telegram or any webhook when a task finishes (after 30 seconds or more), stops with an error, or waits for an approval or an answer; they carry only the session title and status, and approval still happens in DSH. On a phone the web UI's side panels slide over the page, and it can be added to the home screen with its own icon.

resources.name: oxmumu3/dot-dsh-connector#dot-dsh-management
resources.desc: Native Harness workbench and local gateway for Dot to read saved projects and conversations, dispatch native tasks, inspect progress, continue or cancel tasks, and manage connection authorization.

resources.name: pan17/dsh-wechat
resources.desc: Bridges WeChat private chats into DeepSeek Harness as an in-process plugin over Tencent's iLink bot protocol, with two-way text, image, file and voice messaging, in-WeChat slash commands resolved through the native command registry, WeChat-side handling of approvals and agent questions, and proactive push through a send_wechat tool.

resources.name: peng456/dsh-plugin-mesh
resources.desc: Discovers other DSH instances on the local network by UDP multicast or port scan, lists them in a sidebar panel together with the capabilities each one reports, and dispatches tasks between machines in both directions over the LAN or over an automatically downloaded userspace Tailscale node.

resources.name: PerryLink/dsh-reach

resources.name: polaris-smart/dsh-devices
resources.desc: Decentralized multi-device fleet: mDNS LAN discovery, key pairing, and SSH direct execution across networks.

resources.name: Raiyan007-gb/dsh-remote-tunnel-easy
resources.desc: Scan a QR code in Settings to open the DeepSeek Harness web UI on your phone inside the active session via a cloudflared quick tunnel.

resources.name: regrevia/dsh-mobile-use

Requires adb (Android platform-tools) and ffmpeg on the host; the device-side helpers are bundled, and the OCR fallback is macOS-only.

resources.name: RestRegular/dsh-pocket

On the phone it streams assistant text, thinking, tool calls and results, sends prompts, stops the running turn, answers blocking questions and tool approvals (including ones waiting in other sessions), switches model, thinking level and permission preset, sends up to four photos compressed on the device, and keeps the computer awake.

resources.name: rice-awa/dsh-lan-gateway
resources.desc: Publishes the DSH Web GUI to LAN or internet with dsh kept on loopback. Every source must sign in for an HMAC session cookie unless passwordless LAN is opted into. Adds self-signed or custom TLS, a secureCookies override for plaintext-HTTP proxies, and a UUID shim for plain-HTTP origins.

resources.name: RyensX/dsh-remote-gateway

resources.name: SAXEM1997/dsh-cherry-bridge

resources.name: saya-ch/dsh-mobile
resources.desc: Access DeepSeek Harness from the Android app or a mobile browser with secure LAN and remote connections, persistent device pairing, and a customizable mobile interface.

resources.name: scientificmaniac/dsh-ssh-vault
resources.desc: Store SSH hosts in an AES-256-GCM vault and let the agent run commands on them by alias, with passwords handed to ssh through SSH_ASKPASS instead of the command line. Windows only.

resources.name: Shr-CS/dsh-wechat-channel

resources.name: siberiah2o/dsh-plugin-remote

resources.name: siqyka/dsh-ssh-workspace
resources.desc: Use a directory on an SSH host as a DSH workspace — hosts management, directory browser, five agent tools.

resources.name: somebdly/dsh-docker

Credentials are encrypted with Windows DPAPI, HTTP is loopback-only, and command parameters are whitelist-filtered. Build-free pure ESM; client is zero-dependency.

resources.name: songofhawk/dsh-alpha
resources.desc: Multi-machine, multi-agent orchestration and control plane for DSH: discovers Agents and workspaces across devices, routes tasks by machine, repository, capability, and load to local or remote Agent runtimes, streams progress and results, forwards approvals, and recovers durable tasks after disconnections.

resources.name: SOVLOOKUP/dsh-tunnel-preview
resources.desc: Expose local listening ports as public HTTPS URLs via Cloudflare Tunnel, with automatic DNS management and one-click token template authorization.

resources.name: sunChargedd/dsh-plugins#dsh-ssh-manage
resources.desc: SSH host manager for DeepSeek Harness: browse ~/.ssh/config, store AES-256-GCM encrypted passwords, run batch commands and SFTP, and open interactive PTY terminals in persistent sidebar tabs.

resources.name: sunrulin123/dsh-community-web-ui
resources.desc: Standalone remote Web UI for DeepSeek Harness with mobile viewport, soft-keyboard and touch-target adaptations while leaving the native Desktop presentation unchanged.

resources.name: swarm-apps/dsh-swarmdrop
resources.desc: Device channel between the agent and your own phone: it sends files it just produced, and you @-reference what your phone sent back. End-to-end encrypted P2P through the SwarmDrop CLI, with no account and no public IP; node status, paired devices and QR pairing sit in a sidebar panel.

resources.name: swswordholy-tech/AgentsChatProtocol#mcp-plugin
resources.desc: Connect DeepSeek Harness to shared AgentsChat rooms over MCP and WebSocket wake bridge for cross-agent messaging, peer code review, proposals, voting, and OKRs.

resources.name: Sycada/dsh-remote-ssh-tools
resources.desc: SSH session manager for DeepSeek Harness: saved profiles, agent ssh_run, interactive terminals, and SFTP with secrets kept in the DSH credential center.

resources.name: T1gerD/open-whale#dsh-openwhale
resources.desc: Turns a phone into a personal assistant for the DeepSeek Harness on your computer — pair once by QR code, then chat, send photos and files, watch replies stream, and collaborate from several phones at once over LAN, Tailscale or a public tunnel. Ships an Android app, an iOS build pipeline and a zero-install web/PWA client for HarmonyOS and iOS browsers.

resources.name: taxah92/dsh-pve-vm
resources.desc: Control Proxmox VE virtual machines from the conversation: 16 tools for the VM console over VNC (screenshots, mouse, keyboard, batched actions, Unicode text and clipboard) and for running commands and reading or writing files through the QEMU guest agent, all over one ssh connection to the node, so the host needs no X11 or Wayland.

resources.name: tbb051122/dsh-plugin-qq-bridge
resources.desc: Bridge an official QQ bot to DeepSeek Harness in-process: a QQ message starts or resumes a real DSH session inside the host (it appears in the desktop sidebar when its working directory is a registered workspace) and the answer is sent back to QQ as text, image or file. Requires a QQ official bot application (AppID + AppSecret).

resources.name: tdcq9594/dsh-roost

Anyone in a paired QQ group can chat with the bot by default; only the owner gets the full local toolset.

resources.name: techflag/dsh-plugin-ssh
resources.desc: SSH terminals, SFTP file transfer and text editing inside DeepSeek Harness, with server troubleshooting through host models.

resources.name: temotee2103/dsh-remote-gui

resources.name: TiantianFlow/dsh-one-gateway

resources.desc: SSH workspace and operations for DeepSeek Harness: bind a server directory as a workspace whose fs/subprocess calls route to the remote host via cordis seam replacement, plus web terminal, file transfers, tunnels, cluster runs and host management.

resources.name: toddpan/dsh-webapi
resources.desc: Drive DSH from anything that speaks HTTP: 47 routes (REST + SSE) for workspaces, sessions (create/prompt, live SSE generation, history, stats, todos, cancel, ask-user Q&A), models and the global default model, providers, agent presets, settings namespaces, skills, and workspace files including resumable chunked upload — plus an OpenAI-compatible /chat/completions, a built-in OpenAPI 3.0 spec and an interactive request page. It only injects the host webServer and tools, so it rides on the DSH webserver (default prefix /api/v1) or its own port with optional API-key auth, and it ships a skill that teaches the DSH agent to call the API.

resources.name: TongaiLinC/dsh-mobile-access

resources.name: tonytanglab/deepseek-harness-relay-mcp

resources.name: Tuiltex-0216/dsh-wechat-share

resources.name: uumit-ai/dsh-uumit-remote

Requires dsh web on DSH >=0.2.1-rc.2.

resources.name: Very12345/dsh-ssh-workspace
resources.desc: SSH workspaces for Linux/macOS with SSH config import, remote folder selection, and file tools, Bash and persistent remote terminals following native DSH session permissions.

Requires Node.js 24+; the SFTP path also requires OpenSSH (ssh/sftp).

resources.name: Wanderingss/dsh-ws-deflate
resources.desc: Enable permessage-deflate on DSH's WebSocket transport without modifying the DSH install tree.

resources.name: Wayne036/dsh-plugin-login-gate
resources.desc: Password-protected HTTPS login gate that lets LAN devices securely access the DeepSeek Harness web UI over the network.

resources.name: Wazzfhaha/dsh-multi-end
resources.desc: Remote SSH multi-host management for DSH. Access remote workspaces and sessions in one native sidebar, with tasks running on their original machines.

resources.name: wenbin-wb/dsh-bridge
resources.desc: Remote and mobile access for DeepSeek Harness: provides LAN QR code connection, Cloudflare/custom tunnels, WeChat, QQ, Feishu, Telegram bot integration, and security authentication.

resources.name: wentao75/dsh-remote-auth
resources.desc: DSH remote-access authorization page that shows the current process browser-session URL as a clickable link or QR code, behind an optional authority/subnet allow-list and PIN.

resources.name: westanke/dsh-remote-bridge
resources.desc: Translates DSH's private remote protocol into a versioned REST API (chat, sessions, files, devices) for trusted clients such as the Android app dsh-companion, plus a Phone-settings panel with seven inline cards inside the DSH WebUI settings.

resources.name: whoisjiahao/dsh-feishu-channel
resources.desc: Feishu/Lark channel that drives DeepSeek Harness agents from chats: streaming rich cards with live thinking and tool steps, per-turn cost metering at DeepSeek peak/off-peak rates, one-tap approval cards, model-gated image intake, and QR onboarding without a public endpoint.

resources.name: wikkd/dsh-remote-access-web#remote-access-web
resources.desc: Reverse tunnel for the DSH Web GUI: exposes a dsh --profile web deployment at a public frp URL and switches the directory picker to the in-app browser, so a phone or remote machine can open and manage the workspace.

resources.name: WinKing-R/dsh-uniterminal
resources.desc: SSH terminal, SFTP file manager and port forwarding (-L/-R/-D) in the DSH right sidebar, with jump-host chains and remembered passwords kept in the operating system credential store.

resources.name: winlin926/dsh-roam

resources.name: WODE25500/dsh-ssh-pro

resources.desc: Continue an existing PC DSH session from WeChat: polls WeChat iLink messages, injects into a running session via followup or resumes a closed one, and sends the reply back. Supports /会话 to list/bind sessions and /新会话 to unbind. Requires the wechat-acp daemon; only allowlisted WeChat senders are handled (empty allowlist denies everyone).

resources.name: dsh-ssh-agent-workspace
resources.desc: Live remote SSH workspaces with a resident Python RPC agent, remote shell/glob/grep execution, SSH port forwarding, ~/.ssh/config import, ProxyJump, and conflict-safe three-way cache sync.

resources.name: xchannel1987/dsh-mobile-xc
resources.desc: Mobile UI adaptation plugin for DeepSeek Harness - overlay drawer navigation, glassmorphism design, safe-area coverage, PWA support.

Settings cover bind address, port, API key with a generator, fallback provider and model, reasoning effort, CORS origin and timeout.

resources.name: yabolee-kkk/dsh-streaming-mcp-bridge

Not rendered on phone or tablet surfaces.

resources.name: zbzbhs/dsh-remote-agent

The hub dispatches through 8 remote_* tools, receives only a handoff summary plus an artifact manifest, and pulls finished products on demand — intermediate artifacts stay on the worker. Pairing-code onboarding, direct or relay transport for NAT, Web panel on both sides.

resources.name: zdx8637-gitdog/dshmobile#dshmobile-plugin

resources.name: zengpu987-ctrl/dsh-deep-connect#plugin

resources.name: zexadev/dsh-tether

resources.name: ZhangFengshun/dsh-remote-ssh

resources.name: zhu1090093659/dsh-web#packages/dsh-remote-web-ui

resources.name: dingchenhui0618-arch/dsh-doudizhu
resources.desc: Available on npm as dsh-doudizhu-lan. Three-player LAN Dou Dizhu (斗地主) played from a floating window: one machine opens a room on its own port, the other two join with a six-character room code plus an address. Empty seats can be filled by computer players in four switchable strengths (easy, medium, hard, hell), so one or two people can still play a whole hand; the deal starts as soon as the three seats are filled. 54 cards in four suits, bidding of 1/2/3 or pass, the landlord takes the three bottom cards and holds 20, play runs clockwise, and the first-bid seat rotates clockwise between hands. The rule engine is pure and covers 11 legal shapes, with big joker > small joker > 2 > A > K down to 3, suits never compared, straights, pair-straights and planes excluding the 2s and the jokers, and a rocket that beats everything. The table itself is built to be read at a glance: three seat cards side by side in play order (you, then your next and previous seats) with role, hand count and a bar that runs out, one line that says whose hand is on the table and what would beat it, the bottom cards as text, an in-place play history that folds into a single summary line and unfolds into every trick including the passes, plus hint and auto-play buttons that pick the cheapest legal answer out of the local rule enumeration. Nicknames can be changed mid-hand (twelve characters, duplicates get a suffix). Computers run inside the authority and are handed only their own hand, the public record and the seat counts, so no hand can leak; the authority is the only place that decides which card ids leave it. Computers are driven by the room itself, so a one-person table keeps playing with nobody else on the LAN port. Humans have no turn timer, the collapsed floating pill can be dragged around the screen, and 179 unit tests pin the rules, the wire format, the theme tokens, the drag gesture, the history grouping and the computer seats.

resources.name: dingchenhui0618-arch/dsh-poker-night
resources.desc: A no-limit Texas holdem table where you are the only human. Eight seats: you plus seven LLM agents written on AI-founder personas (Altman, Dario Amodei, Musk, Liang Wenfeng, Jensen Huang, Lei Jun, Zhang Yiming). Each agent bets through the currently selected host model and falls back to its own heuristic style when no model is available; every agent only ever sees its own hole cards, because the prompt is built from that seat alone. A hand ends by revealing the winner hole cards, with a flip animation replayed on every community card, and a rail keeps a live action-and-table-talk timeline. LAN mode (off by default, single-machine play is unaffected) lets another install on the same network join this very table: the host shows a six-digit room code, UDP broadcast discovers nearby tables, and a joiner randomly takes over one bot seat, with the seat handed back to its character on leave or after twenty seconds of silence. The room code is never put on the wire and every snapshot is generated for one viewer seat, so nobody, not even the host, can read another player hole cards. Fork of BubblePtr/dsh-holdem (MIT), credited in the README and in the UI.

resources.name: dingchenhui0618-arch/dsh-turing-table

Seat identity and each agent model configuration stay hidden in the host state until a seat is judged, then the disguise parameters are revealed. Every round exports a per-seat conversation JSONL plus the judgment record, and the same seed with the same move script replays byte-identical, so runs with different models or disguise strengths can be diffed.

resources.desc: Native DSH tools for playing Stronghold Protocol solo games over the game site's WebSocket connection, with compact state views, explicit actions and public card lookups.

resources.name: hasan-aghayev/dsh-pet-companion
resources.desc: A WSLg-compatible DSH desktop pet reacts to agent activity, lets you message the active session, and loads Hatch-Pet v2 atlases or transparent portraits.

resources.name: hellodigua/dsh-emoji
resources.desc: Automatically add emojis to AI replies.

resources.name: hellosz/dsh-pets
resources.desc: Codex Pets-style floating pixel pet with 10 built-in Petdex-compatible pets, a 9-state agent-status engine (idle/running/waiting/review/failed plus client-side waving/jumping/directions), draggable overlay, pet picker/zoom settings, notification bubbles, and a pet_say tool for the agent to speak through the pet.

resources.name: Helly0000/dsh-life-game
resources.desc: Conway's Game of Life for DeepSeek Harness: a sidebar panel row opens a drawable centre-column board with four rules, seven stampable patterns and a population chart.

resources.name: hongxin-y/codex-pet-Astra-Yao
resources.desc: An Astra Yao desktop pet for the DeepSeek Harness web GUI that renders the Codex v2 8x11 sprite atlas, follows session state through thinking, running, waiting and failed, shows a status bubble with the running tool and a DeepSeek balance readout (on by default, can be switched off), and quotes her own voice lines while idle.

resources.name: huangzhilin-hzl/dsh-power-type
resources.desc: Power Mode typing effects for the DSH web composer: caret particles and glowing character echoes, a heat ramp from amber to red with rising embers as the combo grows, a combo counter over visible glyphs, and a synthesized key tick with a heavier Enter impact.

resources.name: huangziyuan-general/dsh-xuanji
resources.desc: Fortune-telling toolkit: bazi, ziwei doushu, meihua yijing, liuyao (six-line coin oracle with najia), almanac, chenggu bone-weight, zodiac, date selection, qimen dunjia, fengshui, name scoring, compatibility, numerology, a life K-line chart, tarot and xiaoliuren — 16 tools whose ganzhi, stars, hexagrams and bone weights are all computed by deterministic local engines, with the model only interpreting results. Supports solar and lunar dates with leap months, China DST and true solar time correction, plus a ten-page read-only side panel.

resources.name: HuanLinOTO/dsh-plugin-d399
resources.desc: Pops up a mini-game menu (wordle, match-3, extensible) while the model generates.

resources.name: huashenglian/dsh-livechat
resources.desc: Bilibili-style danmaku overlay for the DSH Web chat area: scroll, top and bottom tracks driven by agent events, three preset packs, optional LLM-generated comments, a draggable control ball, per-session pools with replay, and a settings card.

resources.name: hulibuld/dsh-pet-cuteness-plugin
resources.desc: A companion plugin for dsh-pet: gives the desktop pet a persona card, Chinese reasoning lines, click reactions, and a daily diary she writes herself.

resources.name: HYClub/dsh-ufo
resources.desc: UFO archive terminal: search official and civilian records, keep a local archive, read it offline.

resources.name: Hyfwdnmd666/dsh-ai-ball
resources.desc: Gives the agent a mouth through the ai-ball floating orb: speak text that the orb types out character by character, set its mood colour, show or hide its monologue panel, read back what you typed into it, and check or start it. The orb is a separate Python 3.10+ overlay you install yourself, and the plugin only writes the files it watches.

resources.name: imfuxing/dsh-widget-journey-west
resources.desc: Journey to the West floating desktop pet: a frameless, transparent, always-on-top cartoon widget of Tang Monk and his disciples. Click to switch characters; idle plays a chasing scene.

resources.name: imkingjh999/dsh-deepsea
resources.desc: Turns session context into a deep-sea moyu (slack-off) game in a floating window — your hand sinks as context grows, touch a fish and server-rolled dice decide the mint of a holographic collectible card across five oceans, with a fish pond and a GitHub-linked leaderboard.

resources.name: iypavlov/dsh-cat-pet
resources.desc: An animated pixel cat that lives over the DSH web interface and follows what the agent is doing — sitting while the session is calm, lying down and falling asleep while a run is in progress, and waking when the turn returns or typing starts. It can be dragged anywhere, remembers its position, sleeps after a minute of inactivity, and offers an enable switch, four sizes and a status-reaction toggle in Settings.

resources.name: JAdpp/dsh-whale-galgame
resources.desc: Multi-character Galgame conversation view with separate character and reply-model selection, per-character affection, memory, dialogue history, and CG galleries, plus responses informed by task events across Harness sessions.

resources.name: jarvislee90s-dot/dsh-foxbell-pet
resources.desc: Multi-pet desktop companion: four MAM status lights watch every active session (approval / running / done-unread / error) and each card click-through to its conversation; four voice groups speak on state changes with duration-timed subtitles; import pets from four sources (folder / zip / Codex dir / Petdex registry) with card-style hot-swap and an integrity guard; five action bindings, drag physics, three scales. The built-in fox Foxbell ships in the package — install and go.

resources.name: jcs130/dsh-minecraft-agent
resources.desc: Connect a DSH Agent to Minecraft Java servers with Mineflayer, a live game view alongside native reasoning and tools, configurable personas, server-scoped notebooks, and optional local survival knowledge retrieval. Reuses the host model; installation does not connect to a game or start inference.

resources.name: jcy0chenyuan0/dsh-debate-simulator
resources.desc: Multi-agent Chinese debate simulator with eight debaters, live two-column discussion and draft notes, judges and scoreboard, single-side clocks, per-round ZIP archives, a training side with a configurable end condition (win-rate threshold or fixed rounds), and a Word prep package.

resources.name: jerryqx/dsh-xiaoyuzhou
resources.desc: Listen to Xiaoyuzhou (小宇宙) podcasts in the DSH web UI: paste a share link to play anonymously (host proxies the audio with Range/seek), or log in via QR code to sync subscriptions, keyword-search shows/episodes, page full episode lists, and unlock purchased paywalled episodes; a podcast_play tool lets the agent play by link, podcast pid, or episode eid.

resources.name: Jessie-1939/whalepal#dsh-bridge
resources.desc: Bridges DeepSeek Harness agent state (status, tool calls, errors, approval waits) over loopback to WhalePal, a standalone desktop pet app, so the desktop pet follows the real agent state instead of guessing from screenshots.

resources.name: jiangzeyuan/dsh-rivermind
resources.desc: Heads-up Texas Hold'em training with an independent AI opponent, persistent public-action memory, and decision reviews.

resources.name: jitengfei/dsh-whale-arcade
resources.desc: Floating, browser-local whale arcade with three score games and ocean-themed Gomoku for breaks while waiting on the agent.

resources.name: jusong/dsh-codex-pets
resources.desc: macOS always-on-top desktop pet for DSH Desktop: a bundled DeepSeek whale sprite with Codex-compatible skins, Settings gallery install/import, a recent-session ball, right-click New Session and a configurable global shortcut (default Command+Option+N) for a new-session ask box, and a first-run Electron download (~120 MB) into ~/.dsh.

resources.name: kanoonak/dsh-whale-catcher
resources.desc: A two-minute whale-fishing mini game for the DSH web GUI. Catch fish whose numbers add to your score, avoid fish larger than you, eat rice bowls to heal, and grab coupons to ignore size on the next hook. Standalone HTML, no network, no telemetry.

resources.name: kendu76/dsh-music-player
resources.desc: Music, audiobook, radio and news player for DeepSeek Harness: streams your local music folder over HTTP, reads local .txt/.epub novels aloud with AI voices, plays online QQ/Kugou/Netease music and internet radio (HLS supported), and broadcasts daily news digests — all driven from the UI or by telling the agent through the music_play model tool.

resources.name: Kevinwu901113/dsh-dot
resources.desc: A character who lives on her own phone: the plugin installs and runs her Android phone; she has her own QQ, memory and a diary from real events, a life between conversations (after HDS-Interlude), and an optional microVM computer with approval gates; sidebar tabs show her phone, her computer and a dot panel. Only the QQ number set with /qq owner counts as you; other people's messages are treated as untrusted notifications.

resources.name: KongChengZhi/dsh-pixel-studio#dsh-cli-anything-aseprite
resources.desc: Aseprite-style pixel art studio: the AI draws sprites stroke by stroke with selections, layers, animation frames, gradients, symmetry and reference layers, each step rendered live as ANSI terminal frames.

resources.name: lastplayer82/dsh-tanqi
resources.desc: AI-generated curiosity & trivia plugin for the dsh web GUI (Curio in the English UI): 「开始探奇」 generates a fresh batch of unexpected knowledge (excluding everything already seen), each item unfolds into two deeper layers plus similar knowledge points, and 「探奇清单」 keeps the full history (batch, items, layers, similar points) in browser storage. Reuses the host LLM channel with zero config; when no model is available, a DeepSeek API key can be pasted into the panel. Output language follows the DSH UI language (zh/en).

resources.name: lctfwyt/dsh-liuyao
resources.desc: Liuyao divination in one click — ask a question, cast the six-line hexagram, and let AI interpret it for you; every cast is saved locally.

resources.name: leeclouddragon/dsh-all-in
resources.desc: Adds a local-only six-seat Texas Hold'em table to the DSH Web UI with full betting streets, side pots, persistent Token stacks, and agent-status display.

resources.name: LeemanCheung/dsh-whale-companion
resources.desc: Draggable whale companion with local progression, achievements, skins, and privacy-safe activity tracking.

resources.name: lemonxiny55/dsh-kurowhale-pet
resources.desc: KuroWhale is an unofficial dark-themed whale-girl desktop companion for Windows x64, inspired by the DeepSeek Harness icon, with nine animations that react to DSH Agent activity. Requires WebView2; the first launch downloads the official Neutralino 6.9.0 runtime and artwork over the network and verifies them by SHA-256.

resources.name: lg6169219/dsh-fatfish-level
resources.desc: Adds a token-burn leveling widget to DSH with 14 DeepSeek-whale levels, daily quests, streaks and achievements.

resources.name: lhh010/dsh-minigames
resources.desc: Side-panel arcade: 18 offline mini-games to play while the model thinks.

resources.name: liang-today/dsh-liangxiang
resources.desc: Burned DSH tokens become incense; spend one stick to raise or lower today's case. The case updates daily, Liangwei decides today's Liangzi, and the result is archived at day end.

resources.name: lianzhimanye/dsh-bard-0.03
resources.desc: Role-play plugin for DeepSeek Harness: imports SillyTavern character cards (JSON/PNG) and world books (lorebooks), binds DSH skills to a character, and registers the combination as a native agent preset.

resources.name: liceses/dsh-cosplay
resources.desc: Character cards for DeepSeek Harness: inject a persona section into the system prompt, or rewrite the user message through rule cards before the model sees it. Ships a preset card library, single-file card packs that carry artwork, and a Character tab in the conversation view.

resources.name: lijajiu9205-collab/dsh-history
resources.desc: Per-conversation toggle that makes the model answer in classical Chinese (文言 above a —— line, a modern-Chinese translation below) and speak as a blue classical-style fish that eats plain rice; each conversation keeps its own switch, and turning it off restores plain modern Chinese.

resources.name: linconz/agentduel-dsh
resources.desc: AgentDuel is a code-battle game. This plugin lets you complete the entire game loop inside DSH: manage deathmatch characters and capture-the-flag teams, submit agent code, start battles, watch replays, and use DSH conversations to keep improving agents based on battle results.

resources.name: Link258QAQ/dsh-plugin-genshin-launch
resources.desc: Windows only. On every DSH start it checks, with no configuration, whether Genshin Impact is already installed — if it is, the game is launched (falling back to the miHoYo launcher when the game exits immediately, e.g. while an update is pending); if it is not, the launcher installer is downloaded to the desktop behind a size gate that rejects any link whose payload is more than 15 MiB away from the expected ~224 MiB, and a failed download falls back to opening the official download page.

resources.name: lintwosix-beep/dsh-pet-chat
resources.desc: Desktop pet with a chat panel: QQ-style history, favorites, and branch threads that merge back into the log as a forward card; the panel docks beside the pet and resizes from its edges and corners. Modified from PC2005-cloud/dsh-pet (MIT); do not install together with the original.

resources.name: Little-Star888/dsh-pelican
resources.desc: A pelican riding a bicycle along a seashore in the bottom-right corner: an SVG animation that reflects the agent working state (thinking/done), with a chime and an optional system notification when a reply finishes.

resources.name: liuwenji007/dsh-muyu
resources.desc: Electronic wooden fish in the bottom-right corner of the DSH web UI, a whale-girl sprite by default: tap the head to earn merit; it knocks by itself while the model is busy; per-session merit is stored locally, and the sprite can be swapped for custom art.

resources.name: LJXDSG12/dsh-liuyao
resources.desc: Six-yao (I Ching) divination for DeepSeek Harness — xiantian bagua backdrop, a Zhouyi opening verse, manual line entry or a simulated three-coin toss, najia charting (six relatives, six gods, void branches, hidden spirits, nayin, seasonal strength, transforming lines), an AI interpretation that cites its classical source for every statement, and a one-hexagram-one-question follow-up dialog. Zero npm dependencies; every request goes to the local DSH host, with no third-party network access.

resources.name: Lolancier/v-manager-dsh-pet
resources.desc: A Live2D pet companion for the DeepSeek Harness web UI: the Vivi (芊芊) character with petting/feeding, a daily-treat bond economy and mood-driven expressions.

resources.name: lsjspl/dsh-reel
resources.desc: Local media library management and playback powered by dsh Web: responsive on PC and mobile with touch swipe reels, instant seeking and on-the-fly transcoding.

resources.name: ltmroberthk915/dsh-pet
resources.desc: A fork of zhu1090093659/dsh-pet (Apache-2.0), adding per-conversation companions with whale-girl, MIKU and business blue whale skins, model-themed colors, token-rate animation, completion reminders and shared feeding and affinity.

resources.name: lubenkov/dsh-pajama-whale
resources.desc: A draggable pet in a blue-whale onesie: sticks to window edges, squashes flat, blinks, sleeps, and shows agent status in a thought cloud.

resources.name: Lucasli2018/totoro-pet
resources.desc: A desktop pet that lives in a floating overlay; click it to interact and switch between idle, sleeping, happy, and eating states.

resources.name: lucky8197/dsh-devquest
resources.desc: Turns coding into an RPG: finished turns, tool calls and completed todos earn XP, with 27+ achievement badges, levels, titles and seasons. Event-driven scoring with a pure-function engine — the work itself is the game.

resources.name: luumod/dsh-achievements
resources.desc: Achievement and gamification plugin: unlock badges for turns, tool calls, sessions, daily streaks and coding behavior (edits/reads/tests), with a badge wall, unlock toasts and a ctx.achievements SDK.

resources.name: luweiyabo/dsh-whale-pet
resources.desc: A polished floating whale desktop pet for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI with 95 categorized transparent animations, state-aware event reactions, customizable actions and triggers, click interactions, dragging and screen wandering.

resources.name: lyhtakeashot/dsh-lucky-block
resources.desc: Adds a draggable lucky-block button to the DeepSeek Harness web UI. Single-click plays zero-cost little performances (popups, a fake blue screen, daily fortune, trivia, cold jokes, music, and a set of visual stunts); a 1.4-second long-press mines the block open and starts a new session to write a random paper, read the news, invent something, or spin a short story. It also appends a "lucky block" choice to the model's multiple-choice questions and rolls a random pick, reversible by saying "rollback". Block appearance and event weights are adjustable in settings.

resources.name: MacilyDots/dsh-olivia-bridge
resources.desc: Reimplements the shut-down BSide: Olivia Lin letter API on loopback so the game client keeps sending and receiving letters: every incoming letter is delivered to one persistent DSH agent session, and the reply is written back to the local letter store.

resources.name: MarkGaster/dafiyu-dream
resources.desc: Sends excerpts from recent Chinese Markdown conversation exports to the DeepSeek API (API key required) to generate a dream, saved as a local Markdown file.

resources.name: marvin9551/dynamic-schulte-dsh
resources.desc: Dynamic Schulte grid waiting-time mini-game: click 1..N in order on a static grid or a spinning roulette wheel while the model thinks.

resources.name: marx-otto/dafeiyu-dsh-plugins#dafeiyu-pet-menu
resources.desc: Adds a Screen-sense submenu (turn on, turn off, and an interval of 15, 30, 60 or 120 seconds) to the dsh-pet desktop right-click menu, forwarding each choice to dafeiyu-screensense. dsh-pet exposes no menu extension point, so this plugin appends a marked patch to its renderer.js after backing the original up to renderer.js.dafeiyu.bak; the patch is idempotent and is re-applied when dsh-pet is reinstalled.

resources.name: marx-otto/dafeiyu-dsh-plugins#dafeiyu-screensense
resources.desc: Screen-sense mode for the dsh-pet desktop pet: captures the primary display every 30 seconds, compares an 8x8 average hash of each frame, and sends the screenshot to the session model when the frame changed (and again after the idle interval even if unchanged) so the pet comments in one short bubble line. Adds /fish, /fish_look and /fish_screen commands, a status and control HTTP pair, and a change threshold plus an idle repeat interval that can be tuned in the plugin config. Windows only (PowerShell WinForms).

resources.name: Matthew-Laplace/dsh-ark-pet
