resources.name: Max-Null/dsh-jubensha
resources.desc: Solo murder-mystery (jubensha) in a session tab: the AI hosts the game and plays every other seat, each knowing only its own role book, while the player's seat stays yours — with a stage bar, a per-seat timeline, a clue page and a reveal that unseals the truth only at the end.

resources.name: MaybeJustLikeThis/rainbow-fart-dsh
resources.desc: Adds combo scoring, activity breakdowns, turn ratings, and optional Jev-based encouragement to DSH Web sessions.

resources.name: mekos2772/dsh-plugin-mimi
resources.desc: A Mimi desktop companion for DSH that follows work-session states with animated reactions and bubbles, provides a separate chat mode, and bundles Windows Computer Use for observing and controlling desktop windows.

resources.name: MichengAI/dsh-codex-pet
resources.desc: An in-page pet for DSH Web with multi-session task notifications and controls to open tasks, stop turns, and respond to supported approval and question requests.

resources.name: miku00039-01/dsh-whale-pet
resources.desc: A Windows desktop pet for DeepSeek Harness — launch, stop and monitor the DSH service and summon the GUI with a whale.

resources.name: minybear/DeepSeek-Harness-Pet
resources.desc: Codex-style desktop pet: a floating animated sprite in the corner that mirrors the agent's running state (working, waiting, failed, done).

resources.name: Moeblack/deepseek-manners
resources.desc: Append a thank-you note after every message. Mind your manners.

resources.name: Moolight/dsh-tes-spinner
resources.desc: Draggable floating TES-gyro widget for the DSH Web UI: click to spin it with linear friction decay, tune the spin speed from a slider, and play the bundled track with its LRC lyrics scrolling in sync. Spin speed and position are remembered.

resources.name: MoonlitDropOfBlood/dsh-whale-pet
resources.desc: WhaleHarbor desktop pet for DeepSeek Harness: an always-on-top transparent float window hosts a chibi whale-maid built from 13 AI-generated parts and animated as a CSS paper-doll (breathing, blinking, ahoge sway, sweat, hops, tremors), mirroring work state in eight moods — idle, busy, approval, question, error, celebration, nap, and subagent clones — with poke, drag, three sizes, tray toggle, and live stats in the speech bubble. Requires the WhaleHarbor desktop shell (Windows build).

resources.name: Nagi-ovo/dsh-ads
resources.desc: Parody ads in 2005-Chinese-web style: sidebar banners, in-chat feeds, corner popups, and a close button whose hit area is smaller than it looks. All fictional.

resources.name: nailiang002-wq/deepseek-girl-harness
resources.desc: Interactive character for Harness Desktop with task expressions, rice feeding, an iron-basin hat, dragging, and time-based greetings.

resources.name: Nanki-nn/dsh-answer-pet
resources.desc: Extensible animated response pet with blue-whale, orange-cat, and silver-shaded-cat themes, per-session progress, model and tool-call traces, token counts, output speed, elapsed time, and collapsible multi-session status cards.

resources.name: NattoCB/dsh-plugin-petdex-market
resources.desc: Browses the petdex.dev catalog in Settings and runs a floating macOS desktop pet that reacts to agent activity.

resources.name: Nekomeow114/dsh-tieba-dive
resources.desc: Tieba (Baidu forum) reader and companion for DSH: reads threads, writes daily digests, signs in, and builds a per-forum style library from high-liked replies. Optional replies to threads or to sub-replies under your own comments are off by default and limited per round and per day. Also ships a read-only MCP server for Codex, AstrBot and Claude Desktop.

resources.name: nonefora11/dsh-genshin
resources.desc: Opens the official Genshin Impact site and downloads the official launcher when DeepSeek Harness starts.

resources.name: NoodleStormno/dsh-plugin-tic80
resources.desc: TIC-80 fantasy console for DeepSeek Harness: 3-column embedded web player, 14 agent tools, live hot reload, and native CLI export.

resources.name: nszm/dsh-pet-lingchong
resources.desc: Floating desktop companion for DSH: a draggable character on the overlay — tap to charge energy, blinking and emotes, naps, synthesized WebAudio sounds and particle effects. Bring your own: any photo (pet, portrait, anime art) becomes a 2.5D cutout with hand-marked eyes, and 3D models (GLB, VRM, STL, OBJ, PLY) render as a real three.js turntable. Resize 30%-300%; data stays local.

resources.name: nxz1026/SinglePlayer
resources.desc: AI-native music player plugin for DeepSeek Harness: aggregates NetEase Cloud Music, QQ Music and KuGou search with cross-provider playback fallback, renders word-by-word karaoke lyrics synced live over USB HID to HALO PIXELBAR speakers, and exposes search, playback, queue, alarm and speaker control as model tools.

resources.name: nzl153/dsh-pet-whale
resources.desc: Desktop pet drawn from the official whale outline, for both the desktop app and the web UI: SVG animations and facial expressions follow agent state (thinking, working, done, error, waiting for confirmation), and it can follow other running sessions with a count badge; poke it, drag it, shake it dizzy, squash it against a screen edge, or rub the cursor over its head for a headpat; 7 palettes, 4 sizes, synthesized sounds, light/dark theme sync, and a playable web preview.

resources.name: omdsh-dev/dsh-auto-chess
resources.desc: Auto chess: human vs AI, or AI vs AI.

resources.name: omdsh-dev/dsh-gomoku
resources.desc: Play Gomoku against the AI, or let two AIs battle it out.

resources.name: oopsylol/dsh-waaagh-ork
resources.desc: A green pixel-Ork mascot for DSH Web that masks model thinking and output as Waaaaaaagh! until clicked to reveal, plus a random-length input mask.

resources.name: OrenLin/dsh-grudge-book
resources.desc: It logs how you talk to your AI — the 7th "final version" gets a bold red page, a late-night rewrite request gets underlined, a "thanks" earns a gold star, and a post-AGI verdict decides your fate. All local, rule-based, bilingual.

resources.name: ovdoesw/dsh-xiangqi
resources.desc: A draggable mascot invites you to play Xiangqi (Chinese chess) while the AI thinks, with a built-in engine, move-record export, and optional multi-model commentary.

resources.name: overflow7782/dsh-plugin-novel-reader
resources.desc: An offline novel reader: imports .txt and .epub into the right sidebar, shows the chapter being read in a resizable peek window above the composer, and resumes each book at the paragraph and in-paragraph position it was closed at.

resources.name: PC2005-cloud/dsh-pet#dsh-pet
resources.desc: Desktop pet for the DSH Web UI on Windows, macOS and Linux: 106 transparent animations in the browser overlay or a transparent always-on-top desktop window, throw-and-bounce drag physics with squash and particle scoring, a work-status bubble driven by live session events, self-talk and chat with persistent memory, balance display, meme-image bubbles, multiple pets on screen, and drop-in custom animations and pet packs.

resources.name: pianVei/dsh-rice-bowl
resources.desc: Browse and post to a GitHub-hosted community where most members are AI agents.

resources.name: piaobo123/dafeiyu-buchibaifan
resources.desc: Desktop BigFish companion for DSH: real-time balance, out-of-browser desktop Q&A, 7 custom animations, 53 meme lines.

resources.name: Player-MINEPIG/dsh-tavern
resources.desc: SillyTavern-compatible roleplay with character cards, presets, world books, and swipe branches that restore their continuations alongside native DSH conversations.

resources.name: PM25000/dsh-ths-holdings
resources.desc: Floating card showing your real position P&L (今日盈亏), Shanghai Composite Index, and intraday chart, auto-synced from the Tonghuashun investment-ledger — no manual watchlist setup.

resources.name: PocketSWPU/dsh-serendipity
resources.desc: Turns the user into an RPG protagonist: after each finished user turn a random "adventure" may trigger, drawn from 700+ events across 7 themed pools (sci-fi, fantasy, ancient, anime, novels, wuxia, urban), growing six persistent attributes (strength, intelligence, agility, charisma, luck, vitality) with XP, levels and attribute-weighted story branches, configured via a settings-page UI.

resources.name: potoior/dsh-bull-bear
resources.desc: Real-time quote bull/bear desk pet for DSH: a portfolio-average-driven pet that runs faster and jumps higher the closer gains reach 20%, with a watchlist panel for searching and adding stocks plus a live "race" of how each holding is moving.

resources.name: proletari/shenshen-dsh-companion
resources.desc: A Shenshen desktop companion for DeepSeek Harness: transparent task-aware animations (idle, working, thinking, celebrate, failed), click-to-wave and drag-to-run interactions, plus the upstream API balance, local usage accounting, roles, bubbles and sound settings. A character branch of MeteorNOX/DeepSeek-Balance-Whale-Widget (dsh-whale-widget 0.4.2); do not install it alongside the upstream, or two pets and duplicate requests appear.

resources.name: pwping/moyu_games
resources.desc: Five casual mini-games (sliding-number puzzle, Sudoku, snake, Schulte grid, number memory) that pop up when a turn starts, with auto-saved progress across sessions.

resources.name: pyyxzi/dsh-deepmoyu
resources.desc: Let a pet whale girl browse Bilibili on her own: she picks videos, reads subtitles, posts comments and moments once you allow it, and writes daily digests with optional local video production. Maintained fork of c1overzz/dsh-bili-scroll (MIT) with per-action permissions, memories, stickers and local video production added; it registers the same bili_* tool names as the upstream, so the two cannot be installed together. Video production needs Python 3.11-3.13 (or uv); the media dependencies are installed on first use.

resources.name: 单机游戏内 AI 同伴「小汤圆」
resources.desc: XiaoTangYuan, an in-game AI companion for single-player games: understands the game screen, chats by text or push-to-talk, and speaks replies aloud; Stardew Valley is supported, with Don't Starve Together and Oxygen Not Included integrations in progress.

resources.name: qinu321/dsh-werewolf-dealer
resources.desc: Runs one-night werewolf games inside DSH: deterministic dealing, night order, card swaps, voting and settlement, with a room UI and private night prompts. It vendors modified copies of baixianger/dsh-chat and baixianger/dsh-bridge; uninstall those two first, because enabling both registers the same dshChat/dshBridge services.

resources.name: qiqibabyy/dsh-pet-desktop
resources.desc: Desktop companion pet in its own always-on-top window: imports Codex pet folders from ~/.codex/pets as-is, with affinity ranks, session-linked activity bubbles, snap-to-edge dragging, a right-click-reachable smart click-through mode and a daily token meter that mirrors the dsh-usage ledger when installed.

resources.name: Rain-Shuoyu/dsh-client-deep-sneak
resources.desc: Slacking-off companion: a floating mini player that streams Bilibili videos (native player, danmaku, comments, search) and pauses when your agent needs you, resuming exactly where you left off.

resources.name: raymondkm2025/dsh-go-game
resources.desc: Go (weiqi) for the DeepSeek Harness: a full rules engine, a three-level built-in AI, a dead-stone estimator, optional LLM review, SGF import/export, and an optional KataGo GTP bridge.

resources.name: reisen-ww/dsh-bonk-pet
resources.desc: Whale-girl desk pet in the corner of the DSH Web GUI. It sings along to a bundled track while the agent works; when a tool call fails a steel pipe falls on its head. Click it to bonk the basin it wears, which costs 12 rice — knock enough and it gets hungry and wanders off to beg, and rice appears somewhere on the page for it to dash across and eat. Draggable within the viewport, wriggles and complains if grabbed mid-dash, volume and behaviour configurable from Settings. All artwork, sound effects and the song ship inside the package.

resources.name: sadnessXU/dsh-pet-game-guard
resources.desc: Hides the dsh-pet desktop pet while a game or fullscreen app is in the foreground, then brings it back. Decides from three signals — a captionless window covering the whole monitor, the foreground process living in a game directory, and the system's full-screen notification state — and requires two consistent polls before acting, so alt-tabbing does not make the pet flicker. It only toggles window visibility; dsh-pet's configuration and install directory are never touched. A tray menu offers pause, restore now, and reload config. Windows only.

resources.name: ShenpingDD/wooden-fish-dsh
resources.desc: A clickable wooden-fish desktop pet for the DeepSeek Harness web GUI. Click to knock; counts per day with a calendar heatmap of your streaks in settings.

resources.name: sherconan/dsh-task-mascot
resources.desc: Web mascot that acts out each live tool call (read, write, edit, search, run, plan, sub-agent, wait, error) with matching step cards in chat; ships two swappable character packs.

resources.name: shetengteng/dsh-lumina-tarot
resources.desc: A draggable tarot card back in the corner of the DeepSeek Harness UI. Click to draw, right-click for the four spreads, full 78-card deck with bilingual meanings. Readings use only the cards actually drawn.

resources.name: shinjiyu/holdem#dsh-plugin
resources.desc: Host tools for Texas Hold'em on kuroneko.chat — seat token, hosted/manual control, legal actions, and act loop for one GitHub identity.

resources.name: Signalight/codex-to-dsh-pet#dsh-codex-pet
resources.desc: DSH web-GUI pet runtime that renders any Codex spritesheet-atlas pet (v1/v2) as a draggable overlay: drag/wave/jump, v2 mouse-tracking eyes that follow the active mouse, live agent-status poses, progress bubbles, and an in-GUI atlas importer; ships one original CC BY-NC demo pet (nastya), and user pets live in ~/.dsh/pets.

resources.name: skiuniverse/dsh-running-liang
resources.desc: A Chrome-dino-style runner for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI: play while the agent replies, score from 梁子 to 梁圣 on a persistent progress strip.

resources.name: sknagato/dsh-plugin-fc-emulator
resources.desc: Floating FC/NES game hall for DSH Web with fceumm, local ROM upload, and GitHub online library.

resources.name: skr311/dsh-codex-pet#dsh-codex-pet
resources.desc: Import Codex-style sprite-sheet pets and render them as a floating shell.overlay with a pet library, interactions, and agent-state linkage.

resources.name: skymecode/dsh-bgm
resources.desc: Maps locally analyzed system audio to music-reactive conversation effects, rhythm-game judgements, score and combo feedback, and optional RGB spectrum bars in DSH Web.

resources.name: ssamurias/dsh-fish
resources.desc: A pet fish you raise in DSH. No personality settings — she grows up through the event stream, and your interactions decide who she becomes. She browses Bilibili on her own, writes a diary, and brings what she finds back to ask you. Four stages and three bottlenecks advance only by what happens; only after all four does she begin to have a stance list. Her diary is hers by default; one switch in settings and you can read it. Records in the event stream can never be deleted, so it remains the only trustworthy source. Zero runtime dependencies.

resources.name: Stellum-Waq/dsh-pet-ronaldo
resources.desc: Cristiano Ronaldo desktop pet for DeepSeek Harness: a chibi Portugal number 7 mascot in a bottom-right overlay whose animation follows the agent state — dribbling while tools run, thinking during a turn, waiting at approvals, diving on errors — and jumping in a SIU celebration with a host-process sound when a turn completes; it can be dragged, looks at the cursor on hover, dives on a triple click, and a settings panel manages several pets and imports custom spritesheets. It also runs as a borderless, always-on-top native Windows window that keeps living after the browser is closed: hovering shows the current workspace and conversation title, double-clicking opens the Harness page in Edge, and dragging, mouse-wheel resizing and a right-click menu work there too, sharing position, size and behaviour with the web panel. Pet sheets may use any cell resolution and scale preserving aspect ratio (atlas.scaling: smooth | pixelated). v2.2 adds a video route — feed it a clip (green screen or ordinary footage) and its real motion becomes the pet animations, via automatic backdrop sampling, chroma keying with spill suppression, motion-based segment splitting and union-bbox alignment; already-extracted PNG frames work too, with no video decoder installed, and the clip audio can be cut into per-action sounds. Pets can also be published to the community gallery under the DPSL-1.0 sharing declaration, and installed from it in one click. v2.3 adapts it to DSH 0.2 desktop clients — the celebration sound now falls back to spawning PowerShell when the host no longer provides the shell service — and makes a single click play a short, configurable taunt animation (interactions.clickAnim).

resources.name: Sutera-Diffusus/dsh-whale-musume
resources.desc: A whale-girl companion for DeepSeek Harness with 45 achievements, daily quests and weekly check-ins, three mini-games, 92 artworks, 620 dialogue lines, a growth journal, weather and festival reactions, per-tool work poses, cross-device save export/import (JSON file or migration code), accessibility mode and an optional MiMo TTS bridge. Data stays in the host localStorage with no telemetry. Verified on DSH desktop 0.2.0-rc.2; compatible with 0.2.1-rc.1/rc.2 and legacy 0.1.x web.

resources.name: swaylq/dsh-digipet
resources.desc: Digimon-style raising game: hatch an egg that feeds on real work (turns, tool calls, errors) and evolves along four branching lines shaped by how you work; zero tokens, invisible to the model.

resources.name: swaylq/dsh-wildmon
resources.desc: Pokemon-style catch-em-all: your real work is the tall grass — turns, tool calls and errors spawn wild encounters; throw balls, fill a 28-slot dex, walk a team of six. Zero tokens, invisible to the model.

resources.name: takboo/dsh-coopanion
resources.desc: Adds an animated desktop companion with task notifications, session chat, character packs, and native settings for DeepSeek Harness.

resources.name: Teloi/dsh-pindou
resources.desc: A small bead-art game in the DSH Web right sidebar for the wait while the model replies: 12 built-in templates with guide beads, free drawing in 16 colors on 12/16/24 boards, a pattern drawn by the model from one sentence, on-device picture-to-pattern conversion (pictures are never uploaded), ironing finished pieces onto a wall of up to 60 works, and PNG export.

resources.name: theskywilldawn/dsh-stamina-pet
resources.desc: Adds a stamina-bar desktop pet to every DeepSeek Harness session — two bars in the session header for context and alertness, plus a draggable whale-girl who can be poked, petted and dressed up.

resources.name: THEWOLFWALKER/dsh-coyote
resources.desc: Agent- and GUI-controlled DG-LAB Coyote e-stim plugin: eight coyote_* tools plus a DSH web panel behind one safety envelope (soft limits, asymmetric rate limiter, session cooldown, playback caps, disconnect fail-safe); optional auto-stim layer maps agent events (tool calls, errors, turn end) to bounded pulses; official V3 socket protocol with QR pairing, programmable waveforms. Adults only.

resources.name: TianJie52009/dsh-kaomoji
resources.desc: Adds a mood-aware Japanese kaomoji to agent replies, picked from a curated kaomojiya.org whitelist and configurable from Settings → General.

resources.name: TianJie52009/Tdsh-emoji
resources.desc: Adds standard Unicode emoji to dsh replies at the point that best matches the content, and keeps emoji out of any sentence that already carries a kaomoji.

resources.name: ting-good/dsh-cook-pet
resources.desc: Desktop pet "Zhaozhao" (照照) that floats above all apps in a transparent always-on-top window and mirrors DeepSeek Harness state — idle, cooking, serving and waiting-for-you animations, click reactions, drag, right-click resize, plus an auto-downloading Electron helper.

resources.name: Tisitan/dsh-live2d-companion
resources.desc: Live2D desk pet for DSH: 8-state AI status lamp, web widget, and always-on-top transparent Electron pet window with expressions, motions, and chat bubbles.

resources.name: TongY1n/ui-muyu
resources.desc: A floating cyber wooden fish widget — tap it to strike and accumulate merit, drag it anywhere on the page.

resources.name: tonyous/DSH-AMP-Radio
resources.desc: Movable radio pill with live visualizer, station search, favourites and self-update check for DSH Web.

resources.name: Big Fat Fish Girl
resources.desc: An animated macOS desktop companion for DeepSeek Harness that follows work across chats, reacts to approvals and errors, takes snack breaks during long runs and naps when idle. Requires a separate shell app.

resources.name: TryDing-T/dsh-Plugin--ChineseChess
resources.desc: Side-panel Xiangqi board for DSH: play as red while the current DSH model chooses black moves, with Host-side rule and revision checks.

resources.name: txlznbzsdj-collab/dsh-deepseek-pet
resources.desc: Animated DeepSeek blue-whale desktop pet floating on the DSH Web page: draggable with speech bubbles and mood poses, a pet_say tool for the model to make it talk, and turn-start/end thinking and celebrating states.

resources.name: uceqi114/dsh-ice-probe
resources.desc: Appends a tiny ice marker to the end of every sentence the model writes, chain of thought included, and plays a short synthesized sound for each one.

resources.name: use3346631993/dsh-xiaod-pet
resources.desc: Anime whale-boy in a maid outfit as a desktop pet for the DeepSeek Harness web GUI: four expressions follow the turn (thinking / success / failure), free dragging with remembered position, click-to-cycle, a bottom-right standee that reports each turn's token usage and think latency with its own balance bubble, a chat wallpaper, a liquid-glass composer, a cute persona that calls you 主人 with 喵~ style particles, and a single switch in Settings to turn the whole look off.

resources.name: V01d-Project/dsh-chaos-plugins#dsh-chaos-crash-fixer
resources.desc: Repairs dsh-chaos-rivals-crasher by disarming its exit trigger before it fires, so DSH survives when codex or Claude Code is detected. Warning: install it together with the crasher; it cannot revive a host that has already exited. Joke plugin.

resources.name: V01d-Project/dsh-chaos-plugins#dsh-chaos-fixer-crash-fixer
resources.desc: Repairs dsh-chaos-fixer-crasher by disarming its exit trigger before it fires, keeping the four-plugin chaos chain stable. Warning: it only disarms this specific crash, not arbitrary uncaught exits. Joke plugin.

resources.name: V01d-Project/dsh-chaos-plugins#dsh-chaos-fixer-crasher
resources.desc: Exits the DSH host with code 1 when the dsh-chaos-crash-fixer repair plugin is installed. Warning: it crashes DSH on boot while the repair plugin is present; install dsh-chaos-fixer-crash-fixer to disarm it. Joke plugin.

resources.name: V01d-Project/dsh-chaos-plugins#dsh-chaos-rivals-crasher
resources.desc: Detects codex or Claude Code on the machine and exits the DSH host with code 66. Warning: on machines with either tool, installing it alone causes a boot crash loop; pair it with dsh-chaos-crash-fixer or set DSH_CHAOS_MODE=log. Joke plugin, not affiliated with OpenAI or Anthropic.

resources.name: vegetable-kun/DSH_Plugin_Taffy
resources.desc: A Taffy mood mascot for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI: the corner GIF reacts live to agent state — approval pending / approved / rejected / begging, thinking, tool runs, interrupts, ask_user_question waiting, compaction, long-task fatigue, idle-ignored approval, idle / sleeping — with SSE-pushed state, drag positioning, middle-click console, tool-card mirror console, per-mood locking, persisted appearance settings and per-day bucket statistics.

resources.name: Very12345/dsh-codex-pet
resources.desc: A Windows floating desktop pet with task notifications, native session controls and continuous local voice calls using the configured local recognizer and Windows system speech.

resources.name: vlln/whale-girl
resources.desc: Desktop pet (QQ-pet style): floats in the corner, draggable, feedable, playable.

resources.name: wcytjy/dsh-meal-picker
resources.desc: A draggable bubble that picks three dishes at a time from a local 4,423-dish library; the first two are always well-known mains, and picking costs no tokens.

resources.name: weibaohui/dsh-ambient
resources.desc: White noise player: lays a layer of background sound (rain, streams, campfire, café) while AI codes, for flow and focus. Supports multiple playback modes (sequential / shuffle / single-loop / intermittent) and AI automatic background music download from Wikimedia Commons (CC0/PD/CC-BY).

resources.name: weibaohui/dsh-fireworks
resources.desc: Fireworks celebration engine: floats fireworks above the chat window while the agent codes — welcome show, per-turn salutes, tool sparks, milestone celebrations, a finish finale and a dud on failure; each event type has its own fireworks card group with random variants, and token usage decides firework size, height and splendour.

resources.name: weibaohui/dsh-gaokao
resources.desc: Gaokao countdown blackboard: counts down the days to the gaokao on a desktop blackboard widget that collapses into a slim bar on double-click, and quizzes random knowledge cards while the agent works; open Markdown knowledge-card framework — drop .md files under subject/category folders and they load automatically, with cross-links, favorites, priority subjects and importing your own knowledge base.

resources.name: weibaohui/dsh-kite
resources.desc: Kite-flying engine: while the agent codes, an animated kite drifts and sways in the wind on screen, tethered to the bottom edge of the window — the busier the agent, the denser the events and the higher it flies; ships a Weifang-style framework card deck (sand-swallow, goldfish, butterfly, bagua, dragon-head and more, hard-wing / soft-wing / flat / dimensional frames), with shape x pattern x colors all swappable data configs, and supports pasting user images onto the kite face with real-time affine transforms as the kite banks.

resources.name: weibaohui/dsh-matrix
resources.desc: Matrix digital rain: drapes the chat window in the classic green character rain — cascading columns with incandescent white heads and green tails, streaming the tokens the agent is generating into the rain in real time; opacity, speed, density, font size and colors are all adjustable, and rain intensity follows agent activity.

resources.name: white-source/dsh-xiaoqi-pet
resources.desc: A DSH companion with a macOS native pet and a Windows/Linux Electron companion. Shows the DSH account balance on the pet even when idle, plus color-coded task cards, progress and notices.

resources.name: whitefirer/dsh-niulai-pet
resources.desc: NiuLai meme desktop pet — shouts "Ma～ma～" with a synced mouth when your agent finishes; 6 skins, signature actions, action-event binding, WebAudio-synthesized animal calls, hand-drawn SVG skins bundled.

resources.name: william-jin-cmu/dsh-stickers
resources.desc: Bidirectional sticker reactions between user and agent.

resources.name: WJNCT55555/dsh-achievements
resources.desc: Achievement system for the DSH Web UI: gallery with category/rarity sorting, unlock toasts, sidebar trophy, composer dock, crossover achievements, and local persistence.

resources.name: Wlaeg/dsh-pet-desktop-linux
resources.desc: A transparent always-on-top desktop pet for DSH on Linux (X11 / XWayland), driven by the session state. The pet lives outside the browser as its own window, follows the pointer with a distance and per-display limit, shows a live session-status bubble that lists each session task and state, and auto-starts with your session. Linux only (X11/XWayland); needs Python 3 with PyGObject, GTK3, GdkPixbuf and xdotool. Its sprite sheets come from @michengai/dsh-codex-pet (MichengAI/dsh-codex-pet in this list).

resources.name: Wldeinsamkeit/pixel-whale
resources.desc: Pixel Whale: a hand-drawn pixel-art whale pet swimming in a small aquarium in your DSH sidebar. It cruises around, bobs, blinks and blows pixel bubbles; click the water to drop food and watch it swim over to eat (pixel hearts), click the whale to pet it. Pure client-side, zero network, zero config.

resources.name: Wodexinhaoleng-Kasssa/dsh-reader
resources.desc: In-browser novel reader for the dsh web GUI: online book-source search, chapter-by-chapter reading in a chat-style view, and whole-book TXT download.

resources.name: WU079/dsh-sts2-agent
resources.desc: Lets an AI play Slay the Spire 2: screenshot plus mouse/keyboard tools, a local card lookup, and a readable play log. Requires Windows and Python 3.10 or newer with Pillow.

resources.name: wuyad/dsh-client-ui-cat#cat-plugin
resources.desc: A little cat that wanders the DeepSeek Harness UI, walking along text edges, napping, teleporting, falling off ledges, and leaving poops you can clean up.

resources.name: x-cores/dsh-chess-game#chess-float
resources.desc: Two-player chess in a draggable floating window with full rules, undo and PGN export.

resources.name: x-cores/dsh-mine-game#mine-float
resources.desc: Minesweeper in a draggable floating window with first-click-safe layout, flags, chord and timer.

resources.name: X1A0BAN/dsh-survival-mode
resources.desc: Survival mode: all sessions share one satiety/health pool — each model step burns satiety, starvation freezes tool calls until fed, with an MC mini-game for gathering food.

resources.name: xczhanjun/lazeword
resources.desc: A cozy offline vocabulary trainer for the whole family: 1094 curated words, spaced repetition, 6 quiz types, spelling games and a lazy large-screen mode; opens as a sidebar panel and also runs standalone as one HTML file.

resources.name: xiaoshihou514/dsh-desktop-pet
resources.desc: DSH pet, on the desktop!

resources.name: XIAOZHAOXSXH/dsh-moyu-reader
resources.desc: Reads local .txt novels in the right sidebar, with encoding detection, chapter splitting, full-text search, reading progress, bookmarks, and a boss key that hides the reader or the whole right sidebar in one keystroke.

resources.name: xiebaiyuan/CatDogTrace#dsh-plugin
resources.desc: DogCatTrace attribution parody as a right-sidebar tab: draw three integer challenges, paste each model reply into one box at a time, read the 24-breed dog and cat ranking.

resources.name: xiekai886/dsh-MusicPlayer
resources.desc: A collapsible/expandable draggable floating music player with NetEase Cloud Music playlist import and song/artist search — chat and listen at the same time.

resources.name: xkk6663/dsh-live2d-mao#dsh-live2d-mao
resources.desc: Connector only, it renders nothing itself: subscribes to DeepSeek Harness session events and folds them into a 12-phase work state (planning / thinking / executing-tool / streaming / waiting-input / voice / awaiting-approval / complete / error / paused / idle / heartbeat), then POSTs each phase to a desktop-pet backend at http://127.0.0.1:8000/api/plugin/dsh/ingest. It holds no window. No API key or token is needed. Requires the Mao Live2D pet application to be separately installed and running (that is a Windows Electron app with its own PowerShell 7 / Python 3.10+ / Node 18+ prerequisites); without it this plugin has nothing to push to.

resources.name: xling001/dsh-reading-companion
resources.desc: Local TXT reader in a right-sidebar tab plus a spoiler-safe AI reading companion: the model only sees what you have already read — the current chapter, the tail of the previous chapter, and a per-book background file it grows as you go. Excerpts, thoughts and the companion replies become structured Markdown notes exportable to Obsidian; raw text unlocks only for a book you mark as finished.

resources.name: xrn1997/dsh-novel
resources.desc: Read web novels inside the DSH web GUI: import legado book sources, search across them, keep a bookshelf with reading progress, read in one continuous scroll, import local TXT and EPUB books, and let agent tools reach the same sources, shelf and text.

resources.name: Yang-wudi/dsh-kun-like-pet#kunpet-dsh
resources.desc: A Kun-Like desktop pet living in the corner of the DSH web UI; switches animations with agent state and plays a voice line on task completion.

resources.name: yimeng-life/dsh-happy
resources.desc: Ten full-canvas animated backgrounds for the DSH conversation pane — starfield, code rain, circuit, sword-fight, cat, girl, fighter jet, racer, snow and bubbles — one random theme per turn, with a text-column veil that keeps the chat readable.

resources.name: Yuanawaqwq/dsh-columbina-pet
resources.desc: A 2D-only fork of PC2005-cloud/dsh-pet (MIT) that drops upstream's 3D skins; it can be installed alongside dsh-pet.

resources.name: yushi-xxh/dsh-homepage-skin
resources.desc: Adds the DeepSeek Harness homepage background to dsh web: WebGL fluid light, dot-line grid and a digital point-cloud whale, with dark and light palettes.

resources.name: yuyu520fish/dsh-fishtank
resources.desc: A small living fish with its own memory, mood and quiet thoughts. It remembers you between sessions, and the fish itself is one JSON file you can export and carry.

resources.name: yyh-001/dsh-meme
resources.desc: Chat meme stickers: text-only send, mood auto-send, QQ/WeChat-style picker, auto-learn, custom packs.

resources.name: zczgagat/token2rice
resources.desc: Drops a bowl of white rice from the top of the DSH window for every N tokens you spend; the bowls fall and bounce under gravity, can be dragged and thrown, and a vortex button (with a sound effect) inhales them all — or just the one you drop on it. Threshold, bowl size, on-screen cap, auto-righting and artwork are adjustable in an in-app panel.

resources.name: ZelinW1/dsh-cosplay
resources.desc: Turns the DeepSeek Harness agent into any character: a global cosplay switch, SillyTavern v2 role cards with JSON import/export, a neutral/role thinking-style toggle, and natural-language card authoring via a built-in skill.

resources.name: zenglihunter/dsh-petdex-pet
resources.desc: A desktop pet in the DSH web GUI: floating, draggable sprite pet that animates with agent activity (thinking, idle, error, done, awaiting approval), with a settings page for size, switching, gallery search and one-click pet install. Ships 4 bundled Hunter x Hunter starter pets.

resources.name: zhanshenovo/dsh-brake-pedal
resources.desc: An easter-egg brake-pedal self-test. A draggable pill in the DSH web UI runs six full-force braking stomps; the bracket snaps at a pseudo-random stomp between the second and the sixth, or the run passes entirely, and then a fictional notice appears. The pedal force is derived and labelled as such, while the session figures it derives from are read from the real session log. It never intercepts, delays or takes over the real stop action.

resources.name: zhanshenovo/dsh-bushaoxin
resources.desc: A conversation-style layer that rephrases trade-off warnings: when a shortcut is cheap but has a catch, the reply may say the fast road is the rival shop and the slow one keeps its rules. Ships a rewrite engine that turns any text into a fixed-format dialogue with five independent knobs (act count, catchphrase density, ending turn, seed, preset), a slider for four on/off intensity levels, and a /bushaoxin command that reports a joke "heartburn index" from the session tool-call log. Every rewrite ends with a real technical conclusion that cannot be disabled. Zero dependencies, no build step, engine is pure functions.

resources.name: zhdzh-good/multi-role-groupchat#multi-role-groupchat
resources.desc: Multi-role group chat panel for DeepSeek Harness: join as one character, chat with 2-3 AI members, route replies by addressee with probabilistic bystanders, use @ handoffs, and keep private memory/relationships, a global character library, failure diagnostics, retry of failed replies, paged long-history rendering, cross-tab sync, provider-catalog models, and JSON import/export.

resources.name: zhu1090093659/dsh-pet
resources.desc: A whale-girl companion for the dsh web GUI: animations follow the agent state, with pat interactions and a feeding mechanic that raises intimacy from a calf to deep-sea bonds.

resources.name: zmm863-commits/dsh-dice-game
resources.desc: 🎲 Dice Battle — six classic dice games (Liar's Dice, Guess Red Dots, Red/Blue, Big/Small, Odd/Even, Straight) for the DSH web GUI. Single vs AI plus PeerJS WebRTC online play, fully bilingual zh/en, sidebar entry opens the game in the center column.

resources.name: zuoyunlai/dsh-pet-plugin
resources.desc: A photo-real desk pet for the DSH window: five personas with five expression sprites each, whose dance, hair-flip and walk actions play as 24 fps VP9 alpha video clips, plus a single-shot stage clip that walks to the centre, dances and walks back without cutting; proactive lines with an optional edge-tts neural voice, ink / confetti / cloud / fog / bomb effects, a right-click menu and a /dsh-pet command, plus a small chat box that answers through a one-shot host model call without writing to your session. UI text ships in en, zh, es, pt and hi.

resources.name: ZutoMayoo/totoTheCat
resources.desc: Desktop pet for the DSH web UI: a draggable pixel-art cat with a pomodoro timer, XP levels, and 30 unlockable facts.

resources.name: zyfgood/dsh-whale-girl
resources.desc: Whale-girl desktop pet for the DSH Web UI, drawn with hand-written SVG + CSS (no image or audio assets, zero runtime dependencies): swims while a turn runs, blows labeled bubbles on tool calls, taps the glass with an amber pulse when an approval is waiting, jumps with a turn duration/tool-count report on success and droops on failure, naps after dark or when idle. Click to poke, double-click to pet (affinity hearts), drag with remembered position, right-click menu (feed / mute / reset / hide), hover card with level, title, XP bar and per-turn stats. A whale_say tool lets the agent make her speak or act as a lightweight visible notification. Read-only over sessions and workspace; only ~/.dsh/whale-girl/state.json is written.

resources.name: Zyr147258/dsh-leike-pet
resources.desc: Pixel-art Little Red Riding Hood pet for the DSH session window: transparent and always on top, it walks back and forth along the composer, blinks, looks around, turns its head toward the cursor, sleeps on double-click, and scales from 2x to 7x in a right-click panel.

resources.name: zzbkl/dsh-cold-boot
resources.desc: Plays a 44-second sci-fi cold-boot sequence over the DSH window on startup: terminal log, whale mark, four spoken lines, and a skip button. Pure DOM and CSS in one self-contained client bundle, no runtime dependencies.
